# Brahmavaivarta-purāṇa 2

## Chapter 1

## \|\| 1.1 \|\|

*śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ \|*  
*śrīveṅkaṭeśvarāya namaḥ \|*  
*. śrīmahāsarasvatyai namaḥ \|*  
*. śrīlakṣmīnarasiṃhābhyāṃ namaḥ \|*  
*. atha prakṛtikhaṇḍaprāraṃbhaḥ \|*  
*. nārada uvāca \|*  
*gaṇeśajananī durgā rādhā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī \|*  
*sāvitrī vai sṛṣṭividhau prakṛtiḥ pañcadhā smṛtā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said — Durga, the mother of Ganesha, Radha, Lakshmi, Sarasvati and Savitri are known as the five goddesses of Prakriti. The creation is dependent on them.

## \|\| 1.2-3 \|\|

*āvirbabhūva sā kena kā vā sā jñānināṃ varā \|*  
*kiṃ vā tallakṣaṇaṃ brūhi sābhavatpañcadhā katham \|\| 2 \|\|*

*sarvāsāṃ caritaṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ kathamīpsitam \|*  
*avatāraṃ kutra kasyāstanmāṃ vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. О best of the intellectuals, who is the creator of this Prakriti or its form and could it be described? How has it been described as fivefold? You kindly enlighten me on their life story, the methods of their adoration and the one who incarnated at instance of these goddesses.

## \|\| 1.4 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*prakṛterlakṣaṇaṃ vatsa ko vā vaktuṃ kṣamo bhavet \|*  
*kiṃcittathāpi vakṣyāmi yacchrutaṃ dharmavaktrataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Narayana said — О son who could be competent enough to described details about the formation of each one of them. Still I am going to tell you whatever I have heard from the mouth of Dharma.

## \|\| 1.5-7 \|\|

*prakṛṣṭavācakaḥ praśca kṛtiśca sṛṣṭivācakaḥ \|*  
*sṛṣṭau prakṛṣṭā yā devī prakṛtiḥ sā prakīrtitā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*guṇe prakṛṣṭasattve ca praśabdo vartate śrutau \|*  
*madhyame kṛśca rajasi tiśabdastamasi smṛtaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*triguṇātmasvarūpā yā sarvaśaktisamanvitā \|*  
*pradhānā sṛṣṭikaraṇe prakṛtistena kathyate \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. The word Prakriti means the goddess who can resort to the creation. In the Vedas the word pra stands for Sattvaguna and word kr stands for Rajoguna while the word ti stands for Tamogiina. Therefore, the one in whom all the three gunas are enshrined and is all powerful one, is known as Prakriti.

## \|\| 1.8 \|\|

*prathame varttate praśca kṛtissyātsṛṣṭivācakaḥ \|*  
*sṛṣṭerādyā ca yā devī prakṛtiḥ sā prakīrtitā \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. In the initial meaning the word pra is known for the creation and krti is used for that what is created. Therefore, the eternal force which is responsible for the creation of the universe in enabled Prakriti.

## \|\| 1.9 \|\|

*yogenātmā sṛṣṭividhau dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ \|*  
*pumāṃśca dakṣiṇārddhāṅgo vāmāṅgaḥ prakṛtiḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. At the time of creation she, in combination with the eternal Brahman, appeared in two forms. The one who is created out of the right side is given the name of Purusa and the one who emerges out of her left side is given the name of Prakrit.

## \|\| 1.10 \|\|

*sā ca brahmasvarūpā syānmāyā nityā sanātanī \|*  
*yathā''tmā ca yathāśaktiryathā'gnau dāhikā smṛtā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. She is the illusion of that form of Brahman which is eternal everlasting. He is like the power of the fire, which always remains inherent with the same.

## \|\| 1.11 \|\|

*ataeva hi yogīndraḥ strīpuṃbhedaṃ na manyate \|*  
*sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ brahmañchaśvatpaśyati nārada \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O Narada, therefore, the great yogis do not consider any difference between and the men and the women. They look at them as the form of Brahman.

## \|\| 1.12 \|\|

*svecchāmayasyecchayā ca śrīkṛṣṇasya sisṛkṣayā \|*  
*sā''virbabhūva sahasā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О Brahman, Isvarl, the miila-Prakriti has been created of her own sweet-will as per the desire of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 1.13 \|\|

*tadājñayā pañcavidhā sṛṣṭikarmaṇi bhedataḥ \|*  
*atha bhaktānurodhādvā bhaktānugrahavigrahā \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. At his command she takes to five fold form for the purpose of creation. Or in order to bestow her grace over her devotees, she takes to a definite form.

## \|\| 1.14-16 \|\|

*gaṇeśamātā durgā yā śivarūpā śivapriyā \|*  
*nārāyaṇī viṣṇumāyā pūrṇabrahmasvarūpiṇī \|\| 14 \|\|*

*brahmādidevairmunibhirmanubhiḥ pūjitā sadā \|*  
*sarvādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā brahmarūpā sanātanī \|\| 15 \|\|*

*yaśomaṅgaladharmaśrīsatyapuṇyapradāyinī \|*  
*mokṣaharṣapradātrīyaṃ śokaduḥkhārtināśinī \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. Durga the mother of Ganesha, is the beloved of lord Shiva. She is the fonn of Brahman and is NarayanI, the illusion of Vishnu as well, who is adored by Brahma, Vishnu, sages and Manus always. She happens to be the family deity and is the form of eternal Brahman. She is the bestower of glory, welfare, dharma, fortune, truth, merits and salvation. She also run ones the misery.

## \|\| 1.17 \|\|

*śaraṇāgatadīnārtaparitrāṇaparāyaṇā \|*  
*tejaḥsvarūpā paramā tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. She always engaged in protecting the people who take refuge in her. She is illustrious and is considered to be the family deity.

## \|\| 1.18 \|\|

*sarvaśaktisvarūpā ca śaktirīśasya santatam \|*  
*siddheśvarī siddharūpā siddhidā siddhideśvarī \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. She is all powerful and bestows prowess on Shiva always. She is also the one who grants success.

## \|\| 1.19-20 \|\|

*buddhirnidrā kṣutpipāsā cchāyā tandrā dayā smṛtiḥ \|*  
*jātiḥ kṣāntiśca śāntiśca kāṃtirbhrāntiśca cetanā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭistathā lakṣmīrvṛttirmātā tathaiva ca \|*  
*sarvaśaktisvarūpā sā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. She is also known for granting, intelligence, sleep, hunger, thirst, shade, glory, illusion, consciousness, satisfaction, preservation and Lakshmi (riches). These are all the goddesses which bestow their grace and form part of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 1.21 \|\|

*uktaḥ śrutau śrutaguṇaścātisvalpo yathāgamam \|*  
*guṇo'styananto'nantāyā aparāṃ ca niśāmaya \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Shruti is treated to be possessing the best of qualities out of all these and has been described in the Agaman. She is the endless one and possesses endless qualities. Now you listen to her other forms.

## \|\| 1.22 \|\|

*śuddhasattvasvarūpā yā padmā ca paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*sarvasampatsvarūpā yā tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Padma is the other shakti of lord Vishnu who is blissful, bestower of all the riches and possesses all of them.

## \|\| 1.23-24 \|\|

*kāntā dāntā'tiśāntā ca suśīlā sarvamaṅgalā \|*  
*lobhānmohātkāmaroṣānmadāhaṅkāratastathā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tyaktā'nuraktā patyuśca sarvādyā ca pativratā \|*  
*prāṇatulyā bhagavataḥ premapātrī priyaṃvadā \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. She is extremely beautiful, self disciplined, extremely peaceful, quiet humble and is bestower of welfare to all. She is free from the sins of greed, passions, attraction, anger, intoxication and pride. She bestows her grace on all his devotees and she loved lord Hail By nature, she is eternal and chaste and is the beloved of the lord. She is sweet spoken and very dear to the lord.

## \|\| 1.25 \|\|

*sarvasasyātmikā sarvajīvanopāyarūpiṇī \|*  
*mahālakṣmīśca vaikuṇṭhe patisevāparāyaṇā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. She bestows enough of harvest and like Laks ml who always think of the welfare of all and serve lord Vishnu in Vaikuntha.

## \|\| 1.26 \|\|

*svarge ca svargalakṣmīśca rājalakṣmīśca rājasu \|*  
*gṛhe ca gṛhalakṣmīśca martyānāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ tathā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. When she remains in the heaven, she is known as SvargaLakshmi, when she resides with the kings she is known as Raja-Lakshmi, When she resides with the house-holders she is known as Grhalaks ml.

## \|\| 1.27 \|\|

*sarveṣu prāṇidravyeṣu śobhārūpā manoharā \|*  
*prītirūpā puṇyavatāṃ prabhārūpā nṛpeṣu ca \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. She happens to be the glory of all the kings, is quite charming and happens to be the lustre of the kings as well as the noble souls.

## \|\| 1.28 \|\|

*vāṇijyarūpā vaṇijāṃ pāpināṃ kalahaṅkarī \|*  
*dayāmayī bhaktamātā bhaktānugrahakārikā \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. She pervades the business community as the business and the quarrels with the quarrelsome people. She is quite compassionate, mother of the devotees and bestowers her grace on them.

## \|\| 1.29 \|\|

*capale capalā bhaktasampado rakṣaṇāya ca \|*  
*jagajjīvanmṛtaṃ sarvaṃ yayā devyā vinā mune \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. О sage, she is unstable like the lightening and protects the riches of her devotees. Without her the entire universe looks as dead.

## \|\| 1.30 \|\|

*śaktirdvitīyā kathitā vedoktā sarvasammatā \|*  
*sarvapūjyā sarvavandyā cānyāṃ matto niśāmaya \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Tlius I have spoken about the second force according to the description of the Vedas. She is adorable by all. Now I am going to tell you the qualities of the other goddess.

## \|\| 1.31 \|\|

*vāgbuddhividyājñānādhidevatā paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*sarvavidyāsvarūpā yā sā ca devī sarasvatī \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Sarasvati is known to be the speech of the lord besides being his wisdom, intellectual and knowledge.

## \|\| 1.32 \|\|

*subuddhiḥ kavitā medhā pratibhā smṛtidā satām \|*  
*nānāprakārasiddhāntabhedārthakalpanāpradā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. She bestows the best of intelligence to the noble people besides granting them the wisdom for creating poetry, illustriousness and bestows the creative imagination to the people.

## \|\| 1.33 \|\|

*vyākhyābodhasvarūpā ca sarvasaṃdehabhañjinī \|*  
*vicārakāriṇī granthakāriṇī śaktirūpiṇī \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. She is the one, who can bestow all the knowledge. She removes all the doubts, is a thinker and composer of all the texts.

## \|\| 1.34-38 \|\|

*sarvasaṅgītasandhānatālakāraṇarūpiṇī \|*  
*viṣayajñānavāgrūpā prativiśvaṃ ca jīvinām \|\| 34 \|\|*

*yayā vinā ca viśvaugho mūko mṛtasamaḥ sadā \|*  
*vyākhyāmudrākarā śāntā vīṇāpustakadhāriṇī \|\| 35 \|\|*

*śuddhasattvasvarūpā yā suśīlā śrīharipriyā \|*  
*himacandanakundendukumudāmbhojasannibhā \|\| 36 \|\|*

*japantī paramātmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ratnamālayā \|*  
*tapassvarūpā tapasāṃ phaladātrī tapasvinī \|\| 37 \|\|*

*siddhividyāsvarūpā ca sarvasiddhipradā sadā \|\| 38 \|\|*

34-38. She bestow the knowledge of playing on musical instruments with several tunes. She happens to be the subject of intelligence and speech in all the creatures. Without her the entire universe would seem to be deaf and dumb. Her hand is always raised in Vyakhyana-mudrcl. She is of peaceful appearance and hold a vina and book in her hands. She is sinless quite humble and is the beloved of lord Shiva. She is of white complexion resembling the snow, sandal-paste, lotus flowers and the moon. She is adored with a necklace of white gems and always recites the name of Krishna, she is always engaged in tapas and also bestows on people the reward for their tapas. She is like an ascetic and bestower of success always.

## \|\| 1.39-41 \|\|

*yathāgamaṃ yathākiñcidaparāṃ saṃnibodha me \|*  
*mātā caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ vedāṅgānāṃ ca chandasām \|\| 39 \|\|*

*sandhyāvandanamantrāṇāṃ tantrāṇāṃ ca vicakṣaṇā \|*  
*dvijādijātirūpā ca japarūpā tapasvinī \|\| 40 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇyatejorūpā ca sarvasaṃskārakāriṇī \|*  
*pavitrarūpā sāvitrī gāyatrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā \|\| 41 \|\|*

39-41. After describing her according to the shastras. I now describe the fourth goddess. You listen to me. She is the creator of all the Vedas their subsidiary texts, the science of meters, the sandhva-vandana and the hymns beside the tantras. She has taken to this form for the welfare of the twice-born. She is always engaged in recitation, she is like an ascetic, has the lustre of Brahman and bestows all the Samskaras. She is known by the name of Savitri or Gayatri. She is the beloved of Brahma.

## \|\| 1.42-44 \|\|

*tīrthāni yasyāḥ saṃsparśaṃ darśaṃ vāñchanti śuddhaye \|*  
*śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśā śuddhasattvasvarūpiṇī \|\| 42 \|\|*

*paramānandarūpā ca paramā ca sanātanī \|*  
*parabrahmasvarūpā ca nirvāṇapadadāyinī \|\| 43 \|\|*

*brahmatejomayī śaktistadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā \|*  
*yatpādarajasā pūtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ ca nārada \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. All the sacred places aspire to have an audience with her or to touch her. She has the crystal like lustre, possesses pure form of sattva, is blissful, eternal, everlasting, the form of eternal Brahman and is the one who grants the Kaivalyapada or the highest position. She possesses the lustre of Brahman and is adorable. О Narada the entire universe gets purified with a particle of dust from her feet.

## \|\| 1.45-48 \|\|

*devī caturthī kathitā pañcamīṃ varṇayāmi te \|*  
*premaprāṇādhidevī yā pañcaprāṇasvarūpiṇī \|\| 45 \|\|*

*prāṇādhikapriyatamā sarvādyā sundarī varā \|*  
*sarvasaubhāgyayuktā ca māninī gauravānvitā \|\| 46 \|\|*

*vāmārddhāṅgasvarūpā ca suguṇaistejasā samā \|*  
*parāvarā sarvamātā paramādyā sanātanī \|\| 47 \|\|*

*paramānandarūpā ca dhanyā mānyā ca pūjitā \|*  
*rāsakrīḍādhidevī ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

45-48. Thus I have described four types of goddesses. Now I speak about the fifth one she is in the form of five pranas and is the beloved of lord Krsna. She is the foremost of all the goddesses. She is extremely beautiful, quite fortunate, proud, glorious and adorn the left side of lord Krsna. She equates with eternal Brahman by means of her glory. She is the endless one, the mother of all, eternal, blissful, fortunate, adored by all and happens to be the one who organises the divine dance of lord Krsna.

## \|\| 1.49-52 \|\|

*rāsamaṇḍalasaṃbhūtā rāsamaṇḍalamaṇḍitā \|*  
*rāseśvarī surasikā rāsāvāsanivāsinī \|\| 49 \|\|*

*golokavāsinī devī gopīveṣavidhāyikā \|*  
*paramāhlādarūpā ca santoṣāmarṣarūpiṇī \|\| 50 \|\|*

*nirguṇā ca nirākārā nirliptā''tmasvarūpiṇī \|*  
*nirīhā nirahaṅkārā bhaktānugrahavigrahā \|\| 51 \|\|*

*vedānusāradhyānena vijñeyā sā vicakṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭirdṛṣṭā sahasreṣu surendrairmunipuṅgavaiḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

49-52. She is the one who enhances the glory of divine dance of lord Krsna, she is the goddess of divine dance and resides in the music and dance, though she is the resident of Goloka. She appears in the form of a cowherdesses, is all blissful, patient but some times takes to the wild fonn. She is devoid of all the three gunas, invisible, unattached, having her own fonn, sometime indifferent and without pride. She takes 4to a definite form to shower her grace over her devotee. The goddess in adored by the wise people according to the provisions of the Vedas and can know about her after deep meditation. Thus thousands of the best of the sages and the gods meditate upon her to achiever her.

## \|\| 1.53 \|\|

*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitā \|*  
*koṭiprabhājuṣṭaśrīyuktā bhaktavigrahā \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. She is clad in the blue divine garments and is adorned with all the ornaments emitting lustre of crores of the moons. She is filled with all the glory and takes to a definite fonn for the sake of her devotees.

## \|\| 1.54-55 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇabhaktadāsyaikadāyinī sarvasampadām \|*  
*avatāre ca vārāhe vṛṣabhānusutā ca yā \|\| 54 \|\|*

*yatpādapadmasaṃsparśapavitrā ca vasundharā \|*  
*brahmādibhiradṛṣṭā yā sarvadṛṣṭā ca bhārate \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. She is the goddess who bestows the deep devotion of lord Krsna to her devotees which is the best of all the treasures. She appears as the daughter of Vrsabhanu. At the time of the incarnation of Varaha, the earth was purified with the touch of her feet. The gods like Brahma are unable to have an audience with her but the same goddess is seen in the Bharatavarsa everywhere.

## \|\| 1.56-58 \|\|

*strīratnasārasaṃbhūtā kṛṣṇavakṣaḥ sthalasthitā \|*  
*tathā ghane navaghane lolā saudāminī mune \|\| 56 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi prataptaṃ brahmaṇā purā \|*  
*yatpādapadmanakharadṛṣṭaye cātmaśuddhaye \|\| 57 \|\|*

*svapne'pi naiva dṛṣṭaḥ syātpratyakṣe'pi ca kā kathā \|*  
*tenaiva tapasā dṛṣṭā bhūri vṛndāvane vane \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. О sage having been bom of the gems of a female, she resides in the chest of lord Krsna as the lightening resides in the dark clouds in the sky. In the earlier times Brahma meditated upon her in order to have a look at the nail of her toe for sixty thousands years. But he could not have an audience with her even in dream. Then what could be said about her appearing in person as a result of the same tapas. Brahma could see her again and again in the Vrndavana forest.

## \|\| 1.59 \|\|

*kathitā pañcamī devī sā rādhā parikīrttitā \|*  
*aṃśarūpā kalārūpā kalāṃśāṃśasamudbhavā \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Thus I have described all the five goddesses and the one who has the name of Radha. This goddess has many divisions based on her Amshas.

## \|\| 1.60-62 \|\|

*prakṛteḥ prativiśvaṃ ca rūpaṃ syātsarvayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*paripūrṇatamāḥ pañcavidhā devyaḥ prakīrttitāḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*yā yāḥ pradhānāṃśarūpā varṇayāmi niśāmaya \|*  
*pradhānāṃśasvarūpā ca gaṅgā bhuvanapāvanī \|\| 61 \|\|*

*viṣṇupādābjasaṃbhūtā dravarūpā sanātanī \|*  
*pāpipāpedhmadāhāya jvaladindhanarūpiṇī \|\| 62 \|\|*

60-62. Her form is available in the form of the woman in the universe. These five goddesses are known as the complete ones in all respects. Now I going to highlight the major divisions of these goddesses. You please listen to me. The Ganga which purifies the entire universe is the form of their past. She emerged out of the feet of lord Vishnu and served as a fire for the destroying the sins.

## \|\| 1.63 \|\|

*darśanasparśanasnānapānairnirvāṇadāyinī \|*  
*golokasthānagamanasusopānasvarūpiṇī \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. The Ganga bestows salvation to those who look at her, touch her, bathe in her water or drink her water. She serves as a beautiful step for reaching the Goloka.

## \|\| 1.64 \|\|

*pavitrarūpā tīrthānāṃ saritāṃ ca parāvarā \|*  
*śambhumaulijaṭāmerumuktāpaṃktisvarūpiṇī \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. She has a pure form and is the best of all the three rivers. She appears like the pearls in the matted locks of hair over the head of Shiva.

## \|\| 1.65-67 \|\|

*tapassampādinī sadyo bhārate ca tapasvinām \|*  
*śaṅkhapadmakṣīranibhā śuddhasattvasvarūpiṇī \|\| 65 \|\|*

*nirmalā nirahaṅkārā sādhvī nārāyaṇapriyā \|*  
*pradhānāṃśasvarūpā ca tulasī viṣṇukāminī \|\| 66 \|\|*

*viṣṇubhūṣaṇarūpā ca viṣṇupādasthitā satī \|*  
*tapassaṅkalpapūjādisadyassampādinī mune \|\| 67 \|\|*

65-67. She helps in accomplishing the tapas of the sages. She is purified like the moon, the white lotus or the milk. She is devoid of lord Narayana. Tulasi (holy basil) is considered to be the foremost article of Prakriti. The caste lady is like the ornaments of Vishnu. She always resides under the feet of lord Vishnu. О sage, all the noble deeds like tapas and adoration the accomplished through her..

## \|\| 1.68 \|\|

*sārabhūtā ca puṣpāṇāṃ pavitrā puṇyadā sadā \|*  
*darśanasparśanābhyāṃ ca sadyo nirvāṇadāyinī \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. She (Tulasi) is the essence of the flowers, purified, meritorious and one achieves salvation by looking at her or touching her.

## \|\| 1.69 \|\|

*kalau kaluṣaśuṣkedhmadāhanāyāgnirūpiṇī \|*  
*yatpādapadmasaṃsparśātsadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. In the age of Kali she serves as the dry wood for burning the sins. The entire earth gets purified with the touch of her feet.

## \|\| 1.70 \|\|

*yatsparśadarśaṃ vāñchanti tīrthānāmātmaśuddhaye \|*  
*yayā vinā ca viśveṣu sarvaṃ karmāsti niṣphalam \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Even the holy places get purified with her touch or looking at her. All the good deeds bear no fruit in the universe without her.

## \|\| 1.71 \|\|

*mokṣadā yā mumukṣūṇāṃ kāmināṃ sarvakāmadā \|*  
*kalpavṛkṣasvarūpā ca bhārate vṛkṣarūpiṇī \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. By her grace alone the truth seekers achieve salvation. She fulfils the desires of all her devotees. In Bharata being a tree, she serves as a kalpavr/csa.

## \|\| 1.72-76 \|\|

*trāṇāya bhāratānāṃ ca pūjānāṃ paradevatā \|*  
*pradhānāṃśasvarūpā ca manasā kaśyapātmajā \|\| 72 \|\|*

*śaṅkarapriyaśiṣyā ca mahājñānaviśāradā \|*  
*nāgeśvarasyānantasya bhaginī nāgapūjitā \|\| 73 \|\|*

*nāgeśvarī nāgamātā sundarī nāgavāhinī \|*  
*nāgendragaṇayuktā sā nāgabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 74 \|\|*

*nāgendravanditā siddhayoginī nāgavāsinī \|*  
*viṣṇubhaktā viṣṇurūpā viṣṇupūjāparāyaṇā \|\| 75 \|\|*

*tapaḥsvarūpā tapasāṃ phaladātrī tapasvinī \|*  
*divyaṃ trilakṣavarṣaṃ ca tapastaptaṃ yayā hareḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

72-76. She emerged over the soil of Bharata for the rescue of the people here. She happens to be the great goddess of the people. Manasa is an other goddess of the nature. She happens to be the mind born daughter of the sage Kashyapa therefore she is called Manasa. She is beloved pupil of lord Shiva, possesses all the knowledge and happens to be the sister of the serpent Ananta. She is adored by the Nagas, the beautiful one, Nagavahini and is surround by the serpent ganas. Adorned with all the serpent ornaments, she is known as Siddhayogini, welling over the Nagas, the devotee of lord Vishnu, the form of lord Vishnu, is always devoted in the adoration of Vishnu, is the form of tapas and is the bestower of the reward for performing tapas. She performed tapas for three lakhs of years for lord Hari.

## \|\| 1.77-79 \|\|

*tapasvinīṣu pūjyā ca tapasviṣu ca bhārate \|*  
*sarvamantrādhidevī ca jvalantī brahmatejasā \|\| 77 \|\|*

*brahmasvarūpā paramā brahmabhāvanatatparā \|*  
*jaratkārumuneḥ patnī kṛṣṇaśambhupativratā \|\| 78 \|\|*

*āstīkasya munermātā pravarasya tapasvinām \|*  
*pradhānāṃśasvarūpā yā devasenā ca nārada \|\| 79 \|\|*

77-79. She is the best of the female ascetics in Bharata and is adorable wife of Jaratkaru, learn out of the rays of Shiva and Krishna, she is the deity of all the serpent mantras. She is illumined by the eternal lustre and always remains engrossed in the dhyana of Brahman. She happens to be the wife of Jaratkaru who was born of the particles of Krishna and Shiva and is the mother of the sage Astlka. О Narada one of the prominent particles of Prakriti is known by the name of Devasena.

## \|\| 1.80 \|\|

*mātṛkā sā pūjyatamā sā ca ṣaṣṭhī prakīrttitā \|*  
*śiśūnāṃ prativiśvaṃ tu pratipālanakāriṇī \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. She is considered to be the best of the matrkas and is also known as the Sasthidevl. She takes care of the children of the universe.

## \|\| 1.81 \|\|

*tapasvinī viṣṇubhaktā kārttikeyasya kāminī \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhāṃśarūpā prakṛtestena ṣaṣṭhī prakīrtitā \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. She is an ascetic and a devotee of lord Vishnu, besides the wife of Karttikeya. Because she is the sixth part of Prakriti, she has been given the name Sasthi.

## \|\| 1.82-83 \|\|

*putrapautrapradātrī ca dhātrī ca jagatāṃ sadā \|*  
*sundarī yuvatī ramyā satataṃ bharturantike \|\| 82 \|\|*

*sthāne śiśūnāṃ paramā vṛddharūpā ca yoginī \|*  
*pūjā dvādaśamāseṣu yasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāstu santatam \|\| 83 \|\|*

82-83. She is the mid-wife and bestows sons and grandsons to the people of the universe. She resides with her husband as a beautiful damsel. For the children she is an old Yogini and people adore her during all the twelve months.

## \|\| 1.84 \|\|

*pūjā ca sūtikāgāre paraṣaṣṭhadine śiśoḥ \|*  
*ekaviṃśatime caiva pūjā kalyāṇahetukī \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. She is adorned in the labour room on the sixth or the twenty-first day of the birth of the child. This type of worship is the cause of all welfares.

## \|\| 1.85-86 \|\|

*śaśvanniyamitā caiṣā nityā kāmyā'pyataḥ parā \|*  
*mātṛrūpā dayārūpā śaśvadrakṣaṇakāriṇī \|\| 85 \|\|*

*jale sthale cāntarikṣe śiśūnāṃ svapnagocarā \|*  
*pradhānāṃśasvarūpā yā devī maṅgalacaṇḍikā \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. She always regulates everything's, she is eternal and beyond consumption. She always has the form of mother, is quite compassionate and always provide protection. She protects the children not only in the water, land and sky but also in the dreams. Another prominent particle of Prakriti is known by the name of Mangalachandl.

## \|\| 1.87-88 \|\|

*prakṛtermukhasaṃbhūtā sarvamaṅgaladā sadā \|*  
*sṛṣṭau maṅgalarūpā ca saṃhāre koparūpiṇī \|\| 87 \|\|*

*tena maṅgalacaṇḍī sā paṇḍitaiḥ parikīrttitā \|*  
*pratimaṅgalavāreṣu prativiśveṣu pūjitā \|\| 88 \|\|*

87-88. The goddess emerged out of the root of Prakriti and bestows all the types of welfare on the people, she happens to be the form of welfare and at the time of destruction, she turns herself into terrific form. That is why she has been given the name of Mangalachandl she is adored by the people on every Tuesday.

## \|\| 1.89 \|\|

*pañcopacārairbhaktyā ca yoṣidbhiḥ paripūjitā \|*  
*putrapautradhanaiśvaryyayaśomaṅgaladāyinī \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. The ladies adore her with great devotion with five fold offerings, by which they received the fruits in the form of sons, grandsons, wealth, divinity, fame and the other auspicious things.

## \|\| 1.90 \|\|

*śoka santāpapāpārttiduḥkhadāridryanāśinī \|*  
*parituṣṭā sarvavācchāpradātrī sarvayoṣitām \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Getting pleased she removes the grieved, misery, sin, ailments, pain from all the ladies fulfilling from desires.

## \|\| 1.91 \|\|

*ruṣṭā kṣaṇena saṃhartuṃ śaktā viśvaṃ maheśvarī \|*  
*pradhānāṃśasvarūpā ca kālī kamalalocanā \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. But as Maheshvari, when annoyed she can destroy the entire universe in a moment. The goddess Kali is considered to be the chief particle of the Prakriti, she has lotus-like eyes.

## \|\| 1.92 \|\|

*durgālalāṭasaṃbhūtā raṇe śumbhaniśumbhayoḥ \|*  
*durgārddhāṃśasvarūpā syādguṇaissā tejasā samā \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. The goddess Kali emerged from the forehead of goddess Durga during the battle between Sumbha and Nisumbha, she is considered to be a part of Durga as well, she is comparable to her in virtues and the lustre.

## \|\| 1.93-95 \|\|

*koṭisūryyaprabhājuṣṭadivyasundaravigrahā \|*  
*pradhānā sarvaśaktīnāṃ varā balavatī parā \|\| 93 \|\|*

*sarvasiddhipradā devī paramā siddhiyoginī \|*  
*kṛṣṇabhaktā kṛṣṇatulyā tejasā vikramairguṇaiḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇabhāvanayā śaśvatkṛṣṇavarṇā sanātanī \|\| 94 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ hartuṃ śaktā niḥśvāsamātrataḥ \|*  
*raṇaṃ daityaiḥ samaṃ tasyāḥ krīḍayā lokarakṣayā \|\| 95 \|\|*

93-95. She has a divine beautiful body emitting the lustre of crores of sons, she has the best of the forces, possesses great prowess, bestower of all the success, a great yoginl and is the devotee of lord Krishna. Goddess Kali is comparable to lord Krishna in the virtues and the prowess. She is the eternal goddess and because of her everlasting devotion towards lord Krishna, she has the black complexioned. She can reduce the entire universe to ashes by her breathing alone. That is why her fight with the demons is only a battle play.

## \|\| 1.96-97 \|\|

*dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca dātuṃ śaktā supūjitā \|*  
*brahmādibhiḥ stūyamānā munibhirmanubhirnaraiḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

*pradhānāṃśasvarūpā ca prakṛtiśca vasundharā \|*  
*ādhārabhūtā sarveṣāṃ sarvasasyaprasūtikā \|\| 97 \|\|*

96-97. When adored she bestows dharma, artha, kama and moksa. That is why she is adorned by Brahma besides all the gods, the sages, the Manus and the human beings. The earth goddess is considered to be a part of Prakriti, the entire universe is lodged over her. She is the bestower of greenery, food products and other eatables.

## \|\| 1.98-101 \|\|

*ratnākārā ratnagarbhā sarvaratnākarāśrayā \|*  
*prajādibhiḥ prajeśaiśca pūjitā vanditā sadā \|\| 98 \|\|*

*sarvopajīvyarūpā ca sarvasampadvidhāyinī \|*  
*yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ nirādhāraṃ carācaram \|\| 99 \|\|*

*prakṛteśca kalā yā yāstā nibodha munīśvara \|*  
*yasya yasya ca yāḥ patnyastāḥ sarvā varṇayāmi te \|\| 100 \|\|*

*svāhādevī vahnipatnī triṣu lokeṣu pūjitā \|*  
*yayā vinā havirdattaṃ na grahītuṃ surāḥ kṣamāḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

98-101. She is the time of gems, is filled with gems and is the base of all the gems. All the kings and the people adore her offering prayers to her at the same time. She had taken to this form in order to provide living to all the people. She is the bestower of all the riches. Without her no one in the universe can have a base to live on. О sage, I have described about the rays of Prakriti and the goddesses who have emerged out of the same. Now I speak you about the other goddesses. Svaha happens to be the wife of god of fire and is adorable in all the three worlds. Without her the gods cannot enjoy the share of their sacrifice.

## \|\| 1.102 \|\|

*dakṣiṇā yajñapatnī ca dīkṣā sarvatra pūjitā \|*  
*yayā vinā ca viśveṣu sarvaṃ karma ca niṣphalam \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. There are two wives of yajna called daksina and dlksa who are adored everywhere. Without them all the sacrifices remain incomplete in the universe.

## \|\| 1.103 \|\|

*svadhā pitṝṇāṃ patnī ca munibhirmanubhirnaraiḥ \|*  
*pūjitā paitṛkaṃ dānaṃ niṣphalaṃ ca yayā vinā \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. Svadha, happens to be the wife of the manes who is adored by the sages, the Manus and the people at large. Without her no rites for the manes can be performed.

## \|\| 1.104-105 \|\|

*svastidevī vāyupatnī prati viśveṣu pūjitā \|*  
*ādānaṃ ca pradānaṃ ca niṣphalaṃ ca yayā vinā \|\| 104 \|\|*

*puṣṭirgaṇapateḥ patnī pūjitā jagatītale \|*  
*yayā vinā parikṣīṇāḥ pumāṃso yoṣito'pi ca \|\| 105 \|\|*

104-105. The goddess Svasti happens to be the wife of the wind-god who is adored in the universe. Without her there can be no give and take in the universe. Pusti happens to be the spouse of Ganapati who is adored on earth. Without her the husband and wife become quite lean and thin.

## \|\| 1.106 \|\|

*anantapatnī tuṣṭiśca pūjitā vanditā sadā \|*  
*yayā vinā na santuṣṭāḥ sarve lokāśca sarvataḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. Tusti happens to be the spouse of Ananta the great serpent. She is adored by the people daily. Without her the people remain dissatisfied.

## \|\| 1.107 \|\|

*īśānapatnī sampattiḥ pūjitā ca surairnaraiḥ \|*  
*sarve lokā daridrāśca viśveṣu ca yayā vinā \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. Sampatti happens to be the wife of Isana and is adored by the people daily. Without her the people of the world are devoid of riches.

## \|\| 1.108 \|\|

*dhṛtiḥ kapilapatnī ca sarvaiḥ sarvatra pūjitā \|*  
*sarve lokā adhīrāssyurjagatsu ca yayā vinā \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. Dhrti happens to be the wife of Kapila and the people welcome her everywhere. Without her the people of the world remain impatient.

## \|\| 1.109 \|\|

*yamapatnī kṣamā sādhvī suśīlā sarvapūjitā \|*  
*samunmattāśca rudrāśca sarve lokā yayā vinā \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. Ksama happens to be the wife of Yama. She is a good nature goddess and is quite chaste and adorable. Without her the people get intoxicated and terrific.

## \|\| 1.110 \|\|

*krīḍādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā kāmapatnī ratiḥ satī \|*  
*kelikautukahīnāśca sarve lokā yayā vinā \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. Rati happens to be the wife of the god of love, the chaste lady is the goddess of love-sport. Without her, the people cannot indulge in conjugal pleasures.

## \|\| 1.111 \|\|

*satyapatnī satī muktiḥ pūjitā jagatāṃ priyā \|*  
*yayā vinā bhavelloko bandhutārahitaḥ sadā \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. Mukti happens to be the wife of Satya, the lady is loved by the people who adore her. Without her, the people wander without companion.

## \|\| 1.112 \|\|

*mohapatnī dayā sādhvī pūjitā ca jagatpriyā \|*  
*sarve lokāśca sarvatra niṣṭhurāśca yayā vinā \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. Daya. (compassion) happens to be the wife of Moha. The Chaste lady is adorable and loved by the people. Without her the people become heartless.

## \|\| 1.113 \|\|

*puṇyapatnī pratiṣṭhā sā puṇyarūpā ca pūjitā \|*  
*yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ jīvanmṛtasamaṃ mune \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. О sage, Pratistha (glory) happens to be the wife of Punya she is adored by the people. Without her, even the living people seems as dead.

## \|\| 1.114 \|\|

*sukarmapatnī kīrtiśca dhanyā mānyā ca pūjitā \|*  
*yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ yaśohīnaṃ mṛtaṃ yathā \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. The wife of Sukarma happens to be the Klrti (glory). She is quite fortunate and is adorable. Without her the universe gets devoid of glory.

## \|\| 1.115 \|\|

*kriyā udyogapatnī ca pūjitā sarvasaṅgatā \|*  
*yayā vinā jagatsarvamucchinnamiva nārada \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. Kriya happens to be the wife of Udyoga, all the people agree with the adorable goddess. О Narada without her the universe seems upset.

## \|\| 1.116 \|\|

*adharmapatnī mithyā sā sarvadhūrtaiśca pūjitā \|*  
*yayā vinā jagatsarvamucchinnaṃ vidhinirmitam \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. Mithya happens to be the wife of adharma. The wicked people adore this great goddess. Without her the entire universe seems to be of no consequence.

## \|\| 1.117-118 \|\|

*satye adarśanā yā ca tretāyāṃ sūkṣmarūpiṇī \|*  
*arddhāvayavarūpā ca dvāpare saṃhṛtā hriyā \|\| 117 \|\|*

*kalau mahāpragalbhā ca sarvatra vyāptikāraṇāt \|*  
*kapaṭena saha bhrātrā bhramatyeva gṛhe gṛhe \|\| 118 \|\|*

117-118. In the Satyayuga the goddess had disappeared. In the Tretayuga, she emerged in a tiny form. In the Dvapam, she was squeezed with shame but in the age of Kali, she pervades everywhere and lives with arrogance, she roams about from house to house with her brother named Kapata (Deceit).

## \|\| 1.119-120 \|\|

*śāntirlajjā ca bhārye dve suśīlasya ca pūjite \|*  
*yasyāṃ vinā jagatsarvamunmattamiva nārada \|\| 119 \|\|*

*jñānasya tisro bhāryāśca buddhirmedhā smṛtistathā \|*  
*yābhirvinā jagatsarvaṃ mūḍhaṃ mṛtasamaṃ sadā \|\| 120 \|\|*

119-120. SusTla has two wives named Santi and Lajja. О Narada, without them the entire universe gets intoxicated. The Jnana has intelligence (Buddhi), Medha and Smrti as three wives. Without homa, the entire universe acts foolishly and appears like the dead.

## \|\| 1.121-122 \|\|

*mūrttiśca dharmapatnī sā kāntirūpā manoharā \|*  
*paramātmā ca viśvaughā nirādhārā yayā vinā \|\| 121 \|\|*

*sarvatra śobhārūpā ca lakṣmīrmūrtimatī satī \|*  
*śrīrūpā mūrtirūpā ca mānyā dhanyā ca pūjitā \|\| 122 \|\|*

121-122. Murti happens to be the wife of Dharma and possess beautiful glory which impresses everyone. Without them the entire universe and the great soul becomes baseless. Patronising her only, Lakshmi is adored everywhere. She has two forms named Murti and Sri. She is adorable, graceful and worshipped by all.

## \|\| 1.123 \|\|

*kālāgnirudrapatnī ca nidrā yā siddhayoginām \|*  
*sarvalokāḥ samācchannā māyāyogena rātriṣu \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. Nidra happens to be the wife of Rudra or Kalagni. The same Ratri provides rest to the entire universe with her illusion.

## \|\| 1.124 \|\|

*kālasya tisro bhāryyāśca sandhyā rātrirdināni ca \|*  
*yābhirvinā vidhātrā ca saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ na śakyate \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. There are three wives of Kala (time) who are known as sandhya, Ratri and the Day, without them even Brahma is unable to provide the counting cf the day and time.

## \|\| 1.125 \|\|

*kṣutpipāse lobhabhāryye dhanye mānye ca pūjite \|*  
*yābhyāṃ vyāptaṃ jagatkṣobhayuktaṃ cintitameva ca \|\| 125 \|\|*

125\. Tne greed has two wives named hunger and thirst who have considerable following in the universe. Because of them the entire universe remains in agony.

## \|\| 1.126 \|\|

*prabhā ca dāhikā caiva dve bhārye tejasastathā \|*  
*yābhyāṃ vinā jagatsraṣṭuṃ vidhātā ca na hīśvaraḥ \|\| 126 \|\|*

126\. The Tejas has two wives, named Prabha and Dahika because of whom the creator is unable to make the creation.

## \|\| 1.127 \|\|

*kālakanye mṛtyujare prajvarasya priye priye \|*  
*yasyāṃ jagatsamucchinnaṃ vidhātrā nirmite vidhau \|\| 127 \|\|*

127\. The fever has two wives named old age and death who are the daughters of Kala (time). Without them, the entire arrangement of the universe made by the creator would come to a stand-still.

## \|\| 1.128 \|\|

*nidrākanyā ca tandrā sā prītiranyā sukhapriye \|*  
*yābhyāṃ vyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ vidhiputra vidhervidhau \|\| 128 \|\|*

128\. O son of a Brahmana, Tandara (drowsiness) happens to be the daughter of Nidra (sleep) and the wife of Sukha (pleasure). Both of them are pervading the universe created by Brahma.

## \|\| 1.129 \|\|

*vairāgyasya ca dve bhārye śraddhā bhaktiśca pūjite \|*  
*yābhyāṃ śaśvajjagatsarvaṃ jīvanmuktamidaṃ mune \|\| 129 \|\|*

129\. О sage, Sraddha and Bhakti are the two respectable wives of Vairagya because of whom the entire universe achieves salvation.

## \|\| 1.130-131 \|\|

*aditirdevamātā ca surabhiśca gavāṃ prasūḥ \|*  
*ditiśca daityajananī kadrūśca vinatā danuḥ \|\| 130 \|\|*

*upayuktāḥ sṛṣṭividhāvetāśca prakṛteḥ kalāḥ \|*  
*kalāścānyāḥ santi bahvyastāsu kāścinnibodha me \|\| 131 \|\|*

130-131. Aditi happens to be the mother of file gods, Surabhi happens to be the mother of cows, while Dili happens to be the mother of the Daityas. Similarly KadrO, Vinata and Danu happen to be the rays of Prakriti and are quite useful otherwise. Thus there are several other goddesses who happens to be the rays of Prakriti which I am going to narrate.

## \|\| 1.132 \|\|

*rohiṇī candrapatnī ca saṃjñā sūryasya kāminī \|*  
*śatarūpā manorbhāryā śacīndrasya ca gehinī \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. Rohini happens to be the wife of the moon. Sanjna happens to be the wife of Sruya. Satarupa happens to be the wife of Manu, Shachi is the wife of indra.

## \|\| 1.133 \|\|

*tārā bṛhaspaterbhāryyā vasiṣṭhasyāpyarundhatī \|*  
*ahalyā gautamastrī syādanasūyā'trikāminī \|\| 133 \|\|*

133\. Tara is the wife of Brihaspati and the name of the wife of Vasistha is Arundhal. Ahalya happens to be the wife of Gautama and Anushuya happens to be the wife of Atri.

## \|\| 1.134 \|\|

*devahūtiḥ kardamasya prasūtirdakṣakāminī \|*  
*pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā menakā sā'mbikāprasūḥ \|\| 134 \|\|*

134\. Devahuiti happens to be the wife of Kardama and Prasuti happens to be wife of Daksha. The mind born daughter of the manes was known as Menaka who happens to be the mother of Parvati.

## \|\| 1.135-139 \|\|

*lopāmudrā tathā hūtiḥ kuberasya tu kāminī \|*  
*varuṇānī yamastrī ca balervindhyāvalīti ca \|\| 135 \|\|*

*kuntī ca damayantī ca yaśodā devakī satī \|*  
*gāndhārī draupadī savyā sāvitrī satyavatpriyā \|\| 136 \|\|*

*vṛṣabhānupriyā sādhvī rādhāmātā kalāvatī \|*  
*mandodarī ca kausalyā subhadrā kaikayī tathā \|\| 137 \|\|*

*revatī satyabhāmā ca kālindī lakṣmaṇā tathā \|*  
*mitravindā nāgnajitī tathā jāmbavatī parā \|\| 138 \|\|*

*lakṣmaṇā rukmiṇī sītā svayaṃ lakṣmīḥ prakīrtitā \|*  
*kalā yojanagandhā ca vyāsamātā mahāsatī \|\| 139 \|\|*

135-139. Similarly Lopamudra happens to be the wife of Кubeга. Ahiiti, VarunanI, Yama’s wife, Vindhyavall, the wife of Bali, Kunti, Damayanti, Yashoda, the chaste Devaki, Gandharl, Draupadi, Saivya, Savitri the wife of Satyavan, the mother of Radhika, Kalavati the wife of Vrsabhanu, MandodarT, Kausalya, Subhadra, Kaikeyl, Revati, Satyabhama, Kalindl, Laksmana, Mitravinda, NagnajitI, Jambavati, RukimanI, Sita, who herself is the form of Lakshmi, Yojanagandha, the mother of Vyasa.

## \|\| 1.140-141 \|\|

*bāṇaputrī tathoṣā ca citralekhā ca tatsakhī \|*  
*prabhāvatī bhānumatī tathā māyāvatī satī \|\| 140 \|\|*

*reṇukā ca bhṛgormātā halimātā ca rohiṇī \|*  
*ekānaṃśā ca durgā sā śrīkṛṣṇabhaginī satī \|\| 141 \|\|*

140-141. Usha the daughter of Bana, her friend Chitralekha, Prabhavati, Bhanumatl, The chaste Mayavati, Renuka the mother of Bhargava (Parashurama), Rohini the mother of Balarama and the sister of Shri Krishna, Ekanaiisa the form of Durga are the rays of the Prakriti.

## \|\| 1.142 \|\|

*bahvyaḥ santi kalāścaivaṃ prakṛtereva bhārate \|*  
*yā yāśca grāmadevyastāḥ sarvāśca prakṛteḥ kalāḥ \|\| 142 \|\|*

142\. Similarly several rays of Prakriti are spread over the Bharatavarsa. Besides such of the goddess, are known as village goddess who are also considered to be the rays of Prakriti.

## \|\| 1.143 \|\|

*kalāṃśāṃśasamudbhūtāḥ prativiśveṣu yoṣitaḥ \|*  
*yoṣitāmapamānena prakṛteśca parābhavaḥ \|\| 143 \|\|*

143\. All the ladies in the universe could be considered to be the rays of Prakriti. Therefore by insulting them one insults the nature.

## \|\| 1.144 \|\|

*brāhmaṇī pūjitā yena patiputravatī satī \|*  
*prakṛtiḥ pūjitā tena vastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ \|\| 144 \|\|*

144\. On who adores a Brahmana lady having her husband and son alive offering her the clothes, ornaments and sandal-paste, he actually adores the nature.

## \|\| 1.145 \|\|

*kumārī cāṣṭavarṣīyā vastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ \|*  
*pūjitā yena viprasya prakṛtistena pūjitā \|\| 145 \|\|*

145\. The one who adores the eight year old Brahmana girl offering her the clothes and ornaments, he actually adores the nature.

## \|\| 1.146-148 \|\|

*sarvāḥ prakṛtisambhūtā uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ \|*  
*sattvāṃśāścottamā jñeyāḥ suśīlāśca pativratāḥ \|\| 146 \|\|*

*madhyamā rajasaścāṃśāstāśca bhogyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ \|*  
*sukhasambhogavatyaśca svakārye tatparāḥ sadā \|\| 147 \|\|*

*adhamāstamasaścāṃśā ajñātakulasambhavāḥ \|*  
*durmukhāḥ kulaṭā dhūrttāḥ svatantrāḥ kalahapriyāḥ \|\| 148 \|\|*

146-148. All the women of the world whether they belong to high, middle or lower class are the rays of the Prakriti. Out of these, those who possess the saitva-amsa are quite chaste and good nature and are considered to be the best. These who areinclined towards the worldly pleasures, they represent the rajas part of the nature and are called middle type. Those who devote themselves to their own tasks, enjoying all the pleasures, they could be the ladies which emerge from the tamas part of the nature and are considered to be the degraded ones. Those of the ladies whose race and caste are not known and those who speak harsh words and move according to their own sweet-will and are always engaged in quarrel.

## \|\| 1.149 \|\|

*pṛthivyāṃ kulaṭā yāśca svarge cāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ \|*  
*prakṛtestamasaścāṃśāḥ puṃścalyaḥ parikīrttitāḥ \|\| 149 \|\|*

149\. The wicked women of the earth and the whores of the heaven are created out of the tamas part of nature and they are called degraded women.

## \|\| 1.150 \|\|

*evaṃ nigaditaṃ sarvaṃ prakṛterbhedapañcakam \|*  
*tāḥ sarvāḥ pūjitāḥ pṛthvyāṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate \|\| 150 \|\|*

150\. Thus I have narrated to you the five parts of the nature. All these ladies are adored in the Bharatavarsa.

## \|\| 1.151 \|\|

*pūjitā surathenādau durgā durgārtināśinī \|*  
*dvitīyā rāmacandreṇa rāvaṇasya vadhārthinā \|\| 151 \|\|*

151\. The second part of Prakriti happens to be Durga who relieves one of all the miseries. She was adored first of all by the king Suratha. Thereafter lord Rama adored her for the killing of Ravana.

## \|\| 1.152 \|\|

*tatpaścājjagatāṃ mātā triṣu lokeṣu pūjitā \|*  
*jātā''dau dakṣapatnyāṃ ca nihantuṃ daityadānavān \|\| 152 \|\|*

152\. Thereafter the mother of the universe was adored in all the three lokas. For the destruction of the demons she appeared from womb of the wife of Daksha.

## \|\| 1.153 \|\|

*tato dehaṃ parityajya yajñe bhartuśca nindayā \|*  
*jajñe himavataḥ patnyāṃ lebhe paśupatiṃ patim \|\| 153 \|\|*

153\. Thereafter she listened to the denouncing of her husband in the yajna of Daksha and she end her life. She was reborn from the womb of Mena, the wife of Himavan. She was married to lord Shiva.

## \|\| 1.154 \|\|

*gaṇeśaśca svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ skando viṣṇukalodbhavaḥ \|*  
*babhūvatustau tanayau paścāttasyāśca nārada \|\| 154 \|\|*

154\. О Narada, lord Krishna was himself born as Ganesha and Skanda was born out of the rays of Vishnu. Both of them came to be known as the sons of Shiva.

## \|\| 1.155 \|\|

*lakṣmīrmaṅgalabhūpena prathame paripūjitā \|*  
*triṣu lokeṣu tatpaścāddevatāmunimānavaiḥ \|\| 155 \|\|*

155\. The king Mangala initially adored Lakshmi who was subsequently adored by all the people of the universe.

## \|\| 1.156 \|\|

*sāvitrī prathamaṃ cāpi bhaktyā vai paripūjitā \|*  
*tatpaścāttriṣu lokeṣu devatāmunimānavaiḥ \|\| 156 \|\|*

156\. Savitri was first adored by Bhakti. Thereafter she was adored by all the people of the Universe.

## \|\| 1.157 \|\|

*ādau sarasvatī devī brahmaṇā paripūjitā \|*  
*tatpaścāttriṣu lokeṣu devatāmunimānavaiḥ \|\| 157 \|\|*

157\. Brahma adored Sarasvati first of all and thereafter all the sages and gods besides the humans, adored her.

## \|\| 1.158 \|\|

*prathamaṃ pūjitā rādhā goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*paurṇamāsyāṃ kārttikasya kṛṣṇena paramātmanā \|\| 158 \|\|*

158\. On the full moon day of Karttika, lord Krishna adored Radha in the divine dance in Goloka.

## \|\| 1.159 \|\|

*gopikābhiśca gopaiśca bālikābhiśca bālakaiḥ \|*  
*gavāṃ gaṇaiḥ suragaṇaistatpaścānmāyayā hareḥ \|\| 159 \|\|*

159\. Thereafter all the cowherds and cowherdesses, besides all the children's and the cows, were adored by the people as the illusion of lord Vis nu.

## \|\| 1.160 \|\|

*tadā brahmādibhirdevairmunibhirmanubhistathā \|*  
*puṣpadhūpādibhirbhaktyā pūjitā vanditā sadā \|\| 160 \|\|*

160\. Thereafter Brahma and other gods beside the sages and humans, adored her with devotion.

## \|\| 1.161 \|\|

*pṛthivyāṃ prathame devī suyajñena ca pūjitā \|*  
*śaṅkareṇopadiṣṭena puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate \|\| 161 \|\|*

161\. On the earth, however, Radha was first adored at the advice of lord Shiva by the humans.

## \|\| 1.162 \|\|

*triṣu lokeṣu tatpaścādājñayā paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*puṣpadhūpādibhirbhaktyā pūjitā munibhiḥ suraiḥ \|\| 162 \|\|*

162\. Thereafter at the command of the great soul, all the people of the three worlds besides the gods, adored her with great devotion.

## \|\| 1.163 \|\|

*kalā yā yāḥ susaṃbhūtāḥ pūjitāstāśca bhārate \|*  
*pūjitā grāmadevyaśca grāme ca nagare mune \|\| 163 \|\|*

163\. О sage, thus all the rays emerged out of the nature and were adored in Bharata as the village goddesses.

## \|\| 1.164 \|\|

*evaṃ te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ prakṛteścaritaṃ śubham \|*  
*yathāgamaṃ lakṣaṇañca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 164 \|\|*

164\. Thus I have spoken to you all the details about the noble conduct of the Prakriti according to the scriptures. Now you tell me what else do you want to listen from me.

## Chapter 2

## \|\| 2.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*samāsena śrutaṃ sarvaṃ devīnāṃ caritaṃ vibho \|*  
*vibodhanārthaṃ bodhasya vyāsato vaktumarhasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said — О lord, “I have heard the details about the stones of different gods and goddesses but in order to enhance my knowledge I would like to listen to the same in detail.

## \|\| 2.2 \|\|

*iti śrībra0mahāpu0 dvi0 prakṛ0 nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde devadevyutpattirnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The goddess who is considered to be the best by those well-versed in the Vedas and happens to be the eternal force and the creator of the universe, I would like to know the details about her and also the way in which she appeared in five form.

## \|\| 2.3 \|\|

*bhūtā yā yāśca kalayā tayā triguṇayā bhave \|*  
*vyāsena tāsāṃ caritaṃ śrotumicchāmi sāmpratam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. You also kindly let me know the details of the goddess who emerged out of the three fold race of the goddess. I would like to listen to the story about them in details.

## \|\| 2.4 \|\|

*tāsāṃ janmānukathanaṃ dhyānaṃ pūjāvidhiṃ param \|*  
*stotraṃ kavacamaiśvaryyaṃ śauryaṃ varṇaya maṅgalam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. You kindly intimate me the story about her birth, her dhyanam and the method of her adoration beside her stotra and kavacha. You also enlighten me about her treasure, powers about the bestowing of welfare and prowess.

## \|\| 2.5 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*nityātmā ca nabho nityaṃ kālo nityo diśo yathā \|*  
*viśveṣāṃ gokulaṃ nityaṃ nityo goloka eva ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Shri Narayana said — The time and the sky are eternal like the directions. The universe is a globe and the Goloka is also eternal.

## \|\| 2.6 \|\|

*tadekadeśo vaikuṇṭho lambabhāgaḥ sa nityakaḥ \|*  
*tathaiva prakṛtirnityā brahmalīnā sanātanī \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. In one of its portions, Vaikuntha is lodged. Similarly the eternal Prakriti who always meditates upon Brahman is also eternal.

## \|\| 2.7 \|\|

*yathā'gnau dāhikā candre padme śobhā prabhā ravau \|*  
*śaśvadyuktā na bhinnā sā tathā prakṛtirātmani \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. As the fire as inherent power to born, the moon and the lotus have their lustre and the lustre always remain in the sun and can never be separated, similarly the great soul always resides in the eternal Prakriti.

## \|\| 2.8 \|\|

*vinā svarṇaṃ svarṇakāraḥ kuṇḍalaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ \|*  
*vinā mṛdā kulālo hi ghaṭaṃ kartuṃ na hīśvaraḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. As a gold-smith in unable to make the ornaments without the gold, a potter is unable to prepared the pitcher without earth.

## \|\| 2.9-10 \|\|

*nahi kṣamastathā brahmā sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuṃ tayā vinā \|*  
*sarvaśaktisvarūpā sā tayā syācchaktimānsadā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*aiśvaryyavacanaḥ śak ca tiḥ parākramavācakaḥ \|*  
*tatsvarūpā tayordātrī yā sā śaktiḥ prakīrtitā \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Similarly without Prakriti the great soul is unable to resort to the creation. The one on the base of whom, lord Hari is filled with strength, the same Prakriti is the form of strength of prowess. ТГТ means the riches and frt means the prowess. She is therefore the one who has both these forms and provides these two qualities to everyone, because of which she is called shakti.

## \|\| 2.11 \|\|

*samṛddhibuddhisampattiyaśasāṃ vacano bhagaḥ \|*  
*tena śaktirbhagavatī bhagarūpā ca sā sadā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The word ЧП stands for intelligence, increase in riches and glory. The same sakti is called Bhagavati because she is also known for these qualities. And she is always the form of fortune.

## \|\| 2.12 \|\|

*tayā yuktaḥ sadā''tmā ca bhagavāṃstena kathyate \|*  
*sa ca svecchāmayaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sākāraśca nirākṛtiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Because the lord is always associated with Bhagavati he is called Bhagavan. Lord Krishna moves at his own will but being invisible, he also takes to visible form.

## \|\| 2.13-14 \|\|

*tejorūpaṃ nirākāraṃ dhyāyante yoginaḥ sadā \|*  
*vadanti te paraṃ brahma paramātmānamīśvaram \|\| 13 \|\|*

*adṛśyaṃ sarva draṣṭāraṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvakāraṇam \|*  
*sarvadaṃ sarvarūpāntamarūpaṃ sarvapoṣakam \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. The same great soul being eternal Brahman and the lord is meditated upon by the yogis in his invisible form. Being invisible, he is able to see everything, is all knowledgeable, the cause of all the causes, resides in all the forms, is fonnless and is the preserver of all.

## \|\| 2.15-17 \|\|

*vaiṣṇavāste na manyante tadbhaktāḥ sūkṣmadarśinaḥ \|*  
*vadanti kasya tejaste iti tejasvinaṃ vinā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ brahma tejasvinaṃ param \|*  
*svecchāmayaṃ sarvarūpaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*atīvasundaraṃ rūpaṃ bibhrataṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*kiśoravayasaṃ śāntaṃ sarvakāntaṃ parātparam \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. But his Vaishnava devotees who have a sharp sight do not accept this. They are of the opinion that without the illustrious person who would be taken to possess the tejas. Therefore in the centre of the tejas the illustrious eternal Brahman always resides. He moves at will, is the form of everything and is the cause of all the causes. He always remains in the form of tender-age person, looking extremely beautiful and charming. He is peaceful lord of everyone and is better of the best.

## \|\| 2.18-22 \|\|

*navīnanīradābhāsaṃ rāsaikaśyāmasundaram \|*  
*śaranmadhyāhnapadmaughaśobhāmocakalocanam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*muktāsāramahāsvacchadantapaṅktimanoharam \|*  
*mayūrapucchacūḍaṃ ca mālatīmālyamaṇḍitam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*sunāsaṃ sasmitaṃ śaśvadbhaktānugrahakārakam \|*  
*jvaladagniviśuddhaikapītāṃśukasuśobhitam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam \|*  
*sarvādhāraṃ ca sarveśaṃ sarvaśaktiyutaṃ vibhum \|\| 21 \|\|*

*sarvaiśvaryyapradaṃ sarvaṃ svatantraṃ sarvamaṅgalam \|*  
*paripūrṇatamaṃ siddhaṃ siddhi daṃ siddhikāraṇam \|\| 22 \|\|*

18-22. His dark complexion resembles the glory of new clouds and is the best of all. He has broad eyes and he has the glory, the beauty of the lotus flowers. His teeth are as beautiful as the pearls. He has the feather of a peacock always adorning his head and wears a long garland of jasmine flower. His nose is beautiful and he wears a smile on his face. The extremely beautiful lord always remains anxious to do to good to others, he is clad in pure yellow lower garment and has quite a charming body. He has two arms and holds a flute in his hands. He is adorned with gem-studded ornaments. He is the great lord and the base of all. He is the lord who possesses all the prowess, bestows all the riches, appears in all the forms independent, bestower of welfare, complete in all respect, siddha and the giver of success besides being the cause of success.

## \|\| 2.23 \|\|

*dhyāyante vaiṣṇavāḥ śaśvadevaṃrūpaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokabhītiharaṃ param \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The eternal Vaishnavas meditate upon him in this form and by his grace they are relieved of the pains of birth, death, old age, disease, grief and fear.

## \|\| 2.24 \|\|

*brahmaṇo vayasā yasya nimeṣa upacāryyate \|*  
*sa cātmā paramaṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ityabhidhīyate \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The entire life span of Brahma is equivalent to a moment of the lord. He happens to be the great soul, eternal Brahman and lord Shri Krishna.

## \|\| 2.25 \|\|

*kṛṣistadbhaktivacano naśca taddāsyakārakaḥ \|*  
*bhaktidāsyapradātā yaḥ sa kṛṣṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The word in Krishna stands for Bhakti and ^ stands for slavery or devotion. That is why lord Krishna is known as the bestower of devotion and the feeling of serving others.

## \|\| 2.26 \|\|

*kṛṣiśca sarvavacano nakāro bījavācakaḥ \|*  
*sarvabījaṃ paraṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ityabhidhīyate \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. stands for all and vj stands for seeds. Therefore the word Krishna can be eternal Brahman and the form of seed of all.

## \|\| 2.27-29 \|\|

*asaṃkhyabrahmaṇā pāte kāle'tīte'pi nārada \|*  
*yadguṇānāṃ nāsti nāśastatsamāno guṇena ca \|\| 27 \|\|*

*sa kṛṣṇaḥ sarvasṛṣṭyādau sisṛkṣustveka eva ca \|*  
*sṛṣṭyunmukhastadaṃśena kālena preritaḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*svecchāmayaḥ svecchayā ca dvidhārūpo babhūva ha \|*  
*strīrūpā vāmabhāgāṃśāddakṣiṇāṃśaḥ pumānsmṛtaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

27-29. О Narada all his qualities never declined even during the age of several Brahmas. No one is as virtuous as he is at present. He was alone at the time of creation. At that point of time he developed a desire for creating the universe. Inspired by his smallest form he thought of creation. He moves according to his own will and he appeared in two forms, his left side represents the female and the right side represents the male.

## \|\| 2.30-39 \|\|

*tāṃ dadarśa mahākāmī kāmādhāraḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*atīva kamanīyāṃ ca cārucampakasannibhām \|\| 30 \|\|*

*pūrṇendubimbasadṛśanitamvayugalāṃ parām \|*  
*sucārukadalīstambhasadṛśaśroṇisundarīm \|\| 31 \|\|*

*śrīyuktaśrīphalākārastanayugmamanoramām \|*  
*puṣṭyā yuktāṃ sulalitāṃ madhyakṣīṇāṃ manoharām \|\| 32 \|\|*

*atīva sundarīṃ śāntāṃ sasmitāṃ vakralocanām \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|\| 33 \|\|*

*śaśvaccakṣuścakorābhyāṃ pibantīṃ santataṃ mudā \|*  
*kṛṣṇasya sundaramukhaṃ candrakoṭivinindakam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*kastūrībindubhiḥ sārddhamadhaścandanabindunā \|*  
*samaṃ sindūrabinduṃ ca bhālamadhye ca bibhratīm \|\| 35 \|\|*

*suvakrakabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam \|*  
*ratnendrasārahāraṃ ca dadhatīṃ kāntakāmukīm \|\| 36 \|\|*

*koṭicandraprabhājuṣṭapuṣṭaśobhāsamanvitām \|*  
*gamane rājahaṃsīṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭyā khañjanagañjanīm \|\| 37 \|\|*

*atimātraṃ tayā sārddhaṃ rāseśo rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*rāsollāseṣu rahasi rāsakrīḍāṃ cakāra ha \|\| 38 \|\|*

*nānāprakāraśṛṃgāraṃ śṛṅgāro mūrttimāniva \|*  
*cakāra sukhasambhogaṃ yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

30-39. He is eternal, possesses great passion, is the house of passion and the Purusa started staring at the divine female. She possessed immense glory like the campaka flowers, had round breasts like full moon and her legs were like the trunk of the banana tree; her lips resembled those of the ripe bimba fruit; she had quite a charming and well developed body, besides the slender waist. The damsel was quite, peaceful and wore a serene smile over the face. She was clad in the garments shining like the fire flames and was adorned with all the ornaments. She looked at lord Krishna like the partridge bird looks at the moon continuously. The face of lord Krishna was so glorious that crores of moon were of no consequence before him. The lady had a tilakain of kastiiri over her forehead. Beneath it, there were other small dots. In the centre of the forehead there was another dot of vermilion. She was devoted to her beloved and she had curly hair over her head. The beautiful garland of jasmine flowers was adorning her neck and her body emitted the lustre of crores of moons. She was belittling the grace of the geese and wagtail birds Krishna, the lord of Rasa felt delighted casting a glance at the lady, he entered the dancing hall with her. The Rasakrlda or the dancing started in seclusion as if the Srngara himself emerged in a human form on earth and was dancing with the damsel making several gestures. They enjoyed the pleasure of dancing for a period of the life of Brahma.

## \|\| 2.40 \|\|

*tataḥ sa ca pariśrāntastasyā yonau jagatpitā \|*  
*cakāra vīryyādhānaṃ ca nityānandaḥ śubhakṣaṇe \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Thereafter the lord of the universe, who is blissful felt fatigued and planted his seed in her womb in an auspicious time.

## \|\| 2.41-43 \|\|

*gātrato yoṣitastasyāḥ suratānte ca suvrata \|*  
*nissasāra śramajalaṃ śrāntāyāstejasā hareḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*mahāsuratakhinnāyā niśvāsaśca babhūva ha \|*  
*tadādhāraśramajalaṃ tatsarvaṃ viśvagolakam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*sa ca niḥśvāsavāyuśca sarvādhāro babhūva ha \|*  
*niśśvāsavāyuḥ sarveṣāṃ jīvināṃ ca bhaveṣu ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. At the end of the love-sport, she felt fatigued. The fluid started flowing and she started breathing heavily. Every drop of water which emerged from her body resulted in the building of the universe. Her breathing was the base of all, as a result of which the wind became the source of life of all.

## \|\| 2.44 \|\|

*babhūva mūrttimadvāyorvāmāṅgātprāṇavallabhā \|*  
*tatpatnī sā ca tatputrāḥ prāṇāḥ pañca ca jīvinām \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Thereafter from the left side of Vayu his wife emerged. Thereafter five son were born to her which were taken to be the life of the people.

## \|\| 2.45-46 \|\|

*prāṇo'pānaḥ samānaścaivodāno vyāna eva ca \|*  
*babhūvureva tatputrā adhaḥprāṇāśca pañca ca \|\| 45 \|\|*

*gharmatoyādhidevaśca babhūva varuṇo mahān \|*  
*tadvāmāṅgācca tatpatnī varuṇānī babhūva sā \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. And they were known as Prana, Apcina, Samana, Udana and Vyana who were the five sons. There are five Ad.hah-pra.nas as well as forty five others. Thereafter with the water of her sweet lord Varuna was born from whom his wife Varunanl also emerged.

## \|\| 2.47 \|\|

*atha sā kṛṣṇaśaktiśca kṛṣṇādgarbhaṃ dadhāra ha \|*  
*śatamanvantaraṃ yāvajjvalanto(tī?) brahmatejasā \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Thereafter the great shakti of lord Krishna is also conceived and remained illuminated with the tejas of Brahman for a hundred Manvantras.

## \|\| 2.48-49 \|\|

*kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevī sā kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikapriyā \|*  
*kṛṣṇasya saṅginī śaśvatkṛṣṇavakṣasthalasthitā \|\| 48 \|\|*

*śatamanvantarātīte kāle paramasundarī \|*  
*suṣāvāṇḍaṃ suvarṇābhaṃ viśvādhārālayaṃ param \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. Thereafter the lady of the life of lord Krishna, who was his beloved and companion too and always resided in his heart, after the completion of a hundred Manvantras gave birth to a golden egg which became the base of the entire universe.

## \|\| 2.50 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā cāṇḍaṃ hi sā devī hṛdayena vidūyatā \|*  
*utsasarja ca kopena tadaṇḍaṃ golake jale \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The goddess was filled with mental agony as the sight of the egg and with a painful heart she threw away the egg in the deep oceanic water.

## \|\| 2.51-52 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaśca tattyāgaṃ hāhākāraṃ cakāra da \|*  
*śaśāpa devīṃ deveśastatkṣaṇaṃ ca yathocitam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*yato'patyaṃ tvayā tyaktaṃ kopaśīle suniṣṭhure \|*  
*bhava tvamanapatyā'pi cādyaprabhṛti niścitam \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. Lord Krishna felt disturbed at the sight of throwing of the egg into the water by her and in anger he pronounced a curse on her, “O damsel you are heartless and filled with rage, you have disowned your progeny therefore hence fort you v/ill always remain childless.

## \|\| 2.53 \|\|

*yā yāstvadaṃśarūpāśca bhaviṣyanti surastriyaḥ \|*  
*anapatyāśca tāḥ sarvāstvatsamā nityayauvanāḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. And all the women who are born with you Aihsas would always remain young but shall never bear any children.

## \|\| 2.54 \|\|

*etasminnantare devī jihvāgrātsahasā tataḥ \|*  
*āvirbabhūva kanyaikā śuklavarṇā manoharā \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. At the same movement from the tip of the tongue of the goddess a fair complexioned girl was born.

## \|\| 2.55 \|\|

*pītavastraparīdhānā vīṇāpustakadhāriṇī \|*  
*ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyā sarvaśāstrādhidevatā \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. She was wearing a yellow lower gannent holding a flute and a book in her hands. She happened to be goddess of all the shastras and was adorned with all there ornaments.

## \|\| 2.56 \|\|

*atha kālāntare sā ca dvidhārūpā babhūva ha \|*  
*vāmārddhāṅgā ca kamalā dakṣiṇārddhā ca rādhikā \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. After some time the same goddess appeared in two forms and these two forms were known as Kamala and Radhika.

## \|\| 2.57 \|\|

*etasminnantare kṛṣṇo dvidhārūpo babhūva ha \|*  
*dakṣiṇārddhassyāddvibhujo vāmārddhaśca caturbhujaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. In the meant time Krishna too transfonned into two forms. From the right side, he appeared as having two anus and from the left side he appeared in four arms and was known as Vishnu.

## \|\| 2.58-59 \|\|

*uvāca vāṇīṃ śrīkṛṣṇastvamasya bhava kāminī \|*  
*atraiva māninī rādhā naiva bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 58 \|\|*

*evaṃ lakṣmīṃ saṃpradau tuṣṭo nārāyaṇāya vai \|*  
*saṃjagāma ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ tābhyāṃ sārddhaṃ jagatpatiḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. Lord Krsira asked Sarasvati to be the wife of Vishnu and Radhika remained with him to earn welfare. Similarly he handed over Lakshmi to Narayana. Thereafter lord Vishnu took both of them to Vaikuntha.

## \|\| 2.60-61 \|\|

*anapatye ca te dve ca yato rādhāṃśasambhave \|*  
*nārāyaṇāṅgādabhavanpārṣadāśca caturbhujāḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*tejasā vayasā rūpaguṇābhyāṃ ca samā hareḥ \|*  
*babhūvuḥ kamalāṅgācca dāsīkoṭyaśca tatsamāḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. Since they were born from Radha and Miila-Prakriti, both Lakshmi and Sarasvati had no issue. Thus from Narayana’s body several of the attendants of Vishnu were born who in prowess, age form and qualities were like Vishnu. Thereafter crores of the maid-servants were born out of the body of Lakshmi who were as beautiful as the goddess herself.

## \|\| 2.62 \|\|

*atha golokanāthasya lomāvivarato mune \|*  
*āsannasaṃkhyagopāśca vayasā tejasā samāḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. О sage, thereafter, lord Krishna who is the dweller of Goloka made several of the cowherds from his hair-pits who were like him in prowess and beauty.

## \|\| 2.63 \|\|

*rūpeṇa suguṇenaiva veṣādvā vikrameṇa ca \|*  
*prāṇatulyāḥ priyāḥ sarve babhūvuḥ pārṣadā vibhoḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. All the Gopas bearing the beauty, best qualities, the dress and strength, became the advisors of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 2.64 \|\|

*rādhāṅgalomakūpebhyo babhūvurgopakanyakāḥ \|*  
*rādhātulyāśca sarvāstā nānyatulyāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Similarly from the hair-pits of Radha many cowherd-girls emerged who were as beautiful as Radha and always spoke Sweet words.

## \|\| 2.65 \|\|

*ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyāḥ śaśvatsusthirayauvanāḥ \|*  
*anapatyāśca tāḥ sarvāḥ puṃsaḥ śāpena santatam \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. They were adorned with all the ornaments and were every youthful and because of the curse of lord Krishna they bore no children.

## \|\| 2.66 \|\|

*etasminnantare vipra sahasā kṛṣṇadehataḥ \|*  
*āvirbabhūva sā durgā viṣṇumāyā sanātanī \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. О Brahmana, in the meantime from the body of lord Krishna the eternal Durga, the illusion of lord Vishnu emerged.

## \|\| 2.67-69 \|\|

*devī nārāyaṇīśānā sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī \|*  
*buddhyadhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

*devīnāṃ bījarūpā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|*  
*paripūrṇatamā tejaḥsvarūpā triguṇātmikā \|\| 68 \|\|*

*taptakāñcanavarṇābhā sūryyakoṭisamaprabhā \|*  
*īṣaddhāsaprasannāsyā sahasrabhujasaṃyutā \|\| 69 \|\|*

67-69. She is also called a NarayanI, Tsana and possessor of all the strength. She was the supreme intelligence of lord Krishna. She is the form of the seed of all the goddess and is Milla-Prakriti, Isvari and complete in all respects, illustrious one, possessor of all the three gimas (sattva, rajas and tamas). She has the complexion of molten gold and possesses the lustre of crores of suns. She wears the serene smile over her face and possess a thousand arms.

## \|\| 2.70 \|\|

*nānāśastrāstranikaraṃ bibhratī sā trilocanā \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Durga, the great goddess has three eyes and holds a large number of weapons in her hand. She is clad in the clothes sanctified by the god of fire and is adorned with all the ornaments.

## \|\| 2.71-72 \|\|

*yasyāścāṃśāṃśakalayā babhūvuḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*sarvaviśvasthitā lokā mohitā māyayā yayā \|\| 71 \|\|*

*sarvaiśvaryyapradātrī ca kāmināṃ gṛhamedhinām \|*  
*kṛṣṇabhakti pradātrī ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca vaiṣṇavī \|\| 72 \|\|*

71-72. All the ladies on earth happen to be the rays of the same goddess and her illusion influences the entire universe. Those who adore her with a specific purpose, their desires are fulfilled by her. She bestows the devotion of lord Krishna and for the devotees of lord Vishnu she appears in the fonn of Vishnu.

## \|\| 2.73-75 \|\|

*mumukṣūṇāṃ mokṣadātrī sukhināṃ sukhadāyinī \|*  
*svargeṣu svargalakṣmīḥ sā gṛhalakṣmīrgṛheṣvasau \|\| 73 \|\|*

*tapasviṣu tapasyā ca śrīrūpā sā nṛpeṣu ca \|*  
*yā cāgnau dāhikārūpā prabhārūpā ca bhāskare \|\| 74 \|\|*

*śobhāsvarūpā candre ca padmeṣu ca suśobhanā \|*  
*sarvaśaktisvarūpā yā śrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani \|\| 75 \|\|*

73-75. She bestows salvation to the devotees and those who desires of the worldly pleasures, she bestows the same on them. In the heaven she conduct herself as Lakshmi of the heaven and with the house-holders. She conduct herself as the Lakshmi of the house, she dwells in the tapas of the kings, burning aspect of the fire, lustre of the sun, rays of the moon, beauty of the lotus flower and the entire strength of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 2.76 \|\|

*yayā ca śaktimānātmā yayā vai śaktimajjagat \|*  
*yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ jīvanmṛtamiva sthitam \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. From her, the entire universe gets strength and without her the entire universe inspite of being alive, seems to be dead.

## \|\| 2.77 \|\|

*yā ca saṃsāravṛkṣasya bījarūpā sanātanī \|*  
*sthitirūpā buddhirūpā phalarūpā ca nārada \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. О Narada, she is like the seed for the tree of the universe. She has the form of remaining static, intelligence and bestows the reward also.

## \|\| 2.78-79 \|\|

*kṣutpipāsā dayā śraddhā nidrā tandrā kṣamā dhṛtiḥ \|*  
*śāntirlajjātuṣṭipuṣṭibhrāntikāntyādirūpiṇī \|\| 78 \|\|*

*sā ca saṃstūya sarveśaṃ tatpuraḥ samupasthitā \|*  
*ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ tasyai pradadau rādhikeśvaraḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

78-79. She alone is hunger, thirst, compassion, Sraddha, sleep, fatigue, forgiveness, patience, peaceful, shyness, satisfaction, growth, fallacy and the glory. Thereafter offering prayer to lord Krishna she stood before him who offered him the gem-studded lion throne.

## \|\| 2.80 \|\|

*etasminnantare tatra sastrīkaśca caturmukhaḥ \|*  
*padmanābho nābhipadmānnissasāra pumānmune \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. О sage, at the same time Brahma also reached there with his spouse. Brahma had emerged from the navel of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 2.81-90 \|\|

*kamaṇḍaludharaḥ śrīmāṃstapasvī jñānināṃ varaḥ \|*  
*caturmukhastaṃ tuṣṭāva prajvalanbrahmatejasā \|\| 81 \|\|*

*sudatī sundarī śreṣṭhā śatacandrasamaprabhā \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 82 \|\|*

*ratnasiṃhāsane ramye stutā vai sarvakāraṇam \|*  
*uvāsa svāminā sārddha kṛṣṇasya purato mudā \|\| 83 \|\|*

*etasminnantare kṛṣṇo dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ \|*  
*vāmārddhāṃgo mahādevo dakṣiṇo gopikāpatiḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

*śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaḥ śatakoṭiraviprabhaḥ \|*  
*triśūlapaṭṭiśadharo vyāghracarmadharo haraḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

*taptakāñcanavarṇābha jaṭābhāradharaḥ paraḥ \|*  
*bhasmabhūṣaṇagātraśca sasmitaścandraśekharaḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

*digambaro nīlakaṇṭhaḥ sarpa bhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*bibhraddakṣiṇahastena ratnamālāṃ susaṃskṛtām \|\| 87 \|\|*

*prajapanpañcavaktreṇa brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam \|*  
*satyasvarūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram \|\| 88 \|\|*

*kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam \|*  
*janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokabhītiharaṃ param \|\| 89 \|\|*

*saṃstūya mṛtyormṛtyuṃ taṃ jāto mṛtyuñjayābhidhaḥ \|*  
*ratnasiṃhāsane ramye samuvāsa hareḥ puraḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

81-90. He appeared as an ascetic, was the best of the intellectuals, holding a Kamandalu and his faces were wearing the divine lustre. Brahma then started eulogising lord Krishna. At the same movement the spouse of Brahma having the lustre of hundreds of moons possessing beautiful teeth, clad in the gannents satisfied by god Agni, adorned with all the ornaments, also offered prayer to lord Krishna and thereafter took her seat besides her husband. At that very moment lord Krishna took to two forms his lift part appeared as Mahadeva and the right side remained as Krishna as usual. The glory of lord Mahadeva appeared like crystal gem and he was illumining like crores of suns. He was holding a trident and a pat tisa. He was clad in tiger skin. His matted locks of hair emitted the lustre of the molten gold. He had plastered his body with the ashes and wore a smile over his face besides the crescent over his forehead, he wore no garment and was adorned with the ornaments of snake. He held a rosary of gems in his right hand. He had five heads emitting the eternal lustre. He was eternal, truthful, great soul, Ishvara, cause of all the causes and welfare of all the welfares and the one who could relieve everybody of birth, death,, old age, disease, grief and fear and happens to be death for the god of death. By reciting the glory of lord Krishna he came to be known as Mrtyunjaya. He also took his seat over the gem-studded lion throne, with the permission of lord Krishna.

## Chapter 3

## \|\| 3.1 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*athāṇḍaṃ tajjale'tiṣṭhadyāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ svakāle sahasā dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Lord Narayana said — That egg remained in the water during the complete life of Brahma. At the appropriate time, it broke into two.

## \|\| 3.2-3 \|\|

*tanmadhye śiśurekaśca śatakoṭiraviprabhaḥ \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ rorūyamāṇaśca sa śiśuḥ pīḍitaḥ kṣudhā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*pitṛmātṛparityakto jalamadhye nirāśrayaḥ \|*  
*naikabrahmāṇḍanātho yo dadarśordhvamanāthavat \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. In the centre of it an infant was found whose lustre resembled the lustre of crores of suns. That infant had no parents and was disowned Ъу all and had no support in the ocean, it therefore started crying with hunger. He was the leader of several globes. He looked upward like an orphan.

## \|\| 3.4 \|\|

*sthūlātsthūlatamaḥ so'pi nāmnā devo mahāvirāṭ \|*  
*paramāṇuryathā sūkṣmātparaḥ sthūlāttathā'pyasau \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. He was solid like all the solid things. He was, therefore, called as Mahavirat every atom represents the smallest form, similarly he was like that.

## \|\| 3.5 \|\|

*tejasāṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśo'yaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*ādhāro'saṃkhyaviśvānāṃ mahāviṣṇussureśvaraḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. He happened to be the sixteenth part of the lustre of lord Krishna. And he happened to be the lord of innumerable universes and was called Maha-Vishnu.

## \|\| 3.6 \|\|

*pratyekaṃ romakūpeṣu viśvāni nikhilāni ca \|*  
*adyāpi teṣāṃ saṃkhyāṃ ca kṛṣṇo vaktuṃ na hi kṣamaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Several of the universes were lodged in his hair-pits. Their number cannot be counted even by lord Krishna himself.

## \|\| 3.7-8 \|\|

*yathā'sti saṃkhyā rajasāṃ viśvānāṃ na kadācana \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ tathā saṃkhyā na vidyate \|\| 7 \|\|*

*prativiśveṣu santyevaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|*  
*pātālādbrahmalokāntaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ parikīrttitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. In all the globes Brahma. Vishnu and Shiva could be beside other gods. There is a possibility of ones counting the particles of dust but the number of globes, Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and other gods residing in his body could never be counted. The extent of Brahmanda (globe) extended from Patala to Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 3.9 \|\|

*tata ūrdhve ca vaikuṇṭho brahmāṇḍādbahireva saḥ \|*  
*sa ca satyasvarūpaśca śaśvannārāyaṇo yathā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The Vaikuntha is lodged above it which is beyond the globe. It is truthful, eternal and everlasting like Brahman.

## \|\| 3.10 \|\|

*tadūrdhve golakaścaiva pañcāśatkoṭiyojanāt \|*  
*nityaḥ satyasvarūpaśca yathā kṛṣṇastathāpyayam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The Goloka with the dimensions of fifty crores yojanas is lodged above it, which is also eternal and everlasting.

## \|\| 3.11-12 \|\|

*saptadvīpamitā pṛthvī saptasāgarasaṃyutā \|*  
*ekonapañcāśadupadvīpā'saṃkhyavanānvitā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*ūrdhvaṃ sapta suvarlokā brahmalokasamanvitāḥ \|*  
*pātālāni ca saptādhaścaivaṃ brahmāṇḍameva ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. The earth consist of seven islands and an equal number of oceans, forty nine small islands and innumerable number of forests. The Brahmaloka is lodged above it besides the several seven heavens above and seven nethers below. All these combined are called Brahmanda or the globe.

## \|\| 3.13-14 \|\|

*ūrdhvaṃ dharāyā bhūrloko bhuvarlokastataḥ paraḥ \|*  
*svarlokastu tataḥ paścānmaharlokastato janaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tataḥ parastapolokaḥ satyalokastataḥ paraḥ \|*  
*tataḥ paro brahmalokastaptakāñcananirmitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Bhuloka is above the earth and Bhuvarloka is above this. Then comes Svarloka, then Maharloka then Ja no 1 oka, then Tapoloka and above all is the Brahmaloka having the lustre of gold.

## \|\| 3.15-16 \|\|

*evaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtrimaṃ tadbāhyābhyantara eva ca \|*  
*tadvināśe vināśaśca sarveṣāmeva nārada \|\| 15 \|\|*

*jalabududavatsarvaṃ viśvasaṃghamanityakam \|*  
*nityau golokavaikuṇṭhau satyau śaśvadakṛtrimau \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. They are all artificial. Some of them are within the globe and some of them out of it. О Narada, at the destruction of the globe all these are destroyed because the universe appears like a water bubble and is short lived. Out of these only Goloka and Vaikuntha are eternal and everlasting.

## \|\| 3.17 \|\|

*lomakūpe ca vidhyaṇḍaṃ pratyekaṃ tasya niścitam \|*  
*eṣāṃ saṃkhyāṃ na jānāti kṛṣṇo'nyasyāpi kā kathā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. In the hair-pits of the child several of the Brahmandas (globes) are lodged. Their exact number can hardly be counted even by lord Krishna, what to speak of others.

## \|\| 3.18 \|\|

*pratyekaṃ pratividhyaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|*  
*tisraḥ koṭyaḥ surāṇāṃ ca saṃkhyā sarvatra putraka \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О son, in the globe there live three crores of gods including Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

## \|\| 3.19 \|\|

*digīśāścaiva dikpālā nakṣatrāṇi grahādayaḥ \|*  
*bhuvi varṇāśca catvāro'dho nāgāśca carācarāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. All the directions are protected by the gods of these directions who are known by the name of Dikpalas. The planets and the constellations are included in it. There are four Varnas on earth. Down below in the Nagaloka all the immovable and moveable are lodged.

## \|\| 3.20 \|\|

*atha kālena sa virāḍūrdhvaṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*ḍimbhāntaraṃ ca śūnyaṃ ca na dvitīyaṃ kathaṃcana \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Thereafter that Virat-infant continued to look above again and again, but the entire circular space was vacant. Nothing was available there.

## \|\| 3.21-23 \|\|

*cintāmavāpa kṣudyukto ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*jñānaṃ prāpya tadā dadhyau kṛṣṇaṃ paramapūruṣam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tato dadarśa tatraiva brahma jyotiḥ sanātanam \|*  
*navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ dvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sasmitaṃ muralīhastaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam \|*  
*jahāsa bālakastuṣṭo dṛṣṭvā janakamīśvaram \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. Thereafter the hungry child, getting worried started crying again and again. In the meantime he gained knowledge and started meditating upon lord Krishna and visualised the eternal flame of Brahman resembling the fresh clouds, having dark complexion and two arms, wearing pitambara and a smile on his face. He had a flute in his hand and was always compassionate to his devotees. Finding the lord there, the infant was delighted and in delight he laughed.

## \|\| 3.24-25 \|\|

*varaṃ tasmai dadau tuṣṭo vareśaḥ samayocitam \|*  
*matsamo jñānayuktaśva kṣutpipāsāvivarjitaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍāsaṃkhyanilayo bhava vatsa layāvadhi \|*  
*niṣkāmo nirbhayaścaiva sarveṣāṃ varado varaḥ \|*  
*rogamṛtyujarāśokapīḍādiparivarjitaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. Lord Krishna then getting pleased bestowed a boon on him, saying, “O son you attain knowledge like me, getting free from hunger and thirst and be the shelter of the universe till the time of the dissolution. Getting all the desires fulfilled, you become fearless and grant boons to everyone. You will be free from the disease, the death, old age, grief and pain.”

## \|\| 3.26 \|\|

*ityuktvā taddakṣakarṇe mahāmantraṃ ṣaḍakṣaram \|*  
*triḥ kṛtvā prajajāpādau vedāṅgamavaraṃ param \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Thus speaking he muttered the six-letter mantra in his ear thrice. These three mantras are important part of the Vedas.

## \|\| 3.27 \|\|

*praṇavādicaturthyantaṃ kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam \|*  
*vahnijvālāntamiṣṭaṃ ca sarvavighnaharaṃ param \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. There is a 3ff in the beginning; the middle there are two letters known as and in the last appears Svaha the wife of god Agni. Therefore this is the form of the mantra “ 3tf =ртпч тчтщ” this mantra removes all the obstructions.

## \|\| 3.28 \|\|

*mantraṃ dattvā tadāhāraṃ kalpayāmāsa vai prabhuḥ \|*  
*śrūyatāṃ tadbrahmaputra nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О Narada, the son of Brahma, lord Shri Krishna gave this mantra to him and thereafter the made the arrangements for his food which you pleased listen from me.

## \|\| 3.29-30 \|\|

*prativiśveṣu naivedyaṃ dadyādvai vaiṣṇavo janaḥ \|*  
*ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ viṣayiṇo viṣṇoḥ pañcadaśāsya vai \|\| 29 \|\|*

*nirguṇasyātmanaścaiva paripūrṇatamasya ca \|*  
*naivedyena ca kṛṣṇasya nahi kiñcitprayojanam \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. In the entire universe the Vaishnavas offer Naivedya to lord Vishnu. A sixteenth part of such offering reaches Vishnu and the rest cf the fifteen parts are meant for the Virat child. Because this child happens to be the complete lord in himself and is the Virat form of lord Krishna. Lord Krishna, however, if in no way concerned with the naivedya.

## \|\| 3.31 \|\|

*yaddadāti va naivedyaṃ yasmai devāya yo janaḥ \|*  
*sa ca khādati tatsarvaṃ lakṣmīdṛṣṭyā punarbhavet \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. To whichever god the naivedya is referred by the people, the same is consumed by the same god, but at the sight of Lakshmi the same is restored.

## \|\| 3.32 \|\|

*taṃ ca mantraṃ varaṃ dattvā tamuvāca punarvibhuḥ \|*  
*anyo varaḥ ka iṣṭaste taṃ me brūhi dadāmi te \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Thus giving the best of the mantra to the child, the lord said: “what else is dearer to you? You tell me; I shall get you the boon.”

## \|\| 3.33 \|\|

*kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca mahāvirāṭ \|*  
*adanto bālakastatra vacanaṃ samayocitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Listening to the words of lord Krishna the toothiess child Mahavirat spoke to the lerd thus.

## \|\| 3.34 \|\|

*mahāvirāḍuvāca \|*  
*varaṃ me tvatpadāmbhoje bhaktirbhavatu niścalā \|*  
*santataṃ yāvadāyurme kṣaṇaṃ vā suciraṃ ca vā \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Mahavirat said – I should always remain devoted to your lotus-like feet. Irrespective of my age whether I have a long life or a short life 1 should remain devoted towards you.

## \|\| 3.35-36 \|\|

*tvadbhaktiyukto yo loke jīvanmuktaḥ sa santatam \|*  
*tvadbhaktihīno mūrkhaśca jīvannapi mṛto hi saḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*kiṃ tajjapena tapasā yajñena yajanena ca \|*  
*vratenaivopavāsena puṇyatīrthaniṣevayā \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. Because whosoever remains devoted to you, frees himself from the human bondage and the one who is the devoid of your devotion, appears to be dead on earth while still alive.
