The japam, the penance, performing the yajna, worship, observing fast and resolutions as also residing in the holy places are of no value for him.

## \|\| 3.37 \|\|

*kṛṣṇabhaktivihīnasya puṃsaḥ syājjīvanaṃ vṛthā \|*  
*yenātmanā jīvitaśca tameva nahi manyate \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The life of the one who is deprived of the devotion of Krishna is of no use, because he happens to be the one, who does not know the soul which keeps him alive.

## \|\| 3.38 \|\|

*yāvadātmā śarīre'sti tāvatsyācchaktisaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*paścādyānti gate tasminna svatantrāśca śaktayaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Till such time the soul remains in the body he gets associated with all the powers till then, Thereafter as soon as the soul leaves the body, all his strength also disappeared. Because these saktis have no individuality of their own.

## \|\| 3.39 \|\|

*sa ca tvaṃ ca mahābhāga sarvātmā prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|*  
*svecchāmayaśca sarvādyo brahma jyotiḥ sanātanaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О sage, you are the one who is beyond nature and the soul of all, the one who moves according to his own sweet will and possess the eternal divine flames.

## \|\| 3.40 \|\|

*ityuktvā bālakastatra virarāma ca nārada \|*  
*uvāca kṛṣṇaḥ pratyuktiṃ madhurāṃ śrutisundarīm \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О Narada thus speaking the child kept quiet. Thereafter lord Krishna spoke to him the sweet words.

## \|\| 3.41 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*suciraṃ susthiraṃ tiṣṭha yathā'haṃ tvaṃ tathā bhava \|*  
*asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pāte pātaste na bhaviṣyati \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Shri Krishna said — You continue to remains stable on earth like me for a long time you cannot fall even after the fall of innumerable Brahmas.

## \|\| 3.42-43 \|\|

*aṃśena pratividhyaṇḍe tvaṃ ca putra virāḍ bhava \|*  
*tvannābhipadme brahmā ca viśvasraṣṭā bhaviṣyati \|\| 42 \|\|*

*lalāṭe brahmaṇaścaiva rudrāścaikādaśaiva tu \|*  
*śivāṃśena bhaviṣyanti sṛṣṭisaṃcaraṇāya vai \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. О son, in all the Brahmandas (globes) you will always be present in part and the lord Brahma who will be born out of your navel, would be the creator of the universe. Eleven Rudras shall emerge from the forehead of Brahma and shall destroy the universe.

## \|\| 3.44-45 \|\|

*kālāgnirudrasteṣveko viśvasaṃhārakārakaḥ \|*  
*pātā viṣṇuśca viṣayī kṣudrāṃśena bhaviṣyati \|\| 44 \|\|*

*madbhaktiyuktaḥ satataṃ bhaviṣyasi vareṇa me \|*  
*dhyānena kamanīyaṃ māṃ nityaṃ drakṣyasi niścitam \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. One of the Rudras will be known by the name of Kalagni who will destroy the universe. From the particle of Rudra, Vishnu the protector of the universe shall appear with my grace. You will achieve my devotion and you will always see my divine face all the time. This is certain.

## \|\| 3.46 \|\|

*mātaraṃ kamanīyāṃ ca mama vakṣaḥsthalasthitām \|*  
*yāmi lokaṃ tiṣṭha vatsetyuktvā so'ntaradhīyata \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. О son, you will also have a look at you beautiful mother who resides in my heart. I am moving towards my own abode, but you remain here.” Thus speaking Krishna left with a delightful mind.

## \|\| 3.47 \|\|

*gatvā ca nākaṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ sa uvāca ha \|*  
*sraṣṭāraṃ sraṣṭumīśaṃ ca saṃhartāraṃ ca tatkṣaṇam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Reaching the heaven he met Brahma, the creator and Shiva, the destroyer of the universe.

## \|\| 3.48-49 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuṃ gaccha vatsa nābhipadmodbhavo bhava \|*  
*mahāvirāḍ lomakūpe kṣudrasya ca vidheḥ śṛṇu \|\| 48 \|\|*

*gaccha vatsa mahādeva brahmabhālodbhavo bhava \|*  
*aṃśena ca mahābhāga svayaṃ ca suciraṃ tapaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. Lord Krishna said — О son, you move on for the creation of the universe and appear from the hair-pit of the Mahavirat and the lotus that emerges from his navel. Then pointing towards Rudra he said — О son, Mahadeva you go anhaving been born out of the forehead of Brahma you perform tapas for a long time.

## \|\| 3.50-51 \|\|

*ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho virarāma vidheḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*jagāma natvā taṃ brahmā śivaśca śivadāyakaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*mahāvirāḍ lomakūpe brahmāṇḍe golake jale \|*  
*sa babhūva virāṭkṣudro virāḍaṃśena sāmpratam \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. О Narada, Krishna the lord of the universe, kept quiet after speaking thus. Thereafter both Brahma and Shiva bowing in reverence to him, left the place. The water which had assembled in the hair-pits of Mahavirat was turned into a small Virat in the centre of it.

## \|\| 3.52-53 \|\|

*śyāmo yuvā pītavāsāḥ śayāno jalatalpake \|*  
*īṣaddhāsaḥ prasannāsyo viśvarūpī janārdanaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tannābhikamale brahmā babhūva kamalodbhavaḥ \|*  
*saṃbhūya padmadaṇḍaṃ ca babhrāma yugalakṣakam \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. Не had dark complexion youthful body and was clad in yellow garments and was reclining over the bed of water. His face was delightful and he was known by the name of Janardana. Brahma appeared out of the lotus emerging from his navel and in order to find out the depth of the lotus stalk, Brahma continued to search for a lakh ofyugas.

## \|\| 3.54 \|\|

*nāntaṃ jagāma daṇḍasya padmanābhasya padmajaḥ \|*  
*nābhijasya ca padmasya cintāmāpa pitāmahaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. But he was unable to find out the beginning or end of the lotus stalk that emerged out of the navel of Vishnu which made Brahma restless.

## \|\| 3.55-57 \|\|

*svasthānaṃ punarāgatya dadhyau kṛṣṇapadāmbujam \|*  
*tato dadarśa kṣudraṃ taṃ dhyātvā taddivyacakṣuṣā \|\| 55 \|\|*

*śayānaṃ jalatalpe ca brahmāṇḍapiṇḍamāvṛte \|*  
*yallomakūpe brahmāṇḍaṃ taṃ ca tatparamīśvaram \|\| 56 \|\|*

*śrīkṛṣṇaṃ cāpi golokaṃ gopagopīsamanvitam \|*  
*taṃ saṃstūya varaṃ prāpa tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

55-57. He then returned to the same lotus and started meditating seated over the same. Thereafter he could have an audience with the small Virat-purusa by means of his divine knowledge. The great Purusa was sleeping in the watery bed inside the ocean. There was the globe in each one of his hair-pit. He then saw the great lord Krishna and the Mahavirat-purusa. He also could see the Goloka. Thereafter he offered prayers to lord Krishna and getting boon from him he started the work of creation.

## \|\| 3.58-59 \|\|

*babhūvurbrahmaṇaḥ putrā mānasāḥ sanakādayaḥ \|*  
*tato rudrāḥ kapālācca śivasyaikādaśa smṛtāḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

*babhūva pātā viṣṇuśca vāme kṣudrasya pārśvataḥ \|*  
*caturbhujaśca bhagavāñśvetadvīpanivāsakṛt \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. First of all the four mind born sons named Sanaka and others were born from Brahma. Thereafter the clever Rudras appeared from his forehead being the Athsas of Shiva from the left side of small Virat, lord Vishnu the protector of the universe appeared. He had four arms, he started dwelling in Shveta-Dvipa.

## \|\| 3.60-61 \|\|

*kṣudrasya nābhipadme ca brahmā viśvaṃ sasarja saḥ \|*  
*svargaṃ martyaṃ ca pātālaṃ trilokaṃ sacarācaram \|\| 60 \|\|*

*evaṃ sarvaṃ lomakūpe viśvaṃ pratyekameva ca \|*  
*prativiśvaṃ kṣudravirāḍ brahma viṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. Having been born out of the small Virats’ navel, Brahma created the globe, heaven, the world, the Patala andmll the three lokas with the creatures. Thus the globes lodged in all the hair-pits of the Mahavirat and in all the globes a separate small Virat, Vishnu, Brahma and Shiva were lodged.

## \|\| 3.62 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa kṛṣṇasaṅkīrttanaṃ śubham \|*  
*sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. О son, thus I have narrated to you the story about lord Krishna which bestows pleasure, salvation and happens to be the gist of everything. What more do you want to listen”?

## Chapter 4

## \|\| 4.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*śrutaṃ sarvamapūrvaṃ ca tvatprasādātsudhopamam \|*  
*adhunā prakṛtīnāṃ ca vyāsaṃ varṇaya bho prabho \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said — О lord, by your grace I have been able to listen to the nectar-like story of the lord; now you enlighten me about the Prakritis.

## \|\| 4.2 \|\|

*kasyāḥ pūjā kṛtā kena kathaṃ martye prakā śitā \|*  
*kena vā pūjitā kā vā kena kā vā stutā mune \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О sage, which one of the gods has adored which one of the goddess first of all and how was it made known on earth. Who adored whom earlier offering the prayers.

## \|\| 4.3 \|\|

*kavacaṃ stotrakaṃ dhyānaṃ prabhāvaṃ caritaṃ śubham \|*  
*kābhiḥ kābhyo varo dattastanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. You enlighten me about the kavachas, Stotras, dhyana, their influence and the story of each one of them including the boons granted by each one of them.

## \|\| 4.4 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*gaṇeśajananī durgā rādhā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī \|*  
*sāvitrī vai sṛṣṭividhau prakṛtiḥ pañcadhā smṛtā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Narayana said — Durga is the mother of Ganesha, besides Radha, Lakshmi, Sarasvati and Savitri are the five goddesses who emerged at the time of the creation of the universe.

## \|\| 4.5 \|\|

*āsītpūjyā prasiddhā ca prabhāvaḥ paramādbhutaḥ \|*  
*sudhopamaṃ ca caritaṃ sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The influence of their adoration is astonishing and quite will known. Their life stories are like nectar and bestow all the welfare.

## \|\| 4.6 \|\|

*prakṛtyaṃśāḥ kalā yāśca tāsāṃ ca caritaṃ śubham \|*  
*sarvaṃ vakṣyāmi te brahmansāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О Brahman, such of the goddesses who form part of Prakriti and those who have the form of Kali, I shall tell you all the stories about them you listen to me attentively.

## \|\| 4.7-9 \|\|

*vāṇī vasundharā gaṅgā ṣaṣṭhī maṅgalaca ṇḍikā \|*  
*tulasī mānasī nidrā svadhā svāhā ca dakṣiṇā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tejasā matsamāstāśca rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

*saṃkṣepamāsāṃ caritaṃ puṇyadaṃ atisundaram \|*  
*jīvakarmavipākaṃ ca tacca vakṣyāmi sundaram \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. The goddesses like Van! (Sarasvati), Vasundhara (earth), Ganga, SasthI, Mangalachandika, Tulasi, ManasI, Nidra, Svadha, Svaha and dalcsina are the goddesses who are like in lustre, qualities and merits. I shall narrated to you the stories about them which will relieve the people of all the sins.

## \|\| 4.10 \|\|

*durgāyāścaiva rādhāyā vistīrṇaṃ caritaṃ mahat \|*  
*tacca paścātpravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepātkramataḥ śṛṇu \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The great stories about Durga and Radhika will be narrated by me subsequently. You please listen to me.

## \|\| 4.11 \|\|

*ādau sarasvatīpūjā śrīkṛṣṇena vinirmitā \|*  
*yatprasādānmuniśreṣṭha mūrkho bhavati paṇḍitaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. О best of the sages, lord Krishna first of all started by the grace of whom even the foolish fellows achieve wisdom.

## \|\| 4.12-13 \|\|

*āvirbhūtā yadā devī vaktrataḥ kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*iyeṣa kṛṣṇaṃ kāmena kāmukī kāmarūpiṇī \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sa ca vijñāya tadbhāvaṃ sarvajñaḥ sarvamātaram \|*  
*tāmuvāca hitaṃ satyaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Goddess Sarasvati was born out of the tongue of lord Krishna and when becoming passionate intentions and he then spoke of Sarasvati the mother of all the beneficial words which were truthful and bestowed welfare at the end.

## \|\| 4.14-15 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ sādhvi madaṃśaṃ ca caturbhujam \|*  
*yuvānaṃ sundaraṃ sarvaguṇayuktaṃ ca matsamam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kāmadaṃ kāminīnāṃ ca tāsāṃ taṃ kāmapūrakam \|*  
*koṭikanda rpalāvaṇyaṃ līlānyakkṛtamanmatham \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Lord Krishna said О chaste lady, lord Narayana emerged out of my body and is youthful like me, he is beautiful and possesses all the qualities. You should, therefore, serve him as a wife. He is the one who fulfils the desires of all the ladies and is beautiful like the crores of gods of love. In the divine play, he excels even the god of love.

## \|\| 4.16-18 \|\|

*kānte kāntaṃ ca māṃ kṛtvā yadi sthātumihecchasi \|*  
*tvatto balavatī rādhā na te bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 16 \|\|*

*yo yasmādbalavānvā'pi tato'nyaṃ rakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ parānsādhayati yadi svayamanīśvaraḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*sarveśassarvaśāstā'haṃ rādhāṃ rādhitumakṣamaḥ \|*  
*tejasā matsamā sā ca rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. О lady, if you want to remain here as my wife, it would not be beneficial for you since Radha happens to be more powerful than you. О Sarasvati, one who is quite powerful can protect others but the one who himself his weak cannot protect himself. I am the lord of everyone and the ruler but I am unable to rule over the Radha because she possesses the same type of splendour, beauty and qualities as I do.

## \|\| 4.19 \|\|

*prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ \|*  
*prāṇato'pi priyaḥ kutra keṣāṃ vā'sti ca kaścana \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. She is the presiding deity of my life and who is so competent as to abandon his life. Only a life is the dearest a men then all other objects.

## \|\| 4.20 \|\|

*tvaṃ bhadre gaccha vaikuṇṭhaṃ tava bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati \|*  
*patiṃ tamīśvaraṃ kṛtvā modasva suciraṃ sukham \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Therefore, О lady, you go to Vaikuntha and you will meet with your welfare there. You accept lord Vishnu as your husband and enjoy all the pleasures with him.

## \|\| 4.21 \|\|

*vivarjitā lobhamohakāmakopena hiṃsayā \|*  
*tejasā tvatsamā lakṣmī rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Lakshmi is of course free from grief, attachment, lust, agony, violence and she is as equal as you in beauty, virtues and splendours.

## \|\| 4.22 \|\|

*tayā sārddhaṃ bhava prītyā sukhaṃ kālaṃ prayāsyati \|*  
*gauravaṃ cāpi tattulyaṃ kariṣyati patirdvayoḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. If you remain lovingly with her, your life will meet all the pleasures. And your husband will also love both of you equally.

## \|\| 4.23-27 \|\|

*prativiśveṣu te pūjāṃ mahatīṃ te mudā'nvitāḥ \|*  
*māghasya śuklapañcamyāṃ vidyārambheṣu sundari \|\| 23 \|\|*

*mānavā manavo devā munīndrāśca mumukṣavaḥ \|*  
*santaśca yoginaḥ siddhā nāgagandharvakiṃnarāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*madvareṇa kariṣyanti kalpe kalpe yathāvidhi \|*  
*bhaktiyuktāśca dattvā vai copacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa \|\| 25 \|\|*

*kāṇvaśākhoktavidhinā dhyānena stavanena ca \|*  
*jitendriyāḥ saṃyatāśca pustakeṣu ghaṭe'pi ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

*kṛtvā suvarṇaguṭikāṃ gandhacandana carccitām \|*  
*kavacaṃ te grahīṣyanti kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bhuje \|\| 27 \|\|*

23-27. O beautiful one, with the influence of my boon all the people of the universe get pleased besides the Manus, the gods, the truth seekers, the ascetics, yogl^, siddhas, nagas and Kinnaras will adore you every year on the bright fifth day in the month of Magha or at the time of sharing of learnings and celebrating great festivity at that time, they will perform sixteen type of pitja for you. You will be adored appropriately according to the rites prescribed in the kavacha branch by the self disciplined people. They will invoke you in a kalasha or a book. Your flowers will be decorated by them with the flowers and kept gracefully in gold amulet and shall adore it with offering the sandal-wood paste and tie it around the right arm as armlets.

## \|\| 4.28 \|\|

*paṭhiṣyanti ca vidvāṃsaḥ pūjākāle ca pūjite \|*  
*ityuktvā pūjayāmāsa tāṃ devīṃ sarvapūjitaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. During the time of ptijd as well as after that, the wise people will recite your stotras. Thus speaking, lord Krishna adored the goddess.

## \|\| 4.29 \|\|

*tatastatpūjanaṃ cakrurbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ \|*  
*anantaścāpi dharmaśca munīndrāḥ sanakādayaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Thereafter the gods like Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, Ananta, Dharma and sages like Sanaka and others also adored her.

## \|\| 4.30 \|\|

*sarve devāśca manavo nṛpā vā mānavādayaḥ \|*  
*babhūva pūjitā nityā sarvalokaiḥ sarasvatī \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Thus all the gods, the Manus, the kings and the humans adored the goddess since then.

## \|\| 4.31-32 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*pūjāvidhānaṃ stavanaṃ dhyānaṃ kavacamīpsitam \|*  
*pūjopayuktaṃ naivedyaṃ puṣpaṃ vā candanādikam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*vada vedavidāṃ śreṣṭha śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama \|*  
*varddhate sāmprataṃ śaśvatkimidaṃ śrutisundaram \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Narada said — О best of the gods, you tell us the method of adoration of goddess Sarasvati, her stotra, dhyanam and the kavacha besides Naivedya, flowers and the application of sandalwood paste. I am feeling quite anxious to listen to the same which will be quite pleasant to hear.

## \|\| 4.33 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi kāṇvaśākhoktapaddhatim \|*  
*jaganmātuḥ sarasvatyāḥ pūjāvidhisamanvitām \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Narayana said — О Narada, I will now spell out the method prescribed in the Kanva-shakha for the adoration of goddess of Sarasvati has been detailed.

## \|\| 4.34-36 \|\|

*māghasya śuklapañcamyāṃ vidyārambhadine'pi ca \|*  
*pūrve'hni saṃyamaṃ kṛtvā tatra syātsaṃyataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*snātvā nityakriyāṃ kṛtvā ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjya devaṣaṭkaṃ ca naivedyādibhireva ca \|\| 35 \|\|*

*gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām \|*  
*saṃpūjya saṃyato'gre ca tato'bhīṣṭaṃ prapūjayet \|\| 36 \|\|*

34-36. The bright fifth day of month of Magha is the date for initiating a child. Observing self-discipline and getting purified after bath, one should perform the daily routine besides consecrating the pitcher filled with water. Then presenting Naivedya and other offering to Ganesha, Surya, Agni, Vishnu, Shiva and Parvati, the family god should be adore.

## \|\| 4.37 \|\|

*dhyānena vakṣyamāṇena dhyātvā bāhyaghaṭe budhaḥ \|*  
*dhyātvā punaḥ ṣoḍaśopacāraistāṃ pūjayedvratī \|\| 37 \|\|*

## \|\| 4.38 \|\|

13\. You are the one, having the complexion of snow, sandal-paste, lotus, lotus flower, the moon and the white lotus and you are the supreme goddess of all the letters, I bow in reverence to the goddess Sarasvati again and again. I

## \|\| 5.14 \|\|

*visargabindumātrāṇāṃ yadadhiṣṭhānameva ca \|*  
*itthaṃ tvaṃ gīyase sadbhirbhāratyai te namo namaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. You are supreme goddess of Visarga, Bindu and Ma(rd) thus the noble people recite your glory. I bow in reverence again and again to the goddess Bharati.

## \|\| 5.15 \|\|

*yayā vinā'tra saṃkhyākṛtsaṃkhyāṃ karttuṃ na śaknute \|*  
*kālasaṃkhyāsvarūpā yā tasyai devyai namo namaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. I bow in reverence to the one who is the goddess of counting and counts all the creatures in the universe. I bow in reverence to her again and again.

## \|\| 5.16 \|\|

*vyākhyāsvarūpā yā devī vyākhyādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā \|*  
*bhramasiddhāntarūpā yā tasyai devyai namo namaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. I bow in reverence to the one who is the goddess of principle and also explains the various types of principles, removing all the doubts. I bow in reverence to such a type of goddess again and again.

## \|\| 5.17 \|\|

*smṛtiśakti jñānaśakti buddhiśaktisvarūpiṇī \|*  
*pratibhākalpanāśaktiryā ca tasyai namo namaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. I bow in reverence to the goddess again and again who sharpens the memory increases knowledge, intelligence, glory and the sense of imagination.

## \|\| 5.18 \|\|

*sanatkumāro brahmāṇaṃ jñānaṃ papraccha yatra vai \|*  
*babhūva jaḍavatso'pi siddhāntaṃ karttumakṣamaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Once Sanat-kumara question to Brahma about the knowledge but Brahma in turn became motionless being unable to speak on the principle.

## \|\| 5.19 \|\|

*tadā''jagāma bhagavānātmā śrīkṛṣṇa īśvaraḥ \|*  
*uvāca sattamaṃ stotraṃ vāṇyā iti vidhiṃ tadā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. At that point of time lord Krishna arrived there and apprised Brahma of the best stotra of Sarasvati.

## \|\| 5.20 \|\|

*sa ca tuṣṭāva tāṃ brahmā cājñayā paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*cakāra tatprasādena tadā siddhāntamuttamam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. At the command of the lord, Brahma adored the goddess Sarasvati by reciting the same stotra and thereafter was successful in explaining the principle.

## \|\| 5.21 \|\|

*yadā'pyanantaṃ papraccha jñānamekaṃ vasundharā \|*  
*babhūva mūkavatso'pi siddhāntaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Similarly once the goddess Prthvi discussed about the eternal knowledge with serpent Ananta but he too could not speak on the principle and kept quiet.

## \|\| 5.22 \|\|

*tadā tvāṃ ca sa tuṣṭāva saṃtrastaḥ kaśyapājñayā \|*  
*tataścakāra siddhāntaṃ nirmalaṃ bhramabhañjanam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Thereafter the nervous serpent king adored the goddess Sarasvati and thereafter established the principle which removed all the doubts.

## \|\| 5.23 \|\|

*vyāsaḥ purāṇasūtraṃ ca samapṛcchata vālmikim \|*
