23\. Once the sage Vyasa questioned the sage Valmlki about gist of the Puranas who could not speak anything and kept quiet. Thereafter he started reciting your name in the form of the mother of the universe.

## \|\| 5.24 \|\|

*tadā cakāra siddhāntaṃ tvadvareṇa munīśvaraḥ \|*  
*sa prāpa nirmalaṃ jñānaṃ pramādadhvaṃsakāraṇam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. By your grace the sage spelt out the principle to him who achieved the great knowledge after getting his pride shattered.

## \|\| 5.25-29 \|\|

*purāṇasūtraṃ śrutvā sa vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇakalodbhavaḥ \|*  
*tvāṃ siṣeve ca dadhyau ca śatavarṣaṃ ca puṣkare \|*  
*tadā tvatto varaṃ prāpya sa kavīndro babhūva ha \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tadā vai vedabhāgaṃ ca purāṇāni cakāra ha \|*  
*yadā mahendre papraccha tattvajñānaṃ śivā śivam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*kṣaṇaṃ tvāmeva saṃcintya tasyai jñānaṃ dadau vibhuḥ \|*  
*papraccha śabdaśāstraṃ ca mahendraśca bṛhaspatim \|\| 27 \|\|*

*divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca sa tvāṃ dadhyau ca puṣkare \|*  
*tadā tvatto varaṃ prāpya divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam \|*  
*uvāca śabdaśāstraṃ ca tadarthaṃ ca sureśvaram \|\| 28 \|\|*

*adhyāpitāśca yaiḥ śiṣyā yairadhītaṃ munīśvaraiḥ \|*  
*te ca tvāṃ parisaṃcintya pravarttante sureśvari \|\| 29 \|\|*

25-29. Thereafter VySsa, who was born of the ray of lord Krishna listened to the Sutra of the Puranas and went to the Puskara region, where he meditated upon goddess Sarasvati for a hundred years. After having been blessed by goddess Sarasvati, he became a great poet. At that point of lime he divided the Vedas and also created Puranas. At the time when Parvati had question lord Shiva about the knowledge of tattva, dwelling over the Mahendra mountain, Shiva at that point of time meditated upon you for a moment and imparted the divine knowledge to Parvati. Thereafter India desired to know about the grammar for Brihaspati, went to the Puskara Ks etra and meditated upon Sarasvati for a hundred years.

## \|\| 5.30 \|\|

*tvaṃ saṃstutā pūjitā ca munīndramanumānavaiḥ \|*  
*daityendraiśca suraiścāpi brahmaviṣṇuśivādibhiḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. О supreme goddess, such of the sages who themselves studied and imparted for knowledge to their students, could do so, only after meditating upon you in a proper manner.

## \|\| 5.31-32 \|\|

*jaḍībhūtaḥ sahasrāsyaḥ pañcavaktraścaturmukhaḥ \|*  
*yāṃ stotuṃ kimahaṃ staumi tāmekāsyena mānavaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*ityuktvā yājñavalkyaśca bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ \|*  
*praṇanāma nirāhāro ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. О best of the sages, the Manugana, the Daitya, the gods, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva have adored goddess Sarasvati offering prayers to her. By reciting whose glory even the gods like Brahma, Shiva and Shesha had to keep quite then how can a person like me having only one face can recite your glory.

## \|\| 5.33 \|\|

*tadā jyotistvarūpā sā tenādṛṣṭā'pyuvāca tam \|*  
*sukavīndro bhavetyuktvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca jagāma ha \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Thus speaking Yajnavalkya bowed before her in reverence with his mind filled with devotion and keeping fast went on weeping again and again.

## \|\| 5.34 \|\|

*yājñavalkyakṛtaṃ vāṇīstotraṃ yaḥ saṃyataḥ paṭhet \|*  
*sa kavīndro mahāvāgmī bṛhaspatisamo bhavet \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. At that point of time the invisible Sarasvati spoke to him declaring, “You will become an eminent poet.” Thus speaking she left for Vaikuntha.

## \|\| 5.35 \|\|

*mahāmūrkhaśca durmedhā varṣamekaṃ ca yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*sa paṇḍitaśca medhāvī sukaviśca bhaveddhruvam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The immensely foolish and the one having the little intelligence if recites this stotra for a year, he surely gains intelligence and becomes a great poet.

## Chapter 6

## \|\| 6.1-2 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*sarasvatī sā vaikuṇṭhe svayaṃ nārāyaṇāntike \|*  
*gaṅgāśāpena kalayā kalahādbhārate sarit \|\| 1 \|\|*

*puṇyadā puṇyajananī puṇyatīrthasvarūpiṇī \|*  
*puṇyavadbhirniṣevyā ca sthitiḥ puṇyavatāṃ mune \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said — Sarasvati who always resided with Narayana in Vaikuntha was cursed by Ganga after a quarrel and she descended on the land of Bharata in the fonn of a ray of Narayana. О sage, the river Sarasvati has been quite meritorious and the creator of merit besides the holy places. The meritorious people who always serve her and the noble souls always reside on her banks.

## \|\| 6.3 \|\|

*tapasvināṃ taporūpā tapasyākārarūpiṇī \|*  
*kṛtapāpedhmadāhāya jvaladagnisvarūpiṇī \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. She appears in the form of tapas for ascetics. In the form of tapas the sacred river serves as a burning fire wood for the sin of the sinners.

## \|\| 6.4 \|\|

*jñāne sarasvatītoye gataṃ yairmānavairbhuvi \|*  
*teṣāṃ sthitiśca vaikuṇṭhe suciraṃ harisaṃsadi \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Whosoever takes a bath in the river Sarasvati and the one who meets with his death on her bank goes to Vaikuntha and remains there for a long time.

## \|\| 6.5 \|\|

*bhārate kṛtapāpaśca snātvā tatraiva līlayā \|*  
*mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇuloke vasecciram \|\| 5\|\|*

5\. Therefore, by taking a bath in that sacred river the people are easily relieved of all the sins and they reside in the Vishnuloka for a long time.

## \|\| 6.6-7 \|\|

*caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmakṣayāyāṃ dinakṣaye \|*  
*grahaṇe ca vyatīpāte'nyasminpuṇyadine'pi ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

*anuṣaṅgeṇa yaḥ snāti helayā śraddhayā'pi vā \|*  
*sārūpyaṃ labhate nūnaṃ vaikuṇṭhe sa harerapi \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. The one who playfully has a bath in the river on the fourteenth, full moon or on the third day of the fortnight, in the evenings, during the eclipse and other sacred occasion, he surely proceeds to the Vaikuntha and achieves salvation.

## \|\| 6.8 \|\|

*sarasvatīmantrakaṃ ca māsamekaṃ tu yo japet \|*  
*mahāmūrkhaḥ kavīndraśca sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The one who recites the Sarasvati-mantra seated over the bank of the sacred river, he becomes a great poet. There is no doubt it.

## \|\| 6.9 \|\|

*nityaṃ sarasvatītoye yaḥ snātvā muṇḍayennaraḥ \|*  
*na garbhavāsaṃ kurute punareva sa mānavaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. By taking bath in the river Sarasvati, daily or the one who has his head shaved there, he never lakes birth again.

## \|\| 6.10 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ kiṃcidbhāratīguṇakīrttanam \|*  
*sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Thus I have narrated to you the glory of Sarasvati which bestows welfare and salvation. Now what else do you want to listen from me.

## \|\| 6.11 \|\|

*sautiruvāca \|*  
*nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā nārado munisattamaḥ \|*  
*punaḥ papraccha sandehacchedaṃ śaunaka satvaram \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Sauti said — О Shaunaka on hearing the words of Narayana, N5rada, the best of the sages, then questioned Narayana again and again to remove the doubts of all.

## \|\| 6.12 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ sarasvatī devī gaṅgāśāpena bhārate \|*  
*kalayā kalahenaiva samabhūtpuṇyadā sarit \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Narada said — Because of the quarrel Ganga cursed Sarasvati and because of that she appeared in the land of Bharata. How did it happens?

## \|\| 6.13 \|\|

*śravaṇe śrutisārāṇāṃ varddhate kautukaṃ mama \|*  
*kathāmṛtānāṃ no tṛptiḥ kena śreyasi tṛpyate \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. This story is the essence of the Vedas and is like the, nectar, I feel quite anxious to listen about it. Why should it not be like that, because who feels satisfied with the welfare?

## \|\| 6.14 \|\|

*kathaṃ śaśāpa sā gaṅgā pūjitāṃ tāṃ sarasvatīm \|*  
*śāntā sattvasvarūpā ca puṇyadā sarvadā nṛṇām \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. How did Ganga pronounce a curse on the sacred Sarasvati. Because Ganga provides merits to the people, is quite peaceful and is the form of sattva.

## \|\| 6.15 \|\|

*tejasvinyordvayorvādakāraṇaṃ śrutisundaram \|*  
*sudurlabhaṃ purāṇeṣu tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 15\|\|*

15\. Therefore, I would like to know the reason of controversy between the two goddesses, which is quite beneficial and can be got from the Puranas with difficulty. You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 6.16-17 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm \|*  
*yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa sarvapāpātpramucyate \|\| 16 \|\|*

*lakṣmīssarasvatī gaṅgā tisro bhāryyā harerapi \|*  
*premṇā samāstāstiṣṭhanti satataṃ harisannidhau \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Narayana said — О Narada I am going to narrate to you the old story by remembering which a person is relieved of all the sins. Lord Vishnu had three spouses named Ganga, Sarasvati and Lakshmi who always resided with him with love and affection.

## \|\| 6.18 \|\|

*cakāra saikadā gaṅgā viṣṇormukhanirīkṣaṇam \|*  
*sasmitā ca sakāmā ca sakaṭākṣaṃ punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Once the desirous Ganga smilingly went to lord Vishnu and was looking at his face with a side glance.

## \|\| 6.19 \|\|

*vibhurjahāsa tadvaktraṃ nirīkṣya ca mudā kṣaṇam \|*  
*kṣamāṃ cakāra taddṛṣṭvā lakṣmīrnaiva sarasvatī \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Lord Vishnu also was smiling at heart looking at her face. Finding this Lakshmi did not care but Sarasvati could not tolerated the same.

## \|\| 6.20-21 \|\|

*bodhayāmāsa tāṃ padmā sattvarūpā ca sasmitā \|*  
*krodhāviṣṭā ca sā vāṇī na ca śāntā babhūva ha \|\| 20 \|\|*

*uvāca gaṅgāṃ bharttāraṃ raktāsyā raktalocanā \|*  
*kampitā kopavegena śaśvatprasphuritādharā \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Finding this, Lakshmi who was the form of sattva tried to conceive Sarasvati with love but her anger could not subside. Her face was burning in anger and the eyes were turning red. Sarasvati was therefore trembling with rage and her lower lip was fluttering again and again. She then said to Vishnu, the lord of Ganga.

## \|\| 6.22 \|\|

*sarasvatyuvāca \|*  
*sarvatra samatābuddhiḥ sadbhartuḥ kāminīḥ prati \|*  
*dharmiṣṭhasya variṣṭhasya viparītā khalasya ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Sarasvati said — The husband who is the religious minded on treats equally, all his wives and the wicked husband goes in the first opposite direction.

## \|\| 6.23 \|\|

*jñātaṃ saubhāgyamadhikaṃ gaṃgāyāṃ te gadādhara \|*  
*kamalāyāṃ ca tattulyaṃ na ca kiṃcinmayi prabho \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. О wielder of the club, О lord, I know that you are more attached to the Ganga, that is why she is more virtuous. You are also attached to Lakshmi equally well. But you are not at all attached to me.

## \|\| 6.24 \|\|

*gaṃgāyāḥ padmayā sārddhaṃ prītiścāpi susammatā \|*  
*kṣamāṃ cakāra tenedaṃ viparītaṃ haripriyā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Ganga is also attached to Lakshmi. Because of this she has also forgiven the opposite conduct to the Ganga.

## \|\| 6.25 \|\|

*kiṃ jīvanena me'traiva durbhagāyāśca sāmpratam \|*  
*niṣphalaṃ jīvanaṃ tasyā yā patyuḥ premavañcitā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. I am the unfortunate lady, therefore my living any further on earth would be of no consequence. Because the lady who is deprived of the love of her husband, her life is of no consequence.

## \|\| 6.26 \|\|

*tvāṃ sarveśaṃ sattvarūpaṃ ye vadanti manīṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*te ca mūrkhā na vedajñā na jānanti matiṃ tava \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Such of the people who consider you to be quite intelligent a the lord of all, beside being truthful, those foolish people are unaware of the Vedas nor your intelligence.

## \|\| 6.27 \|\|

*sarasvatīvacaḥ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā tāṃ kopasaṃyutām \|*  
*manasā tu samālocya sa jagāma bahiḥ sabhām \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. О hearing the words of Sarasvati, lord Vishnu felt enraged and he thought is his mind for some time and left the place.

## \|\| 6.28-29 \|\|

*gate nārāyaṇe gaṃgāmavocannirbhayaṃ ruṣā \|*  
*rāgādhiṣṭhātṛ devī sā vākyaṃ śravaṇaduḥsaham \|\| 28 \|\|*

*he nirlajje sakāme tvaṃ svāmigarvaṃ karoṣi kim \|*  
*adhikaṃ svāmisaubhāgyaṃ vijñāpayitumicchasi \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. On the departure of Narayana, Sarasvati the goddess of speech, fearlessly spoke in anger the poisonous words to Ganga, “O shameless and passionate lady, are you proud of your husband? Do you want to listen to the conduct of the husband.

## \|\| 6.30 \|\|

*mānahāniṃ kariṣyāmi tavādya harisannidhau \|*  
*kiṃ kariṣyati te kānto mama vai kāntavallabhe \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. I shall insult you before lord Vishnu today because you are very dear to your husband. I shall see what harm can your husband bring to me.”

## \|\| 6.31 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā gaṃgāyā jighṛkṣuṃ keśamudyatām \|*  
*vārayāmāsa tāṃ padmā madhyadeśasthitā satī \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Thus speaking Sarasvati attempted to hold the Ganga by her hair but Lakshmi stepped in and stood between both of them preventing Sarasvati to become violent.

## \|\| 6.32 \|\|

*śaśāpa vāṇī tāṃ padmāṃ mahākopavatī satī \|*  
*vṛkṣarūpā saridrūpā bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Thereafter the enraged Sarasvati pronounced a curse on Lakshmi, “You will take to the form of a tree and a river. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 6.33 \|\|

*viparītaṃ yato dṛṣṭvā kiṃcinno vaktumarhasi \|*  
*santiṣṭhasi sabhāmadhye yathā vṛkṣo yathā sarit \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Because finding me conducting myself in an opposite direction, you stood in the assembly like a tree or a river and spoke nothing.

## \|\| 6.34 \|\|

*śāpaṃ śrutvā ca sā devī na śaśāpa cukopa na \|*  
*tatraiva duḥkhitā tasthau vāṇīṃ dhṛtvā kareṇa ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Inspite of pronouncing a curse by Sarasvati on Kamala, the latter neither cursed him in revenge nor was she enraged. She stood there holding the hand of a Sarasvati with her mind filled with grief.

## \|\| 6.35 \|\|

*atyuddhatāṃ ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kopaprasphuritānanā \|*  
*uvāca gaṃgā tāṃ devīṃ padmāṃ padmavilocanā \|\| 35\|\|*

35\. Having seen stubborn Sarasvati with her face tensed with anger, the Ganga spoke to goddess Lakshmi.

## \|\| 6.36 \|\|

*gaṃgovāca \|*  
*tvamutsṛja mahogrāṃ tāṃ padme kiṃ me kariṣyati \|*  
*vāgduṣṭā vāgadhiṣṭhātrī devīyaṃ kalahapriyā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Ganga said — О noble lady, you leave this wicked women who is filled with anger. What harm can she bring to me. inspite of her being the goddess of speech, she is extremely quarrelling some.

## \|\| 6.37 \|\|

*yāvatī yogyatā'syāśca yāvatī śaktireva vā \|*  
*tathā karotu vādaṃ ca mayā sārddhaṃ sudurmukhā \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Therefore, let callous to blow the harsh words to the extent she may do it with me.

## \|\| 6.38 \|\|

*svabalaṃ yanmama balaṃ vijñāpayitumarhatu \|*  
*jānantu sarve hyubhayoḥ prabhāvaṃ vikramaṃ sati \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Let her measure her strength with that of mine. Let all the people witness our strength with that of mine. Let all the people witness our influence and prowess.”

## \|\| 6.39 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā sā devī vāṇyai śāpaṃ dadāviti \|*  
*saritsvarūpā bhavatu sā yā tvāmaśapadruṣā \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Thus speaking the Ganga pronounced a curse on Sarasvati, “The one who has pronounced a curse on Lakshmi with harsh words will also be turned into the river and should flow on earth near the dwellings of the sinful people. Let her flow there in the Kaliyuga earning for herself the sins of others. There will be no doubt about it.

## \|\| 6.40 \|\|

*adho martyaṃ sā prayātu santi yatraiva pāpinaḥ \|*  
*kalau teṣāṃ ca pāpāṃśaṃ labhiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Thus speaking Sarasvati pronounced a curse the Ganga also, “You will also flow on earth and shall earn the sins of the sinners.”

## \|\| 6.41 \|\|

*ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tāṃ śaśāpa sarasvatī \|*  
*tvameva yāsyasi mahīṃ pāpipāpaṃ labhiṣyasi \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. In the meantime Vishnu also arrived there with his attendant. Holding Sarasvati with both his hands he embraced her and enlightened her with his divine knowledge.

## \|\| 6.42-43 \|\|

*etasminnantare tatra bhagavānājagāma ha \|*  
*caturbhujaścaturbhiśca pārṣadaiśca caturbhujaiḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*sarasvatīṃ kare dhṛtvā vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi \|*  
*bodhayāmāsa sarvajñaḥ sarvajñānaṃ purātanam \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. Lord Vishnu then came to know of the curses pronounced by the ladies on one and other and spoke to them appropriately.

## \|\| 6.44 \|\|

*śrutvā rahasyaṃ tāsāṃ ca śāpasya kalahasya ca \|*  
*uvāca duḥkhitāstāśca vākyaṃ sāmayikaṃ vibhuḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The lord said — O Lakshmi having a divine figure, you go on earth and out of your rays, you will be born in the house of Dharmadhvaja, as Ayonija. You will, after having been so born, become the wife of SarhkhacQda and by the moves of destiny, you will be turned as a tree.

## \|\| 6.45-46 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*lakṣmi tvaṃ kalayā gaccha dharmadhvajagṛhaṃ śubhe \|*  
*ayonisambhavā bhūmau tasya kanyā bhaviṣyasi \|\| 45\|\|*

*tatraiva daivadoṣeṇa vṛkṣatvaṃ ca labhiṣyasi \|*  
*madaṃśasyāsurasyaiva śaṅkhacūḍasya kāminī \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. Thereafter you will arrive this place and resume the form of my wife. In the country of Bharata you will be known by the name of Tulasi having the effects of purifying the universe.

## \|\| 6.47 \|\|

*bhūtvā paścācca matpatnī bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*trailokyapāvanī nāmnā tulasīti ca bhārate \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. О damsel, having the beautiful face, you move at once to Bharata because of the curse of Sarasvati, you turn a ray of yourself into the form of a river and you will be known as Padmavati. О Ganga you will also move on to Bharata because of the curse pronounced on you by Sarasvati and you will remove the sins of the sinful people. You will be turned into a river from one of your rays.

## \|\| 6.48-49 \|\|

*kalayā ca saridbhūtvā śīghraṃ gaccha varānane \|*  
*bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpānnāmnā padmāvatī bhava \|\| 48 \|\|*

*gaṅge yāsyasi cāṃśena paścāttvaṃ viśvapāvanī \|*  
*bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpātpāpadāhāya dehinām \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. You will have to descent on earth because of the tapas of Bhaglratha and you will be known as Bhaglrathi in the universe. О best of the goddess, the ocean would be born on earth from my rays and the king Santanu would also be born from my rags and with my permission you be his queen.

## \|\| 6.50-51 \|\|

*bhagīrathasya tapasā tena nītā suduṣkarāt \|*  
*nāmnā bhāgīrathī pūtā bhaviṣyasi mahītale \|\| 50 \|\|*

*madaṃśasya samudrasya jāyā jāye mamājñayā \|*  
*mattkalāṃśasya bhūpasya śantanośca sureśvari \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. О Bharati, because of the curse pronounced by Ganga you also go and be born on earth and you suffer the pain of quarrelling with co-wives. Thereafter you go to Brahma and be his wife. Ganga thereafter should go to the Shiva and Laks ml should stay here.

## \|\| 6.52 \|\|

*gaṅgāśāpena kalayā bhārataṃ gaccha bhārati \|*  
*kalahasya phalaṃ bhuṅkṣva sapatnībhyāṃ sahācyute \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. This is because she is peaceful devoid of anger, devoted to me, bears my form, extremely chaste, meritorious, quite humble and is devoted to dharma. All the ladies who are born of her rays on earth would be quite religious, chaste, peaceful and humble.

## \|\| 6.53-55 \|\|

*svayaṃ ca brahmasadanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kāminī bhava \|*  
*gaṅgā yātu śivasthānamatra padmaiva tiṣṭhatu \|\| 53\|\|*

*śāntā c krodharahitā madbhaktā matsvarūpiṇī \|*  
*mahāsādhvī mahābhāgā suśīlā dharmacāriṇī \|\| 54 \|\|*

*yadaṃśakalayā sarvā dharmiṣṭhāśca pativratāḥ \|*  
*śāntarūpā suśīlāśca prativiśveṣu yoṣitaḥ\|\| 55 \|\|*

53-55. Because it is against the command of the Vedas to have three wives, three houses, three servants and three brothers. This does not invoke welfare.

## \|\| 6.56 \|\|

*tisro bhāryyāstrayaḥ śyālāstrayo bhṛtyāśca bāndhavāḥ \|*  
*dhruvaṃ vedaviruddhāśca na hyete maṅgalapradāḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. The house in which a man conducts like a lady and a lady conducts like a man, their birth is of no consequence and they are known to be inauspicious at every step.

## \|\| 6.57 \|\|

*strī puṃvacca gṛhe yeṣāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ strīvaśaḥ pumān \|*  
*niṣphalaṃ janma vai teṣāmaśubhaṃ ca pade pade \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The one whose wife is foolish and speaks harsh words and is wicked besides being quarrelsome, such a person should remain in the dense forest and not in the house.

## \|\| 6.58 \|\|

*mukhaduṣṭā yoniduṣṭā yasya strī kalahapriyā \|*  
*araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ mahāraṇyaṃ gṛhādvaram \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Because in the forest he would be able to get water, fruits and root quite easily. These fruits and water are always available in the forest quite easily which he cannot get at home.

## \|\| 6.59 \|\|

*janānāṃ ca sthalānāṃ ca purāṇāṃ prāptireva ca \|*  
*satataṃ sulabhā tatra na teṣāṃ tadgṛhe'pi ca \|\| 59\|\|*

59\. It is better to jump into the fire flames or to live among the wild animals but it is quite difficult for a man of live with woman who is more troublesome. This is certain.

## \|\| 6.60 \|\|

*varamagnau sthitirhiṃsrajantūnāṃ sannidhau sukham \|*  
*tato'pi duḥkhaṃ puṃsāṃ ca duṣṭastrīsannidhau dhruvam \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. О beautiful faced one, the flames of a medicine or the flames of the poison are better but the flames emerging out of the mouths of the wicked women are worse than death.

## \|\| 6.61 \|\|

*vyādhijvālā viṣajvālā varaṃ puṃsāṃ varānane \|*  
*duṣṭastrīṇāṃ mukhajvālā maraṇādatiricyate \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Such of the people who are subjugated to the harsh treatment by the lady, their life remains of the consequence. Whatever good deeds he performs during the day never gets a reward for them. All the people denounce him on earth and after his death he goes to the hell. Therefore such a person is devoid of glory and popularity. He becomes like dead while still living.

## \|\| 6.62-63 \|\|

*puṃsaśca strījitasyeha jīvitaṃ niṣphalaṃ dhruvam \|*  
*yadahnā kurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet \|\| 62 \|\|*

*sa nindito'tra sarvatra paratra narakaṃ vrajet \|*  
*yaśakīrtivihīno yo jīvannapi mṛto hi saḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. It is not proper to lodge to the all co-wives at one at the same place and it is better to be the husband only of one wife which is more pleasant. This type of pleasure one can never get after becoming husband of many wives.

## \|\| 6.64 \|\|

*bahvīnāṃ ca sapatnīnāṃ naikatra śreyasī sthitiḥ \|*  
*ekabhāryyaḥ sukhī naiva bahubhāryyaḥ kadācana \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Therefore, О Ganga you go to lord Shiva and О Sarasvati you go to Brahma. Only the virtuous Lakshmi should stay with me.

## \|\| 6.65 \|\|

*gaccha gaṃge śivasthānaṃ brahmasthānaṃ sarasvati \|*  
*atra tiṣṭhatu maddehe suśīlā kamalālayā \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Because the one who has the wife with simple nature, quite humble and chaste, he gets all the pleasures of the heaven on earth.

## \|\| 6.66 \|\|

*susādhyā yasya patnī ca suśīlā ca pativratā \|*  
*iha svargasukhaṃ tasya dharmamokṣau paratra ca \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. The one whose wife is a chaste, he gets free from all the troubles, becomes purified and delightful. The husband of an unchaste women is like the dead while still living and becomes impure and has a painful mind.

## \|\| 6.67 \|\|

*pativratā yasya patnī sa ca muktaḥ śuciḥ sukhī \|*  
*jīvanmṛto'śucirduḥkhī duśśīlāpatireva yaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. О Narada thus speaking, the lord of the universe kept quiet. Thereafter all the ladies holding each other started crying aloud.

## \|\| 6.68 \|\|

*ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho virarāma ca nārada \|*  
*atyuccai rurudurdevyaḥ samāliṅgya parasparam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Thereafter trembling with tears flowing from their eyes, filled with grief, they all started praying to lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 6.69 \|\|

*tāśca sarvāḥ samālocya krameṇocuḥ sadīśvaram \|*  
*kampitāḥ sāśrunetrāśca śokena ca bhayena ca \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Sarasvati said — О lord, you kindly tell me the ways and means to purify a wicked lady like me because how can a lady remain alive after having been disowned by his virtuous husband?

## \|\| 6.70 \|\|

*sarasvatyuvāca \|*  
*prāyaścittaṃ dehi nātha duṣṭāyāṃ janmaśodhakam \|*  
*satsvāminā parityaktāḥ kutra jīvanti kāḥ striyaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Therefore, I shall put an end to my body in Bharata by resorting to yogic practices because after having reached such tremendous height the down fall is sure to come.

## \|\| 6.71 \|\|

*dehatyāgaṃ kariṣyāmi dhruvaṃ yogena bhārate \|*  
*atyuccato nipatanaṃ prāptumarhati niścitam \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Ganga said — О lord of the universe, what is the reason for your disowning me? I shall also put an end to my life which will earn you the sin of the killing of a sinless person.

## \|\| 6.72 \|\|

*gaṃgovāca \|*  
*ahaṃ kenāparādhena tvayā tyaktā jagatpate \|*  
*dehatyāgaṃ kariṣyāmi nirdoṣāyā vadhaṃ labha \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Because the people on earth who disown their sinless wives have to remain in the hell for a kalpa whether they be the person like you.

## \|\| 6.73 \|\|

*nirdoṣakāminītyāgaṃ kurute yo jano bhave \|*  
*sa yāti narakaṃ kalpaṃ kiṃ te sarveśvarasya vā \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. Lakshmi said — О lord you are truthful by nature and posses the sattva form. It is quite surprising that you have been enraged. You be pleased with us because a husband of good nature forgives his wife. This is of immense virtues.

## \|\| 6.74 \|\|

*lakṣmīruvāca \|*  
*nātha sattvasvarūpastvaṃ kopaḥ kathamaho tava \|*  
*prasādaṃ kuru cāsmabhyaṃ sadīśasya kṣamā varā \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. In case I descend on earth under the curse of Sarasvati, then for how long shall I remain there. After some time I am sure to come back to you and have a glance at your lotus-like feet. The sinful people taking bath in my water would be relieved of their sins. By accepting their sins how shall I be freed from them and how shall I be able to reach here. О infallible one, I shall be born as Tulasi the daughter of Dharmadhvaja how shall I be able to adore your feet.

## \|\| 6.75-77 \|\|

*bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpādyāsyāmi kalayā yadi \|*  
*katikālaṃ sthitistatra kadā drakṣyāmi te padam \|\| 75 \|\|*

*dāsyanti pāpinaḥ pāpaṃ mahyaṃ snānāvagāhanāt \|*  
*kena tasmādvimuktā'hamāgamiṣyāmi te padam \|\| 76 \|\|*

*kalayā tulasīrūpā dharmadhvajasutā satī \|*  
*bhūtvā kadā labhiṣyāmi tvatpādāmbujamacyuta \|\| 77 \|\|*

75-77. О compassionate one, how by becoming a tree and its goddess, shall I remain on earth. When shall it be possible for you to redeem me, you kindly let me know. If Ganga remains on earth because of the curse of Sarasvati then when I shall be able to achieve you getting relieved of the cursed.

## \|\| 6.78-79 \|\|

*vṛkṣarūpā bhaviṣyāmi tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā \|*  
*māmuddhariṣyasi kadā tanme brūhi kṛpānidhe \|\| 78 \|\|*

*gaṃgā sarasvatīśāpādyadi yāsyati bhāratam \|*  
*śāpena muktā pāpācca kadā tvāṃ vā labhiṣyati \|\| 79 \|\|*

78-79. In case the Ganga shall descend on earth with the curse of Sarasvati then how shall she be able to free from the curse. О lord, you are asking Sarasvati to go to Brahma and Ganga to Shiva, you kindly forgive them.

## \|\| 6.80-81 \|\|

*gaṃgāśāpena sā vāṇī yadi yāsyati bhāratam \|*  
*kadā śāpādvinirmucya labhiṣyati padaṃ tava \|\| 80 \|\|*

*tāṃ vāṇīṃ brahmasadanaṃ gaṃgāṃ vā śivamandiram \|*  
*gantuṃ vadasi he nātha tatkṣamasva ca te vacaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

80-81. Thus speaking Lakshmi fell at the feet of lord Vishnu prostrating before him and she started crying washing his feet with her tears and rinsing them with her hair.

## \|\| 6.82 \|\|

*ityuktvā kamalā kāntapadaṃ dhṛtvā nanāma ca \|*  
*sukeśairveṣṭayitvā ca ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. The lord who is always compassionate to his devotees and from whose navel the lotus had emerged, embraced Lakshmi and smilingly said.

## \|\| 6.83 \|\|

*uvāca padmanābhastāṃ prabhāṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi \|*  
*īṣaddhāsaḥ prasannāsyo bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Narayana said — О best of the goddesses, I accept your words and I shall also maintain my words. I shall also make all the three of you alike. Therefore you listen to me.

## \|\| 6.84 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*tvadvākyamācariṣyāmi svavākyaṃ ca sureśvari \|*  
*samatāṃ ca kariṣyāmi śṛṇu tatkramameva ca \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Lakshmi will descend on earth as a river as one of her rays. The rest of her rays should go to Brahma and her complete set of rays should remain with me.

## \|\| 6.85 \|\|

*bhāratī yātu kalayā saridrūpā ca bhāratam \|*  
*arddhāṃśā brahmasadanaṃ svayaṃ tiṣṭhatu madgṛhe \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. Similarly the Ganga as a result of the tapas of Bhaglratha should descent on earth in the form of her ray, in order to purify the three worlds and should reside here in complete form with me.

## \|\| 6.86 \|\|

*bhagīrathena nītā sā gaṃgā yāsyati bhāratam \|*  
*pūtaṃ kartuṃ tribhuvanaṃ svayaṃ tiṣṭhatu madgṛhe \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. She will also achieve as her abode, the head of the lord Shiva. Being pure by nature Ganga would also stand for purifying others. О Lakshmi, born of lotus, you will also descend on earth as one of your rays and shall be known as the river Padmavati and the plant named Tulasi.

## \|\| 6.87-88 \|\|

*tatraiva candramauleśca mauliṃ prāpsyati durlabham \|*  
*tataḥ svabhāvataḥ pūtā'pyatipūtā bhaviṣyati \|\| 87 \|\|*

*kalāṃśāṃśena gaccha tvaṃ bhārate kamalodbhave \|*  
*padmāvatī saridrūpā tulasīvṛkṣarūpiṇī \|\| 88 \|\|*

87-88. After completion of five thousand years of Kaliyuga you will be freed from the curse and the form of the rivers and shall return to me.

## \|\| 6.89 \|\|

*kaleḥ pañcasahasre ca gate varṣe ca mokṣaṇam \|*  
*yuṣmākaṃ saritāṃ bhūyo madgṛhe cāgamiṣyatha \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. О Lakshmi the riches are always the cause of misfortune of people on earth, no one on earth can achieve glory without facing misfortunes.

## \|\| 6.90 \|\|

*sampadāṃ hetubhūtā ca vipattiḥ sarvadehinām \|*  
*vinā vipattirmahimā keṣāṃ padme bhavedbhave \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. You will be relieved of the sins when the people who are immensely devoted to you take bath in your waters.

## \|\| 6.91 \|\|

*manmantropāsakānāṃ ca satāṃ snānāvagāhanāt \|*  
*yuṣmākaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pāpātpāpisparśanahetukāt \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. О beautiful one there innumerable holy places in Bharata. All these places will get sanctified with the truth and the presence of my devotees.

## \|\| 6.92-93 \|\|

*pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni santyasaṃkhyāni sundari \|*  
*bhaviṣyanti ca pūtāni madbhaktasparśadarśanāt \|\| 92 \|\|*

*manmantropāsakā bhaktā bhramante bhārate sati \|*  
*pūtaṃ karttuṃ bhārataṃ ca supavitrāṃ vasundharām \|\| 93 \|\|*

92-93. О chaste women, the devotees reciting my mantras roam about on earth purifying every place.

## \|\| 6.94 \|\|

*madbhaktā yatra tiṣṭhanti pādaṃ prakṣālayanti ca \|*  
*tatsthānaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ supavitraṃ bhaveddhruvam \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. Wherever my devotees stay, wherever they wash their feet those places become the sacred places.

## \|\| 6.95 \|\|

*strīghno goghnaḥ kṛtaghnaśca brahmaghno gurutalpagaḥ \|*  
*jīvanmukto bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. The people who are condemned for the killing of wives, cows, Brahma and Brahmanas, those who are ungraceful, seek the company of the wives of their Gurus (teacher) they also get purified having an audience with my devotees and by touching them.

## \|\| 6.96-97 \|\|

*ekādaśīvihīnaśca sandhyāhīno'pi nāstikaḥ \|*  
*vṛṣavāho bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt \|\| 96 \|\|*

*asijīvī maṣījīvī dhāvakaḥ śūdrayājakaḥ \|*  
*vṛṣavāho bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt \|\| 97 \|\|*

96-97. Such of the people who do not performs Ekadashi-vrata, do not perform sandhyd, the non believer and the killers of humans also get purified with an audience of my devotees. The one who earns his living with the sale of weapons, those who maintain accounts, the messengers, those who adore Sfldras and the Brahmanas resorting to ploughing the fields by yoking the bullocks also get purified at the sight of my devotees.

## \|\| 6.98-99 \|\|

*viśvāsaghātī mitraghno mithyāsākṣyapradāyakaḥ \|*  
*nyāsahārī bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt \|\| 98 \|\|*

*ṛṇagrasto vārddhuṣiko jārajaḥ puṃścalīpatiḥ \|*  
*pūtaśca puṃścalīputro madbhaktasparśadarśanāt \|\| 99 \|\|*

98-99. The one who betrays is a killer of the friend, one who provides the false evident, one who misappropriates others trusts also gets purified with the touch and the audience of my devotees. The debtor, the money-lender, the illegitimate son, wicked women, the husband of a wicked women and her son also get purified by looking and touching my devotees.

## \|\| 6.100 \|\|

*śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraśca devalo grāmayājakaḥ \|*  
*adīkṣito bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. The store-keeper of the Shudras, the priest of the temple, one who performs yajna's in village after village, the one who is devoid of dlksa are also purified at the sight and touch of my devotees.

## \|\| 6.101 \|\|

*aśvatthaghātakaścaiva madbhaktānāṃ ca nindakaḥ \|*  
*aniveditabhojī ca pūto madbhaktadarśanāt \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. The one who cuts-off the Asvattha tree, the one who denounces my devotees, one who enjoys food without invitations also gets purified with the sight of my devotee.

## \|\| 6.102-103 \|\|

*mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhāryyāṃ bhrātaraṃ tanayaṃ sutām \|*  
*guroḥ kulaṃ ca bhaginīṃ vaṃśahīnaṃ ca bāndhavam \|\| 102 \|\|*

*śvaśrūṃ ca śvaśuraṃ caiva yo na puṣṇāti nārada \|*  
*sa mahāpātakī pūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt \|\| 103 \|\|*

102-103. О Narada the one who does not serve his parents, his wife, his brothers, daughter, the teacher, sister, the brother having no issues and the parents-in-law also get purified at the sight and touch of my devotee.

## \|\| 6.104-105 \|\|

*devadravyāpahārī ca vipradravyāpahārakaḥ \|*  
*lākṣāloharasānāṃ ca vikretā duhitustathā \|\| 104 \|\|*

*mahāpātakinaścaite śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhakāḥ \|*  
*bhaveyurete pūtāśca madbhaktasparśadarśanāt \|\| 105 \|\|*

104-105. The one who kidnap the riches of the gods and the Brahmanas and the one who deals in wax, iron, ashes, the one who sells away the daughter and those burning the dead bodies of Sfldra also gel purified at the touch and sight of my devotees.

## \|\| 6.106-108 \|\|

*lakṣmīruvāca \|*  
*bhaktānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi bhaktānugrahakāraka \|*  
*yeṣāṃ sandarśanasparśātsadyaḥ pūtā narādhamāḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

*haribhaktivihīnāśca mahāhaṅkārasaṃyutāḥ \|*  
*svapraśaṃsāratā dhūrttāḥ śaṭhā vai sādhu nindakāḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

*punanti sarvatīrthāni yeṣāṃ snānāvagāhanāt \|*  
*yeṣāṃ ca pādarajasā pūtā pādodakānmahī \|\| 108 \|\|*

106-108. Lakshmi said — О lord, you bestow your grace on your devotees. You therefore tell me all about those of your devotees with the touch and sight of whom one gets purified, because those who are devoid of the devotion of Vishnu, the immensely arrogant people, those who are always engaged in self-praise, the wicked, the cheats, the denouncer of the ascetics also gets purified at the sight and touch of the devotees. Even the sacred places are further sanctified wherever they take their bath and the particles of the dust purified the earth.

## \|\| 6.109 \|\|

*yeṣāṃ sandarśanaṃ sparśaṃ devā vāñchanti bhārate \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ paramo lābho vaiṣṇavānāṃ samāgamaḥ \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. Even the gods are always desirous of having a vision and company with Vaishnavas as having a colloquial with them is benevolent for all.

## \|\| 6.110 \|\|

*na hyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ \|*  
*te punantyurukālena viṣṇubhaktāḥ kṣaṇādaho \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. It is not the holy place where water alone is available, nor is the image of a god made of earth is called the god, because the image gets sanctified because of its adoration for long. In fact only the devotees of Vishnu should be treated to be true gods because they get purified for serving long to the lord. The tine devotees of Vishnu can purify a person in no time.

## \|\| 6.111 \|\|

*sautiruvāca \|*  
*mahālakṣmīvacaḥ śrutvā lakṣmīkāntaśca sasmitaḥ \|*  
*nigūḍhatattvaṃ kathitumṛṣiśreṣṭhopacakrame \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. Sauti said — О best of the sages on listening to the words of Maha-Lakshmi, lord Vishnu smiled and then spoke about the deep rattvas.

## \|\| 6.112 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*bhaktānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣmi gūḍhaṃ śrutipurāṇayoḥ \|*  
*puṇyasvarūpaṃ pāpaghnaṃ sukhadaṃ bhuktimuktidam \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. Lord Narayana said — O Lakshmi Ihc signs of fine devotees have been spelt out in the Shrutis and the Puranas which are meritorious, remover of sins, bestower of bliss ana the granter of devotion apd salvation.

## \|\| 6.113 \|\|

*sārabhūtaṃ gopanīyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ khaleṣu ca \|*  
*tvāṃ pavitrāṃ prāṇatulyāṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. It is quite secretive because of its being the essence. One should not talk about them to the wicked people. I am speaking this to you because you are like my own life. Therefore you listen to me.

## \|\| 6.114 \|\|

*guruvaktrādviṣṇumantro yasya karṇe viśedvaraḥ \|*  
*vadanti vedavedāṅgāttaṃ pavitraṃ narottamam \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. The mantra of lord Vishnu after emerging from the mouth of the teacher entered into the ears of someone who is called to be the pure by the Vedas and others scriptures.

## \|\| 6.115 \|\|

*puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ pūrvaṃ pūtaṃ tajjanmamātrataḥ \|*  
*svargasthaṃ narakasthaṃ vā muktiṃ prāpnoti tatkṣaṇāt \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. A hundred of his ancestors get purified whether they are in the heaven or hell. They achieve deliverance at once.

## \|\| 6.116-117 \|\|

*yaiḥ kaiścidyatra vā janma labdhaṃ yeṣu ca jaṃtuṣu \|*  
*jīvanmuktāste ca pūtā yānti kāle hareḥ padam \|\| 116 \|\|*

*madbhaktiyukto matpūjāniyukto madguṇānvitaḥ \|*  
*\| madguṇaślāghanīyaśca manniviṣṭaśca santatam \|\| 117 \|\|*

116-117. Out of his ancestors if anyone is reborn on earth in any form, he gets benefited by them and achieves salvation, riches the heaven. The one whose mind is engrossed in my devotion, he always performs adoration to me and also praises my in several way and also remains devoted to me getting engrossed in my meditation.

## \|\| 6.118-119 \|\|

*madguṇaśrutimātreṇa sānandaḥ pulakānvitaḥ \|*  
*sagadgadaḥ sāśrunetraḥ svātmavismṛtireva ca \|\| 118 \|\|*

*na vāñchanti sukhaṃ muktiṃ sālokyādi catuṣṭayam \|*  
*brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā tadvāñchā mama sevane \|\| 119 \|\|*

118-119. On listening to my merits he becomes blissful and emotional, his voice is choked and his eye are filled with tears and he looses consciousness. He does not desire for the pleasure or the four type of salvation, nor does he long for becoming Brahman or being eternal. He is only desirous of serving me.

## \|\| 6.120 \|\|

*indratvaṃ ca manutvaṃ ca devatvaṃ ca sudurlabham \|*  
*svargarājyādibhogaṃ ca svapne'pi na hi vācchati \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. Similarly the throne of Indra, human beings, godhood and the rule of the heaven are beyond his comprehension.

## \|\| 6.121 \|\|

*brahmāṇḍāni vinaśyanti devā brahmādayastathā \|*  
*kalyāṇabhaktiyuktaśca madbhakto na praṇaśyati \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. The entire globe vanishes, the god like Brahma and others also disappears but the person who is endowed with my grace and devotion is never destroyed.

## \|\| 6.122 \|\|

*bhramanti bhārate bhaktā labdhvā janma sudurlabham \|*  
*te'pi yānti mahīṃ pūtāṃ kṛtvā tīrthaṃ mamālayam \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. Thus having been born on earth in Bharata which is difficult to achieve, these devotees roam about all the directions and purify the sacred places and the earth and ultimately return to my abode.

## \|\| 6.123 \|\|

*ityetatkathitaṃ sarvaṃ kuru padme yathocitam \|*  
*tadājñātāśca tāścakrurharistasthau sukhāsane \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. О Lakshmi thus I have told you everything now. You do whatever you like best.” Thereafter accepting the command of the lord, all the three of them acted as was desired by lord Vishnu. Thereafter lord VisOeu was seated over his lion throne.

## Chapter 7

## \|\| 7.1 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*puṇyakṣetre hyājagāma bhārate sā sarasvatī \|*  
*gaṅgāśāpena kalayā svayaṃ tasthau hareḥ pade \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Niirayana said — Because of the curse of the Ganga, Sarasvati with her single ray descended over the sacred land of Bharata and with her remaining rays she remained with the lord.

## \|\| 7.2 \|\|

*bhāratī bhārataṃ gatvā brāhmī ca brahmaṇaḥ priyā \|*  
*vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā tena vāṇī ca kīrttitā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Sarasvati on the other hand with her descending in the land of Bharata, was known as Bharatl. Because of her being the beloved of Brahma, she was known as Brahmi and being the goddess of speech she was known as Vanl.

## \|\| 7.3 \|\|

*sarvaṃ viśvaṃ parivyāpya srotasyeva hi dṛśyate \|*  
*hariḥ sarassu tasyeyaṃ tena nāmnā sarasvatī \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Though Vishnu pervades the entire universe, he is seen sleeping in the watery bed therefore coming in touched with the waters, Van! the beloved of Vishnu came to be known as Sarasvati.

## \|\| 7.4 \|\|

*sarasvatī nadī sā ca tīrtharūpā'tipāvanī \|*  
*pāpipāpedhmadāhāya jvaladagnisvarūpiṇī \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Descending on earth in the form of a river, many holy places developed on her banks which served as the fire flames to burn the sins of the sinners.

## \|\| 7.5 \|\|

*paścādbhagīrathānītā mahīṃ bhāgīrathī śubhā \|*  
*samājagāma kalayā vāṇīśāpena nārada \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. О Narada thereafter with the curse of Sarasvati, Ganga also descended on earth in one of her rays being meditated upon by Bhaglratha.

## \|\| 7.6 \|\|

*tatraiva samaye tāṃ ca dadhāra śirasā śivaḥ \|*  
*vegaṃ soḍhumaśaktāyā bhuvaḥ prārthanayā vibhuḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. At the time of descending, Shiva established her in the matted locks of hair over his head because the earth was unable to bear the force of her flow and Shiva had been prayed to contain her force.

## \|\| 7.7 \|\|

*padmā jagāma kalayā sā ca padmāvatī nadī \|*  
*bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpātsvayaṃ tasthau hareḥ pade \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Lakshmi on the other hand influenced with the curse of Sarasvati appeared on earth in one of her rays as river Padmavati and she herself remained close to the lord with the rest of her rays.

## \|\| 7.8 \|\|

*tato'nyayā sā kalayā cālabhajjanma bhārate \|*  
*dharmadhvajasutā lakṣmīrvikhyātā tulasīti ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Thereafter, with another ray, she also appeared as the daughter of Dhannadhvaja and she came to be known as Tulasi.

## \|\| 7.9 \|\|

*purā sarasvatīśāpāttatpaścāddhariśāpataḥ \|*  
*babhūva vṛkṣarūpā sā kalayā viśvapāvanī \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. With the curse of Sarasvati and subsequently with the curse of the lord, Lakshmi the preserver of the universe, with one of her rays, turned herself into the form of a tree.

## \|\| 7.10-11 \|\|

*kaleḥ pañcasahasraṃ ca varṣaṃ sthitvā ca bhārate \|*  
*jagmustāśca saridrūpaṃ vihāya śrīhareḥ padam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*yāni sarvāṇi tīrthāni kāśīṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vinā \|*  
*yāsyanti sārddhaṃ tābhiśca harervaikuṇṭhamājñayā \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. After the completion of five thousand years in Kaliyuga, all of them living there in river forms reverted to the abode of lord Vishnu. The sacred places of Kas'I, Vnrdavana and all other returned to Vaikuntha with them.

## \|\| 7.12 \|\|

*śālagrāmo harermūrttirjagannāthaśca bhāratam \|*  
*kalerdaśasahasrānte yayau tyaktvā hareḥ padam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. After the completion of ten thousand years the image of Shalagrama and Jagannatha would also revert to Vishnuloka.

## \|\| 7.13 \|\|

*vaiṣṇavāśca purāṇāni śaṅkhāśca śrāddhatarpaṇam \|*  
*vedoktāni ca karmāṇi yayustaiḥ sārddhameva ca \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The attendants of Vishnu, Puranas, the conch, the sraddhas, tarpana and all the rites prescribed in the Vedas will also disappear.

## \|\| 7.14 \|\|

*haripūjā harernāma tatkīrttiguṇakīrttanam \|*  
*vedāṅgāni ca śāstrāṇi yayustaiḥ sārddhameva ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The adoration of the lord, the name of the lord, recitation of their names, the sixth parts of the Vedas and the Shastras will also disappear.

## \|\| 7.15 \|\|

*sattvaṃ ca satyaṃ dharmaśca vedāśca grāmyadevatāḥ \|*  
*vrataṃ tapasyā'naśanaṃ yayustaiḥ sārddhameva ca \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The saints, the truth, dharma, Vedas, village deities, resolution, penance and fast will also disappear with them.

## \|\| 7.16-17 \|\|

*vāmācāraratāḥ sarve mithyākāpaṭyasaṃyutāḥ \|*  
*tulasīvarjitā pūjā bhaviṣyati tataḥ param \|\| 16 \|\|*

*ekādaśīvihīnāśca sarve dharmavivarjitāḥ \|*  
*hariprasaṅgavimukhā bhaviṣyanti tataḥ param \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Thereafter the followers of the left path and those who attacked the shastras, falsehood, cheat shall remain on the earth. Thereafter lord Vishnu will be adored without Tulasi-leaves. All the people will remain without Ekadasi-vrata, devoid of dharma and shall always move against Narayana.

## \|\| 7.18-19 \|\|

*śaṭhāḥ krūrā dāmbhikāśca mahāhaṅkārasaṃyutāḥ \|*  
*caurāśca hiṃsakāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti tataḥ param \|\| 18 \|\|*

*puṃsāṃ bhedastathā strīṇāṃ vivāho vādanirṇayaḥ \|*  
*svasvāmibhedo vastūnāṃ na bhaviṣyatyataḥ param \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. All the people thereafter would become wicked, heartless, crafty, arrogant, thief and violent. There would remain no difference between the men and women. The institution of marriage will disappear, miscarriage of justice would take place and an usurping trend in the title of objects would emerge.

## \|\| 7.20 \|\|

*sarve janāḥ strīvaśāśca puṃścalyaśca gṛhe gṛhe \|*  
*tarjanairbhartsanaiḥ śaśvatsvāminaṃ tāḍayanti ca \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. All the men will be under the influence of women and the houses will be ruled by the wicked women who will denounce their husband's every now and then.

## \|\| 7.21-22 \|\|

*gṛheśvarī ca gṛhiṇī gṛhī bhṛtyādhiko'dhamaḥ \|*  
*ceṭībhṛtyāsamā vadhvaḥ śvaśrūśca śvaśurastathā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*karttāro balino gehe yonisambandhibāndhavāḥ \|*  
*vidyāsambandhibhiḥ sārddhaṃ sambhāṣā'pi na vidyate \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. The house-wife shall be the owner of the house and the position of the man will be verse then servants. All other ladies of the house would be treated as servants. The father-in-law and mother-in-law will also meet the same situation. The one who is quite valorous shall be the leader of the house. Only those will be considered as brothers who are born from the same mother but those who are connected with the knowledge and learnings, will be of no consequences.

## \|\| 7.23 \|\|

*yathā paricitā lokāstathā puṃsaśca bāndhavāḥ \|*  
*sarvakarmākṣamāḥ puṃso yoṣitāmājñayā vinā \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The brothers will conduct themselves as aliens. A man will not be able to perform anything without the permission on his wife.

## \|\| 7.24-25 \|\|

*brahmakṣattriyaviṭśūdrā jātyā cāravinirṇayaḥ \|*  
*saṃdhyā ca yajñasūtraṃ ca bhāvaluptaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*mlecchācārā bhaviṣyanti varṇāścatvāra eva ca \|*  
*mlecchaśāstraṃ paṭhiṣyanti svaśāstrāṇi vihāya te \|*  
*brahmakṣatraviśāṃ vaṃśāḥ śūdrāṇāṃ sevakāḥ kalau \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. The Brahmanas, Kstarlyas, Vaisyas and Shudras will discard the duties of their own varnas would act like Mlecchas and disowning all their scriptures would own the scriptures of the Mlecchas. In the Kaliyuga, the Brahmanas, Ksartrlyas and the Vaishyas will serve the Shudras.

## \|\| 7.26 \|\|

*sūpakārā bhaviṣyanti dhāvakā vṛṣavāhakāḥ \|*  
*satyahīnā janāḥ sarve sasyahīnā ca medinī \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The people of all the castes will become the lords of stores, beside being the messengers, loading the bullocks and devoid of truth. The earth also will be deprived of her greenery.

## \|\| 7.27 \|\|

*phalahīnāśca taravo'patyahīnāśca yoṣitaḥ \|*  
*kṣīrahīnāstathā gāvaḥ kṣīraṃ sarpirvivarjitam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The trees will be without fruits, the ladies will bear no children, the cows will yield no milk and the milk will yield no ghee.

## \|\| 7.28 \|\|

*dampatī prītihīnau ca gṛhiṇaḥ sukhavarjitāḥ \|*  
*pratāpahīnā bhūpāśca prajāśca karapīḍitāḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The husband and wife shall not be devoted to each other and the house hold would be deprived of the pleasure. There will be no glory к ft with the kings and the people will suffer for the payment of revenue.

## \|\| 7.29-30 \|\|

*jalahīnā nadā nadyo dīrghikāḥ kandarādayaḥ \|*  
*dharmahīnā puṇyahīnā varṇāścatvāra eva ca \|\| 29 \|\|*

*lakṣeṣu puṇyavānko'pi na tiṣṭhati tataḥ param \|*  
*kutsitā vikṛtākārā narā nāryyaśca bālakāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. The rivers, rivulets, step-wells and the springs will remain without water and all the people of the four varnas will be deprived of their respective clhanna. There will be a virtuous person in lakhs, the thinking of men, women and children’s will be polluted and will be deformed.

## \|\| 7.31-32 \|\|

*kuvārttāḥ kutsitapathā bhaviṣyanti tataḥ param \|*  
*kecidgrāmāśca nagarā naraśūnyā bhayānakāḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*kecitsvalpakuṭīreṇa nareṇa ca samanvitāḥ \|*  
*araṇyāni bhaviṣyanti grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. They will speak of malicious things, following the wrong path. Some of the cities and the villages will be without population and shall look terrific. In some of them the people will dwell in small huts. Therefore the outlook of the villages and the cities would become similar.

## \|\| 7.33 \|\|

*araṇyavāsinaḥ sarve janāśca karapīḍitāḥ \|*  
*sasyāni ca bhaviṣyanti taḍāgeṣu nadīṣu ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The forest-dwellers will also have to suffer from the payment of taxes. The irrigation would continue by means of the tanks and river water.

## \|\| 7.34 \|\|

*kṣetrāṇi sasyahīnāni prakṛṣṭānyarthataḥ param \|*  
*hīnāḥ prakṛṣṭā dhanino baladarpasamanvitāḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. There would be no good yield of crops and the good harvest will not be profitable. The law-graded people will be honoured. The rich and valorous people shall become arrogant.

## \|\| 7.35 \|\|

*prakṛṣṭavaṃśajā hīnā bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge \|*  
*alīkavādino dhūrttāḥ śaṭhā vai satyavādinaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. In the Kaliyuga the people of the high castes will engage themselves in degraded works and resort of false hood cheating and wickedness. In spite of that, they will be considered as truthful

## \|\| 7.36 \|\|

*pāpinaḥ puṇyavantaścāpyaśiṣṭaḥ śiṣṭa eva ca \|*  
*jitendriyā lampaṭāśca puṃścalyaśca pativratāḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The sinful people would be considered as virtuous. The uncivilised people would be considered as civilised ones. The cheats would be considered as self-disciplined and the wicked women would be considered as chaste ones.

## \|\| 7.37 \|\|

*tapasvinaḥ pātakino viṣṇubhaktā avaiṣṇavāḥ \|*  
*hiṃsakāśca dayāyuktāścaurāśca naraghātinaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The degraded peoples would be considered as ascetics but the people who will believe in lord Vishnu shall continued to be called as the devotees of Vishnu. The people who resort to violence would be considered as the compassionate ones. The thiefs will become the killer of the people.

## \|\| 7.38 \|\|

*bhikṣuveṣadharā dhūrttā nindantyupahasanti ca \|*  
*bhūtādisevānipuṇā janānāṃ modakāriṇaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The cheats would take to the form of ascetics and continue denouncing everyone and finding fault with them. Those who believes in goblins and pretas etc. would become very popular.

## \|\| 7.39 \|\|

*pūjitāste bhaviṣyanti vañcakā jñānadurbalāḥ \|*  
*vāmanā vyādhiyuktāśca narā nāryyaśca sarvataḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The people possessing little knowledge would be considered as intellectuals and the cheats would invite adoration. All the men and women would be of dwarfish nature.

## \|\| 7.40 \|\|

*alpāyuṣo jarāyuktā yauvaneṣu kalau yuge \|*  
*palitā ṣoḍaśe varṣe mahāvṛddhāstu viṃśatau \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Thus in the age of Kaliyuga the people have short span on life. They become old, while being young and at the age of sixteen their hair will grow grey and at the age of twenty the old age will over-power them.

## \|\| 7.41 \|\|

*aṣṭavarṣā ca yuvatī rajoyuktā ca garbhiṇī \|*  
*vatsarānte prasūtā strī ṣoḍaśena jarānvitā \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The women shall attain youthfulness at the age of eight and will start menstruation at the same age and shall also conceive. They will produce a child at the end of each year and shall grow old at the age of sixteen.

## \|\| 7.42-43 \|\|

*etāḥ kāścitsahasreṣu vandhyāścāpi kalau yuge \|*  
*kanyāvikrayiṇaḥ sarve varṇāścatvāra eva ca \|\| 42 \|\|*

*mātṛjāyāvadhūnāṃ ca jāropārjanatatparāḥ \|*  
*kanyānāṃ bhaginīnāṃ ca jāropārjanajīvinaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. In the age of Kali some of the ladies shall be barren and the people of all the varnas will sell away their daughters; the mother, the women and the daughter-in-law shall all remain busy in earnings livelihood from unfair means. The men will earn their livings through the friends of their daughters and sisters.

## \|\| 7.44 \|\|

*harernāmnāṃ vikrayiṇo bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge \|*  
*svayamutsṛjya dānaṃ ca kīrtivarddhanahetave \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. In the age of Kali the people will sell out the name of the lord and to enhance their glory shall give away things in charity.

## \|\| 7.45-49 \|\|

*tatpaścānmanasā''locya svayamullaṅghayiṣyati \|*  
*devavṛttiṃ brahmavṛttiṃ vṛttiṃ gurukulasya ca \|\| 45 \|\|*

*svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā sarvamullaṅghayiṣyati \|*  
*kanyakāgāminaḥ kecitkecicchvaśrvabhigāminaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*keciddhugāminaśca kecitsarvataragāminaḥ \|*  
*bhaginīgāminaḥ kecitsapatnīmātṛgāminaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*bhrātṛjāyāgāminaśca bhaviṣyati kalau yuge \|*  
*agamyāgamanaṃ caiva kariṣyanti gṛhe gahe \|\| 48 \|\|*

*ātmayoniṃ parityajya vihariṣyanti sarvataḥ \|*  
*patnīnāṃ nirṇayo nāsti bhartṝṇāṃ ca kalau yuge \|\| 49 \|\|*

45-49. But after the second thought they shall get back the same. The godhood, the Brahmana-hood are the functioning of a teacher, whether it is given by someone else are is self acquired. The people would snatch them away in the age of Kaliyuga. The people will enjoy the company of their own daughter; some would enjoy the company one's own father-in-law or daughters-in-law, while some of the people would enjoy the company of all. Some of them would have illicit relation with their own sisters, some with the step-mothers and some with the brother's wives. In every house-hold the people will have illicit relation with prohibited women. Leaving their mothers, they will enjoy the company of all ladies. In the Kaliyuga no one would be able to decide the relationship between a husband and a wife.

## \|\| 7.50 \|\|

*prajānāṃ caiva vastūnāṃ grāmāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*alīkavādinaḥ sarve sarve cauryārthalampaṭāḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The people will not be able to establish their ownership rights over the villages and the treasures. Almost all the people would resort to falsehood without any reason. All the people would take to stealing and become cheats.

## \|\| 7.51-52 \|\|

*parasparaṃ hiṃsakāśca sarve ca naraghātinaḥ \|*  
*brahmakṣatraviśāṃ vaṃśā bhaviṣyanti ca pāpinaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*lākṣāloharasānāṃ ca vyāpāraṃ lavaṇasya ca \|*  
*vṛṣavāhā vipravaṃśāḥ śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhinaḥ \|\| 52\|\|*

51-52. All will indulge themselves into violence and kill human beings. The off-springs of Brahmanas Ksatrlyas and Vaisyas will always resort to the sinful ways. The people born in the families of Brahmanas shall deal in wax, iron, rasa and salt besides loading over the bullocks and burning the bodies of the SOdras.

## \|\| 7.53-55 \|\|

*śūdrānnabhojinaḥ sarve sarve ca vṛṣalīratāḥ \|*  
*pañcaparvaparityaktāḥ kuhūrātriṣu bhojinaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*yajñasūtravihīnāśca sandhyāśaucavihīnakāḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*puṃścalī vārdhuṣā'vīrā kuṭṭinī ca rajasvalā \|*  
*viprāṇāṃ randhanāgāre bhaviṣyanti ca pācikāḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

53-55. All the people shall eat the food cooked by Shudras and shall enjoy the company of the Shudra damsels. The В rah man as will not perform Pahcayajhas and can also eat food on the moonless night. They will discard yajhopavTta, performing of sandhya and all the cleansing practices. The wicked women, money-lenders, those having no sons, the degraded women and the women in period shall perform the duties of cooking food in the houses of Brahmanas.

## \|\| 7.56 \|\|

*annānāṃ nirṇayo nāsti yonīnāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*āśramāṇāṃ janānāṃ ca sarve mlecchāḥ kalau yuge \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. No difference between will be left in the different types of foods of the ladies and the inmates of Asrama. All would become Mlecchas in the Kaliyuga.

## \|\| 7.57 \|\|

*evaṃ kalau saṃpravṛtte sarve mlecchamayā bhave \|*  
*hastapramāṇe vṛkṣe cāṅguṣṭhamāne ca mānave \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Thus after the arrival of terrific Kaliyuga all would become Mleccha. At that point of time the trees will be of height of one hand and the humans will be of the size of a thumb.

## \|\| 7.58 \|\|

*viprasya viṣṇuyaśasaḥ putraḥ kalkī bhaviṣyati \|*  
*nārāyaṇakalāṃśaśca bhagavānbalināṃ balī \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. At that point of time in the house of a Brahmana named Vishnuyasha, Narayana shall appear in one of his rays in the form of the great Kalki as the son of the Brahmana.

## \|\| 7.59-60 \|\|

*dīrgheṇa karavālena dīrghaghoṭakavāhanaḥ \|*  
*mlecchaśūnyāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ trirātreṇa kariṣyati \|\| 59 \|\|*

*nirmlecchāṃ vasudhāṃ kṛtvā cāntarddhānaṃ kariṣyati \|*  
*arājakā ca vasudhā datyugrastā bhaviṣyati \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. Не will be mounted over a very big horse and liolding a sword in his hand, he shall destroy all the Mlecchas on earth. Thus the earth would be rid of the Mlecchas, after which he will disappear. At that point of time there will be a chaos on earth. Everywhere and the undesirable activities of the thieves and plunderers would be on the increase.

## \|\| 7.61-62 \|\|

*sthūlapramāṇaṃ ṣaḍrātraṃ varṣādhārāplutā mahī \|*  
*lokaśūnyā vṛkṣaśūnyā gṛhaśūnyā bhaviṣyati \|\| 61 \|\|*

*tataśca dvādaśādityāḥ kariṣyantyudayaṃ mune \|*  
*prāpnoti śuṣkatāṃ pṛthvī samā teṣaṃ ca tejasā \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. Thereafter for six nights continuously, there would be heavy rains on earth which would submerge everything on earth. No human beings or the trees or the houses would be insight. Thereafter, all the twelve Adityas would rise in the sky and dry away the water on earth.

## \|\| 7.63 \|\|

*kalau gate ca durddharṣe saṃpravṛtte kṛte yuge \|*  
*tapassatyasamāyukto dharmaḥ pūrṇo bhaviṣyati \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Reaching at this stage, there will be an end to Kaliyuga and the start of Krtayuga, in which the truth and the tapas would remerge completely together with dharma.

## \|\| 7.64 \|\|

*tapasvinaśca dharmiṣṭhā vedajñā brāhmaṇā bhuvi \|*  
*pativratāśca dharmiṣṭhā yoṣitaśca gṛhe gṛhe \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. At that point of time the Brahmana will perform tapas. They will be extremely religious and well-versed in the Vedic knowledge. In the every house hold, there will be chaste lady devoted to religion.

## \|\| 7.65 \|\|

*rājānaḥ kṣatriyāḥ sarve viprabhaktāḥ svadharmiṇaḥ \|*  
*pratāpavanto dharmiṣṭhāḥ puṇyakarmaratāḥ sadā \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. There will be regional kings who will be devoted to their own dharma, devoted to the Brahmana, glorious, devoted dharma and will be performing always the good deeds.

## \|\| 7.66 \|\|

*vaiśyā vāṇijyaniratā viprabhaktāśca dhārmikāḥ \|*  
*śūdrāśca puṇyaśīlāśca dharmiṣṭhā viprasevinaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. The Vaishyas will engage themselves in commerce and will be devoted to the Brahmana and the religion. The Shudras also will be quite meritorious, devoted to dharma and adore the Brahmana.

## \|\| 7.67 \|\|

*viprakṣattraviśāṃ vaṃśā viṣṇuyajñaparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*viṣṇumantraratāḥ sarve viṣṇubhaktāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. The Brahmana, Kshatriyas and Vaisyas will perform the yajha's of Vishnu. There will be Vais navas always reciting the name of lord Vishnu and devoted to me.

## \|\| 7.68 \|\|

*śrutismṛtipurāṇajñā dharmajñā ṛtugāminaḥ \|*  
*leśo nāsti hyadharmāṇāṃ dharmapūrṇe kṛte yuge \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. They will be well-versed in Smrtis, Shrutis and Puranas, beside dharma and will enjoy the company of their wives only at the appropriate time. Therefore this Krtayuga will be influenced only by dharma and there will be no particle of adharma.

## \|\| 7.69 \|\|

*dharmastripācca tretāyāṃ dvipācca dvāpare smṛtaḥ \|*  
*kalau pravṛtte pādātmā sarvalopastataḥ param \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. In the Tretayiiga, the dharma will stands on three legs, in Kaliyuga only on one leg and ultimately even that will disappear.

## \|\| 7.70-71 \|\|

*vārāḥ sapta yathā vipra tithayaḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ \|*  
*yathā dvādaśa māsāśca ṛtavaśca ṣaḍeva hi \|\| 70 \|\|*

*dvau pakṣau cāyane dve ca caturbhiḥ praharairdinam \|*  
*caturbhiḥ prahare rātrirmāsastriṃśaddinaistathā \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. О Brahmana the seven days (in a weak), sixteen dates and twelve months have been prescribed; similarly six seasons have also been prescribed. In a month there are two fortnights, in a year there are two half years (Ayanas). There are eight praharas in a day, of which four of them form the night and four of them the day. Thirty days make a month.

## \|\| 7.72-73 \|\|

*varṣaḥ pañcavidho jñeyaḥ kālasaṃkhyāṃ nibodha me \|*  
*yathā cāyānti yāntyeva tathā yugacatuṣṭayam \|\| 72 \|\|*

*varṣe pūrṇe narāṇāṃ ca devānāṃ ca divāniśam \|*  
*śatatraye ṣaṣṭyadhike narāṇāṃ ca yuge gate \|*  
*devānāṃ ca yugo jñeyaḥ kālasaṃkhyāvidāṃ mataḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

72-73. The year is of five types. Now I tell you about the counting of the time. As the days rise and end, similarly all the four yugas also come and end. A single divine day and night of Manu compares with the completed year of the humans. Those well-versed in the signs of time, ordain that after the passing of the three hundred and sixty yugas of the humans, a divine yuga of gods is made.

## \|\| 7.74-75 \|\|

*manvantaraṃ tu divyānāṃ yugānāmekasaptatiḥ \|*  
*manvatarasamaṃ jñeyaṃ cendrāyuḥ parikīrtitam \|\| 74 \|\|*

*aṣṭāviṃśatime cendre gate brāhmaṃ divāniśam \|*  
*aṣṭottare varṣaśate gate pāto vidherbhavet \|\| 75 \|\|*

74-75. Seventy one divine yugas comprise of a manvantara. And age of India is equivalent to one manvantara. Thus after the existence of twenty eight Indras, there is one day and night of the Brahma. Thus after the lapse of the hundred and eight years, the life of Brahma comes to an end.

## \|\| 7.76-77 \|\|

*pralayaḥ prākṛto jñeyastatrādṛṣṭā vasundharā \|*  
*jalaplutāni viśvāni brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

*ṛṣayo jīvinaḥ sarve līnāḥ kṛṣṇe parātpare \|*  
*tatraiva prakṛtirlīnā tena prākṛtiko layaḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. That is called the natural dissolution of the universe. At that point of time, the earth becomes invisible and the entire universe is submerged in water. All gods like Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, the ascetics and all the creatures which are moveable and immovable merge to the body of lord Krishna. The nature also is merged in him. That is why it is known as the natural dissolution.

## \|\| 7.78 \|\|

*laye prākṛtike'tīte pāte ca brahmaṇo mune \|*  
*nimeṣamātraḥ kālaśca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. О sage, after the fall of Brahma and his merging at the time of dissolution, the entire period is like the winking of the eye like Krishna.

## \|\| 7.79 \|\|

*evaṃ naśyanti sarvāṇi brahmāṇḍānyakhilāni ca \|*  
*sthitau golokavaikuṇṭhau śrīkṛṣṇaśca sapārṣadaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. Thus the entire globe is destroyed but the Goloka and the Vaikuntha remain intact together with lord Krishna and his attendants.

## \|\| 7.80 \|\|

*nimeṣamātraḥ pralayo yatra viśvaṃ jalaplutam \|*  
*nimeṣānantare kāle punaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ krameṇa ca \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. The universe is resolved in the winking of the eyes of lord Krishna and submerged in water. In the winking of the eyes of lord Krishna the same universe re-emerges.

## \|\| 7.81 \|\|

*evaṃ katividhā sṛṣṭirlayaḥ katividho'pi vā \|*  
*katikṛtvo gatāyātaḥ saṃkhyāṃ jānāti kaḥ pumān \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. Thus the number of time the universe was created and it met with dissolution, the number of kalpas which might have passed, it difficult to describe and none knows about them.

## \|\| 7.82 \|\|

*sṛṣṭīnāṃ ca kalānāṃ ca brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca nārada \|*  
*brahmādīnāṃ ca vidhyaṇḍe saṃkhyāṃ jānāti kaḥ pumān \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. О Narada, who can know the number of the universes, the dissolutions, the globes, Brahma and other gods residing in them.

## \|\| 7.83 \|\|

*brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca sarveṣāmīśvaraścaika eva saḥ \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ paramātmā ca śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Krishna happens to be the lord of entire cosmic and is the supreme-soul to all beyond Prakriti.

## \|\| 7.84 \|\|

*brahmādayaśca tasyāṃśāstasyāṃśaśca mahāvirāṭ \|*  
*tasyāṃśaśca virāṭ kṣudrastasyāṃśā prakṛtiḥ smṛtā \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Brahma and other gods are the rays of that lord. Mahavirat is the ray of Brahma etc., Its ray formulates the junior-Virat while the Prakriti is the ray of that junior-Virat.

## \|\| 7.85 \|\|

*sa ca kṛṣṇo dvidhābhūto dvibhujaśca caturbhujaḥ \|*  
*caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe goloke dvibhujaḥ svayam \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. There lord Krishna had been divided into two parts. One of them is two armed and the other form, has four arms. He resides in the Vaikunt ha. The two armed lord Krishna resides in the Goloka.

## \|\| 7.86 \|\|

*brahmāditṛṇaparyyantaṃ sarvaṃ prākṛtikaṃ bhavet \|*  
*yadyatprākṛtikaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ naśvarameva ca \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. Everything from Brahma to the hay are treated as Prakriti. Whatever comes under the purview of Prakriti is all perishable.

## \|\| 7.87-88 \|\|

*viddhyekaṃ sṛṣṭimūlaṃ tatsatyaṃ nityaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ brahma nirliptaṃ nirguṇaṃ param \|\| 87 \|\|*

*nirupādhiṃ nirākāraṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham \|*  
*atīva kamanīyaṃ ca navīnaghanasannibham \|\| 88 \|\|*

87-88. Lord Krishna happens to be the cause of all the creations, truthful, eternal, ever-lasting, moving according to his own wish, the extreme Brahman, unattached, invisible, beyond, the nature and is devoid of any degrees. Inspite of that, in order to bestow his grace on his devotee, he takes to human form. He is extremely beautiful and the complexion of his body resembles the new clouds.

## \|\| 7.89 \|\|

*dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ gopaveṣaṃ kiśorakam \|*  
*sarvajñaṃ sarvasevyaṃ ca paramātmānamīśvaram \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. Не has two arms, holds a flute in his hands and appears in the form of a tender aged cowherd. He knows everything and is served by all. He is the supreme soul and the lord.

## \|\| 7.90-94 \|\|

*karoti dhātā brahmāṇḍaṃ jñānātmā kama lodbhavaḥ \|*  
*śivo mṛtyuñjayaścaiva saṃharttā sarvatattvavit \|\| 90 \|\|*

*yasya jñānādyattapasā sarveśastatsamo mahān \|*  
*mahāvibhūtiyuktaśca sarvajñaḥ sarvadā svayam \|\| 91 \|\|*

*sarvavyāpī sarvapātā sa dātā sarvasampadām \|*  
*viṣṇuḥ sarveśvaraḥ śrīmānyasya jñānājjagatpatiḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

*mahāmāyā ca prakṛtiḥ sarvaśaktimatīśvarī \|*  
*yajjñānādyasya tapasā yadbhaktyā yasya sevayā \|\| 93 \|\|*

*sāvitrī vedamātā ca vedādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā \|*  
*pūjyā dvijānāṃ vedajñā yajñādyasyāśca sevayā \|\| 94 \|\|*

90-94. Brahma getting emerged from the navel of the lord, resorts to creation. He is well-versed in all the tattvas and has over-powered the death and in the form of Shiva who has over-powered the death, engages himself in destruction. With the learning bestowed by him and with his influence, he has become great and achieved the highest position. With the influence of the supreme soul of lord Krishna, lord Vishnu is possessed with greatest of the treasures, is all knowledgeable, the one who can see everyone, the one who pervades the universe, the protector of all and the one who can bestow all the treasures. He is the best of the gods and the lord of everyone.

## \|\| 7.95 \|\|

*sarvavidyādhidevī sā pūjyā ca viduṣāṃ purā \|*  
*yatsevayā yattapasā yasya jñānātsarasvatī \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. Willi the learnings imparted by him, the tapas, the devotion and service, the nature (Prakriti) has possessed all the prowess besides achieving all the learnings and has become adorable by the wise people.

## \|\| 7.96 \|\|

*yatsevayā yattapasā pradātrī sarvasaṃpadām \|*  
*dhanasasyādhidevī sā mahālakṣmīḥ sanātanī \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. By serving him and performing tapas for him the everlasting Maha-Lakshmi has become the great goddess of riches and wealth.

## \|\| 7.97-98 \|\|

*yatsevayā yattapasā sarvaviśveṣu pūjitā \|*  
*sarvagrāmādhidevī sā sarvasampatpradā yinī \|\| 97 \|\|*

*sarveśvarī sarvavandyā sarveśaṃ prāpa yā patim \|*  
*sarvastutā ca sarvajñā durgā durgatināśinī \|\| 98 \|\|*

97-98. By serving him and with the influence of his tapas Durga is adored in the entire universe becoming the great goddess of knowledge, bestower of all the riches, adorable by all, accepting Shiva as her husband. She is adored by all and is all knowledgeable and removes the fear and pains of the people.

## \|\| 7.99-100 \|\|

*kṛṣṇavāmāṃśasambhūtā kṛṣṇapremādhidevatā \|*  
*kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā premṇā rādhikā kṛṣṇasevayā \|\| 99 \|\|*

*sarvādhikaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ mānagauravam \|*  
*kṛṣṇavakṣasthalasthānaṃ patnītvaṃ prāpa sevayā \|\| 100 \|\|*

99-100. Radhika was originated from the left part of lord Kasim, the same place where the breathing god resides. She had by virtue of extreme service to that god, acquired as a boon excellent beauty, luck, honour and pride as also secured wifehood and an everlasting place on the heart of that lord.

## \|\| 7.101 \|\|

*tapaścakāra sā pūrvaṃ śataśṛṅge ca parvate \|*  
*divyaṃ yugasahasraṃ ca nirāhārā'tikarśitā \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. Radhika had performed tapas at the mountain of hundred peaks for a thousand divine yugas. She became very weak by fasting.

## \|\| 7.102 \|\|

*kṛśāṃ niḥśvāsarahitāṃ dṛṣṭvā candrakalopamām \|*  
*kṛṣṇo vakṣaḥsthale kṛtvā ruroda kṛpayā vibhuḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. Then finding her having been reduced to the form of a ray of the moon, lord Krishna embraced her and started crying out of compassion.

## \|\| 7.103 \|\|

*varaṃ tasyai dadau sāraṃ sarveṣāmapi durlabham \|*  
*mama vakṣaḥsthale tiṣṭha mayi te bhaktirastviti \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. Thereafter lord Krishna bestowed Radha with many boons saying, “O dearest one, you will always remain in my heart and also devoted to me.

## \|\| 7.104 \|\|

*saubhāgyena ca mānena premṇā vai gauraveṇa ca \|*  
*tvaṃ me śreṣṭhā paraṃ premṇā jyeṣṭhā tvaṃ sarvayoṣitām \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. Because of your nature, your pride, your love and the glory, you will be the best of all and you will be senior most wife among the ladies.

## \|\| 7.105 \|\|

*variṣṭhā ca gariṣṭhā ca saṃstutā pūjitā mayā \|*  
*santataṃ tava sādhyo'haṃ bādhyaśca prāṇavallabhe \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. You will achieve the best of glory and honour and I shall always praise you and adore you. You consider myself always to be under you and I shall obey your command always.”

## \|\| 7.106 \|\|

*ityuktvā jagatāṃ nāthaścakre taccetanāṃ tataḥ \|*  
*sapatnīrahitāṃ tāṃ ca cakāra prāṇavallabhām \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. Thus Krishna who happens to be the lord of the universe cautioned her and he relieved his beloved wife of all the trouble.

## \|\| 7.107 \|\|

*yeṣāṃ yā yāśca devyo vai pūjitāstasya sevayā \|*  
*tapasyā yādṛśī yāsāṃ tāsāṃ tādṛkphalaṃ mune \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. All the wives of the gods whosoever have been honoured by each one of them, they have been so honoured because of the adoration of lord Krishna. О sage, those of the people who have performed tapas in a particular way reap the harvest accordingly.

## \|\| 7.108-109 \|\|

*divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca tapastaptvā himālaye \|*  
*durgā ca tatpadaṃ dhyātvā sarvapūjyā babhūva ha \|\| 108 \|\|*

*sarasvatī tapastaptvā parvate gandhamādane \|*  
*lakṣavarṣaṃ ca divyaṃ ca sarvavandyā babhūva sā \|\| 109 \|\|*

108-109. As goddess Durga achieved the divinehood after performing tapas over the Himalaya mountain for thousands of years, concentrating here mind at the feet of lord Krishna, she became adorable by all. Sarasvati on the other hand performed severe tapas for a lakh of divine years at the Gandhamadana mountain and thereafter she became adorable by all.

## \|\| 7.110 \|\|

*lakṣmīryugaśataṃ divyaṃ tapastaptvā ca puṣkare \|*  
*sarvasampatpradātrī sā cābhavattasya sevayā \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. Lakshmi performed tapas for the Puskara region for a hundred yugas as a result of which she achieved the proficiency of bestowing riches to all.

## \|\| 7.111 \|\|

*sāvitrī malaye taptvā dvijapūjyā babhūva sā \|*  
*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasraṃ ca divyaṃ dhyātvā ca tatpadam \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. Savitri on the other hand, performed severe tapas at Malayacala for divine sixty thousand years at the feet of the lord and became adorable by Brahma.

## \|\| 7.112-113 \|\|

*śatamanvantaraṃ taptaṃ śaṃkareṇa purā vibho \|*  
*śatamanvantaraṃ caiva brahmaṇā tasya bhaktitaḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

*śatamanvantaraṃ viṣṇustaptvā pātā babhūva ha \|*  
*śatamanvantaraṃ dharmastaptvā pūjyo babhūva ha \|\| 113 \|\|*

112-113. О lord, in the earlier times, Shiva and Brahma performed tapas with great devotion for a hundred Manvantras. Vishnu also performed tapas for a similar period and thereafter, he became the protector of all.

## \|\| 7.114 \|\|

*manvantaraṃ tapastepe śeṣo bhaktyā ca nārada \|*  
*manvantaraṃ ca sūryyaśca śakraścandrastathā guruḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. О Narada, Surya, Shesha, Indra moon and Brihaspati also performed tapas with great devotion for the lord for a manvantara.

## \|\| 7.115 \|\|

*divyaṃ śatayugaṃ caiva vāyustaptvā ca bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*sarvaprāṇaḥ sarvapūjyaḥ sarvādhāro babhūva saḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. The wind-god also performed tapas with great devotion for a hundred yugas and became the life of all and adorable by all.

## \|\| 7.116 \|\|

*evaṃ kṛṣṇasya tapasā sarve devāśca pūjitāḥ \|*  
*munayo mānavā bhūpā brāhmaṇāścaiva pūjitāḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. Similarly, performing tapas for lord Krishna all the gods, the sages and humans besides the kings and Brahmanas, achieve the respectable position.

## \|\| 7.117 \|\|

*evaṃ te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ purāṇaṃ ca tathā''gamam \|*  
*guruvaktrādyathā jñātaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. Thus I have spoken the gist of the Puranas and Agamas, whatever I had heard from the mouth of my teacher. What else do you want to know from me?

## Chapter 8

## \|\| 8.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*harernimeṣamātreṇa brahmaṇaḥ pāta eva ca \|*  
*tasya pāte prākṛtikaḥ pralayaḥ parikīrttitaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said — With the twinkling of the and eye once. The end of the life of Brahma amounts to the dissolution.

## \|\| 8.2-4 \|\|

*pralaye prākṛte coktaṃ tatrādṛṣṭā vasundharā \|*  
*jalaplutāni viśvāni sarve līnā harāviti \|\| 2 \|\|*

*vasundharā tirobhūtā kutra vā tatra tiṣṭhati \|*  
*sṛṣṭervidhānasamaye sā''virbhūtā kathaṃ punaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kathaṃ babhūva sā dhanyā mānyā sarvāśrayā jayā \|*  
*tasyāśca janmavistāraṃ vada maṅgalakāraṇam \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. At the time of that natural dissolution, the earth disappears and the entire universe gets submerged in water. Thus everything gets absorbed in lord Krishna. Then where does this earth disappear and how does it resurfaces at the time of beginning of the universe how does she become fortunate enough again to grow vegetation on itself? You kindly let me know the story of earth in detail which provides welfare.

## \|\| 8.5 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*sarvādisṛṣṭau sarveṣāṃ janma kṛṣṇāditi śrutiḥ \|*  
*āvirbhāvastirobhāvaḥ sarveṣu pralayeṣu ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Narayana said — Everything emerges from lord Krishna at the time of creation of the universe and at the time of dissolution they merge in him. This has been ordained by the Shrutis.

## \|\| 8.6 \|\|

*śrūyatāṃ vasudhājanma sarvamaṃgalamaṃgalam \|*  
*vighnanighnaṃ paraṃ pāpa nāśanaṃ puṇyavarddhanam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Now you listen to the story of the beginning of the world which is of quite pleasant in nature, destructor of the obstructions, the best, remover of the sins and is quite meritorious.

## \|\| 8.7 \|\|

*aho kecidvadantīti madhukaiṭabhamedasā \|*  
*babhūva vasudhā dhanyā tadviruddhamataṃ śṛṇu \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Some of the people express the opinion that the earth came into existence with the fluid from Madhu and Kaitabha which is again the earlier theory. You listen to the story.

## \|\| 8.8-10 \|\|

*ūcatustau purā viṣṇuṃ tuṣṭau yuddhena tejasā \|*  
*āvāṃ jahi na yatrorvī payasā saṃvṛteti ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tayorjīvanakālena pratyakṣā ca bhavetsphuṭam \|*  
*tato babhūva medaśca maraṇānantaraṃ tayoḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*medinīti ca vikhyātetyuktā yaistanmataṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*jaladhautā kṛśā pūrvaṃ varddhitā medasā yataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. In the ancient times the two demons Madhu and Kaitabha were pleased at lord Vishnu's prowess in war. They were pleased and said: ‘'You can kill us at the place where the earth is not covered with water.” It is evident from this, that at the time when both of them were at five the earth was not visible. When they were dead, some fluid emerged out of their bodies and the earth was formed with it. That is why the earth is also called MedinT. You just listen to the clarification of the story. In the earlier times, there was water everywhere and the earth was covered with water. Fluid of the demons just touched the earth. And therefore, the people call her Medinl.

## \|\| 8.11-13 \|\|

*kathayāmi ca tajjanma sārthakaṃ sarvasammatam \|*  
*purā śrutaṃ ca śrutyuktaṃ dharmavaktrācca puṣkare \|\| 11 \|\|*

*mahāvirāṭśarīrasya jalasthasya ciraṃ sphuṭam \|*  
*malo babhūva kālena sarvāṃgavyāpako dhruvam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sa ca praviṣṭaḥ sarveṣāṃ tallomnāṃ vivareṣu ca \|*  
*kālena mahatā tasmādbabhūva vasudhā mune \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. Now you listen to the story about her realistic birth which is acceptable to all. This theory was profounded at the Puskara region were Dharma, recited it to me from his own mouth and is also according to Vedas. Mahavirat who resides in the water accumulated a lot of dust over his body which was becoming to visible for long. О sage, it accumulated in all his hair-pits. In due course of time it was collected and it reappeared in the form of an earth.

## \|\| 8.14 \|\|

*pratyekaṃ pratilomnāṃ ca sthitā kūpeṣu sā sthirā \|*  
*āvirbhūtā tirobhūtā sā calā ca punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. thus from each one of his hair-pits and earth emerged which appears at the time of creation and during the time of dissolution it disappears. It moves always.

## \|\| 8.15 \|\|

*āvirbhūtā sṛṣṭikāle tajjalātparyyupasthitā \|*  
*pralaye ca tirobhūtā jalābhyantaravasthitā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Appearing at the time of the creation of the universe it emerges out of the water and disappears in water at the time of dissolution. This is the rule for her.

## \|\| 8.16 \|\|

*prativiśveṣu vasudhā śailakānanasaṃyutā \|*

## \|\| 8.17-20 \|\|

*himādrimerusaṃyuktā grahacandrārkasaṃyutā \|*

*puṇyatīrthasamāyuktā puṇyabhāratasaṃyutā \|*

*pātālāḥ sapta tadadhastadūrdhve brahmalokakaḥ \|*

17-20. Similarly the Himalaya, Mem, the planets, the moon and the sun always surround her. There are sacred placed in sacred land of Bharata, having the mountain of gold besides all the castles the nether-world and seven other lokas are beneath it. The seven lokas including Brahmaloka and the Dhnivaloka are above her. Thus the entire universe is based on the earth. Accordingly the entire universe was formed because of the earth. The Goloka and Vaikuntha are eternal and are beyond the universe.

## \|\| 8.21 \|\|

*naśvarāṇi ca viśvāni kṛtrimākṛtrimāṇi ca \|*

21\. О Brahmanas, thus at the end of Brahma the event which has been described as the natural dissolution besides all other globes, get destroyed.

*mahāvirāḍādisṛṣṭau sṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇena cātmanā \|*

22-24. Lord Krishna then at the beginning of the universe, himself creates Mahavirat who remains alive even at the time of dissolution, with the sky, along with other gods. At the time of the Varaha incarnation of the lord, the earth was the goddess. The gods, Manu, the sages, the Brahmanas and Gandharvas adored her, since she happened to be the spouse of lord Visrtu. Their son is known as Mangala and a son named Suyasha was born to Mangala.

## \|\| 8.25-26 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*pūjitā kena rūpeṇa vārāhe ca surairmahī \|*
