*tasyāḥ pūjāvidhānaṃ cāpyadhaścoddharaṇakramam \|*  
*maṃgalaṃ maṃgalasyāpi janmavyāsaṃ vada prabho \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Narada said — О lord, you tell me the way how the earth was adored by the gods at the time of Varaha-kalpa and if so, in what form? The goddess provides shelter to all and it so said that lord Varaha himself adored her along with others. О lord you tell me the method of the adoration of the earth, the process of bringing the earth from the waters of the ocean, the birth Mangala and all other details which provide welfare to all.

## \|\| 8.27 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*vārāhe ca varāhaśca brahmaṇā saṃstutaḥ purā \|*

27\. Narayana said — In earlier times at the time of Varaha incarnation of Vishnu Brahma had eulogised the lord as a result of which the lord killing Hiranyaksa rescued the earth from the water.

## \|\| 8.28 \|\|

*jale tāṃ sthāpayāmāsa padmapatraṃ yathā'rṇave \|*

28\. He established the earth in the waters like lotus leaf over which Brahma resorted to the beautiful creation.

## \|\| 8.29-30 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā tadadhi devīṃ ca sakāmāṃ kāmuko hariḥ \|*

*kṛtvā ratikarīṃ śayyāṃ mūrttiṃ ca sumanoharām \|*

29-30. Thereafter Varaha who possessed the lustre of crores of suns. Looked at PrthvI with passionate eyes who was also reciprocated with passionate eyes at that time. The lord turned himself as capable of performing the love-spots enjoyed the company of a earth for a complete divine day and night.

## \|\| 8.31 \|\|

*sukhasambhogasaṃsparśānmūrcchāṃ samprāpa sundarī \|*  
*vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃgamo'pi sukhapradaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Because of that pleasant union, she fainted. The actor of the love-spot always provides pleasure to his partners.

## \|\| 8.32-34 \|\|

*viṣṇustadaṃgasaṃśleṣād bubudhe na divāniśam \|*  
*varṣānte cetanāṃ prāpya kāmī tatyāja kāmukīm \|\| 32 \|\|*

*dadhāra pūrvarūpaṃ hi vārāhaṃ caiva līlayā \|*  
*pūjāṃ cakāra bhaktyā ca dhyātvā ca dharaṇīṃ satīm \|\| 33 \|\|*

*dhūpairdīpaiśca naivadyaiḥ sindūrairanulepanaḥ \|*  
*vastraiḥ puṣpaiśca balibhiḥ saṃpūjyovāca tāṃ hariḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. Because of that union, they were unconcerned about the passage of time. After the lapse of year, they regained consciousness, the lord then left the company of beautiful damsel and he re-emerged in the form of Varaha. Thereafter, he adored the goddess of earth with devotion offering incense, the lamp, naivedya, vermilion, sandal-paste, clothes and flowers. Thereafter the lord said to her.

## \|\| 8.35-37 \|\|

*mahāvarāha uvāca \|*  
*sarvādhārā bhava śubhe sarvaiḥ saṃpūjitā śubham \|*  
*munibhirmanubhirdevaiḥ siddhairvā mānavādibhiḥ \|\| 35\|\|*

*jalocchvāsājjalatyāgagṛhārambhapraveśane \|*  
*vāpītaḍāgārambhe ca śubhe ca kṛṣi karmaṇi \|\| 36 \|\|*

*tava pūjāṃ kariṣyanti saṃbhrameṇa surādayaḥ \|*  
*mūḍhā ye na kariṣyanti yāsyanti narakaṃ ca te \|\| 37 \|\|*

35-37. Mahavaraha said — “O beautiful one, the sages, the Manus, the gods, siddhas and humans adore you properly and in turn you provide protection to them. At the time of starting of construction of a house or entry into the house after it is constructed, at the time of construction the step-well, tanks, wells, at the time of releasing or blocking of the water, start of irrigation, the people and the gods will always adore you. Those who neglect to perform pitja for you, will invite their fall into the hell.

## \|\| 8.38-41 \|\|

*vasudhovāca \|*  
*vahāmi sarvaṃ vārāharūpeṇāhaṃ tavājñayā \|*  
*līlāmātreṇa bhagavanviśvaṃ ca sacarācaram \|\| 38 \|\|*

*muktāṃ śuktiṃ harerarcāṃ śivaliṃgaṃ śilāṃ tathā \|*  
*śaṃkhaṃ pradīpaṃ ratnaṃ ca māṇikyaṃ hīrakaṃ maṇim \|\| 39 \|\|*

*yajñasūtraṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca pustakaṃ tulasīdalam \|*  
*japamālāṃ puṣpamālāṃ karpūraṃ ca suvarṇakam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*gorocanāṃ candanaṃ ca śālagrāmajalaṃ tathā \|*  
*etānvoḍhumaśaktā'haṃ kliṣṭā ca bhagavañchṛṇu \|\| 41 \|\|*

38-41. Vasudha said — О lord, at the command issued by you in the form of Varaha, I shall, bear the burden of the universe with pleasure, but О lord, I have a request for you and you kindly listen to me. I shall be unable to bear the load of the pearls, mother of pearls, adoration of the lord, ShivaJinga, Scilagrama, the conch, the lamps, the gems, rubies, yajnopavita, the flowers, the book, the leaves of Tulasi, the rosary, garland of flowers, camphor, gold, Gorocana, the sandal-paste and the sacred water of Sdlagrdma. I shall not be able to bear their weight and shall feel uncomfortable with them.”

## \|\| 8.42 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*dravyāṇyetāni ye mūḍhā arpayiṣyanti sundari \|*  
*yāsyanti te kālasūtraṃ divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ tvayi \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The lord said — О beautiful one, such of the fools who will place these things over you will have to fall in the hell named kalasiitra for a hundred divine years.

## \|\| 8.43-44 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā bhagavānvirarāma ca nārada \|*  
*babhūva tena garbheṇa tejasvī maṅgalagrahaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*pūjāṃ cakruḥ pṛthivyāśca te sarve cājñayā hareḥ \|*  
*dadhyuḥ kāṇvoktamārgeṇa tuṣṭuvuḥ stavanena ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. О Narada after speaking this, the lord kept quiet and thereafter from the womb of the earth the planet named Mangala (mars) was born. Thereafter with the permission of the lord all the people started adoring the earth by the method prescribed by Kanva.

## \|\| 8.45 \|\|

*dadyurmūlena mantreṇa naivedyādikameva ca \|*  
*saṃstutā triṣu lokeṣu pūjitā sā babhūva ha \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Reciting the basic mantra they offered naivedya and all other things. Thus the adoration of earth started in all the three worlds.

## \|\| 8.46 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*kiṃ dhyānaṃ stavanaṃ kiṃ vā tasyā mūlaṃ ca kiṃ vada \|*

46\. Narada said: “What is her dhyanam, stolra and the basic mantral I am getting anxious to know about all these details which are enshrined in the Puranas. Therefore you kindly let me know.”

## \|\| 8.47 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*

47\. Narayana said — “In the earlier times Narayana himself adored the goddess of earth. Thereafter Brahma did so, followed by the king Prthu who also did so.

## \|\| 8.48-51 \|\|

*tataḥ sarvairmunīndraiśca manubhirnāradādibhiḥ \|*  
*dhyānaṃ ca stavanaṃ mantraṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi nārada \|\| 48 \|\|*

*oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vāṃ vasudhāyai svāhā \|*  
*ityanena tu mantreṇa pūjitā viṣṇunā purā \|\| 49 \|\|*

*śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ śatacandrasamaprabhām \|*  
*candanokṣitasarvāṅgīṃ sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|\| 50 \|\|*

*ratnādhārāṃ ratnagarbhāṃ ratnākarasamanvitām \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ sasmitāṃ vanditāṃ bhaje \|\| 51 \|\|*

48-51. Thereafter all the sages, the Manus and the sages like Narada honoured her. О Narada I am now speaking out the dhyanam, the stotra and her mantra which you please listen. …. This is the hymn reciting which lord Vishnu had adored the earth. The form of dhyanam is like this, “The body of goddess earth is of white complexion like the jasmine flowers and her lustre exceeds the lustre of hundreds of moons. All her limbs are plastered with sandal-paste and she is adorned with all the ornaments. She is the basis of all the gems is glorified with the mines of the gems. She is clad in silken garments which are purified by fire. She wears a smile over her face and she is adorable by all. I bow in reverence to the earth like this.

## \|\| 8.52 \|\|

*dhyānenānena sā devī sarvairvai pūjitā bhavet \|*  
*stavanaṃ śṛṇu viprendra kaṇvaśākhoktameva ca \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. О best of the Brahmanas, the goddess is adored by all with this dhyanam, now I tell you the method prescribed by Kanva for her adoration you please listen.”

## \|\| 8.53-64 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*yajñasūkarajāyā tvaṃ jayaṃ dehi jayāvahe \|*  
*jaye'jaye jayādhāre jayaśīle jayaprade \|\| 53 \|\|*

*sarvādhāre sarvabīje sarvaśaktisamanvite \|*  
*sarvakāmaprade devi sarveṣṭaṃ dehi me sthire \|\| 54\|\|*

*sarvasasyālaye sarvasasyāḍye sarvasasyade \|*  
*sarvasasyahare kāle sarvasasyātmike kṣite \|\| 55 \|\|*

*maṅgale maṅgalādhāre māṅgalye maṅgalaprade \|*  
*maṅgalārthe maṅgalāṃśe maṃgalaṃ dehi me param \|\| 56 \|\|*

*puṇyasvarūpe puṇyānāṃ bījarūpe sanātani \|*  
*puṇyāśraye puṇyavatāmālaye puṇyade bhave \|\| 57 \|\|*

*ratrasāravagaparade \|\| 58 \|\|*

*bhūme bhūmipasarvasve bhūmipālaparāyaṇe \|*  
*bhūmipāhaṅkārarūpe bhūmiṃ dehi vasundhare \|\| 59 \|\|*

*idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ tāṃ saṃpūjya ca yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*koṭyantare janmani sa saṃbhavedbhūmipeśvaraḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*bhūmidānakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate paṭhanājjanaḥ \|*  
*dattāpahārajātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*ambuvīcībhūkhananātpāpānmucyeta sa dhruvam \|*  
*anyakūpe kupadajātpāpānmucyeta sa dhruvam \|\| 62 \|\|*

*parabhūśrāddhajātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*bhūmau vīryyatyāgapāpāddīpādisthāpanāttathā \|\| 63 \|\|*

*pāpena mucyate prājñaḥ stotrasya paṭhanānmune \|*  
*aśvamedhaśataṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

53-64. Vishnu said — “You are the granter of victory, you give me victory. You are the spouse of lord Yajhavaraha, you can never be defeated by anyone. You are the base of victory and are always victorious. Therefore you bestow us with victory. You are base of all the people and the form of the seed. You are endowed with all the prowess. You fulfil all the wishes, you therefore grant me all my desired things, you have a stable mind and are the store of all the food-stuffs, vegetation store of all the grains and produce the food-stuffs you produce the cereals in appropriate time; you are filled with agriculture produce and have a docile nature, you are the image of welfare, the base of welfare, bestowers of welfare, granter of welfare, the form of welfare and are filled with all the rays of welfare. Therefore you grant me the welfare. You are auspicious one and the seed of suspiciousness, you are eternal and the base of all the good deeds, besides being the temple of the virtuous people, bestower of merit, the form of the lord, the best of the ladies endowed with the heaps of gems and are the giver of the gems. О goddess, earth you are everything for the kings, graceful to the kings and are the very base of arrogance of the kings. О goddess earth, grant me the land.” Thus whosoever adoring the goddess earth like this, recite her stotra he becomes he ruler of the earth. For crores of birth, someone by reciting her stotra get" the merit of giving away land in charity. If one after giving away in charity something, forcibly takes it back, he earns a sin. That sin is removed by reciting this stotra. There is no doubt about it. Thus the digging of the well without the prior permission of the land-lord or digging of the earth, performing sradclha over the land of others, these are sinful acts and the one who earns these sins is relieved of the same by reciting this stotra. О sage by dropping the semen on earth or placing the lamp on the ground, one earns a sin, which can be removed by reciting this stotra. By reciting this stotra an intelligent person earns the merit of performing a hundred Asvamedha sacrifices. There is no doubt about it.

## Chapter 9

## \|\| 9.1-2 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*bhūmidānakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ taddharaṇena yat \|*  
*parabhūmau śrāddharūpaṃ kūpe kupadajaṃ tathā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*ambuvīcībhūkhananabījatyāgajameva ca \|*  
*dīpādisthāpanātpāpaṃ śrotumicchāmi yatnataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narada said — “О lord, I would like to know the merit, one earns by giving away land in charity and the sin one earns by forcibly taking it back. Besides the sin one earns, by performing sraddha over the land of others, digging of wells over the land of others, dropping of semen over the earth and the burning of flames.

## \|\| 9.3 \|\|

*anyadvā pṛthivījanyaṃ pāpaṃ yatpraśnataḥ param \|*  
*yadasti tatpratīkāraṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О best of those well-versed in Vedas, you tell me something else about the sins relating to the earth and the ways and means to get rid of them.”

## \|\| 9.4-5 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*vitastimātraṃ bhūmiṃ ca yo dadāti ca bhārate \|*  
*sandhyāpūtāya viprāya sa yāyādviṣṇumandiram \|\| 4 \|\|*

*bhūmiṃ ca sarvasasyāḍhyā brāhmaṇāya dadāti yaḥ \|*  
*bhūmireṇupramāṇe ca varṣe viṣṇupade vaset \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Narayana said — “In the land of Bharata whosoever gives away a small piece of land in charity to a Brahmana, he indeed goes to the abode of lord Vishnu, the one who gives away in charity to Brahmanas, land filled with vegetation and crops he enjoys to reside in the Vishnuloka for a long time.

## \|\| 9.6-7 \|\|

*grāmaṃ bhūmiṃ ca dhānyaṃ ca yo dadātyādadāti yaḥ \|*  
*sarvapāpādvinirmuktau cobhau vaikuṇṭhavāsinau \|\| 6 \|\|*

*bhūmidānaṃ ca tatkāle yaḥ sādhuścānumodate \|*  
*sa prayāti ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ mitragotrasamanvitaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. One who gives away in charity the land and cereals, is relieved of all his sins and goes to Vaikuntha. Such of the people who support who support the giving away in charity of the land also proceed to the Vaikuntha together with their friends and relatives.

## \|\| 9.8 \|\|

*svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā brahmavṛttiṃ harettu yaḥ \|*  
*kālasūtre tiṣṭhati sa yāvaccandradivākarau \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The one who usurps the land given away in charity to a Brahmana is thrown into the kalasi'Ura hell till the sun and moon last.

## \|\| 9.9-10 \|\|

*tatputrapautraprabhṛtirbhūmihīnaḥ śriyā hataḥ \|*  
*sukhahīno daridraḥ syādante yāti ca rauravam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*gavāṃ mārgaṃ viniṣkṛṣya yaśca sasyaṃ dadāti saḥ \|*  
*divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ caiva kumbhīpāke ca tiṣṭhati \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. All his sons and grandsons and other members of the family are deprived of the land, riches and the pleasures and they become paupers. Thereafter they are thrown in the terrific hell. The one who ploughs the field which is meant for the grazing of the cows, is thrown into the terrific hell for a hundred years.

## \|\| 9.11 \|\|

*goṣṭhaṃ taḍāgaṃ niṣkṛṣya mārgaṃ sasyaṃ dadāti yaḥ \|*  
*sa ca tiṣṭhatyasīpatre yāvadindrāścaturdaśa \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The one who breaks the cowshed and the tanks to construct a road or irrigate the land, he is thrown into the hell named Asipatra for the duration of the time of fourteen Indras.

## \|\| 9.12-13 \|\|

*na pañcapiṇḍamuddhṛtya snāti kūpe parasya yaḥ \|*  
*prāpnoti narakaṃ caiva na snānaphalameva ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

*kāmī bhūmau ca rahasi bījatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ \|*  
*snigdhareṇupramāṇaṃ ca varṣaṃ tiṣṭhati raurave \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. One who takes bath in well or tank without taking out five fists filled with earth, is deprived of the merit of taking bath and falls in the hell for the number of years equivalent to the particles of the dust of the land.

## \|\| 9.14 \|\|

*ambuvīcyambukhananaṃ yaḥ karoti ca mānavaḥ \|*  
*sa yāti kṛmidaṃśaṃ ca sthitistatra caturyugam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The one who excavates the land at the sojourn of ambuvlci yoga is thrown into the Krmidarhsa hell as long as the period of four у upas.

## \|\| 9.15-17 \|\|

*parakīye luptakūpe kūpaṃ mūḍhaḥ karoti yaḥ \|*  
*puṣkariṇyāṃ ca luptāyāṃ tāṃ dadāti ca yo naraḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sarvaṃ phalaṃ parasyaiva taptasūrmiṃ vrajettu saḥ \|*  
*tatra tiṣṭhati saṃtapto yāvadidrāścaturdaśa \|\| 16 \|\|*

*parakīyataḍāge ca paṅkamuddhṛtya cotsṛjet \|*  
*reṇupramāṇavarṣaṃ ca brahmaloke vasennaraḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. The one who rebuilds others well or step-well or renovates them in his own name, he falls into the terrific hell for a period of the live of fourteen Indras and the entire merit of his reconstruction goes to others. The one who takes away the mud from the tank owned by others cleansing the same and then forgets about it, he earns great merit enjoying a comfortable living in Brahmaloka for a large number of years.

## \|\| 9.18 \|\|

*piṇḍaṃ pitre bhūtibhartturna pradāya ca mānavaḥ \|*  
*śrāddhaṃ karoti yo mūḍho narakaṃ yāti niścitam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The one who performs sraddha over the land of others without providing any compensation to the land owner, he surely goes to well.

## \|\| 9.19 \|\|

*bhūmau dīpaṃ yo'rpayati so'ndhaḥ saptasu janmasu \|*  
*bhūmau śaṃkhaṃ ca saṃsthāpya kuṣṭhaṃ janmāntare labhet \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The One who places the lamp over the earth, he becomes blind for seven birth and the one who places the conch on the earth he attracts the disease of leprosy in next birth.

## \|\| 9.20-22 \|\|

*muktāmāṇikyahīraṃ ca suvarṇaṃ ca maṇiṃ tathā \|*  
*yaśca saṃsthāpayedbhūmau daridraḥ saptajanmasu \|\| 20 \|\|*

*śivaliṅgaṃ śilāmarcyāṃ yaścārpayati bhūtale \|*  
*śatamanvantaraṃ yāvatkṛmibhakṣe sa tiṣṭhati \|\| 21 \|\|*

*sūktaṃ mantraṃ śilātoyaṃ puṣpaṃ ca tulasīdalam \|*  
*yaścārpayati bhūmau ca sa tiṣṭhennarake yugam \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. The one who places the gems, rubies, precious stones, gold and crystal over the earth becomes pauper in coming seven births. The one who places the Shivalinga and Shalagrama over the earth, is thrown in the Krmibhaksa hell for a hundred of manvantaras. The one who places the Vedie siiktas, the mantras, Shalagrama, sacred water, the flower and Tulasi leaves over the ground, he is lodged in the hell for four yugas.

## \|\| 9.23 \|\|

*japamālāṃ puṣpamālāṃ karpūraṃ rocanāṃ tathā \|*  
*yo mūḍhaścārpayedbhūmau sa yāti narakaṃ dhruvam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The one who places the rosary, the garland of flowers, camphor and Gorocana on earth, earn and dwelling of a hell.

## \|\| 9.24 \|\|

*mune candanakāṣṭhaṃ ca rudrākṣaṃ kuśamūlakam \|*  
*saṃsthāpya bhūmau narake vasenmanvantarāvadhi \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О sage, the one who places the sandal-wood, Rudraksa, the roots of Kusa grass over the earth, he is thrown into the hell for a manvantara.

## \|\| 9.25 \|\|

*pustakaṃ yajñasūtraṃ ca bhūmau saṃsthāpayettu yaḥ \|*  
*na bhavedviprayonau ca tasya janmāntare janiḥ \|\| 25\|\|*

25\. The one who places a book and the yajnopavlta over the earth, the person can never be born in the race of Brahmana for many times to comes.

## \|\| 9.26 \|\|

*brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpamiha vai labhate dhruvam \|*  
*granthiyuktaṃ yajñasūtraṃ pūjyaṃ syātsarvavarṇakaiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. And the earns the sin of Brahmahatya. The yajnasutra which is tied to a Brahmana has to be adored in all conditions.

## \|\| 9.27-28 \|\|

*yajñaṃ kṛtvā tu yo bhūmiṃ kṣīreṇa nahi siñcati \|*  
*sa yāti taptasūrmiṃ ca saṃtaptaḥ sarvajanmasu \|\| 27 \|\|*

*bhūkampe grahaṇe yo hi karoti khananaṃ bhuvaḥ \|*  
*janmāntare mahāpāpī so'ṅgahīno bhaveddhruvam \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. The one who does not pour the milk over the ground after performing of the yajna, he always suffers in many coming birth and is thrown into the hell. The one who digs the earth at the time of earthquake and at the time of eclipse, such a great sinner is born deformed for many births.

## \|\| 9.29 \|\|

*bhavanaṃ yatra sarveṣāṃ bhūmistana prakīrttitā \|*  
*vasuratnaṃ yā dadhāti vasudhā ca vasundharā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Since the houses of all the people are constructed over the earth that is why it is called Bhumi. Since she bears the riches in her womb she is called Vasundhara.

## \|\| 9.30 \|\|

*harerūrau ca yā jātā sā corvī parikīrttitā \|*  
*dharā dharitrī dharaṇī sarveṣāṃ dharaṇāttu yā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Since she was born out of the high of the lord she has been given the name of Urvl. Since she bears the load of everyone she is known as Dhara and Dharani.

## \|\| 9.31 \|\|

*ijyā ca yāgabharaṇātkṣoṇī kṣīṇā laye ca yā \|*  
*mahālaye kṣayaṃ yāti kṣitistena prakīrtitā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Since the yagas are performed over her, she is called ijya, Because she is reduced in rise during the dissolution, she is known as Ksonl. Since she is destroyed completely as the time of dissolution she is called Ksiti.

## \|\| 9.32 \|\|

*kāśyapī kaśyapasyeyamacalā sthitirūpataḥ \|*  
*viśvambharā taddharaṇāccānantā'nantarūpataḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Since she is the daughter of Kashyapa, she is also known as Kasyapl. Since she remain stable, she is known as immovable. Since she feeds the entire universe, she is known as Vishvambhara. Since she has the endless form she is called Ananta.

## \|\| 9.33 \|\|

*pṛthvī pṛdhukakanyātvādvistṛtatvānmahī mune \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. O' sage, since she is the dauther of Prthu, she is known as Prthvi and having its immeasurable expanse, she is known as Mahl.

## Chapter 10

## \|\| 10.1-3 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*śrutaṃ pṛthivyupākhyānamatīva sumanoharam \|*  
*gaṅgopākhyānamadhunā vada vedavidāṃ vara \|\| 1 \|\|*

*bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpādājagāma sureśvarī \|*  
*viṣṇusvarūpā paramā svayaṃ viṣṇupadī satī \|\| 2 \|\|*

*kathaṃ kutra yuge kena prārthitā preritā purā \|*  
*tatkramaṃ śrotumicchāmi pāpaghnaṃ puṇyadaṃ śubham \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Narada said — О best of those well-versed in the Vedas, I have heard the charming story of the goddess PrthvI but I would now like to listen to the story of birth of Ganga you kindly narrate the same. The goddess Ganga has the form of Vishnu and also is known by the name of VishnupadI (the one who emerged out of the feet of Vishnu). How did she emerge over the land of Bharata because of curse of Sarasvati and during which period did she reach her at whose request and prayers, she had to arrive here. She happens to be the remover of the sins absolutely sacred and is meritorious.

## \|\| 10.4-5 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*rājarājeśvaraḥ śrīmansagaraḥ sūryyavaṃśajaḥ \|*  
*tasya bhāryā ca vaidarbhī śaivyā ca dve manohare \|\| 4 \|\|*

*satyasvarūpaḥ satyeṣṭaḥ satyavāksatyabhāvanaḥ \|*  
*satyadharmavicārajñaḥ paraṃ satyayugodbhavaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Narayana said — There was a king born in the solar race who was known by the name of Sagara who had two beautiful wives named Vaidarbhl and Saivya. The king was quite truthful who always believed in truth, spoke truth and was truthful in the performing Brahma. He was the best of the kings and was born in Satyayuga.

## \|\| 10.6 \|\|

*ekakanyaścaikaputro babhūva sumanoharaḥ \|*  
*asamañja iti khyātaḥ śaibyāyāṃ kulavarddhanaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. From his queen named Saivya a girl was born besides a son named Asamanjasa, who was the promoter of the race.

## \|\| 10.7-8 \|\|

*anyā cārādhayāmāsa śaṅkaraṃ putrakāmukī \|*  
*babhūva garbhastasyāśca śivasya tu vareṇa ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

*gate śatābde pūrṇe ca māṃsapiṇḍaṃ suṣāva sā \|*  
*taddṛṣṭvā ca śivaṃ dhyātvā rurodoccaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. His wife named Vaidarbhl meditated upon Shiva with the desire of having a son. By the grace of Shiva, she was conceived. After the lapse of a hundred years, a block of flesh was born of her. On looking at it, she started meditating upon Shiva and then started crying.

## \|\| 10.9 \|\|

*śambhurbrāhmaṇarūpeṇa tatsamīpaṃ jagāma ha \|*  
*cakāra saṃvibhajyaitatpiṇḍaṃ ṣaṣṭisahasradhā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Shiva then appeared in the form of Brahmana and the block of flesh was broken, out of which sixty thousand sons emerged.

## \|\| 10.10-13 \|\|

*sarve babhūvuḥ putrāśca mahābalaparā kramāḥ \|*  
*grīṣmamadhyāhnamārttaṇḍaprabhājuṣṭakalevarāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*kapilarṣeḥ kopadṛṣṭyā babhūvurbhasmasācca te \|*  
*rājā ruroda tacchrutvā jagāma maraṇaṃ śucā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tapaścakārāsamaṃjo gaṅgānayanakāraṇāt \|*  
*tapaḥ kṛtvā lakṣavarṣaṃ mriyate kālayogataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*dilīpastasya tanayo gaṅgānayanakāraṇāta \|*  
*tapaḥ kṛtvā lakṣavarṣaṃ yayau lokāntaraṃ nṛpaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. All those son were quite valorous, strong and possessed the lustre of the suns of the summer season. After sometime, with the rage of sage Kapila, all the sixty thousand of them were reduced to ashes, the king's mind was filled with grief and in that condition his life came to an end. Thereafter Asamanjasa perfonning tapas for a lakh of years and he died while doing so. Thereafter his son Dillpa meditated for a lakh of year for the same purpose.

## \|\| 10.14 \|\|

*aśumām̐stasya putraśca gaṅgānayanakāraṇāt \|*  
*tapaḥ kṛtvā lakṣavarṣaṃ mṛtaśca kālayogataḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. His son Ansuman meditated for a lakh of years for getting Ganga on earth and he also had to meet with the same fate.

## \|\| 10.15 \|\|

*bhagīrathastasya putro mahābhāgavataḥ sudhīḥ \|*  
*vaiṣṇavo viṣṇubhaktaśca guṇavāna jarāmaraḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. And extremely intelligent son named Bhaglratha was born to Dillpa who was a great Vaishnava, devoted to lord Vishnu, quite meritorious and was eternal and everlasting.

## \|\| 10.16-22 \|\|

*tapaḥ kṛtvā lakṣavarṣaṃ gaṅgānayanakāraṇāt \|*  
*dadarśa kṛṣṇaṃ hṛṣṭāsyaṃ sūryyakoṭisamaprabham \|\| 16 \|\|*

*dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ kiśoraṃ gopaveṣakam \|*  
*paramātmānamīśaṃ ca bhaktānugrahavigraham \|\| 17 \|\|*

*svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ brahma paripūrṇatamaṃ vibhum \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇuśivādyaiśca stutaṃ munigaṇairyutam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*nirliptaṃ sākṣirūpaṃ ca nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaṃ prasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*vahniśuddhāṃ śukādhānaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam \|*  
*tuṣṭāva dṛṣṭvā nṛpatiḥ praṇamya ca punaḥpunaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*līlayā ca varaṃ prāpya vāñchitaṃ vaṃśatārakam \|*  
*tatrājagāma gaṃgā sā smaraṇātparamātmanaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*taṃ praṇamya pratasthau ca tatpuraḥ saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ \|*  
*uvāca bhagavāṃstatra tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sumanoharam \|*  
*kurvatīṃ stavanaṃ divyaṃ pulakāñcitavigrahām \|\| 22 \|\|*

16-22. He meditated upon lord Krishna for a lakh of years and ultimately he had an audience with lord. At that point of time the lustre of crores of suns of the summer season was emerging out of the body of the lord. He had two arms and was holding a flute in his hand. He was of tender age and appeared in the form of a cowherd, in order to grace his devotees, he had taken to this fonn. О sage, lord Krishna happened to be the complete parabrahman. He can take to any form. At that point of time all.he gods including Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva were adoring him. The sages too bowed their heads in reverence to him. He is always unattached, witness of all, invisible one, beyond Prakriti and is the one who bestows his grace over his devotees. The faces of lord Krishna wore a serene smile. He was clad in divine garments and divine ornaments studded with gems, over his body. Having a look at the lord, Bhaglratha bowed in reverence to him again and again, showering all the praises. Thereafter he received the boons from the lord quite easily, by which his race could be redeemed. With the very drought of the river Ganga by the lord she arrived there at the same time. Bowing in reverence before the lord, she stood there with folded hands. Finding the goddess Ganga praising him, with her mind filled with emotions, the lord said.

## \|\| 10.23-24 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpādgaccha śīghraṃ sureśvari \|\| 23 \|\|*

*sagarasya sutānsarvānpūtānkuru mamājñayā \|*  
*tvatsparśavāyunā pūtā yāsyanti mama mandiram \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Lord Krishna said — О best of the goddess because of the curse of Sarasvati you have to descend on earth in Bharata. At my command you go there and purify the sons of Sagara. With the touch of the air from your water they will get purified and reach my abode.

## \|\| 10.25 \|\|

*bibhrato divyamūrttiṃ te divyasyandanagāminaḥ \|*  
*matpārṣadā bhaviṣyanti sarvakālaṃ nirāmayāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. My attendants taking to divine form, mounted over the divine chariots will be available there all the time free from diseases.

## \|\| 10.26-27 \|\|

*karmabhogaṃ samucchidya kṛtaṃ janmani janmani \|*  
*nānāvidhaṃ mahatsvalpaṃ pāpaṃ syādbhārate nṛbhiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*gaṃgāyāḥ sparśavātena naśyatīti śrutau śrutam \|*  
*sparśanaṃ darśanāddevyāḥ puṇyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ tataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. All their misdeeds of many birth would turn into goods deeds and they will attain the divine form. It is ordained by Smtis that the sins earned by a human in the crores of his births, will be washed away by with the simple touch of the wind of the Ganga. By taking a bath in the waters of Ganga one earns ten time more merits.

## \|\| 10.28 \|\|

*mausalasnānamātreṇa sāmānyadivase nṛṇām \|*  
*koṭijanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ naśyatīti śrutau śrutam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. During ordinary days even if one has a dip in the Ganga, the sins, accumulated by him during crores of earlier births are washed away. This has been ordained by the Smtis.

## \|\| 10.29-30 \|\|

*yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca \|*  
*nānājanmārjitānyeva kāmato'pi kṛtāni ca \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tāni sarvāṇi naśyanti mausalasnānato nṛṇām \|*  
*puṇyāhasnānajaṃ puṇyaṃ vedā naiva vadanti ca \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. Many of the sins like Brahmahatya and several others sins committed for any purpose, are washed away by taking a bath in the Ganga. By taking a bath on the sacred days, the same merit is multiplied, which cannot be defined even by the Vedas.

## \|\| 10.31 \|\|

*kecidvadanti te devi phalameva yathāgamam \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇuśivāyāśca sarve naiva vidanti ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. О goddess some of the people came to know about your glory from the scriptures. Even otherwise Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are not fully aware of your glory.

## \|\| 10.32 \|\|

*sāmānyadivasasnānasaṅkalpaṃ śṛṇu sundari \|*  
*puṇyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ caiva mausalasnānataḥ param \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. О beautiful one, by taking bath on ordinary days one gets much more merit by doing so on sacred days.

## \|\| 10.33-34 \|\|

*tatastriṃśadguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ ravisaṃkramaṇe dine \|*  
*amāyāṃ cāpi tattulyaṃ dviguṇaṃ dakṣiṇāyane \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tato daśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ narāṇāmuttarāyaṇe \|*  
*cāturmāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmanantaṃ puṇyameva ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. In case a Sunday falls on the first of the month, one earns great merit which is thirty time more then the ordinary day. On the day Amavasya (dark night) if one takes a bath in the Ganga he earns similar merit. Similarly, when the sun is the southern half year, one gets triple the merit and when the same is in the northern half year, one gets ten times more merit. In the four rainy months, on the full moon day, the merit accruing from taking a bath in the Ganga is beyond measure.

## \|\| 10.35-36 \|\|

*akṣayāyāṃ ca tattulyaṃ naitadvede nirūpitam \|*  
*asaṃkhyapuṇyaphaladameteṣu snānadānakam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*sāmānyadivase snānaṃ dhyānācchataguṇaṃ phalam \|*  
*manvantareṣu deveśi yugādiṣu tathaiva ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. On the Aksyatithi, if one takes a bath in the, he earns similar merit by taking bath in the Ganga during the four rainy seasons one gets merit which cannot be measured. While taking a bath in the Ganga on ordinary days, one gets a hundred time more merit if is the same is accompanied with dhyanam also. Similarly, similar type of merit has been prescribed for the manvanlaras and yuga.

## \|\| 10.37-41 \|\|

*māghasya sitasaptamyāṃ bhīṣmāṣṭamyāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*tathā 'śokāṣṭamītithyāṃ navamyāṃ ca tathā hareḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*tato'pi dviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ nandāyāṃ tava durlabham \|*  
*daśapāpaharāyāṃ tu daśamyāṃ sumahatphalam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*nandāsamaṃ ca vāruṇyāṃ mahatpūrvaṃ caturguṇam \|*  
*tataścaturguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ dvimahatpūrvake sati \|\| 39 \|\|*

*puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ caiva sāmānyasnānato bhavet \|*  
*candrasūryoparāgeṣu smṛtaṃ daśaguṇaṃ tataḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*puṇye'pyarddhodaye kāle tataḥ śataguṇaṃ phalam \|*  
*sarveṣāmeva saṅkalpo vaiṣṇavānāṃ viparyyayaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

37-41. By taking a bath in the Ganga on the bright seventh day of the month of Magha, Bhlsmast ami, AsokastamI, RamanavamI, one gets double the merit. By taking in the Ganga on the Punyananda day the merit is increased. This merit is increases to ten times if one takes a bath on the Papaharana-Dasaml. Like Nanda, one gets the same merit during Varunl. During Mahavanmi, one gets four time more merit which is a crores time more than the merit one earns on ordinary day. During the solar and lunar eclipses one earns ten time more merits by taking a bath in the Ganga. Similarly by taking a bath in Arghyodaya-time, one gets hundred times more merit. As compared to others, the resolve of the Vaishnavas for taking bath in the Ganga, is quite different.

## \|\| 10.42 \|\|

*phalasandhānarahitā jīvanmuktāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ \|*  
*matprītibhaktikāmāste sarvadā sarvakarmasu \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The Vaishnavas always perform the deeds unmindful of the fruits of the same. They are always devoted to me and also desire to be so.

## \|\| 10.43 \|\|

*guruvaktrādviṣṇumantro yasya karṇe viśetparaḥ \|*  
*jīvanmuktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ taṃ vedāḥ sarve vadanti ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The mantra of the lord after emerging from the mouth of the teacher enters into the ear of the Vaishnavas. All the Vedas describe such a person as Jivanmukta Vaishnava.

## \|\| 10.44-47 \|\|

*puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ pūrvaṃ paitṛkaṃ ca paraṃ śatam \|*  
*mātāmahasya ca śataṃ mātaraṃ mātṛmātaram \|\| 44 \|\|*

*bhaginīṃ bhrātaraṃ caiva bhāgineyaṃ ca mātulam \|*  
*śvaśruṃ ca śvaśuraṃ caiva gurupatnīṃ guroḥ sutam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*guruṃ ca jñānadātāraṃ mitraṃ ca sahacāriṇam \|*  
*bhṛtyaṃ śiṣyaṃ tathā ceṭīṃ prajāḥ svāśramasannidhau \|\| 46 \|\|*

*uddharedātmanā sārddhaṃ mantragrahaṇamātrataḥ \|*  
*mantragrahaṇamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

44-47. The one who receives the Vaisnas mantra, he redeems his hundred generation of his parents besides those of the other hundred generations of the mother, the maternal grandmother, the sister, the brothers, sister's sons, the maternal uncle, parents-in-law, wife of the Guru, sons of the Guru, the one who imparts knowledge, friends, servants, describes, maid-servants and the people who take refuge with such a person besides the people of the neighbourhood. By simply receiving the mantra of lord Krishna one is freed form the life bondage.

## \|\| 10.48-52 \|\|

*tasya saṃsparśanātpūtaṃ tīrthaṃ ca bhuvi bhārate \|*  
*tasyaiva pādarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā \|\| 48 \|\|*

*pādodakasthānamidaṃ tīrthameva bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*annaṃ viṣṭhā jalaṃ mūtraṃ yadviṣṇoraniveditam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*khādanti no vaiṣṇavāśca sadā naivedyabhojinaḥ \|*  
*viṣṇorniveditānnaṃ ca nityaṃ ye bhuñjate narāḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*pūtāni sarvatīrthāni teṣāṃ ca sparśanādaho \|*  
*viṣṇoḥ pādodakaṃ puṇyaṃ nityaṃ ye bhuñjate narāḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*tatpāpāni palāyante vainateyādivoragāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa pūtaṃ ca bhuvanatrayam \|\| 52 \|\|*

48-52. The sacred places of the entire Bharatavarsa become sanctified with the touch of such a person and with the touch of the dust of a feet even the land is purified wherever the water of his feet false, it becomes a sacred place. The food which is taken without offering it Vishnu is like refuse and the water like the urine. The Vaishnavas never consume them because they consume everything after first offering it to the lord, the one who consumes food after first offering it to the lord all the holy places are sanctified with the touch of such a person. The people who sip the Carnamrta of lord Vishnu daily, all their sins are driven away in the same way as the serpents flee at the sight of Garuda. All the three worlds are sanctified with the single look of such people.

## \|\| 10.53-54 \|\|

*viṣṇoḥ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ santataṃ tāṃśca rakṣati \|*  
*madguṇaśravaṇādye ca pulakāṅkitavigrahāḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*gadgadāḥ sāśrunetrāśca narāste vaiṣṇavottamāḥ \|*  
*putrādapi paraḥ sneho mayi yeṣāṃ nirantaram \|*  
*gṛhādyāśca mayi nyastāste narāḥ vaiṣṇavottamāḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. The Sudarsana-cakra of lord Vishnu always protects them. They become emotional у listening to my glory and the tears of joy and ecstasy flow from their eyes always. Such people are known to be the best Vaishnavas. Such of the people who adore me belter then their own sons and leave their house hold to my care, they are known as the best Vaishnavas.

## \|\| 10.55 \|\|

*ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ mattaḥ sarvaṃ carācaram \|*  
*sarveṣāmahameveśa itijñā vaiṣṇavottamāḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The entire universe from here to the Brahmaloka emerges from him and I happened to be the lord of everyone, such of the Vaishnavas who are aware of all this, are considered to be the best.

## \|\| 10.56-58 \|\|

*asaṃkhyakoṭibrahmāṇḍaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|*  
*pralaye mayi līyante cetijñā vaiṣṇavottamāḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*tejaḥsvarūpaṃ paramaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham \|*  
*svecchāmayaṃ nirguṇaṃ ca nirīhaṃ prakṛteḥ param \|\| 57 \|\|*

*sarve prākṛtikā matta āvirbhūtāstirohitāḥ \|*  
*iti jānanti ye devi te narā vaiṣṇavottamāḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. The innumerable and crores of globes besides Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva merge in my body at the time of dissolution. Such of the people who are aware of all this are known to be the best Vaishnavas. О goddess I possessed the best of lustre and for bestowing grace on my devotee I am invisible, uncondemed, beyond Prakriti and all the elements of nature emerge from me and finally merge in me. The people who are aware of this, are the true Vaishnavas.

## \|\| 10.59 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā deveśo virarāma tayoḥ puraḥ \|*  
*uvāca taṃ tripathagā bhaktinamrātmakandharā \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Thus speaking before both of them lord Krishna kept quiet. Thereafter Ganga who stood before him with folded hands and bowing her head she spoke.

## \|\| 10.60 \|\|

*gaṅgovāca \|*  
*yāmi cedbhārataṃ nātha bhāratīśāpataḥ purā \|*  
*tavājñayā ca rājendra tapasā caiva sāmpratam \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Ganga said — “O lord because of the curse of goddess Sarasvati pronounced by her in earlier times and at your command, I am proceeding on earth to fulfil the desire the king Bhaglratha.

## \|\| 10.61 \|\|

*yāni kāni ca pāpāni mahyaṃ dāsyanti pāpinaḥ \|*  
*tāni me kena naśyanti tadupāyaṃ vada prabho \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. But О lord all the sinful people will dump their store of sins over me. Then how shall I be able to purify myself. You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 10.62 \|\|

*katikālaṃ parimitaṃ sthitirme tatra bhārate \|*  
*kadā yāsyāmi sarveśa tvadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. О lord of all, up to what time shall I have to remain in Bharata and when shall I be able to return to your sacred place of Vishnuloka?

## \|\| 10.63 \|\|

*mamānyadvācchitaṃ yadyatsarvaṃ jānāsi sarvavit \|*  
*sarvāntarātmantsarvajña tadupāyaṃ vada prabho \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. О lord, you are adorable by all and as such you are also aware of my other desires. О lord of the hearts of all, you kindly tell me the way out to have my desire fulfilled.

## \|\| 10.64 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*jānāmi vāñchitaṃ gaṅge tava sarvaṃ sureśvari \|*  
*patiste rudrarūpo'yaṃ lavaṇodo bhaviṣyati \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Krishna said — О Ganga the best of the goddesses, I am quite well-aware of the desires of your minds. This salt-water ocean who happens to the form of Rudra will be your husband.

## \|\| 10.65 \|\|

*mamaivāṃśaḥ samudraśca tvaṃ ca lakṣmīsvarūpiṇī \|*  
*vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṅgamo guṇavānbhuvi \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. This ocean emerged from one of my rays and you also happen to be the form of Lakshmi, the union of a good actor with a good actress is considered to be quite auspicious on earth.

## \|\| 10.66-67 \|\|

*yāvattyaḥ santi nadyaśca bhāratyādyāśca bhārate \|*  
*saubhāgyaṃ tava tāsveva lavaṇodasya saurate \|\| 66 \|\|*

*adyaprabhṛti deveśi kaleḥ pañca sahasrakam \|*  
*varṣaṃ sthitiste bhāratyā bhuvi śāpena bhārate \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. All rivers of the land like Sarasvati and other will merge in you and you alone will flow towards the ocean. You will be considered to be the sacred most of all the rivers. О goddess, you will have to stay in Bharatavarsa for five thousand years as a result of the curse of Sarasvati.

## \|\| 10.68 \|\|

*nityaṃ vāridhinā sārddhaṃ kariṣyasi raho ratim \|*  
*tvameva rasikā devī rasikendreṇa saṃyutā \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. You will enjoy the company of the ocean there in a scheduled place because you are quite a passionate one.

## \|\| 10.69 \|\|

*tvāṃ toṣayanti stotreṇa bhagīrathakṛtena ca \|*  
*bhāratasthā janāḥ sarve pūjayiṣyanti bhaktitaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. All the dwellers of Bharata would recite your name with devotion and adore you with reverence.

## \|\| 10.70 \|\|

*dhyānena kauthumoktena dhyātvā tvāṃ pūjayiṣyati \|*  
*yaḥ stauti praṇamennityaṃ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. According to the method of Kauthuml-s'dkhd. all the people will perform piijd for you daily, meditate upon you and recite you stotra bowing in reverence. All of them will earn the merit of performing Asvamedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 10.71 \|\|

*gaṅgā gaṅgeti yo brūyādyo janānāṃ śatairapi \|*  
*mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The one who recites the name of Ganga even at a distance of hundred of yojanas, he is relieved of all the sins and achieves access to Vishnuloka.

## \|\| 10.72 \|\|

*sahasrapāpināṃ snānādyatpāpaṃ te bhaviṣyati \|*  
*madbhaktadarśane tāvattadaiva hi vinaśyati \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Hundreds of sinners will be redeemed with the taking of bath in your waters, the sin you will earn by the bathing of such sinners, will be washed out at the sight of my devotees.

## \|\| 10.73 \|\|

*pāpināṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ śavasparśena yattava \|*  
*manmantropāsakasnānāttadaghaṃ ca vinaśyati \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. Similarly the sin you will earn with the touch of thousands of dead bodies will be washed out with the taking of bath of my devotees in your water and reciting of my mantras by them.

## \|\| 10.74 \|\|

*yatra yatra bhavedgaṅge mannāmaguṇakīrttanam \|*  
*tatraiva tvamadhiṣṭhānaṃ kariṣyasyaghamocanāt \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. О Ganga at whichever place my name is recited, it would be relieved of all sins and that would become your abode.

## \|\| 10.75-76 \|\|

*sārddhaṃ saridbhiḥ śreṣṭhābhiḥ sarasvatyādibhiḥ śubhe \|*  
*tattu tīrthaṃ bhavetsadyo yatra madguṇakīrttanam \|\| 75 \|\|*

*yadreṇusparśamātreṇa pūto bhavati pātakī \|*  
*reṇupramāṇaṃ varṣaṃ ca sa vaikuṇṭhe vased dhruvam \|\| 76 \|\|*

75-76. О fortunate one, wherever my glory is recited, the place would become holy place in company with Sarasvati and other holy rivers. They will remain in the heaven for such number of years as would be the number of the particles of sand of that place.

## \|\| 10.77-79 \|\|

*jñānena tvayi ye bhaktyā mannāmasmṛtipūrvakam \|*  
*samutsṛjanti prāṇāṃśca te gacchanti hareḥ padam \|\| 77 \|\|*

*pārṣadapravarāste ca bhaviṣyanti hareściram \|*  
*asaṃkhyakaṃ prākṛtikaṃ layaṃ drakṣyanti te narāḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

*mṛtasya bahupuṇyena tacchavaṃ tvayi vinyaset \|*  
*prayāti sa ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāvadasthnāṃ sthitistvayi \|\| 79 \|\|*

77-79. Such of devotees who reciting my name will take bath in your water and then end their lives they would always achieve the abode of Vishnu and become the permanent attendants of Vishnu. Residing in Vaikuntha they would witness innumerable natural dissolutions. Only such of the dead bodies will be thrown in your water who are devoid of all the sins and are immensely meritorious. Till such time the ashes of such people would reside in your sacred water, they would reside Vaikuntha.

## \|\| 10.80 \|\|

*kāyavyūhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā bhojayitvā svakarmakam \|*  
*tasmai dadāmi sārūpyaṃ taṃ karomi ca pārṣadam \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Thereafter I shall allow him to enjoy the merits of his good deeds and thereafter provide him the salvation making him my own attendants.

## \|\| 10.81-82 \|\|

*ajñānī tvajjalasparśādyadi prāṇānsamutsṛjet \|*  
*tasmai dadāmi sārūpyaṃ taṃ karomi pārṣadam \|\| 81 \|\|*

*anyatra vā tyajetprāṇāṃstvannāmasmṛtipūrvakam \|*  
*tasmai dadāmi sālokyamasaṃkhyapralayālayam \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. Even when unwise person ends his life touching your water he will achieve salvation and I shall make him my own attendants. If anyone meets with the end of his life at some other place reciting your name, I shall bestow on him the salvation.

## \|\| 10.83 \|\|

*anyatra vā tyajetprāṇānmannāmasmṛtipūrvakam \|*  
*tasmai dadāmi sālokyaṃ yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Irrespective of being the place where one meets to the end of his life, I provide him with salvation who recites my name as long as the period of a Brahma's existence is counted.

## \|\| 10.84-85 \|\|

*tīrthe'pyatīrthe maraṇe viśeṣo nāsti kaścana \|*  
*manmantropāsakānāṃ ca nityaṃ naivedyabhojinām \|\| 84 \|\|*

*pūtaṃ kartuṃ sa śakto hi līlayā bhuvanatrayam \|*  
*ratnendrasārayānena lokaṃ sa prayāti ca \|\| 85 \|\|*

84-85. The one who adores me with devotion daily and consumes the food first offering to me a part lip it, (he is redeemed and) his death at a holy place or any other place is of no consequence. Such a person easily purifies all the three worlds and becoming like me, surrounded by my attendants, mounts over a plane and reaches Goloka.

## \|\| 10.86 \|\|

*madbhaktabāndhavā ye ye te te puṇyadhiyaḥ śubhe \|*  
*te yānti ratnayānena golokaṃ ca sudurlabham \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. О virtuous one the relatives of all my devotees proceed to Goloka and occupy the gems studded thrones.

## \|\| 10.87 \|\|

*yatra tatra mṛtā ye ca jñānājñānena vā sati \|*  
*jīvanmuktāśca te pūtā bhaktasannidhimātrataḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. Whether one is learned or a fool, remaining in any condition if one meets with the end of his life, he is freed from the bondage of birth and death because of the company of my devotees he keeps.

## \|\| 10.88 \|\|

*ityuktvā śrīharistāṃ ca tamuvāca bhagīratham \|*  
*stuhi gaṅgāmimāṃ bhaktyā pūjāṃ kuru ca sāmpratam \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. Thus speaking to Ganga lord Krishna spoke to Bhaglratha thus, “You adore the Ganga with reverence and devotion.”

## \|\| 10.89-90 \|\|

*bhagīrathastāṃ tuṣṭāva pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*dhyānena kauthumoktena stotreṇa ca punaḥ puna. \|\| 89 \|\|*

*śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇanāmātha paramātmānamīśvaram \|*  
*bhagīrathaśca gaṅgāṃ ca so'ntarddhāya gato hariḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

89-90. Thereafter Bhaglratha with his mind filled with devotion performed dhyanam according to the Kauthuml-sakha and recited stotras for Ganga again and again. Thereafter Bhaglratha bowed in reverence to the Ganga and lord Krishna thereafter disappeared from the scene.

## \|\| 10.91 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*stotreṇa kena dhyānena kena pūjākrameṇa ca \|*  
*pūjāṃ cakāra nṛpatirvada vedavidāṃ vara \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. Narada said — О best of those who are well-versed in the Vedas, you kindly tell me the way Bhaglratha adored Ganga, the stotra he recited, the dhyanam he performed and the sequence of his meditation.

## \|\| 10.92-93 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*snātvā nityakriyāṃ kṛtvā dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī \|*  
*pādau prakṣālya cācamya saṃyato bhaktipūrvakam \|\| 92 \|\|*

*gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām \|*  
*sampūjayennaraśśuddhaḥ so'dhikārī ca pūjane \|\| 93 \|\|*

92-93. Narayana said — After taking bath and getting free from all the daily routines, one should clad himself in two clean garments and wash his feet. Sipping water, he should adore with devotion Ganesha, Stirya, Agni, Vishnu, Shiva and Parvati.

## \|\| 10.94-95 \|\|

*gaṇeśaṃ vighnanāśāya niṣpāpāya divākaram \|*  
*vahniṃ svaśuddhaye viṣṇuṃ muktaye pūjayennaraḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

*śivaṃ jñānāya tadināṃ śivāṃ buddhivivṛddhaye \|*  
*sampūjyaitallabhetprājño viparītamato'nyathā \|\| 95 \|\|*

94-95. Ganesha should be adored for the remover of obstructions, one would adore Ganesha for destruction of the sins, Stirya should be adored for self purification. Agni should be adored for salvation. Vishnu should be adored for achieving knowledge. Shiva should be adored and for seeking prowess and intelligent, Parvati should be adored because by adoring her these dities are pleased and the devotee gets the desired fruits and by ignoring them, one meets with disappointments.

## \|\| 10.96 \|\|

*dadhyāvanena taddhyānaṃ śṛṇu nārada tattvataḥ \|*  
*dhyānaṃ ca kauthumoktaṃ vai sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. О Narada according to the Kauthumi-sakha. The dhydnum performed by Bhaglratha is going to be narrated by me, you listen to it carefully.

## \|\| 10.97-101 \|\|

*śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ gaṅgāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm \|*  
*kṛṣṇavigrahasambhūtāṃ kṛṣṇatulyāṃ parāṃ satīm \|\| 97 \|\|*

*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|*  
*śaratpūrṇenduśatakaprabhājuṣṭakalevarām \|\| 98 \|\|*

*īṣaddhāsaprasannāsyāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām \|*  
*nārāyaṇapriyāṃ śāntāṃ satsaubhāgyasamanvitāma \|\| 99 \|\|*

*bibhratīṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyasaṃyutām \|*  
*sindūrabindulalitāṃ sārddhaṃ candanabindubhiḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

*kastūrīpatrakaṃ gaṇḍe nānācitrasamanvitam \|*  
*pakvabimbasamānaikacārvoṣṭhapuṭamuttamam \|\| 101 \|\|*

97-101. She has the complexion of the jasmine flowers and is the remover of the sins. She is the one, which appears from the body of lord Krishna and is pure like him. One should meditate upon the Ganga possessing these qualities. She is pure like fire and is clad in sanctified garments. She is adorned with ornaments studded with gems. She has the lustre like the hundreds of full moons of the winter season. She wears a serene smile over her face and is always youthful. The lady of the scriptures, is quite dear to Narayana, the fortune can never get separated from her. Her hair is beautifully arranged and she wears a garland of jasmine flowers. Her forehead is decorated with a red spot surrounded by the small spots of sandal-wood paste. This adds to her beauty. Her temples are beautifully decorated with kastiin; she is decorated with several paintings, her lips are like the ripe wood apples.

## \|\| 10.102 \|\|

*muktāpaṃktiprabhājuṣṭadantapaṃktimanoharām \|*  
*sucāruvakranayanāṃ sakaṭākṣamanoramām \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. The lines of teeth are dazzling like the pearls; the face is beautiful and the eyes are charming with curly eye-brows.

## \|\| 10.103 \|\|

*kaṭhinaṃ śrīphalākāraṃ stanayugmaṃ ca bibhratīm \|*  
*bṛhacchroṇīṃ sukaṭhināṃ rambhāstambhapariṣkṛtām \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. The both the breasts are stiff and are of the size of the apple, the pelvic region is develop and quite stiff. The thighs resemble the trunk of the banana tree.

## \|\| 10.104-106 \|\|

*sthalapadmaprabhājuṣṭapādapadmayugaṃdharām \|*  
*ratnābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kuṃkumāktaṃ sayāvakam \|\| 104 \|\|*

*devendramaulimandāramakarandakaṇāruṇam \|*  
*surasiddhamunīndrādidattārghyaissaṃyutaṃ sadā \|\| 105 \|\|*

*tapasvimaulinikarabhramaraśreṇisaṃyutam \|*  
*muktipradaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ kāmināṃ svargabhogadam \|\| 106 \|\|*

104-106. The pair of feet looked like the lotus flowers and were adorned with ornaments and plastered with vermilion. The redness of the feet of the goddess excelled the beauty of the Mandara flower studded in the crow of Indra. The gods, the siddhas and the sages always stand before her offering arghya, the black-wasps with usually reside over the crowns of the kings hover-around the auspicious feet’s of the goddess who bestows salvation to the truth seekers and also the heavenly pleasures to the devotees.

## \|\| 10.107 \|\|

*varāṃ vareṇyāṃ varadāṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām \|*  
*śrīviṣṇoḥ padadātrīṃ ca bhaje viṣṇupadīṃ satīm \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. Thus the adorable, the best, bestower of boons, the one who showers the grace over her devotees, the granter of the abode of Vishnu, is known as Vishnupadl. I bow in reverence to the chaste Ganga like this.

## \|\| 10.108 \|\|

*iti dhyānena cānena dhyātvā tripathagāṃ śubhām \|*  
*dattvā saṃpūjayedbrahmannupahārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. О Brahmana thus meditating upon the Ganga flowing in three streams, one should adore her by sixteen methods.

## \|\| 10.109-110 \|\|

*āsanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ ca snānīyaṃ cānulepanam \|*  
*dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ śītalaṃ jalam \|\| 109 \|\|*

*vasanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ mālyaṃ gaṃdhamācamanīyakam \|*  
*manoharaṃ sutalpaṃ ca deyānyetāni ṣoḍaśa \|\| 110 \|\|*

109-110. The sixteen methods, include the offering of seat, padya, arghya, water for bathing, sandal-paste for plastering, essence, lamp, naivedya, betel, cook water, clothes, ornaments, garland, fragrance (scent), sipping water and the beautiful bed are the sixteen types of offerings made to the goddess.

## \|\| 10.111-112 \|\|

*dattvā bhaktyā saṃpraṇametstutvā tāṃ saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjyaivaṃprakāreṇa so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 111 \|\|*

*stotraṃ vai kauthumoktaṃ ca saṃvādaṃ viṣṇuvedhasoḥ \|*  
*śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi pāpaghnaṃ ca supuṇyadam \|\| 112 \|\|*

111-112. After offering all these with devotion, one should stand with folded hands and offer the prayers. By doing this one gets the merit of performing Asvamedha sacrifice. О Narada, now I tell you about the stotra prescribed by Kauthuma, which is in the form of a conversation between Vishnu and Brahma, which removes all the sins and brings welfare. You listen to it.

## \|\| 10.113 \|\|

*śrībrahmovāca \|*  
*śrotumicchāmi deveśa lakṣmīkānta namaḥ prabho \|*  
*viṣṇo viṣṇupadīstotraṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyakāraṇam \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. Brahma said — О lord, the lord of Lakshmi, О graceful one, О lord Vishnu, I bow in reverence to you. I intend to listen from you the stotra of Ganga which relieves one of all the sins and bestows merits.

## \|\| 10.114 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*śivasaṃgītasaṃmugdhaśrīkṛṣṇāṅgadravodbhavām \|*  
*rādhāṃgadravasambhūtāṃ tāṃ gaṅgāṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. Narayana said — I bow in reverence to the Ganga which emerged from the music of lord Shiva played by him when Krishna and Radha were engaged in love-sports.

## \|\| 10.115 \|\|

*yā janmasṛṣṭerādau ca goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*sannidhāne śaṅkarasya tāṃ gaṅgāṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. At the beginning of the universe she resided in Goloka in the Rasamandala, in the vicinity of lord Shiva. I bow in reverence to her.

## \|\| 10.116 \|\|

*gopairgopībhirākīrṇe śubhe rādhāmahotsave \|*  
*kārtikīpūrṇimājātāṃ tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. In the Radha festival when all the cowherds and cowherdcsses assembled at the time of full moon day of Kartika, you were born. I bow in reverence to Ganga.

## \|\| 10.117 \|\|

*koṭiyojanavistīrṇā dairghye lakṣaguṇā tataḥ \|*  
*samāvṛtā yā golokaṃ tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. You are crores of yojanas in width and are a lakh of times more in length and pervades the Goloka. I bow in reverence to the Ganga.

## \|\| 10.118 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭilakṣairyojanairyā tato dairghye caturguṇā \|*  
*samāvṛtā yā vaikuṇṭhaṃ tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. You are sixty lakh yojanas in width and four time in length surrounding Vaikuntha. I bow in reverence to Ganga.

## \|\| 10.119 \|\|

*viṃśallakṣairyojanairyā tato dairghye caturguṇā \|*  
*āvṛtā brahmalokaṃ yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. You are twenty lakhs yojanas in width and four times in length surrounding the Brahmaloka; I bow in reverence to the Ganga.

## \|\| 10.120 \|\|

*triṃśallakṣairyojanairyā dairghye pañcaguṇā tataḥ \|*  
*āvṛtā śivalokaṃ yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. By becoming three lakh yojana in width and five times more in length, you surround the Shivaloka. I bow in reverence to Ganga.

## \|\| 10.121 \|\|

*ṣaḍyojanasuvistīrṇā dairghye daśaguṇā tataḥ \|*  
*mandākinī yendraloke tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. By becoming six yojana in width and ten times more in length, you move with the name of Mandakini around Indraloka. I bow in reverence to the Ganga.

## \|\| 10.122 \|\|

*lakṣayojanavirstārṇā dairghye saptaguṇā tataḥ \|*  
*āvṛtā dhruvalokaṃ yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. Becoming a lakh of yojana in width and seven times more in length you move around the Dhruvaloka. I bow in reverence to Ganga.

## \|\| 10.123 \|\|

*lakṣayojanavistīrṇā dairghye ṣaḍguṇitā tataḥ \|*  
*āvṛtā candra lokaṃ yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. Becoming a lakh of yojana in width and six times more in length you covered the abode of moon. I bow in reverence to the Ganga.

## \|\| 10.124 \|\|

*yojanaiṣṣaṣṭisāhasrairdairghye daśaguṇā tataḥ \|*  
*āvṛtā sṛryyalokaṃ yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. By becoming seven thousand yojanas in width and double its length, you surround the solar region.

## \|\| 10.125 \|\|

*lakṣayojanavistīrṇā dairghye ṣaṅguṇitā tataḥ \|*  
*āvṛtā satyalokaṃ yā tāṃ gaṅgāṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 125 \|\|*

125\. I bow in reverence to Ganga. By becoming a lakh of yojanas in width and six times more in length you surround the Salyaloka. I bow in reverence to the Ganga.

## \|\| 10.126 \|\|

*daśalakṣairyojanairyā dairghye pañcaguṇā tataḥ \|*

126\. By becoming ten lakh yojanas in width and live time more in length you surround the tapoloka, I bow in reverence to the Ganga.

## \|\| 10.127 \|\|

*sahasrayojanā yā ca dairghye saptaguṇā tataḥ \|*  
*āvṛtā janalokaṃ yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 127 \|\|*

127\. By expanding yourself to a thousand yojanas and seven limes more in length you surround the janoloka. I bow in reverence to the Ganga.

## \|\| 10.128 \|\|

*sahasrayojanā''yāme dairghye saptaguṇā tataḥ \|*  
*āvṛtā yā ca kailāsaṃ tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 128 \|\|*

128\. By expanding yourself to a thousand yojanas and seven times more in length, you surround the Kailasa mountain. I bow in reverence to the Ganga.

## \|\| 10.129 \|\|

*pātāle yā bhogavatī vistīrṇā daśayojanā \|*

129\. Expending ten yojanas in width and ten times more in length, you surround the Patahtloka and are known by the name of Bhagavati. I bow in reverence to the Ganga.

## \|\| 10.130 \|\|

*krośaikamātravistīrṇā tataḥ kṣīṇā na kutracit \|*

130\. You are the one who is spread in width by a Kosa and your span is not reduced at any stage and you are known by the name of Alakananda. I bow in reverence to the Ganga.

## \|\| 10.131 \|\|

*satye yā kṣīravarṇā ca tretāyāmindusannibhā \|*

131\. In the Satyayuga you were white like the milk. In the Tretayuga you had the complexion of the moon, in the Dvapara you had the complexion of the Sandal-paste. I bow in reverence to the Ganga.

## \|\| 10.132 \|\|

*jalaprabhā kalau yā ca nānyatra pṛthivītale \|*

## \|\| 10.133 \|\|

*yasyāḥ prabhāva atulaḥ purāṇe ca śrutau śrutaḥ \|*

## \|\| 10.134-135 \|\|

*yattoyakaṇikāsparśaḥ pāpināṃ ca pitāmaha \|*

134-135. Brahma the Grandfather removes the crores of sins of Brahmahatya with the touch of a drop of your water. The glory of the same Ganga has been recited in twenty one verses which are quite auspicious, remover of the sins and are meritorious.

## \|\| 10.136 \|\|

*nityaṃ yo hi paṭhedbhaktyā saṃpūjya ca sureśvarīm \|*

136\. The one who adoring the goddess Ganga, recites this slotra with devotion, he always gets the merit of performing Asvamedha sacrifice. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 10.137 \|\|

*aputro labhate putraṃ bhāryāhīno labhetpriyām \|*  
*rogānmucyeta rogī ca baddho mucyeta bandhanāt \|\| 137 \|\|*

137\. Similarly a man without a wife gets her. The sick one is relieved of and the one who is bound in the bondage he is freed from the same.

*aspaṣṭakīrtiḥ suyaśā mūrkho bhavati paṇḍitaḥ \|*

138-139. Even if a fool recites the Ganga-stotra after taking a bath in the early morning, he is filled with wisdom and attains glory his bad dreams turn into good dreams and he attains the merit of taking a bath in the Ganga.

## \|\| 10.140 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*bhagīratho'nayā stutyā stutvā gaṅgāṃ ca nārada \|*

140\. Narayana said — О Narada, Bhagiratha offered this prayer to the Ganga and visited the place where sixty thousand sons of Sagara were destroyed.

## \|\| 10.141 \|\|

*vaikuṇṭhaṃ te yayustūrṇaṃ gaṅgāyāḥ sparśavāyunā \|*

141\. With the touch of the wind by the water of Ganga all the son of Sagara were redeemed and they proceeded to Vaikuntha. Since Bhagiratha brought the Ganga on earth. She was therefore known by the name of Bhaglrathi.

## \|\| 10.142 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gaṅgopākhyānamuttamam \|*

142\. I have thus narrated to you the auspicious story of the Ganga which awards merits and salvation. What more do you want to listen from me.

## \|\| 10.143-144 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*śivasaṃgītasaṃmugdhe śrīkṛṣṇe dravatāṃ gate \|*

*tatrasthāśca janā ye ye te ca kiṃ cakrurudyamam \|*  
*etatsarvaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ prabho vaktumihārhasi \|\| 144 \|\|*

143-144. Narada said — What happened when Radhika and Krishna both were turned into water with the music of Shiva? What were the good deeds performed by the people present there at that point of time? You tell me everything in detail.

## \|\| 10.145 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*kārttikīpūrṇimāyāṃ ca rādhāyāḥ sumahotsave \|*

145\. Narayana said — On the full moon day of Kartika, Shri Krishna organised a beautiful festival where in the adored Radha and lived with her in the Rasamandala.

## \|\| 10.146-147 \|\|

*kṛṣṇena pūjitāṃ tāṃ tu saṃpūjyādṛtamānasāḥ \|*

*etasminnantare kṛṣṇa saṃgītaṃ ca sarasvatī \|*  
*jagau sundaratānena vīṇayā ca manoharam \|\| 147 \|\|*

146-147. After having been adored by lord Krishna, Radha was also adored by Brahma and other sages who also prayed to her. In the meantime the goddess Sarasvati playing on Щй started issuing sweet notes which increased the ecstasy of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 10.148 \|\|

*tuṣṭo brahmā dadau tasyai mahāratnāḍhyamālikām \|*

*kṛṣṇaḥ kaustubharatnaṃ ca sarvaratnātparaṃ varam \|*

149\. Lord Krishna on the other hand presented the kaustubha gem to Radha besides a beautiful garland of gems.

## \|\| 10.152 \|\|

*dharmabuddhiṃ ca dharmastu yaśaśca vipulaṃ bhave \|*

152\. Dharma on the other hand bestowed the great glory besides the devotion in dharmcr, the god Agni presented her the sanctified garments and the wind-gods presented her nupuras (anklets) studded with gems.

## \|\| 10.153-155 \|\|

*etasminnantare śambhurbrahmaṇā prerito muhuḥ \|*

*mūrcchāṃ prāpuḥ surāḥ sarve citraputtalikā yathā \|*

*sthalaṃ sarvaṃ jalākīrṇaṃ hīnarādhāhariṃ tathā \|*

153-155. In the meantime Brahma too having been influenced by the dance of lord Krishna started singing the praise of the lord together with lord Shiva. On listening to the music and songs, all the gods present there with filled with ecstasy and fell unconscious but they regained consciousness after a moment and looked at the Rasamandala and the entire area was submerged in water. Both lord Krishna and Radha were no where to be seem. Thereafter the cowherds, the cowherdcsses, the gods and the Brahmanas started crying loud.

## \|\| 10.156-157 \|\|

*dhyānena dhātā bubudhe sarvametadabhīpsitam \|*

*tato brahmādayaḥ sarve tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram \|*  
*svamūrttiṃ darśaya vibho vāñchitaṃ varameva naḥ \|\| 157 \|\|*

156-157. At the point of time Brahma went in deep meditation and with his divine vision he came to know about the factual position. He said both Radha and Krishna have turned themselves into water. Thereafter Brahma and other gods prayer for the lord saying, “O Lord you appear before us in human form. This is the great desire with us.”

## \|\| 10.158-159 \|\|

*etasminnantare tatra vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī \|*

*sarvātmā'hamiyaṃ śaktirbhaktānugrahavigrahā \|*

158-159. In the meantime a divine voice was heard from the sky which was quite sweet, clear and pleasant. It was heard by all. The voice pronounced “0 gods I am the supreme soul and to shower my grace on my devotees I take to human form and this prowess of mine always remains. What will you do now by looking at our bodies.

## \|\| 10.160 \|\|

*manavo mānavāḥ sarve munayaścaiva vaiṣṇavāḥ \|*

160\. The Manus, the humans, all the sages and the Vaishnavas get purified with the reciting of my mantra and will reach my abode.

## \|\| 10.161-166 \|\|

*mūrtiṃ draṣṭuṃ ca suvyagrā yūyaṃ yadi sureśvarāḥ \|*

*svayaṃ vidhātā tvaṃ brahmannājñāṃ kuru jagadguro \|*

*apūrvamantranikaraiḥ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradaiḥ \|*

*manmantraṃ kavacaṃ stotraṃ kṛtvā yatnena gopaya \|*

*sahasreṣu śateṣveko manmantropāsako bhavet \|*

*anya thā ca bhaviṣyanti sarve golokavāsinaḥ \|*

161-166. О gods, if you are really interested in looking at me then ask Shiva to honour my words at that very place. O Brahma you are yourself the teacher of the universe, you ask lord Shiva to create the tantra shastra as part of the Vedas, which should contain several of the unprecedented mantras, stotras dhyanam, method of adoration, mantras and kavachas. All these should be contained therein. Forming the mantra and kavacha for me, they should be kept secret and those who are opposed to me should not be bestowed with the knowledge of the same. Only one in a thousand humans would be my true devotee reciting the mantra. Therefore such of the people who will be purified with my mantra, will arrive in my abode. If they are unable to reach my abode they will reach and Goloka. A such the entire protected globe of Brahma would become of no consequence.

## \|\| 10.167-169 \|\|

*janāḥ pañcaprakārāśca yuktāḥ sraṣṭurbhave bhave \|*  
*pṛthivīvāsinaḥ kecitkecitsvarganivāsina \|\| 167 \|\|*

*adhonivāsinaḥ kecidbrahmalokanivāsinaḥ \|*  
*kecidvā vaiṣṇavāḥ kecinmama lokanivāsinaḥ \|\| 168 \|\|*

*idaṃ kartuṃ mahādevaḥ karotu surasaṃsadi \|*  
*pratijñāṃ sudṛḍhāṃ sadyastato mūrtiṃ ca paśyasi \|\| 169 \|\|*

167-169. There are five types of creatures in universe created by Brahma. They are those who live on earth, live in heaven, are living Patala, live in brahmaloka and those of the Vaishnavas who live in my abode. In case lord Mahadeva promises to creates such a shastra in a firm manner, then you will surely by able to see my image.

## \|\| 10.170 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā gagane virarāma sanātanaḥ \|*  
*taddṛṣṭvā ca jagannāthastamuvāca śivaṃ mudā \|\| 170 \|\|*

170\. Lord Krishna kept quiet while remaining in the sky after speaking thus. Finding this, Brahma, the lord of the universe, felt delighted and prayed to lord Shiva to take up the job.

## \|\| 10.171 \|\|

*brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā jñāneśo jñānināṃ varaḥ \|*  
*gaṅgātoyaṃ kare dhṛtvā svīcakāra vacastu saḥ \|\| 171 \|\|*

171\. On hearing the words of Brahma, Shiva who is the store of all knowledge, took the waters of Ganga in his hands and took a vow for creating the scriptures.

## \|\| 10.172-173 \|\|

*saṃyuktaṃ viṣṇumāyādyairmantrādyaiḥ śāstramuttamam \|*

*gaṃgātoyamupaspṛśya mithyā yadi vadejjanaḥ \|*

172-173. He said: “At the command of lord Krishna I shall compose a word on the illusion of Vishnu in the fonn of mantras providing the gist of the Vedas. In case anyone tells a lie holding the water of Ganga in his palm, he remains in the kalasutra hell up to the age of lord Brahma.

## \|\| 10.174 \|\|

*ityukte śaṅkare brahmangoloke surasaṃsadi \|*  
*āvirbabhūva śrīkṛṣṇo rādhayā saha tatparaḥ \|\| 174 \|\|*

174\. О Brahmana, in the assembly of gods in Goloka, Shiva took this vow and both Radha and Krishna at once reappeared.

## \|\| 10.175 \|\|

*te taṃ dṛṣṭvā ca saṃhṛṣṭāḥ saṃstūya puruṣottamam \|*  
*paramānandapūrṇāśca cakruśca punarutsavam \|\| 175 \|\|*

175\. Finding them there the gods offered prayers to the lord and delightfully started the festival again.

## \|\| 10.176 \|\|

*kālena śambhurbhagavāñchāstradīpaṃ cakāra saḥ \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sugopyaṃ ca sudurlabham \|\| 176 \|\|*

176\. After some time lord Shiva composed the Shastradlpa. Thus I have narrated to you all the details which are quite secret and are difficult to get.

## \|\| 10.177-178 \|\|

*sā caivaṃ dravarūpā yā gaṅgā golokasambhavā \|*  
*rādhākṛṣṇāṅgasambhūtā bhuktimuktiphalapradā \|\| 177 \|\|*

*sthāne sthāne sthāpitā sā kṛṣṇena paramātmanā \|*  
*kṛṣṇasvarūpā paramā sarvabrahmāṇḍapūjitā \|\| 178 \|\|*

177-178. This is the Ganga that flowed in the Goloka from the limbs of Radha and Krishna and is the one who provides salvation to all and provides all the riches. By the grace of lord Krishna, she could travel from place to place. This sacred Ganga who is the form of lord Krishna is adored by all the people of the earth.

## Chapter 11

## \|\| 11.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*kaleḥ pañcasahasre sā samatīte sureśvarī \|*  
*kva gatā sā mahābhāgā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said — Where shall the Ganga proceed after the lapse of live thousand years in the age of Kali; you please tell me.

## \|\| 11.2-4 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpātsamāgatyeśvarecchayā \|*  
*jagāma taṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ śāpānte punareva sā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*bhārataṃ bhāratī tyaktvā cāgamattaddhareḥ padam \|*  
*padmāvatī ca śāpānte gaṃgāyāścaiva nārada \|\| 3 \|\|*

*gaṅgā sarasvatī lakṣmīścaitāstisraḥ priyā hareḥ \|*  
*tulasīsahitā brahmaṃścatasraḥ kīrttitāḥ śrutau \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Narayana said — The Ganga descended on earth because of the curse of Sarasvati and after the completion of her time she would go back again to Vaikuntha. After the end of the curse of Ganga, Sarasvati, Padmavati and Lakshmi too will disown the earth and revert to the abode of Vis nu. Thus lord Vishnu has three spouses named Ganga, Sarasvati and Lakshmi. Tulasi happens to be the fourth one.

## \|\| 11.5-6 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*hetunā kena devī vai viṣṇupādābjasaṃbhavā \|*  
*dhātuḥ kamaṇḍalusthā ca śaṅkarasya śirogatā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*babhūva sā muniśreṣṭha gaṃgā nārāyaṇapriyā \|*  
*aho kena prakāreṇa tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Narada said — Why did Ganga emerge from the feet of lord Vishnu? How did she reach the Kamandalu of Brahma and Shiva. О best of the sages you tell me, how did Ganga become the beloved of Vishnu.

## \|\| 11.7 \|\|

*. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*purā babhūva goloke sā gaṃgā dravarūpiṇī \|*  
*rādhākṛṣṇāṃgasaṃbhūtā tadaṃśā tatsvarūpiṇī \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Narayana said — In the earlier times Ganga was present in Goloka in the form of water, this Ganga had emerged from the bodies of Radha and Krishna.

## \|\| 11.8 \|\|

*dravādhiṣṭhātṛrūpā yā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi \|*  
*navayauvanasampannā ratnābharaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The Ganga happens to be the goddess of water and she took to different forms on earth and was adorned with different types of gems studded ornaments.

## \|\| 11.9 \|\|

*śaranmadhyāhnapadmāsyā sasmitā sumanoharā \|*  
*taptakāñcanavarṇābhā śaraccandrasamaprabhā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Her face was like the lotus flower of winter season and she was very beautiful. She was youthful and adorned with gem-studded ornaments. Her complexion resembled the molten gold and the moon of winter season was of no consequence before her lustre —

## \|\| 11.10-14 \|\|

*snigdhaprabhā'tisusnigdhā śuddhasattvasvarūpiṇī \|*  
*supīnakaṭhinaśroṇī sunitambayugaṃ varam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*pīnonnataṃ sukaṭhinaṃ stanayugmaṃ suvartulam \|*  
*sucāru netrayugalaṃ sukaṭākṣaṃ suvakrimam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*vakrimaṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyasaṃyutam \|*  
*sindūrabindulalitaṃ sārddhaṃ candanabindubhiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*kastūrīpatrikāyuktaṃ gaṇḍayugmaṃ manoharam \|*  
*bandhūkakusumākāramadharoṣṭhaṃ ca suṃdaram \|\| 13 \|\|*

*pakvadāḍimabījābhadantapaṃktisamujjvalā \|*  
*vāsasī vahniśuddhe ca nīvīyukte ca bibhratī \|\| 14 \|\|*

10-14. She had a thick glow over her body and this was her pure Sattvika form, his body was fleshy and thick. Both the breasts were quite beautiful to look at the regions were also stiff and round; both the eyes looked charming with curly eyebrows. She had the curly locks of hair and wore a garland of jasmine flowers. She had a spot of red vermilion over the forehead surrounded by spots of Sandal-paste. Her cheeks were decorated with paintings with kastiirl, the lower lip resembled the beauty of the blossomed flowers of lotus at the noon. The teeth were quite beautiful and were shinning like the seeds of pomegranate. She was clad in beautiful divine garments.

## \|\| 11.15-16 \|\|

*sā sakāmā kṛṣṇapārśve samuttasthe sulajjitā \|*  
*padmapatrasamānābhyāṃ locanābhyāṃ vibho mukham \|\| 15 \|\|*

*nimeṣarahitābhyāṃ ca pibantī satataṃ mudā \|*  
*praphullavadanā harṣānnavasaṅgamalālasā \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Thus wearing a feeling of shyness in her mind she went to lord Krishna. Her face was filled with delight and a great desire in mind therefore keeping a piece of clothe over her face, she started staring at the lord without winking for a moment and looked like extracting the nectar of his face delightfully.

## \|\| 11.17-18 \|\|

*mūrcchitā prabhurūpeṇa pulakāṅkitavigrahā \|*  
*etasminnantare tatra vidyamānā ca rādhikā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*gopītriṃśatkoṭiyuktā koṭicandrasamaprabhā \|*  
*kopena raktapadmāsyā raktapaṅkajalocanā \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. She was so much engrossed in enjoying the beauty of the face of the lord that she seemed as having been fainted. Her body was filled with ecstasy. At the same time Radhika also appeared there with thirty crores of cowherdesses and wore the lustre of crores of moons, over her face. Her face became red in anger and the eyes were turned like the red lotuses.

## \|\| 11.19-20 \|\|

*śvetacampakavarṇābhā mattavāraṇagāminī \|*  
*amūlyaratnakhacitanānābharaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*māṇikyakhacitaṃ hāramamūlyaṃ vahniśaucakam \|*  
*pītābhavastrayugalaṃ nīvīyuktaṃ ca bibhratī \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. The complexion of her body resembled that of the jasmine flower and her walking resembled that of the intoxicated elephant, she was adorned with the ornaments studded with gems and invaluable garment studded with jewels. She was clad in two costumes sanctified by Agni together with waist-band.

## \|\| 11.21-22 \|\|

*sthalapadmaprabhājuṣṭaṃ komalaṃ ca surañjitam \|*  
*kṛṣṇadattārghyasaṃyuktaṃ vinyasyantī padāmbujam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*ratnendrarājakhacitavimānādavaruhya ca \|*  
*sevyamānā ca sakhibhiḥ śveta cāmaravāyunā \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Her lotus-like feet were quite tender and had the lustre of the blossoming flower. They were painted with red paint over which lord Krishna had offered with arghya. Thus displaying her beautiful feet by walking she was adorned with the best of the gem. Thereafter she got down from the throne. Her friends were moving the fly-whisks.

## \|\| 11.23 \|\|

*kastūrībindutilakaṃ candanendusamanvitam \|*  
*dīptadīpaprabhākāraṃ sindūrāruṇasundaram \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Her face was adorned with a red spot surrounded by 1 Накат of a sandal-paste. She was having the lustre of the burning flames and was having the complexion of vermilion.

## \|\| 11.24-25 \|\|

*dadhatī bhālamadhye ca sīmantādhastadujjvalam \|*  
*pārijātaprasūnādimālāyuktaṃ suvakrimam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sucārukabarībhāraṃ kampayantī ca kampitā \|*  
*sucārunāsāsaṃyuktamoṣṭhaṃ kampayatī ruṣā \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. The lower half of her body was looking quite beautiful and she was wearing the long garland of lowers surround the neck. Her eyes were wavering and she herself was trembling. Her beautiful lips were fluttering in anger.

## \|\| 11.26 \|\|

*gatvā tasthau kṛṣṇapārśve ratnasiṃhāsane vare \|*  
*sakhīnāṃ ca samūhaiśca paripūrṇā vibhoḥ sabhā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. She arrived and occupied the seat besides the gems studded lion-throne of lord Krishna. The entire assembly of lord Krishna was filled with the associates of Radha.

## \|\| 11.27 \|\|

*tāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā samuttasthau kṛṣṇaḥ sādaramacyutaḥ \|*  
*saṃbhāṣya madhurālāpaiḥ sasmitaśca sasaṃbhramaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Finding her there lord Krishna got up from his seat and welcomed her in Sweet voice and started talking to her.

## \|\| 11.28 \|\|

*praṇemurabhi saṃtrastā gopā namrātmakandharāḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭuvuste ca bhaktyā taṃ tuṣṭāva parameśvaram \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Thereafter the cowherds getting nervous bowed in reverence to him thereafter they started offering prayer with devotion. They started praising lord Krishna.

## \|\| 11.29 \|\|

*utthāya gaṃgā sahasā sambhāṣāṃ ca cakāra sā \|*  
*kuśalaṃ paripapraccha bhītā'tivinayena ca \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Suddenly she got up and adored the lord and feeling panicky, she enquired about his welfare quite humbly.

## \|\| 11.30 \|\|

*namrabhāvasthitā trastā śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukā \|*  
*dhyānena śaraṇāpannā śrī kṛṣṇacaraṇambuje \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. In panic the throat, the lips and the tongue of Ganga dried up. she stood there meekly and she mentally took refuge under the feet of lord.

## \|\| 11.31 \|\|

*taddhṛtpadme sthitaḥ kṛṣṇo bhītāyai cābhayaṃ dadau \|*  
*babhūva sthiracittā sā sarveśvaravareṇa ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Lord Krishna then mentally entered her heart and delighting her protected her. She felt satisfied with the blessing of the lord.

## \|\| 11.32 \|\|

*ūrdhvaṃ siṃhāsanasthāṃ ca rādhāṃ gaṅgā dadarśa sā \|*  
*susnigdhāṃ sukhadṛśyāṃ ca jvalantīṃ brahmatejasā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Thereafter the Ganga looked at Radhika who was occupying the throne with glow appearing on her body. She was quite pleasant to look at and was possessing her divine lustre.

## \|\| 11.33 \|\|

*asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāmādyāṃ cādisṛṣṭiṃ sanātanīm \|*  
*yathā dvādaśavarṣīyāṃ kanyāṃ ca navayauvanām \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. She happened to be the mother of innumerable Brahmas, the primeval creator. The eternal Radha appeared quite youthful like a girl of twelve years.

## \|\| 11.34-35 \|\|

*viśvavṛnde nirupamāṃ rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca \|*  
*śānta kāntāmanantāṃ tāmādyantarahitāṃ satīm \|\| 34 \|\|*

*śubhāṃ subhadrāṃ subhagāṃ svāmisaubhāgyasaṃyutām \|*  
*saundaryasundarīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ sundarīṣvakhilāsu ca \|\| 35\|\|*

34-35. There was no other lady comparable to her in beauty and virtues in the universe. She was quite peaceful, attractive beyond measure, free from beginning or end, chaste, image of welfare, possessing divine beauty, charming, possessing the fortune of having a husband, the queen of beauty and the best of beautifies in the universe.

## \|\| 11.36-37 \|\|

*kṛṣṇārddhāṅgī kṛṣṇasamāṃ tejasā vayasā tviṣā \|*  
*pūjitāṃ ca mahālakṣmīṃ mahālakṣmīśvareṇa ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

*pracchādyamānāṃ prabhayā sabhāmīśasya suprabhām \|*  
*sakhīdattaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ gṛhṇatīmanyadurlabham \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. She was the better-half of lord Krishna and no one could compare with her in lustre age, glory and the one who is adored by the husband of Maha-Lakshmi. Her influence and her beauty were pervading the entire assembly of the lord. She was accepting the betel offered by her friends.

## \|\| 11.38 \|\|

*ajanyāṃ sarvajananīṃ dhanyāṃ mānyāṃ ca māninīm \|*  
*kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevīṃ ca prāṇapriyatamāṃ ramām \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. She herself was beyond birth, though she happened to be the mother of all. She was the fortunate one, arrogant, proud, the lady of the life of lord Krishna and was the form of his beloved Lakshmi.

## \|\| 11.39 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā rāseśvarīṃ tṛptiṃ na jagāma sureśvarī \|*  
*nimeṣarahitābhyāṃ ca loca nābhyāṃ papau ca tām \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The mind of the Ganga never felt satisfied even after looking at Radhika again and again. She continued to stare at her without winking her eyes.

## \|\| 11.40 \|\|

*etasminnantare rādhā jagadīśamuvāca sā \|*  
*vācā madhurayā śāntā vinītā sasmitā mune \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О sage, in the meantime the modest and polite Radhika smilingly spoke the sweet words to lord Krishna.

## \|\| 11.41-43 \|\|

*rādhikovāca \|*  
*keyaṃ prāṇeśa kalyāṇī sasmitā tvanmukhāmbujam \|*  
*paśyantī satataṃ pārśve sakāmā raktalocanā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*mūrcchāṃ prāpnoti rūpeṇa pulakāṅkitavigrahā \|*  
*vastreṇa mukhamācchādya nirīkṣantī punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*tvaṃ cāpi māṃ sannirīkṣya sakāmaḥ sasmitaḥ sadā \|*  
*mayi jīvati goloke bhūtā durvṛttirīdṛśī \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. Radhika said — О lord of my life who is this image of welfare seated besides you and looking at me with a smile. Her eyes are getting red having been influenced with passion. She is almost getting fainted, while looking at you. Her body is getting emotional and she is looking at you covering her face with a cloth. You always become passionate while looking at me but when inspite of my presence in the Goloka such an undesirable things are happening.

## \|\| 11.44 \|\|

*tvameva caivaṃ durvṛttaṃ vāraṃvāraṃ karoṣi ca \|*  
*kṣamāṃ karomi te premṇā strījātiḥ snigdhamānasā \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. You had been misbehaving with me again and again. I had been forgiving you because of my love for you and that the ladies in the universe always have a tender mind.

## \|\| 11.45 \|\|

*saṃgṛhyemāṃ priyāmiṣṭāṃ golokādgaccha lampaṭa \|*  
*anyathā nahi te bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati sureśvara \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. O lord of the gods, if you behave like this, you leave the Goloka with her. Otherwise you will be in trouble.

## \|\| 11.46 \|\|
