*dṛṣṭastvaṃ virajāyukto mayā candanakānane \|*  
*kṣamā kṛtā mayā pūrvaṃ sakhīnāṃ vacanādaho \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Because earlier also I had found you in the sandal-wood grove together with Viraja but I forgave you at the instance of my friends.

## \|\| 11.47 \|\|

*tvayā macchabdamātreṇa tirodhānaṃ kṛtaṃ purā \|*  
*dehaṃ santyajya virajā nadīrūpā babhūva sā \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. At the uttering of my words you had discarded her. Thereafter the same Viraja looking at an end of her life was turned into a stream.

## \|\| 11.48 \|\|

*koṭiyojanavistīrṇā tato dairghye caturguṇā \|*  
*adyāpi vidyamānā sā tava satkī rtirūpiṇī \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. That the stream is now a crore of yojanas in width and four time more in length and is flowing displaying your glory.

## \|\| 11.49-50 \|\|

*gṛhaṃ mayi gatāyāṃ ca punargatvā tadantikam \|*  
*uccairarauṣīrviraje viraje ceti saṃsmaran \|\| 49 \|\|*

*tadā toyātsamutthāya sā yogātsiddhayoginī \|*  
*sālaṅkārā mūrtimatī dadau tubhyaṃ ca darśanam \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. When I left for home, you again went to her abode and started crying in grief reciting her name as Viraja. Thereafter the Yogini reappeared from the yogic waters and adorned with beautiful ornaments she give her adoration.

## \|\| 11.51-52 \|\|

*tatastāṃ ca samāśliṣya vīryyādhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā \|*  
*tato babhūvustasyāṃ ca samudrāḥ sapta caiva hi \|\| 51 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭastvaṃ śobhayā gopyā yuktaścampakakānane \|*  
*sadyo macchabdamātreṇa tirodhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. Thereafter you embraced her tightly and in planted your semen in her. Thereafter the seven oceans emerged out of her. The second time you were caught in compromising pose with a cowherds named gopi. Here also you left her hearing my voice.

## \|\| 11.53-57 \|\|

*śobhā dehaṃ parityajya prāviśaccandramaṇḍalam \|*  
*tatastasyāḥ śarīraṃ ca snigdhaṃ tejo babhūva ha \|\| 53 \|\|*

*saṃvibhajya tvayā dattaṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā \|*  
*ratnāya kiñcitsvarṇāya kiñcinmativarāya ca \|\| 54 \|\|*

*kiñcitstrīṇāṃ mukhābjebhyaḥ kiñcidrājñe ca kiñcana \|*  
*kiñcitprakṛṣṭavastrebhyo raupyebhyaścāpi kiñcana \|\| 55 \|\|*

*kiñciccandanapaṅkebhyastoyebhyaścāpi kiñcana \|*  
*kiñcitkisalayebhyaśca puṣpebhyaścāpi kiṃcana \|\| 56 \|\|*

*kiñcitphalebhyaḥ sasyebhyaḥ supakvebhyaśca kiñcana \|*  
*nṛpadevagṛhebhyaśca saṃskṛtebhyaśca kiṃcana \|\| 57 \|\|*

53-57. Thereafter Sobha ending her life entered into the lunar region and her body was turned into a great splendour. Thereafter expressing your heart-felt grief, you distributed the lustre of her body to the gems, gold, the wise people, faces of damsels, the kings, best of clothes, silver, sandal pasted, water" fresh buds, flowers, fruits, cooked milk, the well-cultured royal families and the temples of gods.

## \|\| 11.58-59 \|\|

*dṛṣṭastvaṃ prabhayā gopyā yukto vṛndāvane vane \|*  
*sadyo macchabdamātreṇa tirodhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā \|\| 58 \|\|*

*prabhā dehaṃ parityajya prāviśatsūryyamaṇḍalam \|*  
*tatastasyāḥ śarīraṃ ca tīkṣṇaṃ tejo babhūva ha \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. Then I found you in the company of a cowherds Prabha in Vrindavana. On hearing my words you concealed her. But Prabha ended her life and entered into the solar region and her body was turned into a terrific lustre.

## \|\| 11.60-64 \|\|

*saṃvibhajya tvayā dattaṃ premṇā ca rudatā purā \|*  
*vibhajya cakṣuṣordattaṃ lajjayā tadbhayena ca \|\| 60 \|\|*

*hutāśanāya kiṃcicca nṛpebhyaścāpi kiñcana \|*  
*kiṃcitpuruṣasaṃghebhyo devebhyaścāpi kiṃcana \|\| 61 \|\|*

*kiṃciddasyugaṇebhyaśca nāgebhyaścāpi kiṃcana \|*  
*brāhmaṇebhyo munibhyaśca tapasvibhyaśca kiṃcana \|\| 62 \|\|*

*strībhyaḥ saubhāgyayuktābhyo yaśasvibhyaśca kiṃcana \|*  
*tacca dattvā ca sarvebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ roditumudyataḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*śāntyā gopyā yutastvaṃ ca dṛṣṭo vai rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*vasante puṣpaśayyāyāṃ mālyavāṃścandanokṣitaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

60-64. While crying you distributed her lustre and with shyness and getting panicky from me, you gave it over the fire, kings, group of people, gods, thieves, Nagas, Brahmanas, sages, ascetics, fortunate ladies and glorious people. Thus distributing the lustre, you again started crying. Again during performing of Rasamandula at the lime of spring season, you fainted your body with the paste and wearing the auspicious garland, you enjoyed the company of the cowherdes Santi.

## \|\| 11.65-66 \|\|

*ratnapradīpairyuktaśca ratnanirmitamandire \|*  
*ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyo ratnabhūṣitayā saha \|\| 65\|\|*

*tvayā dattaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ bhuktavatyai suvāsitam \|*  
*tayā dattaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ bhuktavāṃstvaṃ purā vibho \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. О lord, both of you were lodged in the gem-studded palace which was illuminated with the lamps of gems. You were serving fragrant betel to each other.

## \|\| 11.67 \|\|

*sadyo macchabdamātreṇa tirodhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā \|*  
*śāntirdehaṃ parityajya bhiyā līnā tvayi prabho \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. О lord, at that point of time, on hearing my words, you concealed her but in panic Santi ended her life and entered into your body.

## \|\| 11.68-71 \|\|

*tatastasyāḥ śarīraṃ ca guṇaśreṣṭhaṃ babhūva ha \|*  
*saṃvibhajya tvayā dattaṃ premṇā ca rudatā purā \|\| 68 \|\|*

*viśve viṣayiṇe kiṃcitsattvarūpāya viṣṇave \|*  
*śuddhasattvasvarūpāyai kiṃcillakṣmyai purā vibho \|\| 69 \|\|*

*tvanmantropāsakebhyaśca vaiṣṇavebhyaśca kiṃcana \|*  
*tapasvibhyaśca dharmāya dharmiṣṭhebhyaśca kiṃcana \|\| 70 \|\|*

*mayā pūrvaṃ hi dṛṣṭastvaṃ gopyā ca kṣamayā saha \|*  
*suveṣavānmālyavāṃśca gandhacandanasaṃyutaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

68-71. And her body was converted into the best of virtues. Thereafter crying in pain of separation, you also divided her and distributed her to lord Vishnu, Lakshmi, your devotees, your Vaishnavas, ascetics besides Dhanna and the people following dharma. Thereafter I found you in the company of a cowherdesses named Ksama; at that point of time you were altired in the best of the costumes and were wearing a long garland of flowers and painted with the fragrant paste of sandal-wood.

## \|\| 11.72-73 \|\|

*ratnabhūṣitayā cārucandanokṣitayā tayā \|*  
*sukhena mūrchitastalpe puṣpacandanasaṃyute \|\| 72 \|\|*

*śliṣṭo'bhūnnidrayā sadyaḥ sukhena navasaṅgamāt \|*  
*mayā prabodhitau sā ca bhavāṃśca smaraṇaṃ kuru \|\| 73 \|\|*

72-73. You were enjoying the company of the damsels on the flower beds which were scented with the sandal-paste and were adorned with all the ornaments studded with gems. Thereafter both of you went to sleep because of the new union. At that point of time I myself woke you up. You just remember this.

## \|\| 11.74-75 \|\|

*gṛhītaṃ pītavastraṃ te muralī ca manoharā \|*  
*vanamālā kaustubhaścāpyamūlyaṃ ratnakuṇḍalam \|\| 74 \|\|*

*paścātpradattaṃ premṇā ca sakhīnāṃ vacanādaho \|*  
*lajjayā kṛṣṇavarṇo'bhūdadyāpi ca bhavānprabho \|\| 75 \|\|*

74-75. At that time I took away your Pltambara, the charming fluid, long garland of forest flowers, kaustubha gems and the most valuable ear-rings. But at the instance of my friends I returned to you all the things. О lord, because of that shyness you were turned black and you also look the same today.

## \|\| 11.76 \|\|

*kṣamā dehaṃ parityajya lajjayā pṛthivīṃ gatā \|*  
*tatastasyāḥ śarīraṃ ca guṇaśreṣṭhaṃ babhūva ha \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Ksama felt ashamed and ended her life entering the earth; her body was turned into the best of virtues.

## \|\| 11.77-78 \|\|

*saṃvibhajya tvayā dattaṃ premṇā ca rudatā purā \|*  
*kiṃciddattaṃ viṣṇave ca vaiṣṇavebhyaśca kiṃcana \|\| 77 \|\|*

*dharmiṣṭhebhyaśca dharmāya durbalebhyaśca kiṃcana \|*  
*tapasvibhyo'pi devebhyaḥ paṃḍitebhyaśca kiṃcana \|\| 78 \|\|*

77-78. Thereafter shedding tears of love, you distributed it among Vishnu, Vaishnavas. Those devoted to dhanna, the weak people, the ascetics, the gods and the men of letters.

## \|\| 11.79 \|\|

*etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|*  
*tvadguṇaṃ bahuvistāraṃ jānāmi ca paraṃ prabho \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. О lord, I have narrated all this to you. Now what more do you want listen to from me? I am quite well aware of all your virtues.

## \|\| 11.80 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā sā rādhā raktapaṅkajalocanā \|*  
*gaṅgāṃ vaktuṃ samārebhe namrāsyāṃ lajjitāṃ satīm \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Thus speaking Radha having the eyes like the red lotus spoke to Ganga, who in shyness was standing there casting her head downwards.

## \|\| 11.81 \|\|

*gaṅgā rahasyaṃ yogena jñātvā vai siddhayoginī \|*  
*tirobhūya sabhāmadhyātsvajalaṃ praviveśa sā \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. At that point of time Ganga the Siddhctyogini realising the truth of the matter, converted herself into the form of water and entered the river.

## \|\| 11.82 \|\|

*rādhā yogena vijñāya sarvatrāvasthitāṃ ca tām \|*  
*pānaṃ kartuṃ samārebhe gaṇḍūṣātsiddhayoginī \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. Thereafter Radhika the Siddhayogini realised the situation and started sipping the water with folded hands from the river Ganga.

## \|\| 11.83 \|\|

*gaṃgā rahasyaṃ yogena jñātvā vai siddhayoginī \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhojaṃ paramaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. The Siddhayogini Ganga came to know all the secret by her yogic powers and she took refuge under the feet of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 11.84 \|\|

*golokaṃ caiva vaikuṇṭhaṃ brahmalokādikaṃ tathā \|*  
*dadarśa rādhā sarvatra naiva gaṅgāṃ dadarśa sā \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Thereafter Radhika searched for Ganga in the Goloka, Vaikuntha, Brahmaloka and all other continents of the globe but she could not find her anywhere.

## \|\| 11.85 \|\|

*sarvato jalaśūnyaṃ ca śuṣkapaṅkajagolakam \|*  
*jalajantusamūhaiśca mṛtadehaiḥ samanvitam \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. Every place was devoid of water and the lotuses of the Goloka were dried up and the aquatic animals met with their death.

## \|\| 11.86-92 \|\|

*brahmaviṣṇuśivānantadharmendrendudivākarāḥ \|*  
*manavo mānavāḥ sarve devāḥ siddhāstapasvinaḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

*golokaṃ ca samājagmuḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukāḥ \|*  
*sarve praṇemurgovindaṃ sarveśaṃ prakṛteḥ param \|\| 87 \|\|*

*varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ variṣṭhaṃ varakāraṇam \|*  
*vareśaṃ ca varārhaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ pravaraṃ prabhum \|\| 88 \|\|*

*nirīhaṃ ca nirākāraṃ nirliptaṃ ca nirāśrayam \|*  
*nirguṇaṃ ca nirutsāhaṃ nirvyūhaṃ ca nirañjanam \|\| 89 \|\|*

*svecchāmayaṃ ca sākāraṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham \|*  
*satyasvarūpaṃ satyeśaṃ sākṣirūpaṃ sanātanam \|\| 90 \|\|*

*paraṃ pareśaṃ paramaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram \|*  
*praṇamya tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

*sagadgadā sāśrunetrāḥ pulakāṅkitavigrahāḥ \|*  
*sarve saṃstūya sarveśaṃ bhagavantaṃ paraṃ harim \|\| 92 \|\|*

86-92. Thereafter the necks, lips and the tongues of all the gods like Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva besides Ananta, Dharma, Indra, Surya, Manu, humans, the gods, the siddhas and the sages were dried up. All of them arrived in Goloka to take refuge and bowed in reverence to lord Govinda. He happened to be the best of all, most/adorable, the giver of boons, the greatest of all because of boons, the lord of boons, one who is competent to bestow boons, the lord of all, unattached, formless, having no refuge, invisible, devoid of enthusiasm, having no fear, the one who moves at will, having definite form and the one who appears on earth for the welfare of his devotees, truthful, lord of truth, witness of all, eternal, the best, lord of all the best people and the supreme soul. All of them bowed in reverence to him and started pleasing him; they were bowing down having their hearts filled with devotion. Their voices were choked and tears were flowing from their eyes. The hair of their bodies were standing on end. All of them offered their prayers to lord Krishna.

## \|\| 11.93 \|\|

*jyotirmayaṃ paraṃ brahma sarvakāraṇakāraṇam \|*  
*amūlyaratnakhacitacitrasiṃhāsanasthitam \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. At that moment Parabrahman who also, appears in the form of a flame and is the cause of all the causes, was seated on the gem-studded lion throne with his body adorned with ornaments studded with best of gems.

## \|\| 11.94 \|\|

*sevyamānaṃ ca gopālaiḥ śvetacāmaravāyunā \|*  
*gopālikānṛtyagītaṃ paśyantaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. The Gopas were fanning with the ily-whisks of white colour. The lord was busy with witnessing the divine dance and music of the gopis.

## \|\| 11.95-97 \|\|

*valguveṣaiḥ parivṛtaṃ gopaiśca śatakoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam \|\| 95 \|\|*

*navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ kiśoraṃ pītavāsasam \|*  
*yathā dvādaśavarṣīyaṃ bālaṃ gopālarūpiṇam \|\| 96 \|\|*

*koṭicandraprabhājuṣṭapuṣṭaśrīyuktavigraham \|*  
*svatejasā parivṛtaṃ susādṛśyaṃ manoharam \|\| 97 \|\|*

95-97. Clad in the best of clothes, a hundred crores of cowherds, surrounded the lord from all sides. The body of lord Krishna was plastered with the paste of sandal-wood and was adorned with the ornaments studded with gems. His complexion resembled the fresh clouds. He appeared of tender age, wearing a yellow lower garment. He appeared in the form of a cowherd of twelve years. The pleasant form of lord Krishna was worth observing. He was having the beauty of crores of gods of love and the eowherdesses were continuously staring at him.

## \|\| 11.98-101 \|\|

*koṭikandarpasaundaryyalīlālāvaṇyavigraham \|*  
*dṛśyamānaṃ ca gopībhiḥ sasmitābhiśca santatam \|\| 98 \|\|*

*bhūṣaṇairbhūṣitābhiśca mahāratnavinirmitaiḥ \|*  
*pibantībhirlocanābhyāṃ mukhacandraṃ prabhormudā \|\| 99 \|\|*

*prāṇādhikapriyatamārādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitam \|*  
*tayā pradattaṃ tāmbūlaṃ bhuktavantaṃ suvāsitam \|\| 100 \|\|*

*paripūrṇatamaṃ rāse dadṛśuḥ sarvataḥ surāḥ \|*  
*munayo mānavāḥ siddhāstapasā ca tapasvinaḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

98-101. Adorned with the ornaments made of the best of gems, the cowherdessess were looking at the beautiful face of lord Krishna and Radha, who was the lady of his life and was resting her head against his chest. He was chewing the betels offered by them. Such type of lord Krishna who happens to be the lord of all the gods, was present in the Rasamcmdala. All the gods, the sages, the humans, the siddhas, the ascetics arrived there to meet the lord. They were totally surprised.

## \|\| 11.102 \|\|

*prahṛṣṭamānasāḥ sarve jagmuḥ paramavismayam \|*  
*parasparaṃ samālocya te tamūcuścaturmukham \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. Then after making mutual consultation, they requested lord Brahma to place their difficulties before the lord.

## \|\| 11.103-108 \|\|

*nivedituṃ jagannāthaṃ svābhiprāyamabhīpsitam \|*  
*brahmā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sthitaṃ viṣṇostu dakṣiṇe \|\| 103 \|\|*

*vāmato vāmadevasya cāgamatkṛṣṇamuttamam \|*  
*paramānandayuktaṃ ca paramānandarūpakam \|\| 104 \|\|*

*sarvaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ dhātā cāpaśyadrāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*sarvaṃ samānaveṣaṃ ca sabhānāsanasaṃsthitam \|\| 105 \|\|*

*dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam \|*  
*mayūrapucchacūḍaṃ ca kaustubhena virājitam \|\| 106 \|\|*

*atīva kamanīyaṃ ca sundaraṃ śāntavigraham \|*  
*guṇabhūṣaṇarūpeṇa tejasā vayasā tviṣā \|\| 107 \|\|*

*vāsasā yaśasā''kṛtyā mūrtyā sundarayā samam \|*  
*paripūrṇatamaṃ sarvaṃ sarvaiśvaryyasamanvitam \|\| 108 \|\|*

103-108. Brahma on listening to the words of the gods flanked by Vishnu on the right side and lord Mahadeva to the left, reached before lord Krishna enjoying the pleasure of the Rasamandala. All of them were clad in similar types of garments, while lord Krishna was seated on the lion-throne holding the flute in his hand while his neck was adorned with a long garland of forest flowers. His crown was decorated with the feathers of the peacock and the kaustubha gem. He looked quite charming and was seated in a peaceful mood. All the Gopas were wearing ornaments of similar nature and had similar lustre, age, glory, clothes, form, figure and beauty. All of them were filled with all riches and were complete in all respects.

## \|\| 11.109-110 \|\|

*kaḥ sevyassevako veti dṛṣṭvā nirvaktumakṣamaḥ \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ tejaḥ svarūpaṃ ca rūparāśiyutaṃ kṣaṇam \|\| 109 \|\|*

*ekameva kṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhayā sahitaṃ param \|*  
*pratyekāsanasaṃsthaṃ ca tayā ca sahitaṃ kṣaṇam \|\| 110 \|\|*

109-110. It was difficult to judge by looking at them as to who was the lord and who was the servant. Even Brahma fell difficult to judge them because in a moment everyone had his face filled with glory, while at another moment it disappeared. Somewhere Krishna alone could be seen, while sometimes he was seen with Radha and sometimes without her.

## \|\| 11.111-113 \|\|

*rādhārūpadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇarūpakalatrakam \|*  
*kiṃ strīrūpaṃ ca puṃrūpaṃ vidhātā dhyātumakṣamaḥ \|\| 111 \|\|*

*hṛtpadmasthaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ dhātā dhyānena cetasā \|*  
*cakāra stavanaṃ bhaktyā praṇamyātha tvanekadhā \|\| 112 \|\|*

*tataḥ sa cakṣurunmīlya punaśca tadanujñayā \|*  
*apaśyatkṛṣṇamekaṃ ca rādhāvakṣasthalasthitam \|\| 113 \|\|*

111-113. Finding Radha in the form of Krishna and Krishna in the form of Radha, no one could distinguish between the males and females. Even Brahma failed to do so. Thereafter Brahma meditated upon Krishna in his mind with devotion and started offering prayers to him. Thereafter at the command of the lord, Brahma opened his eyes, lie could find only lord Krishna resting his head on the breast of Radha.

## \|\| 11.114 \|\|

*svapārṣadaiḥ parivṛtaṃ gopīmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam \|*  
*punaḥ praṇemustaṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭuvuśca punaśca te \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. He was surrounded by his attendants. The gods looking at him, bowed in reverence again and again, offering their prayers.

## \|\| 11.115 \|\|

*vijñāya tadabhiprāyaṃ tānuvāca sureśvaraḥ \|*  
*sarvātmā sarvayajñeśaḥ sarveśaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. Realising his intentions the lord who happens to be the chief of the souls, the lord of all the yajnas said to Brahma.

## \|\| 11.116 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*āgaccha kuśalaṃ brahmannāgaccha kamalāpate \|*  
*ihāgaccha mahādeva śaśvatkuśalamastu vaḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. The lord said — “0 Brahma the lord of Kamala, come here, О lord Mahadeva, you come; let all of you meet with welfare.

## \|\| 11.117 \|\|

*āgatāḥ stha mahābhāgā gaṅgānayanakāraṇāt \|*  
*gaṃgā maccaraṇatmbhoje bhayena śaraṇaṃ gatā \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. О virtuous one, you have arrived here to take back Ganga with you, but Ganga getting terrified has taken refuge under my feet.

## \|\| 11.118 \|\|

*rādhemāṃ pātumicchantī dṛṣṭvā matsannidhānataḥ \|*  
*dāsyāmīmāṃ bahiḥ kṛtvā yūyaṃ kuruta nirbhayām \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. Radhika intends to drink her up coming closer to me therefore I am handing over Ganga to you. All of you should take Ganga out of this-place and be relieved of all the fears.

## \|\| 11.119 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā sasmitaḥ kamalodbhavaḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭāva sarvārādhyāṃ tāṃ rādhāṃ śrīkṛṣṇapūjitām \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. Hearing the words of Lord Krishna, Brahma started praising Radhika who is adorable by all creatures and the beloved of Shri Krishna.

## \|\| 11.120 \|\|

*saṃstūya bhaktinaprātmakaṃdharaḥ \|*  
*dhātā caturṇā vedānāmuvāca caturānanaḥ \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. Brahma, the reciter of all the four Vedas from his four heads, started praising Radha with devotion from all the four mouths.

## \|\| 11.121-123 \|\|

*gaṅgā tvadaṅgasambhūtā prabhorvai rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*dravarūpā ca sā jātā mugdhayā śaṅkarasvarāt \|\| 121 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇāṃśā ca tvadaṃśā ca tvatkanyāsadṛśī priyā \|*  
*tanmantragrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā karotu tava pūjanam \|\| 122 \|\|*

*bhaviṣyati patistasyā vaikuṇṭhe ca caturbhujaḥ \|*  
*bhūgatāyāḥ kalāyāśca lavaṇodaśca vāridhiḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

121-123. Brahma said — О goddess, Ganga was born from the limbs of lord Krishna and also of yours. Both of you had arrived in the Rasamandala.With the music of lord Shiva you felt impressed and thereafter she appeared as water from both of you. Therefore being the part of your body as well as of lord Krishna she happens to be your daughter. She will receive your mantra and adore you. She will be the spouse of lord Vishnu who-is four-armed and shall move on earth only in the form of day. Where the saltish ocean is, there will be her husband.

## \|\| 11.124 \|\|

*golokasthā ca yā rādhā sarvatrasthā tathātmikā \|*  
*tadātmikā tvaṃ deveśi sarvadā ca tavātmajā \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. О goddess, Radha who is in Goloka pervades everywhere and you happen to be her mother. This surely is your daughter.

## \|\| 11.125-127 \|\|

*brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā svīcakāra ca sasmitā \|*  
*bahirbabhūva sā kṛṣṇapādāṅguṣṭhanakhāgrataḥ \|\| 125 \|\|*

*tatraiva saṃvṛtā śāntā tasthau teṣāṃ ca madhyataḥ \|*  
*uvāsa toyādutthāya tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā \|\| 126 \|\|*

*tattoyaṃ brahmaṇā kiñcitsthāpitaṃ ca kamaṇḍalau \|*  
*kiṃciddadhāra śirasi candrārddhe candraśekharaḥ \|\| 127 \|\|*

125-127. On hearing the words of Brahma, Radha gave her consent with a smile. Thereafter Ganga reappeared from the feet of lord Krishna and drawing a veil over her head, she stood there before the gods in shyness. Thereafter Ganga, the goddess of waters, emerged from the body of the goddess. A small pot of that water was stored by Brahma in Kamandalu.

## \|\| 11.128-129 \|\|

*gaṅgāyai rādhikāmantraṃ pradadau kamalodbhavaḥ \|*  
*tatstotraṃ kavacaṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ dhyānameva ca \|\| 128 \|\|*

*sarvaṃ tatsāmavedoktaṃ puraścaryyākramaṃ tathā \|*  
*gaṅgā tāmeva saṃpūjya vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau satī \|\| 129 \|\|*

128-129. Thereafter Brahma initiated Ganga into the mantra of Radha highlighting the stotra, kavacha, the form of adoration, dhyanam and the rites prescribed in the Samaveda. The chaste Ganga adored Radha by the same method.

## \|\| 11.130 \|\|

*lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī gaṃgā tulasī viśvapāvanī \|*  
*etā nārāyaṇasyaiva catasro yoṣito mune \|\| 130 \|\|*

130\. О sage thus Lakshmi, Sarasvati, Ganga and Tulasi are all the goddesses and they purify the entire universe.

## \|\| 11.131 \|\|

*atha taṃ sasmitaḥ kṛṣṇo brahmāṇaṃ samuvāca ha \|*  
*sarvakālasya vṛttāntaṃ durbodhyamavipaścitām \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. Thereafter lord Krishna narrated to Brahma the entire story of Kala which is difficult of access to the unwise people.

## \|\| 11.132 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*gṛhāṇa gaṃgāṃ he brahman he viṣṇo he maheśvara \|*  
*śṛṇu kālasya vṛttāntaṃ yadatītaṃ niśāmaya \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. Lord Krishna said: О Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, you accept Ganga and I am going to tell you the ancient story about Kala.

## \|\| 11.133-134 \|\|

*yūyaṃ ca ye'nyadevāśca munayo manavastathā \|*  
*siddhāstapasvinaścaiva ye ye'traiva samāgatāḥ \|\| 133 \|\|*

*te te jīvanti goloke kālacakra vivarjite \|*  
*jalāplutaṃ sarvaviśvamāgataṃ prākṛte laye \|\| 134 \|\|*

133-134. All of you including the gods, the sages, the ascetics, siddhas and mendicants will remain here in the Goloka unattracted by the cycle of birth and death because the entire universe has been plunged into water because of dissolution.

## \|\| 11.135 \|\|

*brahmādyā ye'nyaviśvasthāste līnā adhunā mayi \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca vinā sarvaṃ sajalaṃ paśya padmaja \|\| 135 \|\|*

135\. О Brahma, all the chief gods residing in the universe have merged into my body because except the Vaikuntha everything else has been submerged in water.

## \|\| 11.136-138 \|\|

*gatvā sṛṣṭiṃ kuru punarbrahmalokādikaṃ param \|*  
*sabrahmāṇḍaṃ viracaya paścādgaṅgā ca yāsyati \|\| 136 \|\|*

*evamanyeṣu viśveṣu sṛṣṭvā brahmādikaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*karomyahaṃ punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ gaccha śīghraṃ suraiḥ saha \|\| 137 \|\|*

*maccakṣuṣornimeṣeṇa brahmaṇaḥ patanaṃ bhavet \|*  
*gatāḥ katividhāste ca bhaviṣyanti ca vedhasaḥ \|\| 138 \|\|*

136-138. All of you should go to Brahmtuloka and engage yourself in the task of new creation. Thereafter Ganga will also depart from this place. I am also starting creation in other globes together with Brahma. Therefore, you should all proceed at once in the twinkling of my eye. The age of Brahma has come to an end. Therefore many of the Brahmas have completed their age and their numbers cannot be counted.

## \|\| 11.139-142 \|\|

*ityuktvā rādhikānātho jagāmāntaḥpuraṃ mune \|*  
*devā gatvā punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ cakrureva prayatnataḥ \|\| 139 \|\|*

*goloke ca sthitā gaṃgā vaikuṇṭhe śivalokake \|*  
*brahmaloke tathā'nyatra yatra tatra purā sthitā \|\| 140 \|\|*

*tatraiva sā gatā gaṃgā cājñayā paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*nirgatā viṣṇupādābjāttena viṣṇupadī smṛtā \|\| 141 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gaṃgopākhyānamuttamam \|*  
*sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 142 \|\|*

139-142. Thus speaking Krishna the lord of Radhika, retired to the inner apartments and all the gods left the place and engaged themselves in the work of creation. Thereafter Ganga too proceeded on to the globes besides Goloka, Vaikuntha, Shivaloka, Brahmaloka and all other places where lord Krishna had desired her to proceed. Because of the emergence of the Ganga from the feet of the lord Vishnu, she was known as VishnupadT. Thus, I have narrated the entire story of Ganga which bestows welfare, salvation and is the form of the lord. What else do you want to listen to?

## Chapter 12

## \|\| 12.1-2 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī gaṃgā tulasī lokapāvanī \|*  
*etā nārāyaṇasyaiva catasraśca priyā iti \|\| 1 \|\|*

*gaṃgā jagāma vaikuṇṭhamidameva śrutaṃ mayā \|*  
*kathaṃ sā tasya patnī ca babhūva brūhi keśava \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narada said — Lakshmi, Sarasvati, Ganga and Tulasi are the purifiers of the universe or the spouses of lord Vishnu. And I have come to know that Ganga went to Vaikuntha. Therefore, О Kesava, you kindly let me know how Ganga became the spouse of Vishnu.

## \|\| 12.3 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*gaṃgā jagāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ tatpaścācca gato vidhiḥ \|*  
*gatvovāca tayā sārddhaṃ praṇamya jagadīśvaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Narayana said — On the departure of Ganga to Vaikuntha, Brahma also arrived there and bowing in reverence to the lord together with Ganga said.

## \|\| 12.4-5 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*rādhākṛṣṇāgasaṃbhūtā yā devī dravarūpiṇī \|*  
*tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevīyaṃ rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi \|\| 4 \|\|*

*navayauvanasampannā suśīlā sundarī varā \|*  
*śuddhasattvasvarūpā ca krodhāhaṅkāravarjitā \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Brahma said — Ganga was born out of the bodies of Radha and Krishna. She therefore is the goddess of the waters, she is quite youthful on earth, is quite meek, beautiful and devoid of arrogance and anger.

## \|\| 12.6-7 \|\|

*yadaṅgasambhavā nānyaṃ vṛṇotīyaṃ ca taṃ vinā \|*  
*tatrāpi māninī rādhā mahātejasvinī varā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*samudyatā pātumimāṃ bhīteyaṃ buddhipūrvakam \|*  
*viveśa caraṇāmbhoje kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. She doesn't want to be wedded to anyone else except the one from whom she is born but Radhika who happens to be quite powerful and arrogant intended to drink her up. But inspite of getting panicky, she acted wisely and took refuge under the feet of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 12.8-9 \|\|

*sarvaṃ viśuṣkaṃ golokaṃ dṛṣṭvā'hamagamaṃ tadā \|*  
*golākaṃ yatra kṛṣṇaśca sarvavṛttāntalabdhaye \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sarvāntarātmā sarvaṃ no jñātvā'bhiprāyameva ca \|*  
*bahiścakāra gaṃgāṃ ca pādāṅguṣṭhanakhāgrataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Finding the entire universe having been dried up I went to lord Krishna in the Goloka. Lord Krishna who happens to be the soul of everyone, well realised the purpose of my arrival there and from the toe of his foot he made the Ganga to flow.

## \|\| 12.10-12 \|\|

*dattvā'syai rādhikāmantraṃ pūrayitvā ca golakam \|*  
*saṃpraṇamya ca rādheśaṃ gṛhītvā'trāgamaṃ vibho \|\| 10 \|\|*

*gāndharveṇa vivāhena gṛhāṇemāṃ sureśvarīm \|*  
*sureśvarastvaṃ rasiko rasikāṃ rasabhāvanaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*puṃratnaṃ puṃsu deveṣu strīratnaṃ strīṣviyaṃ satī \|*  
*vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṅgamo guṇavānbhavet \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. О lord, thereafter I bestowed the mantra of Radhika on Ganga and filled the universe with her water. Thereafter bowing my head at the feet of Radhika and Krishna, I have arrived here with her. Therefore you aecepl her by means of the Gandharva type of marriage, because you are the lord of the gods and quite passionate. Besides you are the gem of the humans and she happens to be the gem of ladies. Therefore she is the most appropriate lady for you.

## \|\| 12.13 \|\|

*upasthitāṃ ca yaḥ kanyāṃ na gṛhṇāti madena ca \|*  
*taṃ vihāya mahālakṣī ruṣṭā yāti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The one who rejects a damsel in arrogance, the goddess Lakshmi gets annoyed with him. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 12.14 \|\|

*yo bhavetpaṇḍitaḥ so'pi prakṛtiṃ nāvamanyate \|*  
*sarve prākṛtikāḥ puṃsaḥ kāminyaḥ prakṛteḥ kalāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The wise person does not humiliate the Prakriti because the humans are born out of Prakriti and the ladies are just the race of Prakriti.

## \|\| 12.15 \|\|

*tvameva bhagavā nādyo nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|*  
*arddhāṃgo dvibhujaḥ kṛṣṇo'pyardhāṃgena caturbhujaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. You are the only lord who are beyond Prakriti and are invisible. The whole lord Krishna was separated into two parts, from one half emerged lord Krishna having two arms and the second half is represented by you as lord Hari having four arms.

## \|\| 12.16 \|\|

*kṛṣṇavāmāṃgasambhūtā paramā rādhikā purā \|*  
*dakṣiṇāṅgātsvayaṃ sā ca vāmāṅgātkamalā yathā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. In the earlier times Radhika too had emerged out of the left part of lord Krishna. She was therefore divided into two parts. In her right part, she maintained her original self and from the left half emerged Lakshmi. The Ganga also emerged similarly.

## \|\| 12.17 \|\|

*tena tvāṃ sā vṛṇotyeva yatastvaddehasambhavā \|*  
*strīpuṃsau vai tathaikāṅgau yathā prakṛtipūruṣau \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Therefore she having born out of your bodies intends to become your spouse because like Purusa and Prakriti or the men and women are one and the same.

## \|\| 12.18-19 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā dhātā ca tāṃ samarpya jagāma saḥ \|*  
*gāndharveṇa vivāhena tāṃ jagrāha hariḥ svayam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*śayyāṃ ratikarīṃ kṛtvā puṣpacandanacarcitām \|*  
*reme ramāpatistatra gaṅgayā sahito mudā \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Thus speaking, Brahma left the Ganga with lord Vishnu and returned from that place. Thereafter lord Vishnu arranged a Gandharva marriage and accepted the hand of Ganga. Thereafter lord Vishnu enjoyed the company of Ganga on the flowery bed.

## \|\| 12.20 \|\|

*gāṃ pṛthvīṃ ca gatā yasmātsvasthānaṃ punarāgatā \|*  
*nirgatā viṣṇupādācca gaṅgā viṣṇupadī smṛtā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Ganga was so called because she returned to the earth. Because she emerged out of the feet of Vishnu she was called Vishnupadl.

## \|\| 12.21-22 \|\|

*mūrcchāṃ samprāpa sā devī navasaṅgamamātrataḥ \|*  
*rasikā sukhasambhogādrasikeśvarasaṃyutā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*taddṛṣṭvā duḥkhitā vāṇī sāpatnyerṣyāvivarjitā \|*  
*nityamīrṣyati tāṃ vāṇī na ca gaṃgā sarasvatīm \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Thus because of her union with Vishnu, she fainted. Finding her in this position Sarasvati took pity on her and all her jealousy disappeared but after some time Sarasvati became jealous of Ganga, though Ganga in turn never reciprocated.

## \|\| 12.23 \|\|

*gaṅgayā sahitasyaiva tisro bhāryā ramāpateḥ \|*  
*sārddhaṃ tulasyā paścācca catasro hyabhavanmune \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Thus О sage, lord Vishnu had three spouses and subsequently, another, Tulasi was added to the number.

## Chapter 13

## \|\| 13.1-4 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*nārāyaṇapriyā sādhvī kathaṃ sā ca babhūva ha \|*  
*tulasī kutra sambhūtā kā vā sā pūrvajanmani \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kasya vā sā kule jātā kasya kanyā tapasvinī \|*  
*kena vā tapasā sā ca saṃprāpa prakṛteḥ param \|\| 2 \|\|*

*nirvikalpaṃ nirīhaṃ ca sarvasākṣisvarūpakam \|*  
*nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ brahma paramātmānamīśvaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

*sarvārādhyaṃ ca sarveśaṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvakāraṇam \|*  
*sarvādhāraṃ sarvarūpaṃ sarveṣāṃ paripālanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Narada said — “How could the chaste Tulasi become the beloved of lord Narayana”? Where was she bom? What was she in the earlier birth and in which race was she bom? Who was her father? By which of the tapas, did she achieve the position of becoming the spouse of lord Hari who is beyond Prakriti, unthinkable, exclusive and Narayana, who happens to be the witness of all, the eternal Brahman, the supreme soul, the lord adorable by all, the lord of all, all knowledgeable, the cause of everything, the base of all, the form of everything and the preserver of all?

## \|\| 13.5 \|\|

*kathametādṛśī devī vṛkṣatvaṃ samavāpa ha \|*  
*kathaṃ sā'pyasuragrastā saṃbabhūva tapasvinī \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. How did such a goddess turn into a tree and how was such a chaste lady was entangled in the clutches of a demon?

## \|\| 13.6 \|\|

*sandigdhaṃ me mano lolaṃ prerayenmāṃ muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*chettumarhasi sandehaṃ sarvasandehabhañjanā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. O lord, you are the remover of the doubts of all and you remove my doubts as well, because my unstable mind is in doubt.

## \|\| 13.7 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*manuśca dakṣasāvarṇiḥ puṇyavānvaiṣṇavaḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*yaśasvī kīrtimāṃścaiva viṣṇoraṃśasamudbhavaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Narayana said — There was a yaksa named Savami who was quite noble, the devotee of Vishnu, kind-hearted, glorious and was born out of the Amsa of Vishnu.

## \|\| 13.8 \|\|

*tatputro dharmasāvarṇirdharmiṣṭho vaiṣṇavaḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*tatputro viṣṇusāvarṇirvaiṣṇavaśca jitendriyaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. His son was named Dharmasavarni who was quite religious, devoted to lord Vishnu, noble minded and his son was known by the name of Vishnusavaml. He was a great devotee of lord Vishnu and was self-disciplined.

## \|\| 13.9 \|\|

*tatputro devasāvarṇirviṣṇuvrataparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*tatputro rājasāvarṇirmahāviṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. He had a son named Devasavami who too was a great devotee of Vishnu and his son named Rajasavarni also was a great devotee of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 13.10 \|\|

*vṛṣadhvajaśca tatputro vṛṣadhvajaparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*yasyāśrame svayaṃ śambhurāsīddaivayugatrayam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. His son was known by the name of Vrs adhvaja; he was immensely devoted to lord Shiva. Lord Shiva spent three yugas in his abode.

## \|\| 13.11 \|\|

*putrādapi paraḥ sneho nṛpe tasmiñchivasya ca \|*  
*na ca nārāyaṇaṃ mene na ca lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Lord Shiva loved Vrsadhvaja much more than his own son; therefore the king never adored Narayana, Lakshmi or Sarasvati.

## \|\| 13.12-13 \|\|

*pūjāṃ ca sarvadevānāṃ dūrībhūtāṃ cakāra saḥ \|*  
*bhādre māsi mahālakṣmīpūjāṃ matto'tyajannṛpaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*māghe sarasvatīpūjāṃ dūrībhūtāṃ cakāra saḥ \|*  
*yajñaṃ ca viṣṇupūjāṃ ca nininde na cakāra saḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. He discarded the adoration of all other gods and always kept himself busy with the devotion of Shiva. He discard the adoration of Maha-Lakshmi in Bhadrapada and Sarasvati during the month of Magha. Simultaneously he disowned the adoration of Vishnu and started denouncing him.

## \|\| 13.14-15 \|\|

*na ko'pi devo bhūpendraṃ śaśāpa śivakāraṇāt \|*  
*bhraṣṭaśrīrbhava bhūpeti cāśapattaṃ divākaraḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*śūlaṃ gṛhītvā taṃ sūryyaṃ dhṛtavācchaṅkaraḥ svayam \|*  
*pitrā sārddha dineśaśca brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. No one could venture to pronounce a curse on the king because of the fear of Shiva but once Surya cursed the king thus, “All your glory will vanish”. At this lord Shiva got enraged at Surya and attacked him with his trident. Surya then in panic rushed to Brahma with his father Kashyapa.

## \|\| 13.16 \|\|

*śivastriśūlahastaśca brahmalokaṃ yayau krudhā \|*  
*brahmā sūryyaṃ puraskṛtya vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca yayau bhiyā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Holding the trident in his hand, the enraged Shiva reached the Brahmaloka. Brahma on his part was also terrified. Placing Surya before him, he went to Vaikuntha.

## \|\| 13.17 \|\|

*śūlaṃ gṛhītvā tatrāpi dhṛtavāñchaṅkaro ravim \|*  
*brahmakaśyapamārttaṇḍāḥ saṃtrastāḥ śuṣkatālukāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Reaching there lord Shiva who had a trident in his hand caught hold of Surya. The scene terrified Brahma, Kashyapa and Surya who were very much in terror and their tongues dried up.

## \|\| 13.18-19 \|\|

*nārāyaṇaṃ ca sarveśaṃ te yayuḥ śaraṇaṃ bhiyā \|*  
*mūrdhnā praṇemuste gatvā tuṣṭuvuśca punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*sarve nivedanaṃ cakrurbhiyaste kāraṇaṃ harau \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Terrified of Shiva they took refuge under lord Narayana. Reaching before him they bowed in reverence and started offering prayers to him. Thereafter all the three of them narrated the cause of their arrival to lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 13.20 \|\|

*nārāyaṇaśca kṛpayā'bhayaṃ tebhyo dadau mune \|*  
*sthirā bhavata he bhītā bhayaṃ kiṃ vo mayi sthite \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О sage, lord Vishnu assured protection to them saying, "O terrified ones, be stable. You need not be afraid in my presence".

## \|\| 13.21 \|\|

*smaranti ye yatra tatra māṃ vipattau bhayānvitāḥ \|*  
*tāṃstatra gatvā rakṣāmi cakra hastastvarānvitaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Whenever anyone recites my name in terror I always reach the place to protect him holding a Cakra in my hand.

## \|\| 13.22-24 \|\|

*pātā'haṃ jagatāṃ devaḥ karttā'haṃ satataṃ sadā \|*  
*sṛṣṭvā ca brahmarūpeṇa saṃharttā śivarūpataḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*śivo'haṃ tvamahaṃ cāpi sūryyo'haṃ triguṇātmakaḥ \|*  
*vidhāya nānārūpaṃ ca kuryāṃ sṛṣṭyādikāḥ kriyāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*yūyaṃ gacchata bhadraṃ vo bhaviṣyati bhayaṃ kutaḥ \|*  
*adyaprabhṛti vo nāsti madvarācchaṅkarādbhayam \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. О gods, I have been creator and the preserver of this universe, I create the universe in the form of Brahma and destroy it in the form of Shiva. I am myself Shiva, Brahma and Surya, enshrining in me all the three gunas. Thus I take to many forms and conduct myself in the universe. Therefore all the three of you should go back. You will meet with welfare and your fear shall be removed because of my boon. You will henceforth not be afraid of lord Shiva.

## \|\| 13.25 \|\|

*āśutoṣaḥ sa bhagavāñcharaṇyaśca satāṃ gatiḥ \|*  
*bhaktādhīnaśca bhakteśo bhaktātmā bhaktavatsalaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Lord Shiva gets pleased easily, is protector of the noble people, is under the command of the devotees, lord of the devotees, the soul of the devotees and is loved by his devotees.

## \|\| 13.26 \|\|

*sudarśanaṃ śivaścaiva mama prāṇādhikapriyau \|*  
*brahmāṇḍeṣu na tejasvī he brahmannanayoḥ paraḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. О Brahman both the Shudrasana-cakra and Shiva are dearer to me than my life even. There is no one else more glorious than them in the universe.

## \|\| 13.27 \|\|

*śaktaḥ sraṣṭuṃ mahādevaḥ sūryyakoṭiṃ ca līlayā \|*  
*koṭiṃ ca brahmaṇāmevaṃ kimasādhyaṃ ca śūlinaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. With his illusion lord Shiva can create crores of Stiryas and also Brahmanas. Nothing is beyond the competence of lord Shiva.

## \|\| 13.28 \|\|

*bāhyajñānaṃ tanna kiṃciddhyāyato māṃ divāniśam \|*  
*mannāma madgaṇaṃ bhaktyā pañcavaktreṇa gīyate \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Since he is always engaged in meditation on me, he remains unconcerned with the outside world. He always recites my glory from all his five heads.

## \|\| 13.29 \|\|

*ahameva cintayāmi tatkalyāṇaṃ divāniśam \|*  
*ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmyaham \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. As such I always think of his welfare. Because whosoever meets me with any intention I serve him accordingly.

## \|\| 13.30 \|\|

*śivasvarūpo bhagavāñchivādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā \|*  
*śivo bhavati yasmācca śivaṃ tena vidurbudhāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Lord Shiva is the lord of welfare. Because of his being the lord of welfare, he is known always by the people as the bestower of welfare.

## \|\| 13.31 \|\|

*etasminnantare tatra cāgamacchaṅkaraḥ svayam \|*  
*śūlahasto vṛṣārūḍho raktapaṅkajalocanaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. In the meantime lord Shiva himself arrived there. He was holding a trident in his hand with eyes getting red like a red lotus and mounted on the bull.

## \|\| 13.32 \|\|

*avaruhya vṛṣāttūrṇaṃ bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ \|*  
*nanāma bhaktyā taṃ śāntaṃ lakṣmīkāntaṃ parātparam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. He at once descended from the back of the bull. He bowed in reverence to lord Vishnu. He then offered a salutation to the lord with great devotion.

## \|\| 13.33 \|\|

*ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitam \|*  
*kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ cakriṇaṃ vanamālinam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Lord Vishnu at that point of time was seated comfortably on the gem-studded throne, adorned with all the ornaments, kirltu-mukuta and kundala.s\\ A long garland of flowers was also worn by him.

## \|\| 13.34 \|\|

*navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ sundaraṃ ca caturbhujam \|*  
*caturbhujaiḥ sevitaṃ ca śvetacāmaravāyunā \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. He had a dark complexion like the fresh cloud. He was charming to look at, having four arms and served by attendants fanning him with the white fly-whisks.

## \|\| 13.35 \|\|

*candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ bhūṣitaṃ pītavāsasā \|*  
*lakṣmīpradattatāmbūlaṃ bhuktavantaṃ ca nārada \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О Narada, his entire body was plastered with the sandal-paste and he was clad in a yellow garment. He was chewing the betel offered to him by Lakshmi.

## \|\| 13.36 \|\|

*vidyādharīnṛtyagītaṃ śṛṇvantaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā \|*  
*īśvaraṃ paramātmānaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Thus smiling delightfully he was listening to the music of Vidya-dharls. Such a lord incarnates on earth for the welfare of his devotees.

## \|\| 13.37 \|\|

*taṃ nanāma mahādevo brahmāṇaṃ ca nanāma saḥ \|*  
*nanāma sūryyo bhaktyā ca saṃtrastaścandraśekharam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Lord Shiva offered his salutation to both Vishnu and Brahma. Thereafter Sflrya also feeling panicky bowed in reverence to lord Shiva.

## \|\| 13.38 \|\|

*kaśyapaśca mahābhaktyā tuṣṭāva ca nanāma ca \|*  
*śivaḥ saṃstūya sarveśaṃ samuvāsa sukhāsane \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Kashyapa also offered prayers to him with devotion. Thereafter lord Shiva offering prayers to lord Vishnu took his seat.

## \|\| 13.39 \|\|

*sukhāsane sukhāsīnaṃ viśrāntaṃ candraśekharam \|*  
*śvetacāmaravātena sevitaṃ viṣṇupārṣadaiḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Finding lord Shiva seated on Sukhasana comfortably with traces of fatigue on his face, lord Vishnu directed his Shveta camara to serve lord Shiva.

## \|\| 13.40-41 \|\|

*akrodhaṃ sattvasaṃsargātprasannaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā \|*  
*stūyamānaṃ pañcavaktraiḥ paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vibhum \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tamuvāca prasannātmā prasannaṃ surasaṃsadi \|*  
*pīyūṣatulyaṃ madhuraṃ vacanaṃ sumanoharam \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. By coming in touch with the sattvaguna devoid of anger, getting pleased and smilingly lord Shiva started offering prayers to Narayana from all his five heads. Thereafter in the assembly of gods, lord Vishnu spoke nectar-like sweet words to Shiva thus.

## \|\| 13.42 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*atyantamupahāsyaṃ ca śivapraśnaṃ śive śivam \|*  
*laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ caiva tvāṃ pṛcchāmi tathā 'pi śam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Lord Vishnu said — О lord Shiva, though it would be a joke to enquire from you about your welfare, yet following the Vedas I enquire of you about your welfare.

## \|\| 13.43 \|\|

*tapasāṃ phaladātāraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām \|*  
*sampatpraśnaṃ tapaḥpraśnamayogyaṃ tvāṃ ca sāmpratam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Because you bestow the reward of tapas and bestow all the riches on all, therefore it would not be proper for me to ask you the question about the riches and tapas.

## \|\| 13.44-45 \|\|

*jñānādhideve sarvajñe jñānaṃ pṛcchāmi kiṃ vṛthā \|*  
*nirāpadi vipatpraśnamalaṃ mṛtyuñjaye hare \|\| 44 \|\|*

*tvāmeva vāgdhanaṃ praśnamalaṃ svāśrayamāgame \|*  
*āgato'si kathaṃ vegādityuvāca ramāpatiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. Similarly the one who is the store of knowledge, it would not be proper to question him about knowledge. The one who removes the misfortunes of all others it would not be proper for us to question him about misfortunes. Since you are self-supporting it would not be proper for me to question you about the reason for your arrival here. I only ask you this much as to why you have come rushing.

## \|\| 13.46 \|\|

*śrīmahādeva uvāca \|*  
*vṛṣadhvajaṃ ca madbhaktaṃ mama prāṇādhikapriyam \|*  
*sūryyaḥ śaśāpa iti me heturāgamakopayoḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Mahadeva said — “My dear devotee Vrs adhvaja has been cursed by Stirya, which enraged me and I have reached here.

## \|\| 13.47 \|\|

*putravātsalyaśokena sūryyaṃ hantuṃ samudyataḥ \|*  
*sa brahmāṇaṃ prapannaśca sa sūryyaśca vidhistvayi \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Because of my love for my son, I got ready even to kill Surya as a result of which he fled away and has arrived here taking refuge under you. Brahma has arrived here together with him.

## \|\| 13.48 \|\|

*tvāṃ ye śaraṇamāpannā dhyānena vacasā'pi vā \|*  
*nirāpadaste niśśaṅkā jarā mṛtyuśca tairjitaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Such of the people who take refuge in you mentally or by speaking are always relieved of their misfortune and are freed from death.

## \|\| 13.49 \|\|

*sākṣādye śaraṇāpannāstatphalaṃ kiṃ vadāmi bhoḥ \|*  
*harismṛtiścābhayadā sarvamaṅgaladā sadā \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. But the one who himself has arrived to take refuge under you, what could I speak about him? Even the reciting of the name of Vishnu relieves one of all the dangers and bestows welfare.

## \|\| 13.50 \|\|

*kiṃ me bhaktasya bhavitā tanme brūhi jagatprabho \|*  
*śrīhatasyāsya mūḍhasya sūryyaśāpena hetunā \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. О lord of the universe, because of the curse of Surya my devotee has lost all the grace and has become a fool. What shall happen to him you kindly tell me.

## \|\| 13.51-52 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*kālo'tiyāto daivena yugānāmekaviṃśatiḥ \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhe ghaṭikārddhena śīghraṃ yāhi nṛpālayam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*vṛṣadhvajo mṛtaḥ kālāddurnivāryyātsudāruṇāt \|*  
*haṃsadhvajaśca tatputro mṛtaḥ so'pi śriyā hataḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. Lord Vishnu said — A lot of time has passed since the moves of tire destiny and twenty one years have already lapsed though in Vaikuntha the time is equivalent to half a ghadl (measure of time equivalent to twenty four minutes). Therefore now you go back to the king. The terrific Yama has already swallowed Vrsadhvaja who happened to be your devotee; his son Hansadhvaja also has died.

## \|\| 13.53-57 \|\|

*tatputrau ca mahābhāgau dharmadhvajakuśadhvajau \|*  
*hataśriyau sūryyaśāpāttau vai paramavaiṣṇavau \|\| 53 \|\|*

*rājyabhraṣṭau śriyā bhraṣṭau kamalātāpasāvubhau \|*  
*tayośca bhāryyayorlakṣmīḥ kalayā ca janiṣyati \|\| 54 \|\|*

*sampadyuktau tadā tau ca nṛpaśreṣṭhau bhaviṣyataḥ \|*  
*mṛtaste sevakaḥ śambho gaccha yūyaṃ ca gacchata \|\| 55 \|\|*

*ityuktvā ca salakṣmīkaḥ sabhāto'bhyantaraṃ gataḥ \|*  
*devā jagmuśca saṃhṛṣṭāḥ svāśramaṃ paramaṃ mudā \|\| 56 \|\|*

*śivaśca tapase śīghraṃ paripūrṇatamo yayau \|\| 57 \|\|*

53-57. His two sons named Dharmadhvaja and Kusadhvaja who were quite illustrious, have also died because of the curse of Surya. Deprived of all the riches they have been devoid of their kingdom. Therefore when goddess Lakshmi incarnates in the form of their wives, both the princes would regain their lost grace. О Shiva, your devotee has already met with his end. Therefore you can leave this place. О gods, you can also revert to your respective places. Thus speaking lord Vishnu left the assembly with Laks nil and reached the inner apartments. All the gods were delighted fully and reverted to their respective places. Thereafter lord Shiva also left the place for performing tapas.

## Chapter 14

## \|\| 14.1 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*lakṣmīṃ tau ca samārādhya cogreṇa tapasā mune \|*  
*pratyekaṃ varamiṣṭaṃ ca saṃprāpaturabhīpsitam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said — О sage, both Dharmadhvaja and Kusadhvaja performed severe tapas for Laks ml and achieved their desired boons.

## \|\| 14.2 \|\|

*mahālakṣmyā vareṇaiva tau pṛdhvīśau babhūvatuḥ \|*  
*dhanavantau putravantau dharmadhvajakuśadhvajau \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. With the boon of Maha-Lakshmi both Dharmadhvaja and Kusadhvaja received all the riches and sons.

## \|\| 14.3-4 \|\|

*kuśadhvajasya patnī ca devī mālāvatī satī \|*  
*sā suṣāva ca kālena kamalāṃśāṃ sutāṃ satīm \|\| 3 \|\|*

*sā ca bhūtalasambandhājjñānayuktā babhūva ha \|*  
*kṛtvā vedadhvaniṃ spaṣṭamuttasthau sūtikāgṛhe \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. After the passage of the some time the chaste wife of Kushadhvaja named Malavati gave birth to a daughter who had the ray of Lakshmi in her. On appearing on earth, she was bestowed with all knowledge. At the very birth of the daughter the labour room was echoed with the reciting of the Vedic hymns and she at once got up.

## \|\| 14.5-9 \|\|

*vedadhvaniṃ sā cakāra jātamātreṇa kanyakā \|*  
*tasmāttāṃ te vedavatīṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*jātamātreṇa susnātā jagāma tapase vanam \|*  
*sarvairniṣiddhā yatnena nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ekamanvantaraṃ caiva puṣkare ca tapasvinī \|*  
*atyugrāṃ vai tapasyāṃ tu līlayā ca cakāra sā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tathā'pi puṣṭā na kṛśā navayauvanasaṃyutā \|*  
*śuśrāva khe ca sahasā sā vācamaśarīriṇīm \|\| 8 \|\|*

*janmāntare te bharttā ca bhaviṣyati hariḥ svayam \|*  
*brahmādibhirdurārādhyaṃ patiṃ lapsyasi sundari \|\| 9 \|\|*

5-9. Therefore people called her by the name of Vedavati, after her birth she took a bath properly and at once proceeded to the forest inspite of the people of the country opposing her. She did not listen and being a devotee of Narayana went to the forest and performed tapas. Though the ascetic lady performed tapas in the Puskara region for a manvantara, yet she was not reduced in her strength but her strength remained stable and she continued to be well-built and youthful. Suddenly she heard a divine voice from the sky. “O beautiful one, after many births you will get lord Vishnu as your husband. The one who is beyond the reach of the gods like Brahma and others will surely be your husband.”

## \|\| 14.10 \|\|

*iti śrutvā tu sā ruṣṭā cakāra ca punastapaḥ \|*  
*atīva nirjanasthāne parvate gandhamādane \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. On hearing this she got annoyed and she went to Gandhamadana mountain and started performing tapas at a lonely place.

## \|\| 14.11 \|\|

*tatraivaṃ suciraṃ taptvā viśvasya samuvāsa sā \|*  
*dadarśa puratastatra rāvaṇaṃ durnivāraṇam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. She performed tapas at that place for a long lime but once she had an encounter with the terrific demon Ravana.

## \|\| 14.12-13 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā sā'tithibhaktyā ca pādyaṃ tasmai dadau kila \|*  
*susvādu phalamūlaṃ ca jalaṃ cāpi suśītalam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tacca bhuktvā sa pāpiṣṭhaścāvātsīttatsamīpataḥ \|*  
*cakāra praśnamiti tāṃ kā tvaṃ kalyāṇi ceti ca \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. On his arrival before her, she offered him the customary welcome besides sweet fruits and cold water. After consuming everything Ravana remained there and ask her, “O beautiful one, who are you”'?

## \|\| 14.14-15 \|\|

*tāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā varārohāṃ pīnonnatapayodharām \|*  
*śaratpadmanibhāsyāṃ ca sasmitāṃ sudatīṃ satīm \|\| 14 \|\|*

*mūrcchāmavāpa kṛpaṇaḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ \|*  
*tāṃ kareṇa samākṛṣya sambhogaṃ kartumudyataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. The beautiful and chaste lady was having round and stiff breasts and a face like the lotus of the winter season. She wore a serene smile on her face, her teeth were attractive. Finding that Ravana was getting passionate she fainted. He then pulled the chaste lady towards him with evil intention.(14-1

## \|\| 14.16 \|\|

*sā satī kopadṛṣṭyā ca stambhitaṃ taṃ cakāra ha \|*  
*sa jaḍo hastapādaiśca kiṃcidvaktuṃ na ca kṣamaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Finding him so misbehaving, the chaste lady made him stand still and he became motionless. He was unable to move his hand nor could he speak anything.

## \|\| 14.17 \|\|

*tuṣṭāva manasā devīṃ padmāṃśāṃ padmalocanām \|*  
*sā tatstavena santuṣṭā prākṛtaṃ taṃ mumoca ha \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Thereafter he offered prayers to the lady mentally who was born of the rays of Lakshmi. Getting pleased with his prayers the damsel released him.

## \|\| 14.18 \|\|

*śaśāpa ca madarthe tvaṃ vinaśyasi sabāndhavaḥ \|*  
*spṛṣṭā'haṃ ca tvayā kāmādvisṛjāmyavalokaya \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Thereafter she pronounced a curse on him, “You will be completely destroyed because of me since you have touched me with evil intentions. I am, therefore, ending my life here before you.”

## \|\| 14.19-22 \|\|

*ityuktvā sā ca yogena dehatyāgaṃ cakāra ha \|*  
*gaṃgāyāṃ tāṃ ca saṃnyasya sva gṛhaṃ rāvaṇo yayau \|\| 19 \|\|*

*aho kimadbhutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ vā mayā'dhunā \|*  
*iti saṃcintya saṃsmṛtya vilalāpa punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*sā ca kālāntare sādhvī babhūva janakātmajā \|*  
*sītādevīti vikhyātā yadarthe rāvaṇo hataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*mahātapasvinī sā ca tapasā pūrvajanmanaḥ \|*  
*lebhe rāmaṃ ca bharttāraṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ harim \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. Thus speaking with the applications of the Yogic practices, she burnt her body. Thereafter Ravana said: “What a surprise have I met with today? What type of an evil act did I perform?” Thus thinking Ravana started repenting again and again. The chaste lady in due course of time was born in the house of Janaka as a result of which Ravana was killed. The chaste lady in earlier times performed tapas as a result of which she got llama as her husband.

## \|\| 14.23-24 \|\|

*saṃprāpya tapasā''rādhya svāminaṃ ca jagatpatim \|*  
*sā ramā suciraṃ reme rāmeṇa saha sundarī \|\| 23 \|\|*

*jātismarā sma smarati tapasaśca kramaṃ purā \|*  
*sukhena tajjahau sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ cāpi sukhaṃ labhet \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. The beautiful damsel perfonned tapas for Rama and getting him she served him for a long time, enjoying his company. She remembered the events of her earlier birth but she did not mind the difficulties she had to face for performing tapas. Keeping in view her present pleasure she forgot about her earlier troubles.

## \|\| 14.25-26 \|\|

*nānāprakāravibhavaṃ cakāra suciraṃ satī \|*  
*samprāpya sukumāraṃ tamatīva navayauvanam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*guṇinaṃ rasikaṃ śāntaṃ kāntaveṣamanuttamam \|*  
*strīṇāṃ manojñaṃ ruciraṃ tathā lebhe yathepsitam \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Achieving Rama as her husband, who was quite tender, youthful, virtuous, passionate, peaceful, extremely beautiful, attractive to the females, Vedavati enjoyed many of the worldly pleasures with him for a long time.

## \|\| 14.27 \|\|

*piturvacaḥpālanārthaṃ satyasandho raghūttamaḥ \|*  
*jagāma kānanaṃ paścātkālena ca balīyasā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The truthful Rama who was the best king of the race of Raghu, honouring the words of his father went to the forest.

## \|\| 14.28 \|\|

*tasthau samudranikaṭe sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca \|*  
*dadarśa tatra vahniṃ ca viprarūpadharaṃ hariḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Thereafter with the moves of the destiny, Rama stayed near the oceans with Sita and Laks mana. There, lord Rama met with Agni who had taken to the form of a Brahma.

## \|\| 14.29 \|\|

*taṃ rāmaṃ duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa ca duḥkhī babhūva ha \|*  
*uvāca kiṃcitsatyeṣṭaṃ satyaṃ satyaparāyaṇaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Finding Rama in a melancholy mood his heart was moved. Being truthful and a lover of truth, he spoke to Rama, who indeed was the form of truth.

## \|\| 14.30-31 \|\|

*vahniruvāca \|*  
*bhagavañchrūyatāṃ vākyaṃ kālena yadupasthitam \|*  
*sītāharaṇakālo'yaṃ tavaiva samupasthitaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*daivaṃ ca durnivāryyaṃ vai na ca daivātparaṃ balam \|*  
*matprasū mayi saṃnyasya cchāyāṃ rakṣāntike'dhunā \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. Agni said — You kindly listen to my words. The time for the abduction of Sita is drawing nearer. The moves of the destiny are sometimes cruel and one cannot escape from them. The destiny is always powerful; therefore you entrust the care of mother Sita to me and in her place you keep her shadow with you.

## \|\| 14.32 \|\|

*dāsyāmi sītāṃ tubhyaṃ ca parīkṣāsamaye punaḥ \|*  
*devaiḥ prasthāpito'haṃ ca na ca vipro hutāśanaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. I shall return her to you at the time of the fire ordeal. The gods have entrusted this job to me. I am not a Brahmana but I am the god of fire.”

## \|\| 14.33 \|\|

*rāmastadvacanaṃ śrutvā na prakāśya ca lakṣmaṇam \|*  
*svacchandaṃ svīcakārāsau hṛdayena vidūyatā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. On hearing this, Rama without disclosing anything to Laksmana, with a painful heart agreed to the proposal.

## \|\| 14.34 \|\|

*vahniryogena sītāvanmāyāsītāṃ cakāra ha \|*  
*tattulyaguṇarūpāṃ tāṃ dadau rāmāya nārada \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. О Narada, the god of fire then at once created an illusory Sita who resembled the real Sita in all respects. He then entrusted the care of the shadow Sita to Rama.

## \|\| 14.35-36 \|\|

*sītāṃ gṛhītvā sa yayau gopyaṃ vaktuṃ niṣedhya ca \|*  
*lakṣmaṇo naiva bubudhe gopyamanyasya kā kathā \|\| 35\|\|*

*etasminnantare rāmo dadarśa kanakaṃ mṛgam \|*  
*sītā taṃ prerayāmāsa tadarthe yatnapūrvakam \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. Soon after that, the Brahmana left the place along with Sita asking Rama not to disclose the secret to anyone. That is why this secret remained unknown to Laksmana even, what to speak of others. In the meantime Rama spotted the golden deer and Sita desired Rama to get it by following it.

## \|\| 14.37 \|\|

*saṃnyasya lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmo jānakyā rakṣaṇe vane \|*  
*svayaṃ jagāma hantuṃ taṃ vivyadhe sāyakena ca \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Lord Rama entrusted the care of JanakI to Laksmana and he himself went after the deer in the forest and he killed it with his arrow.

## \|\| 14.38 \|\|

*lakṣmaṇeti ca śabdaṃ vai kṛtvā māyāmṛgastadā \|*  
*prāṇāṃstatyāja sahasā puro dṛṣṭvā hariṃ smaran \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. While meeting its death, the deer cried aloud, “O Laksmana”. Thus crying, finding Rama before him and remembering Laksmana he met with his death.

## \|\| 14.39 \|\|

*mṛgarūpaṃ parityajya divyarūpaṃ vidhāya ca \|*  
*ratnanirmitayānena vaikuṇṭhaṃ sa jagāma ha \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Discarding the body of the deer, he achieved the divine form and proceeded on to Vaikuntha mounted on a divine plane studded with gems.

## \|\| 14.40 \|\|

*vaikuṇṭhasya mahādvāraṃ kiṅkaro dvārapālayoḥ \|*  
*jaya vijayayoścaiva balavāṃśca jayābhidhaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. On the gate-way of the Vaikunta, there were two gate-keepers by name of Jaya and Vijaya. In the both Jaya was very powerful.

## \|\| 14.41 \|\|

*śāpena sanakādīnāṃ samprāpto rākṣasīṃ tanum \|*  
*punarjagāma taddvāramādau sa dvārapālayoḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Because of the curse of Sanaka and Sanatana, he was turned into a demon but he again got back his original position.

## \|\| 14.42 \|\|

*atha śabdaṃ ca sā śrutvā lakṣmaṇeti ca viklavam \|*  
*sītā taṃ prerayāmāsa lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmasannidhau \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Thereafter Sita hearing the cry calling for Laks mana, asked him to go in search of Rama.

## \|\| 14.43 \|\|

*gate ca lakṣmaṇe rāmaṃ rāvaṇo durnivāraṇaḥ \|*  
*sītāṃ gṛhītvā prayayau laṅkāmeva svalīlayā \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. After Laksmana left the place in search of Rama, the wicked Ravana with the application of his illusion kidnapped JanakI and proceeded towards Lanka.

## \|\| 14.44-45 \|\|

*viṣasāda ca rāmaśca vane dṛṣṭvā ca lakṣmaṇam \|*  
*tūrṇaṃ ca svāśramaṃ gatvā sītāṃ naiva dadarśa saḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*mūrcchāṃ samprāpya suciraṃ vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*punarbabhrāma gahane tadanveṣaṇapūrvakam \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. Finding Laksmana in the forest, the mind of Rama was disturbed and he fainted. Thereafter, he at once went back to his abode with Laks mana and finding Sita missing from the hermitage, he continued lamenting for a long lime. Thereafter they started wandering in the forest in search of Sita.

## \|\| 14.46-47 \|\|

*kāle saṃprāpya tadvārtāṃ gṛdhadvārā nadītaṭe \|*  
*sahāyaṃ vānaraṃ kṛtvā cābadhnātsāgaraṃ hariḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*laṅkāṃ gatvā raghuśreṣṭhaścāvadhītsāyakena ca \|*  
*sabāndhavaṃ rāvaṇaṃ ca sītāṃ samprāpa duḥkhitām \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. After some time they met with Jatayu at the bank of Godavari who conveyed the news to them about JanakI. Thereafter, with the help of the monkeys they reached Lanka, constructing a bridge over the ocean. Reaching Lanka, Rama killed Ravana together with his entire family and friends. He got back the grief-stricken Sita.

## \|\| 14.48 \|\|

*tāṃ ca vahniparīkṣāṃ va kārayāmāsa satvaram \|*  
*hutāśanastatra kāle vāstavīṃ jānakīṃ dadau \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Soon thereafter he made Sita to perform the fire-ordeal when the god Agni himself appeared out of the fire and handed over the real Sita to lord Rama.

## \|\| 14.49 \|\|

*chāyā covāca vahniṃ ca rāmaṃ ca vinayānvitā \|*  
*kariṣyāmīti kimahaṃ tadupāyaṃ vadasva me \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Thereafter the shadow Sita meekly stood there. And asked both Rama, Agni “What should I do now you tell me”?

## \|\| 14.50 \|\|

*vahniruvāca \|*  
*tvaṃ gaccha tapase devi puṣkaraṃ ca supuṇyadam \|*  
*kṛtvā tapasyāṃ tatraiva svargalakṣmīrbhaviṣyasi \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Agni said — О goddess you go to the sacred region of Pusakara and perform tapas there. By doing so, you will become Laksm! of the heaven.

## \|\| 14.51-52 \|\|

*sā ca tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratepe puṣkare tapaḥ \|*  
*divyaṃ trilakṣavarṣa ca svarge lakṣmīrbabhūva ha \|\| 51 \|\|*

*sā ca kālena tapasā yajñakuṇḍasamudbhavā \|*  
*kāminī pāṇḍavānāṃ ca draupadī drupadātmajā \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. On hearing the words of Agni, she performed great tapas for divine three lakhs of years and thereafter she went to heaven. Again after emerging from the fire-altar, she became the daughter of Drupada and was known as Draupadi and became the wife of the five Pandavas.

## \|\| 14.53-54 \|\|

*kṛte yuge vedavatī kuśadhvajasutā śubhā \|*  
*tretāyāṃ rāmapatnī ca sīteti janakātmajā \|\| 53 \|\|*

*tacchāyā draupadī devī dvāpare drupadātmajā \|*  
*trihāyaṇīti sā proktā vidyamānā yugatraye \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. Thus in the krtayuga Vedavati happened to be the daughter of Kushadhvaja, she became the daughter of Janaka known as Sita in the tretayuga and became the wife of Rama. In the Dvapara that shadow Sita emerged from the firc-altcr as Draupadi. Because she remain present m all the three yugas she is known as Trihavanl.

## \|\| 14.55 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*priyāḥ pañca kathaṃ tasyā babhūvurmunipuṅgava \|*  
*iti vai cittasandehaṃ dūrīkuru mahāprabho \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Narada said — О great lord, how did Draupadi get five husbands. You kindly remove this doubt of my mind.

## \|\| 14.56 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*laṅkāyāṃ vastutaḥ sītā rāmaṃ saṃprāpa nārada \|*  
*rūpayauvanasampannā chāyā sā bahuvihvalā \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Narayana said — О Nerada, after Rama got back the real Sita in Lanka, the youthful shadow Sita was upset.

## \|\| 14.57-58 \|\|

*rāmāgnyorājñayā taptvā yayāce śaṅkaraṃ varam \|*  
*kāmāturā pativyagrā prārthayantī punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi trilocana \|*  
*patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi pañcavāraṃ pativratā \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. Thereafter at the command of Rama and Agni she performed tapas and with the blessings of Shiva and she begged Shiva for her husband. She repeated this desire five times.

## \|\| 14.59 \|\|

*śivastatprārthanāṃ śrutvā sasmito rasikeśvaraḥ \|*  
*priye tava priyāḥ pañca bhavantīti varaṃ dadau \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Lord Shiva smiled on hearing to her request and said: “O dear you will get five husbands."

## \|\| 14.60 \|\|

*tenāsītpāṇḍavānāṃ ca pañcānāṃ kāminī priyā \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ prastutaṃ vastutaḥ śṛṇu \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Therefore she became the wife of five Pandavas. I have told you the broad out lines and now listen to me about the details.

## \|\| 14.61 \|\|

*atha saṃprāpya laṅkāyāṃ sītāṃ rāmo manoharām \|*  
*vibhīṣaṇāya tāṃ laṅkāṃ dattvā'yodhyāṃ yayau punaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. After getting back the charming Sita, Rama entrusted the care of Lanka to Vibhisana and returned to Ayodhya.

## \|\| 14.62 \|\|

*ekādaśasahasrābdaṃ kṛtvā rājyaṃ ca bhārate \|*  
*jagāma sarvairlokaiśca sārddhaṃ vaikuṇṭhameva ca \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. He ruled in Bharata for eleven thousand years, enjoying all the royal pleasures and thereafter he proceeded on to Vaikuntha to all his people.

## \|\| 14.63 \|\|

*kamalāṃśā vedavatī kamalāyāṃ viveśa sā \|*  
*kathitaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ puṇyadaṃ pāpanāśanam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. And Vedavati who was born of the rays of Lakshmi entered into the body of Lakshmi. Thus you have listened to the divine story which removes sins and grants merits.

## \|\| 14.64 \|\|

*satataṃ mūrtimantaśca vedāścatvāra eva ca \|*  
*santi yasyāśca jihvāgre sā ca vedavatī smṛtā \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. She was called Vedavati because all the four Vedas resided at the tip of her tongue in everytime.

## \|\| 14.65 \|\|

*kuśadhvajasutākhyānamuktaṃ saṃkṣepatastava \|*  
*dharmadhvajasutākhyānaṃ nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Thus I have narrated in detail the story of the daughter of Kushadhvaja. Now you listen to the story of the daughter of Dharmadhvaja.

## Chapter 15

## \|\| 15.1-3 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*dharmadhvajasya patnī ca mādhavīti ca viśrutā \|*  
*nṛpeṇa sārddhaṃ sā rāgādreme vai gandhamādane \|\| 1 \|\|*

*śayyāṃ ratikarīṃkṛtvā puṣpacandanacarcitā \|*  
*candanokṣitasarvāṅgī puṣpacandanavāyunā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*strīratnamaticārvaṃgī ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā \|*  
*kāmukī rasikaśreṣṭhā rasikeśena saṃgatā \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Narayana said — The wife of kind Dharmadhvaja was known as Madhavi and was enjoying the company of her husband with pleasure at the Gandhamadana mountain. She always enjoyed the company of her husband, decorating herself with all the ornaments, applying sandal-paste all over her limbs and arranging the beds with flowers and sandal-paste, getting adorned with all the ornaments. They always got themselves engaged in love-sports and were never separated from each other.

## \|\| 15.4 \|\|

*suratādviratirnāsīttayoḥ suratavijñayoḥ \|*  
*gataṃ varṣaśataṃ daivaṃ nājānītāṃ divāniśam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Thus a period of hundred divine years passed, while they enjoyed each other's company, they could not remain conscious of the day and night.

## \|\| 15.5 \|\|

*tato rajasvalāṃ prāpya suratādvirarāma saḥ \|*  
*kāmukī sundarī kiṃcinna ca tṛptiṃ jagāma sā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Thereafter the king became conscious and freed himself from the worldly pleasures, but the damsel was not satisfied. Thereafter the chaste lady conceived for the divine hundred years. Because of her conceiving a ray of Lakshmi entered in her womb and her glory went on increasing day by day.

## \|\| 15.6-9 \|\|

*dadhāra garbhaṃ sā sadyo devābdaśatakaṃ satī \|*  
*śrīgarbhā śrīyutā sā ca saṃbabhūva dinedine \|\| 6 \|\|*

*śubhakṣaṇe śubhadine śubhayogena saṃyute \|*  
*śubhalagne śubhāṃśe ca śubhasvāmigṛhānvite \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ ca sitavāre ca padmaje \|*  
*suṣāva sā ca padmāṃśāṃ padminīṃ sumanoharām \|\| 8 \|\|*

*pādapadmayuge caiva padmarāgavirājitām \|*  
*rājarājeśvarīṃ lakṣmīṃ sarvāvayavasundarīm \|\| 9 \|\|*

6-9. Thereafter in an auspicious occasion and auspicious lagna, a daughter was born to her from the rays of Lakshmi and was known by the name of Padmini. Both her feet were imprinted with auspicious signs including the lotuses. All her limbs were quite beautiful and she looked like the supreme goddess Lakshmi.

## \|\| 15.10-11 \|\|

*rājalakṣmīlakṣmayuktāṃ rājalakṣmyadhidevatām \|*  
*śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanām \|\| 10 \|\|*

*pakvabimbādharoṣṭhīṃ ca paśyantīṃ sasmitāṃ gṛham \|*  
*hastapādatalāraktāṃ nimnanābhiṃ manoramām \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. She had all the signs of royal grace and she looked like Lakshmi herself. Her face resembled that of the full moon of the winter season, the eyes resembled the lotus flowers of the winter season and the lips resembled the ripe wood-apples. While wearing a smile on her face, she was looking around her palace. The soles of the feet and the palms of the girl were red and the navel was quite deep.

## \|\| 15.12-15 \|\|

*tadadhastrivalīyuktāṃ vṛttavalgunitambinīm \|*  
*śīte sukhoṣṇasarvāṃgīṃ grīṣme ca sukhaśītalām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*śyāmāṃ sukeśīṃ rucirāṃ nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalām \|*  
*śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ sundarīṣvekasundarīm \|\| 13 \|\|*

*narā nāryyaśca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tulanāṃ dātumakṣamāḥ \|*  
*tena nāmnā ca tulasīṃ tāṃ vadanti purāvidaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sā ca bhūmiṣṭhamātreṇa yogyā strīprakṛtiryathā \|*  
*sarvairniṣiddhā tapase jagāma badarīvanam \|\| 15 \|\|*

12-15. She wore three lines over the belly and she had the round breasts which looked quite beautiful; all her limbs remained warm to provide pleasure during the winter season while during the summer, her limbs remained cool. She always looked like a damsel of sixteen years. Her beautiful hair was so thick that it appeared as if the snakes had surrounded the banyan tree. She had a yellowish complexion and the people were unable to compare her beauty while looking at her. Therefore the wise people gave her the name of Tulasi. As soon as she appeared on earth she looked like the goddess Prakriti herself. She went to perform tapas in Badrikasrama much against the wishes of the people.

## \|\| 15.16 \|\|

*tatra daivābdalakṣaṃ ca cakāra paramaṃ tapaḥ \|*  
*mama nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī bhaviteti viniścitā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. She desired that she should have Narayana as her husband. With this resolve in her mind she performed tapas for a lakh of divine years.

## \|\| 15.17 \|\|

*grīṣme pañcatapāḥ śīte toyasthā sā ca sundarī \|*  
*prakāśasthā vṛṣṭidhārāṃ sahantī ca divāniśam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. She used to have five types of fire around her during the summer. Sometimes she remained in water and during the rainy season she performed tapas under the open sky bearing the force of the rain water. Thus she performed the tapas.

## \|\| 15.18-19 \|\|

*viṃśatsahasravarṣaṃ ca phalatoyāśanā ca sā \|*  
*triṃśacchatasahasrābdaṃ patrāhārā tapasvinī \|\| 18 \|\|*

*catvāriṃśatsahasrābdaṃ vāyvāhārā kṛśodarī \|*  
*tato daśasahasrābdaṃ nirāhārā babhūva sā \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. For twenty years she lived only on fruit and water. Thereafter for thirty years she lived on tree leaves and for forty years she lived only by inhaling air. For ten thousand years the tender-waisted damsel performed tapas without taking any food.

## \|\| 15.20 \|\|

*nirlakṣyāṃ caikapādasthāṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ kamalodbhavaḥ \|*  
*samāyayau varaṃ dātuṃ paraṃ badarikāśramam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Thereafter she performed tapas standing on one leg. Finding her so performing tapas, Brahma arrived in Badrikasrama.

## \|\| 15.21 \|\|

*caturmukhaṃ ca sā dṛṣṭvā prāṇaṃsīddhaṃsavāhanam \|*  
*tāmuvāca jagatkartā vidhātā jagatāmapi \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. He was mounted on a goose having four anns and four heads. She bowed in reverence before Brahma. Thereafter Brahma, the creator of the world, told her.

## \|\| 15.22 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*varaṃ vṛṇuṣva tulasi yatte manasi vāñchitam \|*  
*haribhaktiṃ ca muktiṃ vā'pyajarāmaratāmapi \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Brahma said — “O Tulasi, you ask for any boon you want to achieve like the devotion of the lord, salvation or becoming immortal. You ask for any thing you want.”

## \|\| 15.23 \|\|

*tulasyuvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu tāta pravakṣyāmi yanme manasi vāñchitam \|*  
*sarvajñasyāpi purataḥ kā lajjā mama sāmpratam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Tulasi said — О respectable one, I disclose the desire of my mind before you which you kindly listen'to. You know everything. Therefore why should 1 feel shy before you?

## \|\| 15.24 \|\|

*ahaṃ ca tulasī gopī goloke'haṃ sthitā purā \|*  
*kṛṣṇapriyā kiṅkarī ca tadaṃśā tatsakhī priyā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. In the earlier times I was a cowherdesses named Tulasi and was the beloved of lord Krishna. I was his beloved as well as his servant.

## \|\| 15.25-26 \|\|

*govindena sahāsaktāmatṛptāṃ māṃ ca mūrcchitām \|*  
*rāseśvarī samāgatya cāpaśyadrāsamaṇḍale \|\| 25 \|\|*

*govindaṃ bhartsayāmāsa māṃ śaśāpa ruṣā'nvitā \|*  
*yāhi tvaṃ mānavīṃ yonimityevaṃ ca pitāmaha \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Once when I was dancing with lord Govinda, I became passionate and before getting satisfaction I fainted. At that point of time Radha the great goddess arrived there and she saw everything. Getting annoyed she denounced the lord Govinda and pronounced a curse on me to be born in a human family.

## \|\| 15.27 \|\|

*māmuvāca sa govindo madaṃśaṃ tvaṃ caturbhujam \|*  
*labhiṣyasi tapastaptvā bhārate brahmaṇo varāt \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. O grandfather, at that point of time lord Govinda told me that by performing tapas in Bharata I would achieve a boon from Brahma in order to seek four-armed Vishnu as my husband.

## \|\| 15.28 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā deveśo'pyantardhānamavāpa saḥ \|*  
*devyā bhiyā tanuṃ tyaktvā labdhaṃ janma mayā bhuvi \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Thus speaking, the lord disappeared and terrified from of goddess Radhika my life came to an end. I have been reborn on the earth.

## \|\| 15.29 \|\|

*ahaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ śāntaṃ sundavigraham \|*  
*sāmprataṃ labdhumicchāmi varamevaṃ ca dehi me \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. I am desirous of getting lord Narayana as my husband who is peaceful and has a beautiful body. You kindly grant me this boon.”

## \|\| 15.30 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*sudāmā nāma gopaśca śrīkṛṣṇāṅgasamudbhavaḥ \|*  
*tadaṃśaścātitejasvī cālabhajjanma bhārate \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Brahma said — A cowherd named Sudama who was born of the ray of lord Krishna has been born on earth. He happens to be quite illustrious.

## \|\| 15.31 \|\|

*sāmprataṃ rādhikāśāpāddanuvaṃśasamudbhavaḥ \|*  
*śaṅkhacūḍa iti khyātastrailākye na ca tatparaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Now, by the curse of Radhika, he is born in the race of demons by the name of SamkhacOda. No one can equal him in the world.

## \|\| 15.32 \|\|

*goloke tvāṃ purā dṛṣṭvā kāmonmathitamānasaḥ \|*  
*vilaṃghituṃ na śaknoti rādhikāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. He became passionate in the Goloka while looking at you but he could not transgress the rules because of the influence of Radhika.

## \|\| 15.33 \|\|

*sa ca jātismarastaptvā tvāṃ lalābha vareṇa ca \|*  
*jātismarā tu tvamapi sarvaṃ jānāsi sundari \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. О beautiful one, he is well aware of the happenings of the earlier birth. Therefore by performing tapas he has already got you as a boon. Because of your belonging to the same base you also know him.

## \|\| 15.34 \|\|

*adhunā tasya patnī ca bhava bhāvini śobhane \|*  
*paścānnārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ śāntameva labhiṣyasi \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Therefore, О beautiful one, you accept him as your husband and thereafter you will achieve the peaceful and glorious lord Narayana.

## \|\| 15.35-36 \|\|

*śāpānnārāyaṇasyaiva kalayā daivayogataḥ \|*  
*prāpnoṣi vṛkṣarūpaṃ taṃ tvaṃ pūtā viśvapāvanī \|\| 35 \|\|*

*pradhānā sarvapuṣpāṇāṃ viṣṇuprāṇādhikā bhavet \|*  
*tvayā vinā ca sarveṣāṃ pūjā ca viphalā bhavet \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. As a move of the destiny, you will remain on the earth in the form of a tree with the curse of Narayana and will purify the entire universe. You will be considered to be the best of all the flowers and lord Vishnu will treat you dearer than his life. Without you, the adoration of lord Vishnu will be considered to be of no consequence.

## \|\| 15.37 \|\|

*vṛndāvane vṛkṣarūpā nāmnā vṛndāvanīti ca \|*  
*tvatpatrairgopikā gopāḥ pūjayiṣyanti mādhavam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Because of your taking to the form of a tree in Vrindavana and the cowherds and cowherdesscs will adore lord Krishna offering your leaves.

## \|\| 15.38 \|\|

*vṛkṣādhidevīrūpeṇa sārddhaṃ kṛṣṇena santatam \|*  
*vihariṣyasi gopena svacchandaṃ madvareṇa ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Because of being the goddess of the trees, you will keep company with lord Krishna and because of my boon you will enjoy the company of that cowherd.”

## \|\| 15.39 \|\|

*ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sasmitā hṛṣṭamānasā \|*  
*praṇanāma ca dhātāraṃ taṃ ca kiṃciduvāca ha \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Hearing this she smiled and with a delightful mind she offered her salutation to Brahma and said to him.

## \|\| 15.40 \|\|

*tulatyuvāca \|*  
*yathā me dvibhuje kṛṣṇe vāñchā ca śyāmasundare \|*  
*satyaṃ bravīmi he tāta na tathā ca caturbhuje \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Tulasi said — О respectable one, I am speaking out the truth. The type of devotion I have in the two-armed dark complexioned Krishna, I could never have for the four-armed Vishnu.

## \|\| 15.41 \|\|

*atṛptā'haṃ ca govinde daivācchṛṅgārabhaṃgataḥ \|*  
*govindasyaiva vacanātprārthayāmi caturbhujam \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. As a move of destiny I could not derive full satisfaction from the company of lord Krishna but I am praying for the four-armed Vishnu only on his advice.

## \|\| 15.42 \|\|

*tatprasādena govindaṃ punareva sudurlabham \|*  
*dhruvameva labhiṣyāmi rādhā bhītiṃ pramocaya \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. By your grace I shall surely get the company of lord Krishna. But you kindly relieve me of the fear of Radhika.

## \|\| 15.43-44 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*gṛhāṇa rādhikāmantraṃ dade vai ṣoḍaśākṣaram \|*  
*tasyāśca prāṇatulyā tvaṃ madvareṇa bhaviṣyasi \|\| 43 \|\|*

*śṛṃgāraṃ yuvayorgopyamājñāsyati ca rādhikā \|*  
*rādhāsamā tvaṃ subhagā govindasya bhaviṣyasi \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. Brahma said — I bestow on you the sixteen letter mantra of Radhika. You receive it. Because of the influence of that mantra and by the grace of my boon, you will become dearer to him than his life. Radhika herself will permit you both to decorate yourself in seclusion and you will become the beloved of lord Govinda like Radhika herself.

## \|\| 15.45 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā dattvā ca devyai tatṣoḍaśākṣaram \|*  
*mantraṃ tasyai jagaddhātā stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ param \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Thus speaking Brahma the creator of the universe bestowed the knowledge of the sixteen latter mantra, the stotra and the best of kavacha to Tulasi.

## \|\| 15.46-47 \|\|

*sarvaṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca puraścaryāvidhikramam \|*  
*paraṃ śubhāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā so'ntarddhānamavāpa ha \|\| 46 \|\|*

*sā ca brahmopadeśena puṇye badarikāśrame \|*  
*jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ yadiṣṭaṃ pūrvajanmanaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. Thereafter the entire method of adoration, the performing of all the rites in due consequence and the showering of his blessing on her, Brahma disappeared. Thereafter Tulasi, as per the advice of Brahma reached the sacred place of Badrikasrama and started reciting the mantra known to her in her earlier birth.

## \|\| 15.48 \|\|

*divyaṃ dvādaśavarṣaṃ ca pūjāṃ caiva cakāra sā \|*  
*babhūva siddhā sā devī tatpratyādeśamāpa ca \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. She attained success after performing tapas for twelve years. Thereafter, she received the divine command.

## \|\| 15.49 \|\|

*siddhe tapasi mantre ca varaṃ prāpya yathepsitam \|*  
*bubhuje ca mahābhāgaṃ yadviśveṣu sudurlabham \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. After meeting with success in the performing of tapas and the reciting of mantra, she achieved the desired boon which bestows the merit which is otherwise difficult to achieve.

## \|\| 15.50 \|\|

*prasannamānasā devī tatyāja tapasaḥ klamam \|*  
*siddhe phale narāṇāṃ ca duḥkhaṃ ca sukhamuttamam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. All the troubles for performing tapas were borne by her with pleasure which were ultimately removed because after meeting with success, the miseries faced by a person are turned into pleasure.

## \|\| 15.51 \|\|

*bhuktvā pītvā ca santuṣṭā śayanaṃ ca cakāra sā \|*  
*talpe manorame tatra puṣpacandanacarcite \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Therefore she also getting satisfied with food and drinks, enjoyed the bed with fragrant flowers and sandal-paste.

## Chapter 16

## \|\| 16.1-2 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*tulasī parituṣṭā sā cāsvāpsīddhṛṣṭamānasā \|*  
*navayauvanasampannā praśaṃsantī varāṃganā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*cikṣepa pañcabāṇaśca pañca bāṇāṃśca tāṃ prati \|*  
*puṣpāyudhena sā dagdhā puṣpacandanacarcitā \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said — At the time when the youthful and beautiful Tulasi, with a peaceful and happy mind, was sleeping on the decorated bed, the god of love attacked her with five of his arrows, as a result of which she started burning with passion, inspite of her enjoying the paste of sandal and the flowers.

## \|\| 16.3-5 \|\|

*pulakāñcitasarvāṃgī kampitā raktalocanā \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ sā śuṣkatāṃ prāpa kṣaṇaṃ mūrcchāmavāpa ha \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kṣaṇamudvignatāṃ prāpa kṣaṇaṃ tandrāṃ sukhāvahām \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ sā dahanaṃ prāpa kṣaṇaṃ prāpa pramattatām \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kṣaṇaṃ sā cetanāṃ prāpa kṣaṇaṃ prāpa viṣaṇṇatām \|*  
*uttiṣṭhantī kṣaṇaṃ talpādgacchantī nikaṭaṃ kṣaṇam \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. All the hair of her body stood on end. She started shivering and her eyes became red. In a moment, she felt dryness; in an another moment, she fainted; in another moment she was excited; in a moment she felt fatigued.
