*tulasī ca jagatpūjyā pūtā nārāyaṇapriyā \|*  
*tasyāḥ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca stotraṃ kiṃ na śrutaṃ mayā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said — Tulasi is considered to be quite sacred and pious because of her being the beloved of Narayana. I am not aware of her stotra and the method of her worship. You kindly tell me all that.

## \|\| 22.2 \|\|

*kena pūjyā stutā kena purā prathamato mune \|*  
*tava pūjyā sā babhūva kena vā vada māmaho \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О sage, in the earlier times one adored the goddess Tulasi and offered prayers to her and how could she become adorable for you? You kindly tell me all this.

## \|\| 22.3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya garuḍadhvajaḥ \|*  
*kathāṃ kathitumārebhe puṇyarūpāṃ purātanīm \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Suta said — On hearing the words of Narada, Narayana smiled and started narrating the ancient story.

## \|\| 22.4 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*hariḥ saṃprāpya tulasīṃ reme ca ramayā saha \|*  
*ramāsamāṃ tāṃ saubhāgyāṃ cakāra gauraveṇa ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Narayana said — Lord Vishnu after getting Tulasi with him enjoyed her company and also bestowed on her the glory comparable to Lak'smI.

## \|\| 22.5 \|\|

*sehe lakṣmīśca gaṃgā ca tasyāśca navasaṃgamam \|*  
*saubhāgyaṃ gauravaṃ kopānna sehe ca sarasvatī \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The Ganga and Lakshmi gracefully welcomed the new company of Tulasi, with her fortune and glory but Sarasvati could not tolerate and was filled with anger.

## \|\| 22.6-7 \|\|

*sā tāṃ jaghāna kalahe māninī harisannidhau \|*  
*vrīḍayā svāpamānācca sā'ntarddhānaṃ cakāra ha \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sarvasiddheśvarī devī jñāninī siddhayoginī \|*  
*babhūvādarśanaṃ kopātsarvatra ca hareraho \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Thereafter both of them quarrelled in the presence of the lord and Sarasvati attacked Tulasi. Because of shame and her own disgrace Tulasi disappeared. Tulasi was full of knowledge and the goddess of all the goddesses besides being Siddhayoginl. Therefore she concealed herself from the eyes of the lord.

## \|\| 22.8 \|\|

*harirna dṛṣṭvā tulasīṃ bodhayitvā sarasvatīm \|*  
*tadanujñāṃ gṛhītvā ca jagāma tulasīvanam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The lord tried to convince Sarasvati with sweet words but finding Tulasi absent from the place, he went to the Tulasivana at the instance of Sarasvati.

## \|\| 22.9 \|\|

*tatra gatvā ca snātvā ca tulasyā tulasīṃ satīm \|*  
*pūjayāmāsa dhyātvā tāṃ stotraṃ bhaktyā cakāra ha \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Reaching there he took his bath and adored Tulasi with devotion composing a stotra in her favour.

## \|\| 22.10-11 \|\|

*lakṣmīmāyākāmavāṇībījapūrvaṃ daśākṣaram \|*  
*vṛndāvanīti ṅentaṃ ca vahnijāyāntameva ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

*śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ aiṃ vṛndāvanyai svāhā \|*  
*anena kalpataruṇā mantrarājena nārada \|*  
*pūjayecca vidhānena sarvasiddhiṃ labhennaraḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. The seed of Lakshmi, (ttf) the seed of illusion, fit") the seed of desire (4#) and the seed of speech is (T)-These should be recited first of all followed by the words VrindavanI and the word Svaha should be added at the end. The mantra thus formed would be … He then recited this mantra of ten letters. О Narada, this mantra happens to be a wishful-filling tree; the one who recites this mantra with devotion, meets with all success.

## \|\| 22.12-13 \|\|

*ghṛtadīpena dhūpena sinduracandanena ca \|*  
*naivedyena ca puṣpeṇa copahāreṇa nārada \|\| 12 \|\|*

*haristotreṇa tuṣṭā sā cāvirbhūya mahīruhāt \|*  
*prapannā caraṇāmbhoje jagāma śaraṇaṃ śubham \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. О Narada, one should bum the lamp of ghee and essence offering saffron, sandal-paste, eatables, flower garland and by performing puja one should recite the stolra of Tulasi. Thereafter getting pleased she appeared in the form of Tulasi tree and she took refuge under the feet of the lord.

## \|\| 22.14-15 \|\|

*varaṃ tasyai dadau viṣṇurjagatpūjyā bhaveti ca \|*  
*ahaṃ tvāṃ ca dhariṣyāmi svamūrdhni vakṣasīti ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sarve tvāṃ dhārayiṣyanti svayaṃ mūrdhni surādayaḥ \|*  
*ityuktvā tāṃ gṛhītvā ca prayayau svālayaṃ vibhuḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Lord Vishnu blessed her saying, “You will be adored by the world and I shall accept your leaf to be placed my head and chest. All the gods will bear you on their heads”. Thus speaking the lord took Tulasi with him.

## \|\| 22.16 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*kiṃ dhyānaṃ stavanaṃ kiṃ vā kiṃ vā pūjāvidhikramam \|*  
*tulasyāśca mahābhāga tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Narada said — О great lord, you kindly tell me the clliyanam, the stuti and the method of adoration of Tulasi.

## \|\| 22.17 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*antarhitāyāṃ tasyāṃ ca gatvā ca tulasīvanam \|*  
*hariḥ saṃpūjya tuṣṭāva tulasīṃ virahāturaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Narayana said — At the disappearance of goddess Tulasi, the lord went to the Tulasi-vana and expressing grief at her separation, he offered stuti tc her.

## \|\| 22.18 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*vṛndārūpāśca vṛkṣāśca yadaikatra bhavanti ca \|*  
*vidurbudhāstena vṛndāṃ matpriyāṃ tāṃ bhajā myaham \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The lord said — “When the trees collect in the form of Tulasi, my beloved is then called as Vmda by the intellectuals. I am serving her.

## \|\| 22.19 \|\|

*purā babhūva yā devī hyādau vṛndāvane vane \|*  
*tena vṛndāvanī khyātā tāṃ saubhāgyāṃ bhajāmyaham \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The goddess who appeared in the Vmdavana, was known by the name of VrindavanI I am serving such a fortunate goddess.

## \|\| 22.20 \|\|

*asaṃkhyeṣu ca viśveṣu pūjitā yā nirantaram \|*  
*tena viśvapūjitākhyāṃ jagatpūjyāṃ bhajāmyaham \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. She is adored in the innumerable globes earning her the title of Vishvapiijita, I am adoring the one who is adored by the universe.

## \|\| 22.21-22 \|\|

*asaṃkhyāni ca viśvāni pavitrāṇi yayā sadā \|*  
*tāṃ viśvapāvanīṃ devīṃ viraheṇa smarāmyaham \|\| 21 \|\|*

*devā na tuṣṭāḥ puṣpāṇāṃ samūhena yayā vinā \|*  
*tāṃ puṣpasārāṃ śuddhāṃ ca draṣṭumicchāmi śokataḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. The one who purifies the innumerable globes, I am reciting the name of the same goddess who purifies the universe. Without her the gods do not feel pleased. Even after getting the flowers, I adore the same meritorious goddess.

## \|\| 22.23-24 \|\|

*viśve yatprāptimātreṇa bhaktyā''nando bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*nandinī tena vikhyātā sā prītā bhavitā hi me \|\| 23 \|\|*

*yasyā devyā stulā nāsti viśveṣu nikhileṣu ca \|*  
*tulasī tena vikhyātā tāṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ priye \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. By getting her devotees feel delighted. She is known by the name of Nandini. I therefore pray that the same goddess should be pleased with me. О dear, you are the one who is without comparison in the world, that is why you are known as Tulasi. 1 therefore, take refuge under you.

## \|\| 22.25-27 \|\|

*kṛṣṇajīvanarūpā yā śaśvatpriyatamā satī \|*  
*tena kṛṣṇajīvanīti mama rakṣatu jīvanam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā tatra tasthau ramāpatiḥ \|*  
*dadarśa tulasīṃ sākṣātpāda padme natāṃ satīm \|\| 26 \|\|*

*rudatīmabhimānena māninīṃ mānapūjitām \|*  
*priyāṃ dṛṣṭvā priyaḥ śīghraṃ vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. You happen to be the life of Krishna and always are his beloved. Such a Krishnajlvanl goddess should protect my life. Thus adoring her the lord stood there. Thereafter he found Tulasi standing at his feet in a humble manner who was sobbing because of her pride. Finding her beloved there, the lord embraced her.

## \|\| 22.28-29 \|\|

*bhāratyājñāṃ gṛhītvā ca svālayaṃ ca yayau hariḥ \|*  
*bhāratyā saha tatprītiṃ kārayāmāsa satvaram \|\| 28 \|\|*

*varaṃ viṣṇurdadau tasyai viśvapūjyā bhaveti ca \|*  
*śirodhāryyā ca sarveṣāṃ vandyā mānyā mameti ca \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Thereafter at the instance of Sarasvati he took Tulasi with him and at that very moment she made friends with Sarasvati. Thereafter lord Vishnu blessed her with a boon saying, “O goddess, getting adored by the universe, you will be accepted which grace by all and adored by me also.

## \|\| 22.30 \|\|

*viṣṇorvareṇa sā devī parituṣṭā babhūva ha \|*  
*sarasvatī tāmāśliṣya vāsayāmāsa sannidhau \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Thus having been blessed with the boon of lord Vishnu, the goddess felt immensely delighted. Thereafter Sarasvati also embraced her and made her sit beside her.

## \|\| 22.31 \|\|

*lakṣmīrgaṅgā sasmitā tāṃ samāśliṣya ca nārada \|*  
*gṛhaṃ praveśayāmāsa vinayena satīṃ tadā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. О Narada, both Lakshmi and Ganga smilingly held the hand of Tulasi and made her enter the palace.

## \|\| 22.32-33 \|\|

*vṛndāṃ vṛndāvanīṃ viśvapāvanīṃviśvapūjitām \|*  
*puṣpasārāṃ nandinīṃ ca tulasīṃ kṛṣṇajīvanīm \|\| 32 \|\|*

*etannāmāṣṭakaṃ caita tstotraṃ nāmārthasaṃyutam \|*  
*yaḥ paṭhettāṃ ca saṃpūjya so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. The goddess Tulasi is known by the eight names which are-Vmda, VrindavanI, VishvapavanI, Vishvapujita, Puspasara, Nandini, Tulasi and Krishnajlvanl. All these epithets are turned into the form of a stotra and whosoever adpres Tulasi and recites this stotra earns the merit of performing an Asvamedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 22.34-36 \|\|

*kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ ca tulasyā janma maṅgalam \|*  
*tatra tasyāśca pūjā ca vihitā hariṇā purā \|\| 34 \|\|*

*tasyāṃ yaḥ pūjayettāṃ ca bhaktyā ca viśvapāvanīm \|*  
*sarvapāpādvinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati \|\| 35 \|\|*

*kārttike tulasīpatraṃ viṣṇave yo dadāti ca \|*  
*gavāmayutadānasya phalamāpnoti niścitam \|\| 36 \|\|*

34-36. On the full moon day of Kartika, Tulasi was born and she was adored by the lord on the same day. Thereafter whosoever adores her on the same day of the full moon with devotion and perform puja to VishvapavanI, is relieved of all his sins and proceeds to the abode of Vishnu. The one who offers a Tulasi leaf to lord Vishnu in the month of Kartika, undoubtedly earns the merit of giving away ten thousand cows in charity.

## \|\| 22.37-38 \|\|

*aputro labhate putraṃ priyāhīno labhetpriyām \|*  
*bandhuhīno labhedbandhuṃ stotrasmaraṇamātrataḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*rogī pramucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt \|*  
*bhayānmucyeta bhītastu pāpānmucyeta pātakī \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. By reciting the stotra, a childless person gets a son, a man without a wife gets a wife, the one having no brother gets a brother. The person suffering from ailment is relieved of the disease and the one who is thrown into bondage is redeemed of it. Those praising her in danger are freed from it, I am the sinner and I intend to get relieved of my sins.

## \|\| 22.39-41 \|\|

*ipyevaṃ kathitaṃ stotraṃ dhyānapūjāvidhiṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*tvameva veda jānāsi kāṇvaśākhoktameva ca \|\| 39 \|\|*

*yadvakṣye pūjayettāṃ ca bhaktyā cāvāhanaṃ vinā \|*  
*upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirdhyānaṃ pātakanāśanam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tulasīṃ puṣpasārāṃ ca satīṃ pūjyāṃ manoharām \|*  
*kṛtsnapāpedhmadāhāya jvaladagniśikhopamām \|\| 41 \|\|*

39-41. Thus I have told you everything about the stotra; now I am repeating to you her dhyanam and the method of her adoration, which you please listen to.» You are well aware of the Vedas. I am now speaking out to you about the method prescribed in the Kanva branch. Without invoking, one should perform the pilja ofTulasi making sixteen types of offerings and should meditate upon her thus, “O Tulasi, you are the form of the flowers, you are chaste, adorable, pleasant and are the remover of the sins like the fire flames which burn everything.

## \|\| 22.42 \|\|

*puṣpeṣu tulanāpyasyā nāsīddevīṣu vā mune \|*  
*pavitrarūpā sarvāsu tulasī sā ca kīrttitā \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. О sage, this goddess could not be compared with flowers and other goddesses. Since she happens to be The most sacred one, she has been given the name of Tulasi.

## \|\| 22.43-44 \|\|

*śirodhāryyā ca sarveṣāmīpsitāṃ viśvapāvanīm \|*  
*jīvanmuktāṃ muktidāṃ ca bhaja tāṃ haribhaktidām \|\| 43 \|\|*

*iti dhyātvā ca saṃpūjya stutvā ca praṇamedbudhaḥ \|*  
*uktaṃ tulasyupākhyānaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥśrotumi cchasi \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. She is held in high esteem, fulfils all the wishes, purifies the universe, frees one from the cycle of birth, grants salivation and devotion to lord Hari. Therefore I am serving her. Thus meditating upon her, offering pilja and stuti, the intellectuals should bow before her. Thus I have narrated to you the story of Tulasi; what else do you want to listen to?

## Chapter 23

## \|\| 23.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*tulasyupākhyānamidaṃ śrutamīśa sudhopamam \|*  
*yattu sāvitryupākhyānaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said — О lord, I have listened to the nectar-like sweet story of Tulasi. Now you kindly tell me the story of Savitri.

## \|\| 23.2 \|\|

*purā yena samudbhūtā sā śrutā ca śrutiprasūḥ \|*  
*kena vā pūjitā devī prathame kaiśca vā pare \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The goddess Savitri is the mother of the Vedas, according to the general belief. How was this goddess born earlier and who adored her first of all?

## \|\| 23.3 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*brahmaṇā vedajananī pūjitā prathame mune \|*  
*dvitīye ca devagaṇaistatpaścādviduṣāṃ gaṇaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Narayana said — О sage, the mother of the Vedas was adored by Brahma first of all. Thereafter the other gods adored her.

## \|\| 23.4 \|\|

*tathā cāśvapatiḥ pūrvaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhārate \|*  
*tatpaścātpūjayāmāsurvarṇāścatvāra eva ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. In the land of Bharata the king Asvapati adored her first of all. Thereafter all the four varnas adored her.

## \|\| 23.5 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*ko vā so'śvapatirbrahmankena vā tena pūjitā \|*  
*sarvapūjyā ca sāvitrī tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Narada said — О Brahman, who was this Asvapati and how did he adore Savitri? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 23.6 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*madradeśe mahārājo babhūvāśvapatirmune \|*  
*vairiṇāṃ balaharttā ca mitrāṇāṃ duḥkhanāśanaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Narayana said — О sage, Ashvapati had been the king of Madradesha; he was the destroyer of these enemies with his prowess and always removed the miseries of his friends.

## \|\| 23.7-8 \|\|

*āsīttasya mahārājñī mahiṣī dharmacāriṇī \|*  
*mālatīti ca sā khyātā yathā lakṣmīrgadābhṛtaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sā ca rājñī mahāsādhvī vasiṣṭhasyopadeśataḥ \|*  
*cakārārādhanaṃ bhaktyā sāvitryāścaiva nārada \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. His queen was quite chaste and was known by the name of Malatl she appeared gracefiil with the king in the same way as Lakshmi remained with lord Vishnu. О Narada, the chaste queen adored the goddess Savitri at the advice of the sage Vasistha.

## \|\| 23.9 \|\|

*pratyādeśaṃ na sā prāpa mahiṣī na dadarśa tām \|*  
*gṛhaṃ jagāma sā duḥkhāddhṛdayena vidūyatā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. But the goddess neither appeared before her nor was any message communicated to her. With a painful heart, she returned to her abode.

## \|\| 23.10 \|\|

*rājā tāṃ duḥkhitāṃ dṛṣṭvā bodhayitvā nayena vai \|*  
*sāvitryāstapase bhaktyā jagāma puṣkaraṃ tadā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Finding her so painful at heart, the king tried to make her understand in various ways and in order to adore the goddess Savitri herself with great devotion, he went to Puskara region.

## \|\| 23.11 \|\|

*tapaścacāra tatraiva saṃyataḥ śatavatsaram \|*  
*na dadarśa ca sāvitrīṃ pratyādeśo babhūva ha \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. He perfonned tapas with great devotion for a hundred years. Still the goddess did not appear before him. A message however was received from her.

## \|\| 23.12-13 \|\|

*śuśrāvākāśavāṇīṃ ca nṛpendraścāśarīriṇīm \|*  
*gāyatrīdaśalakṣaṃ ca japaṃ kurviti nārada \|\| 12 \|\|*

*etasminnantare tatra prajagāma parāśaraḥ \|*  
*praṇanāma nṛpastaṃ ca munirnṛpamuvāca ha \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. О Narada, the king had the divine voice from the sky at the same time which said: “You recite the Gayatri mantra ten lakh times.” In the meantime the sage Parasara arrived there. The king bowed before him in reverence. Thereafter the sage spoke to the king.

## \|\| 23.14 \|\|

*parāśara uvāca \|*  
*sakṛjjapaśca gāyatryāḥ pāpaṃ dinakṛtaṃ haret \|*  
*daśadhā prajapānnṝṇāṃ divārātryaghameva ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Parashara said — By reciting the name of Gayatri a person is relieved of all the sins earned during the day and by reciting it ten times the sin committed during the day and the night disappear.

## \|\| 23.15 \|\|

*śatadhā ca japāccaivaṃ pāpaṃ māsārjitaṃ param \|*  
*sahasradhā japāccaiva kalmaṣaṃ vatsarārjitam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. By reciting the mantra of Gayatri a hundred times, the sins committed by a person during a month vanish and by reciting the same mantra a thousand times a person is relieved of the sins committed by him during one year.

## \|\| 23.16 \|\|

*lakṣaṃ janmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ daśalakṣaṃ trijanmanaḥ \|*  
*sarvajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śatalakṣo vinaśyati \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. By reciting the mantra for a lakh of times, the sins committed during the entire life disappear and by reciting the same mantra ten lakh times, the sins committed during three births disappear. Similarly by reciting the mantra one thousand lakh times, the sins committed during all the lives disappear.

## \|\| 23.17-21 \|\|

*karoti muktiṃ viprāṇāṃ japo daśaguṇastataḥ \|*  
*karaṃ sarpaphaṇākāraṃ kṛtvā tu ūrdhvamudritam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*ānamramūrddhamacalaṃ prajapetprāṅmukho dvijaḥ \|*  
*anāmikāmadhyadeśādatho vāmakrameṇa ca \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tarjanīmūlaparyyantaṃ japasyaiṣa kramaḥ kare \|*  
*śvetapaṅkaja bījānāṃ sphāṭikānāṃ ca saṃskṛtām \|\| 19 \|\|*

*kṛtvā vā mālikāṃ rājañjapettīrthe surālaye \|*  
*saṃsthāpya mālāmaśvatthapatrasaptasu saṃyataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*kṛtvā gorocanāktāṃ ca gāyatryā snāpayetsudhīḥ \|*  
*gāyatrīśatakaṃ tasyāṃ japecca vidhipūrvakam \|\| 21 \|\|*

17-21. By reciting the mantra ten times more the Brahmanas achieve salvation. A Brahmana should get himself seated facing the east. He should turn his hands like the serpents hood. Raising the hands he should remain in that position. Then he should be tilted a little. He should then start the recitation from the lowest mark of the little finger and moving on the lower side turning to the left, should move to the lower part of the fore-finger and then touch the thumb. This is the method of the recitation of the mantra with hands. О king, one should make a rosary of the seeds of the white lotus or the beads of the crystal stone and seated in a temple or a sacred place, one should perform the recitation. Prior to that, one should place the rosary on the seven leaves of a plpala tree and the fragrance paste should be applied to it. Thereafter reciting the hymn of Gayatri, the rosary should be washed. Then one should recite the hymn of Gayatri a hundred times appropriately.

## \|\| 23.22-23 \|\|

*athavā pañcagavyena snātā mālā ca saṃskṛtā \|*  
*atha gaṅgodakenaiva snātā vā'tisusaṃskṛtā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*evaṃ krameṇa rājarṣe daśalakṣaṃ japaṃ kuru \|*  
*sākṣād drakṣyasi sāvitrīṃ trijanmamapātakakṣayāt \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Alternatively by offering the Pancagavya and the water of the Ganga, the rosary gets consecrated. О royal sage, the hymn of Gayatri should be recited ten lakh times which removes the sins of all the three births after which you will surely have an audience with Savitri.

## \|\| 23.24 \|\|

*nityaṃ nityaṃ trisandhyaṃ ca kariṣyasi dine dine \|*  
*madhyāhne cāpi sāyāhne prātareva śuciḥ sadā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Thus, you should repeat the recitation of Gayatri hymn thrice a day in the morning, noon and evening getting yourself purified.

## \|\| 23.25 \|\|

*sandhyāhīno'śucirnityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu \|*  
*yadahnā kurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Because without performing sandhya. one remains unclean and is therefore considered to be unfit form performing any religious acts. The one who performs and whatever he performs during the day, he does not get the reward for it.

## \|\| 23.26-27 \|\|

*nopatiṣṭhati yaḥ pūrvāṃ nopāste yaśca paścimām \|*  
*sa śūdravadbahiṣkāryyaḥ sarvasmād dvijakarmaṇaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*yāvajjīvanaparyyantaṃ yastrisandhyāṃ karoti ca \|*  
*sa ca sūryyasamo viprastejasā tapasā sadā \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. Such of the Brahmanas who do not perform sandhyd during the morning as well as the evening, are considered to be excommunicated from the rites performed by the Brahmanas. Such of the Brahmanas who perform sandhya during all the three times a day get the glory of the sun and shine like him.

## \|\| 23.28-29 \|\|

*tatpādapadmarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā \|*  
*jīvanmuktaḥ sa tejasvī sandhyā pūto hi yo dvijaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*tīrthāni ca pavitrāṇi tasya sparśanamātrataḥ \|*  
*tataḥ pāpāni yāntyeva vainateyādivoragāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. The earth gets purified with the dust of the feet of such Brahmanas. Such Brahmanas who get purified with the reciting of Gayatri hymn, achieve great glory and are freed from human life. With their very touch all the sacred places get purified. All their sins at once disappear in the same way as the serpents disappear at the sight of a Garuda.

## \|\| 23.30 \|\|

*na gṛhṇanti surāḥ pūjāṃ pitaraḥ piṇḍatarpaṇam \|*  
*svecchayā ca dvijāteśca trisandhyarahitasya ca \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The one who does not perform sandhya thrice a day and conducts himself according to his own will, the gods do not accept the offering made by him and the manes do not accept the pindas offered by him.

## \|\| 23.31 \|\|

*viṣṇumantravihīnaśca trisandhyarahito dvijaḥ \|*  
*ekādaśīvihīnaśca viṣahīno yathoragaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The one who is deprived of mantra of Vishnu, fails to perform sandhya thrice a day, does not fast on the eleventh day of moon, such a Brahmana becomes like a serpent without its poison.The one who takes food without first offering it to the lord, the one who rides a bull, the one who eats the food of Shudras, he is compared with a snake having no poison.

## \|\| 23.32 \|\|

*hareranaivedyabhojī dhāvako vṛṣavāhakaḥ \|*  
*śūdrānnabhojī vipraśca viṣahīno yathoragaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The one who burns the bodies of the Siidras, takes a Shudra as his wife and eats with them, such a Brahmana is considered to be a serpent without poison.

## \|\| 23.33-34 \|\|

*śavadāhī ca śūdrāṇāṃ yo vipro vṛṣalīpatiḥ \|*  
*śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraśca viṣahīno yathoragaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*śūdrāṇāṃ ca pratigrāhī śūdrayājī ca yo dvijaḥ \|*  
*asijīvī maṣījīvī viṣahīno yathoragaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. The one who receives charity from Shudras, performs yajna for them and makes a living by means of his sword or conducts like a revenue officer, such a Brahmana is considered to be a serpent without poison. The one who consumes food from a widow having no son, the women in period and the one earning his livelihood by forcing his wife on evil path such a Brahmana and the money-lender are considered to be snakes without poison.

## \|\| 23.35-37 \|\|

*yo vipro'vīrānnabhojī ṛtusnātānnabhojakaḥ \|*  
*bhagajīvī vārdhuṣiko viṣahīno yathoragaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*yaḥ kanyāvikrayī vipro yo harernāmavikrayī \|*  
*yo vidyāvikrayī bhūpa viṣahīno yathoragaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*sūryyodaye ca dvirbhojī matsyabhojī ca yo dvijaḥ \|*  
*śilāpūjādirahito viṣahīno yathoragaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

35-37. О king, the one who sells aw ay his daughter, sells away the figures of gods, the Brahmana who sells away knowledge, he is considered to be a serpent without poison. One who takes food twice at dawn, the one who consumes fish, one who does not perform pilja of Shalagrama, such a Brahmana is considered to be a serpent without poison.

## \|\| 23.38-39 \|\|

*ityuktvā ca muniśreṣṭhaḥ sarva pūjāvidhikramam \|*  
*tamuvāca ca sāvitryā dhyānādikamabhīpsitam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*dattvā sarvaṃ nṛpendrāya prayayau svālayaṃ muniḥ \|*  
*rājā saṃpūjya sāvitrīṃ dadarśa varamāpa ca \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Thus speaking the best of the sages made the king aware of the correct method of the adoration of Savitri, her dhyanam and other details. Thus making the king aware of all the details about adoration the sage left for his place. Thereafter the king adoring Savitri achieved a boon from her.

## \|\| 23.40 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*kiṃ vā dhyānaṃ ca sāvitryāḥ kiṃ vā pūjāvidhānakam \|*  
*stotraṃ mantraṃ ca kiṃ dattvā prayayau sa parāśaraḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Narada said — What is the method of the adoration of Savitri, what is her dhyanam, stotra and mantra which was given by the sage Parasara to the king?

## \|\| 23.41 \|\|

*nṛpaḥ kena vidhānena saṃpūjya śrutimātaram \|*  
*varaṃ ca kiṃ vā saṃprāpa vada so'śvapatirnṛpaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. How did the king Asvapati adore Savitri, the mother of the Vedas and what type of boon could he get from her? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 23.42 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*jyeṣṭhe kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ śuddhe kāle ca saṃyataḥ \|*  
*vratameva caturdaśyāṃ vratī bhaktyā samācaret \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Narayana said — One should perform vrata on the thirteenth or fourteenth day of the black fortnight of the month of Jyestha. A devotee should perform the pujcl of Savitri.

## \|\| 23.43-46 \|\|

*vrataṃ caturdaśābdaṃ ca dvisaptaphalasaṃyutam \|*  
*dattvā dvisaptanaivedyaṃ puṣpadhūpādikaṃ tathā \|\| 43 \|\|*

*vastraṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca bhojyaṃ ca vidhipūrvakam \|*  
*saṃsthāpya maṅgalaghaṭaṃ phalaśākhāsamanvitama \|\| 44 \|\|*

*gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām \|*  
*saṃpūjya pūjayediṣṭaṃ ghaṭe āvāhite mune \|\| 45 \|\|*

*śṛṇu dhyānaṃ ca sāvitryāścoktaṃ mādhyandine ca yat \|*  
*stotraṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca mantraṃ ca sarvakāmadam \|\| 46 \|\|*

43-46. After performing the vrata for fourteen years the naivedyas, flowers, essence, clothes, yajnopavita and eatables should be offered. Thereafter fruits and fresh leaves should be consecrated followed by the adoration of Ganesha, Silrya, Agni, Vishnu, Shiva and Parvati. He should invoke the presence of his family goddess over the vase. О sage, according the Madhyandinl-sakha of Yajurveda, the dhyanam and the stotra of Savitri should be recited besides performing puja. I am now speaking put the mantra of the goddess which brings about success to all.

## \|\| 23.47-50 \|\|

*taptakāñcanavarṇābhāṃ jvalantīṃ brahmatejasā \|*  
*grīṣmamadhyāhnamārttaṇḍasahasrasamasuprabhām \|\| 47 \|\|*

*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām \|\| 48 \|\|*

*sukhadāṃ muktidāṃ śāntāṃ kāntāṃ ca jagatāṃ vidheḥ \|*  
*sarvasampatsvarūpāṃ ca pradātrīṃ sarvasampadām \|\| 49 \|\|*

*vedādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca vedaśāstrasvarūpiṇīm \|*  
*vede bījasvarūpāṃ ca bhaje tvāṃ vedamātaram \|\| 50 \|\|*

47-50. The goddess has the complexion of molten gold, having the lustre of Brahman and the glory exceeding thousands of suns of the summer season at noon, wearing a smile on her face, adorned with all the ornaments, clad in the clothes purified by the god of fire and the one who always remains eager to shower her grace over her devotees. She is the bestower of pleasures and salvation. She is peaceful and is the wife of the creator of the universe. She is the form of all the treasures, a bestower of wealth, the goddess of the Vedas. I serve the mother of the Vedas.

## \|\| 23.51-52 \|\|

*dhyātvā dhyānena cānena dattvā puṣpaṃ svamūrddhani \|*  
*punardhyātvā ghaṭe bhaktyā devīmāvāhayedvratī \|\| 51 \|\|*

*dattvā ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ vedoktamantrapūrvakam \|*  
*sampūjya stutvā praṇamedevaṃ devīṃ vidhānataḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. Thus meditating upon her the perfonner should place the flowers on her head and should invoke the goddess in the vase. Thei'eafter, reciting the Vedic hymns one should adore the goddess in sixteen ways, offering her prayers and salutations.

## \|\| 23.53-54 \|\|

*āsanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ ca snānīyaṃ cānulepanam \|*  
*dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ śītalaṃ jalam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*vasanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ mālyaṃ gandhamācamanīyakam \|*  
*manoharaṃ sutalpaṃ ca deyānyetāni ṣoḍaśa \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. Thereafter, he should provide a bath, besides offering padya, arghya and water for bathing besides the paste, the essence, the lamp, naivedya, betel, cool water, the cloth, the ornaments, rosary, sandal-paste, sipping of water and the beautiful bed. These are the sixteen types of offerings.

## \|\| 23.55 \|\|

*dārusāravikāraṃ ca hemādinirmitaṃ ca vā \|*  
*devādhāraṃ puṇyadaṃ ca mayā nityaṃ niveditam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. One should offer sixteen things by reciting the sixteen mantras. A wooden seat or the seat made of gold which should be suitable for the seating of the gods, I am offering for the gods.

## \|\| 23.56-57 \|\|

*tīrthodakaṃ ca pādyaṃ ca puṇyadaṃ prītidaṃ mahat \|*  
*pūjāṅgabhūtaṃ śuddhaṃ ca mayā bhaktyā niveditam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*pavitrarūpamarghyaṃ ca dūrvāpuṣpākṣatānvitam \|*  
*puṇyadaṃ śaṃkhatoyāktaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ niveditam \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. I offer with devotion the water of the sacred places for washing the feet, which is quite pure and is suitable for performing puja. 1 offer the sacred arghya which consists of Ditrvd-grass, flowers and rice. Besides the sacred water poured with conch is offered by me.

## \|\| 23.58-59 \|\|

*sugandhi dhātrītailaṃ ca dehasaundaryyakāraṇam \|*  
*mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā snānīyaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 58 \|\|*

*malayācalasambhūtaṃ dehaśobhāvivarddhanam \|*  
*sugandhiyuktaṃ sukhadaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ niveditam \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. I am offering the fragrant oil of myrobalan which increases beauty, for the purpose of bathing. You kindly accept it. I offer the sandal-paste, which is grown in Malayacala, increases the beauty of the body, is fragrant and bestows pleasure.

## \|\| 23.60-61 \|\|

*gandhadravyodbhavaḥ puṇyaḥ prītido divyagandhadaḥ \|*  
*mayā nivedito bhaktyā dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 60 \|\|*

*jagatāṃ darśanīyaṃ ca darśanaṃ dīptikāraṇam \|*  
*andhakāradhvaṃsabījaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ niveditam \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. I offer with devotion the fragrant and sacred essence which may kindly be accepted. I am offering to you the lamp which illumines the universe and helps the sight, is the cause of light and is the remover of darkness.

## \|\| 23.62 \|\|

*tuṣṭidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ caiva prītidaṃ kṣudvināśanam \|*  
*puṇyadaṃ svādurūpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. I offer the Naivedya which provides satisfaction, growth, love and removes hunger beside being tasteful and graceful.

## \|\| 23.63-64 \|\|

*tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam \|*  
*tuṣṭidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ caiva mayā bhaktyā niveditam \|\| 63 \|\|*

*suśītalaṃ vāsitaṃ ca pipāsānāśakāraṇam \|*  
*jagatāṃ jīvarūpaṃ ca jīvanaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. You kindly accept it. I am offering you the best of betels which is quite charming, is filled with camphor, fragrant and provides satisfaction and growth. I am offering the water which is quite cool, fragrant, is the remover of thirst besides being the life of the universe. You kindly accept it.

## \|\| 23.65 \|\|

*dehaśobhāsvarūpaṃ ca sabhāśobhāvivarddhanam \|*  
*kārpāsajaṃ ca kṛmijaṃ vasanaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. I am offering the cotton and silken cloth which increases the chann of the body and glory of the body in the assembly. You kindly accept it.

## \|\| 23.66 \|\|

*kāñcanādibhirābaddhaṃ śrīyuktaṃ śrīkaraṃ sadā \|*  
*sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ caiva bhūṣaṇaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. I am offering the divine ornaments made of gold and other metals which are beautiful to look at, which are the cause of glory and quite pleasant. You kindly accept them.

## \|\| 23.67 \|\|

*nānāpuṣpalatākīrṇaṃ bahubhāsā samanvitam \|*  
*prītidaṃ puṇyadaṃ caiva mālyaṃ vai pratigṛhyatām \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. I am offering the garland of flowers and creepers with extremely shining, which increase love and gives righteous. You kindly accept it.

## \|\| 23.68-69 \|\|

*sarvamaṅgalarūpaśca sarva maṅgalado varaḥ \|*  
*puṇyapradaśca gandhāḍhyo gandhaśca pratigṛhyatām \|\| 68 \|\|*

*śuddhaṃ śuddhipradaṃ caiva śuddhānāṃ prītidaṃ mahat \|*  
*ramyamācamanīyaṃ ca mayā dattaṃ pragṛhyatām \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. I am offering you the fragrant essence which is the form of all welfare; it is the bestower of welfare, the best and meritorious. You kindly accept it. I am offering you the clean water which removes dirt and helps in keeping one clean, is quite adorable and fit for sipping. You kindly accept it.

## \|\| 23.70 \|\|

*ratnasārādinirmāṇaṃ puṣpacandanasaṃyutam \|*  
*sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ caiva sutalpaṃ pratigṛhyatāma \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. I am offering you a meritorious and beautiful bed which is made of the essence of the gems and is adorned with flowers and sandal. You kindly accept it.

## \|\| 23.71 \|\|

*nānāvṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ nānārūpasamanvitam \|*  
*phalasvarūpaṃ phaladaṃ phalaṃ ca pratigṛhyatām \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. I am offering you fruits of several keAiend efo trees which are quite sweet and tasteful. You kindly accept them.

## \|\| 23.72-73 \|\|

*sindūraṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ bhālaśobhāvivarddhanam \|*  
*bhūṣaṇaṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca sindūraṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 72 \|\|*

*viśuddhagraṃthisaṃyuktaṃ puṇyasūtravinirmitam \|*  
*pavitraṃ vedamantreṇa yajñasūtraṃ ca gṛhyatām \|\| 73 \|\|*

72-73. I am offering you the saffron which is the best, beautful, increases the beauty of one’s forehead and is a substitute for ornament; kindly accept it. I am offering you the sanctified yajhopavlta with pure knots and is made of divine Siidras and purified by the Vedic hymn. You kindly accept it.

## \|\| 23.74 \|\|

*dravyāṇyetāni mūlena dattvā stotraṃ paṭhetsudhīḥ \|*  
*tataḥ praṇamya viprāya vratī dadyācca dakṣiṇām \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Thus all the articles should be offered reciting the Mula mantra and thereafter the intelligent people should recite the stotra. Then after bowing before her, the daksina should be given over to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 23.75 \|\|

*sāvitrīti caturthyantaṃ vahnijāyāntameva ca \|*  
*lakṣmīmāyākāmapūrvaṃ mantramaṣṭākṣaraṃ viduḥ \|\| 75\|\|*

75\. By adding the prefixes of … to Lakshmi, Maya and Kama, together with the fourth form of Savitri (uiLi?4) and further adding the word Svaha as a suffix, the mantra formed. This eight letter mantra has been called the basic or the seed-mantra by the intellectuals.

## \|\| 23.76-77 \|\|

*śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ sāvitryai svāhā \|*  
*madhyandinoktaṃ stotraṃ ca sarvavāñchāphalapradam \|*  
*viprajīvanarūpaṃ ca nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 76 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇena dattā sāvitrī goloke brahmaṇe purā \|*  
*na yāti sā tena sārddhaṃ brahmalokaṃ tu nārada \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. Now you listen to the mantra of Savitri which fulfils all the desires according to Madhyandinl-sakha and is the life line for the Brahmanas. You listen to it.

## \|\| 23.78 \|\|

*brahmā kṛṣṇājñayā bhaktyā paryaṣṭaudvedamātaram \|*  
*tadā sā parituṣṭā ca brahmāṇaṃ cakame satī \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. О Narada — Lord Shri Krishna had initially given away Savitri to Brahma but she did not agree to go with Brahmana to the Brahmaloka. Thereafter at the command of lord Krishna when Brahma adored the mother of the Vedas, then the chaste lady agreed to accompany Brahma.

## \|\| 23.79 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*nārāyaṇasvarūpe ca nārāyaṇi sanātani \|*  
*nārāyaṇātsamudbhūte prasannā bhava sundari \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. Brahma said — О goddess, you have the form of Narayana and are called NarayanI as well as Sanatani. You have emerged from lord Narayana. О beautiful one, you be pleased with me.

## \|\| 23.80 \|\|

*tejaḥ svarūpe parame paramānandarūpiṇi \|*  
*dvijātīnāṃ jātirūpe prasannā bhava sundari \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. You possess extreme lustre and are quite blissful. О beautiful one, you are of the caste of Brahmanas and you be pleased with me.

## \|\| 23.81 \|\|

*nitye nityapriye devi nityānandasvarūpiṇi \|*  
*sarvamaṃgalarūpeṇa prasannā bhava sundari \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. О goddess, you are eternal, are always loved and are blissful. You bestow all the welfare on all and therefore be pleased.

## \|\| 23.82 \|\|

*sarvasvarūpe viprāṇāṃ mantrasāre parātpare \|*  
*sukhade mokṣade devi prasannā bhava sundari \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. О goddess, you are everything for the Brahmanas, the essence of the mantras and are the best of the best. О beautiful one, you bestow pleasure and redemption; you be pleased with me.

## \|\| 23.83 \|\|

*viprapāpendhadāhāya jvaladagniśikhopame \|*  
*brahmatejaḥprade devi prasannā bhava sundari \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. О goddess, you are like a fire flame for the burning of the sins of the Brahmanas and you bestow the glory of Brahmanas. О beautiful one, you be pleased.

## \|\| 23.84 \|\|

*kāyena manasā vācā yatpāpaṃ kurute dvijaḥ \|*  
*tatte smaraṇamātreṇa bhasmībhūtaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Whatever sins are committed by the Brahmana by his speech or deed, are washed away by the mere reciting of your name.

## \|\| 23.85-86 \|\|

*ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā tatra tasthau ca saṃsadi \|*  
*sāvitrī brahmaṇā sārddhaṃ brahmalokaṃ jagāma sā \|\| 85\|\|*

*anena stavarājena saṃstūyāśvapatirnṛpaḥ \|*  
*dadarśa tāṃ ca sāvitrīṃ varaṃ prāpa manogatam \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. Brahma the creator of the universe kept quiet after thus speaking. Thereafter, Savitri went to Brahmaloka accompanied by Brahma. The king Asvapati adored Savitri with the same stotra. Savitri then appeared before him and gave him the desired boon.

## \|\| 23.87 \|\|

*stavarājamidaṃ puṇyaṃ trisandhyāyāṃ ca yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*pāṭhe caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ yatphalaṃ tallabhed dhruvam \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. Whosoever recites the same stotra thrice a day, he surely achieves the merit of reciting all the four Vedas.

## Chapter 24

## \|\| 24.1-2 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*stutvā so'śvapatistena saṃpūjya vidhipūrvakam \|*  
*dadarśa tatra tāṃ devīṃ sahasrārkasamaprabhām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*uvāca sā taṃ rājānaṃ prasannā sasmitā satī \|*  
*yathā mātā svaputraṃ ca dyotayantī diśastviṣā \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said — The king Ashvapati adored Savitri with the great stotra performing her the puja properly who appeared before him having the lustre of a thousand suns. The goddess Savitri came to the king with a smiling face and spoke to him as if a mother was speaking to her son. The entire region illumined with the lustre of Savitri.

## \|\| 24.3 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*jānāmi te mahārāja yatte manasi varttate \|*  
*vāñchitaṃ tava patnyāśca sarvaṃ dāsyāmi niścitam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Savitri said — О great king I am well aware of the desire of your mind; therefore I shall surely fulfil your as well as your wife's desires.

## \|\| 24.4 \|\|

*sādhvī kanyābhilāṣaṃ ca karoti tava kāminī \|*  
*tvaṃ prārthayasi putraṃ ca bhaviṣyati ca te kramāt \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The chaste lady desires for a daughter and you are desirous of having a son. The desires of both of you will be fulfilled.

## \|\| 24.5-6 \|\|

*ityuktvā sā mahādevī brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha \|*  
*rājā jagāma svagṛhaṃ tatkanyā''dau babhūva ha \|\| 5 \|\|*

*rājño dhanācca sāvitryā babhūva kamalā kalā \|*  
*sāvitrīti ca tannāma cakārāśvapatirnṛpaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Thus speaking, the great goddess returned to Brahmaloka and the king also returned to his abode. Thereafter a girl was born from the ray of goddess Lakshmi — who was given the name of Savitri.

## \|\| 24.7-8 \|\|

*kālena sā varddhamānā babhūva ca dine dine \|*  
*rūpayauvanasampannā śukle candrakalā yathā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sā varaṃ varayāmāsa dyumatsenātmajaṃ tadā \|*  
*sāvitrī satyavantaṃ ca nānāguṇasamanvitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. The girl continued growing up like the moon of the bright fortnight and in a short time she became quite youthful. Thereafter Savitri accepted Satyavan as her husband, who was the son of Dyumatsena and was quite truthful and virtuous.

## \|\| 24.9-10 \|\|

*rājā tasmai dadau tāṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|*  
*sa ca sārdhaṃ kautukena tāṃ gṛhītvā gṛhaṃ yayau \|\| 9 \|\|*

*sa ca saṃvatsare'tīte satyavānsatyavikramaḥ \|*  
*jagāma phalakāṣṭhārthaṃ praharṣaṃ piturājñayā \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. The king adorning his daughter Savitri with all the ornaments gave her away in marriage to Satyavan. Both of them then went to the place of Satyavan pleasantly. After a year the tmthful Satyavan, went to the forest with the permission of his father to collect fruits and roots and fire wood.

## \|\| 24.11 \|\|

*jagāma tatra sāvitrī tatpaścāddaivayogataḥ \|*  
*nipatya vṛkṣāddaivena prāṇāṃstatyāja satyavān \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. As a move of the destiny Savitri too accompanied him. There, in the thick forest Satyavan fell down from a tree and he died instantaneously.

## \|\| 24.12-13 \|\|

*yamastajjīvapuruṣaṃ baddhvāṅguṣṭhasamaṃ mune \|*  
*gṛhītvā gamanaṃ cakre tatpaścātprayayau satī \|\| 12 \|\|*

*paścāttāṃ sundarīṃ dṛṣṭvā yamaḥ saṃyaminīpatiḥ \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ sādhvīṃ sādhūnāṃ pravaro mahān \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. О sage, Yama tied the Jlvcitama of Satyavan having the size of a thumb and proceeded on to his place. The chaste Savitri also started following him. When the self-disciplined and noble-minded Yama found Savitri who was extremely beautiful, following him, he then spoke to her in sweet words.

## \|\| 24.14 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*aho kva yāsi sāvitri gṛhītvā mānuṣīṃ tanum \|*  
*yadi yāsyasi kāntena sārdhaṃ dehaṃ tadā tyaja \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Yama said — О Savitri, where are you going with this human body? In case you want to accompany your husband you better put an end to the human body.

## \|\| 24.15-16 \|\|

*gantuṃ marttyo na śaknoti gṛhītvā pāñcabhautikam \|*  
*dehaṃ ca yamalokaṃ ca naśvaraṃ naśvaraḥ sadāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*pūrṇaśca bharttuste kālaḥ hyabhavadbhārate sati \|*  
*sa karmaphalabhogārthaṃ satyavānyāti madgṛham \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. No one can reach the abode of Yama with the human body which consists of five elements (Earth, Water, Agni, Vayu and Akasha). The time for your husband to stay on earth in Bharata has come to an end. Therefore I am taking Satyavan to my place to enable him to bear the fruits of his deeds.

## \|\| 24.17-19 \|\|

*karmaṇā jāyate jantuḥ karmaṇaiva pralīyate \|*  
*sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ karmaṇaiva prapadyate \|\| 17 \|\|*

*karmaṇendro bhavejjīvo brahmaputraḥ svakarmaṇā \|*  
*svakarmaṇā harerdāso janmādirahito bhavet \|\| 18 \|\|*

*svakarmaṇā sarvasiddhimamaratvaṃ labhed dhruvam \|*  
*labhetsvakarmaṇā viṣṇoḥ sālokyādicatuṣṭayam \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. Because one is born as a result of his deeds and also meets with his end because of the same. He achieves pleasure and pain, danger and grief according to his own deeds. By his own deeds he once became Indras and also the sun of Brahma. He also becomes the slave of lord Vishnu getting free from the cycle of birth and death. One becomes eternal and gets all the success because of his own deeds and he also achieves salvation from lord Vishnu because of his own deeds.

## \|\| 24.20-22 \|\|

*karmaṇā brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca muktatvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā \|*  
*suratvaṃ ca manutvaṃ ca rājendratvaṃ labhennaraḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*karmaṇā ca munīndratvaṃ tapasvitvaṃ ca karmaṇā \|*  
*karmaṇā kṣatriyatvaṃ ca vaiśyatvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*karmaṇā caiva śūdratvamantyajatvaṃ svakarmaṇā \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. A man achieves Brahminhood, salvation, godliness and becomes human or king because of his own deeds. By one's own deeds, one becomes a sage, an ascetic, a Kshatriya, a Vaishnava, a Shudra, a Chandala and Mleccha. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 24.23-29 \|\|

*svakarmaṇā ca mlecchatvaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*svakarmaṇā jaṅgamatvaṃ sthāvaratvaṃ svakarmaṇā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*svakarmaṇā ca śailatvaṃ vṛkṣatvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā \|*  
*svakarmaṇā paśutvaṃ ca pakṣitvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*svakarmaṇā kṣudrajantuḥ kṛmitvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā \|*  
*svakarmaṇā ca sarpatvaṃ gandharvatvaṃ svakarmaṇā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*svakarmaṇā rākṣasatvaṃ kinnaratvaṃ svakarmaṇā \|*  
*svakarmaṇā ca yakṣatvaṃ kūṣmāṇḍatvaṃ svakarmaṇā \|\| 26 \|\|*

*svakarmaṇā ca pretatvaṃ vetālatvaṃ svakarmaṇā \|*  
*bhūtatvaṃ ca piśācatvaṃ ḍākinītvaṃ svakarmaṇā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*daityatvaṃ dānavatvaṃ cāpyasuratvaṃ svakarmaṇā \|*  
*karmaṇā puṇyavāñjīvo mahāpāpī svakarmaṇā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*karmaṇā sundaro'rogī mahārogī ca karmaṇā \|*  
*karmaṇā cāndhaḥ kāṇaśca kutsitaśca svakarmaṇā \|\| 29 \|\|*

23-29. By his own deeds a human being moves around and by his own deeds he becomes static. By one's own deeds one becomes a moutnain, a tree an animal and a bird. Because of his own deeds one becomes an insignificant creature, an insect, a reptile, a Gandharva, a Raksasa, a Kinnara, a Yaksa and a Kusmanda, a Vetala, a Preta, a goblin, a Pishaca and a Dakin!. He becomes with his own deeds, a Daitya, a Danava, a Asura and a noble soul or an evil spirit with his own deeds. Because of his own deeds he becomes beautiful, healthy, suffers from the disease and becomes blind, one-eyed and degraded.

## \|\| 24.30-31 \|\|

*karmaṇā narakaṃ yānti jīvāḥ svargaṃ svakarmaṇā \|*  
*karmaṇā śakralokaṃ ca sūryyalokaṃ svakarmaṇā \|\| 30 \|\|*

*karmaṇā candralokaṃ ca vahnilokaṃ svakarmaṇā \|*  
*karmaṇā vāyulokaṃ ca karmaṇā varuṇālayam \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. By his own deeds the creatures go to Indraloka, Suryaloka, Chandraloka, Agniloka, Vayuloka and Varunloka.

## \|\| 24.32-33 \|\|

*tathā kuberalokaṃ ca naro yāti svakarmaṇā \|*  
*karmaṇā dhruvalokaṃ ca śivalokaṃ svakarmaṇā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*yāti nakṣatralokaṃ ca satyalokaṃ svakarmaṇā \|*  
*janolokaṃ tapolokaṃ maharlokaṃ svakarmaṇā \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. By his own deeds, one reaches the abode of Kubera, Dhruvaioka, Shivaloka, the constellations, Satyaloka, Janoloka, Tapoloka and Maharloka.

## \|\| 24.34 \|\|

*svakarmaṇā ca pātālaṃ brahmalokaṃ svakarmaṇā \|*  
*karmaṇā bhārataṃ puṇyaṃ sarvepsitavarapradam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. By one's own deeds one reaches Brahmaloka and also takes birth in the land of Bharata which is desired by all.

## \|\| 24.35 \|\|

*karmaṇā yāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ ca nirāmayam \|*  
*karmaṇā cirajīvī ca kṣaṇāyuśca svakarmaṇā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Не achieves Vaikuntha and the sinless Goloka because of his own deeds. He achieves a long life on a short life because of his own deeds.

## \|\| 24.36 \|\|

*karmaṇā koṭikalpāyuḥ kṣīṇāyuśca svakarmaṇā \|*  
*jīvasaṃcāramātrāyurgarbhe mṛtyuḥ svakarmaṇā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. With his own deeds, he gets life as long as crores of kalpcis and short life by his own deeds. One gets short life for a moment because of his own deeds and also dies in the mother's womb because of his own deeds.

## \|\| 24.37 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ mayā tattvaṃ ca sundari \|*  
*karmaṇā te mṛto bharttā gaccha vatse yathāsukham \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. О beautiful one, thus I have told you everything about all the tattvas. О daughter, your husband has died because of his own karma, therefore you better go back to your abode.

## Chapter 25

## \|\| 25.1 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*yamasya vacanaṃ śrutvā sāvitrī ca pativratā \|*  
*tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā tamuvāca manasvinī \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shri Narayana said — On hearing the words of Yama, the chaste Savitri praised him with great devotion and then said.

## \|\| 25.2 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*kiṃ karma vā śubhaṃ dharmmarāja kiṃ vā'śubhaṃ nṛṇām \|*  
*karma nirmūlayantyeva kena vā sādhavo janāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Savitri said — О lord of Dharma, what is truth and what are bad deeds for a human beings? Which are the deeds, which are discarded by the noble people?

## \|\| 25.3 \|\|

*karmaṇāṃ bījarūpaḥ kaḥ ko vā karmmaphalapradaḥ \|*  
*kiṃ karmma tadbhavetkena ko vā taddhetureva ca \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. What is the seed of actions? Who provides reward for one's actions? What is karma (deeds)? Who performs it? What is the reason for it?

## \|\| 25.4 \|\|

*ko vā karmaphalaṃ bhuṅkte ko vā nirlipta eva ca \|*  
*ko vā dehī kaśca dehaḥ ko vā vai karmakārakaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Who enjoys the fruit of one's deeds? Who gets involved in it? Who possesses a body? What is a body? Who performs deeds?

## \|\| 25.5-6 \|\|

*kiṃ vijñānaṃ mano buddhiḥ ke vā prāṇāḥ śarīriṇām \|*  
*kānīndriyāṇi kiṃ teṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ devatāśca kāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*bhoktā bhojayitā ko vā ko bhogaḥ kā ca niṣkṛtiḥ \|*  
*ko jīvaḥ paramātmā kastanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. What is the life of human beings? What are the-organs of senses? What are their definitions? Who is there to be consumed? How can one get rid of one’s deeds? What is life? What is the supreme soul? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 25.7-8 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*vedena vihitaṃ karma tanmaye maṅgalaṃ param \|*  
*avaidikaṃ tu yatkarma tadevāśubhameva ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ahaitukī viṣṇusevā saṅkalparahitā satām \|*  
*karmmanirmmūlanātmā vai sā caiva haribhaktidā \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Yama said — The deeds which in the Vedas are required to be performed, bestow welfare and those that are prohibited in the Vedas are inauspicious. The selfless service to lord Vishnu results in the destruction of the deeds and also bestows the devotion of lord Hari.

## \|\| 25.9 \|\|

*haribhakto naro yaśca sa ca muktaḥ śrutau śrutam \|*  
*janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokabhītivivarjitaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The devotee of lord Vishnu always feels free and is unmindful of birth, death, old age, ailment, grief and fear. This is ordained in the Vedas.

## \|\| 25.10 \|\|

*muktiśca dvividhā sādhvi śrutyuktā sarvasammatā \|*  
*nirvāṇapadadātrī ca haribhaktipradā nṛṇām \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О chaste lady, the Vedas have prescribed two types of salvation. One of them bestows Nirvdna-pada to the human being and the other bestows the devotion of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 25.11 \|\|

*haribhaktisvarūpāṃ ca muktiṃ vāñchanti vaiṣṇavāḥ \|*  
*anye nirvāṇarūpāṃ ca muktimicchanti sādhavaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The Vaishnava people get desirous of such a type of salvation which provides them with the devotion of the lord while the other devotees aspire for salvation alone.

## \|\| 25.12 \|\|

*karmmaṇo bījarūpaśca santataṃ tatphalapradaḥ \|*  
*rūrmarūpaśca bhagavāñchrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Lord Krishna who is beyond nature, is considered to be the seed of the deeds. He alone bestows reward for the same.

## \|\| 25.13-14 \|\|

*so'pi taddheturūpaśca karmma tena bhavetsati \|*  
*jīvaḥ karmaphalaṃ bhuṅkte ātmā nirlipta eva ca \|\| 13 \|\|*

*ātmanaḥ pratibimbaṃ ca dehī jīvaḥ sa eva ca \|*  
*pāñcabhautikarūpaśca deho naśvara eva ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Не also happens to be the cause of the deeds; he always remains present everywhere and as such he alone is the cause of all the deeds. Human life has to reap the harvest of the deeds but the soul remains detached from the same. The reflection of the soul is considered to be the body as well as the soul in it. The body consists of the five perishable elements.

## \|\| 25.15 \|\|

*pṛthivī vāyurākāśo jalaṃ tejastathaiva ca \|*  
*etāni sūtrarūpāṇi sṛṣṭiḥ sṛṣṭividhau hareḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. In the universe of the lord, there are five elements known as the earth, the wind, the sky, the water and the fire.

## \|\| 25.16 \|\|

*karttā bhoktā ca dehī ca svātmā bhojayitā sadā \|*  
*bhogo vibhavabhedaśca niṣkṛtirmuktireva ca \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The body is the perfonner and the soul enjoys the results of the deeds. There are several types of pleasures of the world and the one who detracts himself from the same is sure to achieve salvation.

## \|\| 25.17 \|\|

*sadasadbhedabījaṃ ca jñānaṃ nānāvidhaṃ bhavet \|*  
*viṣayāṇāṃ vibhāgānāṃ bhedabījaṃ ca kīrttitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The knowledge about truth and untruth is of several types. The subject of Ghata and Pata are the different parts of the same knowledge.

## \|\| 25.18-24 \|\|

*buddhirvivecanārūpā jñānasaṃdīpinī śrutau \|*  
*vāyubhedāśca vai prāṇā balarūpāśca dehinām \|\| 18 \|\|*

*indriyāṇāṃ vai pravaramīśvarāṇāṃ samūhakam \|*  
*prerakaṃ karmaṇāṃ caiva durnivāryaṃ ca dehinām \|\| 19 \|\|*

*anirūpyamadṛśyaṃ ca jñānabhedaṃ manaḥ smṛtam \|*  
*locanaṃ śravaṇaṃ prāṇaṃ tvagjihvādikamindriyam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*aṅgināmaṅga rūpaṃ ca prerakaṃ sarvakarmaṇām \|*  
*ripurūpaṃ mitrarūpaṃ sukhadaṃ duḥkhadaṃ sadā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*sūryyo vāyuśca pṛthivī vāṇyādyā devatāḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*prāṇadehādibhṛdyo hi sa jīvaḥ parikīrttitaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*paramātmā paraṃ brahma nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|*  
*kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ mayā pṛṣṭaṃ yathāgamam \|*  
*jñānināṃ jñānarūpaṃ ca gaccha vatse yathāsukham \|\| 24 \|\|*

18-24. The force which can distinguish between the various elements is called wisdom. Such elements are known in the Vedas as the seed of knowledge. Life is contained in the different forms of the wind. The wind is the only source of keeping the sense organs active. The one which is the main essence of the supreme soul in the organs of senses, alone influences one in performing deeds, is inescapable for the creatures, is invisible and is a particle of wisdom. It is called the mind, it is the inspiration for all the actions of the creatures. It puts a man in grief by attracting him towards evil and becomes his enemy but when it diverts a person to noble deeds bestowing pleasure on him, it becomes his friend. The eyes, the ears, the nose, the skin and the tongue are the organs of senses. The sun, the wind, the earth and speech are the lords of the organs of senses. The one who bears the life and the body is called the Jlva. The lord himself address Shri Krishna as the supreme soul and Parabrahman, who is invisible, beyond nature and is the cause of all the causes. О daughter, I have thus given you replies to all the questions put forth by you according to the shastras and which serve as great wisdom for the intellectuals. Therefore you leave the place now.

## \|\| 25.25 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*tyaktvā kva yāmi kāntaṃ vā tvāṃ vā jñānārṇavaṃ budham \|*  
*praśnaṃ yadyatkaromi tvāṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhati \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Savitri said — “Where shall I go leaving my husband and a person like you who are the ocean of Knowledge? Whatever questions I ask from you, kindly give me the answer.

## \|\| 25.26-27 \|\|

*kāṃ kāṃ yoniṃ yāti jīvaḥ karmaṇā kena vā yama \|*  
*kena vā karmaṇā svargaṃ kena vā narakaṃ pitaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*kena vā karmaṇā muktiḥ kena bhaktirbhaveddhareḥ \|*  
*kena vā karmaṇā rogī cārogī kena karmaṇā \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. Yama, with the influences of one's deeds, how many times one has to be reborn? О father, by performing which deeds does one go either to heaven or hell? Name to me the deeds by the performance of which one obtains the devotion of the lord. By performing which deed, does a man suffer from ailments and by performing which deeds is one freed from the ailment?

## \|\| 25.28-29 \|\|

*kena vā dīrghajīvī ca kenālpāyuśca karmmaṇā \|*  
*kena vā karmmaṇā duḥkhī kena vā karmmaṇā sukhī \|\| 28 \|\|*

*aṅgahīnaśca kāṇaśca badhiraḥ kena karmmaṇā \|*  
*andho vā kṛpaṇo vā'pi pramattaḥ kena karmmaṇā \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. By performing which deed does one get long life and by performing which does one get short life? By performing which deed does one become grief-stricken and by performing which deed does one enjoy pleasure? By performing which deed is one born in life like limbless, one-eyed, deaf, blind, a miser or insane and a nagligent?

## \|\| 25.30 \|\|

*kṣipto'tilubdhakaścaiva kena vā naraghātakaḥ \|*  
*kena siddhimavāpnoti sālokyādicatuṣṭayam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. By performing which deeds does one become greedy, a great hunter or the killer of the people? How can one achieve success or the Salokya type of salvation?

## \|\| 25.31 \|\|

*kena vā brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca tapasvitvaṃ ca kena vā \|*  
*svargabhogādikaṃ kena vaikuṇṭhaṃ kena karmmaṇā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. By perfonning which deeds does one become a Brahmana and an ascetic? By performing which deeds does one enjoy the pleasure of heaven and by performing which deeds does one achieve Vaikuntha?

## \|\| 25.32 \|\|

*golokaṃ kena vā brahmansarvotkṛṣṭaṃ nirāmayam \|*  
*narakaṃ vā katividhaṃ kiṃ saṃkhyaṃ nāma kiṃ tathā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. О Brahman, by performing which deeds does one achieve Goloka, which is the best and all spotless? You kindly tell me the number and nature of hells.

## \|\| 25.33-34 \|\|

*ko vā kaṃ narakaṃ yāti kiyantaṃ teṣu tiṣṭhati \|*  
*pāpināṃ karmmaṇā kena ko vā vyādhiḥ prajāyate \|\| 33 \|\|*

*yadyadasti mayā pṛṣṭaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. How does one achieve them and the period for which one stays there and what type of ailments have to be suffered by the sinners, you kindly answer me all the questions which I have put up to you.

## Chapter 26

## \|\| 26.1 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*sāvitrīvacanaṃ śrutvā jagāma vismayaṃ yamaḥ \|*  
*prahasya vaktumārebhe karmapākaṃ ca jīvinām \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said — On hearing the words of Savitri, Yama was surprised and he then smiled and started speaking on the reward given to the humans as a result of their actions.

## \|\| 26.2 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*kanyā dvādaśavarṣīyā vatse tvaṃ vayasā'dhunā \|*  
*jñānaṃ te pūrvaviduṣāṃ yogināṃ jñānināṃ param \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Yama said — О daughter, though you are at present a girl of twelve years age yet you possess intelligence of a great yogi of ancient times besides the intellectuals.

## \|\| 26.3 \|\|

*sāvitrīvaradānena tvaṃ sāvitrīkalā sati \|*  
*prāptā purā bhūbhṛtā ca tapasā tatsamā śubhe \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О damsel, in earlier times, your father performed a great tapas and got you as a boon from goddess Savitri. You have achieved intelligence and beauty because you are born of the ray of Savitri.

## \|\| 26.4-7 \|\|

*yathā śrīḥ śrīpateḥ kroḍe bhavānī ca bhavorasi \|*  
*yathā rādhā ca śrīkṛṣṇe sāvitrī brahmavakṣasi \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dharmorasi yathā mūrttiḥ śatarūpā manau yathā \|*  
*kardame devahūtiśca vasiṣṭhe'rundhatī yathā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*aditiḥ kaśyape cāpi yathā'halyā ca gautame \|*  
*yathā śacī mahendre ca yathā candre ca rohiṇī \|\| 6 \|\|*

*yathā ratiḥ kāmadeve yathā svāhā hutāśane \|*  
*yathā svadhā ca pitṛṣu yathā saṃjñā divākare \|\| 7 \|\|*

4-7. Therefore as Lakshmi achieves glory in the lap of Vishnu, BhavanI in the lap of Shiva, Radha in the lap of Krishna, Savitri in the lap of Brahma, Mflrti in the lap of Dharma, Satarupa in the lap of Manu, Devahtiti in the lap of Kardama, Arundhati in the lap of Vasistha, Aditi in the lap of Kashyapa, Ahalya in the lap of Gautama, Indrani in the lap of Indra, Rohini in the lap of Chandrama, Rati in the lap of Kamadeva, Svaha in the lap of Agni, Svadha with the Pitris, Saiijna with the Sun.

## \|\| 26.8-9 \|\|

*varuṇānī ca varuṇe yajñe ca dakṣiṇā yathā \|*  
*yathā dharā varāhe ca devasenā ca kārtike \|\| 8 \|\|*

*saubhāgyā supriyā tvaṃ ca bhava satyavati priye \|*  
*iti tubhyaṃ varaṃ dattamaparaṃ ca yadīpsitam \|*  
*vṛṇu devi mahābhāge sarvaṃ dāsyāmi niścitam \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Varunanl in the lap of Varuna, daksina in the lap of yajna, PrthivI in the lap of the Varaha incarnation of the lord and Devsena in the lap of Karttikeya feel glorious, similarly, О dear one, you will also become glorious in the lap of the fortunate Satyavan. I bestow this boon on you. О goddess, О virtuous one, what more can you ask from me? Whatever else is desired by you. I shall surely give you.

## \|\| 26.10-11 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*satyavadaurasenaiva putrāṇāṃ śatakaṃ mama \|*  
*bhaviṣyati mahābhāga varametanmadīpsitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*matpituḥ putraśatakaṃ śvaśurasya ca cakṣuṣī \|*  
*rājyalābho bhavatveva varamevaṃ madīpsitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Savitri said — О lord, I should get sons with the company of my husband Satyavan. This is my desire. Besides this, the eye-sight of my father-in-law may be restored and my father should be bestowed with a hundred sons. I should get back my kingdom. You kindly fulfil this desire of mine.

## \|\| 26.12-13 \|\|

*ante satyavatā sārddhaṃ yāsyāmi harimandiram \|*  
*samatīte lakṣavarṣe dehīmaṃ me jagatprabho \|\| 12 \|\|*

*jīvakarmavipākaṃ ca śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ ca me \|*  
*viśvavistārabījaṃ ca tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. О lord of the universe. I, after enjoying the company of my husband Satyavan for a lakh of years, should proceed to the abode of Vishnu. This is the boon I require from you. О lord, you kindly enlighten me on the process of the soul crossing the ocean of this universe. You kindly tell me. I am quite anxious to listen to it. You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 26.14-15 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*bhaviṣyati mahāsādhvi sarvaṃ mānasikaṃ tava \|*  
*jīvakarmmavipākaṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya \|\| 14 \|\|*

*śubhānāmaśubhānāṃ ca karmmaṇāṃ janma bhārate \|*  
*puṇyakṣetre'tra sarvatra nānyatra bhuñjate janāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Yama said — О immensely chaste lady, all your desires wil be fulfilled. I am now telling you about the reward of the deeds of the people. You listen to it. In the land of Bharata, there emerge good and bad deeds and the people have to reap the harvest of their good or bad deeds, here itself and nowhere else.

## \|\| 26.16 \|\|

*surā daityā dānavāśca gandharvā rākṣasādayaḥ \|*  
*narāśca karmmajanakā na sarve samajīvinaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. All the gods, the demons, the Danavas, Gandharvas, Raksasas and humans have to face the reward of their actions but this is not equal for all.

## \|\| 26.17-21 \|\|

*viśiṣṭajīvinaḥ karmma bhuñjate sarvayoniṣu \|*  
*viśeṣato mānavāśca bhramanti sarvayoniṣu \|\| 17 \|\|*

*śubhāśubhaṃ bhuñjate ca karma pūrvārjitaṃ param \|*  
*śubhena karmaṇā yānti te svargādikameva ca \|\| 18 \|\|*

*karmmaṇā cāśubhenaiva bhramanti narakeṣu ca \|*  
*karmmanirmūlane muktiḥ sā coktā dvividhā matā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*nirvāṇarūpā sevā ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*kukarmaṇā jīvaścārogī śubhakarmaṇā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*dīrghajīvī ca kṣīṇāyuḥ sukhī duḥkhī ca niścitam \|*  
*andhādayaścāṅgahīnāḥ kutsitena ca karmaṇā \|\| 21 \|\|*

17-21. Out of them only the humans perfonn the deeds or otherwise it is only in human form that one has to perfonn the good or bad deeds but the reward of the same good or bad deeds has to be faced in heaven or hell. The humans specially have to reap the harvest of their deeds in many births. They have to suffer for the misdeeds committed by them in their earlier births. As a result of performing the good deeds they go to heaven and by performing the bad deeds they have to go to hell. By not performing, one is freed from the result of the actions and achieves salvation. О chaste lady, salvation too is of two types, one is the salvation from birth and death and the other results in devotion of lord Krishna. By perforating bad deeds one attracts ailments and by performing good deeds, he is freed from the ailment. Because of the good or bad deeds he attains long life, short life, pleasure or pain.

## \|\| 26.22-23 \|\|

*siddhyādikamavāpnoti sarvotkṛṣṭena karmmaṇā \|*  
*sāmānyaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sundari \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sudurlabhaṃ subhogyaṃ ca purāṇeṣu śrutiṣvapi \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. The one who performs bad deeds is born deformed, blind, deaf or having other deformities. The one who performs good deeds, meets with success.Thus, I have told you about the reward of ordinary deeds. Now you listen from me to something special which has been termed as difficult to get in the Shrutis.

## \|\| 26.24-25 \|\|

*durlabhā mānavī jātiḥ sarvajātiṣu bhārate \|*  
*sarvābhyo brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ praśastaḥ sarvakarmmasu \|\| 24 \|\|*

*viṣṇubhakto dvijaścaiva garīyānbhārate tataḥ \|*  
*niṣkāmaśca sakāmaśca vaiṣṇavo dvividhaḥ sati \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. For all the regions, it is difficult to be born on the sacred land of Bharata. О chaste lady of all the castes, the Brahmanas are the best and have been commended for their noble deeds in the land of Bharata. Such of the Brahmanas as are devoted to lord Vinsu are considered to be the best. The Vaishnavas are also of two types: those who perform selfless deeds and those who perfonn deeds with some desire in their mind.

## \|\| 26.26 \|\|

*sakāmaśca pradhānaśca niṣkāmo bhakta eva ca \|*  
*karmabhogī sakāmaśca niṣkāmo nirupadravaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The Vaishnavas who perform deeds with definite desire, treat their actions as more important but the selfless devotees of lord Vishnu give importance only to the devotion. The Vais navas with desires has to face the result of his actions, whereas the selfless Vaishnava is free from the result of his good or bad actions.

## \|\| 26.27 \|\|

*sa yāti dehaṃ tyaktā ca padaṃ viṣṇornirāmayam \|*  
*punarāgamanaṃ nāsti teṣāṃ niṣkāmiṇāṃ sati \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The selfless devotee of Vishnu, after his death, achieves the abode of Vishnu and being selfless, he never comes back from that place.

## \|\| 26.28 \|\|

*ye sevante ca dvibhujaṃ kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram \|*  
*golokaṃ yānti te bhaktā divyarūpavidhāriṇaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Such of the devotees as adore the two armed lord Krishna, proceed to Goloka after death taking to a divine form.

## \|\| 26.29 \|\|

*ye ca nārāyaṇaṃ bhaktāḥ sevante ca caturbhujam \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhaṃ yānti te sarve divyarūpavidhāriṇaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Such of the devotees as meditate upon the four armed Vishnu, taking to divine form, go to Vaikunlha.

## \|\| 26.30-31 \|\|

*sakāmino vaiṣṇavāśca gatvā vaikuṇṭhameva ca \|*  
*bhārataṃ punarāyānti teṣāṃ janma dvijātiṣu \|\| 30 \|\|*

*kālena te ca niṣkāmā bhaviṣyanti krameṇa ca \|*  
*bhaktiṃ ca nirmalāṃ buddhiṃ tebhyo dāsyati niścitam \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. But the Vaishnavas who adore Vishnu purposefully, have to come back to the land of Bharata, after staying in Vaikuntha and are reborn as Brahmanas. After the passage of time they also get turned into selfless devotees of lord Vishnu because the lord also bestows on them his devotion and spotless wisdom.

## \|\| 26.32-33 \|\|

*brāhmaṇādvaiṣṇavādanye sakāmāḥ sarvajanmasu \|*  
*na teṣāṃ nirmalā buddhirviṣṇubhaktivivarjitāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*tīrthāśritā dvijā ye ca tapasyāniratāḥ sati \|*  
*te yānti brahmalokaṃ ca punarāyānti bhāratam \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. Besides the Vaishnavas1 all other devotees of Vishnu adore him purposefully but because they do not have the deep devotion of the lord in their minds, their wisdom does not become spotless. Such of the Brahmanas as engage themselves in tapas while dwelling at the sacred place, achieve Brahmaloka and after the completion of their prescribed period they have to return several times over to the land of Bharata.

## \|\| 26.34 \|\|

*svadharmaniratā viprāḥ sūryyabhaktāśca bhārate \|*  
*vrajanti sūryalokaṃ te punarāyānti bhāratam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Those of the people that following their own dharmas adore the sun, go to Silryaloka and return to the land of Bharata after some time.

## \|\| 26.35 \|\|

*svadharmaniratā viprāḥ śaivāḥ śāktāśca gāṇapāḥ \|*  
*te yānti śivalokaṃ ca punarāyānti bhāratam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Similarly following their own Dharma such of the Brahmanas as adore Shiva, Durga and Ganesha proceed to the abode of Shivaloka and return after some time.

## \|\| 26.36-37 \|\|

*ye viprā anyadeveṣṭāḥ svadharmaniratāḥ sati \|*  
*te gatvā śakralokaṃ ca punarāyānti bhāratam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*haribhaktāśca niṣkāmāḥ svadharmmarahitā dvijāḥ \|*  
*te'pi yānti harerlokaṃ kramādbhaktibalādaho \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Such of the Brahmanas as adore other dharmas, go to Indraloka and then return after sometime. Such of the selfless devotee Brahmanas as are devoted to their own family-gods, also achieve the abode of Vishnu on the strength of their devotion.

## \|\| 26.38 \|\|

*svadharmmarahitā viprā devānyasevinaḥ sadā \|*  
*bhraṣṭācārāśca bālāśca te yāṃti narakaṃ dhruvam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Such of the Brahmanas as are devoid of their own dharma and adore some demi-god besides having a polluted and wicked mind surely fall into the hell.

## \|\| 26.39 \|\|

*svadharmmaniratāścaivaṃ varṇāścatvāra eva ca \|*  
*bhavantyeva śubhasyaiva karmaṇaḥ phalabhāginaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Therefore the people of all the four varanas if they adore their respectives gods, surely reap the good results of the same.

## \|\| 26.40 \|\|

*svadharmmarahitāste ca narakaṃ yānti hi dhruvam \|*  
*bhārate ca bhavantyeva karmmaṇaḥ phalabhāginaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. In case they fall from their dharma they surely go to the hell, because in the land of Bharata one has to reap the harvest of his good or bad deeds.

## \|\| 26.41-42 \|\|

*svadharmaniratā viprāḥ svadharmaniratāya ca \|*  
*kanyāṃ dadati viprāya candralokaṃ vrajanti te \|\| 41 \|\|*

*vasaṃti tatra te sādhvi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa \|*  
*sālaṅkṛtāyā dānena dviguṇaṃ phalamucyate \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. A Brahmana who gets devoted to his own dharma and gives away his own daughter to the followers of the same dharma, goes to Chandraloka. He remains there up to the duration of the life of fourteen Indras. О chaste lady, in case a daughter adorned with all the ornaments is given away in marriage, one gets double the merit for the same.

## \|\| 26.43 \|\|

*sakāmā yāṃti tallokaṃ na niṣkāmāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ \|*  
*te prayāṃti viṣṇulokaṃ phalasandhānavarjitāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. But a Brahmana with a mind filled with desires cannot equate with a selfless Vaishnava. Such people remain seperate because of their desire for the good deeds performed by them and then proceed to the abode of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 26.44-45 \|\|

*gavyaṃ ca rajataṃ bhāryāṃ vastraṃ sasyaṃ phalaṃ jalam \|*  
*ye dadatyeva viprebhyastallokaṃ hi vrajanti ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

*vasaṃti te ca tallokaṃ yāvanmanvantaraṃ sati \|*  
*kālaṃ ca suciraṃ vāsaṃ kurvaṃti tatra te janāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. Such of the people who give away in charity the cow’s milk, silver, clothes, fruit, the food and water also go to the same loka and remain there up to a manvantara. Thus they reside there for a long time.

## \|\| 26.46-47 \|\|

*ye dadati suvarṇaṃ ca gāṃ ca tāmrādikaṃ sati \|*  
*te yāṃti sūryalokaṃ ca śucaye brāhmaṇāya ca \|\| 46 \|\|*

*vasanti tatra te loke varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati \|*  
*vipule ca ciraṃ vāsaṃ kurvaṃti ca nirāmayāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. The noble Brahmana when he gives away gold, the cow, copper in charity, goes to heaven. He resides there for ten thousand years. Thereafter without any obstruction he stays there for a long time.

## \|\| 26.48-49 \|\|

*dadāti bhūmiṃ viprebhyo dhānyāni vipulāni ca \|*  
*sa yāti viṣṇulokaṃ ca śvetadvīpaṃ manoharam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*tatraiva nivasatyeva yāvaccandradivākarau \|*  
*vipulaṃ vipule vāsaṃ karoti puṇyavānsati \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. The one who gives away in charity, the land, immense riches to a Brahmana, he goes to the Vishnuloka as well as Shvetadvipa. They dwell there up to the life of the sun and moon. He, the meritorious lives there for a long time.

## \|\| 26.50 \|\|

*gṛhaṃ dadaṃti viprāya ye janā bhaktipūrvakam \|*  
*te yāṃti suralokaṃ ca ciraṃ tatra bhavaṃti te \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The one who gives away to a Brahmana with devotion a house in charity, goes to heaven and stays there for a long time.

## \|\| 26.51-52 \|\|

*gṛhareṇupramāṇābdaṃ dānaṃ puṇyadine yadi \|*  
*vipulaṃ vipule vāsaṃ kurvaṃti mānavāḥ sati \|\| 51 \|\|*

*yasmai yasmai ca devāya yo dadāti gṛhaṃ naraḥ \|*  
*sa yāti tasya lokaṃ ca reṇumānābdameva ca \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. If someone gives away in charity at an auspicious day an account book, he resides in the heaven for a period of the dust of that house still remains. Thus whosoever gives away in charity in favour of any god, goes to the abode of the same god and resides there for a long time.

## \|\| 26.53 \|\|

*saudhe caturguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ pūrtte śataguṇaṃ phalam \|*  
*prakṛṣṭe'ṣṭaguṇaṃ tasmādityāha kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. In case one performs charity in a temple instead of his own house, he gets four times the merit. The one who constructs a step-well or a tank gets a hundred times more merit and in case the same is done at a sacred place the merit is multiplied to eight times. This has been ordained by Brahma.

## \|\| 26.54 \|\|

*yo dadāti taḍāgaṃ ca sarvabhūtāya bhārate \|*  
*sa yāti janalokaṃ ca varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. In the land of Bharata whosoever constructs a tank and gives it away in charity he gets a hundred times the merit. The one who constructs a bridge, earns the merit of constructing a tank.

## \|\| 26.55-56 \|\|

*vāpyāṃ phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ prāpnoti mānavastataḥ \|*  
*tathā setupradānena taḍāgasya phalaṃ labhet \|\| 55 \|\|*

*dhanuścatuḥsahasreṇa dairghyamānena niścitam \|*  
*nyūnā vā tāvatī prasthe sā vāpī parikīrttitā \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. The size of the tank should be four thousand dhamisas (one dhanusa is four feet in length and four feet in breadth) Such pf the tanks which are smaller than this size are called step-wells.

## \|\| 26.57 \|\|

*daśavāpīsamā kanyā yadi pātre pradīyate \|*  
*phalaṃ dadāti dviguṇaṃ yadi sālaṃkṛtā bhavet \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. If one gives away his daughter to a competent person he earns the merit of constructing ten step-wells. If the daughter is given away in marriage adorned with all the ornaments, one earns double the merit.

## \|\| 26.58-59 \|\|

*tatphalaṃ ca taḍāge ca paṅkoddhāreṇa tatphalam \|*  
*vāpyāśca paṃkoddhāreṇa vāpītulyaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 58 \|\|*

*aśvatthavṛkṣamāropya pratiṣṭhāṃ ca karoti yaḥ \|*  
*sa yāti tapaso lokaṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ param \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. The merit one earns by constructing a tank, the same merit is earned by him by repairing it. One who plants a PIpala tree and consecrates it, he resides in Tapoloka for a thousand years.

## \|\| 26.60 \|\|

*puṣpodyānaṃ yo dadāti sāvitri sarvabhūtaye \|*  
*sa vaseddhruvaloke ca varṣāṇāmayutaṃ dhruvam \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. О Savitri, the one who grows a beautiful garden and orchard and opens it for the use of the people, he remains in the Dhruvaloka for ten thousand years. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 26.61-62 \|\|

*yo dadāti vimānaṃ ca viṣṇave bhārate sati \|*  
*viṣṇuloke vasetso'pi yāvanmanvantaraṃ param \|\| 61 \|\|*

*citrayukte ca vipule phalaṃ tasya caturguṇam \|*  
*rathārdhaṃ śibikādāne phalameva labheddhruvam \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. In the land of Bharata, the one who gives away in charity a chariot to lord Vishnu resides in his abode for a marivantara. If q chariot is given away in charity fully decorated with paintings flowers, one earns four times the merit and if apalanquin (palakl) is given away in charity, one gets half of the merit of donating the chariot.

## \|\| 26.63-64 \|\|

*yo dadāti bhaktiyukto haraye dolamandiram \|*  
*viṣṇuloke vasetso'pi yāvanmanvataraṃ param \|\| 63 \|\|*

*rājamārgaṃ saudhayuktaṃ yaḥ karoti pativrate \|*  
*varṣāṇāmayutaṃ so'pi śakraloke mahīyate \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. The one who constructs a temple for lord Vis nu, resides in the abode of the lord for a manvantara. О chaste lady, the one who constructs a road and also provides shelters in appropriate places, resides in Indraloka for ten thousand years.

## \|\| 26.65 \|\|

*brāhmaṇebhyo'pi devebhyo dāne samaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*yacca dattaṃ hi tadbhokturna dattaṃ nopatiṣṭhate \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Thus by giving away charities to Brahmanas and the gods, one earns equal merit. The merit one earns by performing charity in earlier births is received by him in the subsequent births. The one which is not given, how can it be received?

## \|\| 26.66-67 \|\|

*bhuktvā svargādikaṃ saukhyaṃ punarāyānti bhārate \|*  
*labhedviprakuleṣveva krameṇaivottamādiṣu \|\| 66 \|\|*

*bhārate puṇyavānvipro bhuktvā svargādikaṃ param \|*  
*punaḥ so'pi bhavedvipro na punaḥ kṣatriyādayaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. Such of the people are reborn on earth after enjoying all pleasures of the heaven, in the race of Brahmanas and others. The meritorious Brahmanas are reborn in the land of Bharata after enjoying all the pleasures of heaven but the same rule does not apply to the Kshatriyas.

## \|\| 26.68-69 \|\|

*kṣatriyo vā'pi vaiśyo vā kalpakoṭiśatena ca \|*  
*tapasā brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca na prāpnoti śrutau śrutam \|\| 68 \|\|*

*svadharmarahitā viprā nānāyoniṃ vrajanti ca \|*  
*bhuktvā ca karmabhāgaṃ ca viprayoniṃ labhetpunaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. The Kshatriyas and the Vaisyas can achieve Brahmana-hood by performing tapas for a crore of kalpas. This has been ordained in the Vedas. The Brahmana who is deprived of all his dharma, wander in many births and facing the result of his own deeds ultimately is reborn.

## \|\| 26.70-71 \|\|

*nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karmma kalpakoṭiśatairapi \|*  
*avaśyavameva bhoktavyaṃ kalpakoṭiśatairapi \|\| 70 \|\|*

*avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham \|*  
*devatīrthe sahāyena kāyavyūhena śudhyati \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. After the passing of the crores of kalpas the effect of deeds do not vanish and one has to bear the same. One has to face the reward of his good or bad deeds. A person gets purified with the help of the gods and taking baths in the sacred places. О chaste lady, I have told you everything. What more do you want to listen to from me?

## Chapter 27

## \|\| 27.1 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*prayāṃti svargamanyaṃ ca yena yenaiva karmmaṇā \|*  
*mānavāḥ puṇyavantaśca tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Savitri said — You kindly tell me the means by which the meritorius person proceeds to heaven?

## \|\| 27.2 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*annadānaṃ ca viprāya yaḥ karoti ca bhārate \|*  
*annapramāṇavarṣa ca śakraloke mahīyate \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Yama said — In the land of Bharata, the one who offers food to a Brahmana, enjoys his stay in the Indraloka for the number of years equivalent to the number of particles of the food given in charity.

## \|\| 27.3 \|\|

*annadānātparaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati \|*  
*nātra pātraparīkṣā syānna kālaniyamaḥ kvacit \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. But there is no greater merit than the giving away of food in charity nor shall it be there in future. In such a case, one does not have to test about the suitability of the receiver nor could the time for giving away in charity be prescribed.

## \|\| 27.4 \|\|

*devebhyo brāhmaṇebhyo vā dadāti cāsanaṃ yadi \|*  
*mahīyate vahniloke varṣāṇāmayutaṃ dhruvam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The one who offers a seat to the gods or the Brahmanas, enjoys the pleasure of staying in Agniloka for ten thousand years.

## \|\| 27.5 \|\|

*yo dadāti ca viprāya divyāṃ dhenuṃ payasvinīm \|*  
*tallomamānavarṇaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhe ca mahīyate \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The one who gives away in charity to a Brahmana, a wet cow, enjoys the pleasure of staying in Vaikuntha for the number of years equivalent to the hair on the body of the cow and earns great respects there.

## \|\| 27.6 \|\|

*caturguṇaṃ puṇyadine tīrthe śataguṇaṃ phalam \|*  
*dānaṃ nārāyaṇakṣetre phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. In case a cow is given in charity on some auspicious occasion, the accruing merit is multiplied to four times. In case the same charity is offered at a sacred place the merit is multiplied to a hundred times. But if the same charity is offered in the region of Narayana, the charity gets multiplied to a crore of times.

## \|\| 27.7-8 \|\|

*gāṃ yo dadāti viprāya bhārate bhaktipūrvakam \|*  
*varṣāṇāmayutaṃ caiva candraloke mahīyate \|\| 7 \|\|*

*yaścobhayamukhīdānaṃ karoti brāhmaṇāya ca \|*  
*tallomamānavarṣaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhe ca mahīyate \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. In the land of Bharata the one who gives away a cow in charity to a Brahmana, enjoys a blissful life in the region of moon for ten thousand years. The one who gives away to Brahmana a milch cow, remains in Vaikuntha for the number of years equivalent to the hair on the body of the cow.

## \|\| 27.9 \|\|

*yo dadāti brāhmaṇāya śāligrāmaṃ savastrakam \|*  
*mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe yāvaccandradivākarau \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. One, who gives in charity an image of Shalagrama together with the clothes to a Brahmana, enjoys his stay in Vaikuntha for as long as the sun and the moon last.

## \|\| 27.10 \|\|

*yo dadāti brāhmaṇāya chatraṃ ca sumanoharam \|*  
*varṣāṇāmayutaṃ so'pi modate varuṇālaye \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The one who offers a beautiful umbrella to a Brahmana, enjoys his stay in the Varunaloka for ten thousand years.

## \|\| 27.11 \|\|

*viprāya pādukāyugmaṃ yo dadāti ca bhārate \|*  
*mahīyate vāyuloke varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. In the land of Bharata if one offers sandals to a Brahmana, enjoys a stay in Vayuloka for ten thousand years.

## \|\| 27.12 \|\|

*yo dadāti brāhmaṇāya śayyāṃ divyāṃ manoharām \|*  
*mahīyate candraloke yāvaccandradivākarau \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Anyone who gives away in charity to Brahmana a beautiful and divine bed remains in heaven for as long as the sun and the moon last.

## \|\| 27.13 \|\|
