*yo dadāti pradīpaṃ ca devāya brāhmaṇāya ca \|*  
*yāvanmanvantaraṃ so'pi brahmaloke mahīyate \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. О beautiful one, the one who gives away to a Brahmana a lamp in charity, stays in heaven for a manvantara and is adored there.

## \|\| 27.14 \|\|

*samprāpya mānavīṃ yoniṃ cakṣuṣmāṃśca bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*na yāti yamalokaṃ ca tena puṇyena sundari \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. By the merit of that charity his eye-sight always remains intact and he never goes to the abode of Yama.

## \|\| 27.15 \|\|

*karoti gajadānaṃ ca yo hi viprāya bhārate \|*  
*yāvadindrādidevasya loke cārdhāsane vaset \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The one who gives away in charity an elephant to a Brahmana in the land of Bharata, lives in Indraloka for a period as long as Indra lasts. Indra shares his throne with such a person.

## \|\| 27.16 \|\|

*bhārate yo'śvadānaṃ ca karoti brāhmaṇāya ca \|*  
*modate vāruṇe loke yāvadindrāścaturdaśa \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. In the land of Bharata if anyone offers a horse in charity to a Brahmana, he remains in the Varunaloka for the period of the duration of fourteen Indras. He enjoy his life there.

## \|\| 27.17 \|\|

*prakṛṣṭāṃ śibikāṃ yo hi dadāti brāhmaṇāya ca \|*  
*mahīyate viṣṇuloke yāvanmanvantaraṃ sati \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The one who gives away in charity a beautiful, palanquin, resides in Vishnuloka for a manvantara and is respected there.

## \|\| 27.18 \|\|

*yo dadāti ca viprāya vyajanaṃ śvetacāmaram \|*  
*mahīyate vāyuloke varṣāṇāmayutaṃ dhruvam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The one who gives away in charity a white fly-whisk to a Brahmana, enjoys pleasure in the Vayuloka, for ten thousands years.

## \|\| 27.19 \|\|

*dhānyācalaṃ yo dadāti brāhmaṇāya ca bhārate \|*  
*sa ca dhānyapramāṇābdaṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The one who gives away land in Bharata, with heaps of paddy equivalent to the size of a mountain, enjoys comfortable life in Vishnuloka for the number of years equivalent to the number of the paddy given away.

## \|\| 27.20 \|\|

*tataḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya cirajīvī bhavetsukhī \|*  
*dātā grahītā tau dvau ca dhruvaṃ vaikuṇṭhagāminau \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Thereafter he is reborn in the human race and enjoys a comfortable long life. Thus the one who gives away in charity and the one who receives it, both of them stay in Vaikuntha.

## \|\| 27.21 \|\|

*satataṃ śrīharernāma bhārate yo japennaraḥ \|*  
*sa eva cirajīvī ca tato mṛtyuḥ palāyate \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. In the land of Bharata due to the perpetual recitation of the name of lord Vishnu, they enjoy a long life and death runs away at their very sight.

## \|\| 27.22-23 \|\|

*yo naro bhārate varṣe dolanaṃ kārayeddhareḥ \|*  
*pūrṇimārajanīśeṣe jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante viṣṇumandiram \|*  
*niścitaṃ nivasettatra śatamanvantarāvadhi \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. The one who gives away in charity a beautiful queen to lord Krishna on the full moon night, is freed from all bondages. After enjoying all the pleasures in his present life he proceeds to Vis nuloka and there also he lives for a hundred manvantaras.

## \|\| 27.24-25 \|\|

*phalamuttaraphālgunyāṃ tato'pi dviguṇaṃ bhavet \|*  
*kalpāntajīvī sa bhavedityāha kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*tiladānaṃ brāhmaṇāya yaḥ karoti ca bhārate \|*  
*tilapramāṇavarṣaṃ ca modate viṣṇumandire \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. In the uttara-phalguni constellation, the one who celebrates the Dolotsava, earns double the merit. Such a person remains alive up to the end of kalpa. This has been ordained by Brahma. The one who offers in charity the sheshamum seeds to a Brahmana in the land of Bharata, remains in Vis nloka for as many years as the number of the seeds of the sheshamum.

## \|\| 27.26 \|\|

*tataḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya cirajīvī bhavetsukhī \|*  
*tāmrapātrasthadānena dviguṇaṃ ca phalaṃ labhet \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Thereafter he is reborn in the human race and enjoys comfortable life for long. The one who gives away in charity these same seeds in a copper vase, earns double the merit.

## \|\| 27.27-28 \|\|

*sālaṃkṛtāṃ ca bhogyāṃ ca savastrāṃ sundarīṃ priyām \|*  
*yo dadāti brāhmaṇā ya bhārate ca pativratām \|\| 27 \|\|*

*mahīyate candraloke yāvadindrāścaturdaśa \|*  
*tatra svarveśyayā sārddhaṃ modate ca divāniśam \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. The one who gives away in charity to a Brahmana a beautiful chaste girl adorned with all ornaments and clad in beautiful costumes, is respected in the Chandraloka, for a period of fourteen Indras, where he will spend his time always in the company of Apsaras quite delightfully.

## \|\| 27.29-30 \|\|

*tato gandharvaloke ca varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati \|*  
*divāniśaṃ kautukena corvaśyā saha modate \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tato janmasahasraṃ ca prāpnoti sundarīṃ priyām \|*  
*satīṃ saubhāgyayuktāṃ ca komalāṃ priyavādinīm \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. Thereafter he will spend ten thousand years in the Gandharvaloka enjoying the company of Urvasl. Thereafter for a thousand births he will get a beautiful beloved who will be quite chaste, fortunate, tender-limbed and one who would speak in a sweet voice.

## \|\| 27.31 \|\|

*dadāti saphalaṃ vṛkṣaṃ brāhmaṇāya ca yo naraḥ \|*  
*phalapramāṇavarṣaṃ ca śakraloke mahīyate \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The one who gives away in charity to a Brahmana a tree laden with fruits, is adored in Indraloka for the number of years equivalent to the number the fruits in the trees.

## \|\| 27.32 \|\|

*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya labhate sutamuttamam \|*  
*saphalānāṃ ca vṛkṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca praśaṃsitam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Thereafter he is reborn in human race and because of the glory of the tree laden with the fruits given by him in charity, he gets a virtuous son. The glory of giving away in charity the trees laden with fruits has been described to have a thousand times more merit.

## \|\| 27.33-35 \|\|

*kevalaṃ phaladānaṃ ca brāhmaṇāya dadāti yaḥ \|*  
*suciraṃ svargavāsaṃ ca kṛtvā yāti ca bhāratam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*nānādravyasamāyuktaṃ nānāsasyasamanvitam \|*  
*dadāti yaśca viprāya bhārate vipulaṃ gṛham \|\| 34 \|\|*

*kuberaloke vasati sa ca manvantarāvadhi \|*  
*tataḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya mahāṃśca dhanavānbhavet \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. The one who gives away to a Brahmana in charity only the fruits, resides in heaven for a long time and thereafter he is reborn in the land of Bharata. If a person residing in Bharata gives away a house with many valuables and filled with cereals to a Brahmana, (as a result of the same) he remains in the abode of Kubera for a long time. Thereafter he is reborn in the human race and enjoys all the riches.

## \|\| 27.36-37 \|\|

*yo janaḥ sasyasaṃyuktāṃ bhūmiṃ ca rucirāṃ sati \|*  
*dadāti bhaktyā viprāya puṇyakṣetre ca vā sati \|\| 36 \|\|*

*mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe manvantaraśataṃ dhruvam \|*  
*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya mahāṃśca bhūmivānbhavet \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Such of the persons who gives away in charity at a sacred place to a Brahmana a plot of green land with devotion, he remains in Vaikuntha for a hundred manvantara and is established there. He is reborn in the human race and owns a lot of land and riches.

## \|\| 27.38 \|\|

*taṃ na tyajati bhūmiśca janmanāṃ śatakaṃ param \|*  
*śrīmāṃśca dhanavāṃścaiva putravāṃśca prajeśvaraḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. During hundreds of births the land never disowns him and he always remains rich, glorious and has sons. He becomes a king also.

## \|\| 27.39 \|\|

*saprajaṃ ca prakṛṣṭaṃ ca grāmaṃ dadyāddvijātaye \|*  
*lakṣamanvantaraṃ caiva vaikuṇṭhe sa mahīyate \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The one who gives away in charity to a Brahmana the best of the villages with its population, stays in Vaikuntha for a lakh of manvantaras.

## \|\| 27.40 \|\|

*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya grāmalakṣaṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*na jahāti ca taṃ pṛthvī janmanāṃ lakṣameva ca \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. He is reborn in the human race and becomes the honour of a lakh of villages. The land never deserts him for a lakh of his births.

## \|\| 27.41-42 \|\|

*saprajaṃ suprakṛṣṭaṃ ca pañcasasyasamanvitam \|*  
*nānāpuṣkariṇīvṛkṣaphalabhogasamanvitam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*nagaraṃ yaśca viprāya dadāti bhārate bhuvi \|*  
*mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe daśalakṣendrakālakam \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. The one who gives away to the Brahmana, in the land of Bharata, rich crops, several step-wells and trees laden with flowers and fruits, he remains in the abode of Indra for the period equivalent to the age of ten lakhs of Indra and is respected there.

## \|\| 27.43 \|\|

*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya rājendro bhārate bhavet \|*  
*nagarāṇāṃ ca niyutaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. He is reborn in the human race and becomes a great king over a lakh of cities. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 27.44 \|\|

*dharā taṃ na jahātyeva janmanāṃ niyutaṃ dhruvam \|*  
*paramaiśvarya saṃyukto bhavedeva mahītale \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The earth never parts company with such a person for ten thousand births. He always remains filled with riches on the earth.

## \|\| 27.45-47 \|\|

*nagarāṇāṃ ca śatakaṃ deśaṃ yo hi dvijātaye \|*  
*suprakṛṣṭaprajāyuktaṃ dadāti bhaktipūrvakam \|\| 45\|\|*

*vāpītaḍāgasaṃyuktaṃ nānāvṛkṣasamanvitam \|*  
*mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe koṭimanvantarāvadhi \|\| 46 \|\|*

*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya jambūdvīpapatirbhavet \|*  
*paramaiśvaryyasaṃyukto yathā śakrastathā bhuvi \|\| 47 \|\|*

45-47. The one who gives away in charity with devotion a hundred cities to a Brahmana, which are inhabited by high ranking people and having step-wells, tanks and trees of various kinds, he remains in Vaikuntha for crores of manvantaras is respected there. Thereafter he is reborn in the human race and becomes the lord of JambQdvIpa and he enjoys all the royal pleasures and rules on earth like Indra.

## \|\| 27.48-49 \|\|

*mahī taṃ na jahātyeva janmanāṃ koṭimeva ca \|*  
*kalpāntajīvī sa bhavedrājarājeśvaro mahān \|\| 48 \|\|*

*svādhikāraṃ samagraṃ ca yo dadāti dvijātaye \|*  
*caturguṇa phalaṃ cāto bhavettasya na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. The earth never deserts him for a crore of births. He enjoys long life and becomes a great monarch. The one who bestows all his riches on a Brahmana earns four times the merit. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 27.50 \|\|

*jambūdvīpaṃ yo dadāti brāhmaṇāya pativrate \|*  
*phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ cāto bhavettasya na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. О chaste lady, one who offers to a Brahmana in charity the entire Jambudvipa, earns a hundred times more merit, there is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 27.51-52 \|\|

*saptadvīpamahīdātuḥ sarvatīrthānusevinaḥ \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ tapasāṃ karttuḥ sarvopavāsakāriṇaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*sarvadānapradātuśca sarvasiddheśvarasya ca \|*  
*astyeva punarāvṛttirna bhaktasya hareraho \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. The one who gives away in charity the seven continents of the world or the one who serves all the holy places or the one who always engages himself in tapas or the one who is always engaged in performing the vratas without consuming anything or the one who gives away everything in charity, achieves all the success in life; he also has to be reborn on earth. But surprisingly enough the devotees of the lord never return to the earth.

## \|\| 27.53 \|\|

*asaṃkhyabrahmaṇā pātaṃ paśyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ sati \|*  
*nivasanti hi goloke vaikuṇṭhe vā hareḥ pade \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The devotees of Vishnu remain in the Goloka or the abode of Vishnu. From there, they witness the fall of innumerable Brahmas.

## \|\| 27.54-55 \|\|

*viṣṇumantropāsakaśca vihāya mānavīṃ tanum \|*  
*bibhartti divyarūpaṃ ca janmamṛtyujarāpaham \|\| 54 \|\|*

*labdhvā viṣṇośca sārūpyaṃ viṣṇusevāṃ karoti ca \|*  
*sa ca paśyati goloke hyasaṃkhyaṃ prākṛtaṃ layam \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. Such of the Vaishnava people as recite the mantra of Vishnu, after meeting the end of their lives, are relieved of their birth, death and old age, They take to the divine form and go to the abode of Vishnu. From there, after having an audience with lord Vishnu they proceed on to Goloka, the abode of lord Krishna, where they serve him. They witness to innumerable natural scenes.

## \|\| 27.56 \|\|

*naśyanti devāḥ siddhāśca viśvāni nikhilāni ca \|*  
*kṛṣṇabhaktā na naśyanti janmamṛtyujarāharāḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. The gods, the siddhas and the entire universe can be destroyed but the one who is devoted to lord Krishna never meets with his end. Death, birth and old age can never approach him.

## \|\| 27.57 \|\|

*kārttike tulasīdānaṃ karoti haraye ca yaḥ \|*  
*yugaṃ patrapramāṇaṃ ca modate harimandire \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The one who offers the Tulasi leaf to the lord in the month of Kartika remains in the abode of the lord delightfully for the number of years equivalent to the number of Tulasi leaves offered by him..

## \|\| 27.58 \|\|

*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya haribhaktiṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*sukhī ca cirajīvī ca sa bhavedbhārate bhuvi \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Thereafter, he is reborn in the human race and continues to be a devotee of the lord. He therefore lives a comfortable life in the land of Bharata for long.

## \|\| 27.59 \|\|

*ghṛtapradīpaṃ haraye kārttike yo dadāti ca \|*  
*palapramāṇaṃ varṣaṃ ca modate harimandire \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. The one who offers a lamp of ghee in the month of Kartika, enjoys living in the abode of the lord for the number of the years equivalent to the number of the seconds for which the lamp is burnt.

## \|\| 27.60 \|\|

*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya viṣṇubhaktiṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*mahādhanāḍhyaḥ sa bhaveccakṣuṣmāṃścaiva dīptimān \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Ultimately he is reborn in the human race and achieves the devotion of lord Vishnu. He becomes an immensely rich person on earth, with a clear vision and glory.

## \|\| 27.61-62 \|\|

*māghe yaḥ snāti gaṅgāyāmaruṇodayakālataḥ \|*  
*yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi modate harimandire \|\| 61 \|\|*

*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya viṣṇubhaktiṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaraḥ sa bhavedbhārate bhuvi \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. The one who takes a bath in the Ganga in the month of Magha at sunrise, enjoys life in the abode of Vishnu for sixty thousand yugas delightfully. Thereafter he is reborn in the human race and undoubtedly becomes a devotee of lord Vishnu. He becomes the best among the self-disciplined people.

## \|\| 27.63 \|\|

*māghe yaḥ snāti gaṃgāyāṃ prayāge cāruṇodaye \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhe modate so'pi lakṣamanvantarāvadhi \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. The one who takes a bath in the month of Magha in the Prayaga region in the waters of Ganga at sunrise, enjoys the comforts of Vaikunt ha for a lakh of manvantaras.

## \|\| 27.64-65 \|\|

*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya viṣṇumantraṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*tyaktvā ca mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ punaryāti hareḥ padam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*nāsti tatpunarāvṛttirvaikuṇṭhācca mahītale \|*  
*karoti haridāsyaṃ ca labdhvā sārūpyameva ca \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. Thereafter he is reborn in the human race and recites the mantra of Vishnu. Ultimately he meets with the end of the human body and proceeds on to the abode of Vishnu. The people of Vaikuntha never send him back to the earth. By achieving salvation, he becomes a courtier of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 27.66-67 \|\|

*nityasnāyī ca gaṅgāyāṃ sa pūtaḥ sūryyavadbhuvi \|*  
*pade pade'śvamedhasya labhate niścitaṃ phalam \|\| 66 \|\|*

*tasyaiva pādarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā \|*  
*modate sa ca vaikuṇṭhe yāvaccandradivākarau \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. The one who take a bath in the Ganga daily, is purified on earth like the sun in the sky and he earns the merit of Asvamedha sacrifice at every step. The earth gets purified with the dust of his feet. He lives with pleasure in the Vaikuntha for as long as the sun and the moon last.

## \|\| 27.68 \|\|

*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya tapasvipravaro bhavet \|*  
*svadharmanirataḥ śuddho vidvāṃśca sujitendriyaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Thereafter he is reborn in the human race the as best of the ascetics remaining devoted to his dharma possessing spotless intelligence and exercising self-control.

## \|\| 27.69-70 \|\|

*mīnakarkaṭayormadhye gāḍhaṃ tapati bhāskare \|*  
*bhārate yo dadātyeva jalameva suvāsitam \|\| 69 \|\|*

*modate sa ca vaikuṇṭhe yāvadindrāścaturdaśa \|*  
*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya sukhī niṣkapaṭo bhavet \|\| 70 \|\|*

69-70. The one who gives away in charity in the land of Bharata the fragrant water during the time of extreme heat, enjoys his stay in the Vaikuntha for a period of fourteen Indras. He is then reborn in the human race and is free from cheating, remaining comfortable.

## \|\| 27.71-72 \|\|

*vaiśākhe haraye bhaktyā yo dadāti ca candanam \|*  
*yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi modate viṣṇumandire \|*  
*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya rūpavāṃśca sukhī bhavet \|\| 71 \|\|*

*yajñasūtreṇa tatpuṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhe modate so'pi kṛṣṇabhakta labhedadharuvam \|\| 72 \|\|*

71-72. The one who offers sandal-paste to the lord in the month of Vaisakha, enjoys a blissful life in the abode of the lord for sixty thousand yugas. Thereafter he is reborn on earth as a beautiful human and lives a comfortable life. By offering a yajnopavlta in charity, one undoubtedly achieves the same merit and enjoys the same comfort in the Vaikuntha. Ultimately he achieves the devotion of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 27.73 \|\|

*vaiśākhe saktudānaṃ ca yaḥ karoti dvijātaye \|*  
*saktureṇupramāṇābdaṃ modate viṣṇumandire \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. In the month of Vaisakha whosoever offers in charity to the Brahmanas the ground barley, enjoys a comfortable life in the Vishnuloka up to the number of years equivalent to the particles of the barley.

## \|\| 27.74-75 \|\|

*karoti bhārate yo hi kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīvratam \|*  
*śatajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

*vaikuṇṭhe modate so'pi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa \|*  
*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 75 \|\|*

74-75. The one who performs the vrata of Krishna Janamastaml, is relieved of the sins of crores of births. There is no doubt about it. He also enjoys life in Vaikuntha up to the period of fourteen Indras; thereafter he is reborn in the human race and surely achieves the devotion of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 27.76-77 \|\|

*ihaiva bhārate varṣe śivarātriṃ karoti yaḥ \|*  
*modate śivaloke ca saptamanvantarāvadhi \|\| 76\|\|*

*śivāya śivarātrau ca bilvapatraṃ dadāti yaḥ \|*  
*patrapramāṇaṃ ca yugaṃ modate śivamandire \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. In the land of Bharata the one who performs the vrata of Shivaratri, remains in Shivaloka for seven manvantaras. The one who offers the leaves of wood-apples to lord Shiva on the day of Shivaratri, enjoys the life of Shivaloka for the number of years equivalent to the number of leaves offered by him.

## \|\| 27.78 \|\|

*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya śivabhaktiṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*vidyāvānputravāñchrīmānprajāvānbhūmivānbhavet \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. Thereafter he is reborn in the human race and achieves the devotion of lord Shiva, besides being virtuous obtains high education, sons, riches, the people and land.

## \|\| 27.79-80 \|\|

*caitramāse'thavā māghe śaṅkaraṃ yo'rcayedvratī \|*  
*karoti narttanaṃ bhaktyā vetrapāṇirdivāniśam \|\| 79 \|\|*

*māsaṃ vāpyarddhamāsaṃ vā daśa saptadināni vā \|*  
*dinamānaṃ yugaṃ so'pi śivaloke mahīyate \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. In the month of Caitra or Magha whosoever adores lord Shiva and also dances before him for a week during the day and night, achieves the Shivaloka and remains there for the number of years equivalent to the moments for which he performed the dance. Whether he dances for a day, half a month, ten days, a week or only for two days or even a day, he achieves the similar type of merit.

## \|\| 27.81-82 \|\|

*śrīrāmanavamīṃ yo hi karoti bhārate naraḥ \|*  
*saptamanvantaraṃ yāvanmodate viṣṇumandire \|\| 81 \|\|*

*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya rāmabhaktiṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaro mahāṃśca dhārmiko bhavet \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. In the land of Bharata whosoever celebrates RamanavamI, enjoys a comfortable life for seven manvanlaras in Vishnuloka. He is reborn in the human race and achieves the devotion of Rama. He becomes the best of the self-disciplined people and appears as a great religious leader.

## \|\| 27.83-89 \|\|

*śāradīyāṃ mahāpūjāṃ prakṛteryaḥ karoti ca \|*  
*mahiṣaiśchāgalairmeṣairikṣukūṣmāṇḍakaistathā \|\| 83 \|\|*

*naivedyairupahāraiśca dhūpadīpādibhistathā \|*  
*nṛtyagītādibhirvādyairnānākautukamaṅgalaiḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

*śivaloke vasetso'pi saptamanvantarāvadhi \|*  
*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya buddhiṃ ca nirmalāṃ labhet \|\| 85 \|\|*

*acalāṃ śriyamāpnoti putrapautrādivarddhinīm \|*  
*mahāprabhāvayuktaśca gajavājisamanvitaḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

*rājarājeśvaraḥ so'pi bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*bhādraśuklāṣṭamīṃ prāpya mahālakṣmīṃ ca yo'rcayet \|\| 87 \|\|*

*nityaṃ bhaktyā pakṣamekaṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate \|*  
*dattvā tasyai prakṛṣṭāni copacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa \|\| 88 \|\|*

*vaikuṇṭhe modate so'pi yāvaccandradivākarau \|*  
*punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya rājarājeśvaro bhavet \|\| 89 \|\|*

83-89. In the Navaratra of the winter season whosoever performs the puja of goddess Durga and offers sacrifice in a buffalo, a goat, a sheep, sugar-cane, a melon and naivedyas beside other presents like essence, a lamp etc., performing dance at the same time accompanied by music and celebrates the festival, he also proceeds to Shivaloka and remains there for seven manvantaras. Thereafter he is reborn in the human race and gets spotless wisdom. He has a sons and grandsons and the glory which does not vanish. Becoming influential he becomes a king possessing several elephants and horses. There is no doubt about it. In the sacred land of Bharata on the bright eighth day of the moon in the month of Bhadrapada, whosoever adores Maha-Lakshmi for a week regularly with devotion offering her puja with sixteen types of offering, he remains in the Vaikuntha till the sun and the moon last and enjoys the earth there with delight. He is reborn in the human race and becomes a king.

## \|\| 27.90-92 \|\|

*kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ ca kṛtvā tu rāsamaṇḍalam \|*  
*gopānāṃ śatakaṃ kṛtvā gopīnāṃ śatakaṃ tathā \|\| 90 \|\|*

*śilāyāṃ pratimāyāṃ vā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rādhayā saha \|*  
*bhārate pūjayeddattvā copacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa \|\| 91 \|\|*

*goloke ca vasetso'pi yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ \|*  
*bhārataṃ punarāgatya haribhaktiṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 92 \|\|*

90-92. In the month of Kartika, in the land of Bharata, whosoever organises Rasamandala (the divine dance) and taking to the form of a hundred cowherds and cowherdesses worship the stone image of lord Krishna with sixteen type of offerings remains in Goloka up to the age of Brahma. Thereafter he is reborn in the land of Bharata and becomes a devotee of lord Hari.

## \|\| 27.93 \|\|

*krameṇa sudṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ labdhvā mantraṃ harerapi \|*  
*dehaṃ tyaktvā ca golokaṃ punareva prayāti saḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. Thus by achieving the deep devotion of Vishnu with the recitation of mantras he achieves Goloka after his death.

## \|\| 27.94 \|\|

*tatra kṛṣṇasya sārūpyaṃ saṃprāpya pārṣado bhavet \|*  
*punastatpatanaṃ nāsti jarāmṛtyuharo mahān \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. Reaching there he achieves salvation and becomes a courtier of lord Krishna; he never has to face old age nor has he to fall from the Goloka.

## \|\| 27.95 \|\|

*śuklāṃ vā'pyathavā kṛṣṇāṃ karotyekādaśīṃ ca yaḥ \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhe modate so'pi yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. The one who performs the Ekadas'I-vrata during the bright or dark fortnight remains in Vaikuntha up to the age of Brahma.

## \|\| 27.96-97 \|\|

*bhārataṃ punarāgatya haribhaktiṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*punaryāti ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ na tasya patanaṃ bhavet \|\| 96 \|\|*

*bhādre śukle ca dvādaśyāṃ yaḥ śakraṃ pūjayennaraḥ \|*  
*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi śakraloke mahīyate \|\| 97 \|\|*

96-97. Thereafter he is reborn in the land of Bharata and undoubtedly achieves the devotion of lord Vishnu. With the influence of the same he goes back to Vaikuntha from where he never falls back. On the bright Dvadashi of the month of Rhadrapada whosoever adores Indra enjoys life in Indraloka for sixty thousand years.

## \|\| 27.98-99 \|\|

*ravivāre'rkasaṃkrāntyāṃ saptamyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ \|*  
*sampūjyārkaṃ haviṣyānnaṃ yaḥ karoti ca bhārate \|\| 98 \|\|*

*mahīyate so'rkaloke yāvaccandradivākarau \|*  
*bhārataṃ punarāgatya cārogī śrīyuto bhavet \|\| 99 \|\|*

98-99. Such of the people who in the land of Bharata adore the sun on Sunday, on the first day of the month and the seventh day of the bright fortnight offering food and other eatables remain in the Suryaloka till the sun and the moon last. Thereafter they are reborn on the land of Bharata and remain healthy and possesse numerous riches.

## \|\| 27.100-101 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ sāvitrīṃ yo hi pūjayet \|*  
*mahīyate brahmaloke saptamanvantarāvadhi \|\| 100 \|\|*

*punarmahīṃ samāgatya śrīmānatulavikramaḥ \|*  
*cirajīvī bhavetso'pi jñānavānsampadā yutaḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

100-101. On the fourteenth the bright fortnight of the month of Jyestha whosoever adores Savitri, remains in Brahmciloka for seven manvantaras and resides there gracefully. Thereafter he is reborn on earth as an immensely valorous person enjoying a long life possessing great intelligence and riches.

## \|\| 27.102-103 \|\|

*māghasya śuklapañcamyāṃ pūjayedyaḥ sarasvatīm \|*  
*saṃyato bhaktito dattvā copacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa \|\| 102 \|\|*

*mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe yāvadbrahmadivāniśam \|*  
*saṃprāpya ca punarjanma sa bhavetkavipaṇḍitaḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

102-103. The one who adores goddess Sarasvati with sixteen types of offerings getting self-disciplined on the bright fifth day of the month of Magha, offering sixteen types of presents, he resides in the Vaikuntha up to the age of Brahma and is held in high esteem. Ultimately he is reborn again on earth and he becomes a poet and an intellectual.

## \|\| 27.104-105 \|\|

*gāṃ suvarṇādikaṃ yo hi brāhmaṇāya dadāti ca \|*  
*nityaṃ jīvanaparyantaṃ bhaktiyuktaśca bhārate \|\| 104 \|\|*

*gavāṃ lomapramāṇābdaṃ dviguṇaṃ viṣṇumandire \|*  
*modate hariṇā sārddhaṃ krīḍākautukamaṅgalaiḥ \|\| 105 \|\|*

104-105. The one who, during his life time offers with devotion, cows or gold to a Brahmana resides in the Goloka for double the number of years more than the number of cows given by him in charity. He enjoys the company of the lord there spending time playfully with the lord.

## \|\| 27.106 \|\|

*tataḥ punarihāgatya viṣṇubhaktiṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*tataḥ punarihāgatya rājarājeśvaro bhavet \|*  
*gomāṃśca putravānvidvāñjñānavānsarvataḥ sukhī \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. Thereafter, he is reborn on earth and achieves the devotion of lord Vishnu. After he returns to the earth, he becomes a great monarch having innumerable cows, sons, great intelligence, knowledge and all types of pleasures.

## \|\| 27.107-108 \|\|

*bhojayedyo hi miṣṭānnaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaśca bhārate \|*  
*vipralomapramāṇābdaṃ modate viṣṇumandire \|\| 107 \|\|*

*tataḥ punarihāgatya sa sukhī dhanavānbhavet \|*  
*vidvānsucirajīvī ca śrīmānatulavikramaḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

107-108. The one who serves sweet food to the Brahmana in the land of Bharata, enjoys life in the Vishnuloka for the number of years equivalent to the hair-pits on the body of the Brahmana. After his return to Vaikuntha, he is reborn in the human race and enjoys a long life and all pleasures, possessing intelligence, riches, wealth and great prowess.

## \|\| 27.109 \|\|

*yo vakti vā dadātyeva harernāmāni bhārate \|*  
*yuganāmapramāṇaṃ ca viṣṇuloke mahīyate \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. The one who recites the name of Vishnu in the land of Bharata is adored in the Vishnuloka for the number of years equivalent to the number of names of the lord recited by him.

## \|\| 27.110 \|\|

*tataḥ punarihāgatya viṣṇubhaktiṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*yadi nārāyaṇakṣetre phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ labhet \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. When he is reborn on earth, he surely achieves the devotion of the lord. If he has performed good deeds in the Narayana region he gets merit many times more.

## \|\| 27.111-112 \|\|

*nāmnāṃ koṭiṃ hareryo hi kṣetre nārāyaṇe japet \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmukto jīvanmukto bhaveddhruvam \|\| 111 \|\|*

*labhate na punarjanma vaikuṇṭhe sa mahīyate \|*  
*labhedviṣṇośca sārūpyaṃ na tasya patanaṃ bhavet \|\| 112 \|\|*

111-112. The one who recites the name of the lord a crore of times in the Narayana region, is relieved of all sins and achieves salvation. This is certain. He is never reborn and is respected in the Vaikuntha. He then earns the place of Vishnu and he never falls from that place.

## \|\| 27.113-114 \|\|

*yaḥ śivaṃ pūjayennityaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ ca pārthivam \|*  
*yāvajjīvanaparyyantaṃ sa yāti śivamandiram \|\| 113 \|\|*

*mṛdāṃ reṇupramāṇābdaṃ śivaloke mahīyate \|*  
*tataḥ punarihāgatya rājendro bhārate bhavet \|\| 114 \|\|*

113-114. The one who adores lord Shiva daily preparing a linga and follows the practice throughout his life, proceeds to the land of Shiva and stays there for the number of years equivalent to the particles of dust with which he had prepared the linga while adoring them. Thereafter he is reborn in the land of Bharata as a grea monarch.

## \|\| 27.115-116 \|\|

*śilāṃ ca yo'rcayennityaṃ śilātoyaṃ ca bhakṣati \|*  
*mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam \|\| 115 \|\|*

*tato labdhvā punarjanma haribhaktiṃ sudurlabhām \|*  
*mahīyate viṣṇuloke na tasya patanaṃ bhavet \|\| 116 \|\|*

115-116. The one who adores the Shalagrama stone daily and sips the water with which the stone is washed, remains in the Vaikuntha up to the age of a hundred Brahmas. Thereafter he is reborn in the land of Bharata and achieves the devotion of the lord. He again proceeds to Vishnuloka from where he never falls back.

## \|\| 27.117-118 \|\|

*tapāṃsi caiva sarvāṇi vratāni nikhilāni ca \|*  
*kṛtvā tiṣṭhati vaikuṇḍe yāvadindrāścaturdaśa \|\| 117 \|\|*

*tato labdhvā punarjanma rājendro bhārate bhavet \|*  
*tato mukto bhavetpaścātpunarjanma na vidyate \|\| 118 \|\|*

117-118. By performing all the vratas and other religious ceremonies, he spends time in the Vaikuntha up to the age of Bharata and becomes a monarch. Thereafter he achieves salvation ultimately and he is never reborn.

## \|\| 27.119 \|\|

*yaḥ snāti sarvartīrtheṣu bhuvi kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam \|*  
*sa ca nirvāṇatāṃ yāti na tajjanma bhavedbhuvi \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. The one who takes a bath in the holy places going round the earth, achieves salvation and he is never reborn on earth.

## \|\| 27.120-121 \|\|

*puṇyakṣetre bhārate ca yo'śvamedhaṃ karoti ca \|*  
*aśvalomapramāṇābdaṃ śakrasyārddhāsane vaset \|\| 120 \|\|*

*caturguṇaṃ rājasūye phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ \|*  
*naramedhe'śvamedhārddhaṃ gomedhe ca tadeva ca \|\| 121 \|\|*

120-121. The one who performs the Asvamedha sacrifice on the sacred land of Bharata, remains in the land of Indra for the number of years equivalent to the hair on the body of the horse. Indra then shares half of his throne with him but by performing the Rajasitya yajna, one gets four times the merit and by performing Naramedha yajna, one gets half the merit and by performing Gomedha yajna, one achieves similar knowledge.

## \|\| 27.122-123 \|\|

*putreṣṭau ca tadardhaṃ ca suputraṃ ca labheddhruvam \|*  
*labhate lāṅgaleṣṭau ca gomedhasadṛśaṃ phalam \|\| 122 \|\|*

*tatsamānaṃ ca vipreṣṭau vṛddhiyāge ca tatphalam \|*  
*padmayajñe tadarddhaṃ ca phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

122-123. By performing putrestl yajna, one gets half the merit and a very good son. By performing laiigalestl yajna, one achieves merit comparable to the Gomedha yajna. Similarly with the performing of the viprestl and vrddhi yajna, one achieves similar merits. By performing padma yajna, one achieves half the merit.

## \|\| 27.124 \|\|

*viśoke ca viśokaṃ ca padmārddhaṃ svargamaśnute \|*  
*vijaye vijayī rājā svarge padmasamaṃ bhavet \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. By performing the visoka yajna, one is relieved of all the sins and by performing padma yajna, one achieves heaven. The one who performs the vijaya yajna, the king after becoming victorious earns the merit equivalent to the padma yajna and enjoys heavenly bliss.

## \|\| 27.125 \|\|

*prājāpatye prajālābho bhūvṛddhirbhūbhṛtāṃ bhavet \|*  
*iha rājaśriyaṃ labdhvā padmārddhaṃ svargamaśnute \|*  
*ṛddhiyāge mahaiśvaryaṃ svargaṃ padmasamaṃ bhavet \|\| 125 \|\|*

125\. After performing prdjapatya yajna there is an increase in the population as well as the land. A king after performing this yajna enjoys all the riches and pleasures and ultimately with the influence of half the merit of the padma yajna, he achieves heaven. By performing the rddhi yajna, he achieves heaven. By performing padma yajna, one gets heaven.

## \|\| 27.126 \|\|

*viṣṇuyajñaḥ pradhānaṃ ca sarvayajñeṣu sundari \|*  
*brahmaṇā ca kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ mahāsambhārasaṃyutaḥ \|\| 126 \|\|*

126\. О beautiful one, of all the sacrifice of Vishnu is considered to be the best which was celebrated earlier by Brahma with great pomp and show.

## \|\| 27.127-129 \|\|

*babhūva kalaho yatra dakṣaśaṅkarayoḥ sati \|*  
*śepuśca nandinaṃ viprā nandī viprāṃśca kopataḥ \|\| 127 \|\|*

*yato hetoradakṣayajñaṃ babhañca canadrarokharaḥ \|*  
*cakāra viṣṇuyajñaṃ ca purā dakṣaprajāpatiḥ \|\| 128 \|\|*

*dharmaśca kaśyapaścaiva śeṣaścāpi ca kardamaḥ \|*  
*svāyambhuvo manuścaiva tatputraśca priyavrataḥ \|\| 129 \|\|*

127-129. At that point of time there has been a fight between Daksha and lord Shiva where the Brahmanas getting enraged had pronounced a curse on Nandi and in turn Nandi had cursed the Brahmana as a result of which lord Chandrasekhar Shiva had destroyed the yajna of Daksha. Thus in the earlier times Daksha Prajapati had performed the Vishnu yajna.

## \|\| 27.130-131 \|\|

*śivaḥ sanatkumāraśca kapilaśca dhruvastathā \|*  
*rājasūyasahasrāṇāṃ samṛddhyā ca kraturbhavet \|\| 130 \|\|*

*rājasūyasahasrāṇāṃ phalamāpnoti niścitam \|*  
*viṣṇuyajñātparo yajño nāsti vede phalapradaḥ \|\| 131 \|\|*

130-131. Similarly Dharma, Kashyapa, Shesha, Kardama, Svayambhuva, Manu, his son Priyavrata, Shiva, Sanatkumara, Kapila and Dhruva also performed the Vishnu yajna. Thousands of Rajashuya yajrias can be performed with the availability of the riches but by performing Vishnu yajna one gets the knowledge equivalent to a thousand RajasUyayajnas. Therefore there is no other yajna more rewarding than the Vishnu yajna. This has been ordained in the Vedas.

## \|\| 27.132 \|\|

*bahukalpāntajīvī ca jīvanmukto bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*jñānena tejasā caiva viṣṇutulyo bhavediha \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. By performing that yajna a person is freed from birth and enjoys life in heaven for many kalpas; such a person is equated with lord Vishnu in intelligence and prowess.

## \|\| 27.133-138 \|\|

*devānāṃ ca yathā viṣṇurvaiṣṇavānāṃ yathā śivaḥ \|*  
*śāstrāṇāṃ ca yathā vedā āśramāṇāṃ ca brāhmaṇāḥ \|\| 133 \|\|*

*tīrthānāṃ ca yathā gaṅgā pavitrāṇāṃ ca vaiṣṇavāḥ \|*  
*ekādaśī vratānāṃ ca puṣpāṇāṃ tulasī yathā \|\| 134 \|\|*

*nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathā candraḥ pakṣiṇāṃ garuḍo yathā \|*  
*yathā strīṇāṃ ca prakṛtirādhārāṇāṃ vasundharā \|\| 135 \|\|*

*śīghragānāṃ cendriyāṇāṃ cañcalānāṃ yathā manaḥ \|*  
*prajāpatīnāṃ brahmā ca prajeśānāṃ prajāpatiḥ \|\| 136\|\|*

*vṛndāvanaṃ vanānāṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ bhārataṃ yathā \|*  
*śrīmatāṃ ca yathā śrīśca viduṣāṃ ca sarasvatī \|\| 137 \|\|*

*pativratānāṃ durgā ca saubhāgyānāṃ ca rādhikā \|*  
*viṣṇuyajñastathā vatse yajñeṣu ca mahāniti \|\| 138 \|\|*

133-138. As lord Vishnu happens to be the best of the gods, Shiva among the Vaishnavas, the Vedas among the scriptures, Brahmana among the Asramas, Ganga among the sacred rivers, Vais nava among the pious people Ekadashi among the vratas, the Tulasi among the trees, the moon among the constellations, Garuda among the birds, Prakriti among the ladies, the earth among the bases, the mind among the fast moving unstable organs of the senses, Brahma among the Prajajpatis, the Prajfipati among the people, Vrindavana among the forests, Shri with the rich people, Sarasvati among the intellectuals. Durga among the chaste ladies, Radhika among the virtuous ladies, similarly, О daughter, Vishnu yajna is the best of all theyajnas.

## \|\| 27.139 \|\|

*aśvamedhaśatenaiva śakratvaṃ labhate dhruvam \|*  
*sahasreṇa viṣṇupadaṃ saṃprāpa pṛthureva ca \|\| 139 \|\|*

139\. Thus after performing a hundred Asvamedha sacrifices, one gets the place of Indra. The king Prlhu achieved the Vishnupadas after performing a thousand Asvamedha sacrifices.

## \|\| 27.140-141 \|\|

*snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dakṣiṇam \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca tapasāṃ phalameva ca \|\| 140 \|\|*

*pāṭhaścaturṇāṃ vedānāṃ prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvastathā \|*  
*phalaṃ bījamidaṃ sarvaṃ muktidaṃ kṛṣṇasevanam \|\| 141 \|\|*

140-141. Therefore by taking a bath in all the sacred places, by performing all the yajnas, by performing all the vratas and by performing lapas, by reciting all the four Vedas, by going round the entire universe, one earns the adoration of the supreme lord Krishna who bestows salvation.

## \|\| 27.142 \|\|

*purāṇeṣu ca vedeṣu cetihāseṣu sarvataḥ \|*  
*nirūpitaṃ sārabhūtaṃ kṛṣṇapādāmbujārcanam \|\| 142 \|\|*

142\. This is the gist derived from the Vedas, the Puranas and the historical treatises. All the scriptures go on to justify that one should serve the lotus-like feet of lord Krishna somehow or the other.

## \|\| 27.143-144 \|\|

*tadvarṇanaṃ ca taddhyānaṃ tannāmaguṇakīrttanam \|*  
*tatstotraṃ smaraṇaṃ caiva vandanaṃ japa eva ca \|\| 143 \|\|*

*tatpādodakanaivedyabhakṣaṇaṃ nityameva ca \|*  
*sarvasammatamityevaṃ sarvepsitamidaṃ sati \|\| 144 \|\|*

143-144. Thus he has always to be adored, meditated upon, reciting his glory and mantra besides the stotras, offering prayer, performing japam and sipping the water of his feet. One should then take naivedya for him. This is the method by which all the desires are fulfilled.

## \|\| 27.145 \|\|

*bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ paraṃ brahma nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param \|*  
*gṛhāṇa svāminaṃ vatse sukhaṃ gaccha svamandiram \|\| 145 \|\|*

145\. Therefore one should recite the name of Krishna only who is Parabrahman, invisible and beyond Prakriti. Therefore, О daughter, you take over your husband and get back comfortably to your abode.

## \|\| 27.146 \|\|

*etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vipākaṃ karmaṇāṃ nṛṇām \|*  
*sarvepsitaṃ sarvamataṃ paraṃ tattvapradaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 146 \|\|*

146\. I have narrated to you the rewards one gets after performing the various deeds which are desired by all and is quite educative for the people.

## Chapter 28

## \|\| 28.1 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*harerutkīrttanaṃ śrutvā sāvitrī yamavaktrataḥ \|*  
*sāśrunetrā sapulakā yamaṃ punaruvāca sā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shri Narayana said — On hearing the praise of lord Vishnu from the mouth of Yama, the eyes of Savitri were filled with tears and she felt emotional. She then spoke to Yama again.

## \|\| 28.2 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*harerutkīrttanaṃ dharma svakuloddhārakāraṇam \|*  
*śrotṝṇāṃ caiva vaktṝṇāṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Savitri said — О Dharma, reciting the name of lord Vishnu or speaking or hearing his names, result in the redemption of the race, because such a recitation removes old age, death and birth of the people.

## \|\| 28.3 \|\|

*dānānāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca siddhīnāṃ tapasāṃ param \|*  
*yogānāṃ caiva vedānāṃ sevanaṃ kīrttanaṃ hareḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Therefore, of all the methods of adoration, of the charities, the performing of vratas, siddhis, Htpas practice of the yogis, the study of the Vedas, the recitation of the name of the lord Vishnu happens to be the best.

## \|\| 28.4 \|\|

*muktatvamamaratvaṃ vā sarvasiddhitvameva vā \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇasevanasyaiva kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Therefore it is said that salvation, eternity, the possessing of all the siddhis do not compare even one sixteenth part of the adoration of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 28.5 \|\|

*bhajāmi kena vidhinā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param \|*  
*mūḍhāṃ māmabalāṃ tāta vada vedavidāṃvara \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Therefore, О lord, you are the best among those well-versed in the Vedas; you tell me the method of adoration of lord Krishna who is beyond Prakriti; you kindly tell that to a helpless lady like me.

## \|\| 28.6-7 \|\|

*śubhakarmmavipākaṃ ca śrutaṃ nṛṇāṃ manoharam \|*  
*karmmāśubhavipākaṃ ca tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ityuktvā sā satī brahmanbhaktinamrātmakandharā \|*  
*tuṣṭāva dharmmarājaṃ ca vedoktena stavena ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. I have heard about the good reward of the noble deeds of the people but I would like to know the reward they get for their evil deeds. Therefore, you kindly tell the same to me. О Brahman, thus speaking the chaste Savitri bowed her head in reverence and started offering prayers to the god of death.

## \|\| 28.8 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*tapasā dharmamārādhya puṣkare bhāskaraḥ purā \|*  
*dharmāṃśaṃ yaṃ sutaṃ prāpa dharmarājaṃ namāmyaham \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Savitri said — In earlier times, the sun-god went to the Puskara regions and meditated upon Dharma for a long time. Thereafter, he got a son from the ariisa of Dharma who was given the name of Dharmaraja.

## \|\| 28.9-10 \|\|

*samatā sarvabhūteṣu yasya sarvasya sākṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*ato yannāma śamanamiti taṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 9 \|\|*

*yenāntaśca kṛto viśve sarveṣāṃ jīvināṃ param \|*  
*karmānurūpakālena taṃ kṛtāntaṃ namāmyaham \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. He happens to be the witness of all and extended equal treatment to all the creatures. He has been given the name of Saman. I bow in reverence to him he is the one who destroys all the creatures on earth according to their deeds. I bow in reverence to lord Yama.

## \|\| 28.11 \|\|

*bibharti daṇḍaṃ daṇḍyāya pāpināṃ śuddhihetave \|*  
*namāmi taṃ daṇḍadharaṃ yaḥ śāstā sarvakarmaṇām \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. He is the one who gives punishment to the sinners and controls all the deeds. He is the staff bearer, I bow in reverence to him.

## \|\| 28.12 \|\|

*viśve yaḥ kalayatyeva sarvāyuścāpi santatam \|*  
*atīva durnivāryyañca taṃ kālaṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. He is the one who regulates the age of the creatures on earth, I bow in reverence to such a terrific god of death.

## \|\| 28.13 \|\|

*tapasvī vaiṣṇavo dharmmī saṃyamī vijitendriyaḥ \|*  
*jīvināṃ karmmaphaladaṃ taṃ yamaṃ praṇamāmyaham \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. He is the one who provides rewards for the deeds of all the Tcipasvls, Vaishnavas, religious people, the self-disciplined ones and those who have controlled their organs of senses. I bow in reverence to such a Yama.

## \|\| 28.14 \|\|

*svātmārāmañca sarvajño mitraṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ bhavet \|*  
*pāpināṃ kleśado yaśca puṇyaṃ mitraṃ namāmyaham \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The one who roams in his own soul, is all knowledgeable, the friend of noble souls, a terror for the sinners, I bow in reverence to such a type of friend of the noble souls.

## \|\| 28.15 \|\|

*yajjanma brahmaṇo vaṃśe jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā \|*  
*yo dhyāyati paraṃ brahma brahmavaṃśaṃ namāmyaham \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The one who was born in the race of Brahma and is established by the tejas of Brahma meditating upon the eternal Brahman always, I bow in reverence to the one who belongs to the race of Brahma.

## \|\| 28.16-17 \|\|

*ityuktvā sā ca sāvitrī praṇanāma yamaṃ mune \|*  
*yamastāṃ viṣṣubhajanaṃ karmmapākamuvāca ha \|\| 16 \|\|*

*idaṃ yamāṣṭakaṃ nityaṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*yamāttasya bhayaṃ nāsti sarvapāpātpramucyate \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Thus speaking, О sage, Savitri, bowed in reverence to Yama. Yama on his part enlightened Savitri on the grace of lord Vishnu and the reciting of his name. Thus getting up early in the morning whosoever recites the eight verses of Yama, the god of death never frightens him.

## \|\| 28.18 \|\|

*mahāpāpī yadi paṭhennityaṃ bhaktyā ca nārada \|*  
*yamaḥ karoti taṃ śuddhaṃ kāyavyūhena niścitam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О Narada, even if this stotra is recited by the great sinners with devotion, he is sure to be rejuvenated and becomes completely pure.

## Chapter 29

## \|\| 29.1 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*yamastasyai viṣṇumantraṃ dattvā ca vidhipūrvakam \|*  
*karmmāśubhavipākaṃ ca tāmuvāca raveḥ sutaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shri Narayana said — Yama the son of Surya imparted the knowledge of Vishnu mantra to Savitri and then started narrating the effects of evil deeds.

## \|\| 29.2 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*śubhakarmavipākaṃ ca śrutaṃ nānāvidhaṃ sati \|*  
*karmāśubhavipākaṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Yama said — You have gained knowledge of the results of performing noble deeds of various types. I am now narrating to you the results of committing evil deeds. You listen to me.

## \|\| 29.3-5 \|\|

*nānāprakāraṃ svargaṃ ca yāti jīvaḥ sukarmaṇā \|*  
*kukarmaṇā ca narakaṃ yāti nānāvidhaṃ naraḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*narakāṇāṃ ca kuṇḍāni santi nānāvidhāni ca \|*  
*nānāpurāṇabhedena nāmabhedāni tāni ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

*vistṛtāni gabhīrāṇi kleśadāni ca jīvinām \|*  
*bhayaṅkarāṇi ghorāṇi he vatse kutsitāni ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. By perfonning good deeds a person achieves heaven and by resorting to evil deeds he falls into hell. There are several types of pits in the hell, the names of which have beem spelt out in the Puranas. О daughter, they are quite vast, deep, troublesome, horrible, terrific and henious.

## \|\| 29.6 \|\|

*ṣaḍaśītiśca kuṇḍāni saṃyamanyāṃ ca santi ca \|*  
*nibodha teṣāṃ nāmāni prasiddhāni śrutau sati \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. In the city of the self-disciplined there are eighty-six pits which are well known in the Vedas. I am going to speak out their names which you please listen to attentively.

## \|\| 29.7-13 \|\|

*vahnikuṇḍaṃ taptakuṇḍaṃ kṣamakuṇḍaṃ bhayānakam \|*  
*viṭkuṇḍaṃ mūtrakuṇḍaṃ ca śleṣmakuṇḍaṃ ca duḥsaham \|\| 7 \|\|*

*garakuṇḍaṃ dūṣikākuṇḍaṃ vasākuṇḍaṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*śukrakuṇḍamasṛkkuṇḍamaśrukuṇḍaṃ ca kutsitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*kuṇḍaṃ gātramalānāṃ ca karṇaviṭkuṇḍameva ca \|*  
*majjākuṇḍaṃ māṃsakuṇḍaṃ nakhakuṇḍaṃ ca dustaram \|\| 9 \|\|*

*lomnāṃ kuṇḍaṃ keśakuṇḍamasthikuṇḍaṃ ca duḥkhadam \|*  
*tāmrakuṇḍaṃ lauhakuṇḍaṃ prataptaṃ kleśadaṃ mahat \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tīkṣṇakaṇṭakakuṇḍaṃ ca viṣakuṇḍaṃ ca vighnadam \|*  
*dharmmakuṇḍaṃ taptasurākuṇḍaṃ cāpi prakīrttitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*prataptatailakuṇḍaṃ ca dantakuṇḍaṃ ca durvaham \|*  
*kṛmikuṇḍaṃ pūyakuṇḍaṃ sarpakuṇḍaṃ durantakam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*maśakuṇḍaṃ daṃśakuṇḍaṃ bhīmaṃ garalakuṇḍakam \|*  
*kuṇḍaṃ ca vajradaṃṣṭrāṇāṃ vṛścikānāṃ ca suvrate \|\| 13 \|\|*

7-13. They are agnikunda, tapatkunda, the terrific ksarakunda, vitkunda, the kunda of urine, the kunda of cough, the kunda of poison, the kunda of eye-mud, the kunda of fat, the kunda of semen, nidrakunda, the denounced kunda of tears, the kunda of human refuse, the kunda of ear wax, the lainda of veins, the lainda of flesh, the kunda of nails, the kunda of hair on the body, a kunda of hair on head, the lainda of bones, the burning kunda and the kunda which burns like copper, the kunda burning like iron, the lainda with sharp thorns, the kunda of Dhanna, the kunda of boiling wine, the lainda having deadly poison, the kunda of sharp teeth, the lainda of insects, the kunda of puss, the knnda of snakes which is difficult to cross, the lainda of biting, the kunda of terrific poison, the kunda of scorpions having vajra like teeth.

## \|\| 29.14-20 \|\|

*śarakuṇḍaṃ śūlakuṇḍa khaḍgakuṇḍaṃ ca bhīṣaṇam \|*  
*golakuṇḍaṃ nakrakuṇḍaṃ kākakuṇḍaṃ śucāspadam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sañcālakuṇḍaṃ vājakuṇḍaṃ bandhakuṇḍaṃ sudustaram \|*  
*taptapāṣāṇakuṇḍaṃ ca tīkṣṇa pāṣāṇakuṇḍakam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*lālākuṇḍamasikuṇḍaṃ cūrṇakuṇḍaṃ sudāruṇam \|*  
*cakrakuṇḍaṃ vajrakuṇḍaṃ kūrmmakuṇḍaṃ maholbaṇam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*jvālakuṇḍaṃ bhasmakuṇḍaṃ pūtikuṇḍaṃ ca sundari \|*  
*taptasūryamasīpatraṃ kṣuradhāraṃ sucīmukham \|\| 17 \|\|*

*godhāmukhaṃ nakramukhaṃ gajadaṃśaṃ ca gomukham \|*  
*kumbhīpākaṃ kālasūtramavaṭodamaruntudam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*pāṃśubhojaṃ pāśaveṣṭaṃ śūlaprotaṃ prakampanam \|*  
*ulkāmukhamandhakūpaṃ vedhanaṃ daṇḍatāḍanam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*jālabandhaṃ dehacūrṇaṃ dalanaṃ śoṣaṇaṅkaram \|*  
*sarpajvālāmukhaṃ jihmadhūmāndhaṃ nāgaveṣṭanam \|\| 20 \|\|*

14-20. О noble lady, there are also kundas of arrows, kundas of tridents, kundas of terrific swords, circular kundas, the kunda of tortoises, the kunda of crows, the sancala kunda, the kunda of eagles, the terrific kunda, the kunda of burning stones, the kunda of heart fluid, the kunda of swords, the kunda of terrific powder, the circular kunja, the vajra lainda, the tortoise kunda, the kunda of flames, the kunda of ashes and the kunda of bad smell. О beautiful one, similarly there creatures like burning sun, Asipatra, sharp edged, having a mouth of keen needles, lizard faced, having the face of a crocodile, having the face of an elephant, having the face of a cow, КитЪЫрйка, Kalsutra, Avatoda, Aruntuda, Pamsubhoja, Pashavesta, Sillaprota, Prakampan, Ulkamukha, AndhalcUpa, Vedhans, Dandatadana, Jalabandha, Dehacilrna, Dalana, Sosana, Sarpajvalamukha, Jivha, Dhiimcindha and Nagavestana kundas are there.

## \|\| 29.21 \|\|

*kuṇḍānyetāni sāvitri pāpināṃ kleśadāni ca \|*  
*niyuktaiḥ kiṅkaragaṇai rakṣitāni ca santatam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. О Savitri, These kundas are there to torture the sinners and several attendants keep guard over the sinners.

## \|\| 29.22-24 \|\|

*daṇḍahastaiḥ śūlahastaiḥ pāśahastairbhayaṅkaraiḥ \|*  
*śaktihastairgadāhastairmadamattaiśca dāruṇaiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tamoyuktairdayāhīnairdurnivāryyaṃ ca sarvataḥ \|*  
*tejasvibhiśca niḥśaṅkaistāmrapiṅgalalocanaiḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*yogayuktaiḥ siddhayogairnānārūpadharairvaraiḥ \|*  
*āsannamṛtyubhirdṛṣṭaiḥ pāpibhiḥ sarvajīvibhiḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. The terrific messengers of Yama holding the danda, sula, pasha, sakti and gad a (club) move on intoxicated in a frightening manner and devoid of any compassion. They move out on all the four sides and are terrific to look at. They possess great lustre, are fearless and have the complexion of copper and yellow eyes. Resorting to yogic practices they move about taking to many forms. All the sinners have to face them in one form or other at the time death.

## \|\| 29.25 \|\|

*svakarmanirataiḥ śaivaiḥ śāktaiḥ sauraiśca gāṇapaiḥ \|*  
*adṛṣṭaiḥ puṇyakṛdbhiśca siddhayogibhireva ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Such of the noble souls known as Saiva, Sakta, Saura, Ganapatyas, Punyatma and siddhas cannot be terrified by them.

## \|\| 29.26-27 \|\|

*svadharmmaniratairvā'pi viratairvā svatantrakaiḥ \|*  
*balavadbhiśca niḥśaṅkaiḥ svapnadṛṣṭaiśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*etatte kathitaṃ sādhvi kuṇḍasaṃkhyānirūpaṇam \|*  
*yeṣāṃ nivāso yatkuṃḍe nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. Those who are devoted to their own dharma and are independent, unattached, brave and the fearless Vaishnavas do not have to face them even in dreams. О chaste lady, I have thus spoken out to you the number of the Kundas of the hell. I am now going to tell you about the sinners who are lodged in these Kundas you please listen to him.

## Chapter 30

## \|\| 30.1 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*harisevārataḥ śuddho yogī siddho vrato sati \|*  
*tapasvī brahmacārī ca na yāti narakaṃ yatiḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yama said — The devotees of the lord who engage themselves in the tapas include the yogis with a pure mind, the siddhas, the Vratis, the Tapasvlns, Brahmacarlns and mendicants who never fall in the hell.

## \|\| 30.2 \|\|

*kaṭuvācā bāndhavāṃśca khalatvena ca yo naraḥ \|*  
*dagdhānkaroti balavānvahnikuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. But such of the person who are quite valorous but wicked at the same time and because of their wicked nature they always speak harsh words and turn their relatives into mental agony, they fall into the hell named Agnikunda.

## \|\| 30.3 \|\|

*gātralomapramāṇābdaṃ tatra sthitvā hutāśane \|*  
*paśuyonimavāpnoti raudre dagdhastrijanmani \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. They have to suffer because of the terrific fire-flames and they remain there in such a condition for many years and thereafter they are born as animals thrice.

## \|\| 30.4 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaṃ tṛṣitaṃ kṣubdhaṃ prataptaṃ gṛhamāgatam \|*  
*na bhojayati yo mūḍhastaptakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The one who does not provide food and drink to a thirsty and hungry Brahmana who comes to door, such a foolish fellow falls into the burning cell.

## \|\| 30.5 \|\|

*tatra lomapramāṇābdaṃ sthitvā tatra ca duḥkhitaḥ \|*  
*taptasthale vahnikuṇḍe pakṣī ca saptajanmasu \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. There he suffers for many years all kinds of troubles and ultimately is reborn as a bird for seven births.

## \|\| 30.6-7 \|\|

*ravivārārkasaṃkrāntyāmamāyāṃ śrāddhavāsare \|*  
*vastrāṇāṃ kṣārasaṃyogaṃ karoti yo hi mānavaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sa yāti kṣārakuṇḍaṃ ca sūtramānābdameva ca \|*  
*sa vrajedrājakīṃ yoniṃ saptajanmasu bhārate \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. The one who applies soap and oil on Sundays, on the first day of the sun, moonless night he falls into the saline Kunda up to the number of years equivalent on the grains to the cloth. Thereafter he is reborn as a washerman on earth for seven births.

## \|\| 30.8-9 \|\|

*svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā brahmavṛttiṃ harettu yaḥ \|*  
*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṭkuṇḍaṃ ca prayāti saḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viḍbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati \|*  
*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṭkṛmiśca punarbhuvi \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. The one who snatches away the Brahmanhood bestowed by himself or by another for a Brahmana, falls into the pit of refuse and insects where he remains consuming the refuse. He is then reborn on earth as an insect of refuse for the similar number of years.

## \|\| 30.10 \|\|

*parakīyataḍāge ca taḍāgaṃ yaḥ karoti ca \|*  
*utsṛjeddaivadoṣeṇa mūtrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The one who unfortunately digs a tank someone else's place claiming it to be belonging to him he falls into the deep pit of urine.

## \|\| 30.11-13 \|\|

*tadreṇumānavarṣaṃ ca tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati \|*  
*bhārate godhikā caiva sa bhavetsaptajanmasu \|\| 11 \|\|*

*ekākī miṣṭamaśnāti śleṣmakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ \|*  
*pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati \|\| 12 \|\|*

*pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva sa preto bhārate bhavet \|*  
*śleṣmamūtragaraṃ caiva pūyaṃ bhuṅkte tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. And he remains there up to the years equivalent to the number of particles of dust of the tank consuming the same dirty things. Thereafter he is born on earth in Bharata as a lizard for seven births. The one who consumes sweet-meats alone he falls into the pit of cough and remains there for a hundred years consuming the same. Thereafter he is reborn in the land of Bharata as a goblin and continues there for a hundred years. Thereafter he is born in the land of Bharata and remains there for a hundred years consuming daily cough and urine. He gets purified thereafter.

## \|\| 30.14-15 \|\|

*pitaraṃ mātaraṃ caiva guruṃ bhāryyāṃ sutaṃ sutām \|*  
*yo na puṣṇātyanāthaṃ ca garakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*pūrṇamabdasahasraṃ ca tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati \|*  
*tato vrajedbhūtayoniṃ śatavarṣaṃ tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. The one who does not maintain his father, his mother, the teacher, the wife, the son, the daughter and orphan, he falls into the pit called Garakunda and remains there for a thousand years. Thereafter he is born as a goblin and remains in that position for a hundred years. Thereafter he is purified.

## \|\| 30.16 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvātithiṃ vakracakṣuḥ karoti yo hi mānavaḥ \|*  
*pitṛdevāstasya jalaṃ na gṛhṇanti ca pāpinaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The person who dislikes the arrival of a guest is not accepted by the gods as well as the manes.

## \|\| 30.17-18 \|\|

*yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca \|*  
*ihaiva labhate cānte dūṣikākuṇḍamāvrajet \|\| 17 \|\|*

*pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati \|*  
*tato naro bhavedbhūmau daridraḥ saptajanmasu \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. He therefore earns the, sin of Brahmahatya while living on earth earning at the same time some other sin. After his death he falls into the Diisikcikunda. He remains there for a hundred years consuming the same food. Thereafter he is reborn as a human and remains a pauper for seven births.

## \|\| 30.19-20 \|\|

*dattvā dravyaṃ ca viprāya cānyasmai dīyate yadi \|*  
*sa tiṣṭhati vasākuṇḍe tadbhojī śatavatsaram \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tato bhavetsa caṇḍālastrijanmani tataḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*kṛkalāso bhavetso'pi bhārate saptajanmasu \|*  
*tato bhavenmānavaśca daridro'lpāyureva ca \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. The person who snatches away something from a Brahmana after giving it to him and then gives it to somebody else, falls into the pit of fat consuming the same. Thereafter he is reborn on earth a Chandala in the land of Bharata and then as a chameleon for seven births and thereafter he becomes a pauper having a short life.

## \|\| 30.21-22 \|\|

*pumāṃsaṃ kāminī vā'pi kāminīṃ vā pumānatha \|*  
*yaḥ śukraṃ pāyayatyeva śukrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati \|*  
*yonikṛmiḥ śatābdaṃ ca bhavedbhuvi tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. If a lady consumes the semen of a man and if a man consumes the egg (ovum) of a lady, both of them fall into the pit of semen and remain there for a hundred years consuming the same. Thereafter he becomes an insect of the vagina and ultimately gets purified.

## \|\| 30.23-24 \|\|

*santāḍya ca guruṃ vipraṃ raktapātaṃ ca kārayet \|*  
*sa ca tiṣṭhatyasṛkkuṇḍe tadbhojī śatavatsaram \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tato bhavedvyādhajanma saptajanmasu bhārate \|*  
*tataḥ śuddhimavāpnoti mānavaśca krameṇa ca \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. The one who injures a Brahmana or his own teacher and consumes his blood, falls into the pit of blood consuming the same for a hundred years. Thereafter he is reborn in the land of Bharata and becomes a hunter for seven births. He is then purified.

## \|\| 30.25-26 \|\|

*aśru sravantaṃ gāyantaṃ bhaktaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca gadgadam \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇaguṇasaṃgīte hasatyeva hi yo naraḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sa vasedaśrukuṇḍe ca tadbhojī śatavatsaram \|*  
*tato bhavetsa caṇḍālastrijanmani tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. The one who is devoted to lord Krishna and is always engrossed in reciting his name; when such a person is despised by others, they fall into the pit of tears for a hundred years and consumes the same. Thereafter they are reborn as Chandalas for three births and ultimately get purified after having been born in the house of a Chandala.

## \|\| 30.27-28 \|\|

*karoti khalatāṃ śaśvadaśuddhahṛdayo naraḥ \|*  
*kuṇḍaṃ gātramalānāṃ ca sa ca yāti daśābdakam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*tataḥ sa gārdabhīṃ yonimavāpnoti trijanmani \|*  
*trijanmani ca śārgālīṃ tataḥ śuddho bhaveddhruvam \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. The wicked person who is always engaged in evil deeds, remains in the pit of the human dirt for ten years and for three births he becomes a jackal. He is purified thereafter.

## \|\| 30.29-30 \|\|

*badhiraṃ yo hasatyeva nindatyeva hi mānavaḥ \|*  
*sa vasetkarṇaviṭkuṇḍe tadbhojī śatavatsaram \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tato bhavetsa badhiro daridraḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*saptajanmasvaṅgahīnastataḥ śuddhiṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. The person who denounce a deaf person or makes a joke about him, he falls into the pit of ear wax and consumes the same. Thereafter he is born as a deaf and a pauper for seven births. Then again he is born as a deformed person for seven births before he is purified.

## \|\| 30.31-32 \|\|

*lobhātsvapālanārthāya jīvinaṃ hanti yo naraḥ \|*  
*majjākuṇḍe vasetso'pi tadbhojī lakṣavarṣakam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tato bhavetsa śaśako mīnaśca saptajanmasu \|*  
*eṇādayaśca karmmabhyastataḥ śuddhiṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. In case a greedy person kills another creature for feeding himself he falls into the pit of marrow and consumes the same. Thereafter he is born as a rabbit for seven births and taking births as fish and other animals, he has to suffer considerably. Thereafter he is purified.

## \|\| 30.33-35 \|\|

*svakanyāpālanaṃ kṛtvā vikrīṇāti hi yo naraḥ \|*  
*arthalobhānmahāmūḍho māṃsakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*kanyālomapramāṇābdaṃ tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati \|*  
*taṃ ca kuṇḍe prahāraṃ ca karoti yamakiṅkaraḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*māṃsabhāraṃ mūrdhni kṛtvā raktadhārāṃ lihetkṣudhā \|*  
*tato hi bhārate pāpī kanyāviṭsu kṛmirbhavet \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. The one who after bringing up a girl sells her away in greed, such a foolish fellow falla as into the pit of flesh up to the number of years equivalent to the number of hair on his body. At that point of time, the messengers of Yama attack the pit and he carries the heaps of flesh over his head. He consumes the blood whenever he is hungry. Thereafter the sinner is reborn on earth and has to consume the refuse of the girls for sixty thousand years. He is then born as an insect of the refuse.

## \|\| 30.36-37 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi vyādhaśca saptajanmasu \|*  
*trijanmani varāhaśca kukkurassaptajanmasu \|\| 36 \|\|*

*saptajanmasu maṇḍūko jalaukāḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*saptajanmasu kākaśca tataḥ śuddhiṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Thereafter he is born as a hunter for seven births, as a boar for three births, as a dog for seven births, as a frog for seven births, as a jonka (leech) for seven births, as a crow for seven births. Thereafter he is purified.

## \|\| 30.38 \|\|

*vratānāmupavāsānāṃ śrāddhādīnāṃ ca saṃyame \|*  
*na karoti kṣaurakarma so'śuciḥ sarvakarmasu \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. While performing the vratas, the fast and sraddha etc., his actions are considered to be infructuous who does not perform the necessary ceremony.

## \|\| 30.39 \|\|

*sa ca tiṣṭhati kuṇḍeṣu nakhādīnāṃ ca sundari \|*  
*tadeva dinamānābdaṃ tadbhojī daṇḍatāḍitaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О beautiful one, he has to fall into the pit of nails for a long time consuming the same and is beaten with rods.

## \|\| 30.40-42 \|\|

*sakeśaṃ pārthivaṃ liṅgaṃ yo vā'rcayati bhārate \|*  
*sa tiṣṭhati keśakuṇḍe mṛdreṇumānavarṣakam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tadante yāvanīṃ yoniṃ prayāti harakopataḥ \|*  
*śatābdācchuddhimāpnoti svakulaṃ labhate dhruvam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*pitṝṇāṃ yo viṣṇupade piṇḍaṃ naiva dadāti ca \|*  
*sa tiṣṭhatyasthikuṇḍe ca svalomābdaṃ maholbaṇe \|\| 42 \|\|*

40-42. The one who adores the linga with matted locks of hair in the land of Bharata, remains in the Kesakunda tip to the number of years equivalent to the particles of the earth of which the linga is made. Because of the anger of Shiva, he has to be born in the Yavana family for a hundred years. Thereafter he gets purified and is reborn in a noble race. The one who does not offer the pindas at the place of lord Vishnu he falls into the terrific pit of bones for a long time equivalent to the number of hair on his body.

## \|\| 30.43 \|\|

*tataḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya khañjaḥ saptasu janmasu \|*  
*bhavenmahādaridraśca tataḥ śuddho hi daṇḍataḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Thereafter he is reborn in his own race and leads the life of a pauper besides being a deformed person. He gets purified after thus suffering.

## \|\| 30.44 \|\|

*yaḥ sevate mahāmūḍho gurviṇīṃ ca svakāminīm \|*  
*prataptatāmrakuṇḍe ca śatavarṣaṃ sa tiṣṭhati \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The foolish fellow who cohabits with his pregnant wife, falls into the copper pit for a hundred years.

## \|\| 30.45-46 \|\|

*avīrānnaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte ṛtusnātānnameva ca \|*  
*lauhakuṇḍe śatābdaṃ ca sa ca tiṣṭhati taptake \|\| 45\|\|*

*sa vrajedrājakīṃ yoniṃ karmakārīṃ ca saptasu \|*  
*mahāvraṇī daridraśca tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. The one who consumes the food of a widow having no son or of a lady who is in menses falls into the burning pit of iron and remains in it for a hundred years. Thereafter he is born as a washerman for seven births, as a black smith having a big wound and he gets purified thereafter.

## \|\| 30.47 \|\|

*yo hi gharmāktahastena devadravyamupaspṛśet \|*  
*śatavarṣapramāṇaṃ ca gharmakuṇḍe sa tiṣṭhati \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The one who touches the image of a god or anyone of his things while he is sweating, such a Brahmana falls into Dhannakunda remaining there for a hundred years.

## \|\| 30.48-49 \|\|

*yaḥ śūdreṇābhyanujñāto bhuṅkte śūdrānnameva ca \|*  
*sa ca taptasurākuṇḍe śatābdaṃ tiṣṭhati dvijaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*tato bhavecchradrayājī brāhmaṇaḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*śūdraśrāddhānnabhojī ca tataḥ śuddho bhaved dhruvam \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. The one who consumes the food of a Siidra under his command, such a Brahmana falls into the pit of wine for a hundred years. Thereafter he is reborn in the race of the Shudras for seven births. He then performs yajna's for the Shudras till seven births and eats with them. He is purified thereafter.

## \|\| 30.50-51 \|\|

*vāgduṣṭā kaṭuvācā yā tāḍayetsvāminaṃ sadā \|*  
*tīkṣṇakaṇṭakakuṇḍe sā tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati \|\| 50 \|\|*

*tāḍitā yamadūtena daṇḍena ca caturyugam \|*  
*tata uccaiḥśravāḥ saptajanmasveva tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. In case a lady who always speaks harsh words, injures the mind of her husband with harsh words, she falls into the pit of thorns and remains there for four yugas. The messengers of Yama beat her with rods. Thereafter she is reborn for seven births as a woman with a long neck. She is purified thereafter.

## \|\| 30.52 \|\|

*viṣeṇa jīvinaṃ hanti nirdayo yo hi pāmaraḥ \|*  
*viṣakuṃḍe ca tadbhojī sahasrābdaṃ ca tiṣṭhati \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. If a heartless person kills others by poisoning, he falls into the pit of poison and remains there for a thousand years consuming the same.

## \|\| 30.53 \|\|

*tato bhavennṛghātī ca vraṇī syātsaptajanmasu \|*  
*saptajanmasu kuṣṭhī ca tataḥ śuddho bhaveddhruvam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Thereafter he is reborn as a killer for seven births. Thereafter he is reborn as a leper for seven births before he is purified.

## \|\| 30.54-55 \|\|

*daṇḍena tāḍayedyo hi vṛṣaṃ ca vṛṣavāhakaḥ \|*  
*bhṛtyadvārā svatantro vā puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate \|\| 54 \|\|*

*prataptatailakuṇḍe ca sa tiṣṭhati caturyugam \|*  
*gavāṃ lomapramāṇābdaṃ vṛṣo bhavati tatparam \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. If a farmer or his servant beats a bull with a rod, he falls into the pit of burning oil and remains there for a period of four yugas. Thereafter he is reborn as a bull and remains in that position for as many years as the number of hair a bull has over its body.

## \|\| 30.56-57 \|\|

*dantena hanti jīvaṃ yo lauhena baḍiśena vā \|*  
*dantakuṇḍe vasetso'pi varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati \|\| 56 \|\|*

*tataḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya codaravyādhisaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*kliṣṭena janmanaikena tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. The one who kills the creatures by beating them or with the teeth remains there in the hell for a hundred years. Thereafter he is reborn in his own race and suffers from ailments. After thus suffering he purifies himself ultimately.

## \|\| 30.58-60 \|\|

*yo bhuṃkte ca vṛthā māṃsaṃ matsyabhojī ca brāhmaṇaḥ \|*  
*hareranaivedyabhojī kṛmikuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

*svalomamānavarṣaṃ ca tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati \|*  
*tato bhavenmlecchajātistrijanmani tato dvijaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇaḥ śūdrayājī yaḥ śūdraśrāddhānnabhojakaḥ \|*  
*śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca pūyakuṇḍaṃ vrajeddhruvam \|\| 60 \|\|*

58-60. Such of the Brahmanas as consume meat leaving the naivedya of the lord, fall into the pit of insects and remain there up to the number of years equivalent to the number of hairs on their body consuming the same. Thereafter they are reborn as Mlecchas for three births before they are born as Brahmanas. The one who performs yajna with Siidras, the one who consumes the food of the sraddha and bums their dead bodies, surely falls into the pit of the puss.

## \|\| 30.61 \|\|

*yāvallomapramāṇābdaṃ yajamānasya suvrate \|*  
*tāḍito yamadūtena tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. О chaste lady, he consumes the same and remains in that position up to the number of years equivalent to the hair on his body. He is daily tortured by the messengers of Yama.

## \|\| 30.62 \|\|

*tato bhāratamāgatya sa śūdraḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*mahāśūlī daridraśca tataḥ śuddhaḥ punardvijaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Thereafter arriving in the land of Bharata he is reborn as a Shudra for seven births and becomes sick and a pauper. Thereafter getting purified he is reborn as a Brahmana.

## \|\| 30.63-65 \|\|

*laghuṃ kūraṃ mahāntaṃ vā sarpaṃ hanti ca yo naraḥ \|*  
*svātmalomapramāṇābdaṃ sarpakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*sarpeṇa bhakṣitaḥ so'pi yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ \|*  
*vasecca sarpaviṭjīvī tataḥ sarpo bhaveddhruvam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*tato bhavenmānavaścāpyalpāyurdadrusaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*mahākleśena tanmṛtyuḥ sarpeṇa bhakṣaṇaṃ dhruvam \|\| 65 \|\|*

63-65. The one who kills a small, terrific and a long snake, he falls into the snake pit and remains there for the number of years equivalent to the number of hair on his body, consuming the refuse of the snakes. He is tortured by the messengers of Yama. Thereafter, he is reborn as a snake. Ultimately he is reborn as a human always having pain in his teeth and enjoys a short life. Thereafter he dies as a result of snakebite and dies a painful death.

## \|\| 30.66-67 \|\|

*vidhiṃ prakalpya jīvāṃśca kṣudrajantūṃśca hanti yaḥ \|*  
*sadaṃśamaśake kuṇḍe janmamānadinābdakam \|\| 66 \|\|*

*divāniśaṃ bhakṣitastairanāhāraśca śabdakṛt \|*  
*baddhahastapadādiśca yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. The one who kills the small insects falls into the pit of the pus for a number of years where he is bitten daily by the insects and he cries there without food. The messengers of Yama tie his hand and feet besides belabouring him.

## \|\| 30.68 \|\|

*tato bhavetkṣudrajanturjātirvai yāvatī smṛtā \|*  
*tato bhavenmānavaśca so'ṅgahīnastataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Thereafter he is reborn as an insignificant insect. After having so born as an insect, for many births, he is reborn as a deformed human. Thereafter he is purified.

## \|\| 30.69 \|\|

*yo mūḍho madhu gṛhṇāti hatvā ca madhumakṣikāḥ \|*  
*sa eva garale kuṃḍe jīvamānadinābdakam \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. The one who extracts honey by killing the bees falls into the pit of poison up to the number of years equivalent to his own age.

## \|\| 30.70 \|\|

*bhakṣito garalairdagdho yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ \|*  
*tato hi makṣikājātistataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. He keeps on burning there consuming the poison. He is tortured by the messengers of Yama. Thereafter he is born as a bee before he is purified.

## \|\| 30.71-72 \|\|

*daṇḍaṃ karotyadaṃḍye ca vipre daṇḍaṃ karoti ca \|*  
*sa kuṇḍaṃ vajradaṃṣṭrāṇāṃ kīṭānāṃ vai prayāti ca \|\| 71 \|\|*

*tallomamānavarṣaṃ ca tatra tiṣṭhatyaharniśam \|*  
*śabdakṛdbhakṣitastaiśca tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

71-72. The one who punishes an innocent Brahmana falls into the pit having insects with vajra-Yike teeth. He remains in that kunda up to the number of years as the Brahmana has the hair on his body. He is bitten by the insects daily. Thereafter, he gets purified.

## \|\| 30.73-74 \|\|

*arthalobhena yo bhūpaḥ prajādaṇḍaṃ karoti ca \|*  
*vṛścikānāṃ ca kuṇḍeṣu tallomābdaṃ vaseddhruvam \|\| 73 \|\|*

*tato vṛścikajātiśca saptajanmasu jāyate \|*  
*tato naraścāṅgahīno vyādhiyukto bhaveddhruvam \|\| 74 \|\|*

73-74. In case a king feeling greedy for riches punishes his innocent people, he falls into the pit of scorpions and is bitten by them for a number of years. Thereafter he is reborn as a scorpion for seven births and becomes ultimately a deformed human who is always suffering from diseases.

## \|\| 30.75 \|\|

*yaḥ khādati guru svaṃ ca dhūrto dhūrtatayā khalaḥ \|*  
*sa kuṇḍe vacradaṣrāṇāṃ vasenmanvantarāvadhi \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. In case a wicked person, because of his wicked nature, kills his own teacher, he falls into a Kunda having the insects with vajra-like teeth. He remains there for a manvantara.

## \|\| 30.76-77 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaḥ śastradhārī yo hyanyeṣāṃ dhāvako bhavet \|*  
*sandhyāhīnaśca mūḍhaśca haribhaktivihīnakaḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

*sa tiṣṭhati svalomābdaṃ kuṇḍādiṣu śarādiṣu \|*  
*viddhaḥ śarādibhiḥ śaśvattataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. If a foolish Brahmana does not perform sandhya regularly and is also not devoted to the gods and taking to arms becomes a messenger of others, he falls into the pit of arrows for the number of years equivalent to the hair on his body. He is injured there with the arrows before he is purified.

## \|\| 30.78-80 \|\|

*kārāgāre sāndhakāre nibadhnāti prajāśca yaḥ \|*  
*pramattaḥ svalpadoṣeṇa golakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

*tatkuṇḍaṃ taptatoyāktaṃ sāndhakāraṃ bhayaṅkaram \|*  
*tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraiśca kīṭaiśca saṃyuktaṃ golakuṇḍakam \|\| 79\|\|*

*kīṭairviddho vasettatra prajālomābdameva ca \|*  
*tato bhavennīcabhṛtyastataḥ śuddho naro bhuvi \|\| 80 \|\|*

78-80. If an intoxicated person gives horrible punishment to the people imprisoning them for petty crimes, he falls into a pit named Golakunda having boiling water, darkness and the insects with sharp teeth looking terrible. He is bitten by the insects for the number of years equivalent to the hair on the bodies of the people. Thereafter he is born as a degraded servant. Ultimately he is purified.

## \|\| 30.81-82 \|\|

*sarovarādutthitāṃśca nakrādīnhanti yaḥ sati \|*  
*nakrakaṇṭakamānābdaṃ nakrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ 1 \|\| 81 \|\|*

*tato nakrādijātiśca bhavennadyādiṣu dhruvam \|*  
*tataḥ sadyo viśuddho hi daṇḍenaiva naraḥ punaḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. The one who kills the crocodiles and other aquatic animals who arrive in a tank from outside, falls into the crocodile-fomrfa for a number of years. Thereafter he is reborn as a crocodile in a river and he gets purified.

## \|\| 30.83-89 \|\|

*vakṣaḥ śroṇīstanāsyaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati parastriyāḥ \|*  
*kāmena kāmuko yo hi puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate \|\| 83 \|\|*

*sa vasetkākakuṇḍaṃ ca kākaiśca kṣuṇṇalocanaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ svalomamānābdaṃ tataścāndhastrijanmani \|\| 84 \|\|*

*svarṇasteyī ca yo mūḍho bhārate suraviprayoḥ \|*  
*sa ca saṃcānakuṇḍaṃ ca svalopābdaṃ vasedagharuvam \|\| 85 \|\|*

*tāḍito yamadūtena saṃcānaiḥ kaṣuṇṇalocanaḥ \|*  
*tato bhojī ca tatraiva tataścāndhastarijanmani \|\| 86 \|\|*

*saptajanmadaridraśca mahākrūraśca pātakī \|*  
*bhārate svarṇakāraśca sa ca svarṇavaṇiktataḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

*yo bhārate tāmracauro lauhacauraśca sundari \|*  
*sa svalomapramāṇābdaṃ vajrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti vai \|\| 88\|\|*

*tatraiva vajraviḍbhojī vajraiśca kṣuṇṇalocanaḥ \|*  
*tāḍito yamadūtena tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

83-89. In this sacred land of Bharata, the one who looks at the breast, the navel and the face of other's wives with a passion in his mind falls in the kunda of crows where the crows bite his eyes. Thereafter he remains there for the number of years equivalent to the hair on the body of that person and is reborn as a blind person on earth. In the land of Bharata, whosoever steals away the gold of a Brahmana or the gods, remains in the terrific kunda for the number of years equivalent to the hair on his body. The messengers of Yama torture him and the crows peck at his eyes with their beaks. After remaining there for a long time, he is reborn on earth as a blind man and for seven births he becomes a pauper, heartless, a sinner, a goldsmith and a merchant of gold. О beautiful one, the one who steals iron and copper in the land of Bharata, remains in the pit of vajra for the number of years equivalent to the hair on his body. While remaining there he has to consume the refuse of the insects named vajra. Those insects break his eyes while the messengers of Yama torture him. He gets purified thereafter.

## \|\| 30.90-91 \|\|

*bhārate devacauraśca devadravyādihārakaḥ \|*  
*suduṣkare vajrakuṇḍe svalomābdaṃ vaseddhruvam \|\| 90 \|\|*

*dehadagdho hi tadvajrairanāhāraśca śabdakṛt \|*  
*tāḍito yamadūtena tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

90-91. In the land of Bharata, whosoever steals away the things of gods, he remains in the terrific kunda for the number of years equivalent to the hair on his body. The vajra insects bite him as a result of which Kis body gets burnt and he cries again and again without food. On the other hand the messengers of Yama torture him. He gets purified thereafter.

## \|\| 30.92 \|\|

*raupyagavyāṃ śukānāṃ ca yaścauraḥ suraviprayoḥ \|*  
*taptapāṣāṇakuṇḍe ca svalomābdaṃ vaseddhruvam \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. The one who steals away the clothes and the silver of Brahmana. falls into the stone pit and remains there for the number of years equivalent to the number of hair on his body.

## \|\| 30.93-94 \|\|

*trijanmani bakaḥ so'pi śvetahaṃsastrijanmani \|*  
*janmaikaṃ śaṅkhacillaśca tato'nye śvetapakṣiṇaḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

*tato raktavikārī ca śūlī vai mānavo bhavet \|*  
*saptajanmasu cālpāyustataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

93-94. Thereafter for three births he becomes a skylark, a goose for three births, a Samkhacilla for one birth and for the rest of the births he becomes a white bird. In the next seven births he suffers from various ailments and enjoys only a short life. He is purified thereafter.

## \|\| 30.95 \|\|

*raityakāṃsyādipātraṃ ca yo haretsuraviprayoḥ \|*  
*tīkṣṇapāṣāṇakuṇḍe ca svalomābdaṃ vaseddhruvam \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. Similarly the one who steals away the vases of brass or bronze belonging to a Brahmana, falls into the stone-pit and remains there up to the number of years equivalent to the hair on his body.

## \|\| 30.96 \|\|

*sa bhavedaśvajātiśca bhārate saptajanmasu \|*  
*tato' dhikāṅgayuktaśca pādarogī tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. Thereafter he is reborn in the land of Bharata as a horse for seven births. Thereafter he is born as a human suffering from many ailments and he gets purified thereafter.

## \|\| 30.97-98 \|\|

*puṃścalyannaṃ ca yo bhuṃkte puṃścalījīvyajīvanaḥ \|*  
*svalomamānavarṣaṃ ca lālākuṇḍe vaseddhruvam \|\| 97 \|\|*

*tāḍito yamadūtena tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati \|*  
*tataścakṣuśśūlarogī tataḥ śuddhaḥ krameṇa saḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

97-98. The one who earns his living through a wicked woman and cats her food, falls into a terrific pit and remains there up to a number of' years equivalent to the hair on his body. He is tortured by the messenger of Yama. He drinks the fluid there. Thereafter he is purified after suffering from the ailment of his eyes as well as stomach.

## \|\| 30.99-101 \|\|

*mlecchasevī Wi yo vipro bhārate bhuvi \|*  
*sa ca taptamaṣīkuṇḍe svalomāvda॑ vasedadharuvam \|\| 99 \|\|*

*tāḍito yamadūtena tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati \|*  
*tatastrijanmani bhavetkṛṣṇavarṇaḥ paśuḥ sati \|\| 100 \|\|*

*trijanmani bhavecchāgaḥ kṛṣṇasarpastrijanmani \|*  
*tataśca tālavṛkṣaśca tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

99-101. In the land of Bharata such of the people who earn their livelihood by serving Mlecchas and are maintaining their account. They fall into the pit of ink and remain there up to the number of years equivalent to the hair on his body. He consumes the same ink there and is tortured by the messengers of Yama. Thereafter he is born as an animal of black colour during the next three births. He is then born as a goat for three births and for three births he is born as a cobra. He then is purified by becoming a palm tree.

## \|\| 30.102-104 \|\|

*dhānyādi sasyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ yo haretsuraviprayoḥ \|*  
*āsanaṃ ca tathā talpaṃ cūrṇakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

*śatābdaṃ tatra nivasedyamadūtena tāḍitaḥ \|*  
*tato bhavenmeṣajātiḥ kukkuṭaśca trijanmani \|\| 103 \|\|*

*tato bhavenmānavaśca kāsavyādhiyuto bhuvi \|*  
*vaṃśahīno daridraścāpyalpāyuśca tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 104 \|\|*

102-104. The one who steals away the food, betel, seed and the bed of the Brahmana, falls into the pit of dust. He remains there for a hundred years suffering the torture of the messengers of Yama. He is then born as a ram for three births. He is then reborn as a human being suffering from cough, is without any sons, is a pauper and having a short span of life. He is thereafter purified.

## \|\| 30.105 \|\|

*cakraṃ karoti viprāṇāṃ hṛtvā dravyaṃ ca yo naraḥ \|*  
*sa vaseccakrakuṇḍe ca śatābdaṃ daṃḍatāḍitaḥ \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. The one who by stealing away the valuables of the Brahmanas constructs a wheel, has to suffer the punishment for a hundred years by falling into the pit of cakras.

## \|\| 30.106 \|\|

*tato bhavenmānavaśca tailakārastrijanmani \|*  
*vyādhiyukto bhavedrogī vaṃśahīnastataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. Thereafter he is born as an oil-crusher for three births and has to suffer from ailments having no sons. He is purified thereafter.

## \|\| 30.107 \|\|
