*bāndhaveṣu ca vipreṣu kurute vakratāṃ naraḥ \|*  
*prayāti vajrakuṇḍaṃ ca vasettatra yugaṃ sati \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. The one who behaves deceitfully with his own relations as well as the Brahmanas, falls into the vajra-kunda and remains there for a yuga.

## \|\| 30.108 \|\|

*tato bhavetsa vakrāṃgo hīnāṅgaḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*daridro vaṃśahīnaśca bhāryyāhīnastataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. Thereafter he is born as a hunch-back for a hundred years having no wife and becomes a Shudra.

## \|\| 30.109 \|\|

*śayane kūrmamāṃsaṃ ca brāhmaṇo yo hi bhakṣati \|*  
*kūrmmakuṇḍe vasetso'pi śatābdaṃ kūrmmabhakṣitaḥ \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. The Brahmana who eats the flesh of a tortoise seating on a bed, falls into the pit of tortoise and remains there for a hundred years; his flesh is eaten by the tortoises.

## \|\| 30.110 \|\|

*tato bhavetkūrmmajanma trijanmani ca sūkaraḥ \|*  
*trijanmani biḍālaśca mayūraśca trijanmani \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. He is then reborn as a tortoise and a pig for three births, a cat for three births and a peacock for three births.

## \|\| 30.111-112 \|\|

*ghṛtatailādikaṃ caiva yo haretsuraviprayoḥ \|*  
*jvālakuṇḍaṃ sa vai yāti bhasmakuṇḍaṃ ca pātakī \|\| 111 \|\|*

*tatra sthitvā śatābdaṃ ca sa bhavettailapāyikaḥ \|*  
*saptajanmasu matsyaḥ syānmūṣakaśca tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

111-112. The one who steals the oil or ghee of the Brahmana or the gods, falls into the pit of flames or the pit of ashes and after suffering there, for a number of years, he is reborn as a jackal for seven births besides being born fish and a rat, he is purified thereafter.

## \|\| 30.113-115 \|\|

*sugandhitailaṃ dhātrīṃ ca gandhadravyaṃ tathaiva vā \|*  
*bhārate puṇyavarṣe ca yo haretsuraviprayoḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

*vaseddurgandhakuṃḍe ca durgandhaṃ ca labhetsadā \|*  
*svalomamānavarṣaṃ ca tato durgandhiko bhavet \|\| 114 \|\|*

*durgaṃdhikaḥ saptajanau mṛganābhistrijanmani \|*  
*saptajanma sugaṃdhiśca tato vai mānavo bhavet \|\| 115 \|\|*

113-115. The one who steals away the fragrant articles of the god or the Brahmanas, falls into the pit of terrific smell and always has to face the bad smell. He is reborn as a porcupine for seven births, kastiin for three births and for seven births as a fragrant article. It ultimately is reborn as a human being.

## \|\| 30.116-117 \|\|

*balenaiva khalatvena hiṃsārūpeṇa vā sati \|*  
*balī ca yo haredbhūmiṃ bhārate parapaitṛkīm \|\| 116 \|\|*

*sa vasettaptaśūle ca bhavettato divāniśam \|*  
*taptataile yathā jīvo dagdho bhramati santatam \|\| 117 \|\|*

116-117. In the land of Bharata, the one who forcibly usurps the ancestral land, he is thrown into the pit of boiling oil and is tortured with weapons burning from all sides daily.

## \|\| 30.118 \|\|

*bhasmasānna bhavatyeva bhogadeho na naśyati \|*  
*saptamanvantaraṃ pāpī santaptastatra tiṣṭhati \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. But he is neither burnt into ashes nor is his body destroyed. Thus he has to suffer for his sins for seven manvantaras living there.

## \|\| 30.119 \|\|

*śabdaṃ karotyanāhāro yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ \|*  
*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṭkṛmirbhārate tataḥ \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. Remaining without food and with the torture of the messenger of Yama, he cries aloud. Thereafter, he becomes an insect of refuse in the land of Bharata for sixty thousand years.

## \|\| 30.120 \|\|

*tato bhavedbhūmihīno daridraśca tataḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*tataḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya śubhakarmā bhavetpunaḥ \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. Thereafter he is reborn as a pauper having no land and is ultimately purified. He is again reborn in his own race and performs good deeds.

## \|\| 30.121-122 \|\|

*chinatti jīvinaḥ khaṅgairdayāhīnaḥ sudāruṇaḥ \|*  
*naraghātī hanti naramarthalobhena bhārate \|\| 121 \|\|*

*asipatre ca sa vasedyāvadindrāścaturdaśa \|*  
*teṣu cedbrāhmaṇānhanti śatamanvantaraṃ tadā \|\| 122 \|\|*

121-122. In the land of Bharata the one who behaves like a cruel person killing human beings and animals with sword infested with the greed for riches, falls into the Asipatra hell and remains there up to the age of fourteen Indras. In case he kills, the Brahmanas he has to remain in the same hell for a hundred manvantaras.

## \|\| 30.123 \|\|

*chinnāṅgaśca bhavetpāpī khaṅgadhāreṇa santatam \|*  
*anāhāraḥ śabdakṛcca yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. The sinner is reduced into pieces with the striking of the sword and remains without food and being tortured by the messengers of Yama and he cries aloud.

## \|\| 30.124-125 \|\|

*caṇḍālaḥ śatajanmāni bhārate sūkaro bhavet \|*  
*kukkuraḥ śatajanmāni sṛgālaḥ saptajanmasu \|\| 124 \|\|*

*vyāghraśca saptajanmāni vṛkaścaiva trijanmani \|*  
*janmasaptasu gaṃḍo syānmahiṣaśca trijanmani \|\| 125 \|\|*

124-125. Thereafter, he is reborn in the land of Bharata as a Chandala and as a pig for a hundred births, a dog for a hundred births, a jackal for seven births, a hyena for three births, Rhino for seven births and for three births he is born as a buffalo.

## \|\| 30.126 \|\|

*grāmaṃ vā nagaraṃ vā'pi dāhanaṃ yaḥ karoti ca \|*  
*kṣuradhāre vasetso'pi cchinnāṅgastriyugaṃ sati \|\| 126 \|\|*

126\. The one who burns the land or the city, falls into the hell named Ksuradhara. His body is shattered there for three yugas.

## \|\| 30.127-128 \|\|

*tataḥ preto bhavetsadyo vahnivaktro bhramenmahīm \|*  
*saptajanmāmedhyabhojī khadyotaḥ saptajanmasu \|\| 127 \|\|*

*tato bhavenmahāśūlī mānavaḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*saptajanma galatkuṣṭhī tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ \|\| 128 \|\|*

127-128. Thereafter becoming a goblin by the name of Agnimukha, he wanders over the land and for three births he is born consuming unclean food. For seven births he is born as fire-fly, for seven births he suffers from intensive pain in the belly and for seven births he badly suffers from leprosy. He is purified thereafter.

## \|\| 30.129-131 \|\|

*parakarṇopajāpena paranindāṃ karoti yaḥ \|*  
*paradoṣe mahātoṣī devabrāhmaṇanindakaḥ \|\| 129 \|\|*

*sūcīmukhe sa ca vasetsūcīviddho yugatrayam \|*  
*tato bhavedvṛścikaśca sarpaḥ syātsaptajanmasu \|\| 130 \|\|*

*vajrakīṭaḥ saptajanau bhasmakīṭastataḥ param \|*  
*tato bhavenmānavaśca mahāvyādhistataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 131 \|\|*

129-131. The one who indulges in backbiting or the one who feels satisfied by denouncing others or the one who denounces the Brahmanas and gods daily, falls into the hell known as Siicimukha. He is pricked there with needles. Then he is born as a scorpion and snake for seven births, the terrific insects for seven births, an insect of dust for seven births and is reborn ultimately as a human being suffering from grave and terrific ailments. He is purified thereafter.

## \|\| 30.132 \|\|

*gṛhiṇāṃ ca gṛhaṃ bhittvā vastuteyaṃ karoti yaḥ \|*  
*gāśca cchāgāṃśca meṣāṃśca yāti godhāmukhaṃ ca saḥ \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. The one who breaks the house of a householder and steals away his belongings, including the cows, the sheep and goats, he falls into the hell of lizards.

## \|\| 30.133-138 \|\|

*tato bhavetsaptajanau gojātirvyādhisaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*trijanmameṣajātiśca cchāgajātistrijanmani \|\| 133 \|\|*

*tato bhavenmānavaśca nityarogī daridrakaḥ \|*  
*bhāryyāhīno bandhuhīnaḥ santāpī ca tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 134 \|\|*

*sāmānyadravyacauraśca yāti nakramukhaṃ yugam \|*  
*tato bhavenmānavaśca mahārogī tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 135 \|\|*

*hanti gāśca gajāṃścaiva turagāṃśca narāṃstat \|\| 136 \|\|*

*sa yāti gajadaṃśaṃ ca mahāpāpī yugatrayam \|*  
*tāḍito yamadūtena gajadantena santatam \|\| 137 \|\|*

*sa bhavedgajajātiśca turagaśca trijanmani \|*  
*gojātimlecchajātiśca tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ \|\| 138 \|\|*

133-138. Thereafter he is born with diseases as a cow and a sheep for three births and a goat for three births. Thereafter he is reborn as a human with disease, a pauper, a woman without a brother and he suffers variously. Thereafter he is purified. The one who steals away ordinary things, falls into the hell of crocodiles and remains there for yuya. Thereafter he is reborn as a human being and remains sick. He then gets purified. The one who kills a cow, an elephant, a horse for a human being, such a sinful person falls into the hell named Gajadamsha; he is tortured there by the messengers of Yama with elephant tusks. Thereafter he is reborn as a cow and then in the race of Mlecchas. He is then purified.

## \|\| 30.139-140 \|\|

*jalaṃ pibantīṃ tṛṣitāṃ gāṃ vārayati yo naraḥ \|*  
*tacchuśrūśāvihīnaśca gomukhaṃ yāti mānavaḥ \|\| 139 \|\|*

*narakaṃ gomukhākāraṃ kṛmitaptodakānvitam \|*  
*tatra tiṣṭhati santapto yāvanmanvantarāvadhi \|\| 140 \|\|*

139-140. One who stops a thirsty cow from drinking water, that serviceless man falls into the Gomukha hell. Cow-faced hell is full of insects and heated water. He remains there for a period of manvantara.

## \|\| 30.141 \|\|

*tato naro'pi gohīno mahārogī daridrakaḥ \|*  
*sapta janmanyantyajātiḥ tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ \|\| 141 \|\|*

141\. Such a person is born with ailments and is deprived of cows. For seven births he has to be born in the degraded race. Thereafter he is purified.

## \|\| 30.142-145 \|\|

*gohatyāṃ brahmahatyāṃ ca yaḥ karotyatideśikīm \|*  
*yo hi gacchedagamyāṃ ca sandhyāhīno'pyadīkṣitaḥ \|\| 142 \|\|*

*pratigrāhī ca tīrtheṣu grāmayājī ca devalaḥ \|*  
*śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraśca pramatto vṛṣalīpatiḥ \|\| 143 \|\|*

*gohatyāṃ brahmahatyāṃ ca strīhatyāṃ ca karoti yaḥ \|*  
*mitrahatyāṃ bhrūṇahatyāṃ mahāpāpī ca bhārate \|\| 144 \|\|*

*kumbhīpāke sa ca vasedyāvadindrāścaturdaśa \|*  
*tāḍito yamadūtena cūrṇyamānaśca santatam \|\| 145 \|\|*

142-145. By incitation of another person, one who kills a cow, a Brahmana or visits a prohibited place, does not perform sandhya, remains without diksa receives charity at the sacred places, performer of yajnas in villages, the pujarl of temple, the store-keeper of the Siidras, arrogant, the one who enjoys the company of a degraded woman, the killer of a cow, a Brahmana, a woman, a friend and does abortion, falls into the Kumbhlpaka hell and remains there up to the life of fourteen Indras. He is tortured by the messengers of Yama rotating him at the same time.

## \|\| 30.146-148 \|\|

*kṣaṇaṃ patati vahnau ca kṣaṇaṃ patati kaṇṭake \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ ca taptataileṣu taptatoyeṣu ca kṣaṇam \|\| 146 \|\|*

*kṣaṇaṃ ca taptapāṣāṇe taptalohe kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*gṛdhrakoṭisrahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ \|\| 147 \|\|*

*kākaśca saptajanmāni sarpassyātsaptajanmasu \|*  
*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tato vai viṭkṛmirbhavet \|\| 148 \|\|*

146-148. He falls into the fire flames in a moment and in the next moment he lulls into the pit of thorns. In a moment he is thrown into the boiling oil and the next moment he is thrown into the boiling water. In another moment he is thrown on the hot rocks and in the next moment he is thrown on the hot iron; thereafter for several births he is eaten up by the vultures for crores of births. For a hundred births he is born as a pig, for seven births he is born as a cow and for seven births he is born as a serpent. Thereafter he is born as an insect of refuse for sixty thousand years.

## \|\| 30.149 \|\|

*tato bhavetsa vṛṣaṇo galatkuṣṭhī daridrakaḥ \|*  
*yakṣmagrasto vaṃśahīno bhāryyāhīnastataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 149 \|\|*

149\. He is then born as a Shudra suffering from the leprosy of the throat, a pauper, suffering from the disease of consumption, having no progeny and wife. He is then purified.

## \|\| 30.150-152 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*brahmahatyā ca gohatyā kiṃvidhā vā''tideśikī \|*  
*kā vā nṛṇāmagamyā vā ko vā sandhyāvihīnakaḥ \|\| 150 \|\|*

*adīkṣitaḥ pumānko vā ko vā tīrthe pratigrahī \|*  
*dvijaḥ ko vā grāmayājī ko vā vipraśca devalaḥ \|\| 151 \|\|*

*śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraḥ kaḥ pramatto vṛṣalīpatiḥ \|*  
*eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara \|\| 152 \|\|*

150-152. Savitri said — О lord, well-versed in the Vedas, how is the killing of the cow, killing of a Brahmana and a guest is killed? What are the places beyond the reach of human beings? Who are the people deprived of the performing of sandhya and those receiving charity at the sacred places? Who are the Brahmanas performing yajna in villages, who is the Brahmana serving as a pitjarl in a temple, a store-keeper of the Shudras and the husband of a wicked woman? You kindly enlighten me on the subject in detail.

## \|\| 30.153-154 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇe ca tadarccāyāṃ mṛnmayyāṃ prakṛtau tathā \|*  
*śive ca śivaliṅge vā sūryye sūryyamaṇau tathā \|\| 153 \|\|*

*gaṇeśe vā tadarccāyāmevaṃ sarvatra sundari \|*  
*karoti bhedabuddhiṃ yo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ \|\| 154 \|\|*

153-154. Yama said — О beautiful one, the person who adores the image of lord Krishna made of earth and also the goddess Durga, Shivalinga, SUrya, Sfiryamani and Ganesha making a distinction between them attract the sin of Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 30.155 \|\|

*svagurau sveṣṭadeve vā janmadātari mātari \|*  
*karoti bhedabuddhiṃ yo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ \|\| 155 \|\|*

155\. The one who discriminates among his teachers, the family gods, the parents who have given birth to him, attracts the sin of Brahmahatya..

## \|\| 30.156-157 \|\|

*vaiṣṇaveṣvanyabhakteṣu brāhmaṇeṣvitareṣu ca \|*  
*karoti samatāṃ yo hi brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ \|\| 156 \|\|*

*yo mūḍho viṣṇunaivedye cānyanaivedyake tathā \|*  
*hareḥ pādodakeṣvanyadevapādodake tathā \|*  
*karoti samatāṃ yo hi brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ \|\| 157 \|\|*

156-157. The one who equates the Vaishnavas, other worshippers, Brahmanas and the devotees of other races, attracts Brahmahatya. The one who equates the naivedya of Vishnu with others, the water of the feet of the lord with the water of other gods, attracts Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 30.158-159 \|\|

*sarveśvareśvare kṛṣṇe sarvakāraṇakāraṇe \|*  
*sarvādye sarvadevānāṃ sevye sarvāntarātmani \|\| 158 \|\|*

*māyayā'nekarūpe vā'pyeka eva hi nirguṇe \|*  
*karotyanyena samatāṃ brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ \|\| 159 \|\|*

158-159. The one who equates with other gods, lord Krishna who is the cause of all the causes, the eternal Brahman, served by all the gods, soul of all of them, who takes to many fonns with his illusion or remains invisible, he attracts Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 30.160 \|\|

*pitṛdevārcanāṃ paurvāparāṃ vedavinirmitām \|*  
*yaḥ karoti niṣedhaṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ \|\| 160 \|\|*

160\. The one who does not follow the tradition prescribed by the gods and the manes and creates obstructions for the same, attracts Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 30.161 \|\|

*ye nindanti hṛṣīkeśaṃ tanmantropāsakaṃ tathā \|*  
*pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ labhanti te \|\| 161 \|\|*

161\. The one who denounces lord Vishnu who is the purifier of all and also his mantras and the devotees, attracts Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 30.162-165 \|\|

*śivaṃ śivasvarūpaṃ ca kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikaṃ priyam \|*  
*pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca jñānānandaṃ sanātanam \|\| 162 \|\|*

*pradhānaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca devānāṃ savyamīśvaram \|*  
*ye nārcayanti nindanti brahmahatyāṃ labhaṃti te \|\| 163 \|\|*

*ye viṣṇumāyāṃ nindanti viṣṇubhaktipradāṃ satīm \|*  
*sarvaśaktisvarūpāṃ ca prakṛtiṃ sarvamātaram \|\| 164 \|\|*

*sarvadevīsvarūpāṃ ca sarvādyāṃ sarvavanditām \|*  
*sarvakāraṇarūpāṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ labhanti te \|\| 165 \|\|*

162-165. Lord Shiva is the form of welfare, is extremely dear to lord Krishna more than his life. He is the purifier of the purified people, blissful, eternal, the best of gods and is eternal the lord, the one who does not adore him denouncing him at the same time, attracts the sin of Brahmahatya. The illusion of lord Vishnu bestows devotion, is quite chaste, is completely the form of strength, the universal mother, the form of all the goddesses, the beginning of all, adorable by all and is the cause of all, whosoever denounces her attracts Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 30.166-167 \|\|

*kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīṃ rāmanavamīṃ puṇyadāṃ parām \|*  
*śivarātriṃ tathā caikādaśīṃ vāraṃ ravestathā \|\| 166 \|\|*

*pañcaparvāṇi puṇyāni ye na kurvanti mānavāḥ \|*  
*labhante brahmahatyāṃ te cāṇḍālādhikapāpinaḥ \|\| 167 \|\|*

166-167. The birth-day of lord Krishna is quite meritorious and the best of all besides and the birth day of Rama, Shivaratri, Ekddasi and Sundays are considered to be quite auspicious. Those who do not perform vrata on these days, become sinners like the Chandala and attract Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 30.168-169 \|\|

*ambuvīcyāṃbukhanane jale śaucādikaṃ ca ye \|*  
*kurvanti bhārate vatse brahmahatyāṃ labhanti te \|\| 168 \|\|*

*guruṃ ca mātaraṃ tātaṃ sādhvīṃ bhāryyāṃ sutaṃ sutām \|*  
*anāthānyo na puṣṇāti brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ \|\| 169 \|\|*

168-169. О daughter, the one who cleanses himself with the water accumulated in the pits fonned by the waves of the water, attracts the sin of Brahmahatya. The one who does not maintain his teacher, his parents, chaste wife, the son, the daughter and other orphans, according to his own position, attracts Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 30.170 \|\|

*vivāho yasya na bhavenna paśyati sutaṃ ca yaḥ \|*  
*haribhaktivihīno yo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ \|\| 170 \|\|*

170\. The one who does not get married, the one who does not see the face of a son, the one who is deprived of the devotion of the lord, attracts Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 30.171 \|\|

*hareranaivedyabhojī nityaṃ viṣṇuṃ na pūjayet \|*  
*puṇyaṃ pārthivaliṃgaṃ vā brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ \|\| 171 \|\|*

171\. The one who does not take the naivedya of lord Vishnu, does not adore the Shivalihga daily, attracts Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 30.172 \|\|

*āhāraṃ kurvatīṃ gāṃ ca pibantīṃ yo nivārayet \|*  
*yāti goviprayormmadhye gohatyāṃ ca labhettu saḥ \|\| 172 \|\|*

172\. The one who obstructs a cow from eating fodder or drinking water or the one who walks between a cow and a Brahmana attracts Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 30.173 \|\|

*daṇḍairgāstāḍayenmūḍho yo vipro vṛṣavāhakaḥ \|*  
*dine dine gavāṃ hatyāṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 173 \|\|*

173\. Such a foolish Brahmana who beats a cow with a rod or yokes her to the plough, daily attracts the sin of killing a cow. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 30.174 \|\|

*dadāti gobhya ucchiṣṭaṃ yojayedvṛṣavāhakam \|*  
*bhojayedvṛṣavāhānnaṃ sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 174 \|\|*

174\. The one who feeds the cows with the left-over and performs yajha for Suras or drives a bull and also eats the food supplied by the driver of the bull surely attracts Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 30.175 \|\|

*vṛṣalīpatiṃ yājayedyo bhuṃkte'nnaṃ tasya yo naraḥ \|*  
*gohatyāśatakaṃ so'pi labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 175 \|\|*

175\. The one who performs yajha for the husband of a Siidra woman and eats the food supplied by her, attracts the sin of killing hundreds of cows. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 30.176 \|\|

*pādaṃ dadāti vahnau ca gāśca pādena tāḍayet \|*  
*gṛhaṃ viśedadhautāṃghriḥ snātvā govadhamāpnuyāt \|\| 176 \|\|*

176\. The one who places his feet towards the fire or kicks the cow, roams about in the house without washing his feet, surely attracts gohatya.

## \|\| 30.177 \|\|

*yo bhuṃkte snigdhapādena śete snigdhāṃghrireva ca \|*  
*sūryyodaye ca dvirbhojī sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 177 \|\|*

177\. The one who consumes food after rubbing oil in his feet and then sleeps or eats his food twice in the morning, attracts the sin of gohatya.

## \|\| 30.178-179 \|\|

*avīrānnaṃ ca yo bhuṃkte yonijīvī ca vai dvijaḥ \|*  
*yastrisandhyāvihīnaśca sa gohatyāṃ labhed dhruvam \|\| 178 \|\|*

*pitṝṃśca parvakāle ca tithikāle ca devatām \|*  
*na sevate'tithiṃ yo hi gohatyāṃ sa labheddhruvam \|\| 179 \|\|*

178-179. Such a Brahmana who takes food from a widow with his family or maintains his livelihood by evil ways and does not perform sandhya during all the three times, surely attracts the sin of gohatya (killing of cow). The one who does not serve the manes on their death anniversaries nor serve the gods or the guest, surely attracts the sin of Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 30.180 \|\|

*svabhartari ca kṛṣṇe ca bhedabuddhiṃ karoti yā \|*  
*kaṭūktyā tāḍayetkāntaṃ sā gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 180 \|\|*

180\. A woman who does not equate her husband with lord Krishna and then injures her feeling with harsh words, she surely attracts the sin of gohatya.

## \|\| 30.181 \|\|

*gomārgakhananaṃ kṛtvā vapate sasyameva ca \|*  
*taḍāge vā tadūrdhvaṃ vā sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 181 \|\|*

181\. The one who sows the seed after ploughing the track of the cows, ploughs the bank of the tanks, surely attracts gohatya.

## \|\| 30.182 \|\|

*prāyaścittaṃ govadhasya yaḥ karoti vyatikramam \|*  
*arthalobhādathājñānātsa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 182 \|\|*

182\. The one who infested with greed or out of innocence performs the repentance ceremony in a disorderly manner, he surely attracts Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 30.183 \|\|

*rājake daivake yatnādgosvāmī gāṃ na pātayet \|*  
*duḥkhaṃ dadāti yo mūḍho gohatyāṃ sa labheddhruvam \|\| 183 \|\|*

183\. The one who does not properly adore the cows on the Gopastaml day, but tortures them at the same time, surely attracts the sin of gohatya.

## \|\| 30.184-186 \|\|

*prāṇinaṃ laṃghayedyo hi devārcāyāṃ rataṃ jalam \|*  
*naivedyaṃ puṣpamannaṃ ca sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 184 \|\|*

*śaśvannāstīti vādī yo mithyāvādī pratārakaḥ \|*  
*devadveṣī gurudveṣī sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 185 \|\|*

*devatāpratimāṃ dṛṣṭvā guruṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ sati \|*  
*sambhramānna namedyo hi sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 186 \|\|*

184-186. The one who walks over a human being, the water meant for the adoration of gods, naivedya, the flowers and the food, surely attracts the sin of gohatya. The one who always has a negative approach, is deceitful and speaks falsehood always, becomes envious of the gods and the teachers surely attracts the sin of Brahmahatya. The one who does not bow in reverence before the image of the god, a teacher and a Brahmana, surely attracts the sin of Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 30.187-188 \|\|

*na dadātyāśiṣaṃ kopātpraṇatāya ca yo dvijaḥ \|*  
*vidyārthine ca vidyāṃ vai sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 187 \|\|*

*gohatyā brahmahatyā ca kathitā cātideśikī \|*  
*yathā śrutaṃ sūryyavaktrātkiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 188 \|\|*

187-188. The Brahmana who does not shower his blessing on someone getting annoyed or does not impart knowledge to the students, surely attracts the sin of gohatya. I have thus told you everything about gohatya (killing of cow) and Brahmahatya (killing of Brahmana) What more do you want to listen to from me?

## \|\| 30.189 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*vāstave cātideśe ca sambandhe pāpapuṇyayoḥ \|*  
*nyūnādhike ca ko bhedastanmāṃ vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 189 \|\|*

189\. Savitri said — You tell me about the real difference between merit and sin and their increase or decrease.

## \|\| 30.190-191 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*kutrāpi vāstavaḥ śreṣṭho nyūno'tideśikassadā \|*  
*kutrātideśikaḥ śreṣṭho vāstavo nyūna eva ca \|\| 190 \|\|*

*kutra vā samatā sādhvi tayorvedapramāṇataḥ \|*  
*karoti tatra nāsthāṃ yo guruhatyāṃ labhettu saḥ \|\| 191 \|\|*

190-191. Yama said — О chaste lady, sometimes the reality prevails and sometimes the unreality overpowers reality. Sometimes both of them run paralleled. The Vedas are the evidence for the same, the one who does not believe in this evidence attracts the sin of killing a teacher.

## \|\| 30.192 \|\|

*purā paricite vipre vidyāmantrapradātari \|*  
*gurau pitṛtvamāropādvastutaśśreṣṭha ucyate \|\| 192 \|\|*

192\. It's always good to honour a Brahmana, the teacher who imparts learnings or the mantra as your own father.

## \|\| 30.193 \|\|

*pituḥ śataguṇā mātā mātuḥ śataguṇastathā \|*  
*vidyā mantrapradātā ca guruḥ pūjyaḥ śrutermataḥ \|\| 193 \|\|*

193\. The mother is adorable a hundred times more than the father and the teacher who imparts learnings and the mantra is equally adorable. This is ordained by the Vedas.

## \|\| 30.194 \|\|

*guruto gurupatnī ca gaurave ca garīyasī \|*  
*yatheṣṭaṃ devapatnī ca pūjyā cābhīṣṭadevatā \|\| 194 \|\|*

194\. The glory of the teacher's wife is to be held in the highest esteem. She is to be adored like a goddess.

## \|\| 30.195 \|\|

*vipraḥ śivasamo yaśca viṣṇutulyaparākramaḥ \|*  
*rājā''tideśikācchreṣṭho vāstavo guṇalakṣataḥ \|\| 195 \|\|*

195\. The Brahmana is adorable like Shiva but a valorous king is adorable like lord Vishnu but the reality is thousand times better than the unreality.

## \|\| 30.196 \|\|

*sarvaṃ gaṅgāsamaṃ toyaṃ sarve vyāsasamā dvijāḥ \|*  
*grahaṇe sṛryyaśaśinoścātraiva samatā tayoḥ \|\| 196 \|\|*

196\. Similarly all the waters are like the water of Ganga and all the Brahmanas are like Vyasa. That is why they are equated with the time of the rolar or lunar eclipses.

## \|\| 30.197 \|\|

*ātideśikahatyāyā vāstavaśca caturguṇaḥ \|*  
*sammataḥ sarvavedānāmityāha kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 197 \|\|*

197\. Real killing is four times more sinful than fake killing. This is the opinion of the Vedas. This has been ordained by Brahma.

## \|\| 30.198-199 \|\|

*ātideśikahatyāyā bhedaśca kathitaḥ sati \|*  
*yā yā'gamyā nṛṇāmeva nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 198 \|\|*

*svastrī gamyā ca sarveṣāmiti vede nirūpitā \|*  
*agamyā ca tadanyā yā ceti vedavedo viduḥ \|\| 199 \|\|*

198-199. Thus I have spoken out to you the difference between real killing and fake killing. Now I tell you the place which is approachable by human beings. It is ordained in the Vedas that only one's own spouse is approachable. This is a command for everyone therefore the other women are considered to be unapproachable. This has been ordained by the Vedas.

## \|\| 30.200 \|\|

*sāmānyaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sundari \|*  
*atyagamyāśca yā yā vai nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 200 \|\|*

200\. O beautiful one, I have told you about the ordinary difference in this regard and I am going to tell you about the specific difference in this connection. You please listen to me as to who is approachable and who is not? I am going to speak out the same.

## \|\| 30.201 \|\|

*śūdrāṇāṃ viprapatnī ca viprāṇāṃ śūdrakāminī \|*  
*atyagamyā'tinindyā ca loke vede pativrate \|\| 201 \|\|*

201\. О chaste lady, for Shudras a Brahmana girl is unapproachable while for a Brahmana a Stidra girl is unapproachable. This has been denounced in the Vedas.

## \|\| 30.202 \|\|

*śūdraścedbrāhmaṇīṃ gacchedbrahmahatyāśataṃ labhet \|*  
*tatsamaṃ brāhmaṇī cāpi kumbhīpākaṃ vrajeddhruvam \|\| 202 \|\|*

202\. Such a Shudra who enjoys the company of a Brahmana woman attracts the sin of a hundred Brahmahatyas and similarly the Brahmana lady also falls into the Kumbhlpaka hell.

## \|\| 30.203 \|\|

*yadi śūdrāṃ vrajedvipro vṛṣalīpatireva saḥ \|*  
*sa bhraṣṭo viprajāteśca caṇḍālātso 'dhamaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 203 \|\|*

203\. If a Brahmana enjoys the company of a Shudra woman he is called the husband of a wicked woman. He falls from the Brahmana race and achieves the position of a Chandala.

## \|\| 30.204 \|\|

*viṣṭhāsamaśca tatpiṃḍo mūtratulyaṃ ca tarpaṇam \|*  
*tatpitṝṇāṃ surāṇāṃ ca pūjane tatsamaṃ sati \|\| 204 \|\|*

204\. The pindas offered by him are treated like refuse and the tarpana offered by him is equated with urine, which is neither accepted by the manes nor the god.

## \|\| 30.205 \|\|

*koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ sandhyārcātapasā'rjitam \|*  
*dvijasya vṛṣalībhogānnaśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 205 \|\|*

205\. Similarly the performing of sandhya., the adoration of the gods, besides the merits earned by him in many of his previous births, vanish with the company of a Shudra woman. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 30.206 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaśca surāpītī viḍbhojī vṛṣalīpatiḥ \|*  
*harivāsarabhojī ca kumbhīpākaṃ vrajeddhruvam \|\| 206 \|\|*

206\. The Brahmana who consumes liquor, the one who consumes the food on the Ekadashi day, surely falls in the Kumbhlpakas hell.

## \|\| 30.207-209 \|\|

*gurupatnīṃ rājapatnīṃ sapatnīmātaraṃ prasūm \|*  
*sutāṃ putravadhūṃ śvaśrūṃ sagarbhāṃ bhaginīṃ sati \|\| 207 \|\|*

*sodarabhrātṛjāyāṃ ca mātulānīṃ pitṛprasūm \|*  
*mātuḥ prasūṃ tattvasāraṃ bhaginīṃ bhrātṛkanyakām \|\| 208 \|\|*

*śiṣyāṃ ca śiṣyapatnīṃ ca bhagineyasya kāminīm \|*  
*bhrātuḥ putrapriyāṃ caivāpyagamyāmāha padmajaḥ \|\| 209 \|\|*

207-209. The wife of the teacher, the wife of the ruler, the step-mother, the mother, the daughter, the daughter-in-law, the wife of the real brother, the maternal-aunt, the mother of the father (grandmother), the mother of the mother, the sister of the mother, the sister, the daughter of the brother (niece), the student, the wife of the student, the wife of the son of the sister, the wife of brother's son, all these women are unapproachable (and one should not cohabit with them.) This has been ordained by Brahma.

## \|\| 30.210 \|\|

*etāsvekāmanekāṃ vā yo vrajenmānavo'dhamaḥ \|*  
*svamātṛgāmī vedeṣu brahmahatyāśataṃ labhet \|\| 210 \|\|*

210\. If any one enjoys the company of one's own mother he falls into the hell. Such a person attracts several of the Brahmahatyas. This has been ordained in the Vedas.

## \|\| 30.211 \|\|

*akarmmārho'pi so'spṛśyo loke vede'ti ninditaḥ \|*  
*sa yāti kumbhīpākaṃ ca mahāpāpī sudustaram \|\| 211 \|\|*

211\. He becomes an untouchable, is incapable of performing good deeds and is denounced in public, finally falling into the terrific hell.

## \|\| 30.212 \|\|

*karotyaśuddhāṃ sandhyāṃ ca sandhyāṃ vā na karoti yaḥ \|*  
*trisandhyāṃ varjayedyo vā sandhyāhīnaśca sa dvijaḥ \|\| 212 \|\|*

212\. The one who performs incomplete sandhya or does not perform it at all or does not perform the sandhya thrice, such a type of Brahmana is deprived of the sandhya performing.

## \|\| 30.213 \|\|

*vaiṣṇavaṃ ca tathā śaivaṃ śāktaṃ sauraṃ ca gāṇapam \|*  
*yo'haṅkārānna gṛhṇāti mantraṃ so'dīkṣitaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 213 \|\|*

213\. Such of the person who does not accept the mantras of Vishnu, Shiva, sakti and Ganpati out of arrogance is called a person without the dlksa.

## \|\| 30.214-218 \|\|

*pravāhamavadhiṃ kṛtvā yāvaddhastacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*tatra nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī gaṅgāgarbhāntare vare \|\| 214 \|\|*

*tatra nārāyaṇakṣetre kurukṣetre hareḥ pade \|*  
*vārāṇasyāṃ badaryyāṃ ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame \|\| 215 \|\|*

*puṣkare bhāskarakṣetre prabhāse rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*haridvāre ca kedāre some badarapāvane \|\| 216 \|\|*

*sarasvatīnadītīre puṇye vṛndāvane vane \|*  
*godāvaryāṃ ca kauśikyāṃ triveṇyāṃ ca himālaye \|\| 217 \|\|*

*eṣvanyatra ca yo dānaṃ pratigṛhṇāti kāmataḥ \|*  
*sa ca tīrthapratigrāhī kumbhīpākaṃ prayāti ca \|\| 218 \|\|*

214-218. The land extending to the four feet of the river bank is called the Narayana-ksetra. Narayana himself happens to be the lord of the said region. In the Narayana-ksetra, Kuruksetra, Vishnupada, Varanasi, Badarl, the confluence of the Ganga and the ocean, Puskara. Bhaskara-ksetra, Prabhasa, Rasamandala, Haridvara, Kedara, Soma, Badrikashrama, the banks of the Sarasvati river, the sacred place of Vrindavana, Godavari, Kausikl, TrivenI and Himalaya are the sacred places. Whosoever accepts charities in these places has to fall into the Kumbhipaka hell.

## \|\| 30.219 \|\|

*śūdrātiriktayājī yo grāmayājī ca kīrttitaḥ \|*  
*tathā devopajīvī yo devalaḥ parikīrttitaḥ \|\| 219 \|\|*

219\. Those who perform yajnas for the Siidras and in different villages, are called Gramayaji. Such of the people as earn their living by performing рща are called Pujarls.

## \|\| 30.220 \|\|

*śūdrapākopajīvī yaḥ sūpakāra iti smṛtaḥ \|*  
*sandhyāpūjāvihīnaśca pramattaḥ patitaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 220 \|\|*

220\. The one who cooks food in the kitchen of the Siidras is called a Bhandarl. All these persons are deprived of sandhya and the adoration of the lord and are considered to be quite degraded.

## \|\| 30.221-222 \|\|

*uktaṃ pūrvaprakaraṇe lakṣaṇaṃ vṛṣalīpateḥ \|*  
*ete mahāpātakinaḥ kumbhīpākaṃ prayānti te \|\| 221 \|\|*

*kuṃḍānyanyāni te yānti nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 222 \|\|*

221-222. In the earlier context the definition of the husband of a wicked woman has been described. Such a sinful person falls into the Kumbhipaka hell. I am now going to tell you about the people who fall in the other types of hells. You please listen to me.

## Chapter 31

## \|\| 31.1-2 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*harisevāṃ vinā sādhvi na labhetkarmakhaṇḍanam \|*  
*śubhakarmma svargabījaṃ narakaṃ ca kukarmmataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*puṃścalyannaṃ ca yo bhuṃkte veśyānnaṃ ca pativrate \|*  
*tāṃ vrajettu dvijo yo hi kālasūtraṃ prayāti saḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yama said — О chaste lady, without adoring the lord, the bad deeds of the human beings do not vanish. Because by performing good deeds one achieves heaven and by performing bad deeds one achieves hell. О chaste lady, the one who consumes the food of a wicked woman or a whore or the one who enjoys the company of a degraded woman, falls into the hell named kalasutra.

## \|\| 31.3-4 \|\|

*śatavarṣaṃ kālasūtre sthitvā śūdro bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*tatra janmani rogī ca tataḥ śuddho bhaveddvijaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*pativratā caikapatnī dvitīye kulaṭā smṛtā \|*  
*tṛtīye dharṣiṇī jñeyā caturthe puṃścalī smṛtā \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. He remains there for a hundred years and is reborn in the house of a Shudra and attracts illness right from the time of the birth. Thereafter he is purified. Thus the woman having only one husband is called the chaste woman and the one having two of them is called КиШй and the one having three of them is called Dharsinl and the one having four of them is called Punscall.

## \|\| 31.5 \|\|

*veśyā ca pañcame ṣaṣṭhe yugmī ca parikīrtitā \|*  
*ata ūrdhvaṃ mahāveśyā sā'spṛśyā sarvajātiṣu \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The one having the company of five men is called a whore and the one having six of them is called Yugml and the one who has more than that is called a great whore. She becomes untouchable for all the castes.

## \|\| 31.6 \|\|

*yo dvijaḥ kulaṭāṃ gaccheddharṣiṇīṃ puṃścalīmapi \|*  
*veśya yugmīṃ mahāveśyāmavaṭodaṃ prayāti saḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. A Brahmana who enjoys the company of a kulata, dharslnl, punscall, vesya, yugml and the great whore, falls into the terrific hell.

## \|\| 31.7-8 \|\|

*śatābdaṃ kulaṭāgāmī dhṛṣṭāgāmī caturguṇam \|*  
*ṣaḍguṇaṃ puṃścalīgāmī veśyāgāmī guṇāṣṭakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*yugmīgāmī daśaguṇaṃ vasettatra na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*mahāveśyākāmukaśca tataḥ śataguṇaṃ vaset \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Such a sinful person remains there for a hundred years. The one who visits, Dhrsta, remains in the hell for four hundred years and the one who visits, Punscall remains in the hell for six times more the number of years, the one who visits the whore remains eight time more the number of years in the hell, the one who keeps the company of Yugml, remains in the hell for ten times more the number of years in the hell and the one who visits the great whore, has to remain in the hell for a hundred times more the number of years in the hell. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 31.9 \|\|

*tadā hi sarvagāmī cetyevamāha pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*tatraiva yātanāṃ bhuṅkte yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. He is then termed as Sarvagaml. This has been ordained by Brahma. He is then tortured by the messengers of Yama and he suffers variously.

## \|\| 31.10-11 \|\|

*tittiriḥ kulaṭāgāmī dhṛṣṭāgāmī ca vāyasaḥ \|*  
*kokilaḥ puṃścalīgāmī veśyāgāmī vṛkastathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*yugmīgāmī sūkaraśca saptajanmasu bhārate \|*  
*mahāveśyākāmukaśca śmaśāne śālmalistaruḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Thereafter that sinful person is reborn as a crow, a cuckoo, a hyena, a pig and a semara-tree in the cremation ground respectively.

## \|\| 31.12 \|\|

*yo bhuṃkte jñānahīnaśca grahaṇe candrasūyyaryoḥ \|*  
*aruntudaṃ sa yātyeva candramānābdameva ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The one who takes food innocently during the time of solar or lunar eclipse, falls into the hell named Aruntuda.

## \|\| 31.13 \|\|

*tato bhavenmānavassyādudaravyādhisaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*gulmayuktaśca kāṇaśca dantahīnastataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Therefore he takes birth as a human and suffers from stomach-ache, pain in joints, besides being one-eyed and is deprived of teeth. He is thereafter purified.

## \|\| 31.14-15 \|\|

*vākpradattāṃ hi kanyāṃ ca yaścānyasmai dadāti ca \|*  
*sa vasetpāṃśubhoge ca tadbhojī ca śatābdakam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*dattāpahārī yaḥ sādhvi pāśaveṣṭaṃ śatābdakam \|*  
*nivaseccharaśayyāyāṃ yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. The one who gives away to someone else his daughter whom he had promised to give, suffers in the hell name Pansubhoga for a hundred years and consumes dust as his food. О chaste lady, the one who snatches away something given in charity, falls into the hell named bed of arrows and is tortured by the messengers of Yama daily for a hundred years.

## \|\| 31.16-17 \|\|

*na pūjayedyo hi bhaktyā śivaliṅgaṃ ca pārthivam \|*  
*sa yāti śūlinaḥ kopācchūlaprotaṃ sudāruṇam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*sthitvā śatābdaṃ tatraiva śvāpadaḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*tato bhaveddevalaśca saptajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. The one who does not adore the Shiva-linga of Shiva, falls into the hell named sidaprota and suffers badly. He suffers the torture of many types for a hundred years and then is reborn as a wild animal seven times. Thereafter he becomes a pujarl of a temple before he is purified.

## \|\| 31.18-19 \|\|

*karoti daṇḍaṃ yo vipre yadbhayātkampate dvijaḥ \|*  
*prakampane vasetso'pi vipralomābdameva ca \|\| 18 \|\|*

*prakopavadanā kopātsvāminaṃ yā ca paśyati \|*  
*kaṭūktiṃ taṃ ca vadati yāti colkāmukhaṃ ca sā \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. The one who punishes a Brahmana and by whose terror a Brahmana gets terrified, such a wicked fellow falls in the hell named Prakampana and remains there for the number of years equivalent to the number of the hair on the body of a Brahmana. The woman who looks at her husband in rage and also utters harsh words to him, falls into the hell named Ulkamukha.

## \|\| 31.20 \|\|

*ulkāṃ dadāti vaktre ca satataṃ yamakiṅkaraḥ \|*  
*daṇḍena tāḍayenmūrdhni tallomābdapramāṇakam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The messengers of Yama continuously insert the burning wood into her mouth and she remains in that hell suffering the torture striking her head.

## \|\| 31.21-22 \|\|

*tato bhavenmānavī ca vidhavā saptajanmasu \|*  
*bhuktvā duḥkhaṃ ca vaidhavyaṃ vyādhiṃ bhuktvā tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*yā brāhmaṇī śūdrabhogyā sā'ndhakūpaṃ prayāti ca \|*  
*taptaśaucodake dhvānte tadāhārā divāniśam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. She is then reborn in the human race and becomes a widow seven times. Thus suffering the misfortune of becoming a widow, she suffers from ailments and thereafter she is purified. When a Brahmana woman keeps the company of a SDdra, she falls into and andhakiipa hell. She had to spend time in the dirty water and has to consume the same day and night.

## \|\| 31.23 \|\|

*nivasedatisantaptā yamadūtena tāḍitā \|*  
*śaucodake nimagnā ca yāvadindrāścaturdaśa \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Thus suffering badly, she has to face the torture of the messengers of Yama. Thus she remains in that hell up to the time of the life of fourteen Indras.

## \|\| 31.24-26 \|\|

*kākī janmasahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkarī \|*  
*kukkuṭī śatajanmāni śṛgālī saptajanmasu \|\| 24 \|\|*

*pārāvatī saptajanau vānarī saptajanmasu \|*  
*tato bhavetsā caṇḍālī sarvabhogyā ca bhārate \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tato bhavecca rajakī yakṣmagrastā ca puṃścalī \|*  
*tataḥ kuṣṭhayutā tailakārī śuddhā bhavettataḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. Thereafter she is born in the land of Bharata as a female crow for a thousand times, a female pig for a hundred limes, a doe for a hundred times and a female jackal for seven times, a female pigeon for seven limes and then she is born in the family of a Chandala, then a washerwoman suffering from consumption and then becomes a whore. Thereafter she becomes on oil-woman suffering from leprosy. She is then purified.

## \|\| 31.27-29 \|\|

*veśyā vasedvedhane ca yugmī vai daṇḍatāḍane \|*  
*jālabandhe mahāveśyā kulaṭā dehacūrṇake \|\| 27 \|\|*

*svairiṇī dalane caiva dhṛṣṭā vai śoṣaṇe tathā \|*  
*nivasedyātanāyuktā yamadūtena tāḍitā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*viṇmūtrabhakṣaṇaṃ tatra yāvanmanvantaraṃ sati \|*  
*tato bhavedviṭkṛmiśca varṣalakṣaṃ tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

27-29. Similarly a whore falls into Vedhana hell, the Yugml in Dandatadana hell, the great whore in Jalabandha hell, Kulata in Dehacdrna hell and other wicked woman in the hell named Dalana. Dhrstd falls into the Sosana hell and is tortured by the messengers of Yama and has to suffer several types of pains. Thereafter she is born as the insect of refuse. Thereafter she is purified.

## \|\| 31.30-31 \|\|

*brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇīṃ gacchetkṣattriyāmapi kṣatriyaḥ \|*  
*vaiśyo vaiśyāṃ ca śūdrāṃ ca śūdro vā'pi vrajedyadi \|\| 30 \|\|*

*svavarṇaparadārī ca kaṣaṃ yāti tayā saha \|*  
*bhuktvā kaṣāyataptodaṃ nivaseddvādaśābdakam \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. If a Brahmana enjoys another Brahmana woman, a Ksatrlya and an other Ksatrlya woman and a Vaishaya a Vaisaya woman and a Shudra with other Sfldra woman, such a person falls into a hell named Kasa. He remains there for twelve years in a hot water kunda and has to consume the same water.

## \|\| 31.32 \|\|

*tato vipro bhavecchuddhaścaivaṃ ca kṣatriyādayaḥ \|*  
*yoṣitaścāpi śudhyantītyevamāha pitāmahaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Thereafter the Brahmana is purified. Similarly the Ksatrlya and other women are also purified. This has been ordained by Brahma.

## \|\| 31.33 \|\|

*kṣatriyo brāhmaṇīṃ gacchedvaiśyo vā'pi pativrate \|*  
*mātṛgāmī bhavetso'pi śūrpaṃ ca narakaṃ vrajet \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. О chaste lady, if a Ksatrlya or Vaishya cohabits with a Brahmana woman, he earns the sin of cohabiting with his own mother and falls into the hell named Supra.

## \|\| 31.34-35 \|\|

*śūrpākāraiśca kṛmibhirbrāhmaṇyā saha bhakṣitaḥ \|*  
*prataptamūtrabhojī ca yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*tatraiva yātanāṃ bhuṃkte yāvadindrāścaturdaśa \|*  
*saptajanmasu vārāhaśchāgalaśca tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 35\|\|*

34-35. The insects of the types of wallowing baskets torture that person together with the Brahmana woman and the man has to consume boiling hot urine. They are also tortured by the messenger of Yama. Thus they suffer the human torture up to the period of the life of fourteen Indras; they are then born as pigs and goats for seven times before they are purified.

## \|\| 31.36-37 \|\|

*kare dhṛtvā ca tulasīṃ pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet \|*  
*mithyā vā śapathaṃ kuryyātsa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet \|\| 36 \|\|*

*gaṅgātoyaṃ kare dhṛtvā pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet \|*  
*śilāṃ ca devapratimāṃ sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Holding the Tulasi leaf in his hand if one takes a vow and then backs out or takes a false vow, he falls into the hell named Jvalamukha. The one who takes a vow holding the water of the Ganga, Shalagrama stone or image of the god and does not follow it, he falls into a hell named Jvalamukha.

## \|\| 31.38 \|\|

*dattvā ca dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet \|*  
*sthitvā devagṛhe vā'pi sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. One who takes a vow raising his right hand or takes a vow in the temple of the god but fails to follow it, he falls into hell named Jvalamukha.

## \|\| 31.39-40 \|\|

*spṛṣṭvā ca brāhmaṇaṃ gāṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇusamaṃ sati \|*  
*na pālayetpratijñāṃ ca sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet \|\| 39 \|\|*

*mitradrohī kṛtaghnaśca yo hi viśvāsaghātakaḥ \|*  
*mithyāsākṣyapradaścaiva sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. The one who takes a vow touching a Brahmana or Vishnu or a cow or the fire and does not fulfil the vow falls into the hell named Jvalamukha. The one who betrays his friend, is an ungrateful person, the one who is the betrayer of the faith of others and the one who gives false evidence, falls into the hell named Jvalamukha.

## \|\| 31.41 \|\|

*ete tatra vasantyeva yāvadindrāścaturdaśa \|*  
*yathā'ṅgārapradagdhāśca yamadūtaiśca tāḍitāḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. All such people remain in the hell up to the period equivalent to the life of fourteen Indras and have to suffer badly from the fire flames and are tortured daily by the messengers of Yama.

## \|\| 31.42-43 \|\|

*caṇḍālastulasīsparśī saptajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*mleccho gaṃgājalasparśī pañcajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*śilāsparśī viṭkṛmiśca saptajanmasu sundari \|*  
*arccāsparśī vraṇakṛmissaptajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. Those who take a vow after touching the Tulasi plant are reborn as Chandalas for seven times. The one who takes a false vow after touching the waters of the Ganga has to be born as a Mleccha at least five times before he is purified. О beautiful one, touching the stone of SHlagrama the one who takes a false oath, is reborn as an insect of the refuse for seven times. The one who takes a false oath after touching the articles of adoration, is reborn as an insect of the refuse for seven times. Thereafter he is purified.

## \|\| 31.44-45 \|\|

*dakṣahastapradhātā ca sarpassyātsaptajanmasu \|*  
*tato bhaveddhastahīno mānavaśca tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*mithyāvādī devagṛhe devalaḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*viprādisparśakārī ca so'gradānī bhaveddhruvam \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. The one who takes a false oath extending the right hand is born as a snake seven times; he is then born as a human without right hand. He is purified thereafter. The one who tells a lie in a temple, is reborn as the temple priest seven times. Thereafter he is born as a Brahmana.

## \|\| 31.46-48 \|\|

*tato bhavanti mūkāste badhirāśca trijanmasu \|*  
*bhāryyāhīnā vaṃśahīnā buddhihīnāstataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*mitradrohī ca na kulaḥ kṛtaghnaścāpi gaṇḍakaḥ \|*  
*viśvāsaghātī vyāghraśca saptajanmasu bhārate \|\| 47 \|\|*

*mithyāsākṣyapradaścaiva bhallūkaḥ saptajanmasu \|*  
*pūrvānsapta parānsapta puruṣānhanti cātmanaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

46-48. He is born as a deaf and dumb person thrice, having no wife, children or wisdom. He is purified thereafter. The one who betrays his own friend, is reborn as a mongoose seven times, the ungrateful person is born as the rhinoceros, the betrayer turns as a tiger and the one who gives false evidence becomes a bear. Thus such people have to suffer for their sins up to seven births and they also drag their seven earlier generations with them to the hell.

## \|\| 31.49-50 \|\|

*nityakriyāvihīnaśca jaḍatvena yuto dvijaḥ \|*  
*yasyānāsthā vedavākye mandaṃ hasati saṃtamam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*vratopavāsahīnaśca sadvākyapariniṃdakaḥ \|*  
*jihme jihmo vasetso'pi śatābdaṃ ca himodake \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. Such of the Brahmanas as are deprived of their daily religious routine and do not believe in the Vedas, are devoid of wisdom. The one who laughs at the intelligent people, is relieved of all the vratas and denounces the rightful things. He then becomes wicked and falls into the pit of snow for a hundred years suffering badly.

## \|\| 31.51-53 \|\|

*jalajaṃturbhavetso'pi śatajanmakrameṇa ca \|*  
*tato nānāprakārā ca matsyajātistataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*yo vā dhanasyāpahāraṃ devābrahmaṇayoścaret \|*  
*pātayitvā svapuruṣāndaśa pūrvāndaśāparān \|\| 52 \|\|*

*svayaṃ yāti ca dhūmāṃdhaṃ dhūmadhvāṃtasamanvitam \|*  
*dhūmakliṣṭo dhūmabhojī vasettatra caturyugam \|\| 53 \|\|*

51-53. Thereafter for a hundred births he appears an aquatic animal and a fish. He is purified thereafter. The one who steals away the riches of the Brahmanas and the gods, falls into the hell with ten earlier generations and is covered with smoke always. He gets fed up with the smoke there and has to consume only the smoke. He remains there for four yugas.

## \|\| 31.54-55 \|\|

*tato mūṣakajātiśca śatajanmāni bhārate \|*  
*tato nānāvidhāḥ pakṣijātayaḥ kṛmijātayaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*tato nānāvidhā vṛkṣajātayaśca tato naraḥ \|*  
*bhāryāhīno vaṃśahīnaḥ śabaro vyādhisaṃyutaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. Thereafter he takes rebirth hundred of times in the land of Bharata in the line if rats. Thereafter he entered into the various types of birds and insects.

## \|\| 31.56 \|\|

*tato bhavetsvarṇakāraḥ suvarṇasya vaṇiktathā \|*  
*tato yavanasevī ca brāhmaṇo gaṇakastataḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. He is then grown on earth as a tree besides being a forest dweller having no wife, no son and he always suffers from ailments. Thereafter, he is born as a wise Brahmana well-versed in astrology.

## \|\| 31.57-58 \|\|

*vipro daivajñopajīvī vaidyajīvī cikitsakaḥ \|*  
*vyāpārī lohalākṣāde rasādervikrayī ca yaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*sa yāti nāgaveṣṭaṃ ca nāgairveṣṭita eva ca \|*  
*vasetsvalomamānābdaṃ tatra vai nāgadaṃśitaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. The Brahmana who earns his living by practising astrology or becomes a physician or a dealer in iron and also sells powdered medicine falls into the Nagavesfl hell. Depending on the Nagas he has to stay there up to the number of years equivalent to the number of the hair he has on his body and is bitten by the Nagas daily.

## \|\| 31.59-61 \|\|

*tato bhavetsa gaṇako vaidyo vai saptajanmasu \|*  
*gopaśca karmmakāraśca śaṅkhakārastataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*prasiddhāni ca kuṇḍāni kathitāni pativrate \|*  
*anyāni cāprasiddhāni tatra kṣudrāṇi santi vai \|\| 60 \|\|*

*santi pātakinasteṣu svakarmaphalabhoginaḥ \|*  
*bhramaṃti tāvatsaṃsāre kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 61 \|\|*

59-61. Thereafter for seven births, he becomes an astrologer, a physician, a cowherd, a carpenter and a creator of conches. He is then purified. О chaste lady, I have now described and prominent hells to you. There are several other hells which are of insignificant nature which the sinners achieve as a result of their evil deeds and roam about in the entire universe. What made do you want to listen to from me?

## Chapter 32

## \|\| 32.1-4 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*dharmarāja mahābhāga vedavedāṅgapāraga \|*  
*nānāpurāṇetihāsapāñcarātrapradarśakaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sarveṣu sārabhūtaṃ yatsarveṣṭaṃ sarvasammatam \|*  
*karmacchede bījarūpaṃ praśaṃsyaṃ sukhadaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 2 \|\|*

*yaśaḥpradaṃ dharmadaṃ ca sarvamaṃgalamaṃgalam \|*  
*yena yāmīṃ na te yāṃti yātanāṃ bhavaduḥkhadām \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kuṇḍāni ca na paśyanti tatra naiva pataṃti ca \|*  
*na bhavedyena janmādi tatkarma vada suvrata \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Savitri said — О Dharmaraja, О great lord, you are the best among those well-versed in the Vedas, you are the profounder of the Puranas, the history and the philosophy of Pancarcitra. Therefore you tell me the true form of tattva, the one which is dearest of all, adorable by all and is responsible for the destruction from the roots of the deeds of the human-beings who is praised by everyone, is the bestower of welfare and glory besides dharma and is the welfare of all the welfares. You kindly enlighten me on the subject to enable me to relieve myself of the tortures of Yama and the worldly miseries. О great person, you tell me about the action by performing which one should not have a sight at the various types of hells and one should not fall into them besides freeing oneself from the cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 32.5 \|\|

*kimākārāṇi kuṇḍāni kāni teṣāṃ matāni ca \|*  
*kena rūpeṇa tatraiva sadā tiṣṭhaṃti pāpinaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. What are the size of the Kunclas, what are their basis and how do the sinners dwell in them.

## \|\| 32.6 \|\|

*svadehe bhasmasādbhūte yāṃti lokāntaraṃ narāḥ \|*  
*kena dehena vā bhogaṃ bhuñjate vā śubhāśubham \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. After the dead body is burnt, the soul travels to the other regions, then how does he suffer the result of his deeds and in what forms.

## \|\| 32.7 \|\|

*suciraṃ kleśabhogena kathaṃ deho na naśyati \|*  
*deho vā kiṃvidho brahmaṃstanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Why then the ethereal body is not destroyed after suffering so much of fortune? Therefore О Brahmana, what is the form at of that ctherial body you kindly explain to me.

## \|\| 32.8 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*sāvitrīvacanaṃ śrutvā dharmarājo hariṃ smaran \|*  
*kathāṃ kathitumārebhe guruṃ natvā ca nārada \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Narayana said — О Narada, having been so asked by Savitri, Dharmaraja remembered lord Vishnu and bowing before his teacher he started speaking.

## \|\| 32.9-10 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*vatse caturṣu vedeṣu dharmo vai saṃhitāsu ca \|*  
*purāṇeṣvitihāseṣu pāñcarātrādikeṣu ca \|\| 9 \|\|*

*anyeṣu sarvaśāstreṣu vedāṃgeṣu ca suvrate \|*  
*sarveṣṭaṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca maṃgalaṃ kṛṣṇasevanam \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Yama said — О daughter, all the four Vedas, the Samhitas, the Puranas, history, Pancaratra and other scriptures have highlighted this point. All other scriptures also point towards the same. The adoration of lord Krishna is the desire of all and provides welfare to all.

## \|\| 32.11-12 \|\|

*janmamṛtyujarārogaśokasantāpatāraṇam \|*  
*sarvamaṅgalarūpaṃ ca paramānandakāraṇam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kāraṇaṃ sarvasiddhīnāṃ narakārṇavatāraṇam \|*  
*bhaktivṛkṣāṃkurakaraṃ karmavṛkṣanikṛntanam \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. This relieves one of the birth, death, old age, disease, grief, sufferings and provides for welfare and bliss. It is the cause of all success and makes one to cross over the ocean of hell. It makes the tree of devotion sprout in one's mind and destroys the tree of actions in one's body.

## \|\| 32.13 \|\|

*golokamārgasopānamavināśipadapradam \|*  
*sālokyasārṣṭisārūpyasāmīpyādipradaṃ śubhe \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. This is the step towards proceeding to Goloka; it never vanishes and leads to the eternal place and four types of Moksas.

## \|\| 32.14-16 \|\|

*kuṇḍāni yamadūtaṃ ca yamaṃ ca yamakiṅkarān \|*  
*svapne'pi nahi paśyanti sati śrīkṛṣṇakiṅkarāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*harivrataṃ ye kurvaṃti gṛhiṇaḥ karmabhoginaḥ \|*  
*ye snāṃti haritīrthe ca nāśnanti harivāsare \|\| 15 \|\|*

*praṇamaṃti hariṃ nityaṃ haryyarcāṃ pūjayanti ca \|*  
*na yānti te ca ghorāṃ ca mama saṃyamanīṃ purīm \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. О glorious one, thus becoming the slave of lord Krishna, such a person is relieved of all the kundas and messengers of Yama. Yama and his messengers do not trouble him even in dream. The good nature house-holders should adore him, lake a bath at the sacred places of the lord and do not take food on Ekadashi day, adore the lord daily making offerings to him, do not reach the hell which is my abode.

## \|\| 32.17-18 \|\|

*trisandhyapūtā viprāśca śuddhācārasamanvitāḥ \|*  
*svadharmaniratāḥ śāntā na yānti yamamandiram \|\| 17 \|\|*

*te svargabhogino'nye ca śuddhā devānyakiṃkarāḥ \|*  
*yāntyāyānti ca martyaṃ ca svargaṃ ca nahi nirvṛtāḥ \|*  
*nivṛttiṃ na hi lipsanti kṛṣṇasevāṃ vinā narāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Those Brahmanas who perform the sandhyas thrice a day, whose actions are spotless, who are engrossed in religious activities and remain peaceful, they do not have to go to the abode of Yama. They enjoy the comforts of the heaven, the other people also w'ho are very clean in their approach and serve the other gods, they travel between heaven and earth and from earth to heaven. But they do not achieve salvation because without the adoration of lord Krishna, the people cannot be freed from the cycle of birth and death. 1

## \|\| 32.19-23 \|\|

*svadharmmaniratāścāpi svadharmaviratāstathā \|*  
*gacchanto martyalokaṃ ca durddharṣā yamakiṅkarāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*bhītāḥ kṛṣṇopāsakācca vainateyādivoragāḥ \|*  
*svadūtaṃ pāśahastaṃ ca gacchantaṃ taṃ vadāmyaham \|\| 20 \|\|*

*yāsyasīti ca sarvatra haribhaktāśramaṃ vinā \|*  
*kṛṣṇamantropāsakānāṃ nāmāni ca nikṛntanam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*karoti nakharāñjalyā citraguptaśca bhītavat \|*  
*madhuparkādikaṃ brahmā teṣāṃ ca kurute punaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*vilaṃghya brahmalokaṃ ca goloke gacchatāṃ satām \|*  
*duritāni ca naśyanti teṣāṃ saṃsparśamātrataḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

19-23. The messengers of Yama are quite terrific ones, but finding a devotee of lord Krishna they disappear so rapidly like the serpent who vanishes in no time on the arrival of Garuda. Thereafter even after getting engaged in their own dharma they get relieved of their own dharma. When the messengers of Yama holding the noose in their hands get ready to descent on earth, then I tell those messengers that “You should go lo every place but never go to the place of the devotees of lord Krishna. In case the names of the devotees of lord Krishna are return erroneously, the messengers, of Yama get terrified and Chitragupta removes them (from the list) with folded hands. Brahma serves them offering Madhuparka. Such devotees of Vishnu cross the Brahmaloka and proceed on to Goloka the abode of Krishna. Such devotees of Krishna while proceeding on to Goloka to whomsoever they come in touch wdth, all their sins are removed.

## \|\| 32.24 \|\|

*yathā suprajvaladvahnau kāṣṭhāni ca tṛṇāni ca \|*  
*prāpnoti mohaḥ saṃmohaṃ tāṃśca dṛṣṭvā'tibhītavat \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. As the dry wood and the hay burns out in flames, similarly (at the sight of devotees of Vis nu) the illusion also disappears getting terrified.

## \|\| 32.25 \|\|

*kāmaśca kāminaṃ yāti lobha krodhau tataḥ sati \|*  
*mṛtyuḥ palāyate rogo jarā śoko bhayaṃ tathā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The god of love goes to the passionate person; the greed and the anger also flee at his sight; death, disease, old age, grief and fear vanish at the sight of the devotees of Vishnu.

## \|\| 32.26 \|\|

*kālaḥ śubhāśubhaṃ karmma harṣo bhogastathaiva ca \|*  
*ye ye na yānti yāmīṃ ca kathitāste mayā sati \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Similarly Kala, good or bad deeds, pleasures and pain also disappear. Thus they do not visit the abode of Yama at my command.

## \|\| 32.27-28 \|\|

*śṛṇu dehasya vivṛtiṃ kathayāmi yathāgamam \|*  
*pṛthivī vāyurākāśaṃ tejastoyamiti sphuṭam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*dehināṃ dehabījaṃ ca sraṣṭuḥ sṛṣṭividhau param \|*  
*pṛthvyādipañcabhūtaiśca yo deho nirmito bhavet \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Now I tell you about the formation of the body as ordained in the scriptures. You listen to me attentively. There are five elements in the universe comprising of the earth, the wind, the sky, the fire and the water. They are put in a body with the soul and thus the body is created by the creator, which is created by the five elements as explained above.

## \|\| 32.29-33 \|\|

*sa kṛtrimo naśvaraśca bhasmasācca bhavediha \|*  
*vṛddhāṅguṣṭhapramāṇena yo jīvaḥ puruṣākṛtiḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*bibharti sūkṣmadehaṃ ca tadrūpaṃ bhogahetave \|*  
*sa deho na bhavedbhasma jvaladagnau mamālaye \|\| 30 \|\|*

*jalena naṣṭo deho vā prahāre suciraṃ kṛte \|*  
*na śastre ca na cāstre ca sutīkṣṇe kaṇṭake tathā \|\| 31 \|\|*

*taptadrave taptalauhe taptapāṣāṇa eva ca \|*  
*prataptapratimāśleṣe'pyatyūrdhvane'pi ca \|\| 32 \|\|*

*na ca dagdho na bhagnaśca bhuṃkte saṃtāpameva ca \|*  
*kathitaṃ devi vṛttāntaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca yathāgamam \|*  
*kuṇḍānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 33 \|\|*

29-33. The perishable elements are reduced to dust on the earth. Thereafter they proceed to the hell in the form of a thumb in order to face the reward of their deeds. The said body is known as the ethereal body (Suksma-sarira). This ethereal body does not vanish in the fire in the hell nor'by torture or any other weapon or the fire. Even the burning iron or the burning stone can have no effect on the same. It does not vanish by embracing a burning image or by a fall from great heights. It does not bum. It does not break but only suffers from pain. О goddess, I have thus told you everything about the ethereal body as has been described in the scriptures. I am now describing about the different pits (kundas) in the hell. You listen to me.

## Chapter 33

## \|\| 33.1 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*pūrṇendumaṇḍalākāraṃ sarvakuṇḍaṃ ca vartulam \|*  
*atīva nimnaṃ pāṣāṇabhedaiśca khacitaṃ sati \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yama said — All the pits in the hell are circular like the moon. They are quite deep and have many types of stones arranged in them.

## \|\| 33.2 \|\|

*na naśvaraṃ cāpralayaṃ nirmitaṃ ceśvarecchayā \|*  
*kleśadaṃ vai pātakināṃ nānārūpaṃ tadālayam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. They have been constructed according to the will of the lord; that is why they cannot be destroyed before the time of dissolution. They are of various types and are painful to the sinners.

## \|\| 33.3-4 \|\|

*jvaladaṅgārarūpaṃ ca śatahastaśikhānvitam \|*  
*paritaḥ krośamānaṃ ca vahnikuṇḍaṃ prakīrttitam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*mahacchabdaṃ prakurvadbhiḥ pāpibhiḥ paripūritam \|*  
*rakṣitaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiścāpi santatam \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. They have burning flames rising up to a hundred feet, have a circumference of a Kosa. One of them is called Agnikunda. It always remains filled with sinners who cry aloud always. My messengers always protect the kunda, torturing the sinners all the time.

## \|\| 33.5-6 \|\|

*prataptodakapūrṇaṃ ca hiṃsrajantusamanvitam \|*  
*mahāghorāndhakāraṃ ca pāpisaṃghena saṃkulam \|\| 5\|\|*

*prakurvatā kākuśabdaṃ prahārairvarṇitena ca \|*  
*krośārddhamānaṃ maddūtastāḍitena ca rakṣitam \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. There is a Prataptodakakunda having a diameter of half of Kosa which is filled with wild animals, boiling water, complete darkness and the sinners. My messengers torture the sinners there who cry aloud expressing their grief and fear.

## \|\| 33.7-8 \|\|

*tattakṣārodakaiḥ pūrṇaṃ nakraiśca pariveṣṭitam \|*  
*saṅkulaṃ pāpibhiścaiva krośamānaṃ bhayānakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*trāhīti śabdaṃ kurvadbhirmama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ \|*  
*pracaladbhiranāhāraiḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. The Taptaksaroda-kunda always remains filled with boiling saline water, having a number of crocodiles and the sinners. It has a circumference of a Kosa and is quite terrific. The sinners cry aloud after having been tortured by my attendants there. They always keep on moving in the same and in the absence of any food, their lips and throat always remain dry.

## \|\| 33.9-10 \|\|

*viṇmūtraireva pūrṇaṃ ca krośamānaṃ ca kutsitam \|*  
*atidurgandhisaṃyuktaṃ vyāptaṃ pāpibhireva ca \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tāḍitairmama dūtaiścāpyanāhārairupadravaiḥ \|*  
*rakṣeti śabdaṃ kurvadbhistatkīṭaireva bhakṣitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. The Vinmiltra-kunda is filled with refuse and urine and is spread in the area of one Kosa', it is denounced by everyone and emits a foul smell and is filled with the sinners. They are made to starve there and are tortured by my attendants, as a result of which they cry for hell. Many of the insects bite them severely.

## \|\| 33.11-12 \|\|

*taptamūtradravaiḥ pūrṇaṃ mūtrakīṭaiśca saṃkulam \|*  
*yuktaṃ mahāpāpibhiśca tatkīṭairdaṃśitaṃ sadā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*gavyūtimānaṃ dhvāntāktaṃ śabdakṛdbhiśca santatam \|*  
*maddūtaistāḍitairghoraiḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. The Kunda is filled with boiling urine and the insects of the urine bite the great sinners. This is named as Mutra-kunda and is spread in an area of two Kosas, covered with darkness where the sinners are always bitten by the insects and are also tortured by my attendants who always cry aloud and their throat, tongue and lips get dried up.

## \|\| 33.13 \|\|

*ślaiṣmapūrṇaṃ krośamitaṃ veṣṭitaṃ ceṣṭitaiḥ sadā \|*  
*tadbhojibhiḥ pāpibhiśca tatkīṭairbhakṣitaiḥ sadā \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Slesmahinda is always filled with cough and is spread over an area of one Kosa. The area is inhabited by the sinners who consume the cough and are eaten away by the insects daily.

## \|\| 33.14-15 \|\|

*krośārddhaṃ garapūrṇaṃ ca garabhojibhiranvitam \|*  
*garakīṭairbhakṣitaiśca pāpibhiḥ pūrṇameva ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca śabdakṛdbhiśca kampitaiḥ \|*  
*sarpākārairvajradaṃṣṭraiḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. The poison Kunda is spread over an area of half a kosa and the sinners consuming the poison reside there, the insects of the poison always bite them with their fangs resembling those of the snakes and vajra. My terrific messengers torture them who cry aloud while trembling and their throats dry up.

## \|\| 33.16-17 \|\|

*netrayormalapūrṇaṃ ca krośārddhaṃ kīṭasaṃyutam \|*  
*pāpibhiḥ saṃkulaṃ śaśvaddravadbhiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*vasārasena pūrṇaṃ ca krośaturyyaṃ sudussaham \|*  
*tadbhojibhiḥ pātakibhirvyāptaṃ dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Then there is a Netramala-kunda which is spread over half a kosa and is filled with many types of insects in which the sinners are lodged. Because of their having been bitten by the insects daily they become lean and thin. There is another kunda filled with fat and is spread over an area of four kosas, the sinners who consume the fat are lodged there. They are tortured by my attendants daily.

## \|\| 33.18-19 \|\|

*śukrapūrṇaṃ krośaturyyaṃ śukrakīṭaiśca bhakṣitaiḥ \|*  
*krandadbhiḥ pāpibhiḥ śaśvatsaṃkulaṃ vyākulairbhiyā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*durgandhiraktapūrṇaṃ ca vāpīmānaṃ gabhīrakam \|*  
*tadbhojibhiḥ pāpibhiśca saṃkulaṃ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. There is another Siidra-kunda which is filled with semen and is spread over an area of four kosas. The place is inhabited by the terrified sinners who are bitten by the insects of semen as a result of which they cry aloud. It is like a step-well filled with blood emitting a foul smell and is given the name of Rakta-kunda; the sinners who consume the blood are lodged there. The insects eat them up daily,

## \|\| 33.20 \|\|

*pūrṇaṃ netrāśrubhirnṛṇāṃ vāpyarddhaṃ pāpibhiryutam \|*  
*tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca tadbhakṣyaiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The Asrukunda is filled with tears and looks like half a portion of the step-well. It is filled with the sinners whom my messengers always torture. Besides, the insects of the place bite them and eat them up; the sinners lodged there consume only the tears. The Karnavit-kunda is filled with ear wax and has the size of four step-wells; it is filled with the sinners who consume the refuse and they are eaten up by the insects, the pain of which they have to bear.

## \|\| 33.21-22 \|\|

*nṛṇāṃ gātramalaiḥ pūrṇaṃ tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryutam \|*  
*tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca vyagraiśca kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*karṇaviṭparipūrṇaṃ ca tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryutam \|*  
*vāpīturyyapramāṇaṃ ca rudadbhiḥ kīṭabhakṣitai \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. There is a Gatramala-kunda which is filled with the refuse of the human bodies. The sinners consume the same and the messengers torture them daily. The insects bite them daily which keep the sinners quite unhappy.

## \|\| 33.23 \|\|

*majjāpūrṇaṃ narāṇāṃ ca mahādurgandhisaṃyutam \|*  
*mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ vāpīturyyapramāṇakam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. There is a Majja-lcunda which is filled with the human veins and it emits a terrific evil smell. It is spread over an area of four step-wells.

## \|\| 33.24-25 \|\|

*paripūrṇaṃ snigdhamāṃsairmama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ \|*  
*pāpibhiḥ saṅkulaṃ caiva vāpīmānaṃ bhayānakam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*kanyāvikrayibhiścaiva tadbhakṣyaiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ \|*  
*trāhīti śabdaṃ kurvadbhistrāsitaiśca bhayānakam \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. The Mansa-kunda is filled with human flesh and is spread over an area of a step-well; the sinners are lodged there who are tortured by my messengers. They include those who sell their daughter and they eat the same flesh. They are bitten by the insects and they always cry for hell getting terrified.

## \|\| 33.26-27 \|\|

*vāpīturyyapramāṇaṃ ca nakhādikacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*pāpibhiḥ saṃkulaṃ śaśvanmama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*prataptatāmrakuṃḍaṃ ca tāmraparyyunmukhānvitam \|*  
*tāmrāṇāṃ pratimālakṣaiḥ prataptairāvṛtaṃ sadā \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. There is another kunda named Nakha-kunda which is spread over an area of four step-wells and is filled with the sinners who are tortured by my attendants daily.

## \|\| 33.28 \|\|

*pratyekaṃ pratimāśliṣṭai rudadbhiḥ pāpibhiryutam \|*  
*gavyūtimānaṃ vistīrṇaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The Prataptamra-kunda is encased with copper from all sides. It contains lakhs of images of copper. They are always kept there to torture the sinners who have to embrace the burning images which make them cry aloud. They are beaten by messengers also. The kunda is spread over an area of two kosas.

## \|\| 33.29-30 \|\|

*prataptalohadhāraṃ ca jvaladaṅgārasaṃyutam \|*  
*lohānāṃ pratimālakṣaiḥ prataptairāvṛtaṃ sadā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*pratyekaṃ sarvasaṃśliṣṭaiḥ śaśvadvicalitairbhiyā \|*  
*rakṣa rakṣeti śabdaṃ ca kurvadbhirdūtatāḍitaiḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. There is another kunda having the weapon of sharp edged iron and is filled with burning flames; it is surrounded by iron balls which always remain burning and the sinners are required to embrace them. This terrify them and they try to separate themselves from the same but are unsuccessful. On the other hand when they are tortured by the messengers of Yama they cry for help.

## \|\| 33.31-32 \|\|

*mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ dvigavyūtipramāṇakam \|*  
*bhayānakaṃ dhvāntayuktaṃ lauhakuṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*dharmakuṇḍaṃ taptasurākuṇḍaṃ vāpyarddhameva ca \|*  
*tadbhojibhiḥ pāpibhiśca vyāptaṃ maddūtatāḍitaiḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. There is a Lauha-kunda in which the great sinners dwell. It is spread over an area of four kosas. The Dharma-kunda and Taptasura-kunda are of the size of half a step-well and they are meant for the types of sinners who are beaten by my messengers and have to consume boiling wine.

## \|\| 33.33 \|\|

*adhaḥ śālmalivṛkṣasya tīkṣṇakaṇṭakakuṇḍakam \|*  
*lakṣapauruṣamānaṃ ca krośamānaṃ ca duḥkhadam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. There is a kunda beneath the Salmali-tree which is filled with sharp edged thorns; it is spread in one kosha land and very painful. Lakhs of people are lodge there; it is surrounded with sharp edged thorns of the size of arrows.

## \|\| 33.34-35 \|\|

*dhanurmāne kaṇṭakaiśca sutīkṣṇaiḥ pariveṣṭitam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*pratyekaṃ kaṃṭakairviddhaṃ mahāpātakibhiryutam \|*  
*vṛkṣāgrānnipatadbhiśca mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. Those thorns pierce through the bodies of a great sinner which are thrown from the top of the tree. These sinners are further tortured by my attendants. They cry for water but they never get it and their tongues dry. up. Their heads are broken by the strike of rods. Running in the boiling oil, such people suffer badly terrified.

## \|\| 33.37 \|\|

*viṣaughaistakṣakādīnāṃ pūrṇaṃ ca krośamānakam \|*  
*tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. There is another kunda of snakes in which serpents like Taksaka and others bite the sinners who are also tortured by my messengers.

## \|\| 33.38-39 \|\|

*prataptatailapūrṇaṃ ca kīṭādiparivarjitam \|*  
*tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ snigdhagātraiśca veṣṭitaiḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*kākuśabdaṃ prakurvadbhiścaladbhirdūtatāḍitaiḥ \|*  
*mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ dvigavyūtipramāṇakam \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. There is another kunda which always remains filled with boiling oil, having no insects, the burning oil is applied on the tender limbs of the sinners. Besides my messengers beat them mercilessly as a result of which they cry aloud; thus this kunda which is filled with great sinners is spread over an area of four kosas.

## \|\| 33.40 \|\|

*śastrakuṇḍaṃ dhvāntayuktaṃ krośamānaṃ bhayānakam \|*  
*śūlākāraiḥ sutīkṣṇāgrairlauhaśastraiśca veṣṭitam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The kunda which is filled with darkness is spread over an area of one kosa. It is quite horrible and is surrounded by weapons which are terrific, like the tridents and pointed tops and are made of iron. This kunda is named as Shastra-kunda.

## \|\| 33.41-43 \|\|

*śastratalpasvarūpaṃ ca krośaturyyapramāṇakam \|*  
*pātakibhirveṣṭitaṃ ca kuntaviddhaiśca veṣṭitam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālakaiḥ \|*  
*kīṭaiḥ saṃpīḍyamānaiśca sarpayānairbhayaṅkaraiḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*tīkṣṇadantaiśca vikṛtairvyāptaṃ dhvāntayutaṃ sati \|*  
*mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ bhītairvā kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ \|*  
*rudadbhiḥ krośamānaṃ ca mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. There is a kunda named the weapon-fainhu which has beds of spears on which each one of the sinners is made to hang. Thereafter my messengers torture them, as a result of which their throats, lips and tongues get dried up. There is a Krmi-kunda where there are insects with sharp fangs and is filled with great sinners. Those insects bite the sinners daily. Besides my messengers continue to torture them, making them cry-aloud.

## \|\| 33.44-46 \|\|

*atidurgandhisaṃyuktaṃ krośārddhaṃ pūyasaṃyutam \|*  
*tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*dvigavyūti pramāṇaṃ ca himatoyaprapūritam \|*  
*tālavṛkṣapramāṇaiśca sarpakoṭibhirāvṛtam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*sarpaveṣṭitagātraiśca pāpibhiḥ sarpabhakṣitaiḥ \|*  
*saṃkulaṃ śabdakṛdbhiśca mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

44-46. There is a kunda which is spread over an area of half a kosa which is filled with puss. It is always filled with sinners who have to consume the same and my messengers always beat them. There is a snow-water kunda which is spread over an area of four kosas. It is filled with snakes of the size of a palm tree; the sinners are dumped therein and the snakes encircle their bodes. My messengers always belabour them making the sinners cry aloud.

## \|\| 33.47-48 \|\|

*kuṇḍatrayaṃ maśādīnāṃ pūrṇaṃ ca maśakādibhiḥ \|*  
*sarvaṃ kośārddhamānaṃ ca mahāpātakibhiryutam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*hastapādādibhirbaddhaiḥ kṣatraiḥ kṣatajalauhitaiḥ \|*  
*hāheti śabdaṃ kurvadbhiḥ pracaladbhiśca santatam \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. There are three kundas which are filled with leeches and mosquitoes. They are all spread in an area of half a kosa each. They remain filled with sinners. Their hands and feet are tied and are soaked in blood. They are crying ha ha words and walking constantly.

## \|\| 33.49-50 \|\|

*vajravṛścikayoḥ kuṇḍaṃ tābhyāṃ ca paripūritam \|*  
*vāpyarddhaṃ pāpibhiryuktaṃ vajravṛścikadaṃśitaiḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*kuṇḍatrayaṃ śarādīnāṃ taireva paripūritam \|*  
*tairviddhaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ vāpyarddhaṃ raktalohitaiḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. Then there are kundas which are filled with scorpions and vajras. They are of the size of step-wells and are filled with the scorpions and vajras. They are of the size of a step-well and are filled with evil-doers they are pierced with arrows. They appear red having been soaked with blood. Such kundas are half the size of a step-well.

## \|\| 33.51-52 \|\|

*taptapaṅkodakaiḥ pūrṇaṃ sadhvāntaṃ golakuṇḍakam \|*  
*kīṭaiḥ saṃpīḍyamānaiśca bhakṣitaiḥ pāpibhiryutam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*vāpyarddhaṃ paripūrṇaṃ ca jalasthairnakrakoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*dāruṇairvikṛtākārairbhakṣitaiḥ pāpibhiryutam \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. The Gola-kunda is filled with boiling mud and darkness. The sinners are bitten by the insects there. Such a kunda is half the size of a step-well. The Nakra-kunda always remains filled with crores of crocodiles which are horrible in appearance. The sinners are bitten by them.

## \|\| 33.53 \|\|

*viṇmūtraśleṣmabhakṣyaiśca saṃyuktaṃ śatakoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*kākaiśca vikṛtākārairdhanurlakṣaṃ ca pāpibhiḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Similarly there are kundas of refuse, urine and cough in which crows peck at the bodies of the sinners. Such kundas are called Vinmutraslesma-kundas. They are spread over an area of a lakh of yojanas.

## \|\| 33.54 \|\|

*sañcālavājayoḥ kuṇḍaṃ tābhyāṃ ca paripūritam \|*  
*bhakṣitaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ śabdakṛdbhiśca santatam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The Sancala and Vaja-kunda are filled with birds where the sinners in large number have to reside. The birds eat up the sinners daily as a result of which they cry aloud.

## \|\| 33.55 \|\|

*dhanuḥśataṃ vajrayuktaṃ pāpibhiḥ saṅkulaṃ sadā \|*  
*śabdakṛdbhirvajradagdhairantardhvāntamayaṃ sadā \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The vajra-kunda is of the size of a hundred bows in area, is filled with vajra and always remains dark. The sinners lodged in that kunda always cry with pain caused by the vajra. They are spread over double the area of a step-well.

## \|\| 33.56-57 \|\|

*vāpīdviguṇayānaṃ ca taptaprastaranirmitam \|*  
*jvaladaṅgārasadṛśaṃ caladbhiḥ pāpibhiryutam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*kṣuradhāropamaistīkṣṇaiḥ pāṣāṇe rnirmitaṃ param \|*  
*mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ kṣataṃ kṣatajalohitaiḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. There is Pasana-kunda which is of double the size of a step-well and is filled with stones which are always burning hot. The sinners are made to sit on them, who cry aloud. Then there is a sharp-arrow kunda having sharp blades made of stones. The sinners are tortured with them which are filled with blood and wounds.

## \|\| 33.58-59 \|\|

*durgandhilālāpūrṇaṃ ca tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryutam \|*  
*krośamānaṃ gabhīraṃ ca mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

*taptatoye'ñjanākāraiḥ paripūrṇaṃ dhanuśśatam \|*  
*caladbhiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ mama dūtena tāḍitaiḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. The Lala-kunda is filled with bad smell and spit. The sinners have to consume the same. It is spread over an area of half a kosa. My messengers torture the sinners badly. The kunda of boiling water is quite black in colour, like the collyrium and is spread over an area of a hundred bows. It remains filled with sinners who are tortured by my messengers and cry aloud.

## \|\| 33.60-61 \|\|

*pūrṇaṃ cūrṇadravaiḥ krośamānaṃ pāpibhiranvitam \|*  
*tadbhojibhiḥ pradagdhaiśca mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*kuṇḍaṃ kulālacakrābhaṃ ghūrṇyamānaṃ ca santatam \|*  
*sutīkṣṇaṣoḍaśāraṃ ca ghūrṇitaiḥ pāpibhiryutam \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. There is a kunda of melted metals which is spread over an area of one kosa and is filled with sinners. The sinners have to consume the same liquid which keeps on burning. On the other hand my messengers also torture them. There is a Cakra-kunda which is like the potter's wheels and keeps on moving. It has saws and tusks on which the sinners are made to sit.

## \|\| 33.62-63 \|\|

*atīva vakraṃ nimnaṃ ca dvigavyūtipramāṇakam \|*  
*kandarākāranirmāṇaṃ taptodakasamanvitam \|\| 62 \|\|*

*mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ bhakṣitairjalajantubhiḥ \|*  
*pracaladbhiḥ śabdakṛdbhirdhvāntayuktaṃ bhayānakam \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. It is quite deep and is spread over an area of four kosas and appears like a cave filled with boiling water. It is quite dark and terrific in size; many of the great sinners are lodged there who are consumed by aquatic animals daily and they keep on crying.

## \|\| 33.64-65 \|\|

*koṭibhirvikṛtākāraiḥ kacchapaiśca sudāruṇaiḥ \|*  
*jalasthaiḥ saṃyutaṃ taiśca bhakṣitaiḥ pāpibhiryutam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*jvālākalāpaistejobhinirmitaṃ krośamānakam \|*  
*śabdakṛdbhiḥ pāpibhiśca caladbhiḥ saṃyutaṃ sadā \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. The Kurma-kundas is filled with crores of tortoises of gigantic size who surround the sinners and eat them daily. There is a kunda of multitude flames, built with lustre, which is spread in the area of one kosha, where the sinners are crying for help and walking continuously.

## \|\| 33.66 \|\|

*krośamānaṃ gabhīraṃ ca taptabhasmabhiranvitam \|*  
*śaśvaccaladbhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ pāpibhirbhasmabhakṣitaiḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. There is a kunda of hot ashes which is spread over an area of one kosa and is quite deep. It is filled with many sinners who wander about. They have to consume the burning ashes daily.

## \|\| 33.67 \|\|

*taptapāṣāṇaloṣṭānāṃ samūhaiḥ paripūritam \|*  
*prāṇibhirdagdhagātraiśca yuktaṃ vai śuṣkatālukaiḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. One of the kundas is filled with burning rocks and earth having a large number of sinners lodged therein. Their bodies are badly burnt and the tongue is dried up completely.

## \|\| 33.68 \|\|

*krośamānaṃ dhvāntamayaṃ gabhīramatidāruṇaiḥ \|*  
*tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca dagdhakuṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. It is spread over an area of one kosa and is dark and quite deep. The terrific messengers of Yama always torture them. It is called the Dagdha-kunda.

## \|\| 33.69-71 \|\|

*apyūrmiyuktatoyaṃ ca prataptakṣārasaṃyutam \|*  
*nānāprakāra vikṛtaṃ jalajantusamanvitam \|\| 69 \|\|*

*dvigavyūtipramāṇaṃ ca gabhīraṃ dhvāntasaṃyutam \|*  
*tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ daṃśitairjalajantubhiḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*caladbhiḥ krandamānaiśca na paśyadbhiḥ parasparam \|*  
*uttaptasūrmikuṇḍaṃ ca kīrtitaṃ ca bhayānakam \|\| 71 \|\|*

69-71. One of the kundas is filled with innumerable waves of hot and saline water having a large number of aquatic animals. It is spread over an area of four kosas and is quite deep and full of darkness. The sinners are eaten by the aquatic animals daily where they cry aloud but they are unable to see one another in darkness. This kunda is called Uttaptasiirmi-kunda.

## \|\| 33.72-74 \|\|

*asipatravanasyaivāpyuccaistāla taroradhaḥ \|*  
*krośārddhamānakuṇḍaṃ ca patatpatrasamanvitam \|\| 72 \|\|*
