*pāpināṃ raktapūrṇaṃ ca vṛkṣāgrātpatatāṃ param \|*  
*paritrāhīti śabdaṃ ca kurvatāmasatāmapi \|\| 73 \|\|*

*gabhīraṃ dhvāntasaṃyuktaṃ raktakīṭasamanvitam \|*  
*tadasīpatrakuṇḍaṃ ca kīrtitaṃ ca bhayānakam \|\| 74 \|\|*

72-74. There are forests having trees with leaves as sharp as sharp-edged swords and the leaves of palm trees. This kunda is spread over an area of half a kosa and the falling leaves of the palm tree injures many sinners and the blood always keeps oozing from their bodies who cry for help. Besides, in the darkness red-coloured insects torture the evil souls. This is called Asipatra kunda.

## \|\| 33.75 \|\|

*dhanuśśatapramāṇaṃ ca kṣurākārāstrasaṃkulam \|*  
*pāpināṃ raktapūrṇaṃ ca kṣuradhāraṃ bhayānakam \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. The kunda which is spread over an area of a hundred bows has sharp-edged weapons like daggers and swords, is filled with evil souls who are injured by these weapons. This kunda is called KsuradhUr-lainda.

## \|\| 33.76 \|\|

*sūcīvāśyāstrasaṃyuktaṃ pāpiraktaughapūritam \|*  
*pañcāśaddhanurāyāmaṃ kleśadaṃ sūcīkāmukham \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. The Siicikamukha hell has weapons having their tips as sharp as the tip of a needle; it makes the evil souls to undergo considerable agony.

## \|\| 33.77-78 \|\|

*godhāhvajantubhedasya mukhākṛti bhayānakam \|*  
*kūparūpaṃ gabhīraṃ ca dhanurviṃśatimānakam \|\| 77 \|\|*

*mahāpātakinā caiva mahākleśakaraṃ param \|*  
*tatkīṭabhakṣitānāṃ ca namrāsyānāṃ ca santatam \|\| 78 \|\|*

77-78. The Godhamukha lainda is of the shape of a lizard. It is quite terrific and has the shape of a lizard spreading over an area of twenty bows. The great sinners have to suffer considerable torture in this kunda. The insects of the kunda eat away the sinners quite badly.

## \|\| 33.79-80 \|\|

*kuṇḍaṃ naramukhākāraṃ dhanuṣṣoḍaśamānakam \|*  
*gabhīraṃ kūparūpaṃ ca pāpiṣṭhaiḥ saṃkulaṃ sadā \|\| 79 \|\|*

*gajendrāṇāṃ samūhena vyāptaṃ kuṇḍākṛti sthalam \|*  
*gajadantahatānāṃ ca pāpināṃ raktapūritam \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. The Nakra-kunda is filled with many of the terrible aquatic animals including crocodiles. It is spread over an area of sixteen bows. It is quite deep like a well and is covered with darkness and is filled with the sinners. There is another kunda which is infested with elephants or tuskers who injure the sinners with their tusks.

## \|\| 33.81-82 \|\|

*tatkīṭabhakṣitānāṃ ca dīnaśabdakṛtāṃ sadā \|*  
*dhanuśśatapramāṇaṃ ca kīrttitaṃ gajadaṃśanam \|\| 81 \|\|*

*dhanustriṃśatpramāṇaṃ ca kuṇḍaṃ vai gomukhākṛti \|*  
*pāpināṃ duḥkhadaṃ caiva gomukhaṃ parikīrttitam \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. Many of the insects bite them severely and they cry always helplessly. This kunda is spread over an area of a hundred bows and is known by the name of Gajadamsana. The Gomukha-kunda is spread over an area of three bows, is circular in shape and is filled with the sinners who are tortured there.

## \|\| 33.83-88 \|\|

*bhramitaṃ kālacakreṇa santataṃ ca bhayānakam \|*  
*kumbhākāraṃ dhvāntayuktaṃ dvigavyūtipramāṇakam \|\| 83 \|\|*

*lakṣamānavamānaṃ ca gabhīramativistṛtam \|*  
*kutracittaptatailaṃ ca kuṇḍābhyantaramantike \|\| 84 \|\|*

*kutracittaptalauhādikuṇḍaṃ tāmrādikaṃ tathā \|*  
*kutracittaptapāṣāṇakuṇḍābhyantaramantike \|\| 85 \|\|*

*pāpināṃ ca pradhānaiśca mahāpātakibhiryutam \|*  
*parasparaṃ na paśyadbhiḥ śabdakṛdbhiśca santatam \|\| 86 \|\|*

*tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca daṇḍaiśca musalaistathā \|\| 87 \|\|*

*ghūrṇamānaṃ patadbhiśca mūrcchitaiśca muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*pātitairmama dūtaiścāpyatyūrdhvātpatitaiḥ kṣaṇam \|\| 88 \|\|*

83-88. The Kalacakra-kunda, has a Kdlacakra which always keeps on rotating. It is quite terrific to look at and resembles a pitcher. It is also called the Kumbhipaka hell. It is spread over an area of four kosas and filled with darkness. Its death is equivalent to a lakh of humans. The Taptataila-kimda, Lauhadi-kunda and Tamradi-kunda and Taptapasana-kunda form part of the same kunda (Kumbhlpaka-kunda). It always remains filled with great sinners who are unable to see any one and cry again and again. They faint quite often and sometimes they fall unconscious. The messengers of Yama throw them from considerable heights.

## \|\| 33.89 \|\|

*yāvantaḥ pāpinaḥ santi sarvakuṇḍeṣu sundari \|*  
*caturguṇāḥ santi tatra kumbhīpāke ca dustare \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. O beautiful one. the number of sinners lodged in the Kumbhipaka hell excels the collective number of the sinners of all other kundas.

## \|\| 33.90-91 \|\|

*suciraṃ patitāścaiva bhogadehavivarjitāḥ \|*  
*sarvakuṇḍapradhānaṃ ca kumbhīpākaṃ prakīrtitam \|\| 90 \|\|*

*kālanirmitasūtreṇa nibaddhā yatra pāpinaḥ \|*  
*utthāpitāśca maddūtaiḥ kṣaṇameva nimajjitāḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

90-91. The Kumbhipaka hell is the topmost of all the hells where the sinners have to remain after shedding their human body. Such of the sinners as are tied in the kalasiitra are lifted up by my messengers and the next moment they are drowned again.

## \|\| 33.92-93 \|\|

*niśvāsabandhāḥ suciraṃ kuṇḍānāmantare tathā \|*  
*atīvakleśayuktāśca bhogadehā anaśvarāḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

*daṇḍena musalenaiva mama dūtaiśca tāḍitāḥ \|*  
*prataptatoyayuktaṃ ca kālasūtraṃ prakīrtitam \|\| 93 \|\|*

92-93. The sinners remain captive in all the kundas for long and go on breathing. Their bodies which have to suffer all the pain and torture never die. On the other hand my messengers beat them with rods, clubs and many other weapons. The hell always remains filled with boiling water and is known as the kcilasiitra hell.

## \|\| 33.94-95 \|\|

*avaṭaḥ kūpabhedaśca yatrodaṃ ca tadākṛti \|*  
*prataptatoyapūrṇaṃ ca dhanurviṃśatpramāṇakam \|\| 94 \|\|*

*vyāptaṃ mahāpāpibhiśca dagdhagātraiśca santatam \|*  
*maddūtaistāḍitaiḥ śaśvadavaṭodaṃ prakīrtitam \|\| 95 \|\|*

94-95. The Avata-hell is of the shape of a well filled with water. That is why it is known as a part of the well. It is filled with boiling water in an area of twenty-four bows, where a large number of sinners reside whose bodies always remain burning and on the other hand my messengers keep on torturing them. Such a place is called Avatoda-hell.

## \|\| 33.96-99 \|\|

*yattoyasparśamātreṇa sarva vyādhiśca pāpinām \|*  
*bhavedakasmātpatatāṃ yatra kuṇḍe dhanuśśate \|\| 96 \|\|*

*sarve ruddhāḥ pāpinaśca vyathante yatra santatam \|*  
*hāheti śabdaṃ kurvantastadevāruntudaṃ viduḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

*taptapāṃsubhirākīrṇaṃ jvaladbhistu sudagdhakaiḥ \|*  
*tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ pāṃsubhojaṃ dhanuśśatam \|\| 98 \|\|*

*patatāṃ pāpināṃ yatra bhavedeva prakampanam \|*  
*pātamātreṇa pāpī vai bhavetpāśena veṣṭitaḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

96-99. After having a fall in a kunda of the size of a hundred bows and with the touch of its water, the body of the sinners attract ailments. All the sinners are stuck up there and have to suffer. They cry aloud continuously. That is why the wise people call it Arunliida hell.

## \|\| 33.100-105 \|\|

*krośamāne ca kuṇḍe vai vidustatpāśaveṣṭanam \|*  
*dhanurviṃśatimānaṃ ca śūlaprotaṃ prakīrtitam \|\| 100 \|\|*

*pātamātreṇa pāpī ca śūlena grathito bhavet \|*  
*patatāṃ pāpināṃ yatra bhavedeva prakampanam \|\| 101 \|\|*

*atīva himatoye ca krośārddhaṃ ca prakampanam \|*  
*dadatyeva hi maddūtā yatrolkāḥ pāpināṃ mukhe \|\| 102 \|\|*

*dhanurviṃśatimānaṃ ca tadulkābhiśca saṃkulam \|*  
*lakṣamānavamānaṃ ca gabhīraṃ ca dhanuśśatam \|\| 103 \|\|*

*nānāprakārakrimibhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ ca bhayānakaiḥ \|*  
*atyandhakārakhyāptaṃ yatkūpākāraṃ ca varttulam \|\| 104 \|\|*

*tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ na paśyadbhiḥ parasparam \|*  
*taptatoyapradagdhaiśca caladbhiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ \|*  
*dhvāntena cakṣuṣā cāndhairandhakūpaṃ prakīrtitam \|\| 105 \|\|*

100-105. Covered with burning ashes and the bodies of the sinners, the kunda always remains filled with them. All the sinners have to consume the burning ashes. It is spread over an area of a hundred bows and sinners start trembling as soon as they fall in it. They are then tied in a noose. The kunda is spread over an area of one kosa. This is called the Pasavestana hell. The kunda known as Scdaprota hell is spread over an area of twenty bows. As soon as the sinners fall in it, they are tom with the tridents and start trembling. It is filled with snow and is spread over an area of half a kosa. It has been named as Prakampana hell where our messengers insert burning flames into the mouths of the sinners. It is spread over an area of twenty bows and is infested with comets. It has therefore been named as Ulkamukha hell. This one keeps lakhs of people together and is quite deep and spread over an area of a hundred bows infested with terrific insects and is filled with darkness, having the form of a circular well. It is filled with all the sinners who are unable to see one another and they keep on suffering in the boiling water and the biting of the insects. Since it is pitch dark there, nothing is visible. It is therefore called the andhakupa hell.

## \|\| 33.106 \|\|

*nānāprakāraśastraughairyatra viddhāśca pāpinaḥ \|*  
*dhanurviṃśatimānaṃ ca vedhanaṃ tatprakīrtitam \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. The hell where the sinners are tortured with various weapons is spread over an area of twenty bows. It is called the Vedhana-kunda.

## \|\| 33.107 \|\|

*daṇḍena tāḍitā yatra mama dūtaiśca pāpinaḥ \|*  
*dhanuḥṣoḍaśamānaṃ ca tatkuṇḍaṃ daṇḍatāḍanam \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. The place at which our messengers torture the sinner is spread over an area of sixteen bows. It is called Dandatadana-kunda.

## \|\| 33.108 \|\|

*nibaddhāśca mahājālairyathā mīnāśca pāpinaḥ \|*  
*dhanustriṃśatpramāṇaṃ ca jālabaddhaprakīrtitam \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. The place where the sinners are trapped like the fish in a net is spread over an area of thirty bows and is known as Jalabaddha-kunda.

## \|\| 33.109-110 \|\|

*patatāṃ pāpināṃ kuṇḍe dehāścūrṇībhavanti ca \|*  
*lauhavedinibaddhāntaḥ koṭimānavamānakam \|\| 109 \|\|*

*gabhīraṃ dhvāntayuktaṃ ca dhanurviṃśatimānakam \|*  
*mūrcchitānāṃ jaḍānāṃ taddehacūrṇaṃ prakīrtitam \|\| 110 \|\|*

109-110. This is the kunda in which the bodies of sinners are reduced to pieces when they fall and where a number of pedestals are made which can accommodate crores of people. It is quite deep and dark. It is spread over an area of twenty bows. It is called the Dehaciima-kunda for those who fall in it, faint and become motionless.

## \|\| 33.111 \|\|

*dalitāḥ pāpino yatra maddūtairmusalaiḥ sadā \|*  
*dhanuṣṣoḍaśamānaṃ ca tatkuṇḍaṃ dalanaṃ smṛta m \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. The kunda in which my messengers torture the sinners with clubs in their hands, is spread over an area of sixteen bows. It is called Dalana-kunda.

## \|\| 33.112-113 \|\|

*pātamātre yatra pāpī śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ \|*  
*vālukāsu ca taptāsu dhanustriṃśatpramāṇakam \|\| 112 \|\|*

*śatamānavamānaṃ ca gabhīraṃ dhvāntasaṃyutam \|*  
*jalāhārairvirahitaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ tatprakīrtitam \|\| 113 \|\|*

112-113. The kunda in which the sinners, while falling, have their throat, lips and tongues dried up, is filled with burning sand and is spread over an area of thirty bows, is deep as much as a hundred humans. It is filled with darkness, is deprived of water. It is called the Sosana-kunda.

## \|\| 33.114 \|\|

*nānācarmakaṣāyodaiḥ paripūrṇaṃ dhanuḥśatam \|*  
*durgandhiyuktaṃ tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiḥ saṃkulaṃ mahat \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. The kunda which is filled with leather giving out a bad smell, is spread over an area of a hundred bows. It is infested with evil smells and the sinners feed on the same.

## \|\| 33.115 \|\|

*śūrpākāramukhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dhanurdvādaśamānakam \|*  
*taptalauhīvālukābhiḥ pūrṇaṃ pātakibhiryutam \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. The kunda of the shape of a winnowing basket is spread over an area of twelve bows. It has the sands burning like iron and is filled with sinners.

## \|\| 33.116-117 \|\|

*antarā 'gniśikhānāṃ ca jvālāvyāttamukhaṃ sadā \|*  
*dhanurviṃśatimānaṃ ca yasya kuṇḍasya sundari \|\| 116 \|\|*

*jvālābhirdagdhagātraiśca pāpibhirvyāptameva yat \|*  
*tanmahatkleśadaṃ śaśvatkuṇḍaṃ jvālāmukhaṃ smṛtam \|\| 117 \|\|*

116-117. О beautiful one, the kunda in which heaps of fire are found and the flames of fire keep on burning, has to be faced by the sinners. The flames of fire emerge from their bodies. The one which always inflicts terrific pain is called Jvalamukha kunda.

## \|\| 33.118 \|\|

*pātamātrādyatra pāpī mūrchito vyathito bhavet \|*  
*tapteṣṭakābhyantaritaṃ vāpyarddhaṃ jihmakuṇḍakam \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. The kunda in which the sinners lose their senses after a fall, the inner part of which always remains burning and which is spread over an area of half a step-well, is called Jihma-kunda.

## \|\| 33.119 \|\|

*dhūmāndhakārayuktaṃ ca dhūmāndhaiḥ pāpibhiryutam \|*  
*dhanuḥśataṃ śvāsabaddhairdhūmāndhaṃ parikīrtitam \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. The kunda which is filled with darkness like a well and blinded by the smoke inside, is filled with sinners. It is spread over an area of a hundred bows and is know by the name of Dlmmandha hell.

## \|\| 33.120 \|\|

*pātamātrādyatra pāpī nāgaissaṃveṣṭito bhavet \|*  
*dhanuḥśataṃ nāgapūrṇaṃ nāgaveṣṭanakuṇḍakam \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. The kunda in which the sinners are encircled by the serpents with their fall and which is spread over an area of a hundred bows, is filled with snakes. Ii is called the Ndgaveslcma kunda.

## \|\| 33.121 \|\|

*ṣaḍaśītiśca kuṇḍāni mayoktāni niśāmaya \|*  
*lakṣaṇaṃ cāpi teṣāṃ ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. I have thus spelt out the details of eighty kundas with their names and definitions, what else do you want to listen io from me further?

## Chapter 34

## \|\| 34.1-2 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*haribhaktiṃ dehi mahyaṃ sārabhūtāṃ sudurlabhām \|*  
*tvattaḥ sarvaṃ śrutaṃ deva nāvaśiṣṭo'dhunā mama \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kiṃcitkathaya me dharmaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaguṇakīrttagam \|*  
*puṃsāṃ lakṣoddhārabījaṃ narakārṇavatārakam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Savitri said — О lord, I have listened enough to you and nothing more is required to be listened to by me. Therefore you bestow the devotion of the lord on me which is extremely difficult to get. Now you enlighten me also on dharma, including the ways to adore lord Krishna and the reciting of his name. He is the one who redeems all and can also help the people to cross over the ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 34.3-6 \|\|

*kāraṇaṃ muktikāryāṇāṃ sarvāśubhanivāraṇam \|*  
*dāraṇaṃ karmavṛkṣāṇāṃ kṛta pāpaughahārakam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*muktayaḥ katidhā santi kiṃ vā tāsāṃ ca lakṣaṇam \|*  
*haribhaktermūrtibhedaṃ niṣekasyāpi lakṣaṇam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tattvajñānavihīnā ca strījātirvidhinirmitā \|*  
*kiṃ tajjñānaṃ sārabhūtaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sarvadānaṃ hyanaśanaṃ tīrthasnānaṃ vrataṃ tapaḥ \|*  
*ajñāne jñānadānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm \|\| 6 \|\|*

3-6. Similarly he is the bestower of salvation, the cause of salvation, the destroyer of all the evils, the destroyer of the tree of deeds and the remover of all the sins; what is the number of types of salvation? What are their definitions? You kindly let me know the types of the devotions of the lord and the way one has to reap the harvest of their deeds. Among those who are well-versed in the Vedas, Brahma has created the female devoid of the knowledge of tattvas. What is the essence of the learning for them. You kindly tell me, because the giving of charities, fasting, taking a bath in holy places, the performing of trat as and tapas do not equal even eleven times as compared to the imparting of knowledge to others.

## \|\| 34.7 \|\|

*pituḥ śataguṇā mātā gauraveṇātiricyate \|*  
*mātuḥ śataguṇaiḥ pūjyo jñānadātā guruḥ prabho \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О lord, the glory of the mother is a hundred times more than that of the father and the glory of the one who imparts knowledge or a teacher is a hundred limes more than that of the mother.

## \|\| 34.8-9 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*pūrvaṃ sarvo varo datto yaste manasi vāñchitaḥ \|*  
*adhunā haribhaktiste vatse bhavatu madvarāt \|\| 8 \|\|*

*śrotumicchasi kalyāṇi śrīkṛṣṇaguṇakīrttanam \|*  
*vaktṝṇāṃ praśnakartṝṇāṃ śrotṝṇāṃ kulatārakam \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Yama said — О daughter, whatever was desired by you has already been granted by me, but now with my boon you will surely achieve the devotion of the lord. O virtuous lady, you want to listen to the glory of lord Krishna which redeems all the people who recite his name as well as those who listen to his glory.

## \|\| 34.10 \|\|

*śeṣo vaktrasahasreṇa nahi yadvaktu mīśvaraḥ \|*  
*mṛtyuñjayo na kṣamaśca vaktuṃ pañcamukhena ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. In fact the Shesha, having the thousand hoods, is unable to rccuc the glory of lord Krishna. Lord Shiva who had over-powered the death, is unable to recite his glory with all his five faces.

## \|\| 34.11-12 \|\|

*dhātā caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ vidhātā jagatāmapi \|*  
*brahmā caturmukhenaiva nālaṃ viṣṇuśca sarvavit \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kārtikeyaḥ ṣaṇmukhena nāpi vaktumalaṃ dhruvam \|*  
*na gaṇeśaḥ samarthaśca yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Even Brahma, who holds the four Vedas and the creator of the world and omniscient lord Vishnu. is also not able to recite the glory of lord Krishna.The six-headed Karttikeya is unable to do so with all his six heads. Ganesha, the lord of all the ganas and who is the best of the yogis is unable in this respect.

## \|\| 34.13 \|\|

*sārabhūtāśca śāstrāṇāṃ vedāścatvāra eva ca \|*  
*kalāmātraṃ yadgaṇānāṃ na vidanti budhāśca ye \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Even the scriptures which are the essence of the Vedas cannot speak out a particle of the glory of lord Vishnu. Then how can the intellectuals do so?

## \|\| 34.14-15 \|\|

*sarasvatī ca yatnena nālaṃ yadguṇavarṇane \|*  
*sanatkumāro dharmaśca sanakaśca sanātanaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sanandaḥ kapilaḥ sūryyo ye cānye brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ \|*  
*vicakṣaṇā na yadvaktuṃ ke vā'nye jaḍabuddhayaḥ \|\| 15\|\|*

14-15. Even Sarasvati after making great efforts find it difficult to spell out the glory of the lord. The sages like Sanatkumara, Dharma, Sanaka, Sanatana, Sananda, Kapila, Surya, Brahma and several other intellectuals are unable to recite his glory; so what to speak of those having little wisdom.

## \|\| 34.16-17 \|\|

*na yadvaktuṃ kṣamāḥ siddhā munīndrā yoginastathā \|*  
*ke vā'nye ca vayaṃ ke vā bhagavadguṇavarṇane \|\| 16 \|\|*

*dhyāyanti yatpadāmbhojaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|*  
*atisādhyaṃ svabhaktānāṃ tadanyeṣāṃ sudurlabham \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Similarly the siddhas, sages and yogis are unable to spell out the glory of the lord. The one whose lotus-like feet are always adored by Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva is the one who is quite docile to his devotees and difficult to excess by others.

## \|\| 34.18-20 \|\|

*kaścitkiṃcidvijānāti tadguṇotkīrttanaṃ mahat \|*  
*atiriktaṃ vijānāti brahmā brahmasutādayaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tato'tiriktaṃ jānāti gaṇeśo jñānināṃ guruḥ \|*  
*sarvātiriktaṃ jānāti sarvajñaḥ śambhureva ca \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tasmai dattaṃ purā jñānaṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā \|*  
*atīva nirjane ramye goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. Who else could speak about his glory? Of course, Brahma knows much about Brahma.Besides Brahma, Ganesha is considered to be a great intellectual and is also considered to be quite knowledgeable, because in the earlier times lord Krishna had imparted divine knowledge to Ganesha in a secluded place in the forest in Goloka at the time of Rasamandala.

## \|\| 34.21 \|\|

*tatraiva kathitaṃ kiṃcidyadguṇotkīrttanaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*dharmāya kathayāyāsa śivaloke śivaḥ svayam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The glory of lord Krishna was recited by Ganesha at that point of time and the same was repeated by Shiva to Dharma in his own abode.

## \|\| 34.22 \|\|

*dharmastatkathayāmāsa puṣkare bhāskarāya ca \|*  
*pitā mama yamārādhya gāṃ prāpa tapasā sati \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Dharma then imparted the knowledge of the same to Slirya at Puskara; thereafter my father narrated the same to him and from him I got the same.

## \|\| 34.23-25 \|\|

*pūrvaṃ svaviṣayaṃ cāhaṃ na gṛhṇāmi prayatnataḥ \|*  
*vairāgyayuktastapase gantumicchāmi suvrate \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tadā māṃ kathayāmāsa pitā tadguṇakīrttanam \|*  
*yathāgamaṃ tadvadāmi nibodhātīva durgamam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*tadguṇaṃ sa na jānāti tadanyasya ca kā kathā \|*  
*yathā''kāśaṃ na jānāti svāntameva varānane \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. О chaste lady, after making many efforts in earlier times, I could not understand much about it and I was going for perfonning tapas since my mind was filled with detachment. At that point of time my father enlightened me on the qualities of lord Krishna. Therefore, I am speaking out on the subject, on the basis of my own knowledge. You please listen to me. О beautiful one, as the sky is not aware of its dimensions, what to speak of others?

## \|\| 34.26-28 \|\|

*sarvāntarātmā bhagavānsarvakāraṇakāraṇam \|*  
*sarveśvaraśca sarvādyaḥ sarvavitsarvarūpadhṛk \|\| 26 \|\|*

*nityarūpī nityadehī nityānando nirākṛtiḥ \|*  
*niraṃkuśaśca niśśṛṅgo nirguṇaśca nirāśrayaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*nirliptaḥ sarvasākṣī ca sarvādhāraḥ parātparaḥ \|*  
*prakṛtistadvikārā ca prākṛtāstadvikārajāḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. Lord Krishna resides in everyone as a soul. He is the cause of all the causes, the lord of all, the beginning of all, all knowledgeable, is the one who can take to any form, always having beautiful form, always taking to various forms, blissful, formless, independent, doubtless, devoid of virtues, devoid of Asrama, unattached, the witness of all, the base of everything and is the best. The Prakriti is his deformed image, the one who is born of that deformity is known as the nature.

## \|\| 34.29-30 \|\|

*svayaṃ pumāṃśca prakṛtiḥ svayaṃ ca prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|*  
*rūpaṃ vidhatte'rūpaśca bhaktānugrahahetave \|\| 29 \|\|*

*atīva kamanīyaṃ ca sundaraṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ kiśoraṃ gopaveṣakam \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. He himself is having the form of Purusa and Prakriti while he is beyond Prakriti. He is formless but in order to shower his grace on his devotees, he lakes to human form.

## \|\| 34.31-34 \|\|

*kandarpakoṭilāvaṇyalīlādhāma manoharam \|*  
*śaranmadhyāhnapadmānāṃ śobhāmoṣakalocanam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*śaratpārvaṇakoṭīnduśobhāsaṃśobhitānanam \|*  
*amūlyaratnakhacitaratnābharaṇabhūṣitam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*sasmitaṃ śobhitaṃ śaśvadamūlyā''pītavāsasā \|*  
*paraṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ ca jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sukhadṛśyaṃ ca śāntaṃ ca rādhākāntamanantakam \|*  
*gopībhirvīkṣyamāṇaṃ ca sasmitābhiḥ samantataḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

31-34. He is extremely beautiful and chaiming having the complexion of new clouds. He is of tender age, having the form of a cowherd; is the abode of crores of gods of love, quite pleasant, is like the lotus flower of the noon of the summer season, having lotus-like eyes and possesses the lustre of crores of moons of the winter season; he is adorned with innumerable valuable gems and the ornaments studded with gems, he wears a srene smile on his face and is always clad in a lower yellow garment, is the form of eternal Brahman, the lustre of Brahman, pleasant to look at, quite peaceful, lord of Radha and is immeasurable. The cowherdesses wearing smiles on their faces surround him always.

## \|\| 34.35-36 \|\|

*rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ ratnasiṃhāsanasthitam \|*  
*vaṃśīṃ kvaṇantaṃ dvibhujaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa sundaraṃ vakṣasojjvalam \|*  
*kuṅkumāgarukastūrīcandanārcitavigraham \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. He is seated on the gem-studded throne in the Rcisamandala playing on the flute a tune. He has two amis and wears a long garland of forest flowers. He has a kaustubha gem adorning his chest and all his limbs are plastered with saffron, agaru, kasturl and sandal-paste.

## \|\| 34.37 \|\|

*cārucampakamālābjamālatīmālyamaṇḍitam \|*  
*cārucampakaśobhāḍhyacūḍāvaktrimarājitam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. He is adorned with a beautiful garland of jasmine flowers, besides those of lotus and Malatl and several other flowers. His hair is curly.

## \|\| 34.38-39 \|\|

*dhyāyanti caivambhūtaṃ vai bhaktā bhaktipariplutāḥ \|*  
*yadbhayājjagatāṃ dhātā vidhatte sṛṣṭimeva ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

*karoti lekhanaṃ karmānurūpaṃ sarvadehinām \|*  
*tapasāṃ phaladātā ca karmaṇāṃ ca yadājñayā \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. His devotees with their mind filled with devotion always adore him in this form. The terrified Brahma engages himself in creation at the command of lord Krishna. He also writes the fortune of all human beings on their forehead according to their deeds. He also gives the reward for the tapas and other deeds performed by the people.

## \|\| 34.40 \|\|

*viṣṇuḥ pātā ca sarveṣāṃ yadbhayātpāti santatam \|*  
*kālāgnirudraḥ saṃharttā sarvaviśveṣu yadbhayāt \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. By the fear from him, lord Vishnu protects the world constantly and also dreadful Rudra destroys the universe.

## \|\| 34.41-42 \|\|

*śivo mṛtyuñjayaścaiva jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ \|*  
*yajjñānadānātsiddheśo yogīśaḥ sarvavitsvayam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*paramānanda yuktaśca bhaktivairāgyasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*yatprasādādvāti vātaḥ pravaraḥ śīghragāminām \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. With the knowledge imparled by Krishna to lord Shiva he happens to be the teacher of the intellectuals, besides being yoglsvara, all blissful and filled with devotion and detachment. With the pride of whom, the wind moves with great speed.

## \|\| 34.43-52 \|\|

*tapanaśca pratapati yadbhayātsantataṃ sati \|*  
*yadājñayā varṣatīndro mṛtyuścarati jantuṣu \|\| 43 \|\|*

*yadājñayā dahedvahnirjalameva suśītalam \|*  
*diśo rakṣanti dikpālā mahābhītā yadājñayā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*bhramanti rāśicakrāṇi grahā vai yadbhayena ca \|*  
*bhayātphalanti vṛkṣāśca puṣpantyapi ca yadbhayāt \|\| 45 \|\|*

*bhayātphalāni pakvāni niṣphalāstaravo bhayāt \|*  
*yadājñayā sthalasthāśca na jīvanti jaleṣu ca \|\| 46 \|\|*

*tathā sthale jalasthāśca na jīvanti yadājñayā \|*  
*ahaṃ niyamakarttā ca dharmādharmaṃ ca yadbhayāt \|\| 47 \|\|*

*kālaśca kalayetsarvaṃ bhramatyeva yadājñayā \|*  
*akāle haretkālo mṛtyurvai yadbhayena ca \|\| 48 \|\|*

*jvaladagnau patantaṃ ca gabhīre ca jalārṇave \|*  
*vṛkṣāgrāttīkṣṇakhaḍge ca sarpādīnāṃ mukheṣu ca \|\| 49 \|\|*

*nānāśastrāstraviddhaṃ ca raṇeṣu viṣameṣu ca \|*  
*puṣpacandanatalpe ca bandhuvargaiśca rakṣitam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*śayānaṃ tantramantraiśca kāle kālo haredbhayāt \|*  
*dhatte vāyustoyarāśiṃ toyaṃ kūrmaṃ yadājñayā \|\| 51 \|\|*

*kūrmo'nantaṃ sa ca kṣoṇīṃ samudrānsaptaparvatān \|*  
*sarvāṃścaiva kṣamārūpo nānārūpaṃ bibhartti saḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

43-52. By whose fear, the sun bums throughout the day, by whose command Indra causes the rain, by whose command the death roams about everywhere, by whose command the fire bums, the water becomes cool, the Dikpalas protect the directions, by whose command the constellations move, by whose command the fruits become ripe and the trees are timely deprived of the fruits, by whose command, the creatures of the earth cannot live in water, by whose command the aquatic animals cannot survive on earth, by whose command I decide about dharma and adharma, by whose command the god of death roams about on earth, by whose command the death does not kill anyone before time, by whose command the death is unable to kill a person who falls in burning flames, falls in the deep water of the ocean or from the top of a tree, on the edge of a sharp sword, falling as a prey to the wild animals, in the terrific battle field getting wounded with many types of weapons or the one who sleeps on a comfortable bed of roses. The god is death does not harm them. At whose command the water carries the tortoise, the tortoise carries the serpent Shesha and the serpent Ananta carries the earth while the earth carries all the oceans, seven continents, the seven mountains and all the people in all the fonns.

## \|\| 34.53-62 \|\|

*yataḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni līyante'nte ca tatra vai \|*  
*indrāyuścaiva divyānāṃ yugānāmekasaptatiḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*aṣṭāviśacchakrapāte brahmaṇaḥ syādaharniśam ।*  
*paṣṭyā'dhike pañcaśate sahasra pañcaviśatau \|\| 54 \|\|*

*yuge narāṇāṃ śakrāyurevaṃ saṃkhyāvido viduḥ \|*  
*evaṃ triṃśaddinairmāso dvābhyāṃ tābhyāmṛtuḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*ṛtubhiḥ ṣaḍbhirevābdaṃ śatābdaṃ brahmaṇo vayaḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇaśca nipāte vai cakṣurunmīlanaṃ hareḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*cakṣurnimīlane tasya layaṃ prākṛtikaṃ viduḥ \|*  
*pralaye prākṛtāḥ sarve devādyāśca carācarāḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*līnā dhātari dhātā ca śrīkṛṣṇe nābhipaṅkaje \|*  
*viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodaśāyī ca vaikuṇṭhe yaścaturbhujaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

*vilīnā vāmapārśve ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*rudrādyā bhairavādyāśca yāvantaśca śivānugāḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*śivādhāre śive līnā jñānānande sanātane \|*  
*jñānādhidevaḥ kṛṣṇasya mahādevasya cātmanaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*tasya jñāne vilīnaśca babhūvātha kṣaṇaṃ hareḥ \|*  
*durgāyāṃ viṣṇumāyāyāṃ vilīnāḥ sarva śaktayaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*sā ca kṛṣṇasya buddhau ca buddhyadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā \|*  
*nārāyaṇāṃśaḥ skandaśca līno vakṣasi tasya ca \|\| 62 \|\|*

53-62. And ultimately in whom all the elements get merged. The life of Indra is as long as Seventy yugas, the period of twenty eight Indras equates with a day and night for Brahma. Indra’s age has been measured as being of twenty five thousand, five hundred and sixty yugas. This has been ordained by the knowledgeable people. Accordingly each month has thirty days, two months form a season and six seasons form a year. Brahma lives a hundred years. The period of Brahma's age is equivalent to the fall of the eye-lid of Vishnu. Therefore the very shutting of the eyes of Vishnu results in dissolution. This has been ordained by the intellectuals. At the time of dissolution all the gods, moveable and immovable nature merge in Brahma and Brahma in turn merges into the navel of lord Krishna through the lotus. Lord Vishnu sleeps in the ocean of milk and remains four-armed in Vaikuntha. He gets merged into the body of lord Krishna. All the Rudras, Bhairvas or followers of lord Shiva ultimately merge in him. They are all blissful and eternal. All the learnings of lord Krishna and Mahadeva merge into the knowledge of lord Hari. All the Saklis merge in Vishnumaya and other forms of Durga. The same goddess Durga dwells in the intelligence of lord Krishna. She happens to be the supreme goddess of intelligence. Similarly Skanda who appeared from the ray of Narayana ultimately merges into his chest.

## \|\| 34.63-64 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇāṃśaśca tadbāhau devādhīśo gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*padmāṃśabhūtā padmāyāṃ sā rādhāyāṃ ca suvrate \|\| 63 \|\|*

*gopyaścāpi ca tasyāṃ ca sarvā vai devayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevī sā tasya prāṇeṣu sā sthitā \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. Lord Ganesha merges into the anus of lord Krs па. О chaste lady, the amsa of Padrna merges into Kamala and Kamala merges into Radhika together with all the cowherdesscs and the goddesses. The same Radha happens to be the goddess of lord Krishna and as such Radha always resides in his heart.

## \|\| 34.65-68 \|\|

*sāvitrī ca sarasvatyāṃ vedaśāstrāṇi yāni ca \|*  
*sthitā vāṇī ca jihvāyāṃ tasyaiva paramātmanaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*golokasthasya gopāśca vilīnāstasya lomasu \|*  
*tatprāṇeṣu ca sarveṣāṃ prāṇā vātā hutāśanaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

*jaṭharāgnau vilīnaśca jalaṃ tadrasanāgrataḥ \|*  
*vaiṣṇavāścaraṇāmbhoje paramānandasaṃyutāḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

*sārātsāratarā bhaktirasapīyūṣapāyinaḥ \|*  
*virāṭ kṣudraśca mahati līnaḥ kṛṣṇe mahānvirāṭ \|\| 68 \|\|*

65-68. Savitri and all the Vedas merge in Sarasvati and the goddess Sarasvati merges into the tip of the tongue of the lord Krishna. All the residents of Goloka including the cowherds, merge into lord Krishna. The fire is born out of his Jatharagni, water in the tip of the tongue and all the devotees who always adore lord Krishna besides the Vais navas merge into his feet. Thereafter, the pure Virat and Mahavirat merge into Krishna.

## \|\| 34.69-70 \|\|

*yasyaiva lomakūpeṣu viśvāni nikhilāni ca \|*  
*yasya cakṣu nimeṣeṇa mahāṃśca pralayo bhavet \|\| 69 \|\|*

*cakṣurunmīlane sṛṣṭiryasyaiva paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*yāvannimeṣe sṛṣṭissyāttāvadunmīlane vyayaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

69-70. The one is whose hair-pits the entire universe in accommodated, by shutting whose eyes, the dissolution overtakes, by whose opening of the eyes, the creation starts; similarly at the time of closing of the eyes, whatever universe is saved, at the time of opening of his eyes, the same universe emerges out of them.

## \|\| 34.71-72 \|\|

*brahmaṇaśca śatābdena sṛṣṭistatra layaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*brahmasṛṣṭilayānāṃ ca saṃkhyā nāstyeva suvrate \|\| 71 \|\|*

*yathā bhūrajasāṃ caiva saṃkhyānaṃ ca niśāmaya \|*  
*cakṣurnimeṣe pralayo yasya sarvāntarātmanaḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

71-72. The universe continues up to the hundred years of Brahma. Thereafter it merges into him. Therefore, О chaste lady, there is no counting of the universes of Brahma, in the same way as one cannot count the particles of dust.

## \|\| 34.73 \|\|

*unmīlane punaḥ sṛṣṭirbhavedeveśvarecchayā \|*  
*tadguṇotkīrttanaṃ vaktuṃ brahmāṇḍeṣu ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. Because the all-pervading lord by whose closing of the eyes, the universe is dissolved and with the opening of whose eye-lids, the creation starts, who could be competent enough to describe his glory?

## \|\| 34.74-76 \|\|

*yathā śrutaṃ tātavaktrāttathoktaṃ ca yathāgamam \|*  
*muktayaśca caturvedairniruktāśca caturvidhāḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

*tatpradhānā harerbhaktirmukterapi garīyasī \|*  
*sālokyadā harerekā cānyā sārūpyadā parā \|\| 75 \|\|*

*sāmīpyadā ca nirvāṇadātrī caivamiti smṛtiḥ \|*  
*bhaktāstā nahi vāñchanti vinā tatsevanādikam \|\| 76 \|\|*

74-76. Thus whatever I had heard from the mouth of my father, according to the scriptures, has been narrated by me. In all the four Vedas the salvation has been spelt out to be of four types, out of all of them the devotion of lord is considered to be more glorious than salvation. Out of these four types of salvation, one is called the Salokya salvation, the second is known as Sarupya salvation, the third is called Samipya salvation and the fourth is called Sayujya which is also called complete redemption but the devotees of the lord do not prefer anyone of the four salvations.

## \|\| 34.77-78 \|\|

*siddhatvamamaratvaṃ ca brahmatvaṃ cāvahelayā \|*  
*janmamṛtyujarāvyādhibhayaśokādikhaṇḍanam \|\| 77 \|\|*

*dhāraṇaṃ divyarūpasya vidurnirvāṇamokṣadam \|*  
*muktiśca sevārahitā bhaktiḥ sevāvivarddhinī \|\| 78 \|\|*

77-78. Not only this, the devotees of the lord are not desirous of eternalship or Brahman in preference to the devotion of the lord. Therefore the devotion removing the birth, death, old age, disease, fear, grief takes to the divine form and grants salvation. The salvation is without service while the adoration increases the sense of devotion.

## \|\| 34.79-80 \|\|

*bhaktimuktyorayaṃ bhedo niṣeke lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*vidurbudhā niṣekaṃ ca bhogaṃ ca kṛtakarmaṇām \|\| 79 \|\|*

*tatkhaṇḍanaṃ ca śubhadaṃ paraṃ śrīkṛṣṇasevanam \|*  
*tattvajñānamidaṃ sādhvi sāraṃ vai lokavedayoḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. This is the difference between the devotion and the salvation. Now I tell you the definition of niseka (impregnation). You listen to me. Praising the result of the deeds performed by the intellectual is called, niseka (impregnation) О chaste lady, the deeds vanish only with the adoration of lord Krishna because it always bestows welfare. Thus the knowledge of tattva and the essence of the Vedas.

## \|\| 34.81-84 \|\|

*vighnaghnaṃ śubhadaṃ coktaṃ gaccha vatse yathāsukham \|*  
*ityuktvā sūryyaputraśca jīvayitvā ca tatpatim \|\| 81 \|\|*

*tasyai śubhāśiṣaṃ dattvā gamanaṃ kartumudyataḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā yamaṃ ca gacchantaṃ sāvitrī taṃ praṇamya ca \|\| 82 \|\|*

*ruroda caraṇe dhṛtvā sadvicchedo'tiduḥkhadaḥ \|*  
*sāvitrīrodanaṃ dṛṣṭvā yamasso'yaṃ kṛpānidhiḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*tāmityuvāca santuṣṭastvarodīccāpi nārada \|\| 84 \|\|*

81-84. It removes all obstructions and grants welfare. О daughter, thus I have spoken to you everything; therefore now you proceed to your abode comfortably. Thus speaking Yama the son of Surya brought back her husband to life and showering all the blessings, asked them to go. Thereafter Savitn bowed in reverence to Yama. When she found him returning, she held his feet and started crying because the separation from noble people is always painful. О Narada, finding Savitn so sobbing the compassionate Yama was extremely satisfied. He then assured her variously and tears started flowing from his eyes.

## \|\| 34.85 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*lakṣavarṣaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate \|*  
*ante yāsyasi goloke śrīkṛṣṇabhavanaṃ śubhe \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. Yama said — О chaste lady, in the sacred land of Bharata you will pleasantly spend a lakh of years and ultimately you will achieve Goloka, the abode of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 34.86 \|\|

*gatvā ca svagṛhaṃ bhadre sāvitryāśca vrataṃ kuru \|*  
*ddvisaptavarṣaparyyantaṃ nārīṇāṃ mokṣakāraṇam \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. Therefore, О noble lady, you revert to your abode and perform vratas of banyan tree for fourteen years. It redeems the woman from all sins.

## \|\| 34.87-88 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhe śuklacaturdaśyāṃ sāvitryāśca vrataṃ śubham \|*  
*śuklāṣṭamyāṃ bhādrapade mahālakṣmyā vrataṃ śubham \|\| 87 \|\|*

*dvyaṣṭavarṣavrataṃ cedaṃ pratyabdaṃ pakṣameva ca \|*  
*karoti parayā bhaktyā sā yāti ca hareḥ padam \|\| 88 \|\|*

87-88. Thus the adoration of Savitri (banyan tree) is to be performed in the month of the Jyestha on the fourteenth day of bright fortnight. On the bright fifth day of the month of Bhadrapada, the sacred vrata for Maha-Lakshmi is performed for sixteen years with great devotion by the ladies which entitles them to proceed to Vishnuloka.

## \|\| 34.89-93 \|\|

*pratimaṅgalavāre ca devīṃ maṅgalacaṇḍikām \|*  
*pratimāsaṃ śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ maṅgaladāyikām \|\| 89 \|\|*

*tathā cāṣāḍhasaṃkrāntyāṃ manasā sarvasiddhidām \|*  
*rādhāṃ rāse ca kārtikyāṃ kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikāṃ priyām \|\| 90 \|\|*

*upoṣya śuklāṣṭamyāṃ ca pratimāse varapradām \|*  
*viṣṇumāyāṃ bhagavatīṃ durgāṃ durgārtināśinīm \|\| 91 \|\|*

*prakṛtiṃ jagadambāṃ ca patiputravatīṃ satīm \|*  
*pativratāsu śuddhāsu yantreṣu pratimāsu ca \|\| 92 \|\|*

*yā nārī pūjayedbhaktyā dhanasantānahetave \|*  
*iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante śrīhareḥ padam \|\| 93 \|\|*

89-93. Similarly on Tuesday the Mangalachandika is to be adored. Everyone on the sixth day of the bright fortnight Sasthi-devJ, the bestower of welfare has to be adored. On the first day of the month of Asadha, Manasa-devi has to be adored who always grants welfare. On the first day of Kartika and on full moon day of the same month, Radha the beloved of lord Krishna has to be adored. On the eighth day of the bright fortnight of every month, one should keep a fast and then adore goddess Durga the illusion of lord Vishnu who bestows boons. She protects from misfortune, is the mother of the universe and is the foremost of the chaste women having her own husband and sons. The woman who adores her with great devotion for seeking progeny, surely gets the same in this birth and thereafter she achieves the abode of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 34.94 \|\|

*ityuktvā tāṃ dharmarājo jagāma nijamandiram \|*  
*gṛhītvā svāminaṃ sā ca sāvitrī ca nijālayam \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. Thus speaking, lord Yama returned to his abode and Savitri too accompanied by her husband Satyavan went back to her abode.

## \|\| 34.95 \|\|

*sāvitrī satyavantaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ ca yathākramam \|*  
*anyāṃśca kathayāmāsa bāndhavāṃścaiva nārada \|\| 95\|\|*

95\. O Narada, on reaching home Savitri narrated all the happenings to Satyavan and all other relatives.

## \|\| 34.96-97 \|\|

*sāvitrījanakaḥ putrānsa prāpadvai krameṇa ca \|*  
*śvaśuraścakṣuṣī rājyaṃ sā ca putrānvareṇa ca \|\| 96 \|\|*

*lakṣavarṣaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate \|*  
*jagāma svāminā sārddhaṃ golokaṃ sā pativratā \|\| 97 \|\|*

96-97. She narrated the entire story to her husband. She then got sons and her father-in-law got back his eye-sight. Thus the chaste lady with the boon of Yama enjoyed all the worldly pleasures in the sacred land of Bharata for a lakh of years and thereafter she proceeded to Goloka with her husband.

## \|\| 34.98 \|\|

*savituścādhidevī yā mantrādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā \|*  
*sāvitrī cāpi vedānāṃ sāvitrī tena kīrttitā \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. She is called Savitri because she is the supreme goddess of them, the supreme goddess of the mantra and the Vedas.

## \|\| 34.99 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa sāvitryākhyānamuttamam \|*  
*jīvakarmavipākaṃ ca kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. О son, thus this is the sacred story of Savitri which I have narrated to you. What else do you want to listen to from me?

## Chapter 35

## \|\| 35.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇasyātmanaścaiva nirguṇasya nirākṛteḥ \|*  
*sāvitrīyamasaṃvāde śrutaṃ suvimalaṃ yaśaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said — I have listened to the spotless glory of lord Krishna and the story relating to the conversation between Savitri and Yama.

## \|\| 35.2 \|\|

*tadguṇotkīrttanaṃ satyaṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam \|*  
*adhunā śrotumicchāmi lakṣmyupākhyānamīśvara \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The reciting of his glory is truthful and the form of welfare. О lord, now I intend to listen to the story of Lakshmi.

## \|\| 35.3 \|\|

*kenādau pūjitā sā'pi kimbhūtā kena vā purā \|*  
*tadguṇotkīrttanaṃ satyaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О best of the gods, who adored him first and before whom she appeared in the first instance and before whom she appeared in her true from in the earlier times. It is truthful to recite her face. Therefore, you kindly tell me all that.

## \|\| 35.4-9 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*sṛṣṭerādau purā brahmankṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*devī vāmāṃśasaṃbhūtā cāsītsā rāsamaṇḍale \|\| 4 \|\|*

*atīva sundarī śyāmā nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalā \|*  
*yathā dvādaśavarṣīyā ramyā susthirayauvanā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*śvetacampakavarṇābhā sukhadṛśyā manoharā \|*  
*śaratpārvaṇakoṭīnduprabhāsaṃśobhitānanā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*śaranmadhyāhnapadmānāṃ śobhāśobhitalocanā \|*  
*sā ca devī dvidhābhūtā sahasaiveśvarecchayā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*samā rūpeṇa varṇena tejasā vayasā tviṣā \|*  
*yaśasā vāsasā mūrtyā bhūṣūṇena guṇena ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

*smitena vīkṣaṇenaiva vacasā gamanena ca \|*  
*madhureṇa svareṇaiva nayenānunayena ca \|\| 9 \|\|*

4-9. Narayana said — О Brahman, in the earlier times at the beginning of the universe, she appeared from the left side of lord Krishna in the Msamandala. She was extremely beautiful, quite pleasant, having stiff breasts and buttocks with a tender waist. She was twelve years old, quite charming and had the complexion of a white jasmine flower. She was beautiful to look at, attractive, possessing the luster of crores of suns, galore of the moons of SaratpUrnimd on her face and her eyes resembled the grace of the lotus flowers of the summer season blossoming during the mid-day. And because of the wish of the lord she at once was divided into two bodies which were totally equal in tejas, glory, age, lustre, costumes, forms, ornaments, virtues, serene smiles, eye-sight, speech and sweet tongue besides being well-behaved.

## \|\| 35.10 \|\|

*tadvāmāṃśā mahālakṣmīrdakṣiṇāṃśā ca rādhikā \|*  
*rādhā''dau varayāmāsa dvibhujaṃ ca parātparam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The female form emerging out of her left side was known as Maha-Lakshmi and the one which appeared from the right side was known as Radhika. At that point of time Radhika selected lord Krishna possessing two anns only as her husband.

## \|\| 35.11-13 \|\|

*mahālakṣmīśca tatpaścāccakame kamanīyakam \|*  
*kṛṣṇastadgauraveṇaiva dvidhārūpo babhūva ha \|\| 11 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāṃśo vai dvibhujo vāmāṃśaśca caturbhujaḥ \|*  
*caturbhujāya dvibhujo mahālakṣmīṃ dadau purā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*lakṣyate dṛśyate viśvaṃ snigdhadṛṣṭyā yayā'niśam \|*  
*devīṣu yā ca mahatī mahālakṣmīśca sā smṛtā \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. While Maha-Lakshmi also selected the beautiful husband because of the glory of both of them lord Krishna who also appeared in two forms. The form that appeared from the right side was having two arms only and the one that emerged from the left side had four arms. Lord Krishna having two arms, had already entrusted Maha-Lakshmi to Maha-Vishnu having four arms. The same goddess Maha-Lakshmi views the entire universe with loving sight and happens to be the best of the goddesses. She is therefore called Maha-Lakshmi.

## \|\| 35.14-15 \|\|

*dvibhujo rādhikākānto lakṣmīkāntaścaturbhujaḥ \|*  
*goloke dvibhujastasthau gopairgopībhirāvṛtaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau padmayā saha \|*  
*sarvāṃśena samau tau dvau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇau parau \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Thus lord Krishna having two arms happens to be the husband of Radhika and the four armed Maha-Vishnu happens to be the lord of Lakshmi. The two armed lord Krishna is surrounded by the cowherds and cowherdesses dwelling in Goloka. Thereafter the four armed lord Vishnu proceeded on to Vaikuntha together with Lakshmi. Thus lord Krishna and lord Narayana both are equal.

## \|\| 35.16-17 \|\|

*mahālakṣmīśca yogena nānārūpā babhūva sā \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhe ca mahālakṣmīḥ paripūrṇatamā parā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*śuddhasattvasvarūpā ca sarvasaubhāgyasaṃyutā \|*  
*premṇā sā vai pradhānā ca sarvāsu ramaṇīṣu ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. The same goddess Maha-Lakshmi with the yogic practices took to many forms, remaining in Vaikuntha. She is the best of the women having pure and sattva form, all fortunate and bestows love on all the women.

## \|\| 35.18 \|\|

*svarge ca svargalakṣmīśca śakrasampatsvarūpiṇī \|*  
*pātāleṣu ca martyeṣu rājalakṣmīśca rājasu \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Similarly Lakshmi of heaven is the asset of Indra and the one possessed by the kings on earth as well as in the nether-world is called Raja-Lakshmi.

## \|\| 35.19 \|\|

*gṛhalakṣmīrgṛheṣveva gṛhiṇī ca kalāṃśayā \|*  
*sampatsvarūpā gṛhiṇāṃ sarvamaṅgalamaṃgalā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Lakshmi of the house is known as GrhaLakshmi who bestows welfare and riches to all the householders.

## \|\| 35.20 \|\|

*gavāṃ prasūḥ sā surabhirdakṣiṇā yajñakāminī \|*  
*kṣīrodasindhu kanyā sā śrīrūpā padminīṣu ca \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. She is Surabhl the mother of the cows, daksina of the yajna, Kamala of the ocean of milk and Shri in the lotus flowers.

## \|\| 35.21-24 \|\|

*śobhārūpā ca candre sā sūryyamaṇḍalamaṇḍitā \|*  
*vibhūṣaṇeṣu ratneṣu phaleṣu jalajeṣu ca \|\| 21 \|\|*

*nṛpeṣu nṛpapatnīṣu divyastrīṣu gṛheṣu ca \|*  
*sarvasasyeṣu vastreṣu sthāne sā saṃskṛte tathā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*pratimāsu ca devānāṃ maṅgaleṣu ghaṭeṣu ca \|*  
*māṇikyeṣu ca muktāsu mālyeṣu ca manoharā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*maṇīṃdreṣu ca hāreṣu kṣīraṃ vai candaneṣu ca \|*  
*vṛkṣaśākhāsu ramyāsu navamegheṣu vastuṣu \|\| 24 \|\|*

21-24. She is the grace of the moon and the lustre of the sun. Similarly she also remains present in the ornaments, gems, fruits and the things born of the water. She also remains with the kings, the queens, the divine ladies in houses, the crops, the clothes, cultural fields, images of the gods, welfare pitchers, things made of gems, besides the garland of jewels and gems. She appears in beautiful form in the best of the garments of gem and pearls, milk, sandal, beautiful branches of the trees and new clouds.

## \|\| 35.25 \|\|

*vaikuṇṭhe pūjitā sā''dau devī nārāyaṇena ca \|*  
*dvitīye brahmaṇā bhaktyā tṛtīye śaṅkareṇa ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Thus first of all lord Narayana had adored the goddess in Vaikuntha, thereafter lord Shiva and Brahma followed her with devoted minds.

## \|\| 35.26 \|\|

*viṣṇunā pūjitā sā ca kṣīrode bhārate mune \|*  
*svāyambhuvena manunā mānavendraiśca sarvataḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. O sage, thereafter in the ocean of milk, lord Vishnu adored her; while in the sacred land of Bharata, Svayambhuva Manu and other gods adored her appropriately.

## \|\| 35.27 \|\|

*ṛṣīndraiśca munīndraiśca sadbhiśca gṛhibhirbhavet \|*  
*gandharvādyaiśca nāgādyaiḥ pātāleṣu ca pūjitā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. She was then adored by the ascetics, the sages, noble house-holders, besides the Gandharvas, the serpents in Patala.

## \|\| 35.28 \|\|

*śuklāṣṭamyāṃ bhādrapade pūjā vai brahmaṇā kṛtā \|*  
*bhaktyā ca pakṣaparyantaṃ triṣu lokeṣu nārada \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О Narada, on the eighth bright day of the month of Bhadrapada, Brahma adored her with devotion and she was adored in the three worlds for a fortnight.

## \|\| 35.29 \|\|

*caitre pauṣe ca bhādre ca puṇye maṅgalavāsare \|*  
*viṣṇunā nirmitā pūjā triṣu lokeṣu bhaktitaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Lord Vishnu adored her in all the three Lokas with great devotion. For her devotion in the month of Caitra, Pausa, Bhadrapada and Tuesdays are considered to be auspicious.

## \|\| 35.30 \|\|

*varṣānte pauṣasaṃkrāṃtyāṃ medhyāmāvāhya cāṅgaṇe \|*  
*manustāṃ pūjayāmāsa sā bhūtā bhuvanatraye \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Manu adored her after the end of the rains, on the first day of the month of Pausa in his courtyard invoking Lakshmi, as a result of which she appeared in all the three lokas on that very day.

## \|\| 35.31-33 \|\|

*rājñā saṃpūjitā sā vai maṅgalenaiva maṅgalā \|*  
*kedāreṇaiva nīlena nalena subalena ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

*dhruveṇauttānapādena śakreṇa balinā tathā \|*  
*kaśyapena ca dakṣeṇa manunā ca vivasvatā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*priyavratena candreṇa kubereṇaiva vāyunā \|*  
*yamena vahninā caiva varuṇenaiva pūjitā \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. Thereafter, the king Marigala adored Mahalaks ml who happens to be the form of welfare. Thereafter Kedara, Nila, Nala, Subala, Dhruva, the son of Uttanapada, Indra, Bali, Kashyapa, Daksha, Manu, Stirya, the loveable moon, Kubera, Vayu, Yama, Agni and Varuna also adored her.

## \|\| 35.34 \|\|

*evaṃ sarvatra sarvaiśca vanditā pūjitā sadā \|*  
*sarvaiśvaryyādhidevī sā sarvasampatsvarūpiṇī \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. She was therefore adored by all the people at all the places and became the goddess of riches and fortune.

## Chapter 36

## \|\| 36.1-3 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*nārāyaṇapriyā sā ca varā vaikuṇṭhavāsinī \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhādhiṣṭhātṛdevī mahālakṣmīḥ sanātanī \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kathaṃ babhūva sā devī pṛthivyāṃ sindhukanyakā \|*  
*kiṃ taddhyānaṃ ca kavacaṃ sarvaṃ pūjāvidhikramam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*purā kena stutā''dau sā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Narada said — О lord, Maha-Lakshmi who happens to be the beloved of Narayana, the best of the lord, resides in Vaikuntha. Maha-Lakshmi too is the supreme goddess of Vaikuntha and eternal but how could she be born on earth as the daughter of Sindhu. You kindly let me know her dhyanam, kavacha and the method of her adoration? Who adored her first of all offering prayers, you kindly tell me.

## \|\| 36.4 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*purā durvāsasaḥ śāpādbhraṣṭaśrīkaḥ purandaraḥ \|*  
*babhūva devasaṃghaśca martyalokaśca nārada \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Narayana said — О Narada, in the earlier times, the glory of Indra was lost as a result of a curse pronounced by him on Durvasa. Because of that the gods and the people on earth, were also deprived of their glory.

## \|\| 36.5 \|\|

*lakṣmīḥ svargādikaṃ tyaktvā ruṣṭā paramaduḥkhitā \|*  
*gatvā līnā ca vaikuṇṭhe mahālakṣmyāṃ ca nārada \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. О Narada, Lakshmi then felt disturbed because of the anger of the sage and leaving the heaven she reached Vaikuntha and got herself merged in Maha-Lakshmi.

## \|\| 36.6-7 \|\|

*tadā śokādyayurdevā duḥkhitā brahmaṇaḥ sabhām \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ ca puraskṛtya yayurvaikuṇṭhameva ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

*vaikuṇṭhe śaraṇā pannā devā nārāyaṇe pare \|*  
*atīva dainyayuktāśca śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. At that point of time the grieved gods went to Brahma and all of them proceeded on to Vaikunt ha. Reaching there, they sought the protection of lord Narayana who mostly remains scheduled. At that point of lime all the gods were filled with grief and with humility, their throats, the lips and tongues had dried up.

## \|\| 36.8-9 \|\|

*tadā lakṣmīśca kalayā purā nārāyaṇājñayā \|*  
*babhūva sindhukanyā sā śakrasampatsvarūpiṇī \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tadā mathitvā kṣīrodaṃ devā daityagaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*saṃprāpuśca varaṃ lakṣmyā dadṛśustāṃ ca tatra hi \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Narada said — In the earlier times the sage Durvasa possessing the divine knowledge pronounced a curse on Indra. What was the reason for it? О lord how did the gods chum the ocean. By reciting of which stotra, Indra pleased Lakshmi having an audience with her and what was the subject of conversation between them you kindly tell me.

## \|\| 36.10 \|\|

*surādibhyo varaṃ dattvā vanamālāṃ ca viṣṇave \|*  
*dadau prasannavadanā tuṣṭā kṣīrodaśāyine \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Thereafter Lakshmi from one of her rays was born as the daughter of Sindhu, who was like the fortune of Indra. She had already been ordained by lord Narayana in this regard. Thereafter the gods accompanied by the demons, churned the ocean as a result of which they could have an audience with Lakshmi and also received boons from her.

## \|\| 36.11 \|\|

*devāścāpyasurākrāntaṃ rājyaṃ prāpuśca tadvarāt \|*  
*tāṃ saṃpūjya ca saṃstūya sarvatra ca nirāpadaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Thereafter Lakshmi was pleased and granted the gods a boon. She then placing a garland of forest flowers around the neck of lord Vishnu selected him as her husband.

## \|\| 36.12-14 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ śaśāpa durvāsā muniśreṣṭhaḥ purandaram \|*  
*kena doṣeṇa vā brahmanbrahmiṣṭhaṃ brahmavitpurā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*mamanthe kena rūpeṇa jaladhistaiḥ surādibhiḥ \|*  
*kena stotreṇa sā devī śakre sākṣādbabhūva ha \|\| 13 \|\|*

*ko vā tayośca saṃvādo hyabhavattadvada prabho \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. After receiving the boon from the goddess, the gods also got back their kingdoms. All the gods then adored Lakshmi, appropriately offering salutations ю her. This way all the gods were freed from all the miseries.

## \|\| 36.15 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*madhupānapramattaśca trailokyādhipatiḥ purā \|*  
*krīḍāṃ cakāra rahasi rambhayā saha kāmukaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Narayana said — Once Indra the god of all the three worlds was enjoying the company of Rambha, intoxicated with the drinking of wine.

## \|\| 36.16 \|\|

*kṛtvā krīḍāṃ tayā sārddhaṃ kāmukyā hṛtacetanaḥ \|*  
*tasthau tatra mahāraṇye kāmonmathita cetanaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. After enjoyment with her, that women had over-powered his mind and he was therefore indulging in the love-sport.

## \|\| 36.17 \|\|

*kailāsaśikharaṃ yāntaṃ vaikuṇṭhādṛṣipuṅgavam \|*  
*durvāsasaṃ dadarśendro jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Perchance Durvasa, who, while going from Vaikuntha to Kailasa passed by that way. The sage possessed divine lustre and Indra looked at him from a distance.

## \|\| 36.18-19 \|\|

*grīṣmamadhyāhnamārttaṇḍasahasraprabhamīśvaram \|*  
*prataptakāñcanābhāsaṃ jaṭābhāramahojjvalam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*śuklayajñopavītaṃ ca cīraṃ daṇḍaṃ kamaṇḍalum \|*  
*mahojjvalaṃ ca tilakaṃ bibhrataṃ candrasannibham \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Durvasa was having the lustre of thousands of rays of sun of the mid-day and was the great lord, besides having the glory of molten gold, beautiful matted locks of hair on the head, wearing yafiiopavlta and clothes, holding a staff and a Kamandalu. His forehead was painted with sandal-paste which looked like the crescent.

## \|\| 36.20 \|\|

*samanvitaṃ śiṣyavargairvedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā nanāma śirasā sambhramāttaṃ purandaraḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Thus the sage who was well-versed in the Vedic and post-Vedic literature, was accompanied by a number of his students. Finding them there, Indra offered his salutation to them bowing his head.

## \|\| 36.21-22 \|\|

*śiṣyavargaṃ sa bhaktyā vai tuṣṭāva ca mudānvitaḥ \|*  
*muninā ca saśiṣyeṇa tasmai dattāśśubhāśiṣaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*viṣṇudattaṃ pārijātapuṣpaṃ ca sumanoharam \|*  
*mṛtyurogajarāśokaharaṃ mokṣakaraṃ dadau \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. He with a delightful mind and with devotion offered prayers to the students of the sage. Thereafter the sage blessed him together with his pupils. He then handed over the Parijata flower to Indra which he had brought from Vaikuntha and looked quite charming. It relieved one of death, disease, old age and grief, providing the salvation.

## \|\| 36.23-24 \|\|

*śakraḥ puṣpaṃ gṛhītvā ca pramatto rājasampadā \|*  
*bhrameṇa sthāpayāmāsa tatra vai hastimastake \|\| 23 \|\|*

*hastī tatsparśamātreṇa rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca \|*  
*tejasā vayasā kāntyā viṣṇutulyo babhūva saḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. But influenced by the illusion and becoming arrogant of his riches, Indra took that flower and placed it on the head of the elephant. With the touch of the flower, the elephant was turned into the form of Vishnu having the same beauty, virtues, lustre, age and glory like that of lord Vis nu.

## \|\| 36.25 \|\|

*tyaktvā śakraṃ gajendraścāpyagacchadghorakānanam \|*  
*na śaśāka mahendrastaṃ rakṣituṃ tejasā mune \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. О sage, the elephant at once left Indra and went to some other place in the dense forest and Indra with all his prowess could not prevent him from leaving the place.

## \|\| 36.26 \|\|

*tatpuṣpaṃ tyaktavantaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā śakraṃ munīśvaraḥ \|*  
*taṃ śaśāpa mahātejāḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Thereafter the best of the ascetics and the illustrious sage Durvasa felt enraged at the sight of Indra’s disowning the flower and placing it on the head of the elephant. In rage he pronounced a curse on Indra.

## \|\| 36.27-30 \|\|

*durvāsā uvāca \|*  
*are śriyā pramattastvaṃ kathaṃ māmavamanyase \|*  
*maddattapuṣpaṃ garveṇa tyaktavānhastimastake \|\| 27 \|\|*

*viṣṇorniveditaṃ puṣpaṃ naivedyaṃ vā phalaṃ jalam \|*  
*prāptimātreṇa bhoktavyaṃ tyāgena brahmahā janaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*bhraṣṭaśrīrbhraṣṭabuddhiśca bhraṣṭajñāno bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*yastyajedviṣṇunevedyaṃ bhāgyenopasthitaṃ śubham \|\| 29 \|\|*

*prāptimātreṇa yo bhuṅkte bhaktyā viṣṇuniveditam \|*  
*puṃsāṃ śataṃ samuddhṛtya jīvanmuktaḥ svayaṃ bhavet \|\| 30 \|\|*

27-30. Durvasa said — By getting Lakshmi you have been intoxicated. Why are you insulting us by placing the flower given by me to you on the head of the elephant in pride? You are unaware that the offerings of the lord like flower, naivedya, fruit and water should be consumed at once as soon as it is received by anyone. By discarding it, one earns the sin of Brahmahatya. Therefore the one who throws away the auspicious naivedya of lord Vishnu, is deprived of Lakshmi and intelligence and falls from grace. The one who consumes the naivedya of lord Vishnu with devotion at once, redeems his hundred generations.

## \|\| 36.31 \|\|

*viṣṇunaivedyabhojī yo nityaṃ tu praṇameddharim \|*  
*pūjayetstauti vā bhaktyā sa viṣṇusadṛśo bhavet \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Thus the one who consumes the naivedya of lord Vishnu daily with devotion offering prayers to him, becomes equal to Vishnu.

## \|\| 36.32-33 \|\|

*tatsparśavāyunā sadyastīrthaughaśca viśudhyati \|*  
*tatpādarajasā mūḍha sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*puṃścalyannamavīrānnaṃ śūdraśrāddhānnameva ca \|*  
*yaddhareranivedyaṃ ca vṛthāmāṃsamabhakṣakam \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. О foolish one, with the touch of wind of whose feet, the sacred places are purified and the dust from his feet purifies the entire universe. The food offered by a wicked woman, a widow, a Shudra and the food of sraddha besides the food which is not offered to lord Vishnu, they are all useless like the meat and cannot be eaten.

## \|\| 36.34-38 \|\|

*śivaliṅgapradattānnaṃ yadannaṃ śūdrayājinām \|*  
*cikitsakadvijānāṃ ca devalānnaṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

*kanyāvikrayiṇāmannaṃ yadannaṃ yonijīvinām \|*  
*anuṣṇānnaṃ paryuṣitaṃ sarvabhakṣyāvaśeṣi tam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*śūdrāpatidvijānnaṃ ca vṛṣavāhadvijānnakam \|*  
*adīkṣitadvijānnaṃ ca yadannaṃ śavadāhinām \|\| 36 \|\|*

*agamyagāmināṃ caiva dvijānāmannameva ca \|*  
*mitradruhāṃ kṛtaghnānāmannaṃ viśvāsaghātinām \|\| 37 \|\|*

*mithyāsākṣyapradānāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*etatsarvaṃ vi śudhyeta viṣpunaivedyabhakṣaṇāt \|\| 38 \|\|*

34-38. But the food offered to Shivalinga, the food offered by a Brahmana who performed yajna for Shudras, the food offered by a physician Brahmana and also by the temple priest, the food offered by the one who sells his daughter or the food offered by anyone who lives in immorality, the cold and left-over food, the food left after eating, the food offered by a Brahmana who is the husband of a Stidra woman, the food of a Brahman who loads the bullocks, the food of a Brahmana who has received dlksd, the one who bums the dead bodies or and the one who cohabits with a degraded woman, the food offered by the one who betrays his friend, an ungrateful person, a betrayer of the faith, the Brahmana who gives false evidence, all such sinners are purified with the consuming of the naivedya of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 36.39-41 \|\|

*śvapaco viṣṇusevī ca vaṃśānāṃ koṭimuddharet \|*  
*harerabhakto vipraśca svaṃ ca rakṣitumakṣamaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*ajñānādyadi gṛhṇāti viṣṇornirmālyameva ca \|*  
*saptajanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*jñātvā bhaktyā ca gṛhṇāti viṣṇornaivedyameva ca \|*  
*koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

39-41. Not only this, even the sweeper who serves lord Vishnu redeems crores of his generation, but a Brahmana who is deprived of devotion of lord Vishnu is unable to protect himself. In case one consumes the naivedya of Vishnu even by mistakche redeems seven of his generations. There is no doubt about it. The one who consumes the naivedya of lord Vishnu with devotion, is surely relieved of the sins of crores of his births.

## \|\| 36.42 \|\|

*yasmātsaṃsthāpitaṃ puṣpaṃ garvādvai hastimastake \|*  
*tasmādyuṣmānparityajya yātu lakṣmīrhareḥ padam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Therefore, since you have thrown the flower on the head of elephant, Lakshmi will surely desert you returning to the abode of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 36.43 \|\|

*nārāyaṇasya bhakto'haṃ na bibhemīśvaraṃ vidhim \|*  
*kālaṃ mṛtyuṃ jarāṃ caiva kānanyāngaṇayāmi ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. I am a devotee of lord Narayana, therefore I am not afraid of Shiva, Brahma, Kala, death and old age, what to speak of others.

## \|\| 36.44 \|\|

*kiṃ kariṣyati te tātaḥ kaśyapaśca prajāpatiḥ \|*  
*bṛhaspatirguruścaiva niśśaṅkasya ca me hareḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. I remain carefree even from the lord. Therefore your father Prajapati Kashyapa and the teacher Brihaspati are of no consequence for me.

## \|\| 36.45 \|\|

*idaṃ puṣpaṃ yasya mūrdhni tasya vai pūjanaṃ puraḥ \|*  
*mūrdhni cchinne śivaśiśośchittvedaṃ yojayiṣyati \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. The head on which this flower remains, will always be worshipped and it will be replace the head of the son of Shiva whose head would be cut-off. The head of this elephant will be fixed on the human body.

## \|\| 36.46 \|\|

*iti śrutvā mahendraśca dhṛtvā taccaraṇadvayam \|*  
*uccai ruroda śokārttastamuvāca bhayākulaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. On hearing this, indra was grieved and terrified at the same time. He then held the feet of sage Durvasa and started crying aloud.

## \|\| 36.47 \|\|

*indra uvāca \|*  
*dattaḥ samucitaḥ śāpo mahyaṃ mattāya he prabho \|*  
*hṛtā tvayā cetsampattiḥ kiyajjñānaṃ ca dehi me \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Indra said — О lord, you have done well by pronouncing a curse on an arrogant person like me. In case you have deprived me of all my riches you kindly bestow some knowledge to me also.

## \|\| 36.48-50 \|\|

*aiśvaryyaṃ vipadāṃ bījaṃ pracchannajñānakāraṇam \|*  
*muktimārgārgalaṃ dārḍhyāddharibhaktivyapāyakam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*janmamṛtyujarārogaśokaduḥkhāṃkuraṃ param \|*  
*sampattitimirāndhaśca muktimārgaṃ na paśyati \|\| 49 \|\|*

*sampanmattaḥ samūḍhaśca surāmattaḥ sacetanaḥ \|*  
*bāndhavairveṣṭitaḥ so'pi bandhudveṣakaro mune \|\| 50 \|\|*

48-50. Because the riches are the seeds for misfortune. Wealth is the means for achieving hidden wisdom, leads to obstruct the road to salvation, prevents in getting true devotion of the lord and causes birth, death, old age, disease, grief and trouble. The darkness of riches blinds a person who cannot lead himself to the path of salvation. О sage, the one who gets intoxicated with riches, loses his wisdom, consciousness and he becomes envious of his own relatives should they surround him.

## \|\| 36.51 \|\|

*sampanmade pramattaśca viṣayāndhaśca vihvalaḥ \|*  
*mahākāmī sāhasikaḥ sattvamārge na paśyati \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. A person possessing immense riches gets intoxicated with the same and indulges himself into all the worldly pleasures, remain anxious, passionate and courageous but never follows the virtuous path.

## \|\| 36.52 \|\|

*dvividho viṣayāndhaśca rājasastāmasaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*aśāstrajñastāmasaśca śāstrajño rājasaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. There are two types of person infested with rajas and tamas. Out of these the one possessing lamas is deprived of the knowledge of the Shastras but the one who is rajas possesses all the knowledge of the scriptures.

## \|\| 36.53 \|\|

*śāstre ca dvividhaṃ mārgaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ munipuṅgava \|*  
*pravṛttibījamekaṃ ca nivṛtteḥ kāraṇaṃ param \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. О best of the sages, there are two types of paths prescribed for the people in the scriptures. The first one is the path of indulgence and the other is of detachment.

## \|\| 36.54 \|\|

*caranti jīvinaścādau pravṛttau duḥkhavartmani \|*  
*svacchande cāprasanne ca nirnirodhe ca santatam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The soul first of all follows the path of indulgence which is troublesome, devoid of pleasure and makes one to move at will.

## \|\| 36.55 \|\|

*āpātamadhure lobhātkleśe ca sukhamāninaḥ \|*  
*pariṇāmotpattibīje janmamṛtyujarākare \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. This path of indulgence outwardly looks pleasant though it results into grief always, the greedy person mistakes pain for pleasure which leads to the misfortune in future. Therefore this path is considered to lead to the birth, death and old age.

## \|\| 36.56-57 \|\|

*anekajanmaparyyantaṃ kṛtvā ca bhramaṇaṃ mudā \|*  
*svakarmavihitāyāṃ ca nānāyonyāṃ krameṇa ca \|\| 56 \|\|*

*tataḥ kṛṣṇānugrahācca satsaṅgaṃ labhate janaḥ \|*  
*sahasreṣu śateṣveko bhavābdheḥ pārakāraṇam \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. The souls move into human bodies according to their actions. They continue moving in this way for a thousand years. Only a selected few achieve the devotion of lord Krishna and the company of the noble people, which results into the crossing of the ocean of the universe by the soul.

## \|\| 36.58-59 \|\|

*sādhuḥ sattvapradīpena muktimārgaṃ pradarśayet \|*  
*tadā karoti yatnaṃ ca jīvī bandhanakhaṇḍane \|\| 58 \|\|*

*anekajanmayogena tapasā'naśanena ca \|*  
*tadā labhenmuktimārgaṃ nirvighnaṃ sukhadaṃ param \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. The noble people indicate the right path showing the lamp of sattva which results into redemption. Thereafter the soul tries to free itself from the worldly bondages. Then after performing the yogis practices for a number of births, by fasting, he achieves the road to salvation which bestows welfare.

## \|\| 36.60-62 \|\|

*idaṃ śrutaṃ gurorvaktrātprasaṅgāvasareṇa ca \|*  
*nahi pṛṣṭamato'nyacca bhavaduḥkhaughaveṣṭitāḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*adhunā vidhinā datto vipattau jñānasāgaraḥ \|*  
*sampadrūpā vipadiyaṃ mama nistārakāriṇī \|\| 61 \|\|*

*jñānasindho dīnabandho mahyaṃ dīnāya sāmpratam \|*  
*dehi kiñcijjñānasāraṃ bhavapāraṃ dayānidhe \|\| 62 \|\|*

60-62. Though I had heard from the mouth of my teacher all this, yet having been surrounded by the miseries of the universe, I could not question him further. At this time of misfortune, the destiny has bestowed the ocean of knowledge to me, this misfortune has provided me with immense treasure. Therefore, I am sure to be the ocean of knowledge and the compassionate one, now you bestow the knowledge by which I should be redeemed from the ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 36.63 \|\|

*indrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya jñānināṃ guruḥ \|*  
*jñānaṃ kathitumārebhe hyatituṣṭaḥ sanātanaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. On hearing these words of Indra, the teacher of the learned people was satisfied and with a smile on his face he started speaking.

## \|\| 36.64-65 \|\|

*durvāsā uvāca \|*  
*aho mahendra māṅgalyamātmānaṃ draṣṭumicchasi \|*  
*āpātato duḥkhabījaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham \|\| 64 \|\|*

*svagarbhayātanānāśapīḍākhaṇḍanakāraṇam \|*  
*duṣpārāsāradurvārasaṃsārārṇavatārakam \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. Durvasa said — О Mahendra it is quite astonishing that you intend to witness your own welfare, since yourself are suddenly in trouble but which will ultimately lead you to pleasure. It relieves of the pains of birth and leads one to cross the difficult ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 36.66-67 \|\|

*karmavṛkṣāṅkuracchedakāraṇaṃ sarvatārakam \|*  
*santoṣasantatikaraṃ pravaraṃ sarvavartmanām \|\| 66 \|\|*

*dānena tapasā vā'pi vratenānaśanādinā \|*  
*karmaṇā svargabhogādi sukhaṃ bhavati jīvinām \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. This is the cause of the destruction of the tree on which the leaves of the actions sprout. It redeems everyone, increases patience and is the best of all the paths. The people enjoy pleasure by giving away in charity, by performing tapas, vratas and fasting and achieve heavenly pleasures.

## \|\| 36.68-69 \|\|

*kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ caiva mūlaṃ saṃchidya yatnataḥ \|*  
*adhunedaṃ mokṣabījaṃ saṃkalpābhāva eva ca \|\| 68 \|\|*

*yatkarma sāttvikaṃ kuryyādasaṃkalpitameva ca \|*  
*sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā pare brahmaṇi līyate \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. Therefore one should be active in subjugating one's desires which are the sole reason for the destruction. Because any deeds performed without definite resolve lead one to salvation; therefore such of the sattvika deeds as are performed without definite resolve should be offered to lord Krishna, as a result of which a person merges himself into the eternal Brahman.

## \|\| 36.70 \|\|

*sāṃsārikāṇāmetattu nirvāṇaṃ mocakaṃ viduḥ \|*  
*necchanti vaiṣṇavāstattu sevāvirahakātarāḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. For the worldly people this is described as salvation which is not desired by the Vaishnava people because they feel pain after having been deprived of the devotion of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 36.71 \|\|

*sevāṃ kurvanti te nityaṃ vidhāyottamadehakam \|*  
*goloke vā'pi vaikuṇṭhe tasyaiva paramātmanaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The Vaishnava people proceed to Goloka or Vaikuntha and. enjoy themselves after serving lord Vishnu in divine form.

## \|\| 36.72-74 \|\|

*harisevādirūpāṃ ca muktimicchanti vaiṣṇavāḥ \|*  
*jīvanmuktāśca te śakra svakuloddhārakāriṇaḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

*smaraṇaṃ kīrttanaṃ viṣṇorarcanaṃ pādasevanam \|*  
*vandanaṃ stavanaṃ nityaṃ bhaktyā naivedyabhakṣaṇam \|\| 73 \|\|*

*caraṇodakapānaṃ ca tanmaṃtrajapanaṃ param \|*  
*idaṃ nistārabījaṃ ca sarveṣāmīpsitaṃ bhavet \|\| 74 \|\|*

72-74. О Indra, they are deprived of the birth and redeem their own races. They are only desirous of serving the lord. Lord Vishnu is adored by them daily; they recite his name, offer puja to him, serving at his feet, offer prayers, consume his naivedya while sipping the water with which the feet of the lord are washed. They recite his divine mantra which is the cause of salvation and is desired by all the people.

## \|\| 36.75 \|\|

*idaṃ mṛtyuñjayajñānaṃ dattaṃ mṛtyuñjayena me \|*  
*tacchiṣyo'haṃ ca niśśaṅkastatprasādācca sarvataḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. This is the knowledge which will enable one to overcome his death. This was received by me from lord Shiva himself. I am the pupil of Shiva and by his grace I carelessly wander in the entire universe.

## \|\| 36.76-77 \|\|

*sa janmadātā sa guruḥ sa ca bandhuḥ satāṃ paraḥ \|*  
*yo dadāti harerbhaktiṃ trailokye ca sudurlabham \|\| 76 \|\|*

*darśayedanyamārgaṃ ca vinā śrīkṛṣṇasevanam \|*  
*sa ca taṃ nāśayatyeva dhruvaṃ tadvadhabhāgbhavet \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. He is the creator of the noble people, is a teacher and the best of the relatives, because it is he alone, who can bestow the devotion of lord Vishnu in the three worlds. The one who leads a person to another path leaving the adoration of lord Krishna, surely meets with his end. Therefore, he becomes responsible for his killing and has to slay as Dhruva.

## \|\| 36.78-79 \|\|

*santataṃ jagatāṃ kṛṣṇanāma maṅgalakāraṇam \|*  
*maṅgalaṃ varddhate nityaṃ na bhavedāyuṣo vyayaḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

*tebhyo'pyapaiti kālaśca mṛtyussyādroga eva ca \|*  
*santāpaścaiva śokaśca vainateyādivoragāḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

78-79. The recitation of the name of lord Krishna is the cause of the welfare of the world, besides being the welfare itself. By doing so, life never gets wasted. The Kala, the death, the diseases, grief and pain disappear with the recitation of his name as the serpent disappears at the sight of Garuda.

## \|\| 36.80 \|\|

*kṛṣṇamantropāsakaśca brāhmaṇaḥ śvapaco'pi vā \|*  
*brahmalokaṃ samullaṃghya yāti golokamuttamam \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Irrespective of a Brahmana or a Chandala whosoever recites the name of lord Krishna reach the Goloka after crossing Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 36.81-82 \|\|

*brahmaṇā pūjitaḥ so'pi madhuparkādinā ca yaḥ \|*  
*stutaḥ suraiśca siddhaśca paramānandabhāvanaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

*jñānasāraṃ tapaḥsāraṃ brahmasāraṃ paraṃ śivam \|*  
*śivenoktaṃ yogasāraṃ śrīkṛṣṇapadasevanam \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. Brahma and other gods adore such people offering Madhuparka while offering prayers to them. Lord Shiva achieves the essence of the knowledge and the essence of the Brahma and the essence of the great welfare and yogic practices only by serving at the feet of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 36.83-84 \|\|

*brahmādistambaparyyantaṃ sarvaṃ mithyaiva kevalam \|*  
*bhaja satyaṃ paraṃ brahma rādheśaṃ prakṛteḥ param \|\| 83 \|\|*

*atīva sukhadaṃ sāraṃ bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ param \|*  
*siddhiyogapradaṃ caiva dātāraṃ sarvasampadām \|\| 84 \|\|*

83-84. Everything from an insect to Brahma is all false and the name of lord Krishna alone is truth, eternal Brahman, beyond Prakriti, quite pleasant and bestower of the salvation, besides all the riches.

## \|\| 36.85 \|\|

*yogināmapi siddhānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca tapasvinām \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ karmabhogo'sti na nārāyaṇasevinām \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. Though all the yogis, siddhas, yatls and tapasvl have to suffer for their deeds yet this does not apply to the person who engages himself in the service of lord Narayana.

## \|\| 36.86-87 \|\|

*bhasmasācca bhavetpāpaṃ yadupasparśamātrataḥ \|*  
*jvaladagnau pātitaṃ ca yathā śuṣkendhanaṃ tathā \|\| 86 \|\|*

*tato rogā hi vepante pāpāni ca bhayāni ca \|*  
*dūrataśca palāyante yamadūtāstato bhayāt \|\| 87 \|\|*

86-87. All his sins vanish like the dry wood thrown into the flames of fire which are reduced to ashes. All the ailments, sins, fears disappear and the messengers of Yama run away from the devotees of Vishnu.

## \|\| 36.88 \|\|

*tāvannibaddhaḥ saṃsāre kārāgāre vidherjanaḥ \|*  
*na yāvatkṛṣṇa mantraṃ ca prāpnoti guruvaktrataḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. A person remains captive in the prison of the universe till such time he is not educated by his teacher reciting the mantra of lord Krishna to him.

## \|\| 36.89-91 \|\|

*kṛtakarmaughabhogākhyanigaḍacchedakāraṇam \|*  
*māyājālocchedakaraṃ māyāpāśanikṛntanam \|\| 89 \|\|*

*golokamārgasopānaṃ nistāre bījakāraṇam \|*  
*bhaktyaṃkurasvarūpaṃ ca nityaṃ vṛddhamanaśvaram \|\| 90 \|\|*

*sāraṃ ca sarvatapasāṃ yovānāṃ sādhanaṃ tathā \|*  
*siddhīnāṃ vedapāṭhānāṃ vratādīnāṃ ca niścitam \|\| 91 \|\|*

89-91. Because they are the cause of destruction of the bondages created by the performing of deeds, destroyer of the illusion, the one which destroys the bondage of illusion, the step towards the Goloka, the seed for redemption, a form of the sprouting of the devotion, is always increasing, is eternal, the essence of all the tapas, recitation of the Vedas, bestower of the siddhis and the source of all the vratas.

## \|\| 36.92 \|\|

*dānānāṃ tīrthaśaucānāṃ yajñādīnāṃ purandara \|*  
*pūjānāmupavāsānāmityāha kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. О Indra, of all the types of charities performed, baths taken at holy places, the yajnas, adoration and fasting are based on the same. This has been ordained by Brahma himself.

## \|\| 36.93-95 \|\|

*puṃsāṃ lakṣaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca śataṃ mātāmahasya ca \|*  
*pūrvaṃ paraṃ ca tatsaṃkhyaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ gurum \|\| 93 \|\|*

*sahodaraṃ kalatraṃ ca vaktuṃ śiṣyaṃ ca kiṅkaram \|*  
*samuddharecca śvaśuraṃ śvaśrūṃ kanyāṃ ca tatsutam \|\| 94 \|\|*

*svātmānaṃ ca satīrthyaṃ ca gurupatnīṃ guroḥ sutam \|*  
*uddharedbalavānbhakto mantragrahaṇamātrataḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

93-95. Therefore by receiving the mantra of lord Krishna, a devotee of the lord redeems a lakh of his earlier generations from the maternal and paternal side, the father, the teacher, real brother, the wife, relatives, pupils, the servants, parents-in-law, daughter and her sons, the classmates, the wife of the teacher and his son are all redeemed.

## \|\| 36.96-97 \|\|

*mantragrahaṇamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*tatsparśapūtastīrthaughaḥ sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā \|\| 96 \|\|*

*anekajanmaparyyantaṃ dīkṣāhīno bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*tadanyadevamantraṃ ca labhate puṇyaleśataḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

96-97. By merely receiving the mantra one is relieved of the cycle of birth and by touching him all the sacred places are sanctified besides the earth. A person without dlksa for many births and achieving little merit for his devotion if he achieves the mantra of some other gods.

## \|\| 36.98 \|\|

*saptajanmasu devānāṃ kṛtvā sevāṃ svakarmataḥ \|*  
*labhate ca ravermantraṃ sākṣiṇaḥ sarvakarmaṇām \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. He serves the same gods for seven years as a result of which he receives the Surya-mantra.

## \|\| 36.99-100 \|\|

*janmatrayaṃ bhāskaraṃ ca sevitvā mānavaḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*labhedgaṇeśamantraṃ ca sarvavighnaharaṃ param \|\| 99 \|\|*

*janmatrayaṃ taṃ niṣevya nirvighnaśca bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*vighneśasya prasādena divyajñānaṃ labhennaraḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

99-100. That virtuous person adores the sun-gods for three births and then he receives the Ganesha-mantra which relieves one of all obstachies. After serving him up to three births, he is relieved of all the obstructions and with the grace of lord Ganesha, he receives the divine knowledge.

## \|\| 36.101-106 \|\|

*tadā jñānapradīpena samālocya mahāmatiḥ \|*  
*ajñānāndhatamaśchittvā mahāmāyāṃ bhajennaraḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

*prakṛtiṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ ca durgāṃ durgatināśinīm \|*  
*siddhidāṃ siddhirūpāṃ ca paramāṃ siddhiyoginīm \|\| 102 \|\|*

*vāṇīrūpāṃ ca padmāṃ ca bhadrāṃ kṛṣṇapriyātmikām \|*  
*nānārūpāṃ tāṃ niṣevya janmanāṃ śatakaṃ naraḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

*tatprasādādbhavejjñānī jñānānandaṃ tadā bhajet \|*  
*kṛṣṇaṃ jñānādhidevaṃ ca mahādevaṃ sanātanam \|\| 104 \|\|*

*śivaṃ śivasvarūpaṃ ca śivadaṃ śivakāraṇam \|*  
*paramānandarūpaṃ ca paramānandadāyinam \|\| 105 \|\|*

*sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ caiva dātāraṃ sarvasampadām \|*  
*amaratvapradaṃ caiva dīrghamāyuṣyadaṃ param \|\| 106 \|\|*

101-106. Thereafter the great intelligent person after thinking deeply using his knowledge, destroys the darkness of ignorance and serves Mahamaya, which is also called Prakriti, Vishnumaya, remover of misfortune, Durga, Siddhiprada, Siddhisvarupa, the great Siddhiyogini, Sarasvati and Kamala beloved of lord Krishna he serves the goddess in various forms for a hundred births and with her grace, he achieves the divine knowledge. It is only then that he adores the blissful lord who happens to be lord Krishna, the lord of all knowledge, eternal, bestower of welfare, Shiva and bestows all pleasures and salvation besides riches, etemalship and long life.

## \|\| 36.107-109 \|\|

*indratvaṃ ca manutvaṃ ca dātuṃ śaktaṃ ca līlayā \|*  
*rājendratvapradaṃ caiva jñānadaṃ haribhaktidam \|\| 107 \|\|*

*janmatrayaṃ tamārādhya cāśutoṣaprasādataḥ \|*  
*sarvadasya prasādena śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

*varadasya vareṇaiva haribhaktiṃ labheddhruvam \|*  
*tadā tadbhaktasaṃsargātkṛṣṇamantraṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 109 \|\|*

107-109. He is in a position to bestow the status of Indra on a man quite playfully. He also bestows kingship, eternal knowledge and the devotion of the lord. With the grace of Shiva, who gets pleased in no time, he adores him for three births. Thereafter with the grace of lord Shiva who is blissful and the bestower of the boons, he receives the devotion of lord Krishna. With the devotion of the lord he also receives the mantra of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 36.110-113 \|\|
