*nirmmalajñānadīpena pradīptena ca tattvavit \|*  
*brahmādistambaparyyantaṃ sarvaṃ mithyaiva paśyati \|\| 110 \|\|*

*dayānidheḥ prasādena nirmalajñānamālabhet \|*  
*varadasya vareṇaiva haribhaktiṃ labheddhruvam \|\| 111 \|\|*

*tadā nirvṛtimāpnoti sārātsārāṃ parātparām \|*  
*yatra dehe labhenmantraṃ taddehāvadhi bhārate \|\| 112 \|\|*

*tatpāñcabhautikaṃ tyaktvā bibhṛyāddivyarūpakam \|*  
*karoti dāsyaṃ goloke vaikuṇṭhe vā hareḥ pade \|\| 113 \|\|*

110-113. Thereafter such a truthful person achieves spotless knowledge right from Brahma to a straw, to whom the whole universe seems to be falsehood only. Thus with the grace of the merciful lord he achieves the spotless knowledge. Then Shiva the bestower of the boon grants him the eternal devotion and he attains the supreme knowledge. The body which received the mantra, devotee of the lord remains on earth in the land of Bharata. Thereafter his soul departs from the human body of five elements and attains the divine body. With that divine body he serves the lord remaining in Goloka or Vaikuntha.

## \|\| 36.114-127 \|\|

*paramānandasaṃyukto mohādiṣu vivarjitaḥ \|*  
*na vidyate punarjanma punarāgamanaṃ hare \|\| 114 \|\|*

*punaśca na pibetkṣīraṃ dhṛtvā mātṛstanaṃ param \|*  
*viṣṇumantropāsakānāṃ gaṅgādestīrthasevinām \|\| 115 \|\|*

*svadharmiṇāṃ ca bhikṣūṇāṃ punarjanma na vidyate \|*  
*tīrthe parityajetpāpaṃ kriyāṃ kṛtvā hariṃ bhajet \|\| 116 \|\|*

*ayaṃ nirūpito dhātrā svadharmastīrthasevinām \|*  
*tannāmamantraṃ prajapettatsevādiṣu tatparaḥ \|\| 117 \|\|*

*vratopavāsarata ityukto vai viṣṇusevinām \|*  
*sadanne vā kadanne vā loṣṭe vā kāñcane tathā \|\| 118 \|\|*

*samā buddhiryasya śaśvatsa saṃnyāsīti kīrtitaḥ \|*  
*daṇḍaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ raktavastramātraṃ ca dhārayet \|\| 119 \|\|*

*nityaṃ pravāsī naikatra syātsaṃnyāsīti kīrttitaḥ \|*  
*śuddhācāradvijānnaṃ ca bhuṅkte lobhādivarjitaḥ \|\| 120 \|\|*

*kintu kiṃcinna yāceta sa saṃnyāsīti kīrttitaḥ \|*  
*na vyāpārī nāśramī ca sarvakarmavivarjitaḥ \|\| 121 \|\|*

*dhyāyennārāyaṇaṃ śaśvatsa saṃnyāsīti kīrttitaḥ \|*  
*śaśvanmaunī brahmacārī saṃbhāṣā parivarjitaḥ \|\| 122 \|\|*

*sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ paśyetsa saṃnyāsīti kīrttitaḥ \|*  
*sarvatra samabuddhiśca hiṃsāmāyāvivarjitaḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

*krodhāhaṅkārarahitaḥ sa saṃnyāsīti kīrttitaḥ \|*  
*ayācitopasthitaṃ ca miṣṭāmiṣṭaṃ ca bhuktavān \|\| 124 \|\|*

*na yācate bhakṣaṇārthī sa saṃnyāsīti kīrttitaḥ \|*  
*na ca paśyenmukhaṃ strīṇāṃ na tiṣṭhettatsamīpata \|\| 125 \|\|*

*dāravīmapi yoṣāṃ ca na spṛśedyaḥ sa bhikṣukaḥ \|*  
*ayaṃ saṃnyāsināṃ dharma ityāha kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 126 \|\|*

*viparyyaye vināśaśca janmayāmyaṃ bhayaṃ bhavet \|*  
*janmaduḥkhaṃ yāmyaduḥkhaṃ jīvināmatidāruṇam \|\| 127 \|\|*

114-127. O Indra, he always enjoys eternal ecstasy, free from all the attachments. He is never reborn on earth again and does not suck milk from the breast of his mother. Because a devotee of Vishnu, who serves at the holy places like Ganga, who follows with devotion his own dharma and the

## \|\| 36.128-129 \|\|

*surasūkarayonau vā garbhe duḥkhaṃ samaṃ sura \|*  
*yonau vā kṣudrajantūnāṃ paśvādīnāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 128 \|\|*

*garbhe smaranti sarve te karmma janma śatodbhavam \|*  
*vismarennirgato jīvo garbhādvai viṣṇumāyayā \|*  
*svadehaṃ pāti yatnena suro vā kīṭa eva vā \|\| 129 \|\|*

128-129. Bhiksus are never reborn, besides those who perform all the rites, reciting the name of the lord. This has been ordained by Brahma who has described it to be the personal dharma, for the devotees of Vishnu who recites his mantra and adore him, performing all the vratas and fasting, are called the personal dharma. The one who remains unmoved by good and bad food, treats gold and iron alike, treats all the people alike, is termed as a Samnyasl. The one who carries a staff, a kamandalu, wears saffron clothes, is always on фе move, never resides for long at one place, is also termed as a Samnyasl. The one who consumes the food from a noble Brahmana, is freed from the grief, is never desirous of anything, is called a Samnyasl. The one who does not resort to trading in anything nor does he make any place, is devoid of all the karmas and is always engrossed in meditation, is called a Samnyasl. The one who always keeps mum, remains away from all the worldly affairs and looks everything in the world as the form of Brahman, such a Brahmacarl is called a Samnyasl. The one who treats everyone with the same wisdom, is free from violence and illusion, is free from anger and pride is called a Samnyasl. The one who consumes the tasteless or untasteful food without begging, who never begs for food, is called a Samnyasl. The one who never looks at the face of the woman nor does he stay close to them and does not touch even a female image made of wood, is called a Samnyasl. This has been ordained by Brahma. In case one discards the dharma he has to suffer from the pains caused by the messengers of Yama. The pain of birth has been described as the greatest pain of Yama.

## \|\| 36.130 \|\|

*yonerabhyantare śukre patite puruṣasya ca \|*  
*śukraṃ śoṇitayuktaṃ ca sahasā tatkṣaṇaṃ bhavet \|\| 130 \|\|*

130\. О Indra, thus, the gods, the pigs, the animals and small insects have to suffer equally the pain of birth. While in the mother's womb all the creatures are reminded of all the actions of their previous births. But on coming out of the womb they forget everything because of the illusion of lord Vishnu. Whether it is a god or a small insect, he protects his body with great care.

## \|\| 36.131-132 \|\|

*raktādhike mātṛsamaścetare piturākṛtiḥ \|*  
*yugmāhe ca bhavetputraḥ kanyakā tadviparyyaye \|\| 131 \|\|*

*ravibhaumagurūṇāṃ ca vāre cettadbhavetsutaḥ \|*  
*ayugmāhe taditare vāre vai kanyakā bhavet \|\| 132 \|\|*

131-132. At the time of the implanting of a seed by a man in the womb of a woman, his blood is united with that of the woman.

## \|\| 36.133-134 \|\|

*prathamaprahare janma yasya so'lpāyureva ca \|*  
*dvitīye madhyamaścaiva tṛtīye tatparo bhavet \|\| 133 \|\|*

*caturthe cirajīvī syātkṣaṇānāmanurūpakaḥ \|*  
*duḥkhī vā'tha sukhī vā'pi pūrvakarmānurūpataḥ \|\| 134 \|\|*

133-134. With the increase in the blood the womb appears in the form of a mother and when it is reduced she appears like a father. At the time of conception during the even days one gets a son and by conceiving on the odd days one gets a daughter. If one conceives on Sunday, Tuesday and Thursday one gets a son and by conceiving on other days a daughter is born.

## \|\| 36.135 \|\|

*yādṛśe ca kṣaṇe janma prasavastādṛśe bhavet \|*  
*prasūtikṣaṇacarcā ca kurvantyevaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ \|\| 135 \|\|*

135\. The child who is born in the first prahara of the day, such a child has short life, the one who is born in the second prahara, enjoys middle age and the one who is born in the third or the fourth prahara he enjoys long life. The person enjoys pleasure and pain according to his previous karmas.

## \|\| 36.136-137 \|\|

*kalalaṃ tvekarātreṇa pravṛddhaḥ syāddine dine \|*  
*saptame badarākāro māse gaṇḍusamo bhavet \|\| 136 \|\|*

*māsatraye māṃsapiṇḍo hastapādādivarjitaḥ \|*  
*sarvāvayavasampanno dehī māse ca pañcame \|\| 137 \|\|*

136-137. The moment during which a child is born, he achieves vices and virtues according to the time of birth. This is the way intelligent people have described about the birth of a child.

## \|\| 36.138-139 \|\|

*bhavettu jīvasaṃcāraḥ ṣaṇmāse sarvatattvavit \|*  
*duḥkhī svalpasthalasthāyī śakunta iva pañjare \|\| 138 \|\|*

*mātṛjagdhānnapānaṃ ca bhuṅkte'medhyasthale sthitaḥ \|*  
*hāheti śabdaṃ kṛtvā ca cintayedīśvaraṃ param \|\| 139 \|\|*

138-139. After the accumulation of the menstruation and till the child is born, it goes on increasing daily. On the seventh day it develops into the size of Jujubi. In a month it increase in size further, during the third month it develops into a pinda devoid of hands and feet. Thereafter the foetus after the period of five months develop further with all the human limbs.

## \|\| 36.140 \|\|

*evaṃ ca caturo māsānbhuktvā paramayātanām \|*  
*prerito vāyunā kāle garbhādvai nirgato bhavet \|\| 140 \|\|*

140\. Thus suffering variously during childhood, he becomes a youth. Infested with the illusion of lord Vishnu he becomes helpless and is unable to remember the happenings of his past birth.

## \|\| 36.141 \|\|

*digdeśakālāvyutpanno vismṛto viṣṇumāyayā \|*  
*śaśvadviṇmūtrasaṃyuktaḥ śiśuḥ syācchaiśavāvadhi \|\| 141 \|\|*

141\. Life is generated in the child after the expiry of six months and it remains in a compact form lodged in the womb like a bird in a cave. Remaining in the unclean environment, the child has to live on the food taken by the mother. He cries in pain in the womb always reciting the name of the lord.

## \|\| 36.142-143 \|\|

*parāyatto'pyakṣamaśca maśakādini vāraṇe \|*  
*kīṭādibhukto duḥkhī ca rauti tatra punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 142 \|\|*

*stanāndho'pyasamarthaśca yāñcāṃ kartumabhīpsitām \|*  
*na vāṇī nissarettasya paugaṇḍāvadhi susphuṭā \|\| 143 \|\|*

142-143. Similarly all the four months are spent bearing the pain and at the appropriate time pressed with the wind, the child comes out of the womb.

## \|\| 36.144 \|\|

*paugaṇḍe yātanāṃ bhuktvā prāpnute yauvanaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*na smarenmāyayā dehī garbhāderyātanāṃ punaḥ \|\| 144 \|\|*

144\. The illusion of lord Vishnu which pervades everywhere over-powers the child which forgets all its past memories. Thereafter having been surrounded by the refuse and urine he crosses infancy and becomes a child.

## \|\| 36.145 \|\|

*āhāramaithunārttaśca nānāmohādiveṣṭitaḥ \|*  
*putraṃ kalatramanugaṃ yatnena paripālayet \|\| 145 \|\|*

145\. Since he remains dependent, he is unable to drive away even the mosquito and other insects, which bite him making him to cry. While sucking the milk he is unable to express his desires because up to sometime he is unable even to express himself clearly.

## \|\| 36.146 \|\|

*evaṃ yāvatsamarthaśca tāvadeva hi pūjitaḥ \|*  
*asamarthaṃ ca manyante bāṃdhavā gojaraṃ yathā \|\| 146 \|\|*

146\. During those days, he engages himself in consuming food eaten by the mother, in the womb and he is over powered by illusion. When he is grown up and children are born to him, he engages himself in the love of the children and the wife, carefully bringing them up.

## \|\| 36.147-148 \|\|

*yadā'tīva jarāyukto jaḍo'tibadhiro bhavet \|*  
*kāsaśvāsādiyuktaśca parāyatto'timūḍhavat \|\| 147 \|\|*

*tadantare'nutāpaṃ ca kurute santataṃ punaḥ \|*  
*na sevitaṃ harestīrthaṃ satsaṃgaścāpi kāmataḥ \|\| 148 \|\|*

147-148. The people of the house respect him up to the time he is able to provide livelihood to them and when he is unable to feed them, they consider him like an old bull.

## \|\| 36.149-150 \|\|

*punaśca mānavīṃ yoniṃ labhāmi bhārate yadi \|*  
*tadā tīrthaṃ gamiṣyāmi bhaje vai kṛṣṇamityaho \|\| 149 \|\|*

*ityevamādi manasi kurvantaṃ taṃ jaḍaṃ sura \|*  
*gṛhṇāti yamadūtaśca kāle prāpte'tidāruṇaḥ \|\| 150 \|\|*

149-150. Thus when he grows further old he becomes deaf, suffers from ailments like cough and bronchitis and he becomes dependent totally on his relatives for food etc. At that stage he starts repenting on his past deeds further saying, “I never visited the holy places of the lord nor did I keep the company of the holy people or resorted to the reciting of the name of the lord.

## \|\| 36.151-152 \|\|

*sa paśyedyamadūtaṃ ca pāśahastaṃ ca daṇḍinam \|*  
*atīva koparaktākṣaṃ vikṛtākāramulbaṇam \|\| 151 \|\|*

*durnivāryyamupāyaiśca baliṣṭhaṃ ca bhayaṅkaram \|*  
*durdṛśyaṃ sarvasiddhijñaṃ sarvādṛṣṭaṃ puraḥ sthitam \|\| 152 \|\|*

151-152. In case I am reborn in the land of Bharata and achieve the human form then I shall surely travel to the holy places and shall also recite the name of lord Krishna. О god, thus he remains thinking in his mind, when life departs out of his body and the terrific messengers of Yama arrive and carry him away.

## \|\| 36.153-154 \|\|

*dṛṣṭamātrānmahābhīto viṇmūtraṃ ca samutsṛjet \|*  
*tadā prāṇāṃstyajetsadyo dehaṃ vai pāñcabhautikam \|\| 153 \|\|*

*aṃguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ gṛhītvā yamakiṅkaraḥ \|*  
*vinyasya bhogadehe ca svasthānaṃ prāpayed drutam \|\| 154 \|\|*

153-154. Не looks at the messengers of Yama at that point of time who hold the bamboo staff in their hands, their eyes appear red with anger and have deformed bodies. Such messengers of Yama are quite powerful and horrible to look at. Their very sight is painful, they possess all the knowledge and becoming invisible remain at the spot.

## \|\| 36.155 \|\|

*jīvo gatvā yamaṃ paśyetsarvadharmajñameva ca \|*  
*ratnasiṃhāsanasthe ca sasmitaṃ susthiraṃ param \|\| 155 \|\|*

155\. At the sight of the messengers of Yama, the person on death bed releases refuse and urine in terror. Thereafter he discards from the human body the five elements. The messenger of Yama then captures the ethereal body of the size of a thumb and place it in the tiny body and then carry him on to the abode of Yama.

## \|\| 36.156-158 \|\|

*dharmādharmavicārajñaṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvatomukham \|*  
*viśveṣvekādhikāraṃ ca vidhātrā nirmitaṃ purā \|\| 156 \|\|*

*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam \|*  
*veṣṭitaṃ pārṣadagaṇairdūtaiścāpi trikoṭibhiḥ \|\| 157 \|\|*

*japantaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanāma śuddhasphāṭikamālayā \|*  
*dhyāyamānaṃ tatpadābjaṃ pulakāṅkitavigraham \|\| 158 \|\|*

156-158. The soul then arrives in the abode of Yama where he looks at him. Yama is in the know of all the dharma, is seated on a gem-studded lion throne wearing a serene smile on his face.

## \|\| 36.159-160 \|\|

*sagadgadaṃ sāśrunetraṃ sarvatra samadarśinam \|*  
*atīva kamanīyaṃ ca śaśvatsusthirayauvanam \|\| 159 \|\|*

*svatejasā prajvalantaṃ sukhadṛśyaṃ vicakṣaṇam \|*  
*śaratpārvaṇacandrābhaṃ citraguptapuraḥsthitam \|\| 160 \|\|*

159-160. The sole rights up the universe were entrusted to the god of death in earlier times by the creator, who is all knowledgeable, having faces on all sides and is of religious mind. He is clad m the costumes sanctified by god Agni and adorned with all the ornaments studded with gems. He is surrounded by his courtiers and three of the messengers. He holds a rosary of crystal beads in his bands and always recites the name of Krishna. His mind is always devoted at the feet of lord Krishna and he becomes emotional often with pleasure.

## \|\| 36.161 \|\|

*puṇyātmanāṃ śāntarūpaṃ pāpināṃ ca bhayaṅkaram \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇameddehī mahābhītaśca tiṣṭhati \|\| 161 \|\|*

161\. At times his voice is choked because of his intensive love for Krishna with tears coming out of his eyes. He is quite beautiful and looks evenly on all sides. He is always youthful and illumines with his own lustre. He is pleasant to look at, is a wise person and maintains the lustre of the full moon. Chitragupta stands besides him.

## \|\| 36.162-164 \|\|

*citraguptavicāreṇa yeṣāṃ yaducitaṃ phalam \|*  
*śubhāśubhaṃ ca kurute tadeva ravinandanaḥ \|\| 162 \|\|*

*evaṃ teṣāṃ gatāyāte nivṛttirnāsti jīvinām \|*  
*nivṛttiheturūpaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇapadasevanam \|\| 163 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ varaṃ prārthaya vāñchitam \|*  
*sarvaṃ dāsyāmi te vatsa na me'sādhyaṃ ca kiṃcana \|\| 164 \|\|*

162-164. Yama is quite pleasant for the noble soul and is quite terrible for the sinners. At the sight of such a Yama, the soul bows in reverence to him and remains there getting terrified.

## \|\| 36.165 \|\|

*mahendra uvāca \|*  
*indratvaṃ ca gataṃ bhadraṃ kimaiśvaryye prayojanam \|*  
*kalpavṛkṣa muniśreṣṭha dehi me paramaṃ padam \|\| 165 \|\|*

165\. Thereafter in consultation with Chitragupta, he gives the reward of the good or bad deeds of the persons. Thus because of the cycle of birth and death the souls never get freed, because the only way to escape the cycle of birth and death happens to be the service at the feet of lord Krs па. О son, thus I have explained to you everything. Now you asked for a boon, because I am competent enough to bestow everything and nothing is beyond me.

## \|\| 36.166 \|\|

*mahendrasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya munipuṅgavaḥ \|*  
*tamuvāca vacaḥ satyaṃ vedoktaṃ sārameva ca \|\| 166 \|\|*

166\. Mahendra said — О wish-fulfilling tree, О best of the sages I have already fallen from the position of Indra which was beneficial for me. Now these worldly pleasures are of no consequence for me. Therefore, you bestow the eternal position on me?

## \|\| 36.167 \|\|

*durvāsā uvāca \|*  
*paraṃ padaṃ viṣayiṇāṃ mahendrātisudurlabham \|*  
*muktiryuṣmadvidhānāṃ ca na laye prākṛte'pi ca \|\| 167 \|\|*

167\. Listening to the words of Mahendra, Durvasa who was truthful and knew the essence of the Vedas, smiled and said.

## \|\| 36.168 \|\|

*āvirbhāvaḥ sṛṣṭividhau tirobhāvo laye'pi ca \|*  
*yathā jāgaraṇaṃ suptirbhavatyeva krameṇa ca \|\| 168 \|\|*

168\. DurvasS said — О Mahendra, it is quite difficult for the people who achieve the eternal position and indulge in all the worldly pleasures. It is impossible for a person like you to achieve salvation even at the time of dissolution.

## \|\| 36.169 \|\|

*yathā bhramati kālaśca tathā viṣayiṇo dhuvam \|*  
*cakranemikrameṇaiva nityameveśvarecchayā \|\| 169 \|\|*

169\. As a person goes to sleep and then wakes up, similarly you people always emerge at the time of creation and disappear at the time of dissolution.

## \|\| 36.170 \|\|

*palamekaṃ bhavedeva yathā vipalaṣaṣṭibhiḥ \|*  
*ṣaṣṭibhiśca palairdaṇḍo muhūrtto dviguṇāttataḥ \|\| 170 \|\|*

170\. With the will of the lord, such people roam about in the universe like the potter's wheel. Similarly the people who indulge in worldly pleasures keep on rotating.

## \|\| 36.171-178 \|\|

*triṃśadbhiśca muhūrttaiśca bhavedeva divāniśam \|*  
*daśapañca divārātriḥ pakṣamekaṃ vidurbudhāḥ \|\| 171 \|\|*

*pakṣābhyāṃ śuklakṛṣṇābhyāṃ māsa eva vidhīyate \|*  
*ṛturdvābhyāṃ ca māsābhyāṃ saṃkhyāvidbhi prakīrttitaḥ \|\| 172 \|\|*

*ṛtutrayeṇāyanaṃ ca tābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ ca vatsaraḥ \|*  
*triṃśatsahasrādhikaiśca tricatvāriṃśalakṣakaiḥ \|\| 173 \|\|*

*vatsarairnaramānaiśca yugānāṃ ca catuṣṭayam \|*  
*ṣaṣṭyā'dhike pañcaśate sahasre pañcaviṃśatau \|\| 174 \|\|*

*yuge narāṇāṃ śakrāyurmanorāyuḥ prakīrttitam \|*  
*diglakṣendranipāte'ṣṭasahasrādhika eva ca \|\| 175 \|\|*

*nipāto brahmaṇastatra bhavetprākṛtiko layaḥ \|*  
*laye prākṛtike vatsa kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 176 \|\|*

*cakṣurnimeṣaḥ sṛṣṭiśca punarunmīlane tathā \|*  
*brahmasṛṣṭilayānāṃ ca saṃkhyā nāsti śrutau śrutam \|\| 177 \|\|*

*yathā pṛthivyā reṇūnāmityūce candraśekharaḥ \|*  
*eteṣāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ nāsti kathitāni ca yāni tu \|\| 178 \|\|*

171-178. As the sixty vipalas make a pala, sixty palas make a danda and two dandas make a muhUrta and thirty muhUrtas make a day and night, the wise people have declared fifteen days to be a fortnight. The month comprises of a bright and a dark fortnight. The Mathematicians describe a season comprising of two months, the three seasons make an Ayana or a half year and two Ayanas or two half years make a year. The human yugas comprise of forty three lakhs and thirty thousand years. The age of peoples comprises of twenty five thousand five hundred and sixty yugas as the age of Indra and Manu. Thus with the fall of ten lakhs and sixty thousand Indras, Brahma also has to fall and get merged into Prakriti. О son, the eye lid of lord Krishna drops at the same time during the time of dissolution. When he reopens his eyes the creation starts. The number of Brahmas, the creation of universe and the number of dissolution have not been prescribed in the Vedas, because they are immeasurable like the particles of dust. This has been described by lord Shiva himself. All the gods do not achieve salvation.

## \|\| 36.179 \|\|

*sṛṣṭisūtrasvarūpaṃ hi cānyadvṛṇu varaṃ sura \|*  
*munīndrasya vacaḥ śrutvā devendro vismito mune \|\| 179 \|\|*

179\. Therefore О god, this is the form of creation and therefore you ask for any other boon except the same. О sage, on hearing these words of Durvasa, Indra the god of gods, was extremely surprised.

## \|\| 36.180 \|\|

*ātmanaḥ pūrvamaiśvaryyaṃ varayāmāsa tatra vai \|*  
*tatprāpsyasyacireṇaivetyuktvā sa prayayau gṛham \|\| 180 \|\|*

180\. Indra then prayed for the restoration of his earlier glory. Durvasa said: you will surely get it in no time. Thus speaking the sage Durvasa went to his abode. Indra got the great knowledge but there can be no riches without misfortune.

## Chapter 37

## \|\| 37.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*harerguṇaṃ samākarṇya jñānaṃ prāpya purandaraḥ \|*  
*kiṃ cakāra gṛhaṃ gatvā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said — What did Indra, the god of the gods, do after listening to the glory of lord Vishnu and achieving the divine knowledge, you kindly tell me.

## \|\| 37.2-4 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇasya guṇaṃ śrutvā vītarāgo babhūva sa \|*  
*vairāgyaṃ varddhayāmāsa tadā brahmandine dine \|\| 2 \|\|*

*munisthānādgṛhaṃ gatvā sa dadarśāmarāvatīm \|*  
*daityairasurasaṃghaiśca samākīrṇāṃ bhayākulām \|\| 3 \|\|*

*viṣaṇṇabāndhavāṃ caiva bandhuhīnāṃ ca kutracit \|*  
*pitṛmātṛkalatrādivihīnāmaticañcalām \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Narayana said — О Brahman, after listening to the glory of lord Krishna, Indra developed a sense of detachment which went on increasing day by day. Leaving the place of the sage he then went and arrived in the city of Amaravati which he looked at from a distance, which was infested with the terror of the demons. His relatives were seated losing all the grace with their faces crestfallen. At places some houses were deserted and the father, the mother or the wife could not be found there. Their whereabouts were unknown.

## \|\| 37.5-8 \|\|

*śatrugrastāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā tāmagamadvākpatiṃ prati \|*  
*śakro mandākinītīre dadarśa gurumīśvaram \|\| 5 \|\|*

*dhyāyamānaṃ paraṃ brahma gaṅgātoye sthitaṃ param \|*  
*sūryyābhisaṃmukhaṃ pūrvamukhaṃ vai viśvato mukham \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sāśrunetraṃ pulakitaṃ paramānandasaṃyutam \|*  
*variṣṭhaṃ ca gariṣṭhaṃ ca dharmiṣṭhaṃ ceṣṭasevinam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*śreṣṭhaṃ ca vandhuvargāṇāmatiśreṣṭhaṃ ca māninām \|*  
*jyeṣṭhaṃ ca bandhuvargāṇāṃ neṣṭaṃ ca suravairiṇām \|\| 8 \|\|*

5-8. Then finding his kingdom infested with the enemies, Indra went to Brihaspati who was lodged on the bank of the river Mandakinl. He was adoring the eternal Brahman in the water of the Ganga facing the sun in the east engrossed in blissful tapas with wet eyes and the body becoming emotional. He was the best of the sages and extremely glorious besides being extremely religious, devoted towards his family-god, best of his relatives and the people having pride. He was the eldest of the brothers who was disliked by the demons.

## \|\| 37.9 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā guruṃ japantaṃ ca tatra tasthau sureśvaraḥ \|*  
*praharānte guruṃ dṛṣṭvā cotthitaṃ praṇanāma saḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Finding the teacher seated in the water Indra the god of gods stood there waiting for him. After a prahara the teacher got up from his piijd and Indra bowed in reverence to him.

## \|\| 37.10 \|\|

*praṇamya caraṇāmbhoje rurodoccairmuhurmurhuḥ \|*  
*vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa brahmaśāpādikaṃ tathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Bowing at his feet Indra started crying aloud and then narrated about the curse pronounced on him by the sage Durvasa.

## \|\| 37.11 \|\|

*punarvaro mayā labdho jñānināmapi durlabhām \|*  
*vairigrastāṃ svīyapurīṃ krameṇaiva sureśvaraḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. At that very moment Indra also informed the sage that he has been blessed to get back his kingdom in due course of time. This is the boon and the eternal knowledge which has been received by me from Durvasa.

## \|\| 37.12 \|\|

*śiṣyasya vacanaṃ śrutvā satāṃ buddhimatāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*bṛhaspatiruvācedaṃ koparaktāntalocanaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. On hearing the words, intelligent Brihaspati got enraged and with his eyes red in anger said to him.

## \|\| 37.13 \|\|

*bṛhaspatiruvāca \|*  
*śrutaṃ sarvaṃ suraśreṣṭha mā rodīrvacanaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*na kātaro hi nītijño vipattau syātkadācana \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Brihaspati said — О best of the gods, I have heard everything. You stop crying and listen to my words. The wise people do not lose heart at the time of misfortune.

## \|\| 37.14 \|\|

*sampattirvā vipattirvā naśvarā svapnarūpiṇī \|*  
*pūrvasvakarmāyattā ca svayaṃ karttā tayorapi \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Fortune and misfortune are both perishable and are like a dream which are governed by the earlier deeds because they are created by one's own doing.

## \|\| 37.15 \|\|

*sarveṣāṃ ca bhramatyeva śaśvajjanmani janmani \|*  
*cakranemikrameṇaiva tatra kā paridevanā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Because of this they keep on rotating in the life of a person like a potter's wheel. Therefore it is of no use to grieve over them.

## \|\| 37.16-17 \|\|

*bhuṅkte hi svakṛtaṃ karma sarvatrāpi ca bhārate \|*  
*śubhāśubhaṃ ca yatkiṃcitsvakarmaphalabhukpumān \|\| 16 \|\|*

*nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi \|*  
*avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. One gets the result of one's own deeds in the land of Bharata. Whatever good or bad deeds are perfonned by him, he surely has to face the result. Because the deeds never vanish even after the lapse of hundreds and crores of kalpas, one has to reap the result of the good or bad deeds perfonned by him.

## \|\| 37.18 \|\|

*ityevamuktaṃ vede ca kṛṣṇena paramātmanā \|*  
*sāmni kauthumaśākhāyāṃ saṃbodhya svakulodbhavam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Lord ' Krishna had advised his people accordingly in the Kauthumlsakha of the Samaveda.

## \|\| 37.19 \|\|

*janma bhogāvaśeṣe ca sarveṣāṃ kṛtakarmaṇām \|*  
*anurūpaṃ ca teṣāṃ vai bhārate'nyatra caiva hi \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. If the results of some of the deeds are left out in one birth, he has to face them in the next birth.

## \|\| 37.20 \|\|

*karmaṇā brahmaśāpaṃ ca karmaṇā ca śubhāśiṣam \|*  
*karmaṇā ca mahālakṣmīṃ labheddainyaṃ ca karmaṇā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Because with the performing of deeds one receives a curse, a boon, all the riches or poverty.

## \|\| 37.21 \|\|

*koṭijanmārjitaṃ karma jīvināmanugacchati \|*  
*nahi tyajedvinā bhogāttaṃ chāyeva purandara \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. О Indra, therefore, the deeds performed in crores of births and accumulated earlier follows a person like his shadow and do not leave him unless he faces the result.

## \|\| 37.22-23 \|\|

*kālabhede deśabhede pātrabhede ca karmaṇām \|*  
*nyūnatā'dhikatā vā'pi bhavedeva hi karmaṇām \|\| 22 \|\|*

*vastudāne ca vastūnāṃ samaṃ puṇyaṃ same dine \|*  
*dinabhede koṭiguṇamasaṃkhyaṃ vā'dhikaṃ tataḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. There could be a difference in time, country, the actors or increase or decrease in the deeds as a person receives and ordinary merit by giving away things in charity on ordinary days and on certain occasion by offering things in charity the merit is multiplied to crores of times or even more than that.

## \|\| 37.24 \|\|

*samadeśe ca vastūnāṃ dāne puṇyaṃ samaṃ vṛṣan \|*  
*deśabhede koṭiguṇamasaṃkhyaṃ vā'dhikaṃ tataḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Similarly by making offering to in ordinary countries, one gets the normal merit and by offering in sacred places, the merit is increased manifold or even more than that.

## \|\| 37.25 \|\|

*same pātre samaṃ puṇyaṃ vastūnāṃ kartureva ca \|*  
*pātrabhede śataguṇamasaṃkhyaṃ vā tato'dhikam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Similarly by preferring charity of the normal things, the performer receives the normal merit but by offering the same to some competent person the merit is increased manifold.

## \|\| 37.26 \|\|

*yathā phalanti sasyāni nyūnānyapyadhikāni ca \|*  
*karṣakāṇāṃ kṣetrabhede pātrabhede phalaṃ tathā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. As the seeds sown by the farmers sprout variously, similarly by offering charity to certain people one gets the merit differently.

## \|\| 37.27-29 \|\|

*sāmānyadivase vipre dānaṃ samaphalaṃ bhavet \|*  
*amāyāṃ ravisaṃkrāntyāṃ phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet \|*  
*cāturmāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmanantaphalameva ca \|\| 27 \|\|*

*grahaṇe śaśinaḥ koṭiguṇaṃ ca phalameva ca \|*  
*sūryyasya grahaṇe cāpi tato daśaguṇaṃ phalam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*akṣayāyāmakṣayaṃ cāpyasaṃkhyaphalamucyate \|*  
*evamanyatra puṇyāhe phalādhikyaṃ bhavediha \|\| 29 \|\|*

27-29. If a charity is given to a Brahmana on an ordinary day, one gets the ordinary merit but if the same is given on a moonless day or on the first day of the month, the merit is multiplied considerably. In the Caturmasya (four months of the rainy season), on the full moon day, the day of solar or lunar eclipse, one earns ten times more merit. On the Aksya-trtiya day, one gets the merit beyond measure. Similarly on the other sacred days, one; achieves great merit.

## \|\| 37.30 \|\|

*yathā dāne tathā snāne jape vai puṇyakarmasu \|*  
*evaṃ sarvatra boddhavyaṃ narāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ phalam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. As one gets more or less merit by offering charity, taking a bath at holy places, performing of japam and other noble deeds, similarly human beings achieve merit more or less according to the occasion.

## \|\| 37.31 \|\|

*sāmānyadeśe dānaṃ ca vipre samaphalaṃ bhavet \|*  
*tīrthe devagṛhe caiva phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ smṛtam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. As by making an offering to a Brahmana at an ordinary place, one gets the normal merit but when the offering is made in the temple of the god, the merit increases to hundred times more.

## \|\| 37.32-34 \|\|

*gaṅgāyāṃ vai koṭiguṇaṃ kṣetre nārāyaṇe'vyayam \|*  
*kurukṣetre badaryyāṃ ca kāśyāṃ koṭiguṇaṃ tathā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*yathā ca vai koṭiguṇaṃ tathā vai viṣṇumandire \|*  
*kedāre vai lakṣaguṇaṃ haridvāre tathā phalam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*puṣkare bhāskarakṣetre daśalakṣaguṇaṃ phalam \|*  
*evaṃ sarvatra boddhavyaṃ phalādhikyaṃ krameṇa ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. The merit one achieves by bathing in the Ganga multiplies to crores of times, but by doing so in the Ndrayana-ksetra, it is beyond measure and in the Kuruksetra, Badrlkasrama and KasI, the merit multiplies to crores of time. As one gets the merit crores of times more in the above sacred places, similarly one gets a merit crores of times greater than offering something in charity in the temple of Vishnu. The merit is multiplied to lakhs of times at Kedara and Haridvara. At Pus kara and Bhaskara-ksetra it is multiplied to ten lakh times. Thus the merit goes on increasing according to the place or time.

## \|\| 37.35-36 \|\|

*sāmānyabrāhmaṇe dānaṃ samameva phalaṃ labhet \|*  
*lakṣaṃ trisandhyaṃ pūte ca paṇḍite ca jitendriye \|\| 35 \|\|*

*viṣṇumantropāsake ca budhe koṭiguṇaṃ phalam \|*  
*evaṃ sarvatra boddhavyaṃ phalādhikyaṃ guṇādhikaṃ \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. By offering charities to the simple Brahmanas, one gets the simple merits but when the charity is given to a well-read Brahmana devoted to Vishnu, the merit is increased to crores of times. Similarly with the increase in the qualities, the merit is also increased.

## \|\| 37.37-38 \|\|

*yathā daṇḍena sūtreṇa śarāveṇa jalena ca \|*  
*kumbhaṃ nirmāti cakreṇa kumbhakāro mṛdā bhuvi \|\| 37 \|\|*

*tathaiva karmasūtreṇa phalaṃ dhātā dadāti ca \|*  
*yasyājñayā sṛṣṭividhau taṃ ca nārāyaṇaṃ bhaja \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. As the potter makes the vases with his potter's wheel, mud, the earth and water similarly Brahma at the time of creation also bestows the merit on everyone on the basis of the deeds. Therefore, you better recite the name of Narayana.

## \|\| 37.39 \|\|

*sa vidhātā vidhātuśca pātuḥ pātā jagattraye \|*  
*sraṣṭuḥ sraṣṭā ca saṃharttuḥ saṃharttā kālakālakaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. In the three worlds he happens to be the creator of the creator, protector of the three worlds, creator of Brahma, destroyer of the destroyer and gives death to the god of death.

## \|\| 37.40 \|\|

*mahāvipattau saṃsāre yaḥ smarenmadhusūdanam \|*  
*vipattau tasya sampattirbhavedityāha śaṅkaraḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. At the time of great misfortune, if one recites the name of the lord, he achieves fortune even at the time of great misfortune. This has been ordained by lord Shiva.

## \|\| 37.41 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā jīvaśca samāliṅgya sureśvaram \|*  
*dattvā śubhāśiṣaṃ ceṣṭaṃ bodhayāmāsa nārada \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. O Narada, thus speaking Brihaspati embraced Indra the god of gods and blessing him imparted the divine knowledge to him.

## Chapter 38

## \|\| 38.1 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*hariṃ dhyātvā harirbrahmañjagāma brahmaṇaḥ sabhām \|*  
*bṛhaspatiṃ puraskṛtya sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said — Indra reciting the name of Narayana went to Brahma with all the gods under the leadership of Brihaspati.

## \|\| 38.2 \|\|

*śīghraṃ gatvā brahmalokaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca kamalodbhavam \|*  
*praṇemurdevatāḥ sarvā guruṇā saha nārada \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О Narada, reaching there quickly together with the teacher Brihaspati and Indra found Brahma there who was born out of the lotus and bowed before him.

## \|\| 38.3 \|\|

*vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa surācāryo vidhiṃ vibhum \|*  
*prahasyovāca tacchrutvā mahendraṃ kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Thereafter Brihaspati the teacher of all the gods narrated the entire story to Brahma, on hearing which he smiled and said to Indra.

## \|\| 38.4 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*vatsa madvaṃśajāto'si prapautro me vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*bṛhaspateśca śiṣyastvaṃ surāṇāmadhipaḥ svayam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. BrahmS said — О son, you are born in my race and happen to be my intelligent grandson; you are the pupil of Brihaspati and happen to be the lord of gods.

## \|\| 38.5 \|\|

*mātāmahaste dakṣaśca viṣṇubhaktaḥ pratāpavān \|*  
*kulatrayaṃ yacchuddhaṃ ca kathaṃ so'haṃkṛto bhavet \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Your great maternal grandfather had also been a glorious devotee of Vishnu. Therefore the one whose three races are purified how could be become arrogant?

## \|\| 38.6-7 \|\|

*mātā pativratā yasya pitā śuddho jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*mātāmaho mātulaśca kathaṃ so'haṃkṛto bhavet \|\| 6 \|\|*

*janaḥ paitṛkadoṣeṇa doṣānmātāmahasya ca \|*  
*gurordāṣānnītidoṣairharidveṣī bhaveddhruvam \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Because the one, who has a chaste mother, a chaste father and whose maternal grandfather as well as the maternal uncle are quite pure and self-disciplined, how can he become proud? The sins of the father, maternal grandfather and the teacher are envious to the lord.

## \|\| 38.8 \|\|

*sarvāntarātmā bhagavānsarvadeheṣvavasthitaḥ \|*  
*yasya dehātsa prayāti sa śavastatkṣaṇaṃ bhavet \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The one who pervades the bodies of all in the form of a soul and the same soul when it departs from the body, a person becomes dead.

## \|\| 38.9-10 \|\|

*mano'hamindriyeśaśca jñānarūpo hi śaṅkaraḥ \|*  
*asravaḥ prakṛtirviṣṇurbuddhirbhagavatī satī \|\| 9 \|\|*

*nidrādayaḥ śaktayaśca tāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛteḥ kalāḥ \|*  
*ātmanaḥ pratibimbaṃ ca jīvo bhogī śarīrabhṛt \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. I happen to be the mind in the body who controls the organs of the senses. Lord Shiva is all knowledgeable. Shiva is the life while goddess Bhagavati has the form of Prakriti who controls sleep and all other natural rays. The Jlva happens to be the shadow of the soul who remains in the body and feeding the body has to experience pleasure and pain.

## \|\| 38.11-12 \|\|

*ātmanīśe gate dehātsarve yānti sasaṃbhramāt \|*  
*yathā vartmani gacchantaṃ naradevamivānugāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*ahaṃ śivaśca śeṣaśca viṣṇurdharmo mahānvirāṭ \|*  
*vayaṃ yadaṃśā bhaktāśca tatpuṣpaṃ nyakkṛtaṃ tvayā \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. As the attendants follow the king, similarly at the time of the departure of the soul from the body, the mind and other organs of the senses follow him. Thus the one to whom Shiva, myself, Shesha, Vishnu, Dharma, Mahavirat and other gods are devoted and also form part of him, the same lord has been humiliated by you.

## \|\| 38.13-15 \|\|

*śivena pūjitaṃ pādapadmaṃ puṣpeṇa yena ca \|*  
*tacca durvāsasā dattaṃ daivenānyakṛtaṃ sura \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tatpuṣpaṃ mastake yasya kṛṣṇapādābjataścyutam \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ vai surāṇāṃ ca tatpūjā purato bhavet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*daivena vañcitastvaṃ ca daivaṃ ca balavattaram \|*  
*bhāgyahīnaṃ janaṃ mūḍhaṃ ko vā rakṣitumīśvaraḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. О god, the flower with which Shiva has adored at the feet of the lord, the same flower was handed over by Shesha to Durvasa which was given to you and you showed disrespect to the same.

## \|\| 38.16 \|\|

*kṛṣṇaṃ na manyate yo hi śrīnāthaṃ sarvavanditam \|*  
*prayāti ruṣṭā taddāsī mahālakṣmīrvihāya tam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. AH the gods adore the person on whose head the flower is placed after its getting separated from the feet of lord Vishnu. You have therefore been separated by the destiny (from the fortune) which is quite powerful. Who can be competent enough to save such an unfortunate and a foolish fellow? The one who does not respect Krishna who is the lord of Lakshmi, his beloved Maha-Lakshmi also gets annoyed with him and leaving him moves elsewhere.

## \|\| 38.17-18 \|\|

*śatayajñena yā labdhā dīkṣitena tvayā purā \|*  
*sā śrīrgatā 'dhunā kopātkṛṣṇanirmālyavarjanāt \|\| 17 \|\|*

*adhunā gaccha vaikuṇṭhaṃ mayā ca guruṇā saha \|*  
*niṣevya tatra śrīnāthaṃ śriyaṃ prāpsyasi tadvarāt \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. The merits you had earned in earlier times by performing a hundred yajnas have vanished because of yotir showing disrespect to the flower of lord Krishna as a result of which the goddess of fortune has left you for some other places. Therefore you get along with me just now together with Brihaspati to the abode of lord Vishnu and regain you last fortune by adoring him.

## \|\| 38.19 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā sa brahmā sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*śīghraṃ jagāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ yatra śrīśastayā saha \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Thus speaking, Brahma quickly moved towards Vaikuntha, together with all the gods, where the lord of Lakshmi was residing.

## \|\| 38.20-22 \|\|

*tatra gatvā paraṃ brahma bhagavantaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā tejaḥsvarūpaṃ ca prajvalantaṃ svatejasā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*grīṣmamadhyāhnamārttaṇḍaśatakoṭisamaprabham \|*  
*śāntaṃ cānādimadhyāntaṃ lakṣmīkāntamanantakam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*caturbhujaiḥ pārṣadaiśca sarasvatyā stutaṃ natam \|*  
*bhaktyā caturbhirvedaiśca gaṅgayā pariṣevitam \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. Reaching there, they had an audience with lord Narayana who was the form of tejas and was illumining with his own lustre. He had the glory resembling crores of the suns of the midday of the summer season. He was peaceful, eternal, without beginning or end, lord of Laks ml, beyond measure, having four arms, being prayed to by Sarasvati and the four Vedas with devotion, besides being served by the goddess Ganga.

## \|\| 38.23 \|\|

*taṃ praṇemuḥ surāḥ sarve mūrdhnā brahmapurogamāḥ \|*  
*bhaktinamrāḥ sāśrunetrāstuṣṭuvuḥ puruṣottamam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Thereafter placing Brahma in the forefront, with their minds filled with devotion and humility, their eyes having bee'n filled with tears all the gods bowed in reverence to lord Vishnu.Thereafter, they started offering prayers to lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 38.24 \|\|

*vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa svayaṃ brahmā kṛtāñjaliḥ \|*  
*rurudurdevatāḥ sarvāḥ svādhikāracyutāśca tāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Brahma then narrated the entire story of lord Vishnu. All the gods were crying aloud having been deprived of their riches.

## \|\| 38.25 \|\|

*sa cāpaśyatsuragaṇaṃ vipadgrastaṃ bhayākulam \|*  
*vastrabhūṣaṇaśūnyaṃ ca vāhanādivivarjitam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The lord looked at he gods who were overpowered by misfortune, terrified and were deprived of the ornaments, costumes and vehicles.

## \|\| 38.26 \|\|

*śobhāśūnyaṃ hataśrīkaṃ parivārairanāvṛtam \|*  
*uvāca kātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā vipannabhayabhañjanaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. They had lost the grace and were surprised at having been deprived of their families. They were desperate and took refuge under the lord. Finding them in such a miserable condition the lord spoke.

## \|\| 38.27-28 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*mā bhairbrahmanhe surāśca bhayaṃ kiṃ vo mayi sthite \|*  
*dāsyāmi lakṣmīmacalāṃ paramaiśvaryavarddhinīm \|\| 27 \|\|*

*kiñca madvacanaṃ kiñcicchrūyatāṃ samayocitam \|*  
*hitaṃ satyaṃ sārabhūtaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Narayana said — О Brahman and other gods, don't be afraid. Why should you worry when I am there? I shall bestow the imperishable Lakshmi which will increase your riches but before doing so you just listen to what I have to say. These words will be beneficial, truthful and will provide welfare to you in future according to the time.

## \|\| 38.29 \|\|

*janāścāsaṃkhyaviśvasthā madadhīnāśca santatam \|*  
*yathā tathā'haṃ madbhaktaiḥ parādhīnaḥ svatantrakaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. As the innumerable people are living in the universe under me, similarly in spite of my being quite independent I remain under the command of my devotees.

## \|\| 38.30 \|\|

*yo yo ruṣṭo hi madbhakte matpare hi niraṅkuśaḥ \|*  
*tadgṛhe'haṃ na tiṣṭhāmi padmayā saha niścitam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Because of this, it is sure that whosoever gets annoyed with my devotees who always remain engrossed in my devotion, Lakshmi leaves their place.

## \|\| 38.31-32 \|\|

*durvāsāḥ śaṅkarāṃśaśca vaiṣṇavo matparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*tacchāpādāgato'haṃ ca saśrīko vo gṛhādapi \|\| 31 \|\|*

*yatra śaṅkhadhvanirnāsti tulasī ca śilārcanam \|*  
*na bhojanaṃ ca viprāṇāṃ na padmā tatra tiṣṭhati \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Durvasa happens to be a ray of Shiva and is a Vaishnava residing in my place. Because of the curse pronounced by him, I had to leave your place together with Lakshmi.

## \|\| 38.33 \|\|

*madbhaktānāṃ ca me nindā yatra yatra bhavetsurāḥ \|*  
*mahāruṣṭā mahālakṣmīstato yāti parābhavāt \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The place where the conches are not blown, Tulasi and Shalagrama are not adored, the Brahmanas are not served with food, Lakshmi does not stay, О gods, the place where my devotees are denounced, the goddess Lakshmi gets annoyed and because of the humiliation, she leaves that place.

## \|\| 38.34 \|\|

*madbhaktihīno yo mūḍho yo bhuṅkte harivāsare \|*  
*mama janmadine cāpi yāti śrīstadgṛhādapi \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Such of the people as are deprived of my devotion and take food on Ekadas'l day or on my birthday, Lakshmi leaves their abodes.

## \|\| 38.35-37 \|\|

*mannāmavikrayī yaśca vikrīṇāti svakanyakām \|*  
*yatrātithirna bhuṅkte ca matpriyā yāti tadgṛhāt \|\| 35 \|\|*

*pāpināṃ yo gṛhaṃ yāti śūdraśrāddhānnabhojinām \|*  
*mahāruṣṭā tato yāti mandirātkamalālayā \|\| 36 \|\|*

*śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca bhāgyahīnaśca vāḍavaḥ \|*  
*yāti ruṣṭā tadgṛhācca devī kamalavāsinī \|\| 37 \|\|*

35-37. The one who sells away my name or his own daughter, the place where the guests are not served with food, such a place is deserted by Lakshmi. The one who goes to the house of Shudras for consuming the sraddha food, Lakshmi leaves his place. The Brahmana, who bums the bodies of the Shdras, Lakshmi leaves the place of such an unfortunate Brahmana.

## \|\| 38.38 \|\|

*śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāro yo brāhmaṇo vṛṣavāhakaḥ \|*  
*tattoyapānabhītā ca kamalā yāti tadgrahāt \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The one who is the store-keeper of Shudras or works for loading the bullocks, Lakshmi leaves the place of that Brahmana.

## \|\| 38.39-41 \|\|

*vipro yavanasevī ca devalaḥ śūdrayājakaḥ \|*  
*tattoyapānabhītā ca vaiṣṇavī yāti tadgrahāt \|\| 39 \|\|*

*viśvāsaghātī mitraghno naraghātī kṛtaghnakaḥ \|*  
*agamyāṃ yāti yo vipro madbhāryyā yāti tadgṛhāt \|\| 40 \|\|*

*aśuddhahṛdayaḥ kūro hiṃsako nindako dvijaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇyāṃ śūdrajātaśca yāti devī ca tadgrahāt \|\| 41 \|\|*

39-41. The one who takes to the service of the yavanas or the one who is a temple priest or the one who performs yujna for Shudras, such a type of Brahmanas loses the grace of Lakshmi. The one who betrays the faith of others, indulges in the killing of a friend or the killing of a person, the one who is ungrateful or visits the place of a Brahmana whose house is not to be visited, Laks ml leaves that place. The one who has a polluted mind, is cruel, heartless, the one who denounces others or the one who was born from a Brahmana lady having a Shudra husband, Lakshmi leaves that place.

## \|\| 38.42-44 \|\|

*yo vipraḥ puṃścalīputro mahāpāpī ca tatpatiḥ \|*  
*avīrānnaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte tasmādyāti jagatprasūḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*tṛṇaṃ chinatti nakharaistairvā yo hi likhenmahīm \|*  
*jihmo vā malavāsāśca sā prayāti ca tadgrahāt \|\| 43 \|\|*

*sūryyodaye ca dvirbhojī divāśāyī ca vāḍavaḥ \|*  
*divāmaithunakārī ca tasmādyāti haripriyā \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. A Brahmana, who happens to be the son of an unchaste lady or is the husband of an unchaste lady or the one who eats the food a widow, the goddess Lakshmi leaves that place. He who breaks the straw with nail, the diggers of the earth, is deceitful or is clad in dirty clothes, has to lose the grace of Lakshmi. The one who eats twice at dawn, sleeps during the day time or the one who indulges in love-sport during the day, such a Brahmana is deprived of Lakshmi.

## \|\| 38.45-46 \|\|

*ācārahīno yo vipro yaśca śūdrapratigrahī \|*  
*adīkṣito hi yo mūḍhastasmāllolā prayāti ca \|\| 45\|\|*

*snigdhapādaśca nagno vā yaḥ śete jñānadurbalaḥ \|*  
*śaśvaddharmātivācālo yāti vai tadgṛhātsatī \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. Those who receive charity from a Siidra having no character, a Brahmana who is unmindful of the direction, the goddess Lakshmi leaves their place. Such of the people who sleep with the feet rubbed with oil or sleep naked or those who make tall claims about dharma, Laks ml deserts the houses of such people.

## \|\| 38.47-48 \|\|

*śirasnātaśca tailena yo'nyadaṅgamupaspṛśet \|*  
*svāṅge ca vādayedvādyaṃ ramā yāti ca tadgṛhāt \|\| 47 \|\|*

*vratopavāsahīno yaḥ sandhyāhīno'śucirdvijaḥ \|*  
*viṣṇubhaktivihīno yastasmādyāti haripriyā \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. The one who applies oil on his body after taking a bath or the one who beats his body like a drum, Lakshmi leaves that place. A Brahmana, who is deprived of the vratas or fasting and remains unclean or is deprived of the devotion of lord Vishnu, Lakshmi leaves their place.

## \|\| 38.49-50 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaṃ nindayedyo hi tānvai dveṣṭi ca santatam \|*  
*hiṃsākārī dayāhīno yāti sarvaprasūstataḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*yatra tatra harerarcā harerutkīrttanaṃ śubham \|*  
*tatra tiṣṭhati sā devī kamalā sarvamaṅgalā \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. The one who denounces the Brahmanas becoming envious of them or is violent and heartless, the goddess Lakshmi never remains in that place. Wherever the name of the lord is recited or puja is performed, the goddess Lakshmi always remains there.

## \|\| 38.51-52 \|\|

*yatra praśaṃsā kṛṣṇasya tadbhaktasya pitāmaha \|*  
*sā ca kṛṣṇapriyā devī tatra tiṣṭhati santatam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*yatra śaṅkhadhvaniḥ śaṅkhaḥ śilā ca tulasīdalam \|*  
*tatsevā vandanaṃ dhyānaṃ tatra sā tiṣṭhati svayam \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. О grandfather, wherever lord Krishna and his devotees are always praised, the goddess Lakshmi always stays there. Wherever the conch is blown, Shalagrama stone and the leaves of Tulasi are adored, goddess Lakshmi always remains there.

## \|\| 38.53-54 \|\|

*śivaliṅgārcanaṃ yatra tasya cotkīrttanaṃ śubham \|*  
*durgārcanaṃ tadguṇāśca tatra padmanivāsinī \|\| 53\|\|*

*viprāṇāṃ sevanaṃ yatra teṣāṃ vai bhojanaṃ śubham \|*  
*arcanaṃ sarvadevānāṃ tatra padmamukhī satī \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. The place, where the Shivalinga is adored, its glory is recited, the adoration of Durga is performed reciting her glory, the goddess Laks ml, who emerges from the lotus, always remains there. The place where the Brahmanas are respected and served with pure food and the place where the gods are adored, the lotus-faced Lakshmi always remained there.

## \|\| 38.55 \|\|

*ityuktvā ca surānsarvānramāmāha ramāpatiḥ \|*  
*kṣīrodasāgare janma labhasva kalayā rame \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Thus speaking to all the gods lord Vishnu – the husband of Lakshmi – then spoke to her, “O Laks ml, you go and take a birth from the ray of your body in the ocean of milk.”

## \|\| 38.56-57 \|\|

*ityuktvā tāṃ jagannātho brahmāṇaṃ punarāha ca \|*  
*mathitvā sāgaraṃ lakṣmīṃ devebhyo dehi padmaja \|\| 56 \|\|*

*ityuktvā kamalākānto devaścāntaradhānmune \|*  
*devāścireṇa kālena yayuḥ kṣīrodasāgaram \|\| 57\|\|*

56-57. Thus speaking to Lakshmi, the lord then spoke to Brahma: О Brahma, you were born out of the lotus. By churning the ocean restore Lakshmi to the gods. О sage, Vishnu the lord of Kamala, then disappeared and the gods reached the ocean of milk after many days.

## \|\| 38.58-59 \|\|

*manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā kūrmaṃ kṛtvā ca bhājanam \|*  
*rajjuṃ kṛtvā vāsukiṃ ca mamanthuścaiva sāgaram \|\| 58 \|\|*

*dhanvantariṃ ca pīyūṣamuccaiḥśravasamīpsitam \|*  
*nānāratnaṃ hastiratnaṃ prāpurlakṣmyāśca darśanam \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. Reaching there the gods used Mandaracala as a churning rod, made the tortoise as its base and used VasukI as the churning rope. Thereafter they churned the ocean. After churning the ocean the physician Dhanvantrl, the nectar, the pleasant Uccaisrava horse, several types of gems, the elephant Airavata besides Lakshmi emerged from the ocean.

## \|\| 38.60 \|\|

*vanamālāṃ dadau sā ca kṣīrodaśāyine mune \|*  
*sarveśvarāya ramyāya viṣṇave vaiṣṇavī satī \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. О sage, the chaste Vaishnavi placed a garland of flowers around the neck of Vishnu who dwells in the ocean of milk and is quite beautiful.

## \|\| 38.61 \|\|

*devaiḥ stutā pūjitā ca brahmaṇā śaṅkareṇa ca \|*  
*dadau dṛṣṭiṃ suragṛhe brahmaśāpavimocikām \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. The gods prayed to Lakshmi. Brahma and Shiva adored her. Thereafter she bestowed her grace on the gods.

## \|\| 38.62-63 \|\|

*prāpurdevāḥ svaviṣayaṃ daityairgrastaṃ bhayaṅkaraiḥ \|*  
*mahālakṣmīprasādena varadānena nārada \|\| 62 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmyupākhyānamuttamam \|*  
*sukhadaṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. О Narada, by the grace of Maha-Lakshmi and with the boon granted by her, the gods defeated the demons and got back their kingdom. Thus I have narrated the best of the stories of Lakshmi to you which is quite pleasant and is the essence of the world. What more do you want listen to from me. !

## Chapter 39

## \|\| 39.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*harerutkīrttanaṃ bhadraṃ śrutaṃ tajjñānamuttamam \|*  
*īpsitaṃ lakṣmyupākhyānaṃ dhyānaṃ stotrādikaṃ vada \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said — I have listened to the recitation of the name of lord Krishna which bestows welfare besides the best of his knowledge and the story of Lakshmi. Now you kindly enlighten me on his Dhyanam, stotra and other connected details.

## \|\| 39.2-3 \|\|

*hariṇā pūjitā pūrvaṃ tato brahmādibhistathā \|*  
*śakreṇa bhraṣṭarājyena sārddhaṃ suragaṇena ca \|\| 2 \|\|*

*dhyānena pūjitā kena vidhinā kena vā purā \|*  
*kena stutā vā stotreṇa tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. First of all lord Vishnu adored Lakshmi followed by Brahma and Indra who was deprived of his kingdom. Now I would like to know that in the earlier times which one of the gods adored her by which method. What is her stotra or stuti, you kindly speak out to me.

## \|\| 39.4-6 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*snātvā tīrthe purā śakro dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī \|*  
*kṣīrode saṃsthāpya ghaṭaṃ devaṣaṭkamapūjayat \|\| 4 \|\|*

*gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām \|*  
*etānbhaktyā samabhyarcya puṣpagandhādibhistathā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tatrāvāhya mahālakṣmīṃ paramaiśvaryyarūpiṇīm \|*  
*pūjāṃ cakāra deveśo brahmaṇā ca purodhasā \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. Narayana said — In the earlier times, Indra once took a bath in a holy place and clothed himself in pure garments consecrating a vase at the shore of the ocean of milk; he adored all the six deities like Ganesha, Surya, Agni, Vishnu, Shiva and Parvati. He adored all the deities offering flowers and essence with his heart filled with devotion. Thereafter, consecrating a vase, he invoked Maha-Lakshmi the goddess of fortune, adoring her together with Brahma and Brihaspati.

## \|\| 39.7 \|\|

*puraḥ sthiteṣu muniṣu brāhmaṇeṣu gurau tathā \|*  
*devādiṣu ca deveśe jñānānande śive mune \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. O sage, he was accompanied by all the sages, a group of Brahmana, the teacher Brihaspati, all the gods and the all-knowledgeable Shiva.

## \|\| 39.8 \|\|

*pārijātasya puṣpaṃ ca gṛhītvā candanokṣitam \|*  
*dhyātvā devīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ pūjayāmāsa nārada \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О Narada, holding the Parijata flower soaked in sandal-paste, he adored goddess Lakshmi quite attentively.

## \|\| 39.9 \|\|

*dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ yaduktaṃ brahmaṇe purā \|*  
*dhyānena hariṇā tena tannibodha vadāmi te \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. In the earlier times the lord has apprised Brahma of the dhyanam mentioned in the Samaveda, which I am repeating to you.

## \|\| 39.10-14 \|\|

*sahasradalapadmasya karṇikāvāsinīṃ parām \|*  
*śaratpārvaṇakoṭīnduprabhājuṣṭakarāṃ varām \|\| 10 \|\|*

*svatejasā prajvalantīṃ sukhadṛśyāṃ manoharām \|*  
*prataptakāñcananibhāṃ śobhāṃ mūrtimatīṃ satīm \|\| 11 \|\|*

*ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyāṃ śobhitāṃ pītavāsasā \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ ramyāṃ susthirayauvanām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sarvasampatpradātrīṃ ca mahālakṣmīṃ bhaje śubhām \|*  
*dhyānenānena tāṃ dhyātvā copahāraissusaṃyutaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*sampūjya brahmavākyena copahārāṇi ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*dadau bhaktyā vidhānena pratyekaṃ mantrapūrvakam \|\| 14 \|\|*

10-14. The goddess who resides in the lotus of a thousand petals, having the lustre of crores of full moons of the winter season, the best of all, shining with her own lustre, pleasant to look at, quite attractive, having the complexion of molten gold and perfect figure, the chaste lady adorned with all the gem-studded ornaments, clad in yellow garments, wearing a serene smile on his face, extremely beautiful and bestower of all the fortunes who is goddess Maha-Lakshmi, I adore her by offering the presents, reciting this dhyanam. Indra adored her as advised by Brahma. He offered the sixteen presents with his mind filled with devotion and reciting the mantras.

## \|\| 39.15 \|\|

*praśaṃsyāni prahṛṣṭāni durlabhāni varāṇi ca \|*  
*amūlyaratnakhacitaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā \|*  
*āsanaṃ ca vicitraṃ ca mahālakṣmi pragṛhyatām \|\| 15\|\|*

15\. О Maha-Lakshmi, I offer to you the gem-studded seat which is difficult to get and is the best of the presents and is studded with valuable gems.

## \|\| 39.16 \|\|

*śuddhaṃ gaṅgodakamidaṃ sarvavanditamīpsitam \|*  
*pāpedhmavahnirūpaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ kamalālaye \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. О dweller in the abode of lotus, I offer you the water of Ganga which is quite sacred and serves as a burning wood for the destruction of sins.

## \|\| 39.17 \|\|

*puṣpacandanadūrvādisaṃyutaṃ jāhnavījalam \|*  
*śaṅkhagarbhasthitaṃ śuddhaṃ gṛhyatāṃ padmavāsini \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. О dweller of the lotus, you please accept the flowers, the sandal-paste, Dhrva-grass dipped in waters of Ganga which is quite sacred and emerged from the womb of a conch.

## \|\| 39.18 \|\|

*sugandhiyuktatailaṃ ca sugandhāmalakījalam \|*  
*dehasaundaryyabījaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ śrīharipriye \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О beloved of lord Hari, I offer you the perfumed oil, the fragrant water of Myrobalan, which increases the beauty of the body; you kindly accept it.

## \|\| 39.19 \|\|

*vṛkṣaniryāsarūpaṃ ca gandhadravyādisaṃyutam \|*  
*kṛṣṇakānte pavitro vai dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. О beloved of Krishna, I offer the essence made of the gum of the tree and other fragrant articles; you kindly accept it.

## \|\| 39.20 \|\|

*malayācalasaṃbhūtaṃ vṛkṣasāraṃ manoharam \|*  
*sugandhiyuktaṃ sukhadaṃ candanaṃ devi gṛhyatām \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О goddess, you kindly accept the sandal-wood which is grown in Malayacala, is the best of the trees, is quite pleasant and fragrant and bestows pleasure.

## \|\| 39.21-22 \|\|

*jagaccakṣussvarūpaṃ ca dhvāntapradhvaṃsakāraṇam \|*  
*pradīpaṃ śuddharūpaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ parameśvari \|\| 21 \|\|*

*nānopahārarūpaṃ ca nānārasasamanvitam \|*  
*nānāsvādukaraṃ caiva naivedyaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. O great goddess, you accept this pure lamp which represents the eyes of the universe and removes darkness. You please accept this naivedya of various flavours, which is in the many forms of rewards and much delighted in its taste.

## \|\| 39.23-24 \|\|

*annaṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ ca prāṇarakṣaṇakāraṇam \|*  
*tuṣṭidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ cānnaṃ madhuraṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 23 \|\|*

*śālyakṣatasupakvaṃ ca śarkarāgavyasaṃyutam \|*  
*susvādu ramyaṃ padme ca paramānnaṃ pragṛhyatām \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. You accept this sweet food which is the form of Brahma and provides nourishment besides protection of the body. О born of lotus, you accept the payasam which is quite pleasant and is made of milk and rice besides sugar.

## \|\| 39.25 \|\|

*śarkarāgavyapakvaṃ ca susvādu sumanoharam \|*  
*mayā niveditaṃ lakṣmi svastikaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. O goddess Lakshmi, I offer you Svastika food, which you kindly accept, which is quite tasteful and is made of sugar and cow's milk.

## \|\| 39.26-27 \|\|

*nānāvidhāni ramyāṇi pakvāni ca phalāni tu \|*  
*svādurasyāni kamale gṛhyantāṃ phaladāni ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

*surabhistanasambhūtaṃ susvādu sumanoharam \|*  
*martyāmṛtaṃ ca gavyaṃ vai gṛhyatāmacyutapriye \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. О Kamala I offer you various types of beautiful, ripe tasty fruits which you kindly accept. О beloved of Acyuta, I offer you cow's milk, which has been extracted from the udder of the cow, is quite tasteful and serves like nectar on the earth.

## \|\| 39.28 \|\|

*susvādurasasaṃyuktamikṣuvṛkṣarasodbhavam \|*  
*agnipakvamapakvaṃ vā guḍaṃ vai devi gṛhyatām \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О goddess, you accept the guda (sugar-cane balls) which is boiled or unboiled, but is quite tasteful and delicious.

## \|\| 39.29 \|\|

*yavagodhūmasasyānāṃ cūrṇareṇusamudbhavam \|*  
*supakvaguḍagavyāktaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ devi gṛhyatām \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. О goddess, I offer you the powder of barley, wheat and rice which has been very well fried in the ghee made of cow's milk and the guda. This sweet is quite tasteful and you kindly accept it.

## \|\| 39.30 \|\|

*sasyacūrṇodbhavaṃ pakvaṃ svastikādisamanvitam \|*  
*mayā niveditaṃ devi piṣṭakaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. О goddess, I offer you the Svastika made of the powdered rice fried in ghee; you kindly accept it.

## \|\| 39.31 \|\|

*pārthivaṃ vṛkṣabhedaṃ ca vividhairdravyakārakam \|*  
*susvādu rasasaṃyuktamaikṣavaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. You accept the sugar-cane which is the for making many of the sweets and is filled with enough of juice.

## \|\| 39.32 \|\|

*śītavāyupradaṃ caiva dāhe ca sukhadaṃ param \|*  
*kamale gṛhyatāṃ cedaṃ vyajanaṃ śvetacāmaram \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. O Kamala, you accept this fan which is like a white fly-whisk, provides cool air during the summer and is quite comfortable.

## \|\| 39.33-34 \|\|

*tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam \|*  
*jihvājāḍyacchedakaraṃ tāmbūlaṃ devi gṛhyatām \|\| 33 \|\|*

*suvāsitaṃ śītalaṃ ca pipāsānāśakāraṇam \|*  
*jagajjīvanarūpaṃ ca jīvanaṃ devi gṛhyatām \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. О goddess of lord Krishna, you accept this sipping water which belongs to the sacred place, is quite auspicious and purifies everything. You accept this bed which is filled with flowers and sandal-paste and is adorned with gem-studded ornaments.

## \|\| 39.35-36 \|\|

*dehasaundaryyabījaṃ ca sadā śobhāvivarddhanam \|*  
*kārpāsajaṃ ca kṛmijaṃ vasanaṃ devi gṛhyatām \|\| 35 \|\|*

*ratnasvarṇavikāraṃ ca dehasaukhyavivarddhanam \|*  
*śobhādhānaṃ śrīkaraṃ ca bhūṣaṇaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. О goddess, you accept the best of the betels which contains camphor and is quite tasteful being fragrant. О goddess, you accept the scented water, enriches coolness and removes thirst and is the life of the universe. You kindly accept it.

## \|\| 39.37-38 \|\|

*nānākusumasandarbhaṃ bahuśobhāpradaṃ param \|*  
*suralokapriyaṃ śuddhaṃ mālyaṃ devi pragṛhyatām \|\| 37 \|\|*

*śuddhidaṃ śuddhirūpaṃ ca sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam \|*  
*gandhavastūdbhavaṃ ramyaṃ gandhaṃ devi pragṛhyatām \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. O goddess, you accept the cloth made of cotton as well as silk which increases the beauty of the body; you accept the ornaments made of gold and gems which increases the beauty of the body.

## \|\| 39.39-40 \|\|

*puṇyatīrthodakaṃ caiva viśuddhaṃ śuddhidaṃ sadā \|*  
*gṛhāṇa kṛṣṇakānte tvaṃ ramyamācamanīyakam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*ratnasāraissaṃgrathitaṃ puṣpacandanasaṃyutam \|*  
*ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyaṃ sutalpaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. O goddess, you accept the garland of fragrant flowers, which is quite sacred. О goddess, you accept this essence which is pure, sacred and provides welfare to all and has been extracted from fragrant things.

## \|\| 39.41-42 \|\|

*yadyaddravyamapūrvaṃ ca pṛthivyāmasti durlabham \|*  
*devabhūṣāḍhyabhogyaṃ ca taddravyaṃ devi gṛhyatām \|\| 41 \|\|*

*dravyāṇyetāni dattvā vai mūlena devapuṃgava \|*  
*mūlaṃ jajāpa bhaktyā ca daśalakṣaṃ vidhānataḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. O goddess, you accept the articles offered by me which are quite difficult to get on earth and which are used by the kings and the gods. Thus Indra offered the various articles to the goddess reciting the basic mantra with great devotion. Thereafter he recited the basic-mantra for ten lakh times.

## \|\| 39.43 \|\|

*japena daśalakṣeṇa mantrasiddhirbabhūva ha \|*  
*mantraśca brahmaṇā dattaḥ kalpavṛkṣaśca sarvadā \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. After performing japam for ten lakhs times, Indra met with success. Thus Brahma gave away the mantra as well as the kalpavrksa for all times to come.

## \|\| 39.44-52 \|\|

*lakṣmīrmāyā kāmavāṇī tataḥ kamalavāsinī \|*  
*svāhānto vaidiko mantrarājo'yaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ aiṃ kamalavāsinyai svāhā \|*  
*kubero'nena mantreṇa sarvaiśvaryamavāptavān \|\| 45\|\|*

*rājarājeśvaro dakṣaḥ sāvarṇirmanureva ca \|*  
*maṃgalo'nena mantreṇa saptadvīpavatīpatiḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*priyavratottānapādau kedāro nṛpa eva ca \|*  
*ete ca siddhā rājendrā mantreṇānena nārada \|\| 47 \|\|*

*siddhe mantre mahālakṣmīrdadau śakrāya darśanam \|*  
*ratnendravyūhakhacitavimānasthā varapradā \|\| 48 \|\|*

*saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ chādayantī tviṣā ca sā \|*  
*śvetacampakavarṇābhā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā\|\| 49 \|\|*

*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā bhaktānugrahakārikā \|*  
*bibhratī ratnamālāṃ ca koṭi candrasamaprabhā \|\| 50 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā jagatprasūṃ śāntāṃ tāṃ tuṣṭāva purandaraḥ \|*  
*pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetraḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*brahmaṇā ca pradattena stotrarājena saṃyataḥ \|*  
*sarvābhīṣṭapradenaiva vaidikenaiva tatra ca \|\| 52 \|\|*

44-52. The ten letter mantra becomes the chief of the mantras with the addition of Lakshmi, Maya, KamavanI and Kamalavasa besides the word svaha as a suffix – ‘ яТ iff 4#' "if qiHcidiRi'^ 7=ЩТ’ Kubera had achieved all the riches by reciting all these mantras and he became the lord of all the riches. Daksha, Savarni also became Manu by reciting the same and Mangala because of the same became the lord of the seven continents on earth. О Narada, Priyavrata, Uttanapada and Kedamatha besides several others gained success by the reciting of the mantra. When Indra met with success with the reciting of this mantra, Lakshmi appeared before him who was mounted on a throne studded with heaps of gems, bestowed the boons and her lustre pervaded the entire universe. She had the lustre of the white lotus flowers and the glory of her body was increasing with the gem-studded ornaments worn by her. She was wearing a serene smile on her face. She was always graceful to her devotees and wore the garland of gems having the lustre of crores of full moons. Thus the peaceful Laks ml who happens to be the mother of the universe was adored by the gods with their minds filled with emotions, the eyes filled with tears and they offered prayers with folded hands reciting the stotra given to them for Brahma.

## \|\| 39.53 \|\|

*indra uvāca \|*  
*oṃ namaḥ kamalavāsinyai nārāyaṇyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇapriyāyai sārāyai padmāyai ca namo namaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Indra said — I bow in reverence to the goddess who resides in the lotus, the one who is NarayanI I bow to her. She is the beloved of lord Krishna and is also called Padma. I bow to her again and again.

## \|\| 39.54-55 \|\|

*padmapatrekṣaṇāyai ca padmāsyāyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*padmāsanāyai padminyai vaiṣṇavyai ca namo namaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*sarvasampatsvarūpāyai sarvadātryai namo namaḥ \|*  
*sukhadāyai mokṣadāyai siddhidāyai namo namaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. She has the eyes resembling the lotus leaf, besides having the lotus-like face I bow in reverence to her. She uses lotus at her feet and in Vaishnavl having the lotus-like eyes. I bow in reverence to her. She provides welfare, salvation and success. I bow in reverence to her again and again.

## \|\| 39.56 \|\|

*haribhaktipradātryai ca harṣadātryai namo namaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇavakṣasthitāyai ca kṛṣṇeśāyai namo namaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. She bestows the devotion of the lord besides the pleasures. She always resides in the heart of lord Krishna, I bow in reverence to the beloved of Krishna.

## \|\| 39.57-58 \|\|

*kṛṣṇaśobhāsvarū pāyai ratnāḍhyāyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*sampattyadhiṣṭhātṛdevyai mahādevyai namo namaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*sasyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai ca sasyalakṣmyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*namo buddhisvarūpāyai buddhidāyai namo namaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. She is the glory of lord Krishna and I bow to the goddf^S who is adorned with all the ornaments studdecf with gems. I bow in reverence to the one who is the chief goddess of all the riches and is intelligent.

## \|\| 39.59-61 \|\|

*vaikuṇṭhe ca mahālakṣmīrlakṣmīḥ kṣīrodasāgare \|*  
*svargalakṣmīrindragehe rājalakṣmīrnṛpālaye \|\| 59 \|\|*

*gṛhalakṣmīśca gṛhiṇāṃ gehe ca gṛhadevatā \|*  
*surabhissā gavāṃ mātā dakṣiṇā yajñakāminī \|\| 60 \|\|*

*aditirdevamātā tvaṃ kamalā kamalālaye \|*  
*svāhā tvaṃ ca havirdāne kavyadāne svadhā smṛtā \|\| 61 \|\|*

59-61. You are Maha-Lakshmi in Vaikuntha, Lakshmi in the ocean of milk, SvargaiaksmI in the house of Indra, Raja-Lakshmi in royal places, GrhaLakshmi in the houses of the householders. You are the deity of the houses, you are Surabhl the mother of the cows, daksina the spouse of yajna, Aditi the mother of the gods and are the lotus among the lotuses. You are Svaha for those who perform yajna and also Svadha who offer Kavya.

## \|\| 39.62-63 \|\|

*tvaṃ hi viṣṇusvarūpā ca sarvādhārā vasundharā \|*  
*śuddhasattvasvarūpā tvaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā \|\| 62 \|\|*

*krodhahiṃsāvarjitā ca varadā ca śubhānanā \|*  
*paramārthapradā tvaṃ ca haridāsyapradā parā \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. You are the fonn of Vishnu, the ways of everything earning the name of Vasundhara. You possess the purified form and always remain devoted to Narayana. You are free from anger, violence and are the bestower of boons: You are pleasant-faced, bestower of Parmartha and bestow the devotion of lord Hari.

## \|\| 39.64 \|\|

*yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ bhasmībhūtamasārakam \|*  
*jīvanmṛtaṃ ca viśvaṃ ca śavatulyaṃ yayā vinā \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Without you the entire universe looks like dust or without essence, without you the entire universe seems dead in spite of remaining alike.

## \|\| 39.65-66 \|\|

*sarveṣāṃ ca parā tvaṃ hi sarvabāndhavarūpiṇī \|*  
*yayā vinā na saṃbhāṣyo bāndhavairbāndhavaḥ sadā \|\| 65 \|\|*

*tvayā hīno bandhuhīnastvayā yuktaḥ sabāndhavaḥ \|*  
*dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ tvaṃ ca kāraṇarūpiṇī \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. You are the best of all and are like all the relatives. Without you even the brothers do not remain on talking terms. A person who is deprived of you, is deserted by all the brothers and relatives but the one on whom you shower your grace, always remains surrounded by his brothers. This way you happen to be the granter of dharma, artha, Imma and moksa.

## \|\| 39.67 \|\|

*stanandhayānāṃ tvaṃ mātā śiśūnāṃ śaiśave yathā \|*  
*tathā tvaṃ sarvadā mātā sarveṣāṃ sarvaviśvataḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. You happen to be the mother of the entire universe like the infant suckling the milk of its mother.

## \|\| 39.68-69 \|\|

*tyaktastano mātṛhīnaḥ sa cejjīvati daivataḥ \|*  
*tvayā hīno janaḥ ko'pi na jīvatyeva niścitam \|\| 68 \|\|*

*suprasannasvarūpā tvaṃ me prasannā bhavāmbike \|*  
*vairigrahastadviṣayaṃ dehi mahyaṃ sanātani \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. An infant can survive in case he is deprived of the suckling of its mother breasts or it can survive even without its mother, by the move of destiny, but without you no one can survive even for a moment. Therefore as a mother, you be pleased with me since you always remain happy. О eternal one, you restore my riches to me which have been usurped by my enemies.

## \|\| 39.70 \|\|

*vayaṃ yāvattvayā hīnā bandhuhīnāśca bhikṣukāḥ \|*  
*sarvasaṃpadvihīnāśca tāvadeva haripriye \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Beloved of Hari, till such time we are deprived of your grace, till such time we shall be deprived of our relatives, besides the riches and the fortune.

## \|\| 39.71 \|\|

*rājyaṃ dehi śriyaṃ dehi balaṃ dehi sureśvari \|*  
*kīrtiṃ dehi dhanaṃ dehi putrānmahyaṃ ca dehi vai \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Therefore, О goddess, you restore our kingdom to us with all the fortune, glory, riches and also get me the son.

## \|\| 39.72 \|\|

*kāmaṃ dehi matiṃ dehi bhogāndehi haripriye \|*  
*jñānaṃ dehi ca dharmaṃ ca sarvasaubhāgyamīpsitam \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. О beloved of Hari, you fulfil our desire and bestow intelligence on us, make us enjoy all the pleasures and bestow intelligence on us fulfilling all our desires.

## \|\| 39.73-74 \|\|

*sarvādhikāramevaṃ vai prabhāvaṃ ca pratāpakam \|*  
*jayaṃ parākramaṃ yuddhe paramaiśvaryyameva ca \|\| 73 \|\|*

*ityuktvā tu mahendraśca sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*nanāma sāśrunetro'yaṃ mūrdhnā caiva punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

73-74. Therefore, restore all our rights, influence, glory and all the riches lost by us in the war. Thus speaking, tears started flowing from the eyes of Indra and he bowed in reverence to her again and again.

## \|\| 39.75 \|\|

*brahmā ca śaṃkaraścaiva śeṣo dharmaśca keśavaḥ \|*  
*sarve cakruḥ parīhāraṃ surārthe ca punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Brahma, Shiva, Shesha, Yama and Kesava besides other gods begged forgiveness again and again.

## \|\| 39.76-77 \|\|

*devebhyaśca varaṃ dattvā puṣpamālāṃ manoharām \|*  
*keśavāya dadau lakṣmīḥ santuṣṭā surasaṃsadi \|\| 76 \|\|*

*yayurdevāśca santuṣṭāḥ svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ ca nārada \|*  
*devī yayau hareḥ kroḍaṃ hṛṣṭā kṣīrodaśāyinaḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. Lakshmi then got pleased and showered her grace on the gods granting a garland of flowers to Keshava.

## \|\| 39.78 \|\|

*yayatustau svasvagṛhaṃ brahmeśānau ca nārada \|*  
*dattvā śubhāśiṣaṃ tau ca devebhyaḥ prītipūrvakam \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. Delighted, the gods went back to their respective places and Lakshmi at the same time went to her abode in the ocean of milk and enjoyed the comforts in the lap of her husband.

## \|\| 39.79 \|\|

*idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ \|*  
*kuberatulyaḥ sa bhavedrājarājeśvaro mahān \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. О Narada, both Brahma and Shiva granted pleasant boons to the god and went to their respective places. The one who recites this stotra three times during the morning, noon and evening, becomes great like Kubera, the goo of riches.

## \|\| 39.80 \|\|

*siddhastotraṃ yadi paṭhetso'pi kalpatarurnaraḥ \|*  
*pañcalakṣa japenaiva stotrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Narada said — О lord, you had already told me that he on whose head on which the flower would fall, would adored him first and foremost of all. The same flower was placed on the head of the elephant by Indra as a result of which Ganesha was born. Thereafter, that elephant getting intoxicated went to the dense forest. In earlier times, because of the side glance of Sani, the head of Ganapati was severed, after which the lord joined the elephant's head on to the trunk of Ganapati. Now it is said that Indra had adored the six deities in the ocean of milk and thereafter he adored Lakshmi. О best of those well-versed in the Vedas, because of this the details in the Puranas are difficult to be understood by the people; therefore you kindly clarify this point.

## \|\| 39.81 \|\|

*siddhiḥstotraṃ yadi paṭhenmāsamekaṃ ca saṃyataḥ \|*  
*mahāsukhī ca rājendro bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. In case a person recites it with devotion he will become like a kalpavrksa; the one who performs five lakhs of times the japam of the stotra. he meets with success.

## \|\| 39.82-86 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*puṣpaṃ durvāsasā dattamasti vai yasya mastake \|*  
*tasya sarvā puraḥpūjetyuktaṃ pūrvaṃ tvayā prabho \|\| 82 \|\|*

*tadeva sthāpitaṃ puṣpaṃ gajendrasyaiva mastake \|*  
*yato janma gaṇeśasya sa ca matto vanaṃ gataḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*mūrdhni cchinne gaṇapateḥ śanerdṛṣṭyā purā mune \|*  
*tatskandhe yojayāmāsa hastimastaṃ hariḥ svayam \|\| 84 \|\|*

*adhunoktaṃ devaṣaṭkaṃ saṃpūjya ca purandaraḥ \|*  
*pūjayāmāsa lakṣmīṃ ca kṣīrode ca suraiḥ saha \|\| 85 \|\|*

*aho purāṇavaktṝṇāṃ durbodhaṃ vacanaṃ nṛṇām \|*  
*suvyaktamasya siddhāntaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara \|\| 86 \|\|*

82-86. In case one recites this siddha-stotra for a month, he becomes a great king. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 39.87-88 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*yadā śaśāpa śakraṃ ca durvāsā munipuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*tadā nāstyeva tajjanma pūjākāle babhūva saḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

*suciraṃ duḥkhitā devā babhramurbrahmaśāpataḥ \|*  
*paścātprāpuśca tāṃ lakṣmīṃ vareṇa ca harermune \|\| 88 \|\|*

87-88. Narayana said — When the sage Durvasa pronounced the curse on Indra, Ganesha was not born at that time. He was born while performing the pitja. О sage because of that curse, the gods were wandering here and there with a painful heart. Thereafter-they got back Lakshmi, because of the blessings of the lord.

## Chapter 40

## \|\| 40.1-3 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*nārāyaṇa mahābhāga samaścaiva tvayā prabho \|*  
*rūpeṇa ca guṇaiścaiva yaśasā tejasā tviṣā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tvameva jñānināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ siddhānāṃ yogināṃ tathā \|*  
*tapasvināṃ munīnāṃ ca paro vedavidāṃ tathā \|*  
*mahālakṣmyā upākhyānaṃ vijñātaṃ mahadadbhutam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*anyatkiñcidupākhyānaṃ nigūḍhaṃ vada sāmpratam \|*  
*atīva gopanīyaṃ yadupayuktaṃ ca sarvataḥ \|*  
*aprakāśyaṃ purāṇeṣu vedoktaṃ dharmasaṃyutam \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Narada said: – O Narayana, О Mahabhaga, О lord, no one is comparable to you in beauty, quality, glory, tejas and lustre. You are the best of all the intellectuals, siddhas, yogis, mendicants the sages and the best of the people well-versed in the Vedas. I have listened with great devotion, to the auspicious story of Maha-Lakshmi as told by you. Now you kindly tell me some other deep story which may be quite secret, beneficial to all as told in the Puranas, with the background of the Vedas and is quite religious.

## \|\| 40.4 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*nānāprakāramākhyānamaprakāśyaṃ purāṇataḥ \|*  
*śrutau katividhaṃ gūḍhamāste brahmansudurlabham \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Narayana said — О Brahma, there are several types of stories brought out in the Puranas. The Vedas also contain several such secret stories which are difficult of access for all.

## \|\| 40.5 \|\|

*teṣu yatsārabhūtaṃ ca śrotuṃ kiṃvā tvamicchasi \|*  
*tanme brūhi mahābhāga paścādvakṣyāmi tatpunaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Out of these stories you intend to listen to those which happen to be the essence. Which one of them would you like to listen to? I shall surely speak out the same.

## \|\| 40.6-7 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*svāhā devahavirdāne praśastā sarvakarmasu \|*  
*pitṛdāne svadhā śastā dakṣiṇā sarvato varā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*etāsāṃ caritaṃ janma phalaṃ prādhānyameva ca \|*  
*śrotumicchāmi te vaktrādvada vedavidāṃ vara \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Narada said — In all these religious deeds relating to the goddesses, Svaha is considered to be the most important one, besides the performing of charity and home. For the rites which are to be performed in favour of the manes, Svadha happens to be the foremost but the glory of daksina is considered to be the best. Therefore, you kindly let me know the story of each one of them including their birth, the merit one derives from their adoration. I would like to listen to the same from your mouth since you are the best of those who are well-versed in the Vedas. Therefore you kindly tell me the same.

## \|\| 40.8 \|\|

*sautiruvāca \|*  
*nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya munipuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*kathāṃ kathitumārebhe purāṇoktāṃ purātanīm \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Sauti said — On hearing the words of Narada, Narayana the best of the sages, smiled for a moment and then started narrating the old stories of the Puranas.

## \|\| 40.9-10 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*sṛṣṭeḥ prathamato devāścāhārārthaṃ yayuḥ purā \|*  
*brahmaloke brahmasabhāmagamyāṃ sumanoharām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*gatvā nivedanaṃ cakrurmune tvāhārahetukam \|*  
*brahmā śrutvā pratijñāya siṣeve śrīhareḥ padam \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Narayana said — In the earlier times, the gods while searching for food reached Brahmaloka which is difficult to reach by others and is quite pleasant. О sage, reaching there, the gods prayed to Brahma for their food. Brahma listening to their request promised to fulfil their desire and started adoring at the feet of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 40.11-12 \|\|

*yajñarūpo hi bhagavānkalayā ca babhūva saḥ \|*  
*yajñe yadyaddhavirdānaṃ dattaṃ tebhyaśca vedhasā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*havirdadati viprāśca bhaktyā ca kṣatriyādayaḥ \|*  
*surā naiva prāpnuvanti taddānaṃ munipuṃgava \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Lord Vishnu then appeared in one of his rays as yajna. Whatever offerings were made in the yajna, Brahma did everything for the sake of the gods. О best of the sages in the yajna, all the Brahmanas and Ksatrlyas made all the offerings with devotion, but the same could not reach the gods.

## \|\| 40.13 \|\|

*devā viṣaṇṇāste sarve tatsabhāṃ ca punaryayuḥ \|*  
*gatvā nivedanaṃ cakrurāhārābhāvahetukam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Feeling disturbed in their minds, the gods again went to Brahma and enquired of him about the reason for their not getting the food.

## \|\| 40.14 \|\|

*brahmā śrutvā tu manasā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau \|*  
*prakṛtiṃ pūjayāmāsa dhyāyanneva tadājñayā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Brahma then listened to their words and devoting his mind towards lord Krishna adored his Prakriti.

## \|\| 40.15 \|\|

*prakṛtiḥ kalayā caiva sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī \|*  
*babhūva dāhikā śaktiragneḥ svāhāsvarūpiṇī \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Thereafter taking to the fonn of the supreme salcti, the same Prakriti with one of her rays turned herself into the form of fire flames and was then called herself as Svaha.

## \|\| 40.16 \|\|

*grīṣmamadhyāhnamārttaṇḍa prabhānyakkārakāriṇī \|*  
*atīva sundarī rāmā ramaṇīyā manoharā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. She was putting to shame the lustre of the sun of the mid-day during the summer season. She thus possessed a charming, attractive and beautiful figure.

## \|\| 40.17 \|\|

*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā bhaktānugrahakāriṇī \|*  
*uvāceti vidheragre padmayone varaṃ vṛṇu \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Wearing a serene smile on her face, she showered her blessing on her devotees. Moving towards Brahma she said to him, “O born of the lotus, you ask for a boon.”

## \|\| 40.18-19 \|\|

*vidhistadvacanaṃ śrutvā sambhramātsamuvāca tām \|\| 18 \|\|*

*brahmovāca \|*  
*tvamagnerdāhikā śaktirbhava patnī ca sundarī \|*  
*dagdhuṃ na śaktassvahutaṃ hutāśaśca tvayā vinā \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. On hearing her words Brahma became nervous and started speaking to her. Brahma said — You become the spouse of god Agni as his burning instinct, possessing all the beauties. Because without you the god of fire is unable to burn anything dropped in the fire.

## \|\| 40.20 \|\|

*tvannāmoccāryya mantrānte yaddāsyati havirnaraḥ \|*  
*surebhyastatprāpnuvanti surāḥ sānandapūrvakam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. By reciting your name after all the mantras, whatever offerings are made in the fire will delightfully reach the gods.

## \|\| 40.21 \|\|

*agneḥ sampatsvarūpā ca śrīrūpā ca gṛheśvarī \|*  
*devānāṃ pūjitā śaśvannarādīnāṃ bhavāmbike \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. O mother, you are the riches of Agni, the torm of glory, the treasure of the house and will be adored by the gods and the humans for all times to come.

## \|\| 40.22 \|\|
