*brahmaṇaśca vacaḥ śrutvā sā viṣaṇṇā babhūva ha \|*  
*tamuvāca svayaṃ devī svābhiprāyaṃ svayambhuvam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Thus hearing the words of Brahma, the goddess was upset in her mind and she expressed her feelings to Brahma thus.

## \|\| 40.23 \|\|

*svāhovāca \|*  
*ahaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhajiṣyāmi tapasā sucireṇa ca \|*  
*brahmaṃstadanyadyatkiṃcitsvapnavadbhrama eva ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Svaha said — О Brahman, I shall achieve lord Krishna after performing tapas for a long time and shall adore him always because nothing is beyond him and whatever there it is like a dream.

## \|\| 40.24 \|\|

*vidhātā jagatāṃ tvaṃ ca śambhurmṛtyuñjayaḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*bibharti śeṣo viśvaṃ ca dharmmaḥ sākṣī ca dehinām \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. By whose grace you happen to be the creator of the universe Shiva has been victorious over the death, Shesha preserves the universe and Dharma stands as the witness to all.

## \|\| 40.25 \|\|

*sarvādyapūjyo devānāṃ gaṇeṣu ca gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*prakṛtiḥ sarvasūḥ sarve pūjitā yatprasādataḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Ganesha happens to be adorable by all and became the leader of the gartas by whose grace Prakriti emerged and was adored by all.

## \|\| 40.26 \|\|

*ṛṣayo munayaścaiva pūjitā yaṃ niṣevya ca \|*  
*tatpādapadmaṃ brahmaikyabhāvādvai cintayāmyaham \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. And by serving him all the sages and mendicants became graceful, I always adore at the lotus-like feet of the same lord.

## \|\| 40.27-28 \|\|

*padmāsyā pādmamityuktvā padmalābhānusārataḥ \|*  
*jagāma tapase pādme padmādīśasya padmajā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*tapastepe lakṣavarṣamekapādena pādmajā \|*  
*tadā dadarśa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Thus speaking to Brahma, who was born out of lotus, Svaha moved towards the tank of lotus flowers and seated on a lotus she started performing tapas. Svaha performed tapas there fore a lakh of years standing on one leg. After this period she had an audience with lord Krishna who is beyond Prakriti.

## \|\| 40.29 \|\|

*atīva kamanīyaṃ ca rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca sundarī \|*  
*mūrchāṃ samprāpa kāmena kāmeśasya ca kāmukī \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The beautiful damsel casting a glance on the immensely beautiful lord Krishna became passionate and fainted.

## \|\| 40.30 \|\|

*vijñāya tadabhiprāyaṃ sarvajñastāmuvāca saḥ \|*  
*svakroḍe ca samutthāpya kṣīṇāṃgīṃ tapasā ciram \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. But the all-knowledgeable lord Krishna could understand her desire and he took her injjphis lap who had grown quite lean and thin bwause of performing tapas and said to her.

## \|\| 40.31-44 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*vārāhe ca tvamaṃśena mama patnī bhaviṣyasi \|*  
*nāmnā nāgnajitī kanyā kānte nagnajitasya ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

*adhunā'gnerdāhikā tvaṃ bhava patnī ca bhāvini \|*  
*mantrāṅgarūpā pūtā ca matprasādādbhaviṣyasi \|\| 32 \|\|*

*vahnistvāṃ bhaktibhāvena sampūjya ca gṛheśvarīm \|*  
*ramiṣyate tvayā sārddhaṃ rāmayā ramaṇīyayā \|\| 33 \|\|*

*ityuktvā'ntardadhe devo devīmāśvāsya nārada \|*  
*tatrājagāma santrasto vahnirbrahmanideśataḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*dhyānaiśca sāmavedoktairdhyātvā tāṃ jagadambikām \|*  
*sampūjya parituṣṭāva pāṇiṃ jagrāha mantrataḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*tadā divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ sa reme rāmayā saha \|*  
*atīva nirjane ramye sambhogasukhade sadā \|\| 36 \|\|*

*babhūva garbhaṃ tasyāśca hutāśasyaiva tejasā \|*  
*taddadhāra ca sā devī divyaṃ dvādaśavatsaram \|\| 37 \|\|*

*tataḥ suṣāva putrāṃśca ramaṇīyānmanoharān \|*  
*dakṣiṇāgnirgārhapatyāhavanīyānkrameṇa ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

*ṛṣayo munayaścaiva brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyādayaḥ \|*  
*svāhāntaṃ mantramuccāryya havirdadati nityaśaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*svāhāyuktaṃ ca mantraṃ ca yo gṛhṇāti praśastakam \|*  
*sarvasiddhirbhavettasya brahmangrahaṇamātrataḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*viṣahīno yathā sarpo vedahīno yathā dvijaḥ \|*  
*patisevāvihīnā strī vidyāhīno yathā naraḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*phalaśākhāvihīnaśca yathā vṛkṣo hi ninditaḥ \|*  
*svāhāhīnastathā mantro na drutaṃ phaladāyakaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*parituṣṭā dvijāḥ sarve devāḥ saṃprāpurāhutim \|*  
*svāhāntenaiva mantreṇa saphalaṃ sarvakarma ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ varṇitaṃ sarvaṃ svāhopākhyānamuttamam \|*  
*sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ ki bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 44 \|\|*

31-44. Shri Krishna said: “O damsel during the time of the incarnation of Varaha you wolild be born of my ray in the house of the king Nagnajita as a daughter named NagnajitI and become my spouse. О beautiful one, currently you become the wife of Agni and take to burning. With my grace you will always form part of the mantras and also remain sanctified. The fire god taking you as his wife will adore you with devotion and shall always remain with you pleasantly. О Narada, Lord Narayana thus speaking to her, disappeared from the scene and with the permission of Brahma, the god Agni getting terrified reached there. With the recitation of Samaveda, dhyanam the fire god adored the mother of the universe offering prayers to her. Thereafter reciting the mantras, he received her hand. Thereafter, proceeding to a pleasant and secluded place which was most suited for the physical union, he enjoyed her company for a divine hundred years. She was then conceived with the tejas of the god of fire and the conception remained intact for twelve years. Thereafter three sons named Daksinagni, Garhapatya and Ahavanlya were born who were quite beautiful. Thus all the sages, the mendicants, Brahmanas, started mantras with the suffix of Svaha while performing the yajnas. О Brahmana, whosoever recites a mantra with the suffix of Svaha, meets with success with the mere recitation of the same. As a serpent without poison, a Brahmana without the knowledge of the Vedas, a woman deprived of the serving of her husband, a person without the learnings, a tree without the branches and the fruits, are deplorable; similarly the mantra without Svaha is of no consequence. Thus all the Brahmanas felt satisfied with the recitation of the mantras suffixed with Svaha. All the gods started receiving the offerings and all their deeds met with success. Thus I have narrated to you the story of Svaha, which you have heard, which is quite pleasant and provides pleasure and salvation. What else do you want to listen to from me?

## \|\| 40.45 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*svāhāpūjāvidhānaṃ ca dhyānaṃ stotraṃ munīśvara \|*  
*saṃpūjya vahnistuṣṭāva yena tāṃ vada me prabho \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Narada said — О best of the sages, О lord you kindly let me know the method of adoring Svaha, her dhyanam, stotra and her prayer of the fire gods after performing pQja and her stiili. You kindly tell me all this.

## \|\| 40.46-47 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ stotraṃ pūjāvidhānakam \|*  
*vadāmi śrūyatāṃ brahmansāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya \|\| 46 \|\|*

*sarvayajñārambhakāle śālagrāme ghaṭe'thavā \|*  
*svāhāṃ saṃpūjya yatnena yajñaṃ kuryyātphalāptaye \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. Narayana said — О Brahman, I am speaking out the method of adoration of the goddess and her stotra as spelt out in the Samaveda. You listen to it attentively. At the beginning of all the yajnas, Sdlagrama and Svaha should be adored for achieving good results.

## \|\| 40.48-49 \|\|

*svāhāṃ mantrāṅgabhūtāṃ ca mantrasiddhisvarūpiṇīm \|*  
*siddhāṃ ca siddhidāṃ nṛṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ phaladāṃ bhaje \|\| 48 \|\|*

*iti dhyātvā ca mūlena dattvā pādyādikaṃ naraḥ \|*  
*sarvasiddhiṃ labhetstutvā mūlaṃ stotraṃ mune śṛṇu \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. As a part of the mantra, the fonn of the success of mantra, bestower of success, such a type of Svaha is adored who bestows the results of the good deeds on men. I adore Svaha. After performing this dhyanam the basic mantra should be recited offering prayers to her as a result of which a person meets with all the success. О sage, now I am telling you about her basic stotra.

## \|\| 40.50-54 \|\|

*oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vahnijāyāyai devyai svāhetyanena ca \|*  
*yaḥ pūjayecca tāṃ devīṃ sarveṣṭaṃ labhate dhruvam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*vahniruvāca \|*  
*svāhā ''dyā prakṛteraṃśā mantratantrāṅgarūpiṇī \|*  
*mantrāṇāṃ phaladātrī ca dhātrī ca jagatāṃ satī \|\| 51 \|\|*

*siddhisvarūpā siddhā ca siddhidā sarvadā nṛṇām \|*  
*hutāśadāhikāśaktistatprāṇādhikarūpiṇī \|\| 52 \|\|*

*saṃsārasārarūpā ca ghorasaṃsāratāriṇī \|*  
*devajīvanarūpā ca devapoṣaṇakāriṇī \|\| 53 \|\|*

*ṣoḍaśaitāni nāmāni yaḥ paṭhedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*sarvasiddhirbhavettasya ceha loke paratra ca \|\| 54 \|\|*

50-54. Reciting this mantra the goddess should be adored to achieve success. Vahni said — О Svaha, you are the ray of Prakriti, a part of mantra and tantra and the bestower of the fruits of mantras. You are the one who bears the entire universe, a chaste woman, bestower of success, the one who bestows success on all the people and the bunting instinct of the god of fire, loved by him more than his life, the essence of the universe, the one who redeems the entire universe, the life of the gods and the one who feeds them. The one who recites these sixteen names of Svaha, meets with success in the present as well as future life.

## \|\| 40.55 \|\|

*nāṅgahīno bhavettasya sarvakarmasu śobhanam \|*  
*aputro labhate putramabhāryyo labhate priyām \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. He is not deprived of any limb and he always becomes successful in his life. The one without a son gets a son and the one without a wife gets a wife.

## Chapter 41

## \|\| 41.1-2 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi svadhopākhyānamuttamam \|*  
*pitṝṇāṃ vai tṛptikaraṃ śrāddhānāṃ phalavarddhanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*hareśca kavacaṃ dhṛtvā kṛtvā niḥ kṣatriyāṃ mahīm \|*  
*rāmo jagāma kailāsaṃ namaskartuṃ śivaṃ gurum \|*  
*gurupatnīṃ śivāmambāṃ draṣṭuṃ gurusutau ca tau \|*  
*guṇairnārāyaṇasamau kārttikeyagaṇeśvarau \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said — О Narada, I am going to tell you the secret story of the birth of Svadha, which is responsible for the satisfaction of the manes and increases the merit of performing sraddhas; Brahma the creator of the universe also created the manes at the time of the creation. Four of them having a definite form while three of them had the form of tejas..

## \|\| 41.3 \|\|

*manoyāyī mahātmā sa bhṛgussaṃprāpya tatkṣaṇam \|*  
*dadarśa parvataṃ ramyamatīva sumanoharam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Finding the seven manes there who bestowed success and were quite pleasant to look at Brahma created sraddha and tarpana as their food.

## \|\| 41.4-5 \|\|

*śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśairmaṇibhiḥ sumanoharaiḥ \|*  
*suvarṇabhūmisadṛśai rājamārgairvirājitam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*sindūrāruṇavarṇaiśca veṣṭitaṃ maṇivedibhiḥ \|*  
*saṃyuktaṃ muktānikaraiḥ pūritaṃ maṇimaṇḍapaiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. In the Vedas it has been prescribed for the Brahmanas to take a bath and perform yajna, tarpana, srdddha, adoration of gods and sandhya thrice a day. Therefore, О Brahmana, the one who does not perform sandhya-tarpana thrice a day or performs Balivaishvadeva, reciting the Vedas, becomes of no consequence like a snake without its poison.

## \|\| 41.6 \|\|

*yakṣāṇāmālayairdivyaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ śatakoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*kapāṭastambhasopānaiḥ śobhitairmaṇinirmitaiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О Narada, one who is deprived of the devotion of the lord and the one who takes the food without first offering it to the lord remains impure up to the time of his death and is not considered to be suitable for any job.

## \|\| 41.7-13 \|\|

*suvarṇakalaśairdivyai rājataiḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|*  
*ratnakāñcanapūrṇaiśca yakṣendragaṇaveṣṭitaiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyairdīpitaiḥ sundarīgaṇaiḥ \|*  
*bālikābhirbālakaiśca citraputtalikākaraiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*krīḍadbhiḥ sasmitaiḥ śaśvatsvacchandaṃ ca virājitaiḥ \|*  
*pārijātadrumagaṇaiḥ svarṇadītīranīrajaiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*vidyāvatīṃ guṇavatīmapi rūpavatīṃ satīm \|*  
*śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|\| 10 \|\|*

*siddhavidyāsu nipuṇaiḥ puṇyavadbhirniṣevitam \|*  
*trilakṣayojanācchāyairvaṭavṛkṣairathākṣayaiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*śatayojanavistīrṇaiḥ śataskandhasamanvitaiḥ \|*  
*asaṃkhyaśākhāni karairasaṃkhyaphalasaṃyutaiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*nānāpakṣigaṇākīrṇaiḥ sumanoharaśabditaiḥ \|*  
*kampitaiḥ śītavātena maṇḍitaṃ ca sugandhinā \|\| 13 \|\|*

7-13. Thus Brahma created sraddha etc. and entrusted the same to the manes. Brahma in order to please the manes continued to perform the sraddha but such offerings did not reach the manes. Thereafter all the manes started suffering from hunger and with a disturbed mind they reached Brahma and prayed to him. Hearing them Brahma created a girl who was quite beautiful and had the glory resembling that of the moon of the winter season. She was filled with knowledge, virtues, beauty, chastity and had the complexion of the white jasmine flowers. She was adorned with all the gem-studded ornaments, was extremely pure, a ray of Prakriti, wore a smile on her face and was given the name 'Svadha. She had beautiful teeth and all the auspicious symbols and grace. Her feet resembled the lotus flower having the signs of lotuses over the soles. She was declared to be the wife of the manes and had a lotus-like face and lotus-like eyes, having been born out of the lotus. They handed over the girl who was the form of satisfaction to the manes and secretly advised the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 41.14-15 \|\|

*puṣpodyānasahasreṇa sarasāṃ ca śatena ca \|*  
*siddhendrālayalakṣaiśca maṇiratnavikārajaiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*rāmaśca dṛṣṭvā nagaramatisaṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ \|*  
*dadarśa purato ramyaṃ śrīyuktaṃ śaṃkarālayam \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. That all the offerings to the manes should be made by suffixing Svadha to the mantras. Thus all the Brahmanas are making the offerings to the manes accordingly. The offerings made in favour of the gods, the name of Svaha is recited for the offerings to the manes the name of Svadha is recited and daksind's name is recited in all the performances. A yajna without daksina is considered to be destroyed and is of no consequence.

## \|\| 41.16-17 \|\|

*suvarṇamūlyaśatakairmaṇibhiḥ svarṇavarṇakaiḥ \|*  
*khacitaṃ ratnasāraiśca racitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tripañcayojanocchrāyaṃ caturyojanavistṛtam \|*  
*caturasraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ prākāraṃ sumanoharam \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Thereafter all the manes, gods, the Brahmanas, the sages and the humans adored Svadha. With the boon granted by the goddess Svadha all the gods were extremely satisfied and the desire of all the Brahmanas were fulfilled.

## \|\| 41.18 \|\|

*dvāraṃ ratnakapāṭena nānā citrānvitena ca \|*  
*maṇīndravedibhiryuktaṃ maṇistambhavirājitaiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Thus, I have narrated to you the best of the stories of the goddess Svadha, which satisfies all. What more do you want to listen to from me?

## \|\| 41.19 \|\|

*taddakṣiṇe vṛṣendraṃ ca vāme siṃhaṃ ca nārada \|*  
*nandīśvaraṃ mahākālaṃ piṅgalākṣaṃ bhayaṃkaram \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Narada said — О great sage, I intend to be enlightened on the method of adoration of Svadha and her dhyanam\\ you kindly tell me with great efforts.

## \|\| 41.20 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*taddhyānaṃ stavanaṃ brahmanvedoktaṃ sarvasammatam \|*  
*sarvaṃ jānāsi vakṣye vai jñātumicchasi vṛddhaye \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Narayana said — О Brahmana, her Dhyanam the prayer prescribed in the Vedas is well known to all. Still you want to know about it for the increase of your knowledge. You better listen to me.

## \|\| 41.21 \|\|

*saṃhārabhairavaṃ kālabhairavaṃ ca bhayaṅkaram \|*  
*rurubhairavamīśābhaṃ mahābhairavameva ca \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. In the black thirteenth day in the winter season in the constellation of Magha, Svadha should be adored on the first day of sraddha. Thereafter the sraddha should be performed.

## \|\| 41.22-23 \|\|

*kṛṣṇāṅgabhairavaṃ caiva krodhabhairavamulbaṇam \|*  
*kapālabhairavaṃ caiva rudrabhairavameva ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

*siddheṃdrādīnrudragaṇānvidyādharasuguhyakān \|*  
*bhūtānpretānpiśācāṃśca kūṣmāṇḍānbrahmarākṣasān \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Such of the Brahmanas as do not adore Svadha before the performing of the sraddha, never achieve the merit of the same. I am adoring the mind born daughter of Brahma who is always youthful and is adored by the gods and the manes alike and grants the merit of the sraddha.

## \|\| 41.24-25 \|\|

*vetālāndānavāṃścaiva yogīndrāṃśca jaṭādharān \|*  
*yakṣānkimpuruṣāṃścaiva kinnarāṃśca dadarśa ha \|\| 24 \|\|*

*tāndṛṣṭvā nandikeśājñāṃ gṛhītvā bhṛgunandanaḥ \|*  
*tānsambhāṣyābhyantaraṃ ca jagāmānandasaṃplutaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. Thus reciting the mantras, Svadha should be adored in a kalasha or the image of Shalagrama. Then reciting the basic mantra, the padya and arghya should be offered to her, as prescribed in the Vedas. "ओं ही श्रीं कलीं स्वधा देव्यै स्वाहा" – is the mantra which should be recited while performing puja and offering prayer. Thereafter the Brahmana should be adored.

## \|\| 41.26 \|\|

*ratnendrasārakhacitaṃ dadarśa śatamandiram \|*  
*amūlyaratnakalaśairjvaladbhiśca virājitam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. О best of the sages, the great intellectual and the son of sages, the great intellectual and the son of Brahma, you listen to her stotra which bestows success and fulfils all the desires of the people which was recited by Brahma himself in the earlier times.

## \|\| 41.27 \|\|

*amūlyaratnaracitairmuktānirmmaladarpaṇaiḥ \|*  
*hīrasāravikāraiśca kapāṭaiśca virājitam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Brahma said — By the mere reciting of the name of Svadha, one achieves the merit of taking a bath at a holy place. Then getting deprived of all the sins he leamt the merit of performing the Vajpeya-yajna.

## \|\| 41.28-29 \|\|

*gorocanābhirmaṇibhiryutaṃ stambhasahasrakaiḥ \|*  
*maṇisāravikāraiśca sopānaiḥ pariśobhitam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*dadarśābhyantaraṃ dvāraṃ nānācitraiśca citritam \|*  
*māṇikyamuktāgrathitairmālājālairvirājitam \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. By reciting the name of Svadha thrice one gets the merit of performing sraddha, bali and tarpana. The one who listens to the stotra of Svadha at the time of perfonning a hundred smddhas. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 41.30 \|\|

*svadhā svadhā svadhetyevaṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ \|*  
*priyāṃ vinītāṃ sa labhetsādhvīṃ putraṃ guṇānvitam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The one who recites the words of Svadha thrice at the time of sandhya, he achieves a loveable, docile and chaste wife and a virtuous son.

## \|\| 41.31 \|\|

*pradhānapārṣadagaṇānkṣetrapālāṃśca nārada \|*

31\. You are the life of the manes, the life of the Brahmanas, the supreme goddess of the sraddha and also grant the merits for performing shrdddha.

## \|\| 41.32 \|\|

*tānsambhāṣya bhṛguḥ śīghraṃ mahābalaparākramaḥ \|*

32\. You depart from our minds for the satisfaction of the manes. By doing so there will be an increase in the pleasure of the Brahmanas and also the house-holders.

## \|\| 41.33 \|\|

*gacchantaṃ taṃ gaṇeśaśca kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhetyuvāca ha \|*

33\. You are the one, perfonning all the noble vratas, you are noble and eternal besides being the form of all the gunas. Your presence is noticed at the time of creation and dissolution, after which you disappear.

## \|\| 41.34-35 \|\|

*īśvarājñāṃ gṛhītvā'hamatrāgatya kṣaṇāntare \|*  
*tvayā sārddhaṃ gamiṣyāmi bhrātastiṣṭhātra sāmpratam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*gaṇeśavākyaṃ paraśurāmaśśrutvā mahābalaḥ \|*  
*bṛhaspatisamo vaktā pravaktumupacakrame \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. You are … and daksina because all the six of these have emerged from the Vedas and are considered to be praise-worthy by those seeking efficiency in the karmas. In the earlier times, you happened to be a cowherdesses named Svadha in the Goloka, besides being a friend of Radhika, lord Krishna himself embraced you. That is why you were given the name of Svadha.

## \|\| 41.36-37 \|\|

*dhvastā tvaṃ rādhikāśāpādgolokādviśvamāgatā \|*  
*kṛṣṇāśliṣṭā tayā dṛṣṭā purā vṛndāvane vane \|\| 36 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇāliṃganapuṇyena bhūtā me mānasī sutā \|*  
*atṛptasurate tena caturṇāṃ svāmināṃ priyā \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Because of the fear of Radhika, you had to descend on earth from Goloka. In the earlier times when you were embracing lord Krishna in Vrindavana, you were spotted by Radhika, because of the merit of the embrace with Krishna you became the mind-bom daughter of Brahma. Since you remain dissatisfied in love-sports, you got four husbands.

## \|\| 41.38 \|\|

*svāhā sā sundarī gopī purā''sīdrādhikāsakhī \|*  
*ratau svayaṃ kṛṣṇamāha tena svāhā prakīrttitā \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. In earlier times Svaha too was a beautiful cowherdesses and a friend of Radhika. She herself had prayed to lord Krishna for love and that is why she was given the name Svaha.

## \|\| 41.39 \|\|

*kṛṣṇena sārddhaṃ suciraṃ vasante rāsamaṇḍale \|*
