39\. In the earlier times during the spring season you enjoyed the company of lord Krishna in the Rasamandala and you were spotted by Radhika.

## \|\| 41.40 \|\|

*tasyāḥ śāpena sā dhvastā golokādviśvamāgatā \|*  
*kṛṣṇāliṅganapuṇyena samabhūdvahnikāminī \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. With her curse, you had to fall from Goloka on earth and you became the wife of god Agni because of the merit earned by you from the embrace with lord Krishna.

## \|\| 41.41 \|\|

*iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde kailāsavarṇanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The one who is quite auspicious, the best and is adored by the humans, by reciting whose name a person is relieved of all the sins.

## \|\| 41.42 \|\|

*yā suśīlābhidhā gopī purā''sīdrādhikāsakhī \|*  
*uvāsa dakṣiṇe kroḍe kṛṣṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Who in the earlier times was known as a cowherdesses name Sus'Ila and the friend of Radhika was once seated in the right lap of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 41.43 \|\|

*pradhvastā sā ca tacchāpādgolokādviśvamāgatā \|*  
*kṛṣṇāliṅganapuṇyena sā babhūva ca dakṣiṇā \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. She had to descend on earth from Goloka with the curse of Radhika and with the merit of her embrace with lord Krishna, she came to be known as daksina.

## \|\| 41.44-45 \|\|

*sā preyasī ratau dakṣā praśastā sarvakarmasu \|*  
*uvāsa dakṣiṇe bharturdakṣiṇā tena kīrttitā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*gopyā babhūvustisro vai svadhā svāhā ca dakṣiṇā \|*  
*karmiṇāṃ karmapūrṇārthaṃ purā caiveśvarecchayā \|\| 45\|\|*

44-45. The beloved cowherdesses was quite well-versed in the art of love and is competent to perform all the deeds and enjoyed always the right lap of her husband. She was therefore called daksina. Thus in order to make the deeds of all people a success, who is well-versed in the art of love and is competent to perform all the deeds and enjoys always the right lap of the husband, she was therefore called daksina. Thus in order to make the deeds of all the people successful with the will of the lord, all the three cowherdesses name Svaha, Svadha and daksina were born.

## \|\| 41.46-47 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā sa brahmā brahmaloke ca saṃsadi \|*  
*tasthau ca sahasā sadyaḥ svadhā sā''virbabhūva ha \|\| 46 \|\|*

*tadā pitṛbhyaḥ pradadau tāmeva kamalānanām \|*  
*tāṃ saṃprāpya yayuste ca pitaraśca praharṣitāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. In the court of Brahma he kept quite after narrating all this. At that point of time Svadha appeared there in person, whose care was entrusted to the manes. By receiving her all the manes were delighted.

## \|\| 41.48 \|\|

*svadhāstotramidaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ \|*  
*sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu vedapāṭhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Whosoever listens to this auspicious story with an attentive mind, cams the merit of having a bath in all the sacred places besides the recitation of the Vedas.

## Chapter 42

## \|\| 42.1-6 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*uktaṃ svāhāsvadhākhyānaṃ praśastaṃ madhuraṃ param \|*  
*vakṣyāmi dakṣiṇākhyānaṃ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya \|\| 1 \|\|*

*gopī suśīlā goloke purā''sītpreyasī hareḥ \|*  
*rādhāpradhānā sadhrīcī dhanyā mānyā manoharā \|*  
*atīva sundarī rāmā subhagā sudatī satī \|\| 2 \|\|*

*vidyāvatī guṇavatī satī rūpavatī tathā \|*  
*kalāvatī komalāṃgī kāntā kamalalocanā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*suśroṇī sustanī śyāmā nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalā \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*śvetacampakavarṇābhā bimboṣṭhī mṛgalocanā \|*  
*kāmaśāstrasuniṣṇātā kāminī kalahaṃsagā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*bhāvānuraktā bhāvajñā kṛṣṇasya priyabhāminī \|*  
*rasajñā rasikā rāse rāseśasya rasotsukā \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Narayana said — I have narrated the sweet and praise-worthy stories of Svaha and Svadha. Now I am going to narrate the story of daksina to you. You listen to it attentively, In the Goloka there was a cowherdesses named Susila. In the earlier times she happened to be the beloved of lord Krishna and she was the chief friend of Radhika. She was graceful, filled with pride, quite pleasant to look at, extremely beautiful, charming, fortunate, possessing beautiful teeth, quite chaste, knowledgeable, virtuous, beautiful, intelligent, having tender limbs, full of glory, having the lotus-like eyes, developed breasts and pelvic region, dark complexion and the stiff pelvic region, stiff breasts plastered with sandal-paste. She wore a serene smile on her face and adorned with all the ornaments studded with gems. She had the complexion of the white campaka flower, lips like the ripe wood-apple, doe like eyes, well-versed in the art of love, fulfilling the desires of all. She walked like the goose and moved as per the desires for lord Krishna. She knew the mind of lord Krishna. She knew the mind of lord Krishna and was his beloved, well-versed in all the rasas and delighted lord Krishna at the time of Rasa.

## \|\| 42.7 \|\|

*uvāsa dakṣiṇe kroḍe rādhāyāḥ purataḥ purā \|*  
*saṃbabhūvānamramukho bhayena madhusūdanaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. In earlier times she was once seated on the right lap of lord Krishna but lord MadhusQdana kept his head downwards being afraid of Radha.

## \|\| 42.8-10 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā rādhāṃ ca purato gopīnāṃ pravarāṃ varām \|*  
*māninīṃ raktavadanāṃ raktapaṅkajalocanām \|\| 8 \|\|*

*kopena kampitāṅgī ca kopanāṃ kopadarśanām \|*  
*kopena niṣṭhuraṃ vaktumudyatāṃ sphuritādharām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*āgacchantīṃ ca vegena vijñāya tadanantaram \|*  
*virodhabhīto bhagavānantarddhānaṃ jagāma saḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. Finding Radha there, who was the best of all the cowherdesses, filled with pride, having a red complexioned body, having the eyes like the lotus flower. Her limbs were fluttering in anger. She was filled with anger and displayed her anger pretty well. She spoke harsh words because of the anger. Her lips fluttered with anger. Finding her coming into rage, lord Krishna disappeared from the scene.

## \|\| 42.11 \|\|

*palāyantaṃ ca taṃ śāntaṃ sattvādhāraṃ suvigraham \|*  
*vilokya kampitā gopī suśīlā'ntardadhau bhiyā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Thereafter finding Krishna disappearing from the scene, who was the base of sattva, extremely peaceful and possessing the beautiful body, the cowherdesses Sus'ila too felt terrified and disappeared.

## \|\| 42.12-16 \|\|

*vilokya saṅkaṭaṃ tatra gopīnāṃ lakṣakoṭayaḥ \|*  
*baddhāñjalipuṭā bhītā bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*rakṣa rakṣetyuktavatyo he devīti punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*yayurbhayena śaraṇaṃ tasyāścaraṇapaṅkaje \|\| 13 \|\|*

*trilakṣakoṭayo gopāḥ sudāmādaya eva ca \|*  
*yayurbhayena śaraṇaṃ tatpādābje ca nārada \|\| 14 \|\|*

*palāyantaṃ ca kāntaṃ vai vijñāya parameśvarī \|*  
*palāyantīṃ sahacarīṃ suśīlāṃ ca śaśāpa sā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*adyaprabhṛti golokaṃ sā cedāyāti gopikā \|*  
*sadyo gamanamātreṇa bhasmasācca bhaviṣyati \|\| 16 \|\|*

12-16. Finding the danger approaching fast, the lakh and crores of cowherdesses stood there in terror with folded hands and their heads cast downwards. They said: “O goddess, protect us. They all took refuge under the feet of Radhika. О Narada, the three lakh crores of the cowherdesses, took refuge under the lotus-like feet of Radhika. Thereafter, the goddess Radhika finding Krishna running away from the scene, pronounced a curse on SusTla that in case she reappeared in Goloka in future, she would be reduced to ashes.

## \|\| 42.17 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā tatraiva devadevīśvarī ruṣā \|*  
*rāseśvarī rāsamadhye rāseśaṃ cājuhāva ha \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The one who happened to be the great goddess of all the gods and goddesses, the lady of Rasa, Radhika after uttering these words went to the place of dancing and started calling for Krishna.

## \|\| 42.18 \|\|

*nālokya purataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhā virahakātarā \|*  
*yugakoṭisamaṃ mene kṣaṇabhedena suvratā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Burning with the fire of separation, the chaste Radhika finding Krishna absent from the place started suffering from the pain of separation and a single moment for her passed like a crore of yugas.

## \|\| 42.19 \|\|

*he kṛṣṇa he prāṇanāthāgaccha prāṇādhikapriya \|*  
*prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdeveha prāṇā yānti tvayā vinā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. She uttered, “O Krishna, О lord of my life, you are the one dearer to me than my life, you come immediately, О lord of my life, I am going to die in your absence."

## \|\| 42.20 \|\|

*strīgarvaḥ patisaubhāgyādvarddhate ca dine dine \|*  
*sustrī cedvibhavo yasmātte bhajeddharmataḥ sadā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Because the fortune of a lady goes on increasing day by day only with the husband, therefore, if one has the best of a spouse one would serve him.

## \|\| 42.21-23 \|\|

*patirbandhuḥ kulastrīṇāmadhidevaḥ sadā gatiḥ \|*  
*paraṃ sampatsvarūpaśca sukharūpaśca mūrttimān \|\| 21 \|\|*

*dharmadaḥ sukhadaḥ śaśvatprītidaḥ śāntidaḥ sadā \|*  
*sammānado mānadaśca mānyo vai mānakhaṇḍanaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sārātsāratamaḥ svāmī bandhūnāṃ bandhuvarddhanaḥ \|*  
*na ca bharttuḥ samo bandhuḥ sarvabandhuṣu dṛśyate \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. Because the chaste ladies have only the husband as their true relatives. He happens to be the great god for them, their movement, the great fortune, the form of pleasure, the fonn of dharma always loveable and peaceful, the one who grants grace, pride is adorable, the ornament of pride, essence of the essences, the best lord, the relatives and the brothers. This is the reason why there is no other relative better than a husband even for a moment.

## \|\| 42.24-26 \|\|

*bharaṇādeva bhartā'yaṃ pālanātpatirucyate \|*  
*śarīreśācca sa svāmī kāmadaḥ kānta eva ca \|\| 24 \|\|*

*bandhuśca sukhabandhācca prītidānātpriyaḥ paraḥ \|*  
*aiśvaryyadānādīśaśca prāṇeśātprāṇanāyakaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*ratidānācca ramaṇaḥ priyo nāsti priyātparaḥ \|*  
*putrastu svāminaḥ śukrājjāyate tena sa priyaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. He is called Bharta because he feeds, a husband because he maintain, the lord because he happens to be the lord of the body, a relative because he is bound by a pleasant relation, the dearest one because he imparts love, because he bestows fortune, lord of the life because he happens to be leader in the life and Ramana, because he bestows grace in love. There is no one else dearer to a lady than her husband. With the semen of the husband a son is bom; that is why he is called the dearest of all.

## \|\| 42.27 \|\|

*śataputrātparaḥsvāmī kulajānāṃ priyaḥ sadā \|*  
*asatkulaprasūtā yā kāntaṃ vijñātumakṣamā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. That is why for the chaste lady a husband is dearer than hundreds of her sons, but the unclean woman is unable to assess the worth of her husband.

## \|\| 42.28-30 \|\|

*snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣaṇam \|*  
*prādakṣiṇyaṃ pṛthivyāśca sarvāṇi ca tapāṃsi vai \|\| 28 \|\|*

*sarvāṇyeva vratādīni mahādānāni yāni ca \|*  
*upoṣaṇāni puṇyāni yānyanyāni ca viśvataḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*gurusevāviprasevādevasevādikaṃ ca yat \|*  
*svāminaḥ pādasevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. By taking a bath in all the sacred places, by performing all the yajnas, by going round the entire earth, by performing all types of tapas, all the vratas, giving away all the charities, besides performing other good deeds, including fasting, attending on the guru and Brahmanas besides the gods, do not measure even one sixteenth part of serving at the feet of one's husband.

## \|\| 42.31 \|\|

*guruvipreṣṭadeveṣu sarvebhyaśca patirguruḥ \|*  
*vidyādātā yathā puṃsāṃ kulajānāṃ tathā priyaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Of all the teachers, the Brahmanas and the family gods, the husband enjoys the best position of all among them. As the teacher who imparts knowledge is dearer to the men similarly for the chaste lady of high families, the husband happens to be always the dearest.

## \|\| 42.32-33 \|\|

*gopītrilakṣakoṭīnāṃ gopānāṃ ca tathaiva ca \|*  
*brahmāṇḍānāmasaṃkhyānāṃ tatrasthānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 32 \|\|*

*ramādigopakāntānāmīśvarī tatprasādataḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ na jāne taṃ kāntaṃ strīsvabhāvo duratyayaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. There are three lakh crores of cowherdesses and an equal number of cowherds, innumerable globes and an innumerable number of cowherdesses reside therein. I happen to be the lady of all of them, but I am unaware of my own husband as to where has he gone? A woman has perverse nature.

## \|\| 42.34 \|\|

*ityuktvā rādhikā kṛṣṇaṃ tatra dadhyau subhaktitaḥ \|*  
*ārātsaṃprāpa taṃ tena vijahāra ca tatra vai \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Thus speaking Radhika adored lord Krishna with great devotion as a result of which he appeared there at once and engaged himself in the divine play with them.

## \|\| 42.35 \|\|

*atha sā dakṣiṇādevī dhvastā golokato mune \|*  
*suciraṃ ca tapastaptvā viveśa kamalātanau \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О sage, thereafter, the goddess Daksina leaving Goloka performed tapas for a long time and entered into the body of Kamala.

## \|\| 42.36-37 \|\|

*atha devādayaḥ sarve yajñaṃ kṛtvā suduṣkaram \|*  
*na labhante phalaṃ teṣāṃ viṣaṇṇāḥ prayayurvidhim \|\| 36 \|\|*

*vidhirnivedanaṃ śrutvā devādīnāṃ jagatpatiḥ \|*  
*dadhyau sucintito bhaktyā tatpratyādeśamāpa saḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Thereafter, the gods and the people started difficult yajnas but when they could not get the reward after competition of the same, they became dejected and again reached Brahma. Brahma the lord of the universe, listened to the prayers of the gods and feeling extremely worried adored the lord in his mind. He had an audience with him.

## \|\| 42.38-39 \|\|

*nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānmahālakṣmīśca dehataḥ \|*  
*martyalakṣmīṃ viniṣkṛṣya brahmaṇe dakṣiṇāṃ dadau \|\| 38 \|\|*

*brahmā dadau tāṃ yajñāya pūrṇārthaṃ karmaṇāṃ satām \|*  
*yajñaḥ saṃpūjya vidhivattāṃ tuṣṭāva ramāṃ mudā \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Thereafter, lord Narayana and Maha-Lakshmi took out the human Lakshmi from their body in the form of Daksina and handed her over to them. Brahma on his part handed over the same Daksina to the people who were well-versed in performing good deeds. Thereafter the yajna feeling delighted adored her offering prayers to her.

## \|\| 42.40-45 \|\|

*taptakāñcanavarṇābhāṃ candrakoṭisamaprabhām \|*  
*atīva kamanīyāṃ ca sundarīṃ sumanoharām \|\| 40 \|\|*

*kamalāsyāṃ komalāṅgīṃ kamalāyatalocanām \|*  
*kamalāsanasaṃpūjyāṃ kamalāṅgaḥsamudravām \|\| 41 \|\|*

*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ bimboṣṭhīṃ sudatīṃ satīm \|*  
*bibhratīṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|*  
*suveṣāḍhyāṃ ca susnātāṃ munimānasamohinīm \|\| 43 \|\|*

*kastūrībindubhiḥ sārddhaṃ candanaiśca sugandhibhiḥ \|*  
*sindūrabindunā'tyantaṃ mastakādhasthalojjvalām \|\| 44 \|\|*

*supraśastanitambāḍhyāṃ bṛhacchroṇipayodharām \|*  
*kāmadevādhārarūpāṃ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitām \|\| 45 \|\|*

40-45. She had the complexion of molten gold, a beautiful body having the lustre of crores of moons, quite attractive, the one who could influence the mind, the lotus-faced, tender-limped, having broad eyes like the lotus, seated on a lotus, born out of the limbs of Lakshmi, clad in the garments purified by the god of fire, having the lips resembling the wood-apples, having beautiful teeth, the chaste lady adorned with the matted locks of hair, wearing a serene smile on her face, adorned with beautiful ornaments studded with gems appeared in beautiful costumes, who had taken her bath nicely and could attract the mind of sages. Her forehead was adorned with the vermilion spot and with the shining of her lower part, the navel region was praise-worthy. She had broad hips. She possessed unprecedented beauty and was infatuated with the arrows of the god of love.

## \|\| 42.46-47 \|\|

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā ramaṇīyāṃ ca yajño mūrcchāmavāpa ha \|*  
*patnīṃ tāmeva jagrāha vidhibodhitamārgataḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ caiva tāṃ gṛhītvā'tha nirjane \|*  
*yajño reme mudā yukto rāmayā ramayā saha \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. Daksind provides the reward of the good deeds of the people and after completion of the deeds her son gives the reward. The people well-versed in the Vedas say that the yajna with his wife Daksina and the son (putraphala) provides the reward for one's deeds.

## \|\| 42.48 \|\|

*garbhaṃ dadhāra sā devī divyaṃ dvādaśavatsaram \|*  
*tataḥ suṣāva putraṃ ca phalaṃ vai sarvakarmaṇām \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. О sage, at the time of achieving daksina as his wife and phala as his son, yajna distributed rewards to all the people. The gods felt delighted and getting their desires fulfilled, they went back to their abodes. This is what has been heard by us from the mouth of Dharma.

## \|\| 42.49-50 \|\|

*karmaṇāṃ phaladātā ca dakṣiṇā karmaṇāṃ satām \|*  
*paripūrṇe karmaṇi ca tatputraḥ phaladāyakaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*yajño dakṣiṇayā sārddhaṃ putreṇa ca phalena ca \|*  
*karmaṇāṃ phaladātā cetyevaṃ vedavido viduḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. Finding such a beautiful damsel there, yajna fainted. Thereafter Brahma brought him back to his senses and he apprised him of the factual position, after which he accepted her as his spouse. After that he carried the lady to a secluded place and spent the time of a hundred divine years with her pleasantly.

## \|\| 42.51-52 \|\|

*yajñaśca dakṣiṇāṃ prāpya putraṃ ca phaladāyakam \|*  
*phalaṃ dadau ca sarvebhyaḥ karmaṭhebhyo yadā mune \|\| 51 \|\|*

*tadā devādayastuṣṭāḥ paripūrṇamanorathāḥ \|*  
*svasthānaṃ prayayuḥ sarve dharmavaktrādidaṃ śrutam \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. О sage, if a performer after performing the yajna gives away daksina at once he gets the reward at the same time. This has been ordained by the Vedas.

## \|\| 42.53 \|\|

*kṛtvā karma ca kartā tu tūrṇaṃ dadyācca dakṣiṇām \|*  
*tatkṣaṇaṃ phalamāpnoti vedairuktamidaṃ mune \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. If a performer, innocently after the completion of the yajna does not give away daksina to the Brahmanas, then with the lapse of a muhiirta the amount of daksina is doubled.

## \|\| 42.54-55 \|\|

*kartā karmaṇi pūrṇe'pi tatkṣaṇādyadi dakṣiṇām \|*  
*na dadyādbrāhmaṇebhyaśca daivenājñānato'thavā \|\| 54 \|\|*

*muhūrtte samatīte ca dviguṇā sā bhaveddhruvam \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. Thereafter she became pregnant and remained like that for twelve years. Thereafter she gave birth to a son quite joyfully who happened to be the result of all the good deeds.

## \|\| 42.56-57 \|\|

*ekarātre vyatīte tu bhavedrasaguṇā ca sā \|*  
*trirātre vai daśaguṇā saptāhe dviguṇā tataḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*māse lakṣaguṇā proktā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca varddhate \|*  
*saṃvatsare vyatīte tu sā trikoṭiguṇā bhavet \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. After the passing of a night, the amount of daksind is multiplied to six times. After the lapse of three nights, the amount of daksind is multiplied to ten times and after the lapse of a week, the amount is doubled and after the completion of a month, the amount of daksina is multiplied to a lakh of times and after the lapse of one year, the amount is increased to three crores of times.

## \|\| 42.58-59 \|\|

*karmma tadyajamānānāṃ sarvaṃ vai niṣphalaṃ bhavet \|*  
*sa ca brahmasvāpahārī na karmārho'śucirnaraḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

*daridro vyādhiyuktaśca tena pāpena pātakī \|*  
*tadgṛhādyāti lakṣmīśca śāpaṃ dattvā sudāruṇam \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. Thus the entire effort of the performer of the yajna becomes infructuous and earns the sin of misappropriating the, riches of a Brahmana besides becoming unclean and incompetent. Because of that sin, he becomes sinful, a pauper, a patient and the fortune departs from his house pronouncing a terrific curse.

## \|\| 42.60 \|\|

*pitaro naiva gṛhṇanti taddattaṃ śrāddhatarpaṇam \|*  
*evaṃ surāśca tatpūjāṃ taddattāṃ pāvakāhutim \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. The shraddhas and tarpanas performed by him are not received by the manes. Similarly the gods refuse to accept his adoration and the fire-gods refuse to accept the offerings made by them.

## \|\| 42.61 \|\|

*dātā dadāti no dānaṃ grahītā tanna yācate \|*  
*ubhau tau narakaṃ yātaśchinnarajjuryathā ghaṭaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. In case the giver does not give away the charity and the receiver goes on demanding for it, both of them fall into the hell as a pitcher with the broken falls into the well.

## \|\| 42.62 \|\|

*nārpayedyajamānaścedyācitāraṃ ca dakṣiṇām \|*  
*bhavedbrahmasvāpahārī kumbhīpākaṃ vrajeddhruvam \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. In case a performer does not give away daks ina, he is considered to be a thief stealing the riches of the Brahmanas and ultimately falls into the Kumbhlpaka hell.

## \|\| 42.63-64 \|\|

*varṣalakṣaṃ vasettatra yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ \|*  
*tato bhavetsa caṇḍālo vyādhiyukto daridrakaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*pātayetpuruṣānsapta pūrvānvai pūrvajanmanaḥ \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. He is tortured by the messengers of Yama for a lakh of years. Thereafter he is born as a man with diseases and a Chandala deprived of all the riches. He is then consigned to the hell his seven earlier and seven future generations. О Brahmana, I have narrated to you all the details, now what else do you want to listen to from me?

## \|\| 42.65 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*yatkarma dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ ko bhuṅkte tatphalaṃ mune \|*  
*pūjāvidhiṃ dakṣiṇāyāḥ purā yajñakṛtaṃ vada \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Narada said — О sage, who takes care of the remedy for a deed performed without giving away daksina and in the earlier times how did yajna adore daksina?

## \|\| 42.66 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*karmaṇo'dakṣiṇasyaiva kuta eva phalaṃ mune \|*  
*sadakṣiṇe karmaṇi ca phalameva pravarttate \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Narayana said — О sage, there is no reward for a deed performed without daksina. One gets the reward only after a deed is performed by giving away daksina.

## \|\| 42.67 \|\|

*yā yā karmaṇi sāmagrī balirbhuṅkte ca tāṃ mune \|*  
*balaye tatpradattaṃ ca vāmanena purā mune \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. О sage, whatever materials are required for performing a deed are consumed by Bali. This part was handed over by lord Vamana to Bali in earlier time.

## \|\| 42.68-69 \|\|

*aśrotriyaṃ śrāddhavastu cāśrāddhaṃ dānameva ca \|*  
*vṛṣalīpativiprāṇāṃ pūjādravyādikaṃ ca yat \|\| 68 \|\|*

*ṛtvijā na kṛtaṃ yajñamaśuceḥ pūjanaṃ ca yat \|*  
*gurāvabhaktasya karma balirbhuṅkte na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. Therefore, the one who is deprived of the knowledge of all the Vedas, Bali consumes the offerings in shraddha. The charity given without devotion, the articles of adoration offered by a Brahmana by properly performing puja, the deeds of a person who is not devoted, are consumed by Bali. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 42.70 \|\|

*dakṣiṇāyāśca yaddhyānaṃ stotraṃ pūjāvidhikramam \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ kāṇvaśākhoktaṃ pravakṣyāmi niśāmaya \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Now I tell you the form of adoration of goddess daksind, her dhydnam, stotra and puja according to Kanvashakha.

## \|\| 42.71 \|\|

*purā saṃprāpya tāṃ yajñaḥ karmadakṣāṃ ca dakṣiṇām \|*  
*mumoha tasyā rūpeṇa tuṣṭuve kāmakātaraḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. In the earlier times yajna after achieving daksina was infested with her beauties and infatuated with passion for her, he started offering prayers to her.

## \|\| 42.72 \|\|

*yajña uvāca \|*  
*purā golokagopī tvaṃ gopīnāṃ pravarā parā \|*  
*rādhāsamā tatsakhī ca śrīkṛṣṇapreyasī priye \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Yajna said — О dear, in the earlier times, in the Goloka, you happened to be the best of the cowherds among the cowherdesses. You were the friend of Radha and were equal to her. You were the beloved of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 42.73 \|\|

*kārttikīpūrṇimāyāṃ tu rāse rādhāmahotsave \|*  
*āvirbhūtā dakṣiṇāṃśātkṛṣṇasyāto hi dakṣiṇā \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. On the full moon day of the Kartika, at the Radhamahotsava festival you were born out of the right side of lord Krishna in the Rdsamandala.

## \|\| 42.74 \|\|

*purā tvaṃ ca suśīlākhyā śīlena suśubhena ca \|*  
*kṛṣṇadakṣāṃśavāsācca rādhāśāpācca dakṣiṇā \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. At that point of time you were known as Suslla because of the nobility in your character. Since you adorned the right lap of lord Krishna you were cursed by Radha and that is why you are called Daksina.

## \|\| 42.75 \|\|

*golokāttvaṃ paridhvastā mama bhāgyādupasthitā \|*  
*kṛpāṃ kuru tvamevādya svāminaṃ kuru māṃ priye \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. O dear one, the cause of our great fortune, you have arrived here from Goloka. Be pleased with me and make me your lord today.

## \|\| 42.76-77 \|\|

*kartṝṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ devī tvameva phaladā sadā \|*  
*tvayā vinā ca sarveṣāṃ sarva karma ca niṣphalam \|\| 76 \|\|*

*phalaśākhāvihīnaśca yathā vṛkṣo mahītale \|*  
*tvayā vinā tathā karma kartṝṇāṃ ca na śobhate \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. You bestow the reward for the deeds performed by the people. Without you the deeds of all the people become infructuous like a tree on earth having no fruits or branches. Similarly without you the performers do not feel graceful.

## \|\| 42.78 \|\|

*brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca dikpālādaya eva ca \|*  
*karmaṇaśca phalaṃ dātuṃ na śaktāśca tvayā vinā \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. Similarly Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva besides Dikpalas and other gods are unable to bestow the reward for the deeds on you.

## \|\| 42.79 \|\|

*karmarūpī svayaṃ brahmā phalarūpī maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*yajñarūpī viṣṇurahaṃ tvameṣāṃ sārarūpiṇī \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. Brahma himself believes in karmas and lord Shiva as the form of the reward, Vishnu has the form of yajna and you are the gist of all.

## \|\| 42.80 \|\|

*phaladātā paraṃ brahma nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ kṛṣṇaśca bhagavānna ca śaktastvayā vinā \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. You are always beyond Prakriti and are formless but the supreme Brahman has been believed to be the giver of the reward. Even lord Krishna is unable to give the reward without you.

## \|\| 42.81-82 \|\|

*tvameva śaktiḥ kānte me śaśvajjanmani janmani \|*  
*sarvakarmaṇi śakto'haṃ tvayā saha varānane \|\| 81 \|\|*

*ityuktvā tatpurastasthau yajñādhiṣṭhātṛdevakaḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭā babhūva sā devī bheje taṃ kamalākalā \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. О damsel, you are the strength of each and every birth of ours, the possessed competence to perform any deeds because of keeping your company. Thus speaking, the lord of the yajna kept on standing before her. Thereafter, the ray of lord Lakshmi was pleased with the yajna and started serving him as her husband.

## \|\| 42.83 \|\|

*idaṃ ca dakṣiṇāstotraṃ yajñakāle ca yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*phalaṃ ca sarvayajñānāṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Thus whosoever recites this stotra at the time of yajna receives reward for performing the yajna. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 42.84-88 \|\|

*rājasūye vājapeye gomedhe naramedhake \|*  
*aśvamedhe lāṃgale ca viṣṇuyajñe yaśaskare \|\| 84 \|\|*

*dhanade bhūmide phalgau putreṣṭau gajamedhake \|*  
*lohayajñe svarṇayajñe paṭalavyādhikhaṇḍane \|\| 85 \|\|*

*śivayaje rudrayajñe śakrayajñe ca bandhake \|*  
*iṣṭau varuṇayāge ca kanduke vairimardane \|\| 86 \|\|*

*śuciyāge dharmayāge recane pāpamocane \|*  
*bandhane karmayāge ca maṇiyāge subhadrake \|\| 87 \|\|*

*eteṣāṃ ca samārambhe idaṃ stotraṃ ca yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*nirvighnena ca tatkarma sāṅgaṃ bhavati niścitam \|\| 88 \|\|*

84-88. The people who performed Rajcishuya, Vajpeya, Gomedha, Naramedha, Asvamedha, Langala, Vishnu-yajna, which bestows glory, Phalguyajna, which bestows riches and land Pntresti-yajna, Gajamedha, Lohayajna, Suvarna-yajna which removes eye ailment, Shiva-yajna, Rudra-yajna, Indra-yajna, Varuna-yajna, Kandukci, Vairimardana, Suciyaga, then Dharmaydga, Pdpamocana, Recana, Bandhana, Karmciydga and. the Maniydga the bestower of welfare, at the start of all these yajnas whosoever recites this stotra, his yajna is surely completed in all respects without any obstruction.

## \|\| 42.89 \|\|

*idaṃ stotraṃ ca kathitaṃ dhyānaṃ pūjāvidhānakam \|*  
*śālagrāme ghaṭe vā'pi dakṣiṇāṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. Thus I have narrated to you the details about the stotra and dhyanam; now you listen to the method of adoration. Daksina should be invoked in the image of Sdlagrama or a kalasha and should be adored by the intellectuals.

## \|\| 42.90 \|\|

*lakṣmīdakṣāṃśasambhūtāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ kamalākalām \|*  
*sarvakarmasu dakṣāṃ ca phaladāṃ sarvakarmaṇām \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Daksina is the ray of Kamala and has emerged out of the ray of Lakshmi who is well-versed in performing all the deeds and provides rewards for all the deeds.

## \|\| 42.91-95 \|\|

*viṣṇoḥśaktisvarūpāṃ ca suśīlāṃ śubhadāṃ bhaje \|*  
*dhyātvā'nenaiva varadāṃ sudhīrmūlena pūjayet \|\| 91 \|\|*

*dattvā pādyādikaṃ devyai vedoktena ca nārada \|*  
*oṃ śrīṃ klīṃ hrīṃ dakṣiṇāyai svāheti ca vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

*pūjayedvidhivadbhaktyā dakṣiṇāṃ sarvapūjitām \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dakṣiṇākhyānamuttamam \|\| 93 \|\|*

*sukhadaṃ prītidaṃ caiva phaladaṃ sarvakarmaṇām \|*  
*idaṃ ca dakṣiṇākhyānaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

*aṃgahīnaṃ ca tatkarma na bhavedbhārate bhuvi \|*  
*aputro labhate putraṃ niścitaṃ ca guṇānvitam \|\| 95 \|\|*

91-95. She represents the prowess of lord Vishnu, is adored by him, who offers prayers to her, is auspicious, provides purity, the form of purity and is considered to be sacred in all respects. I adore Suslla. Thus concentrating the mind on the goddess who bestows the boons, one should perform puja with the recitation of the basic mantra. О Narada, the goddess should be offered for arghya, padya as prescribed in the Vedas, ‘ …. By reciting this mantra one should adore the goddess daksina. Thus I have narrated to you the graceful story of daksina which bestows pleasure, devotion and bestows the reward of all the deeds; therefore the story of Daksina should be heard attentively and whoever does so, none of his efforts go without bearing fruit.

## \|\| 42.96-99 \|\|

*bhāryyāhīno labhedbhāryyāṃ suśīlāṃ sundarīṃ parām \|*  
*varārohāṃ putravatīṃ vinītāṃ priyavādinīm \|\| 96 \|\|*

*pativratāṃ suvratāṃ ca śuddhāṃ ca kulajāṃ varām \|*  
*vidyāhīno labhedvidyāṃ dhanahīno dhanaṃ labhet \|\| 97 \|\|*

*bhūmihīno labhedbhūmiṃ prajāhīno labhetprajāḥ \|*  
*saṅkaṭe bandhuvicchede vipattau bandhane tathā \|\| 98 \|\|*

*māsamekamidaṃ śrutvā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

96-99. The one who is without a son gets a virtuous son. The one who is without a wife gets a noble, beautiful, the best, charming, humble, soft-spoken wife who bears the son. She is chaste, beautiful, well-disciplined, pure belongs to a high caste and is the best among the ladies. The one without learnings, gets educated, a pauper gets immense riches, a person without land receives land, the people having no issues have their progeny. A man is relieved of all danger, separation from relatives comes to an end and all types of fetters are cleared within a month of the hearing of this stotra and the dangers are removed; there is no doubt about it.

## Chapter 43

## \|\| 43.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*anekāsāṃ ca devīnāṃ śrutamākhyānamuttamam \|*  
*anyāsāṃ caritaṃ brahmanvada vedavidāṃ vara \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said — О Brahman, you are the best among those well-versed in the Vedas. I have already listened from you to the stories of many of the goddesses; now you tell me the story of someone else.

## \|\| 43.2 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*sarvāsāṃ caritaṃ vipra vedeṣvasti pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*pūrvoktānāṃ ca devīnāṃ tvaṃ kāsāṃ śrotumicchasi \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Narayana said — О Brahman, the stories of the goddesses which I have narrated earlier are separately contained in the Vedas. The story of which one of them would you like to listen to now?

## \|\| 43.3 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhī maṅgalacaṇḍī ca manasā prakṛteḥ kalā \|*  
*utpattimāsāṃ caritaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Narada said — I would like to listen to the stories of SasthI, Mangalachandl and Manasa, who happens to be the rays of Prakriti, including their birth, life story and all other details.

## \|\| 43.4 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhāṃśā prakṛteryā ca sā ca ṣaṣṭhī prakīrtitā \|*  
*bālakādhiṣṭhātṛdevī viṣṇumāyā ca bāladā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Narayana said — Since SasthI was born from the sixth amsa of Prakriti, she came to be known by the name of SasthI. She happens to be the supreme goddess of the children; she is conceived as the illusion of Vishnu and the one who grants progeny.

## \|\| 43.5 \|\|

*mātṛkāsu ca vikhyātā devasenābhidhā ca sā \|*  
*prāṇādhikapriyā sādhvī skandabhāryyā ca suvratā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. She is well known in the Matrkas and is also called Devasena. She is the wife of Skanda who loves her more than his life. She is quite chaste, beautiful and self-disciplined.

## \|\| 43.6 \|\|

*āyuḥpradā ca bālānāṃ pātrī rakṣaṇakāriṇī \|*  
*satataṃ śiśupārśvasthā yogādvai siddhiyoginī \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. She bestows long life on the children, protects them by serving as a mid-wife, always remains in the vicinity of the children and is the Siddhiyoginl, well versed in yogic practices.

## \|\| 43.7 \|\|

*tasyāḥ pūjāvidhau brahmannitihāsavidhiṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*yacchrutaṃ dharmamukhataḥ sukhadaṃ putradaṃ param \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О Brahman, I now narrate to you the method of her adoration which has been told to me by Dharma. It is quite pleasant and bestows a son.

## \|\| 43.8 \|\|

*rājā priyavrataścāsītsvāyambhuva manoḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*yogīndro nodvahedbhāryyāṃ tapasyāsu rataḥ sadā \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. In earlier times, king Priyavrata was the son of Svayambhuvamanu who was always engaged in performing tapas. That is why the great ascetic did not marry himself.

## \|\| 43.9 \|\|

*brahmājñayā ca yatnena kṛtadāro babhūva saḥ \|*  
*suciraṃ kṛtadāraśca na lebhe tanayaṃ mune \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Thereafter at the persuasion of lord Brahma he somehow married but could not get a son for a long time.

## \|\| 43.10-11 \|\|

*putreṣṭiyajñaṃ taṃ cāpi kārayāmāsa kaśyapaḥ \|*  
*mālinyai tasya kāntāyai muniryajñacaruṃ dadau \|\| 10 \|\|*

*bhuktvā caruṃ ca tasyāśca sadyo garbho babhūva ha \|*  
*dadhāra taṃ ca sā devī daivaṃ dvādaśavatsaram \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. О sage, thereafter Kashyapa advised him to perform putresti yajira, which he did. His wife named Malini was given the payasam of the yajna, by consuming which she was conceived. She carried on the pregnancy for twelve years in her womb.

## \|\| 43.12 \|\|

*tataḥ suṣāva sā brahmankumāraṃ kanakaprabham \|*  
*sarvāvayavasampannaṃ mṛtamuttāralocanam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О Brahman, thereafter a prince was born to her, having the lustre of gold with all the beautiful limbs but was still born.

## \|\| 43.13 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā ruruduḥ sarvā nāryyo vai bāndhavastriyaḥ \|*  
*mūrcchāmavāpa tanmātā putraśokena suvratā \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Finding the child in that condition, all the ladies present there started crying and the mother of the child fainted out of grief.

## \|\| 43.14 \|\|

*śmaśānaṃ ca yayau rājā gṛhītvā bālakaṃ mune \|*  
*ruroda tatra kāntāre putraṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. О sage, the king carried the child in his arms to the cremation ground and started crying by placing the child's body in the forest.

## \|\| 43.15 \|\|

*notsṛjya bālakaṃ rājā prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyataḥ \|*  
*jñānayogaṃ visasmāra putraśokātsudāruṇāt \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The king was not willing to the company of the child and got prepared even to sacrifice his life for the same because due to the death of the child, his yogic intelligence disappeared.

## \|\| 43.16-17 \|\|

*etasminnantare tatra vimānaṃ ca dadarśa ha \|*  
*śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ maṇirājavirājitam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tejasā jvalitaṃ śaśvacchobhitaṃ kṣaumavāsasā \|*  
*nānācitravicitrāḍhathaṃ puṣpamālā virājitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. In the meantime he spotted a plane which was studded with shining gems and crystals, emitting lustre. It was decorated with silken garments. Besides, astonishing types of things were kept there. It was also decorated with flower garlands.

## \|\| 43.18-19 \|\|

*dadarśa tatra devīṃ ca kamanīyāṃ manoharām \|*  
*śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ ramyasusthirayauvanām \|\| 18 \|\|*

*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|*  
*kṛpāmayīṃ yogasiddhāṃ bhaktānugrahakāriṇīm \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. He found a beautiful damsel seated there who was quite attractive, having the complexion of campaka flowers, quite good-looking, youthful, wearing a smile on her face, adorned with all the ornaments studded with gems. She was well-versed in yogic practices and was the one who graced her devotees.

## \|\| 43.20 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā tāṃ purato rājā tuṣṭāva paramādarāt \|*  
*cakāra pūjanaṃ tasyā vihāya bhuvi bālakam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Finding her there the king offered prayers to her with great devotion and placing the child on the ground he adored the goddess.

## \|\| 43.21 \|\|

*papraccha rājā tāṃ dṛṣṭvā grīṣmasūryyasamaprabhām \|*  
*tejasā jvalitāṃ śāntāṃ kāntāṃ skandasya nārada \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Finding the mother of Skanda there, who possessed the lustre of the mid-day sun of the summer season and dazzling shine, she was quite peaceful. The king then addressed her.

## \|\| 43.22-24 \|\|

*priyavrata uvāca \|*  
*kā tvaṃ suśobhane kānte kasya kāntā'si suvrate \|*  
*kasya kanyā varārohe dhanyā mānyā ca yoṣitām \|\| 22 \|\|*

*nṛpendrasya vacaḥ śrutvā jaganmaṅgaladāyinī \|*  
*uvāca devasenā sā devarakṣaṇakāriṇī \|\| 23 \|\|*

*devānāṃ daityabhītānāṃ purā senā babhūva sā \|*  
*jayaṃ dadau ca tebhyaśca devasenā ca tena sā \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. Priyavrata said — “О beautiful damsel, who are you”? “O chaste lady, who is your husband”? “O damsel, who are your parents”? On hearing the words of the king, the goddess who provides welfare to the universe and provides protection to the gods was known by the name Devasena. She said: “In the earlier times, she happened to be the arm of the gods who were terrified by the demons. She was instrumental in getting the victory for the gods earning her the title Devasena.

## \|\| 43.25 \|\|

*devasenovāca \|*  
*brahmaṇo mānasī kanyā devasenā'hamīśvarī \|*  
*sṛṣṭvā māṃ manaso dhātā dadau skandāya bhūmipa \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Devasena said — О king, I am the mind-bom daughter of Brahma

## \|\| 43.26 \|\|

*mātṛkāsu ca vikhyātā skandasenā ca suvratā \|*  
*viśve ṣaṣṭhīti vikhyātā ṣaṣṭhāṃśā prakṛteryataḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. I am foremost of the Matrkas. I am Skanda-sena, Suvrata and have appeared from the sixth amsa of Prakriti. I am therefore known as SasthI also.

## \|\| 43.27 \|\|

*putradā'hamaputrāya priyadātrī priyāya ca \|*  
*dhanadā ca daridrebhyaḥ kartṛbhyaḥ śubhakarmadā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. I grant sons to those having no sons, beloved to the persons having no wife, riches of the pauper and noble deeds to the performer.

## \|\| 43.28 \|\|

*sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ harṣaṃ maṃgalameva ca \|*  
*sampattiśca vipattiśca sarvaṃ bhavati karmaṇā \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Thus a person gets pleasure, pain, fear, grief, happiness, welfare, riches and misfortune because of his own deeds.

## \|\| 43.29-30 \|\|

*karmaṇā bahuputrī ca vaṃśahīnaśca karmaṇā \|*  
*karmaṇā rūpavāṃścaiva rogī śaśvatsvakarmaṇā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*karmaṇā mṛtaputraśca karmaṇā cirajīvinaḥ \|*  
*karmaṇā guṇavantaśca karmaṇā cāṃgahīnakāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. One gets a son because of his deeds and faces the destruction of the rays because of the same. Because of his own deeds one becomes beautiful or sick and by his own deeds one gets a dead son, because of his own deeds he achieves long life. By one's own deeds, one becomes virtuous and by one's own deeds one is born as deformed.

## \|\| 43.31 \|\|

*tasmātkarma paraṃ rājansarvebhyaśca śrutau śrutam \|*  
*karmarūpī ca bhagavāṃstaddvārā phalado hariḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. О king, therefore actions are the best for all. This has been ordained in the Vedas because the same lord Vishnu provides the reward of actions.

## \|\| 43.32 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā sā devī gṛhītvā bālakaṃ mune \|*  
*mahājñānena sahasā jīvayāmāsa līlayā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. O sage, thus speaking the goddess lifted up the child and infused life into him because of her yogic powers.

## \|\| 43.33-34 \|\|

*rājā dadarśa taṃ bālaṃ sasmitaṃ kanakaprabham \|*  
*devasenā ca paśyantaṃ nṛpamambarameva ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

*gṛhītvā bālakaṃ devī gaganaṃ gantumudyatā \|*  
*punastuṣṭāva tāṃ rājā śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. The king looked at the child who had the lustre of molten gold and was smiling at the same time. While the king was looking at the sky, Devasena tried to carry the child with her in the sky. At that point of time, the throat, tongue and the lips of the king got dried up. He again started offering prayers to the goddess.

## \|\| 43.35 \|\|

*nṛpastotreṇa sā devī parituṣṭā babhūva ha \|*  
*uvāca taṃ nṛpaṃ brahmanvedoktaṃ karma nirmitam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О Brahman, the goddess was pleased at hearing the prayer of the king. She, therefore, spoke to the king about the performing of the deeds as ordained in the Vedas.

## \|\| 43.36 \|\|

*devasenovāca \|*  
*triṣu lokeṣu rājā tvaṃ svāyambhuvamanoḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*mama pūjāṃ ca sarvatra kārayitvā svayaṃ kuru \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Devasena said — You are the son of Svayambhuvamanu and are the ruler of the three worlds; therefore you make all the people to adore me and you also adore me.

## \|\| 43.37-40 \|\|

*tadā dāsyāmi putraṃ te kulapadmaṃ manoharam \|*  
*suvrataṃ nāma vikhyātaṃ guṇavantaṃ supaṇḍitam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*jātismaraṃ ca yogīndraṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇam \|*  
*śatakratukaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kṣattriyāṇāṃ ca vanditam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*mattamātaṅgalakṣāṇāṃ dhṛtavantaṃ balaṃ śubham \|*  
*dhanvinaṃ guṇinaṃ śuddhaṃ viduṣāṃ priyameva ca \|\| 39 \|\|*

*yoginaṃ jñāninaṃ caiva siddharūpaṃ tapasvinam \|*  
*yaśasvinaṃ ca lokeṣu dātāraṃ sarvasampadām \|\| 40 \|\|*

37-40. Only then shall I give back your son who happens to be the lotus of your race. He will be known by the name of Suvrata, will be extremely virtuous, the best of the yogis, devoted to Narayana, will perform a hundred yajnas, the best of people, adored by all the Ksatrlyas, possessing the prowess equivalent to a lakh of elephants, quite pleasant to look at and a great archer. Having many qualities, he will be loved by the intellectuals, yogis, wise people, ascetics, siddhas and will be glorious besides being a distributor of charities in the universe.

## \|\| 43.41 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā sā devī tasmai tadbālakaṃ dadau \|*  
*rājā ca taṃ svīcakāra tatpūjārthaṃ ca suvrataḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Thus speaking the goddess handed over the child to the king, who promised to adore her and get her adored by others also.

## \|\| 43.42-44 \|\|

*jagāma devī svargaṃ ca dattvā tasmai śubhaṃ varam \|*  
*ājagāma mahārājaḥ svagṛhaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ \|*  
*āgatya kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ putrahetukam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*tuṣṭā babhūvuḥ santuṣṭā narā nāryaśca nārada \|*  
*maṅgalaṃ kārayāmāsa sarvatra sutahetukam \|*  
*devīṃ ca pūjayāmāsa brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dadau \|\| 43 \|\|*

*rājā ca pratimāseṣu śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ mahotsavam \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhyā devyāśca yatnena kārayāmāsa sarvataḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. Thereafter, the goddess pronouncing her blessings on the king, went back to her abode. The king, on the other hand, feeling immensely delighted returned to his home and started narrating the story of the reviving of his son. О Narada, on hearing the king, all the people were delighted; the king performed welfare ceremonies for his son everywhere and after performing the puja, he distributed riches to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 43.45-46 \|\|

*bālānāṃ sūtikāgāre ṣaṣṭhāhe yatnapūrvakam \|*  
*tatpūjāṃ kārayāmāsa caikaviṃśativāsare \|\| 45 \|\|*

*bālānāṃ śubhakārye ca śubhānnaprāśane tathā \|*  
*sarvatra varddhayāmāsa svayameva cakāra ha \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. Thereafter the king started celebrating the sixth day of the bright fortnight of the moon as the day of the goddess. In the labour room on the sixth day of the birth of the child, besides the twenty first day, the goddess SasthI is adored.

## \|\| 43.47-48 \|\|

*dhyānaṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca stotraṃ matto niśāmaya \|*  
*yacchrutaṃ dharmavaktreṇa kauthumoktaṃ ca suvrata \|\| 47 \|\|*

*śālagrāme ghaṭe vā'tha vaṭamūle'thavā mune \|*  
*bhittyāṃ puttalikāṃ kṛtvā pūjayedvā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. At the time of performing any welfare ceremony of the children including the annapmsana the goddess SasthI is adored. О Suvrata, now you listen to the dhyclnam method of adoration and stotra of the goddess as has been revealed to me by Dharma according to the Kauthumlsakha.

## \|\| 43.49 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭhāṃśāṃ prakṛteḥ śuddhāṃ supratiṣṭhāṃ ca suvratām \|*  
*suputradāṃ ca śubhadāṃ dayārūpāṃ jagatprasūm \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. О sage, the goddess should be invoked over a Shalagrama stone, a vase, the root of the banyan tree or painting a figure on the wall, the goddess should be adored.

## \|\| 43.50-52 \|\|

*śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|*  
*pavitrarūpāṃ paramāṃ devasenāṃ parāṃ bhaje \|\| 50 \|\|*

*iti dhyātvā svaśirasi puṣpaṃ dattvā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*punardhyātvā ca mūlena pūjayetsuvrataḥ satīm \|\| 51 \|\|*

*pādyārghyācamanīyaiśca gandhadhūpapradīpakaiḥ \|*  
*naivedyairvividhaiścāpi phalena ca śubhena ca \|\| 52\|\|*

50-52. Since she is born of the sixth amsa of Prakriti, she is pure having great glory, a bestower of noble sons, best of welfare, ocean of mercy, mother of the universe, having the complexion of the white campaka flowers, clad in all the ornaments studded with gems. I am, therefore, adoring the best of the goddesses having the auspicious form. Thus thinking, one should place the flower on his head. Then reciting the basic-mantra attentively, he should worship the goddess.

## \|\| 43.53-54 \|\|

*mūlamoṃ hrīṃ ṣaṣṭhīdevye svāheti vidhipūrvakam \|*  
*aṣṭākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ yathāśakti japennaraḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*tatra stutvā ca namate bhaktiyuktaḥ samāhitaḥ \|*  
*stotraṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ dhanaputraphalapradam \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. He should then offer padya, arghya, water for sipping, fragrance, essence, lamp, naivedya and the best of fruits. He should then recite the mantra … with this mantra of eight letters he should perform japam.

## \|\| 43.55 \|\|

*aṣṭākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ lakṣadhā yo japenmune \|*  
*sa putraṃ labhate nūnamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 55\|\|*

55\. He should then prostrate before the goddess with devotion who bestows all the riches and sons and should recite the stotra prescribed in the Sdmaveda.

## \|\| 43.56-57 \|\|

*stotraṃ śṛṇu muniśreṣṭha sarveṣāṃ ca śubhāvaham \|*  
*vāñchāpradaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ gūḍhaṃ vede ca nārada \|\| 56 \|\|*

*priyavrata uvāca \|*  
*namo devyai mahādevyai siddhyai śāntyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*sukhādāyai mokṣadāyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. О sage, whosoever recites this mantra of eight letters a lakh of times surely gets a son. This has been ordained by Brahma himself. О best of the sages, О Narada, I am going to narrate to him the welfare stotra which fiilffls all the desire and is quite secret in the Vedas.

## \|\| 43.58 \|\|

*varadāyai putradāyai dhanadāyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*sukhadāyai mokṣadāyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Priyavrata said — I bow in reverence to the goddess who happens to be the great goddess. She bestows such success and peace. I bow in reverence to her; she provides pleasure and salvation, I bow to the goddess Sasthi.

## \|\| 43.59 \|\|

*śakteḥ ṣaṣṭhāṃśarūpāyai siddhāyai ca namo namaḥ \|*  
*māyāyai siddhayoginyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. She bestows boons besides sons and riches. I bow in reverence to her, I bow to the goddess Sasthi who provides welfare and the pleasure.

## \|\| 43.60 \|\|

*pārāyai pāradāyai ca ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*sārāyai sāradāyai ca pārāyai sarvakarmaṇām \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. She is the sixth part of the shakti and the bestower of success. I bow in reverence to her, I bow in reverence to Maya and goddess Sasthi who is Siddhiyoginl.

## \|\| 43.61 \|\|

*bālādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai ca ṣaṣṭhī devyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*kalyāṇadāyai kalyāṇyai phaladāyai ca karmaṇām \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. She has the best of the form, she has turned the people as best. I offer my salutation to goddess Sasthi, who is the essence of the universe and bestows the essence of pleasure to all besides providing fruits for all the deeds. She is the prisiding goddess of the children; I bow in reverence to goddess Sasthi who provides welfare, is the form of welfare and provides the result of all the deeds.

## \|\| 43.62-64 \|\|

*pratyakṣāyai ca bhaktānāṃ ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*pūjyāyai skandakāntāyai sarveṣāṃ sarvakarmasu \|\| 62 \|\|*

*devarakṣaṇakāriṇyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*śuddhasattvasvarūpāyai vanditāyai nṛṇāṃ sadā \|\| 63 \|\|*

*hiṃsākrodhairvarjitāyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*dhanaṃ dehi priyāṃ dehi putraṃ dehi sureśvari \|\| 64 \|\|*

62-64. Who appears in person before devotees, I bow in reverence to the goddess Sasthi, who is the beloved of Skanda and is adored by all the people at all times. I bow in reverence to the goddess who provides protection to all the gods and has the true sattva form is adored by all the human beings, is free from violence and anger. I bow in reverence to the goddess Sasthi.

## \|\| 43.65 \|\|

*dharmaṃ dehi yaśo dehi ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*\|\| 65\|\|*

65\. О great goddess, provide me with wealth, a wife and a son. You provide me with dharma and glory. I bow in reverence to the goddess Sast hi again and again.

## \|\| 43.66 \|\|

*bhūmiṃ dehi prajāṃ dehi dehi vidyāṃ supūjite \|*  
*kalyāṇaṃ ca jayaṃ dehi ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. О most revered one, you provide me with land, progeny and learning. You provide me the welfare together with victory. I bow in reverence to goddess Sasthi again and again.

## \|\| 43.67 \|\|

*iti devīṃ ca saṃstūya lebhe putraṃ priyavrataḥ \|*  
*yaśasvinaṃ ca rājendraṃ ṣaṣṭhīdevīprasādataḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Thus offering prayers to the goddess Priyavrata got back the life of his son who became a popular king by the grace of goddess Sasthi.

## \|\| 43.68-69 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭhīstotramidaṃ brahmanyaḥ śṛṇoti ca vatsaram \|*  
*aputro labhate putraṃ varaṃ sucirajīvinam \|\| 68 \|\|*

*varṣamekaṃ ca yā bhaktyā saṃyattedaṃ śṛṇoti ca \|*  
*sarvapāpādvinirmuktā mahāvandhyā prasūyate \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. О Brahman, the one who listens to the stotra for a Sasthi for a year gets a son, having a long life. In case a woman recites this stotra with devotion or listens to it, she gets a beautiful son in spite of her being quite barren.

## \|\| 43.70-72 \|\|

*vīraputraṃ ca guṇinaṃ vidyāvantaṃ yaśasvinam \|*  
*sucirāyuṣmantameva ṣaṣṭhīmātṛprasādataḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*kākavandhyā ca yā nārī mṛtāpatyā ca yā bhavet \|*  
*varṣaṃ śrutvā labhetputraṃ ṣaṣṭhīdevīprasādataḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

*rogayukte ca bāle ca pitā mātā śṛṇoti ca \|*  
*māsaṃ ca mucyate bālaḥ ṣaṣṭhīdevīprasādataḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

70-72. She gets a son by the grace of goddess SasthI who is quite valorous, virtuous, wise, glorious and possessing a long life. The extremely barren lady and such of the ladies whose children never survive, if they recite the stotra for a year or listen to it, they get a son by the grace of goddess SasthI. If the parents of a child who is seriously ailing, listen to the stotra for a month, then by the grace of goddess SasthI, the child is relieved of all ailments.

## Chapter 44

## \|\| 44.1-2 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*kathitaṃ ṣaṣṭhyupākhyānaṃ brahmaputra yathāgamam \|*  
*devī maṅgalacaṇḍī ca tadākhyānaṃ niśāmaya \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tasyāḥ pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ dharmavaktrācca yacchrutam \|*  
*śrutisammatameveṣṭaṃ sarveṣāṃ viduṣāmapi \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narayana said — О son of Brahma, you have heard the story of goddess SasthI as prescribed in the Vedas. I am now going to tell you the story of goddess Mangalachandi. Whatever I had heard from the mouth of Dharma and other intellectuals about the story of Mangalachandi. I am going to speak out the same.

## \|\| 44.3-4 \|\|

*caṇḍāyāṃ varttate caṇḍī jāgratī śatrumaṇḍale \|*  
*maṅgaleṣu ca yā dakṣā maṅgalā saiva caṇḍikā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*durgāyāṃ vidyate caṇḍī maṅgalo'pi mahīsute \|*  
*maṅgalā'bhīṣṭadevī yā sā syānmaṅgalacaṇḍikā \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. The word chandl is used in the sense of rage. That is why the goddess chandl remains among the enemies and being well-versed in the performing of welfare deeds, she is called Mangalachandi. The word chandl is also used for Durga and Mangala is known as the son of the earth goddess. Therefore the process who bestowed success on Mangala is called Mangalachandi.

## \|\| 44.5 \|\|

*maṃgalo manuvaṃśaśca saptadvīpāvanīpatiḥ \|*  
*tasya pūjyā'bhīṣṭadevī tena maṃgalacaṇḍikā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Mangala is born in the race of Manu and happened to be the lord of all the seven continents of the earth. The goddess who was adored by him and the one who granted success to him, was given the name of Mangalachandi.

## \|\| 44.6 \|\|

*mūrttibhedena sā durgā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|*  
*kṛpārūpā'tipratyakṣā yoṣitāmiṣṭadevatā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. She is also known as Durga, dhlsvarl, MiilaPrakriti and the great goddess of the ladies. Taking to the compassionate form she always appears before them.

## \|\| 44.7 \|\|

*prathame pūjitā sā ca śaṅkareṇa purā parā \|*  
*tripurasya vadhe ghoraṃ viṣṇunā preritena ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О Brahman, in the earlier times when Tripurasura was to be killed then at the instance of lord Vishnu, lord Shiva first of all adored this goddess.

## \|\| 44.8-9 \|\|

*brahmanbrahmopadeśena durgaprasthe ca saṅkaṭe \|*  
*ākāśātpatite yāne ruṣā daityena pātite \|\| 8 \|\|*

*brahmaviṣṇūpadiṣṭaśca durgāṃ tuṣṭāva śaṅkaraḥ \|*  
*sā ca maṃgalacaṇḍīyamabhavadrūpabhedataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Thereafter finding his own fort in danger, the demon Tripurasura getting enraged threw away the chariot of Shiva from space. Thereafter at the advice of Brahma and Vishnu, lord Shiva adored Durga. She therefore appeared in the form of Mangalachandi.

## \|\| 44.10 \|\|

*uvāca purataḥ śambhorbhayaṃ nāstīti te prabho \|*  
*bhagavānvṛṣarūpaśca sarveśaśca babhūva ha \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Standing before Shiva, she then asked him, О lord, now you need not be afraid because the bull who is the lord of all has come to serve you as your vehicle.

## \|\| 44.11-12 \|\|

*yuddhaśaktisvarūpā'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi tadājñayā \|*  
*mayā''tmanā ca hariṇā sahāyena vṛṣadhvaja \|\| 11 \|\|*

*jahi daityaṃ ca deveśa surāṇāṃ padaghātakam \|*  
*ityuktvā'ntarhitā devī śambhoḥ śaktirbabhūva sā \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. О Vrsadhvaja, at the command of the lord, I shall take to the form of the force of battle. О lord, thus with my efforts and the help of the lord, you better kill the terrific demon. Thus speaking the goddess disappeared and she became the strength of lord Shiva. О best of the sages, thereafter lord Mahadeva, the husband of Uma, destroyed the demon with the weapons provided to him by lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 44.13-20 \|\|

*viṣṇudattena śastreṇa jaghāna tamumāpatiḥ \|*  
*munīndra patite daitye sarve devā maharṣayaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṃkaraṃ devā bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ \|*  
*sadyaḥ śirasi śambhośca puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha \|\| 14 \|\|*

*brahmā viṣṇuśca santuṣṭo dadau tasmai śubhāśiṣam \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇūpadiṣṭaśca susnātaḥ śaṅkaraḥ śuciḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*pūjayāmāsa tāṃ śaktiṃ devīṃ maṅgalacaṇḍikām \|*  
*pādyārghyācamanīyaiśca balibhirvividhairapi \|\| 16 \|\|*

*puṣpacandananaivedyairbhaktyā nānāvidhairmune \|*  
*chāgairmeṣaiśca mahiṣairgaṇḍairmāyāvibhirvaraiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*vastrālaṅkāramālyaiśca pāyasaiḥ piṣṭakairapi \|*  
*madhubhiśca sudhābhiśca pakvairnānāvidhaiḥ phalaiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*saṅgītairnarttanairvādyairutsavaiḥ kṛṣṇakīrttanaiḥ \|*  
*dhyātvā mādhyandinoktena dhyānena vidhipūrvakam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*dadau dravyāṇi mūlena mantreṇaiva ca nārada \|*  
*oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ sarvapūjye devi maṅgalacaṇḍike \|*  
*aiṃ krūṃ phaṭsvāhetyevaṃ cāpyekaviṃśākṣaro manuḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

13-20. Then after the death of the demon all the gods and sages adored Shiva with devotion bowing their heads. At the same time a shower of flowers started falling over the head of Shiva. Both Brahma and Vishnu feeling extremely satisfied, blessed Shiva variously. At the advice of Brahma and Vishnu, Shiva took a bath properly and getting purified, he worshipped the goddess Mangalachandl who possessed the great force, offering padya, arghya, sipping water and various types of offerings including flowers, sandal-paste and naivedyas of different types. О sage, similarly goats, sheep, buffaloes, rhinos, magicians, clothes, ornaments, garland, payasam, fried sweets, honey, nectar and various types of ripe fruits were offered. All the gods in ecstasy danced together with lord Krishna accompanied by divine music and singing. They also started reciting the miilamantra as prescribed by the Madhyandini-sakha. О Narada, then they recited twenty-one letter mantra which is ओं हीं श्री क्लीं सर्वपूज्ये देवि मंगचण्डिके T करू फट् स्वाहा This is the great twenty-one letters mantra.

## \|\| 44.21-22 \|\|

*pūjyaḥ kalpataruścaiva bhaktānāṃ sarvakāmadaḥ \|*  
*daśalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām \|\| 21 \|\|*

*mantrasiddhirbhavedyasya sa viṣṇuḥ sarvakāmadaḥ \|*  
*dhyānaṃ ca śrūyatāṃ brahmanvedoktaṃ sarvasammatam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. This is adorable for the devotees and makes all the desires successful like a kalpataru. By reciting ten lakhs of this mantra a person achieves success. And the one who achieves the Mantrasiddlii, becomes lord Vishnu the bestower of all the success. О Brahmana, now listen to the stotra of the goddess which is well known in the Vedas.

## \|\| 44.23 \|\|

*devīṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ ramyāṃ susthirayauvanām \|*  
*sarvarūpaguṇāḍhyāṃ ca komalāṃgīṃ manoharām \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. I am adoring the goddess of sixteen years who is quite beautiful, is quite youthful, possesses all the qualities, has tender and beautiful limbs.

## \|\| 44.24-27 \|\|

*śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ candrakoṭisamaprabhām \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|\| 24 \|\|*

*bibhratīṃ kabarībhāraṃ mallikāmālyabhūṣitam \|*  
*bimboṣṭhīṃ sudatīṃ śuddhāṃ śaratpadmanibhānanām \|\| 25 \|\|*

*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ sunīlotpalalocanām \|*  
*jagaddhātrīṃ ca dātrīṃ ca sarvebhyaḥ sarvasampadām \|\| 26 \|\|*

*saṃsārasāgare ghore potarūpāṃ varāṃ bhaje \|\| 27 \|\|*

24-27. She has the complexion resembling the white campaka flower, has the glory and the lustre of crores of moons, pure like fire, clad in the sanctified garments and adorned with the gem-studded ornaments. She is having beautiful hair. Her hair is adorned with flowers, her lips are like the ripe wood-apple fruit. She possesses a beautiful line of teeth. She has a pure complexion and her face resembles the lotus flower of the winter season. She wears a serene smile ovn her face. Her eyes resemble the blue lotus flower. She is the base of the universe and is the bestower of all the riches and carries the people across the terrific ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 44.28 \|\|

*devyāśca dhyānamityevaṃ stavanaṃ śrūyatāṃ mune \|*  
*prayataḥ saṅkaṭagrasto yena tuṣṭāva śaṅkaraḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О sage, this is the dhyanam of the goddess; now you listen to her stuti, reciting which lord Shiva had adored her at the time of danger.

## \|\| 44.29 \|\|

*śaṅkara uvāca \|*  
*rakṣa rakṣa jaganmātardevi maṃgalacaṇḍike \|*  
*saṃhartri vipadāṃ rāśerharṣamaṃgalakārike \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Shiva said — О goddess Mangalachandl you are the mother of the universe, you protect us, you are the destroyer of misfortune and provide pleasure and welfare to the people.

## \|\| 44.30 \|\|

*harṣamaṃgaladakṣe ca harṣamaṃgalacaṇḍike \|*  
*śubhe maṃgaladakṣe ca śubhamaṃgala caṇḍike \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. You are well-versed in providing pleasure and welfare and are the form of welfare. You provide pleasant welfare; that is why you are called Mangalachandl.

## \|\| 44.31 \|\|

*maṃgale maṅgalārhe ca sarvamaṃgalamaṃgale \|*  
*satāṃ maṃgalade devi sarveṣāṃ maṃgalālaye \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. You are full of welfare, the form of welfare and are the welfare for all the welfares. О goddess, you provide welfare to the noble people, you happen to be the treasure of welfare.

## \|\| 44.32-33 \|\|

*pūjyā maṃgalavāre ca maṃgalābhīṣṭadaivate \|*  
*pūjye maṃgalabhūpasya manuvaṃśasya santatam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*maṃgalādhiṣṭhātṛdevi maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgale \|*  
*saṃsāre maṃgalādhāre mokṣamaṃgaladāyini \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. You are adored on Tuesdays. You are the great goddess of the welfare and are immensely adorable by the king Mangala. О great goddess of welfare you are the welfare for all the welfare. You are the base of all the welfare and also provide the welfare in salvation.

## \|\| 44.34 \|\|

*sāre ca maṃgalādhāre pāre tvaṃ sarvakarmaṇām \|*  
*pratimaṃgalavāraṃ ca pūjye tvaṃ maṃgalaprade \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. You are the essence of all, the base of welfare, beyond all the deeds and are adorable by the welfare and provide welfare to all.

## \|\| 44.35 \|\|

*stotreṇānena śambhuśca stutvā magalacaṇḍikām \|*  
*pratimaṃgalavāre ca pūjāṃ kṛtvā gataḥ śivaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. By reciting this stotra, lord Shiva worshipped Mangalachandika and adoring her on Tuesday went for war.

## \|\| 44.36 \|\|

*devyāśca maṃgalastotraṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ \|*  
*tanmaṃgalaṃ bhavecchaśvanna bhavettadamaṃgalam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Whosoever recites the welfare stotra of the goddess Mangalachandl, always meets with welfare arid never has to face misery.

## \|\| 44.37-41 \|\|

*prathame pūjitā devī śambhunā sarvamaṃgalā \|*  
*dvitīye pūjitā devī maṃgalena graheṇa ca \|\| 37 \|\|*

*tṛtīye pūjitā bhadrā maṃgalena nṛpeṇa ca \|*  
*caturthe maṃgale vāre sundarībhiśca pūjitā \|*  
*pañcame maṅgalākāṃkṣairnarairmaṃgalacaṇḍikā \|\| 38 \|\|*

*pūjitā prativiśveṣu viśveśaiḥ pūjitā sadā \|*  
*tataḥ sarvatra saṃpūjya sā babhūva sureśvarī \|\| 39 \|\|*

*devādibhiśca munibhirmanubhirmānavairmune \|*  
*devyāśca maṅgalastotraṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tanmaṃgalaṃ bhavecchaśvanna bhavettadamaṃgalam \|*  
*varddhante tatputrapautrā maṃgalaṃ ca dine dine \|\| 41 \|\|*

37-41. Thus the goddess Mangala was adored by lord Shiva on Tuesday. On the next Tuesday the planet Mangala adored her. On the third Tuesday the goddess Bhadra was worshipped by the king Mangala and on the fourth Tuesday all the damsels adored her. On the fifth Tuesday all the people adored the goddess with the desire of achieving welfare. Thus all the gods adored her at all the times. О saf 2, the gods, the ascetics, the mendicants and the humans also adore her and thereafter she was adored at all the places by the people. Whosoever recites or listens to the Mangala-stolra of the goddess, always meets with welfare and misfortune never approaches him. He always has increase in his%ons and grandsons.

## Chapter 45

## \|\| 45.1 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*uktaṃ dvayorupākhyānaṃ brahmaputra yathāgamam \|*  
*śrūyatāṃ manasākhyānaṃ yacchrutaṃ dharmavaktrataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said — О son of Brahma, I have narrated to you the stories of both the goddesses; now I tell you the story of Manasa which I had heard from the mouth of Dharma. You please listen to it.

## \|\| 45.2 \|\|

*kanyā bhagavatī sā ca kaśyapasya ca mānasī \|*  
*teneyaṃ manasādevī manasā yā ca dīvyati \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The goddess was born from the mind of Kashyapa and therefore she was known by the name of Manasa. She plays with the mind.

## \|\| 45.3 \|\|

*manasā dhyāyate yā vā paramātmānamīśvaram \|*  
*tena sā manasādevī yogenaitena dīvyati \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. She adores the lord who happens to be the supreme-soul by devoting her mind to him by means of yogic practices. As such she shines in the universe with her yogic practices.

## \|\| 45.4 \|\|

*ātmārāmā ca sā devī vaiṣṇavī siddhayoginī \|*  
*triyugaṃ ca tapastaptvā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. She is Vaishnavl and Siddhayogini who by concentrating her mind performed tapas for lord Krishna for three yugas.

## \|\| 45.5-6 \|\|

*jaratkāruśarīraṃ ca dṛṣṭvā yāṃ kṣaṇamīśvaraḥ \|*  
*gopīpatirnāma cakre jaratkāruriti prabhuḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*vāñchitaṃ ca dadau tasyai kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*pūjāṃ ca kārayāmāsa cakāra ca punaḥ svayam \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Thereafter Krishna the lord of go pis took the form of the sage named Jaratkaru, the compassionate one, with the intention of fulfilling her desire, made her adore the lord eternal.

## \|\| 45.7-8 \|\|

*svarge ca nāgaloke ca pṛthivyāṃ bahmalokataḥ \|*  
*bhṛśaṃ japatsu gaurī sā sundarī ca manoharā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*jagadgaurīti vikhyātā tena sā pūjitā satī \|*  
*śivaśiṣyā ca sā devī tena śaivīti kīrttitā \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. She had extremely fair complexion in all the damsels of heaven, Ndgaloka, Brahmaloka and the earth; she was quite charming and beautiful, because of which she was adored in the universe as Jagatgauri. Since she happened to be the disciple of lord, Shiva she was known as Saivl.

## \|\| 45.9-13 \|\|

*viṣṇubhaktā'tīva ramyā vaiṣṇavī tena nārada \|*  
*nāgānāṃ prāṇarakṣitrī janamejayayajñake \|\| 9 \|\|*

*nāgeśvarīti vikhyātā sā nāgabhaginī tathā \|*  
*viṣaṃ saṃharttumīśā sā tena sā viṣahāriṇī \|\| 10 \|\|*

*siddhaṃ yogaṃ harātprāpa tenāsau siddhayoginī \|*  
*mahājñānaṃ ca gopyaṃ ca mṛtasañjīvinīṃ parām \|\| 11 \|\|*

*mahājñānayutāṃ tāṃ ca pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*āstīkasya munīndrasya mātā sā vai tapasvinaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*āstīkamātā vikhyātā jaratkāruriti sma sā \|*  
*priyā munerjaratkārormunīndrasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

9-13. О Narada, since she was immensely devoted to lord Vishnu, she was also known as Vaishnavi. It was she who protected the serpent from perishing in the serpent yajna performed by Janamejaya. Because of that, she came to be known as Nageshvari. Since she happened to be the sister of the Nagas, she is in a position to remove the ill-effect of poison. Since she has been performing the yoga of Shiva she is known as Siddhayoginl. She is aware of the great secret knowledge and the method of reviving the dead back to life. Because of this the intellectuals call her as the one who possesses immense wisdom; she happens to be the mother of the sage Astika. Because of her being the mother of Astika she is known as Jaratkaru also. She happens to be the beloved of the great sage and ascetic named Jaratkaru who was held in high esteem in the universe.

## \|\| 45.14-16 \|\|

*yogino viśvapūjyasya jaratkāroḥ priyā tataḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*oṃ namo manasāyai \|*  
*jaratkārurjagadgaurī manasā siddhayoginī \|*  
*vaiṣṇavī nāgabhaginī śaivī nāgeśvarī tathā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*jaratkārupriyā''stīkamātā viṣaharīti ca \|*  
*mahājñānayutā caiva sā devī viśvapūjitā \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. Her mantra is ‘…’. She is known by the twelve epithets of Jaratkaru, JagatGauri, Manasa, Siddhayoginl, Vaishnavi, Nagabhagini, SaivI, Nageshvari, beloved of Jaratkaru, mother of Astika, remover of poison and the one possessing immense wisdom. She is known by these twelve names and is adored the world over.

## \|\| 45.17 \|\|

*dvādaśaitāni nāmāni pūjākāle ca yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*tasya nāgabhayaṃ nasti tasya vaṃśodbhavasya ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Therefore the one who recites these twelve names at the time of performing puja, he and his entire family is relieved of the danger of snakes.

## \|\| 45.18-19 \|\|

*nāgabhīde ca śayane nāgagraste ca mandire \|*  
*nāgakṣate nāgadurge nāgaveṣṭitavigrahe \|\| 18 \|\|*

*idaṃ stotraṃ paṭhitvā tu mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*nityaṃ paṭhedyastaṃ dṛṣṭvā nāgavargaḥ palāyate \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Therefore when a person finds the danger of the snakes while sleeping or resides in a house infested with serpents, at the time of biting by snakes, while in the fort of the serpent or when one is entangled with the serpents round his body, the recitation of this stotra relieves one of all the dangers from the snakes. With the recitation of the stotra daily, the group of serpents flee from the place.

## \|\| 45.20-21 \|\|

*daśalakṣajapenaiva stotrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām \|*  
*stotraṃ siddhaṃ bhavedyasya sa viṣaṃ bhoktumīśvaraḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*nāgaughaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā sa bhavennāgavāhanaḥ \|*  
*nāgāsano nāgatalpo mahā siddho bhavennaraḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. One meets with success after reciting this stotra ten lakhs of time. When a person achieves siddhi by reciting her mantra he remains alive even after consuming the poison which has no effect on his body. Such a person uses the snakes as the ornaments of the body besides using them as his vehicles. Such of the persons who achieves great siddhi use serpents as their seats and beds.

## Chapter 46

## \|\| 46.1 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*pūjāvidhānaṃ stotraṃ ca śrūyatāṃ munipuṃgava \|*  
*dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ devīpūjāvidhānakam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said — О best among the sages, now I tell you the method of her adoration and the stotra as prescribed in the Samaveda besides the dhydna. You listen to it attentively.

## \|\| 46.2-3 \|\|

*śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ nāgayajñopavītinīm \|\| 2 \|\|*

*mahājñānayutāṃ caiva pravarāṃ jñānināṃ satām \|*  
*siddhādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca siddhāṃ siddhipradāṃ bhaje \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. She has the complexion of white campaka flowers; is adored with all the ornaments studded with gems, clad in the garments purified by the gold of fire. She wears the yajhopavlta of the Nagas, possesses immense wisdom and is the best among the intellectuals. She is the chief goddess of the siddhas, she is the form of siddhi and grants success to all. I adore such a goddess.

## \|\| 46.4 \|\|

*iti dhyātvā ca tāṃ devīṃ mūlenaiva prapūjayet \|*  
*naivedyairvividhairdīpaiḥ puṣpairdhūpānulepanaiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. One should adore the goddess reciting the basic mantra. One should offer naivedya, lamp, flowers, essence, paste of sandal-wood and then adore her.

## \|\| 46.5-6 \|\|

*mūlamantraśca vedokto bhaktānāṃ vāñchitapradaḥ \|*  
*mūlakalpatarurnāma susiddho dvādaśākṣaraḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ krīṃ aiṃ manasādevyai svāheti kīrtitaḥ \|*  
*pañcalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Kalpataru is the root of the basic mantra which bestows success on the devotees according to the provision of the Vedas. It grants success and her mantra comprises of twelve letters. The main mantra is ‘ …

## \|\| 46.7 \|\|

*mantrasiddhirbhavedyasya sa siddho jagatītale \|*  
*sudhāsamaṃ viṣaṃ tasya dhanvantarisamo bhavet \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. And the one who achieves siddhi, he is termed as the siddha in the universe. For him his wish turns as a nectar and he equates himself with Dhanvantari.

## \|\| 46.8 \|\|

*brahmannāṣāḍhasaṃkrāntyāṃ guḍāśākhāsu yatnataḥ \|*  
*āvāhya devīṃ māsāntaṃ pūjayedyo hi bhaktitaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О Brahman, on the first day of the month of Asadha one should invoke the goddess Manasa in the branch of a cotton plant and should adore her with devotion. On the fifth day of the moon, one who makes the offering to the goddess Manasadevi receives immense riches, sons and great glory. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 46.9-10 \|\|

*pañcamyāṃ mānasākhyāyāṃ devyai dadyācca yo balim \|*

*pūjāvidhānaṃ kathitaṃ tadākhyānaṃ niśāmaya \|*

9-10. О sage, I have thus apprised you of the method of adoration of the goddess. Now I speak out to you the story about her, which I had heard from Dharma. Please listen to it.

## \|\| 46.11 \|\|

*purā nāgabhayākrāntā babhūvurmānavā bhuvi \|*  
*yānyānkhādanti nāgāśca na te jīvanti nārada \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. О Narada, in the earlier times the people of earth were feeling half dead because of the danger from the serpents. This was because such of the people as were bitten by the snakes could never survive.

## \|\| 46.12 \|\|

*mantrāṃśca sasṛje bhītaḥ kaśyapo brahmaṇā'rthitaḥ \|*  
*vedabījānusāreṇa copadeśena vedhasaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Thereafter at the instance of Brahma, the terrified Kashyapa composed mantras which were based on the Vedas.

## \|\| 46.13 \|\|

*mantrādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ tāṃ mānasāṃ sasṛje tataḥ \|*  
*tapasā manasā tena mānasā sā babhūva ha \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Then by performing tapas they pleased the goddess Manasa who is considered to be the supreme goddess of the mantras. This is the reason why she was given the name of Manasa.

## \|\| 46.14 \|\|

*kumārī sā ca saṃbhūya cāgamacchaṅkarālayam \|*  
*bhaktyā sampūjya kailāse tuṣṭuve candraśekharam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. After her birth, the goddess Manasa immediately went to Kailasa, the abode of lord Shiva and started adoring lord Shiva having the crescent over his head.

## \|\| 46.15 \|\|

*divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca taṃ siṣeve muneḥ sutā \|*  
*āśutoṣo maheśaśca tāṃ ca tuṣṭo babhūva ha \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The daughter of the sage performed tapas for Shiva for a thousand divine years. Thereafter Asutosa Shiva was pleased with her.

## \|\| 46.16 \|\|

*mahājñānaṃ dadau tasyai pāṭhayāmāsa sāma ca \|*  
*kṛṣṇamantraṃ kalpataruṃ dadāvaṣṭākṣaraṃ mune \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O sage, imparting to her immense knowledge, he made her study the Samaveda. He also gave to her the eight-lettered mantra of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 46.17-19 \|\|

*lakṣmīmāyākāmabīja ṅentaṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ tathā \|*

*trailokyamaṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ pūjanakramam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*stavanaṃ sarvapūjyaṃ ca dhyānaṃ bhuvanapāvanam \|*  
*puraścaryyākramaṃ cāpi vedoktaṃ sarvasammatam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*prāpya mṛtyuñjayājjñānaṃ paraṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ satī \|*  
*jagāma tapase sādhvī puṣkaraṃ śaṅkarājñayā \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. The mantra was formed with Lakshmi, Maya, Kama as the seed and with the adding of the fourth form and Krishna. The mantra was read as … ’ i Its kavacha, the sequence of adoration and the stuti which is recited by all, the dhyanam which purifies the universe and the anusthanam besides ahyanam purifies the universe and bestows the knowledge of overpowering death. The chaste goddess achieved the knowledge of over powering the death. With the permission of the lord, she went to the Puskara-ksetra for performing tapas.

## \|\| 46.20 \|\|

*triyugaṃ ca tapastaptvā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*siddhā babhūva sā devī dadarśa purataḥ prabhum \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. She performed tapas for lord Krishna for three yugas. At the time of achieving success, she found the lord before her physically present.

## \|\| 46.21 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā kṛśāṅgīṃ bālāṃ ca kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*pūjāṃ ca kārayāmāsa cakāra ca hariḥ svayam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Thereafter, the compassionate lord, made the goddess Manasa, who had become free, lean and thin, adore him and he himself also adored her.

## \|\| 46.22 \|\|

*varaṃ ca pradadau tasyai pūjitā tvaṃ bhave bhava \|*  
*varaṃ dattvā ca kalyāṇyai sadyaścāntardadhe vibhuḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. He then pronounced a boon on her thus, “You will be adored the world over”. Thus blessing her with a boon, lord Krishna disappeared.

## \|\| 46.23-24 \|\|

*prathame pūjitā sā ca kṛṣṇena paramātmanā \|*  
*dvitīye śaṅkareṇaiva kaśyapena sureṇa ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

*manunā muninā caiva hyahinā mānavādinā \|*  
*babhūva pūjitā sā ca triṣu lokeṣu suśrutā \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Thus she was adored by lord Krishna first of all. Thereafter Shiva did so, followed by Kashyapa and the other gods besides Manu, the sages, the serpents and human beings. Thus the chaste goddess was adored in the three worlds.

## \|\| 46.25 \|\|

*jaratkārumunīndrāya kaśyapastāṃ dadau purā \|*  
*ayācito muniśreṣṭho jagrāha brāhmaṇājñayā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. In the earlier times Kashyapa had handed her over to Jaratkaru, though the sage never desired for her, but he had to accept her because of the command of the Brahma.

## \|\| 46.26 \|\|

*kṛtvodvāhaṃ mahāyogī viśrāntastapasā ciram \|*  
*suṣvāpa devyā jaghane vaṭamūle ca puṣkare \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. After the marriage Jaratkaru the great yogi thought of having a respite from the prolonged tapas. With the above purpose in view, he lay down under the shade of a banyan tree placing his head on the thigh of the chaste lady and slept there.

## \|\| 46.27 \|\|

*nidrāṃ jagāma sa muniḥ smṛtvā nidreśamīśvaram \|*  
*jagāmāstaṃ dinakaraḥ sāyaṃkāla upasthitaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Thereafter, thinking about the lord who is the lord of sleep as well, he went to sleep and remained in that position till the evening.

## \|\| 46.28-29 \|\|

*saṃcintya manasā tatra manasā ca pativratā \|*  
*dharmmalopabhayenaiva cakārālocanaṃ satī \|\| 28 \|\|*

*akṛtvā paścimāṃ sandhyāṃ nityāṃ caiva dvijanmanām \|*  
*brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ labhiṣyati patirmama \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. At that point of time, the chaste Manasa variously considered in her mind about the passage of time and the decrease of dharma, thus, “In case my husband is unable to perform the daily sandhya in the evening, he would earn the sin of Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 46.30 \|\|

*nopatiṣṭhati yaḥ pūrvāṃ nopāste yaśca paścimām \|*  
*sa sarvadā'śucirnityaṃ brahmahatyādikaṃ labhet \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Because, the one who does not perform sandhya in the morning and evening regularly, he becomes impure and attracts Brahmahatya and other sins.

## \|\| 46.31 \|\|

*vedoktamiti saṃcintya bodhayāmāsa taṃ munim \|*  
*sa ca buddhvā muniśreṣṭhastāṃ cukopa bhṛśaṃ muniḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. She considered all these aspects in the background of the Vedas and she therefore made the sage to wake up but when awake the sage was immensely enraged.

## \|\| 46.32 \|\|

*jaratkāruruvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ me suvrate sādhvi nidrābhaṅgaḥ kṛtastvayā \|*  
*vyarthaṃ vratādikaṃ tasyā yā bharttuścāpakāriṇī \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Jaratkaru said — О chaste lady, why did you disturb my sleep? The lady who indulges in the evil of her husband, all her tapas and vratas become infructuous.

## \|\| 46.33 \|\|

*tapaścānaśanaṃ caiva vrataṃ dānādikaṃ ca yat \|*  
*bharturapriyakāriṇyāḥ sarvaṃ bhavati niṣphalam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Similarly the wife who does wrong to her husband, all her tapas, fasting, vratas, charities and all the noble deeds become infructuous.

## \|\| 46.34 \|\|

*yayā patiḥ pūjitaśca śrīkṛṣṇaḥ pūjitastayā \|*  
*pativratāvratārthaṃ ca patirūpī hariḥ svayam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Because whosoever adores her husband it amounts to adoring lord Krishna; thus for the performing of the vratas of the chaste lady, the lord Krishna himself appears in the form of her husband.

## \|\| 46.35-36 \|\|

*sarvadānaṃ sarvayajñaḥ sarvatīrthaniṣevaṇam \|*  
*sarvaṃ tapo vrataṃ sarvamupavāsādikaṃ ca yat \|\| 35 \|\|*

*sarvadharmaśca satyaṃ ca sarvadevaprapūjanam \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ svāmisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. Therefore all the charities, the yajhas, visiting of the holy places, performing of all types of tapas, vratas, fasting, the religious practices, truthfulness, adoration of all the gods, all these combined do not weigh even the sixteenth ray as compared to the adoration of the husband.

## \|\| 46.37 \|\|

*supuṇye bhārate varṣe patisevā karoti yā \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhaṃ svāminā sārddhaṃ sā yāti brahmaṇaḥ padam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Therefore in the sacred land of Bharata, a lady who serves her husband goes to Vaikuntha and Brahmaloka with her husband.

## \|\| 46.38 \|\|

*vipriyaṃ kurute bharturvipriyaṃ vadati priyam \|*  
*asatkulaprajātā yā tatphalaṃ śrūyatāṃ sati \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. A wife who does not belong to the high family, always engages herself in causing harm to her husband, speaking harsh words. The sufferings she has to face are being told by me. You listen to it.

## \|\| 46.39 \|\|

*kumbhīpākaṃ vrajetsā ca yāvaccandradivākarau \|*  
*tato bhavati cāṇḍālī patiputravivarjitā \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Because of that sin she falls into the Kumbhlpaka hell and is ultimately born as a Chandala woman having no husband or son.

## \|\| 46.40 \|\|

*ityuktvā ca muniśreṣṭho babhūva sphuritādharaḥ \|*  
*cakampe manasā sādhvī bhayenovā ca taṃ patim \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. While thus speaking, the lips of the sage were fluttering. At the sight of her husband the chaste goddess trembled in fear and spoke to him.

## \|\| 46.41 \|\|

*manasovāca \|*  
*sandhyālopabhayenaiva nidrābhaṅgaḥ kṛtastava \|*  
*kuru śāntiṃ mahābhāga duṣṭāyā mama suvrata \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Manasa said — О great saint, О noble one, I woke you up because the time for performing sandhya was running out. Therefore, you award peace to a wicked person like me.

## \|\| 46.42 \|\|

*śṛṅgārāhāranidrāṇāṃ yaśca bhaṅgaṃ karoti ca \|*  
*sa vrajetkālasūtraṃ ca svāminaśca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*
