42\. Because the one who disturbs in the make up of the body or while taking up food and sleep, he falls into the kalasiitra hell and by committing the same sin as the husband, one gets the same punishment.

## \|\| 46.43 \|\|

*ityuktvā manasā devī svāminaścaraṇāmbuje \|*  
*papāta bhaktyā bhītā ca ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Thus speaking, feeling panicky with her mind filled with devotion, she fell at the feet of her husband and started crying.

## \|\| 46.44 \|\|

*kupitaṃ ca muniṃ dṛṣṭvā śrīsūryyaṃ śaptumudyatam \|*  
*tatrājagāma bhagavānsandhyayā saha nārada \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. О Narada, realising that the enraged ascetic was about to pronounce a curse on Surya, the sun god himself arrived there together with sandhya.

## \|\| 46.45 \|\|

*tatrāgatya muniśreṣṭhamavocadbhāskaraḥ svayam \|*  
*vinayena vinītaśca tayā saha yathocitam \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Reaching there the sun god together with sandhya, bowed in reverence to the sage and started speaking to him with humility.

## \|\| 46.46-47 \|\|

*śrīsūryya uvāca \|*  
*sūryyāstasamayaṃ dṛṣṭvā dharmalopabhayena ca \|*  
*tvāṃ bodhayāmāsa vipra nāhamastaṃ gatastadā \|\| 46 \|\|*

*kṣamasva bhagavanbrahmanmāṃ śaptuṃ nocitaṃ mune \|*  
*brāhmaṇānāṃ ca hṛdayaṃ navanītasamaṃ sadā \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. Surya said — Finding the time of sunset and to save you from earning the sin for not performing sandhya, Manasa woke you up. I had not set at that point of time. Therefore, О lord, О Brahman, О sage, you kindly forgive her. It is not proper on your part also to pronounce a curse on me because the minds of the Brahmanas are always soft like butter.

## \|\| 46.48 \|\|

*teṣāṃ kṣaṇārddhaṃ krodhaśca tato bhasma bhavejjagat \|*  
*punaḥ sraṣṭuṃ dvijaḥ śakto na tejasvī dvijātparaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. If he gets enraged, he can reduce the entire universe to ashes in a moment and he can also recreate the same. This is because there is no one else, possessing more tejas than the Brahmana.

## \|\| 46.49 \|\|

*brahmaṇo vaṃśasambhūtaḥ prajvalanbrahmatejasā \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇaṃ bhāvayennityaṃ brahma jyotiḥ sanātanam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Therefore having been born in the race of Brahmana and illumining with the tejas of Brahman, a Brahmana should always adore lord Krishna who happens to be the divine flame.

## \|\| 46.50 \|\|

*sūryyasya vacanaṃ śrutvā dvijastuṣṭo babhūva ha \|*  
*sūryyo jagāma svasthānaṃ gṛhītvā brāhmaṇāśiṣam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. On hearing the words of the sun god, the Brahmana was pleased and he returned to his abode after receiving the blessing of the sage.

## \|\| 46.51 \|\|

*tatyāja manasāṃ vipraḥ pratijñāpālanāya ca \|*  
*rudantīṃ śokayuktāṃ ca hṛdayena vidūyatā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. But the Brahmana in order to honour his own words, disowned the chaste goddess Manasa who had been crying with mental agony.

## \|\| 46.52 \|\|

*sā sasmāra guruṃ śambhumiṣṭadevaṃ hariṃ vidhim \|*  
*kaśyapaṃ janmadātāraṃ vipattau bhayakarśitā \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Thereafter, she remembered his teacher Shiva, the family god Vishnu and Brahma besides her father Kashyapa at that hour of misfortune.

## \|\| 46.53 \|\|

*tatrājagāma bhagavāngopīśaḥ śambhureva ca \|*  
*vidhiśca kaśyapaścaiva manasā paricintayan \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. At the instance of Manasa, Krishna the lord of Gopis, Shiva, Brahma and Kashyapa arrived there.

## \|\| 46.54 \|\|

*sa ca dṛṣṭvā'bhīṣṭadevaṃ niguṇe prakṛteḥ param \|*  
*tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā praṇanāma muhurmuhuḥ \|\| 54\|\|*

54\. The Brahmana also started adoring the lord who was invisible and beyond Prakriti, with his mind filled with devotion and offered salutation to him again and again.

## \|\| 46.55 \|\|

*namaścakāra śambhuṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ kaśyapaṃ tathā \|*  
*kathamāgamanaṃ tvatretyevaṃ praśnaṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. He also offered his salutation to Shiva, Brahma and Kashyapa and said: “O gods what for have you arrived her”?

## \|\| 46.56-57 \|\|

*brahmā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sahasā samayocitam \|*  
*tamuvāca namaskṛtya hṛṣīkeśapadāmbujam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*yadi tyaktā dharmapatnī dharmiṣṭhā manasā satī \|*  
*kuruṣvāsyāṃ sutotpattiṃ dharmasaṃsthāpanāya vai \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. On hearing his words, Brahma bowed at the lotus-like feet of Krishna and said. “Since you have disowned the chaste wife Manasa therefore you must implant your seed in her for the birth of a son.

## \|\| 46.58-59 \|\|

*yatirvā brahmacārī vā bhikṣurvanacaro'pi vā \|*  
*jāyāyā ca sutotpattiṃ kṛtvā paścādbhavenmuniḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

*akṛtvā tu sutotpattiṃ virāgī yastyajetpriyām \|*  
*sravettapastatpuṇyaṃ ca cālinyāṃ ca yathā jalam \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. Because all the yogis, Brahmacharis, Samnyasis, forest dwellers or sages become recluses only after bearing out a child from their wives. In case a recluse disowns his wife without producing a child, all his performances like tapas and other noble deeds become infructuous as the water poured in a sieve disappears in no time.

## \|\| 46.60 \|\|

*brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā jaratkārurmunīśvaraḥ \|*  
*cakre tannābhisaṃsparśaṃ yogādvai mantrapūrvakam \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. The sage Jaratkaru then listened to the words of Brahma and reciting the mantras touched the navel of Manasa.

## \|\| 46.61-62 \|\|

*tasyai śubhāśiṣaṃ dattvā yayurdevā mudā'nvitāḥ \|*  
*mudā'nvitā ca manasā jaratkārurmudā'nvitaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*muneḥ karasparśamātrātsadyo garbho babhūva ha \|*  
*manasā yā muniśreṣṭha muniśreṣṭha uvāca tām \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. The gods also then left the place pronouncing their blessings on the couple. The goddess Manasa was then immensely pleased together with Jaratkaru. О best of the sages, with the touch of the sage, Manasa conceived and the sage said to her.

## \|\| 46.63-64 \|\|

*jaratkāruruvāca \|*  
*garbheṇānena manase tava putro bhaviṣyati \|*  
*jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaro dharmiṣṭho vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*tejasvī ca tapasvī ca yaśasvī ca guṇānvitaḥ \|*  
*varo vedavidāṃ caiva yogināṃ jñānināṃ tathā \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. Jaratkaru said — О Manasa, with this conception, a son would be born to you who would be self disciplined, the best of the people, devoted to clharma, the foremost of the Vais navas, glorious one, a great tapasvl, full of lustre, virtuous, best and best among those well-versed in the Vedas, the yogis and people with wisdom.

## \|\| 46.65 \|\|

*sa ca putro viṣṇubhakto dhārmikaḥ kulamuddharet \|*  
*nṛtyanti pitaraḥ sarve janmamātreṇa vai mudā \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The son would be a great devotee of lord Vishnu besides being extremely religious and shall redeem the entire race. With the birth of the child all the manes will dance with ecstasy.

## \|\| 46.66 \|\|

*pativratā suśīlā yā sapriyā priyavādinī \|*  
*dharmiṣṭhā putramātā ca kulajā kulapālikā \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Because a chaste lady is always loved by the husband, speaking sweet words. A devoted mother belonging to the noble race is the one who maintains the race.

## \|\| 46.67 \|\|

*haribhaktiprado bandhustadiṣṭaṃ yatsukhapradam \|*  
*yo bandhacchitsa ca pitā harervartmapradarśakaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. A true brother is the one who bestows the best of the pleasures. A true father is the one who is instrumental in the destruction of the deeds and leads towards the path of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 46.68 \|\|

*sā garbhadhāriṇī yā ca garbhavāsavimocinī \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Only such a lady bearing the child in her womb could maintain the pregnancy pretty well. A compassionate sister is the one, who relieves one of the fear of Yama.

## \|\| 46.69 \|\|

*viṣṇumantrapradātā ca sa gururviṣṇubhaktidaḥ \|*  
*guruśca jñānadātā ca tajjñānaṃ kṛṣṇabhāvanam \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. A true teacher is the one, who bestows the mantra of Vishnu besides the devotion of the lord. A teacher is the one, who bestows knowledge and the knowledge is the one which inculcates the love for lord Krishna.

## \|\| 46.70 \|\|

*ābrahmastambaparyyantaṃ yato viśvaṃ carācaram \|*  
*āvirbhūtaṃ tirobhūtaṃ kiṃ vā jñānaṃ tadanyataḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Therefore the essence of the Vedas and the yogic practices happens to be that one should adore the lord this is also the essence of all the tattvas and whatever is there except lord Hari, is illusion only.

## \|\| 46.71 \|\|

*vedajaṃ yogajaṃ yadyattatsāraṃ harisevanam \|*  
*tattvānāṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca hareranyadviḍambanam \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Because the space between the earth and the Brahmaloka is filled with the creatures created by the lord and they merge into the same lord. What more knowledge can be expected of him?

## \|\| 46.72 \|\|

*dattaṃ jñānaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ sa svāmī jñānado hi yaḥ \|*  
*jñānātpramucyate bandhātsa ripuryo hi bandhadaḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Thus I have imparted to you the divine knowledge. The husband is one who bestows the knowledge, because by possessing the knowledge one is freed from all the fetters and one could be called an enemy who entangles one into the fetters.

## \|\| 46.73 \|\|

*viṣṇubhaktiyutaṃ jñānaṃ yo dadāti sa vai guruḥ \|*  
*sa ripuḥ śiṣyaghātī ca yato bandhānna mocayet \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. Therefore such a Brahmana who does not impart knowledge with the devotion of lord Vis nu, indeed happens to be a destroyer of the pupil because he is unable to free the pupil from the fetters.

## \|\| 46.74 \|\|

*jananīgarbhajātkleśādyamatāḍanajāttathā \|*  
*na mocayedyaḥ sa kathaṃ gurustāto hi bāndhavaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Therefore the one who cannot relieve a pupil from re-entering the womb of the mother and the sufferings, such a teacher, a father or a brother, is considered to be of no consequence.

## \|\| 46.75 \|\|

*paramānandarūpaṃ ca kṛṣṇamārgamanaśvaram \|*  
*na darśayedyaḥ sa kathaṃ kīdṛśo bāndhavo nṛṇām \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. The one who cannot lead another to the infallible path of lord Krishna, such a human relative is of no consequence.

## \|\| 46.76-77 \|\|

*bhaja sādhvi paraṃ brahmācyutaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca nirguṇam \|*  
*nirmūlaṃ ca purākarma bhavedyatsevayā dhruvam \|\| 76 \|\|*

*mayā chalena tvaṃ tyaktā doṣaṃ me kṣamyatāṃ priye \|*  
*kṣamāyutānāṃ sādhvīnāṃ sattvātkrodho na vidyate \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. O chaste lady, you recite the name of lord Krishna who is the supreme Brahman, infallible and devoid of gunas and by adoring him all the deeds of the past births disappear. О dear, I have disowned you deceitfully, therefore I beg forgiveness. Forgiveness is the prime quality of the chaste lady, as such ladies do not get immensely enraged.

## \|\| 46.78 \|\|

*puṣkare tapase yāmi gaccha devi yathāsukham \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhoje dhyānavicchedakātaraḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. О goddess I am proceeding to Puskara for performing tapas. You also go pleasantly from this place, because I am feeling disturbed for not reciting the name of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 46.79 \|\|

*dhanādiṣu striyāṃ prītiḥ pravṛttipathagāminām \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhoje niḥspṛhāṇāṃ manorathāḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. Engrossed in the household affairs the women devote their minds towards their sons and the riches besides thinking of welfare of their husband. Let us devote ourselves at the lotus-like feet of lord Krishna.”

## \|\| 46.80 \|\|

*jaratkāruvacaḥ śrutvā manasā śokakātarā \|*  
*sā sāśrunetrā vinayāduvāca prāṇavallabham \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. On hearing these words of Jaratkaru, the eyes of goddess Manasa were filled with tears and she spoke to his beloved the humble words.

## \|\| 46.81 \|\|

*manasovāca \|*  
*doṣeṇāhaṃ tvayā tyaktā nidrābhaṅgena te prabho \|*  
*yatra smarāmi tvāṃ bandho tatra māmāgamiṣyasi \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. Manasa said — О lord I have disturbed your sleep and because of this, you have disowned me. But, О best of my relatives, you give me a word that you will reach me, whenever I remember you.

## \|\| 46.82 \|\|

*bandhubhedaḥ kleśatamaḥ putrabhedastataḥ paraḥ \|*  
*prāṇeśabhedaḥ prāṇānāṃ vicchedātsarvataḥ paraḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. The separation from a relative it quite painful and the separation from a son is more painful but the separation of a woman from her husband is much more painful and is like the departing of the soul from the body.

## \|\| 46.83 \|\|

*patiḥ pativratānāṃ ca śataputrādhikaḥ priyaḥ \|*  
*sarvasmācca priyaḥ strīṇāṃ priyastenocyate budhaiḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. For the chaste lady, the husband is dearer to her than hundreds of her sons. Thus the husband is extremely dear to the ladies and as such the intellectuals call the husband to be the dearest of the woman.

## \|\| 46.84-86 \|\|

*putre yathaikaputrāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ yathā harau \|*  
*netre yathaikanetrāṇāṃ tṛṣitānāṃ yathā jale \|\| 84 \|\|*

*kṣudhitānāṃ yathā'nne ca kāmukānāṃ yathā striyām \|*  
*yathā parasve caurāṇāṃ yathā jāre kuyoṣitām \|\| 85 \|\|*

*viduṣāṃ ca yathā śāstre vaṇijye vaṇijāṃ yathā \|*  
*tathā śaśvanmanaḥ kānte sādhvīnāṃ yoṣitāṃ prabho \|\| 86 \|\|*

84-86. As a person is devoted to his son, the Vais navas are devoted to the lord, the one-eyed man is devoted to his eye, the thirsty man thinks of water only, the hungry man thinks of food only, the passionate person thinks of woman only and the thief about the stealing of the riches of others, the unchaste woman thinks of the other man only, the intellectuals are devoted to the study of scriptures and the traders are devoted to the commerce, similarly the mind of a chaste lady is always devoted to her husband.

## \|\| 46.87 \|\|

*ityuktvā manasā devī papāta svāminaḥ pade \|*  
*kṣaṇaṃ cakāra kroḍe tāṃ kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. Thus speaking, the goddess Manasa fell at the feet of her husband Jaratkaru. The mind of the merciful sage was filled with compassion and in a moment he lifted her up in his lap.

## \|\| 46.88 \|\|

*netrodakena manasāṃ snāpayāmāsa tāṃ muniḥ \|*  
*sā'śruṇā ca muneḥ kroḍaṃ siṣeve bhedakātarā \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. And made her body bathe with the flow of the tears from his eyes. Manasa too made Jaratkaru to bathe with the tears flowing from her eyes keeping in view the separation from the husband.

## \|\| 46.89 \|\|

*tadā jñānena tau dvau ca viśokau ca babhūvatuḥ \|*  
*smāraṃ smāraṃ padāmbhojaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. But, suddenly over-powered with the divine thought, both of them were relieved of the grief and they started reciting the name of lord Krishna again and again.

## \|\| 46.90 \|\|

*jagāma tapase vipraḥ sa kāntāṃ suprabodhya ca \|*  
*jagāma manasā śambhoḥ kailāsaṃ mandiraṃ guroḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Jaratkaru then imparted the divine knowledge to his wife and proceeded for performing tapas. Manasa too proceeded towards the abode of Shiva at Kailasa who happens to be her teacher as well.

## \|\| 46.91-92 \|\|

*pārvatī bodhayāmāsa manasāṃ śokakarśitām \|*  
*śivaścātīva bodhena śivena ca śivālaye \|\| 91 \|\|*

*supraśaste dine sādhvī suṣuve maṅgale kṣaṇe \|*  
*nārāyaṇāṃśaṃ putraṃ ca jñānināṃ yogināṃ gurum \|\| 92 \|\|*

91-92. Reaching the temple of Shiva, Parvati enlightened Manasa with divine knowledge and removed her grief. Shiva also did so to remove her grief. The chaste lady then gave birth to a son on an auspicious day, who was born of the ray of Narayana and happened to be the teacher of all the yogis.

## \|\| 46.93 \|\|

*garbhasthito mahājñānaṃ śrutvā śaṅkaravaktrataḥ \|*  
*sa babhūva mahāyogī yogināṃ jñānināṃ guruḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. In fact he had listened to the divine knowledge imparted by lord Shiva, while he was still in the womb. This made him the teacher of the yogis and the intellectuals.

## \|\| 46.94-95 \|\|

*jātakaṃ kārayāmāsa vācayāmāsa maṃgalam \|*  
*vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa śivāya ca śivaḥ śiśoḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

*ratnatrikoṭilakṣaṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau śivaḥ \|*  
*pārvatī ca gavāṃ lakṣaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca \|\| 95 \|\|*

94-95. Shiva himself performed all the rites at the birth of the child besides the reciting of the Vedas. Shiva gave away at the same time three crores of gems to the Brahmanas while Parvati gave away a lakh of cows in charity besides many gems.

## \|\| 46.96 \|\|

*śambhuśca caturo vedānvedāṃgānitarāṃstathā \|*  
*bālakaṃ pāṭhayāmāsa jñānaṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ param \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. As the time passed, Shiva himself imparted the knowledge of the Vedas to the boy besides the knowledge of Mrtyunjaya mantra.

## \|\| 46.97-98 \|\|

*bhaktirasti svakānte cābhīṣṭe deve harau gurau \|*  
*yasyāstena ca tatputro babhūvāstīka eva ca \|\| 97 \|\|*

*jagāma tapase viṣṇoḥ puṣkaraṃ śaṅkarājñayā \|*  
*saṃprāpya ca mahāmantraṃ tapaśca paramātmanaḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

97-98. Manasa on the other hand was extremely devoted to her husband, the family god, Vishnu and the teacher. As such, her son was given the name of Astlka. At the command of lord Shiva receiving the great mantra from him, he went to Puskara-ksetra to perform tapas for lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 46.99 \|\|

*divyaṃ varṣatrilakṣaṃ ca tapastaptvā tapodhanaḥ \|*  
*ājagāma mahāyogī namaskartuṃ śivaṃ prabhum \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. The great ascetic performed tapas there for three lakhs of years, after which he returned to Kailasa to bow in reverence to Shiva and his mother.

## \|\| 46.100 \|\|

*śaṃkaraṃ ca namaskṛtya puraḥ kṛtvā ca bālakam \|*  
*sā cājagāma manasā kaśyapasyāśramaṃ pituḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. Manasa went with the child to lord Shiva and bowed before him. The mother Manasa then accompanied with her son went to her father Kashyapa.

## \|\| 46.101-102 \|\|

*tāṃ saputrāṃ sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā mudaṃ prāpa prajāpatiḥ \|*  
*śatalakṣaṃ ca ratnānāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mune \|\| 101 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa tvasaṃkhyāñchreyase śiśoḥ \|*  
*aditiśca ditiścānyā mudaṃ prāpuḥ paraṃ tathā \|\| 102 \|\|*

101-102. О sage, Prajapati Kashyapa, finding his daughter there before him together with her son, was extremely pleased and delightfully he gave a hundred lakh of gems in charity to the Brahmana. A number of Brahmanas were fed by Kashyapa for the welfare of the child. Both Diti and Aditi besides others, were also delighted at the sight of the boy.

## \|\| 46.103 \|\|

*sā saputrā ca suciraṃ tasthau tātālaye tadā \|*  
*tadīyaṃ punarākhyānaṃ vakṣye tvaṃ tanniśāmaya \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. Thus the goddess Manasa stayed in the parents' house for a long time with her son; now I tell you the story about the place also; you please listen to it.

## \|\| 46.104-105 \|\|

*athābhimanyutanaye brahmaśāpaḥ parīkṣite \|*  
*babhūva sahasā brahmandaivadoṣeṇa karmaṇā \|\| 104 \|\|*

*saptāhe samatīte tu takṣakastvāṃ ca daṃkṣyati \|*  
*śaśāpa śṛṅgī kauśikyā jalaṃ saṃspṛśya ceti saḥ \|\| 105 \|\|*

104-105. О Brahman, after that the king Parlksit son of Abhimanyu was cursed by a Brahmana as a move of destiny, that “on the seventh day from today the serpent Taksaka will bite you.” This curse was pronounced by the sage Srngl holding the water of the river KausikI in his hand.

## \|\| 46.106 \|\|

*rājā śrutvā tatpravṛttiṃ gaṃgādvāraṃ jagāma saḥ \|*  
*tatra tasthau ca saptāhaṃ śuśruve dharmasaṃhitām \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. On hearing that curse, the king at once proceeded to Haridvara and remaining there, he perfonned the recitation of Srimad Bhagavata Purana which he listened to for a week.

## \|\| 46.107-109 \|\|

*saptāhe samatīte tu gacchantaṃ takṣakaṃ pathi \|*  
*dhanvantarirmocayitumapaśyadgantuko nṛpam \|\| 107 \|\|*

*tayorbabhūva saṃvādaḥ suprītiśca parasparam \|*  
*dhanvantarermaṇiṃ śreṣṭhaṃ takṣakaḥ svecchayā dadau \|\| 108 \|\|*

*sa yayau taṃ gṛhītvā tu tuṣṭasaṃhṛṣṭa mānasaḥ \|*  
*apaśyattakṣakastūrṇaṃ nṛpaṃ mañcakasaṃsthitam \|\| 109 \|\|*

107-109. After the completion of the seventh day, Taks aka was spotted by Dhanvantari who was going to the king in order to remove the effect of the poison. Both of them had a pleasant conversation. As a result of this Taksaka willingly handed over his gem to Dhanvantari who after receiving the same returned to his home. Taksaka on the other hand reached the court of the king who was sitting on a high throne. The serpent Taksaka bit him.

## \|\| 46.110 \|\|

*rājā jagāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ smāraṃ smāraṃ hari gurum \|*  
*saṃskāraṃ kārayāmāsa piturvai janamejayaḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. The king reciting the name of Шгйуапа and his teacher went to Vaikuntha. Janamejaya, the son of Parlksita cremated the body of his father.

## \|\| 46.111 \|\|

*rājā cakāra yajñaṃ ca sarpasatrābhidhaṃ mune \|*  
*prāṇāṃstatyāja sarpāṇāṃ samūho brahmatejasā \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. О sage, Janamejaya then started the serpent yajna and started dropping the serpents as. offerings in the yajnakunda.

## \|\| 46.112 \|\|

*sa takṣakaśca bhītaśca mahendraṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau \|*  
*sendraṃ ca takṣakaṃ hantuṃ vipravargaḥ samudyataḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. The terrified Taksaka fled the scene and went to Indra the god of gods to take refuge with him. On coming to know that the Brahmana intended to make the offering of Taksaka as well as Indra in the yajna-kunda.

## \|\| 46.113-114 \|\|

*atha devāśca munayaścāyayurmanasāntikam \|*  
*tāṃ tuṣṭāva mahendraśca samakṣaṃ bhayakātaraḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

*tatra āstīka āgatya māturyajñamathājñayā \|*  
*mahendratakṣakaprāṇānyayāce bhūmipaṃ varam \|\| 114 \|\|*

113-114. The god and the sages went to the goddess Manasa. Struck with terror Indrq offered his prayer to the goddess Manasa quite humbly. When the goddess was pleased, she deputed Astika to go to the king and beg for the lives of Taksaka and Indra.

## \|\| 46.115 \|\|

*dadau varaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ kṛpayā brāhmaṇājñayā \|*  
*yajñaṃ samāpya viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ ca dadau mudā \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. After adoring the goddess Manasa, the gods proceeded to their respective abodes. I have now narrate everything to you; what more do you want listen to from me?

## \|\| 46.116-118 \|\|

*viprāśca munayo devā gatvā ca manasāntikam \|*  
*manasāṃ pūjayāmāsustuṣṭuvuśca pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 116 \|\|*

*śakraḥ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro bhaktiyuktaḥ sadā śuciḥ \|*  
*manasāṃ pūjayāmāsa tuṣṭāva paramādarāt \|\| 117 \|\|*

*upacāraḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbaliṃ dattvā priyaṃ tadā \|*  
*pradadau parituṣṭaśca brahmaviṣṇusurājñayā \|\| 118 \|\|*

116-118. Narada said — By reciting which mantra and stotra, Indra adored goddess Manasa and what is the method of her adoration, I would like to know the whole secret of it.

## \|\| 46.119 \|\|

*saṃpūjya manasādevīṃ prayayuḥ svālayaṃ ca te \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. Narayana said — Mahendra properly took his bath purifying his body. Sipping йсатапа he clad himself in two garments, he then placed the goddess on a gem-studded throne.

## \|\| 46.120 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*kena stotreṇa tuṣṭāva mahendro manasāṃ satīm \|*  
*pūjāvidhikramaṃ tasyāḥ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. With the permission of the Brahmanas, the best of the kings granted them the boon, delightfully ending the yajna giving away daks ina to the Brahmana.

## \|\| 46.121 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*susnātaḥ śucirācānto dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī \|*  
*ratnasiṃhāsane devīṃ vāsayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. Thereafter the sages, the gods and the Brahmanas went to goddess Manasa and adored her offering separate prayers to her. Indra adored the goddess with his mind filled with devotion, offering various articles of puja and prayers to her. Making sixteen types of offerings, Indra, with the command of the Brahmana and the gods, offered her many presents.

## \|\| 46.122-128 \|\|

*svargagaṅgājalenaiva ratnakumbha sthitena ca \|*  
*snāpayāmāsa manasāṃ mahendro vedamantrataḥ \|\| 122 \|\|*

*vāsasī vāsayāmāsa vahniśuddhe manorame \|*  
*sarvāṃge candanaṃ liptvā pādyārghyaṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

*gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām \|*  
*saṃpūjya devaṣaṭkaṃ ca pūjayāmāsa tāṃ satīm \|\| 124 \|\|*

*oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ manasādevyai svāhetyevaṃ ca mantrataḥ \|*  
*daśākṣareṇa mantreṇa dadau sarvānyathocitam \|\| 125 \|\|*

*upacārānṣoḍaśakānbhaktito durlabhānhariḥ \|*  
*pūjayāmāsa bhaktyā ca brahmaṇā prerito mudā \|\| 126 \|\|*

*vādyaṃ nānāprakāraṃ ca vādayāmāsa tatra vai \|*  
*babhūva puṣpavṛṣṭiśca nabhaso manasopari \|\| 127 \|\|*

*devo viprājñayā tatra brahmaviṣṇuśivājñayā \|*  
*tuṣṭāva sāśrunetraśca pulakāñcita vigrahaḥ \|\| 128\|\|*

122-128. He consecrated the vases of sacred Ganga-jala made of gems and made the goddess to bathe with the reciting of Vedic hymns. He then offered beautiful costumes to her which were purified by the god Agni applying the sandal-paste on her body. With his mind filled with utmost devotion he offered padya and arghya to the goddess, besides adoring Ganesha, Stirya, Agni, Vishnu, Shiva and Durga. He then recited the mantra … which comprises of ten letters, made over to her with other offerings. Thereafter at the instance of Brahma, Indra with his mind filled with delight made sixteen types of offerings to her. Several of the musical instruments were played upon. There was a shower of flowers from the sky over the goddess Manasa. Mahendra then with the permission of the Brahmanas, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva offered prayers to the goddess with his mind filled with emotion and tears flowing from his eyes.

## \|\| 46.129-130 \|\|

*mahendra uvāca \|*  
*devi tvāṃ stotumicchāmi sādhvīnāṃ pravarāṃ varām \|*  
*parātparāṃ ca paramāṃ nahi stotuṃ kṣamo 'dhunā \|\| 129 \|\|*

*stotrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vede svabhāvākhyānataḥ param \|*  
*na kṣamaḥ prakṛtiṃ vaktuṃ guṇānāṃ tava suvrate \|\| 130 \|\|*

129-130. Mahendra said — О goddess, I went to offer prayers to you who happens to be the best of the goddesses, best of the chaste women, beyond everything, best of all. I am unable to offer prayers to you. О chaste lady, your virtues and the stotras are contained in the Vedas. Your story is enshrined theirin which cannot be recited even by Prakriti.

## \|\| 46.131-137 \|\|

*śuddhasattvasvarūpā tvaṃ kopahiṃsāvivarjitā \|*  
*na ca śapto munistena tyaktayā ca tvayā yataḥ \|\| 131 \|\|*

*tvaṃ mayā pūjitā sādhvi jananī ca yathā'ditiḥ \|*  
*dayārūpā ca bhaginī kṣamārūpā yathā prasūḥ \|\| 132 \|\|*

*tvayā me rakṣitāḥ prāṇāḥ putradārāḥ sureśvari \|*  
*ahaṃ karomi tvāṃ pūjyāṃ mama prītiśca varddhate \|\| 133 \|\|*

*nityaṃ yadyāpi pūjyā tvaṃ bhave'tra jagadambike \|*  
*tathā'pi tava pūjāṃ vai varddhayāmi punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 134 \|\|*

*ye tvāmāṣāḍhasaṃkrāntyāṃ pūjayiṣyanti bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*pañcamyāṃ manasākhyāyāṃ māsānte vā dine dine \|\| 135 \|\|*

*putrapautrādayasteṣāṃ varddhante ca dhanāni ca \|*  
*yaśasvinaḥ kīrttimanto vidyāvanto guṇānvitāḥ \|\| 136 \|\|*

*ye tvāṃ na pūjayiṣyanti nindantyajñānato janāḥ \|*  
*lakṣmīhīnā bhaviṣyanti teṣāṃ nāgabhayaṃ sadā \|\| 137 \|\|*

131-137. You are absolutely pure and free from anger, violence and faults. Though the sage has disowned you, yet you never pronounced a curse on him, after his so doing. О chaste lady, I adore you like Aditi my own mother. О goddess you are a compassionate sister and are pardonable like the mother. You have earlier saved our lives, besides those of our sons and wives. Therefore, О mother of the universe, I adore you. I am getting more and more devoted towards you. Though you are adorable in the universe always yet I go on increasing your worship daily. Thus on the first day of Asadha whosoever adores you with devotion on the day of Manasa-PancamI or will adore you daily will always have an increase in his riches. Besides, he will earn popularity, glory, intelligence and virtues. Such of the people as will not adore you out of ignorance, will be denounced by others and will be deprived of the riches; they will also be infested with the danger of serpents.

## \|\| 46.138 \|\|

*tvaṃ svargalakṣmīḥ svarge ca vaikuṇṭhe kamalā kalā \|*  
*nārāyaṇāṃśo bhagavāñjaratkārurmunīśvaraḥ \|\| 138 \|\|*

138\. You are the Lakshmi of the heaven and Kamala of Vaikuntha. The sage Jaratkaru happens to be the ray of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 46.139-140 \|\|

*tapasā tejasā tvāṃ ca manasā sasṛje pitā \|*  
*asmākaṃ rakṣaṇāyaiva tena tvaṃ manasābhidhā \|\| 139 \|\|*

*manasā devituṃ śaktā cātmanā siddhayoginī \|*  
*tena tvaṃ manasādevī pūjitā vanditā bhave \|\| 140 \|\|*

139-140. Brahma, our father had created you by performing tapas. Because of this you have been given the, name of Manasa. You are a Siddhayogini and adorable by heart. Therefore, you have been given the name of Manasa and people adore you accordingly.

## \|\| 46.141 \|\|

*yāṃ bhaktyā manasā devāḥ pūjayantyaniśaṃ bhṛśam \|*  
*tena tvāṃ manasādevīṃ pravadanti purāvidaḥ \|\| 141 \|\|*

141\. You are the goddess who is adored with devotion by the gods, that is why you have been given the name of Manasa by the ancient people.

## \|\| 46.142 \|\|

*sattvarūpā ca devī tvaṃ śaśvatsattvaniṣevayā \|*  
*yo hi yadbhāvayennityaṃ śataṃ prāpnoti tatsamam \|\| 142 \|\|*

142\. Because you lead the path of sattva you are called the form of sattva. Thus whosoever offers you anything with devotion, gets it back multiplied by hundred times.

## \|\| 46.143 \|\|

*indraśca manasāṃ stutvā gṛhītvā bhaginīṃ ca tām \|*  
*nirjagāma svabhavanaṃ bhūṣāvāsaparicchadām \|\| 143 \|\|*

143\. Indra thus adored Manasa, his sister, who also offered him clothes and ornaments and then left for his abode. The goddess then left the place and retreated to the house of her father and remained there for long.

## \|\| 46.144-146 \|\|

*putreṇa sārddhaṃ sā devī ciraṃ tasthau piturgṛhe \|*  
*bhrātṛbhiḥ pūjitā śaśvanmānyā vandyā ca sarvataḥ \|\| 144 \|\|*

*golokātsurabhī brahmaṃstatrāgatya supūjitām \|*  
*tāṃ snāpayitvā kṣīreṇa pūjayāmāsa sādaram \|\| 145 \|\|*

*jñānasya kathayāmāsa svarūpaṃ sarvadurlabham \|*  
*tadā devaiḥ pūjitā sā svargalokaṃ punaryayau \|\| 146 \|\|*

144-146. She is always adored by her brother; no other goddess is so adorable. О Brahman, Surabhl took her to Goloka and made her bathe in milk adoring her at the same time, imparting to her the divine knowledge which is difficult to get. Thus having been adored by the gods, the goddess Manasa left for heaven.

## \|\| 46.147-148 \|\|

*idaṃ stotraṃ puṇyabījaṃ tāṃ saṃpūjya ca yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*tasya nāgabhayaṃ nāsti tasya vaṃśe bhavecca yaḥ \|\| 147 \|\|*

*viṣaṃ bhavetsudhātulyaṃ siddhastotraṃ yadā paṭhet \|*  
*pañcalakṣajapenaiva siddhastotro bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*sarpaśāyī bhavetso'pi niścitaṃ sarpavāhanaḥ \|\| 148 \|\|*

147-148. Whosoever recites this stotra adoring the goddess Manasa never meets with the danger from serpents. Not only that, no one from his future generation ever meets any danger from the serpents. When recites her stotra achieving its siddhi, the poison is turned into a nectar for him. The one who recites this mantra five lakhs of times, he meets with success. Thereafter he can surely subjugate the serpent and can even make the serpent his vehicle.

## Chapter 47

## \|\| 47.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*kā vā sā surabhī devī golokā dāgatā ca yā \|*  
*tajjanmacaritaṃ brahmañchrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said — О Brahma who was Surabhl, who arrived in the Golokal Who was she? Where was she born and what is the story about her? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 47.2 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*gavāmadhiṣṭhātṛdevī gavāmādyā gavāṃ prasūḥ \|*  
*gavāṃ pradhānā surabhī goloke ca samudbhavā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. NSrayana said — SurabhT was born in Goloka and the foremost of the cows. She is the chief goddess of the cows, the eternal cow and the mother of the gods.

## \|\| 47.3 \|\|

*sarvādisṛṣṭeḥ kathanaṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya \|*  
*babhūva tena tajjanma purā vṛndāvane vane \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Now I am going to tell you about the story of Surabhl who happens to be the eternal one. In the earlier times, in the forest named Vmdavana, she was born when lord Krishna once playfully went to Vmdavana together with other cowherdesses.

## \|\| 47.4 \|\|

*ekadā rādhikānātho rādhayā saha kautukāt \|*  
*gopāṃganāparivṛtaḥ puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ yayau \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Once Krishna the lord of Radhika playfully went to Vmdavana together with all the cowherdesses.

## \|\| 47.5-9 \|\|

*sahasā tatra rahasi vijahāra ca kautukāt \|*  
*babhūva kṣīrapānecchā tadā svecchāparasya ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sasṛje surabhīṃ devīṃ līlayā vāmapārśvataḥ \|*  
*vatsayuktāṃ dugdhavatīṃ vatsānāṃ ca manoramām \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā savatsāṃ surabhīṃ ratnabhāṇḍe dudoha saḥ \|*  
*kṣīraṃ sudhātiriktaṃ ca janmamṛtyuharaṃ param \|\| 7 \|\|*

*taduṣṇaṃ ca payaḥ svādu papau gopīpatiḥ svayam \|*  
*saro babhūva payasā bhāṇḍavisraṃsanena ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dīrghe ca vistṛte caiva paritaḥ śatayojanam \|*  
*golokeṣu prasiddhaṃ tadramyaṃ kṣīrasarovaram \|\| 9 \|\|*

5-9. On reaching there, they hid themselves playfully in a secluded place. After sometime, they developed a desire for consuming milk. He then playfully created the cow Surabhl from his left side together with the calf. Finding her with her calf, he started milking her. The milk was like the nectar which removed the cycle of birth and death. Thereafter the warm milk was consumed by lord Krishna himself. The vase in which the cow was milked fell onto the ground and was broken, as a result of which a stream of milk was consumed by lord Krishna himself. The vase in which the cow was milked fell on the ground and was broken as a result of which a stream of milk appeared on the scene which spread over an area of a hundred yojanas and was subsequently known as the ocean of milk.

## \|\| 47.10-12 \|\|

*gopikānāṃ ca rādhāyāḥ krīḍāvāpī babhūva sā \|*  
*ratnena racitā tūrṇaṃ bhūtā vāpīśvarecchayā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*babhūva kāmadhenūnāṃ sahasā lakṣakoṭayaḥ \|*  
*tāvatyo hi savatsāśca surabhīlomakūpataḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tāsāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca saṃbabhūvurasaṃkhyakāḥ \|*  
*kathitā ca gavāṃ sṛṣṭistayā saṃpūritaṃ jagat \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. Then there appeared a step-well for the water-sport of Radhika which was filled with gems. Thereafter from the hair-pits of Surabhl lakhs and crores of cows with calves emerged. They had many sons and grandsons, the number of which could not be estimated. They were all spread over the entire universe. Thus I have told you about the creation of the cows.

## \|\| 47.13 \|\|

*pūjāṃ cakāra bhagavānsurabhyāśca purā mune \|*  
*tato babhūva tatpūjā triṣu lokeṣu durlabhā \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. О sqge, in the earlier times, Surabhl was adored by the lord and she came to be adored by the entire universe in the three worlds.

## \|\| 47.14 \|\|

*dīpānvitā paradine śrīkṛṣṇasyājñayā bhave \|*  
*babhūva surabhīpūjā dharmavaktrāditi śrutam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Thus at the command of lord Krishna, her adoration started from the next day, offering her a lamp. This is all that, I have heard from the mouth of Dharma.

## \|\| 47.15 \|\|

*dhyānaṃ stotraṃ mūlamantraṃ yadyatpūjāvidhikramam \|*  
*vedoktaṃ ca mahābhāga nibodha kathayāmi te \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. О great ascetic, I am now apprising you of his dhyanam, stotra, miilamantra and the method of her adoration. You please listen to me.

## \|\| 47.16 \|\|

*oṃ surabhyai nama iti mantro'yaṃ tu ṣaḍakṣaraḥ \|*  
*siddho lakṣajapenaiva bhaktānāṃ kalpapādapaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Her mantra is … which consists of six letters and one meets with success by reciting it a lakh of times. It serves as the kalpavrksa for the devotees.

## \|\| 47.17-19 \|\|

*sthitaṃ dhyānaṃ yajurvede pūjanaṃ sarvasammatam \|*  
*ṛddhidāṃ vṛddhidāṃ caiva muktido sarvakāmadām \|\| 17 \|\|*

*lakṣmīsvarūpāṃ paramāṃ rādhāsahacarīṃ parām \|*  
*gavāmadhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ gavāmādyāṃ gavāṃ prasūm \|\| 18 \|\|*

*pavitrarūpāṃ pūjyāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ sarvakāmadām \|*  
*yayā pūtaṃ sarvaviśvaṃ tāṃ devīṃ surabhīṃ bhaje \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. I am now telling you about the dhyanam and the puja as has been prescribed in the Yajurveda. The goddess who bestows fortune, increase in riches, salvation and fulfils all the desires, is the form of Lakshmi, the chaste Radha and her friend, the supreme goddess of the cows, the eternal cow and her mother, is quite auspicious, adorable and giants all the wishes of the devotees; she has purified the whole universe, I adore such a goddess Surabhi.

## \|\| 47.20 \|\|

*ghaṭe vā dhenuśirasi baddhastaṃbhe gavāṃ ca vā \|*  
*śālagrāme jale'gnau vā surabhī pūjayeddvijaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The Brahmana should adore Surabhi in the form of a vase, the head of the cow or the post with which the cows are tied, Shalagrama, the water or the fire.

## \|\| 47.21 \|\|

*dīpānvitā paradine pūrvāhṇe bhaktisaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*yaḥ pūjayecca surabhīṃ sa ca pūjyo bhavedbhuvi \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The one who adores Surabhi at the time of forenoon with devotion, becomes always respectfully on the earth.

## \|\| 47.22 \|\|

*ekadā triṣu lokeṣu vārāhe viṣṇumāyayā \|*  
*kṣīraṃ jahāra sahasā cintitāśca surādayaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Once at the time of the incarnation of Varaha, the illusion of the lord suddenly made the milk to disappear from the ocean of the milk. This made the gods a worried lot.

## \|\| 47.23 \|\|

*te gatvā brahmaṇo lokaṃ brahmāṇaṃ tuṣṭuvustadā \|*  
*tadājñayā ca surabhīṃ tuṣṭuve pākaśāsanaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Thereafter all of them went to Brahmaloka and offered prayers to Brahma. Indra then advised Brahma to adore Surabhi which he did.

## \|\| 47.24 \|\|

*mahendra uvāca \|*  
*namo devyai mahādevyai surabhyai ca namo namaḥ \|*  
*gavāṃ bījasvarūpāyai namaste jagadambike \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Mahendra said — I adore the goddess Surabhi who happens to be the great goddess. She happens to be the cause of all the cows, I offer my salutation to the goddess, who is the mother of the universe.

## \|\| 47.25-26 \|\|

*namo rādhāpriyāyai ca padmāṃśāyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*namaḥ kṛṣṇapriyāyai ca gavāṃ mātre namo namaḥ \|*  
*kalpavṛkṣasvarūpāyai pradātryai sarvasaṃpadām \|\| 25 \|\|*

*śrīdāyai dhanadāyai ca buddhidāyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*śubhadāyai prasannāyai gopradāyai namo namaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. I adore the goddess who is dear to Radha and was born from the ray of padma, I offer my salutation to her. I offer my salutation to the beloved of Krishna. I offer my salutation to the mother of the cows again and again, who taking to the form of kalpavrksa bestows riches to all and also bestows grace besides riches and is intelligent. I offer my salutation to her.

## \|\| 47.27 \|\|

*yaśodāyai saukhyadāyai dharmajñāyai namo namaḥ \|*  
*stotraśravaṇamātreṇa tuṣṭā hṛṣṭā jagatprasūḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. She bestows all the welfare, is delightful and bestows the cows. I offer my salutation to her, she bestows grace, all the pleasure and devotion to dharma I bow in reverence to her.

## \|\| 47.28-29 \|\|

*āvirbabhūva tatraiva brahmaloke sanātanī \|*  
*mahendrāya varaṃ dattvā vāñchitaṃ sarvadurlabham \|\| 28 \|\|*

*jagāma sā ca golokaṃ yayurdevādayo gṛham \|*  
*babhūva viśvaṃ sahasā dugdhapūrṇaṃ ca nārada \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. On hearing this prayer from Indra, the goddess Surabhi was extremely pleased. She therefore appeared in Brahmaloka and granted a boon to Mahendra as a result of which all his desires were fulfilled. Thereafter, she went back to Goloka. The gods also, О Narada, went back to their respective abodes.

## \|\| 47.30 \|\|

*dugdhād ghṛtaṃ tato yajñastataḥ prītiḥ surasya ca \|*  
*idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ bhaktiyuktaśca yaḥ paṭhet \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Thereafter, the entire universe was suddenly filled with milk. Thereafter the ghee emerged out of the milk which was used in the performing of the yajnas and pleased the god.

## \|\| 47.31-33 \|\|

*sa gomāndhanavāṃścaiva kīrttimānpuṇyavānbhavet \|*  
*susnātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante kṛṣṇamandiram \|*  
*suciraṃ nivasettatra kurute kṛṣṇasevanam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*na punarbhavanaṃ tasya brahmaputra bhave bhavet \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. Whosoever recites the stotra with devotion, possesses cows, riches, glory and nobility. He is treated as if he has taken a bath in all the sacred places or having performed all the yajnas. Thereafter, he, enjoying all the pleasures in the universe, proceeds on to the abode of lord Krishna and stays there for a long time. О son of Brahma, he is never born again on earth.

## Chapter 48

## \|\| 48.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*nārāyaṇa mahābhāga nārāyaṇaparāyaṇa \|*  
*nārāyaṇāṃśa bhagavanbrūhi nārāyaṇīṃ kathām \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said — О Narayana, О great lord you are the one who emerged as Narayana, are the amsa of Narayana, О lord, you kindly narrate to me the story of Narayani.

## \|\| 48.2 \|\|

*śrutaṃ surabhyupākhyānamatīva sumanoharam \|*  
*gopyaṃ sarvapurāṇeṣu purāvidbhiḥ praśaṃsitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. I have heard the story of Surabhl which is quite pleasant and is considered to be the secret of the Puranas and is praised therein.

## \|\| 48.3 \|\|

*adhunā śrotumicchāmi rādhikākhyānamuttamam \|*  
*tadutpattiṃ ca taddhyānaṃ stotraṃ kavacamuttamam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Now I want to listen to the best of the story of Radhika including her birth, dhydnam, stotra and the best of the kavachas.

## \|\| 48.4-7 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*purā kailāsaśikhare bhagavantaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*siddheśaṃ siddhidaṃ sarvasvarūpaṃ śaṃkaraṃ param \|\| 4 \|\|*

*praphullavadanaṃ prītaṃ sasmitaṃ munibhiḥ stutam \|*  
*kumārāya prarocantaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*rāsotsavarasākhyānaṃ rāsamaṇḍalavarṇanam \|*  
*tadākhyānāvasāne ca prastāvāvasare satī \|\| 6 \|\|*

*papraccha pārvatī sphītā sasmitā prāṇavallabham \|*  
*stavanaṃ kurvatī bhītā prāṇeśena prasāditā \|\| 7 \|\|*

4-7. Narayana said — In the earlier times, Shiva was seated on the top of the mountain Kailasa who happened to be the lord of the siddhas, who grants success, the form of all, the best of all having a pleasant face, delightful, wearing a serene smile on the face, adored by the ascetic and was narrating the story of the Rasamaridala of lord Krishna at the instance of Kumara Karttikeya. Finding an opportunity goddess Parvati, feeling delighted in her mind, put a question to the lord offering prayers as she had already earned the grace of the lord. The goddess Parvati then said to Mahadeva.

## \|\| 48.8-16 \|\|

*provāca taṃ mahādevaṃ mahādevī sureśvarī \|*  
*apūrvaṃ rādhikākhyānaṃ purāṇeṣu sudurlabham \|\| 8 \|\|*

*śrīpārvatyuvāca \|*  
*āgamaṃ nikhilaṃ nātha śrutaṃ sarvamanuttamam \|*  
*pāñcarātrādikaṃ nītiśāstrayogaṃ ca yoginām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*siddhānāṃ siddhiśāstraṃ ca nānātantraṃ manoharam \|*  
*bhaktānāṃ bhaktiśāstraṃ ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*devīnāmapi sarvāsāṃ caritaṃ tvanmukhāmbujāt \|*  
*adhunā śrotumicchāmi rādhikākhyānamuttamam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*śrutau śrutaṃ praśastaṃ ca rādhāyāśca samāsataḥ \|*  
*tvanmukhātkāṇvaśākhāyā vyāsenoktāṃ vadādhunā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*āgamākhyānakāle ca bhavatā svīkṛtaṃ purā \|*  
*nahīśvaravyāhṛtiśca mithyā bhavitumarhati \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tadutpatiṃ ca taddhyānaṃ nāmno māhātmyamuttamam \|*  
*pūjāvidhānaṃ caritaṃ stotraṃ kavacamuttamam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*ārādhanavidhānaṃ ca pūjāpaddhatimīpsitām \|*  
*sāmprataṃ brūhi bhagavanmāṃ bhaktāṃ bhaktavatsala \|\| 15 \|\|*

*kathaṃ na kathitaṃ pūrvamāgamākhyānakālataḥ \|*  
*pārvatīvacanaṃ śrutvā namravaktro babhūva saḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

8-16. Parvati said — I would like to listen to the unprecedented story of Radhika which is difficult to get even in the Puranas. О lord, I have listened to all the Agamas, the best of Pancardtra, the text on polity, Yogashastras of the yogis, siddhishastras of the siddhas, several types of tantras and the story of the devotion of lord Krishna. Besides the above I have already listened to the stories of all the goddesses from your mouth. Now I want to listen to the unprecedented story of Radhika as described in the Vedas and praised by you and also brought out in the Kanvashakha. You have already admitted while speaking on the other scriptures, that the words of Shiva can never be untrue. Therefore, О lord, protector of the devotees, now you kindly tell me about the birth of Radha, her dhydnam, the glory of reciting her name, the method of her adoration and her stotra besides the dhyanam and the method of adoration. Why was it not recited in the literature before the Agamas? At these words of Parvati, Shiva bowed his head. Getting afraid of desecrating his own words, the five faced Shiva felt panicky and his throat, lips and tongue got dried up.

## \|\| 48.17-18 \|\|

*pañcavaktraśca bhagavāñchuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ \|*  
*svasatyabhaṅgabhītaśca maunībhūya vicintayan \|\| 17 \|\|*

*sasmāra kṛṣṇaṃ dhyānenābhīṣṭadevaṃ kṛpānidhim \|*  
*tadanujñāṃ ca saṃprāpya svārddhāṅgāṃ tāmuvāca saḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. He started thinking, keeping quite. He then thought of his own god lord Krishna and getting his permission, mentally, he spoke to his wife Parvati.

## \|\| 48.19 \|\|

*niṣiddho'haṃ bhagavatā kṛṣṇena paramātmanā \|*  
*āgamārambhasamaye rādhākhyānaprasaṃgataḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Mahadeva said — During the time of Agamas I was prevented by lord Krishna to narrate the story of Radha.

## \|\| 48.20 \|\|

*madarddhāṃgasvarūpā tvaṃ na madbhinnā svarūpataḥ \|*  
*ato'nujñāṃ dadau kṛṣṇo mahyaṃ vaktuṃ maheśvari \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О Parvati, you happen to be my better-half and you will never separate from me. Therefore, lord Krishna has permitted me to narrate the story of Radha to you now.

## \|\| 48.21 \|\|

*madiṣṭadevakāntāyā rādhāyāścaritaṃ sati \|*  
*atīva gopanīyaṃ ca sukhadaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktidam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Radhika happens to be the beloved of my lord and her story is quite secret. It is quite pleasant for the devotees and bestows the devotion of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 48.22-23 \|\|

*jānāmi tadahaṃ durge sarvaṃ pūrvāparaṃ varam \|*  
*yajjānāmi rahasyaṃ ca na tadbrahmā phaṇīśvaraḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*na tatsanatkumāraśca na ca dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*na devendro munīṃdrāśca siddhendrāḥ siddhapuṅgavāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. О Durga, I know the entire story of Radha which is unknown to Brahma Shesha, Sanatkumara, Sanatana, Indra, the best of sages, the siddhas and even the lord of siddha.

## \|\| 48.24 \|\|

*matto balavatī tvaṃ ca prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyatā \|*  
*atastvāṃ gopanīyaṃ ca kathayāmi sureśvari \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О beautiful one, О goddess, at one stage you got ready to end your life, therefore you are quite powerful. Because of that, I am narrating to you the secret story.

## \|\| 48.25 \|\|

*śṛṇu durge pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam \|*  
*caritaṃ rādhikāyāśca durlabhaṃ ca supuṇyadam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. О Durga, the astonishing story of Radha is going to be narrated which is quite difficult to get and bestows immense merit.

## \|\| 48.26-27 \|\|

*purā vṛndāvane ramye goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*śataśṛṃgaikadeśe ca mālatīmallikāvane \|\| 26 \|\|*

*ratnasiṃhāsane ramye tasthau tatra jagatpatiḥ \|*  
*svecchāmayaśca bhagavānbabhūva ramaṇotsukaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. In the earlier times in the charming place of Vnidavana, in Goloka lord Krishna seated on the gem-studded throne in Rasamandala on the beautiful peaks of the mountain having fragrant creepers of the forest. At that point of time lord Krishna developed the desire for the love sport.

## \|\| 48.28-29 \|\|

*riraṃsostasya jagatāṃ patyustanmallikāvane \|*  
*icchayā ca bhavetsarvaṃ tasya svecchāmayasya ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

*etasminnantare durge dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ \|*  
*dakṣiṇāṃgaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇo vāmārddhāṃgā ca rādhikā \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Because everything moves according to his will, therefore in the forest of the creepers when lord Jagannatha developed the desire for enjoying a love-sport, he was divided into two parts, Krishna emerged from right side while his left side was transformed into Radhika.

## \|\| 48.30 \|\|

*babhūva ramaṇī ramyā rāseśā ramaṇotsukā \|*  
*amūlyaratnābharaṇā ratnasiṃhāsanasthitā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The damsel was quite charming, was the goddess of the divine dance and was desirous of having the love of Krishna. She was then seated on the gem-studded throne adorned with all the gem-studded ornaments.

## \|\| 48.31-33 \|\|

*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā koṭipūrṇaśaśiprabhā \|*  
*taptakāñcanavarṇābhā rājitā ca svatejasā \|\| 31 \|\|*

*sasmitā sudatī śuddhā śaratpadmanibhānanā \|*  
*bibhratī kabarīṃ ramyāṃ mālatīmālyamaṇḍitām \|\| 32 \|\|*

*ratnamālāṃ ca dadhatī grīṣmasūryyasamaprabhām \|*  
*muktāhāreṇa śubhreṇa gaṃgādhārānibhena ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. Her garments were purified by fire and possessed the glory resembling the crores of full moons. She had the complexion of molten gold. Illumining in her own lustre, she wore a serene smile on her face. She had the face resembling the lotus flower of the winter season and the lines of teeth looked quite beautiful. She had a beautiful hair-do on her head and there was a fragrant garland of jasmine flowers round her neck. She wore a garland of gems which emitted lustre like the sun; she wore a garland of jewels having the lustre of the flow of the water of Ganga.

## \|\| 48.34-35 \|\|

*saṃyuktaṃ vartulottuṃgaṃ sumeru girisannibham \|*  
*kaṭhinaṃ sundaraṃ dṛśyaṃ kastūrīpatracihnitam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*māṃgalyaṃ maṃgalārhaṃ ca stanayugmaṃ ca bibhratī \|*  
*nitambaśroṇibhārārttā navayauvanasundarī \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. She had very stiff breasts which were roundish, raised like Sumeru mountain; were stiff, beautiful to look at and painted with kasturl. Both of them were the treasure of welfare and bestower of the welfare, her pelvic region was stiff and heavy. She appeared fatigued and looked quite charming because of her youth.

## \|\| 48.36 \|\|

*kāmāturaḥ sasmitāṃ tāṃ dadarśa rasikeśvaraḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā kāntāṃ jagatkānto babhūva ramaṇotsukaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Lord Krishna who happens to be the lord of the lovers and the most beautiful of the universe, looked at her who was smiling with passion and was anxious to enjoy the company of the lord.

## \|\| 48.37 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā cainaṃ sukāntaṃ ca sā dadhāra hareḥ puraḥ \|*  
*tena rādhā samākhyātā purāvidbhirmaheśvari \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. He had also taken her in his lap on meeting her. О goddess, the ancient people described her as Radha because of this.

## \|\| 48.38-39 \|\|

*rādhā bhajati taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sa ca tāṃ ca parasparam \|*  
*ubhayoḥ sarvasāmyaṃ ca sadā santo vadanti ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

*bhavanaṃ dhāvanaṃ rāse smaratyāliṃganaṃ japan \|*  
*tena jalpati saṃketaṃ tatra rādhāṃ sa īśvaraḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Radha recites the name of Krishna while Krishna recites the name of Radha; for them everything is equal. This has been stated by the learned people. Lord Krishna while in the divine dance takes to the form of Radha, runs after her, embraces her and makes love reciting her name and occasionally he invites her with a sign.

## \|\| 48.40 \|\|

*rāśabdoccāraṇādbhakto rāti muktiṃ sudurlabhām \|*  
*dhāśabdoccāraṇāddurge dhāvatyeva hareḥ padam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Therefore О Durga, the devotee of lord Krishna achieves salvation by the mere recitation of .. and by reciting the name of .. they rush to the abode of the lord.

## \|\| 48.41-42 \|\|

*kṛṣṇavāmāṃśasambhūtā rādhā rāseśvarī purā \|*  
*tasyāścāṃśāṃśakalayā babhūvurdevayoṣitaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*rā ityādānavacano dhā ca nirvāṇavācakaḥ \|*  
*tato'vāpnoti muktiṃ ca tena rādhā prakīrtitā \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Radha the goddess of the divine dance emerged from the left side of Krishna and all the other damsel? emerged from her. Therefore the word Radha is. also interpreted to mean salvation. Therefore one gets redeemed with the recitation of her name.

## \|\| 48.43 \|\|

*babhūva gopīsaṃghaśca rādhāyā lomakūpataḥ \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇalomakūpebhyo babhūvuḥ sarvaballavāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. All the cowherdesses emerged from the hair-pits of Radha whereas the cowherds emerged from the hair-pits of Krishna.

## \|\| 48.44 \|\|

*rādhāvāmāṃśabhāgena mahālakṣmīrbabhūva sā \|*  
*tasyādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā gṛhalakṣmīrbabhūva sā \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Maha-Lakshmi was born from the left side of Radha and became the great goddess of the lord known as Griha-Lakshmi.

## \|\| 48.45 \|\|

*caturbhujasya sā patnī devī vaikuṇṭhavāsinī \|*  
*tadaṃśā rājalakṣmīśca rājasampatpradāyinī \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. She became the wife of lord Vishnu and resided in Vaikuntha. The daughter of Sindhu was born of her ray and resided in Shveta-dvipa and happens to be wife of lord Vishnu who dwells in the ocean of milk. О Parvati, Lakshmi of the heaven was born out of her ray and bestowed treasure on Indra. She is known as Svarag-laks ml. From her ray Raja-Lakshmi emerged, who provides grace to the kings.

## \|\| 48.46 \|\|

*tadaṃśā martyalakṣmīśca gṛhiṇāṃ ca gṛhe gṛhe \|*  
*dīpādhiṣṭhātṛdevī ca sā caiva gṛhadevatā \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The Martya-Lakshmi emerged from her and is found in the house of everyone. She is known by the name of Griha-Lakshmi.

## \|\| 48.47 \|\|

*svayaṃ rādhā kṛṣṇapatnī kṛṣṇavakṣaḥsthalasthitā \|*  
*prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī ca tasyaiva paramātmanaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Radha herself becoming the wife of Krishna resides in his heart and she is the presiding deity of life of graet sole.

## \|\| 48.48-50 \|\|

*ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ mithyaiva pārvati \|*  
*bhaja satyaṃ paraṃ brahma rādheśaṃ triguṇātparam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*paraṃ pradhānaṃ paramaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram \|*  
*sarvādyaṃ sarvapūjyaṃ va nirīhaṃ prakṛteḥ param \|\| 49 \|\|*

*svecchāmayaṃ nityarūpaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham \|*  
*tadbhinnānāṃ ca devānāṃ prākṛtaṃ rūpameva ca \|\| 50 \|\|*

48-50. О Parvati, taking everything from a straw of Brahma as false you should recite the name of the husband of Radha, who is the form of truth, beyond all the gunas, best of all, the supreme soul, the lord, eternal, adored by all without any desire, beyond Prakriti, moves at will having the eternal form and bestows grace on his devotees. There is nothing beyond him.

## \|\| 48.51 \|\|

*tasya prāṇādhikā rādhā bahusaubhāgyasaṃyutā \|*  
*mahāviṣṇoḥ prasūḥ sā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. His Radha is dearer to him than his life which represents great fortune. She happens to be the creator of Maha-Vishnu and is the basic Prakriti and the supreme goddess.

## \|\| 48.52 \|\|

*māninīṃ rādhikāṃ santaḥ sevante nityaśassadā \|*  
*sulabhaṃ yatpadāmbhojaṃ brahmādīnāṃ sudurlabham \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. All the sages adore Radhika daily with devotion because her lotus-like feet are easily available to them though Brahma and other gods cannot easily get the same.

## \|\| 48.53 \|\|

*svapne rādhāpadāmbhojaṃ nahi paśyanti ballavāḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ devī hareḥ kroḍe chāyārūpeṇa kāminī \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The cowherds are unable to look at the feet of Radha even in their dream. Radha herself always remains in the lap of lord Krishna like a shadow.

## \|\| 48.54-55 \|\|

*sa ca dvādaśagopānāṃ rāyāṇapravaraḥ priye \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇāṃśaśca bhagavānviṣṇutulyaparākramaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*sudāmaśāpātsā devī golokādāgatā mahīm \|*  
*vṛṣabhānugṛhe jātā tanmātā ca kalāvatī \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. О dearest one, out of the twelve cowherds, there was a cowherd named Rayana-gopa who happened to be a ray of lord Krishna and was as valorous as lord Vishnu himself. Because of the curse of a cowherd named Sudama, the goddess Radha descended from Goloka and was born on earth in the house of Vrsabhanu and her mothers name was Kalavati.

## Chapter 49

## \|\| 49.1 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ sudāmaśāpañca sā devī lalābha ha \|*  
*kathaṃ śaśāpa bhṛtyo hi svābhīṣṭāṃ devakāminīm \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Parvati said — O lord, how could the goddess attract the curse of Sudama and how could Sudama who was just a servant, pronounce a curse on the great goddess?

## \|\| 49.2 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam \|*  
*gopyaṃ sarvapurāṇeṣu śubhadaṃ bhaktimuktidam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Mahadeva said — О goddess, I am going to tell you this astonishing secret. You please listen to it. It is the secret of all the Puranas, bestows welfare and salvation.

## \|\| 49.3-4 \|\|

*ekadā rādhikeśaśca goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*śataśṛṃgākhyagiryekadeśe vṛndāvane vane \|\| 3 \|\|*

*gṛhītvā virajāṃ gopīṃ subhāgyāṃ rādhikāsamām \|*  
*krīḍāṃ cakāra bhagavānratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Once, in Vrindavana of Goloka, Rasamandala was performed at the mountain of hundred peaks. The lord started enjoying the company of cowherdesses Viraja in a secluded place. She was quite fortunate and was equal to Radha. She was adorned with all the gem-studded ornaments.

## \|\| 49.5-7 \|\|

*ratnapradīpasaṃyukte ratnanirmāṇamaṇḍale \|*  
*amūlyaratnakhacitamañcake puṣpatalpake \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kastūrīkuṃkumārakte sucandanasudhūpite \|*  
*sugandhimālatīmālāsamūhaparimaṇḍite \|\| 6 \|\|*

*suratādviratirnāsti dampatī ratipaṇḍitau \|*  
*tau dvau parasparāktau sukhasambhogatantritau \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. In the Rasamandala which was illuminated with the gem-studded lamps of great value, both Viraja and Krishna lay on the bed adorned with flowers and decorated with kastUrl and red vermilion, with the best of sandal-paste and fragrant jasmine flowers which were spread all round emitting immense fragrance. Both were enjoying each other's company by lying on the bed. Both of them were deeply involved in the love-sport and were not separating from each other. Both of them were united with each other and feeling fatigued.

## \|\| 49.8 \|\|

*manvantarāṇāṃ lakṣaśca kālaḥ parimito gataḥ \|*  
*golokasya svalpakāle janmādirahitasya ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. In the meantime the period of a lakh of manvantaras passed which is quite a short duration for Goloka where there is no birth or death.

## \|\| 49.9-12 \|\|

*dūtyaścatasro jñātvā'tha jagadustāṃ tu rādhikam \|*  
*śrutvā paramaruṣṭā sā tatyāja harimīśvarī \|\| 9 \|\|*

*prabodhitā ca sakhibhiḥ koparaktāsyalocanā \|*  
*vihāya ratnālaṅkāraṃ vahniśuddhāṃśuke śubhe \|\| 10 \|\|*

*krīḍāpadmaṃ ca sadratnāmūlyadarpaṇamujjvalam \|*  
*nirmārjayāmāsa satī sindūraṃ citrapatrakam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*prakṣālya toyāñjalibhirmukharāgamalaktakam \|*  
*visrastakabarībhārā muktakeśī prakampitā \|\| 12 \|\|*

9-12. In the meantime, four of the female messengers reported the matter to Radha approaching her. On hearing that, the goddess Radha was immensely enraged and disowned the lord. Her eyes became red with anger. In spite of the advice of her friends she threw away the gem-studded ornaments, the costumes sanctified by the fire, lotuses of the play and the mirror which was decorated with invaluable gems. She removed the decoration on her face besides the vermilion and washed out her face and the decoration of the feet with water. She dishevelled the locks of her hair disarranging them. She then started trembling.

## \|\| 49.13-15 \|\|

*śuklavastraparīdhānā rūkṣā veṣādivarjitā \|*  
*yayau yānāntikaṃ tūrṇaṃ priyālībhirnivāritā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*ājuhāva sakhīsaṃghaṃ roṣavisphuritādharā \|*  
*śaśvatkampānvitāṃgī sā gopībhiḥ parivāritā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tābhirbhaktyā yutābhiśca kātarābhiśca saṃstutā \|*  
*āruroha rathaṃ divyamamūlyaṃ ratnanirmitam \|*  
*daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ dairghye tacchatayojanam \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. She then clad herself in white garment and appeared without any make-up. In spite of all her female friends advising against her moves, she rushed towards the chariot and reached it. She then started calling her female friends there. At that point of time her lips were fluttering in rage and her entire body was trembling. She was surrounded by the cowherdesses on all sides with great humility. Without caring for anyone, she at once mounted the invaluable divine chariot which was built with gems and was a thousand yojanas in a length and ten yojanas in width.

## \|\| 49.16-22 \|\|

*sahasracakrayuktaṃ ca nānācitrasamanvitam \|*  
*nānāvicitravasanaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ kṣaumairvirājitam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*amūlyaratnanirmāṇadarpaṇaiḥ pariśobhitam \|*  
*maṇīndrajālamālābhaiḥ puṣpamālāsahasrakaiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*sadratna kalaśairyuktaṃ ramyairmandirakoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*trilakṣakoṭibhiḥ sārddha gopībhiśca priyālibhiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*yayau rathena tenaiva sumanomālinā priye \|*  
*śrutvā kolāhalaṃ gopaḥ sudāmā kṛṣṇapārṣadaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtvā sāvadhānaṃ gopaiḥ sārddhaṃ palāyitaḥ \|*  
*bhayena kṛṣṇaḥ santrasto vihāya virajāṃ satīm \|\| 20 \|\|*

*svapremamagnaḥ kṛṣṇo'pi tirodhānaṃ cakāra saḥ \|*  
*sā satī samayaṃ jñātvā vicāryya svahṛdi krudhā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*rādhāprakopabhītā ca prāṇāṃstatyāja tatkṣaṇam \|*  
*virajāligaṇāstatra bhayavihvalakātarāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

16-22. It had a thousand wheels bearing beautiful paintings, it was decorated with astonishing types of fine silken cloth. The mirrors in the chariot were made of beautiful gems. It had the best of string beads and a thousand of garland of flowers. Besides it had many of the vases made of gems which were crores in number. Three lakh crores of cowherdesses mounted the chariot with Radha. О dear, the chariot was called Sumanomai and mounting it, they left the place. On hearing the noise of the chariot, Sudama the courtier of lord Krishna rushed together with other cowherds to the place of lord Krishna and cautioned him. In panic lord Krishna separated Viraja from him and engrossed in her love, he disappeared from the scene. The chaste Viraja was antagonised no doubt, but feeling panicky from the rage of Radhika, she could not contain herself and ended her life at once.

## \|\| 49.23-26 \|\|

*prayayuḥ śaraṇaṃ sādhvīṃ virajāṃ tatkṣaṇaṃ bhiyā \|*  
*goloke sā saridrūpā jātā vai śailakanyake \|\| 23 \|\|*

*koṭiyojanavistīrṇā dīrghe śataguṇā tathā \|*  
*golokaṃ veṣṭayāmāsa parikheva manoharā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*babhūvuḥ kṣudranadyaśca tadā'nyā gopya eva ca \|*  
*sarvā nadyastadaṃśāśca prativiśveṣu sundari \|\| 25 \|\|*

*ime sapta samudrāśca virajānandanā bhuvi \|*  
*athāgatya mahābhāgā rādhā rāseśvarī parā \|\| 26 \|\|*

23-26. The female friends of Viraja feeling panicky and desperate followed the path of Viraja, disappearing from the place. But, О daughter of the Himalaya, Viraja was turned in Goloka as a stream and started flowing and there it was turned into the length of a crores of yojanas and crores of yojana in width. She turned herself into a deep ravine and surrounded Goloka from all sides. О beautiful one, all the female friends of Viraja were turned into small streams and rivers flowing in the universe from the same source.

## \|\| 49.27-29 \|\|

*na dṛṣṭvā virajāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ svagṛhaṃ ca punaryayau \|*  
*jagāma kṛṣṇastāṃ rādhāṃ gopālairaṣṭabhiḥ saha \|\| 27 \|\|*

*gopībhirdvāri yuktābhirvārito'pi punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ ca sā devī bhartsayāmāsa taṃ tadā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*sudāmā bhartsayāmāsa tāṃ tathā kṛṣṇasannidhau \|*  
*kruddhā śaśāpa sā devī sudāmānaṃ sureśvarī \|\| 29 \|\|*

27-29. All the six oceans in the universe are the sons of Viraja around. Thereafter when Radha the great goddess arrived there, she could not find Viraja or Krishna there. She ultimately returned to her abode. Thereafter lord Krishna together with eight cowherds reached the abode of Radhika. Inspite of the gate-keepers of the palace of Radha the entry of the lord inside the palace was prevented, Krishna forcibly entered it. At the sight of Krishna, Radhika however denouncing him. At the same time she found Sudama standing beside Krishna who spoke to Radha something, which enraged Radha, who pronounced a curse on him, “At a place far away from here, you will be turned into the fonn of a demon.”

## \|\| 49.30-31 \|\|

*gaccha tvamāsurīṃ yoniṃ gaccha dūramato drutam \|*  
*śaśāpa tāṃ sudāmā ca tvamito gaccha bhāratam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*bhava gopī gopakanyāmukhyābhiḥ svābhireva ca \|*  
*tatra te kṛṣṇavicchedo bhaviṣyati śataṃ samāḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. In his turn Sudama also pronounced a curse on her saying, “You go to the land of Bharata and turn yourself into a cowherdesses getting separated from Krishna for a hundred years. Lord Krishna will incarnate on earth in order to relieve her burden.”

## \|\| 49.32 \|\|

*tatra bhārāvataraṇaṃ bhagavāṃśca kariṣyati \|*  
*iti śaptvā sudāmā'sau praṇamya jananīṃ harim \|*  
*sāśrunetro mohayuktastato gantuṃ samudyataḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Thus pronouncing a curse, Sudama became emotional and bowing at the feet of mother Radhika and Krishna, with the tears flowing from his eyes in illusion, he got ready to leave the place.

## \|\| 49.33 \|\|

*rādhā jagāma tatpaścātsāśrunetrā'tivihvalā \|*  
*vatsa kva yāsītyuccāryya putravicchedakātarā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The tears too started flowing from her eyes, suffering the agony of separation from the son. She felt desperate and said: “O son where are you going”?

## \|\| 49.34 \|\|

*kṛṣṇastāṃ bodhayāmāsa vidyayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*śīghraṃ saṃprāpsyasi sutaṃ mā rudastvaṃ varānane \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Thereafter the merciful lord Krishna cautioned them both with the divine knowledge and said: “0 damsel don't cry, you will get back your son quite soon.

## \|\| 49.35 \|\|

*sa cāsuraḥ śaṅkhacūḍo babhūva tulasīpatiḥ \|*  
*macchūlabhinnakāyena golokaṃ vai jagāma saḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The same Sudama was reborn as Samkhacuda who happened to be a demon king and became the husband of Tulasi, who after meeting with this end at the sight of a trident went back to Goloka.”

## \|\| 49.36-37 \|\|

*rādhā jagāma vārāhe gokulaṃ bhārataṃ satī \|*  
*vṛṣabhānośca vaiśyasya sā ca kanyā babhūva ha \|\| 36 \|\|*

*ayonisambhavā devī vāyugarbhā kalāvatī \|*  
*suṣuve māyayā vāyuṃ sā tatrāvirbabhūva ha \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. In the Varaha-kalpa, Radhika was born in the village of Gokula in the family of a Vaisya cowherd. She was born without any human contact. Her mother during pregnancy carried only the wind. At the time when the mother was giving birth to the wind, in the meantime Radhika appeared as her daughter.

## \|\| 49.38-39 \|\|

*atīte dvādaśābde tu dṛṣṭvā tāṃ navayauvanām \|*  
*sārdhaṃ rāyāṇavaiśyena tatsambandhaṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*chāyāṃ saṃsthāpya tadgehe sā'ntarddhānamavāpa ha \|*  
*babhūva tasya vaiśyasya vivāhaśchāyayā saha \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. After the expiry of twelve years, finding her becoming youthful, she was married to a trader named Rayana; at the time of marriage only a shadow Radha was married to the trader while the real Radha herself disappeared.

## \|\| 49.40 \|\|

*gate caturdaśābde tu kaṃsabhīteśchalena ca \|*  
*jagāma gokulaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śiśurūpī jagatpatiḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. After the expiry of fourteen years Krishna, the lord of the universe appeared there as an infant. He was brought To Gokula deceitfully because of the danger from Krishna.

## \|\| 49.41-42 \|\|

*kṛṣṇamātā yaśodā yā rāyāṇastatsahodaraḥ \|*  
*goloke gopakṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sambandhātkṛṣṇamātulaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇena saha rādhāyāḥ puṇye vṛndāvane vane \|*  
*vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa vidhinā jagatāṃ vidhiḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. This Rayana was the real brother of Yasodha the mother of Krishna who happened to be an arhsa of Krishna in Goloka and was his maternal uncle in the sacred forest of Vrindavana. Brahma the creator of the universe had performed the marriage of Radha with Krishna.

## \|\| 49.43 \|\|

*svapne rādhāpadāmbhojaṃ nahi paśyanti ballavāḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ rādhā hareḥ kroḍe chāyā rāyāṇamandire \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Radha whose lotus-like feet were beyond the sight of cowherds even in dream, the same Radha enjoyed the lap of lord Krishna and her shadow was very much present in the house of Rayana.

## \|\| 49.44-45 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastepe purā vidhiḥ \|*  
*rādhikācaraṇāmbhojadarśanārthī ca puṣkare \|\| 44 \|\|*

*bhārāvataraṇe bhūmerbhārate nandagokule \|*  
*dadarśa tatpadāmbhojaṃ tapasastatphalena ca \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. In the earlier times Brahma had adored for sixty thousand years to have a sight of the lotuslike feet of Radhika, because of that he could have a view of the lotus-like feet of Radha in the village of Gokula during the time of the incarnation of Krishna.

## \|\| 49.46-47 \|\|

*kiñcitkālaṃ sa vai kṛṣṇaḥ puṇye vṛndāvane vane \|*  
*reme golokanāthaśca rādhayā saha bhārate \|\| 46 \|\|*

*tataḥ sudāmaśāpena vicchedaśca babhūva ha \|*  
*tatra bhārāvataraṇaṃ bhūmeḥ kṛṣṇaścakāra saḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. In the sacred forest of Vrindavana in the land of Bharata, Krishna the lord of the cowherds enjoyed the company of Radha in Vrindavana for a short duration. Thereafter because of the curse of Sudama both of them were separated from each other. At that point of time lord Krishna relieved the earth of her burden.

## \|\| 49.48 \|\|

*śatābde samatīte tu tīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ \|*  
*dadarśa kṛṣṇaṃ sā rādhā sa ca tāṃ ca parasparam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. After the lapse of a hundred years, both Krishna and Radha met each other while on a pilgrimage.

## \|\| 49.49 \|\|

*tato jagāma golokaṃ rādhayā saha tattvavit \|*  
*kalāvatī yaśodā ca paryagādrādhayā saha \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Thereafter lord Krishna who was well-versed the knowledge of tattva went back to Goloka together with Radhika and her mother named Kalavati, besides all the cowherdesses and Yasodha the mother of Krishna.

## \|\| 49.50 \|\|

*vṛṣabhānuśca nandaśca yayau golokamuttamam \|*  
*sarve gopāśca gopyaśca yayustā yāḥ samāgatāḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Vrsabhanu, Nanda, all the cowherds and cowherdesses who had arrived on earth from the Goloka went back to their abode.

## \|\| 49.51-52 \|\|

*chāyā gopāśca gopyaśca prāpurmuktiṃ ca sannidhau \|*  
*remire tāśca tatraiva sārddhaṃ kṛṣṇena pārvati \|\| 51 \|\|*

*ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣakoṭyaśca gopyo gopāśca tatsamāḥ \|*  
*golokaṃ prayayurmuktāḥ sārdhaṃ kṛṣṇena rādhayā \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. О Parvati, all the cowherds and cowherdesses who had arrived on earth to keep the company of lord Krishna went back to Goloka and started enjoying the company of lord Krishna; thirty six lakh crores of the cowherdesses and an equal number of cowherds were freed together with Radha and Krishna and went back to Goloka.

## \|\| 49.53 \|\|

*droṇaḥ prajāpatirnando yaśodā tatpriyā dharā \|*  
*saṃprāpa pūrvatapasā paramātmānamīśvaram \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Out of them, Prajapati Drona appeared in the form of Nanda and his wife named Dhara appeared as Yasodha. In their earlier births they had adored the lord to get him as their son.

## \|\| 49.54-55 \|\|

*vasudevaḥ kaśyapaśca devakī cāditiḥ satī \|*  
*devamātā devapitā pratikalpe svabhāvataḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā rādhāmātā kalāvatī \|*  
*vasudāmāpi golokād vṛṣabhānuḥ samāyayau \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. Kashyapa was reborn as Vasudeva and Aditi reappeared as Devaki in each and every kalpa, the parents of the god are reborn according to their nature. Kalavati the mind born daughter of the manes became the mother of Radha and reaching from Goloka Vasudama to birth in form of Vrsbhanu.

## \|\| 49.56 \|\|

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ durge rādhikākhyānamuttamam \|*  
*sampatkaraṃ pāpaharaṃ putrapautravivardhanam \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. O Durga, thus I have narrated to you the best of the story of Radhika which bestows riches, removes sins and bestows sons and grandsons.

## \|\| 49.57 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇaśca dvidhārūpo dvibhujaśca caturbhujaḥ \|*  
*caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe goloke dvibhujaḥ svayam \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Lord Krishna took to two forms, one having two arms and the other having four arms living in Vaikuntha. Krishna with two arms resided in Goloka.

## \|\| 49.58 \|\|

*caturbhujasya patnī ca mahālakṣmīḥ sarasvatī \|*  
*gaṃgā ca tulasī caiva devyo nārāyaṇapriyāḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Lord Krishna had performed a function in favour of Radhika in Goloka in the Rasamandala, on the full moon day of Kartika month.

## \|\| 49.59 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇapatnī sā rādhā tadarddhāṅgasamudbhavā \|*  
*tejasā vayasā sādhvī rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. The lord Krishna keeping the Radha-kavacha in a gem-amulet wore it around the neck or the right arm, together with all the cowherds.

## \|\| 49.60 \|\|

*ādau rādhāṃ samuccārya paścātkṛṣṇaṃ vadedbudhaḥ \|*  
*vyatikrame brahmahatyāṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. With his mind filled with devotion, he composed the stotra. The lord then chewed the betel which had already been chewed by Radhika.

## \|\| 49.61 \|\|

*kārttikīpūrṇimāyāṃ ca goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*cakāra pūjāṃ rādhāyāstatsambandhimahotsavam \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Therefore Radhika is adorable by lord Krishna and Krishna is adorable by Radha. There the one, who differentiates between the two, achieves the hell.

## \|\| 49.62 \|\|

*sadratnaghuṭikāyāśca kṛtvā tatkavacaṃ hariḥ \|*  
*dadhāra kaṇṭhe bāhau ca dakṣiṇe saha gopakaiḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Lord Vishnu having four arms, had Mahalaks ml, Sarasvati', Ganga and Tulasi as his wives. All of them are the beloved of the lord.

## \|\| 49.63 \|\|

*kṛtvā dhyānaṃ ca bhaktyā ca stotrametaccakāra saḥ \|*  
*rādhācarvitatāmbūlaṃ cakhāda madhusūdanaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. The wife of lord Krishna emerged out of his left half and was known as Radhika who was like him in tejas, age, beauty and virtues.

## \|\| 49.64 \|\|

*rādhā pūjyā ca kṛṣṇasya tatpūjyo bhagavānprabhuḥ \|*  
*parasparābhīṣṭadeve bhedakṛnnarakaṃ vrajet \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Thus, the intellectual should first recite the name of Radha and then Krishna and while speaking out vice-versa; one attracts the sin of Brahmahatyd.

## \|\| 49.65-67 \|\|

*dvitīye pūjitā sā ca dharmeṇa brahmaṇā mayā \|*  
*anantavāsukibhyāṃ ca raviṇā śaśinā purā \|\| 65 \|\|*

*mahendreṇa ca rudraiśca manunā mānavena ca \|*  
*surendraiśca munīndraiśca sarvaviśvaiśca pūjitā \|\| 66 \|\|*

*tṛtīye pūjitā sā ca saptadvīpeśvareṇa ca \|*  
*bhārate ca suyajñena putrairmitrairmudā'nvitaiḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

65-67. In the earlier times, she was adored by Dharma, Brahma, myself, serpent Ananta, Vasuki, sun and moon, Mahendra, eleven Rudras, Manu, Indras and the best of the sages. She was thus adored by the entire universe. Then she was adored by Suyajna over the Sapta-dvipa together with his son and friends.

## \|\| 49.68-71 \|\|

*brāhmaṇenābhiśaptena devadoṣeṇa bhūbhṛtā \|*  
*vyādhigrastena hastena duḥkhinā ca vidūyatā \|\| 68 \|\|*

*saṃprāpa rājyaṃ bhraṣṭaśrīḥ sa ca rādhāvareṇa ca \|*  
*stotreṇa brahmadattena stutvā ca parameśvarīm \|\| 69 \|\|*

*abhedyaṃ kavacaṃ tasyāḥ kaṇṭhe bāhau dadhāra saḥ \|*  
*dhyātvā cakāra pūjāṃ ca puṣkare śatavatsarān \|\| 70 \|\|*

*ante jagāma golokaṃ ratnayānena bhūmipaḥ \|*  
*iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 71 \|\|*

68-71. As a move of destiny, the king had been cursed by a Brahmana and he attracted leprosy. While suffering from leprosy, he adored Radha with the stotra given to him by Brahma, as a result of which he got a boon from Radha and regained his riches and got relieved of all the ailments. He then wore the amulet bearing the kavacha of Radha round his neck and arm and performed tapas attentively at Puskara-ksetra for a hundred years. Thereafter the king reached Goloka mounted on a chariot studded with gem. Thus I have narrated everything to you; what more do you want to listen to?

## Chapter 50

## \|\| 50.1-2 \|\|

*pārvatyuvāca \|*  
*ko vā suyajño nṛpatiḥ kutra vaṃśe babhūva saḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ viprābhiśaptaśca kathaṃ saṃprāpa rādhikām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sarvātmanaśca kṛṣṇasya patnīṃ śrīkṛṣṇapūjitām \|*  
*kathaṃ viṇmūtradhārī ca siṣeve parameśvarīm \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Parvati said — “Who was the king Suyajna? In which dynasty was he born? How could he get Radhika who happens to be the spouse of lord Krishna and was adored by him? How could the great goddess be adored by a human being?

## \|\| 50.3-5 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastepe purā vidhiḥ \|*  
*yatpādāmbhojareṇūnāṃ labdhaye puṣkare vibhuḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kathaṃ dadarśa tāṃ devo mahālakṣmīṃ purā satīm \|*  
*durdarśāmapi yuṣmākaṃ dṛśyā sā'bhūtkathaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kathaṃ trijagatāṃ dhātā tasmai tatkavacaṃ dadau \|*  
*dhyānaṃ pūjāvidhiṃ stotraṃ tasyā vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. To receive the dust of her feet, Brahma had to adore for sixty thousand years, how could he have an audience with such a chaste Mahalaks ml? Even you people get an audience with her with difficulty; then how could a human being find her? How did the creator of the three worlds give him the kavacha, dhyanam method of adoration and stotral You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 50.6 \|\|

*śrīmahādeva uvāca \|*  
*svāyambhuvo manurdevi manūnāmādireva ca \|*  
*brahmātmajastapasvī ca śatarūpāpatiḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Mahadeva said — Svayambhuva Manu was first born in the race of Manu, who happened to be the son of Brahma, a great ascetic and the husband of Satarupa.

## \|\| 50.7-8 \|\|

*uttānapādastatputrastatputro dhruva eva ca \|*  
*dhruvasya kīrtirvikhyātastrailokye śailakanyake \|\| 7 \|\|*

*utkalastasya putraśca nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*sahasraṃ rājasūyānāṃ puṣkare sa cakāra ha \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. He had a son named Uttanapada who further had a son named Dhruva. О daughter of the mountain, Dhruva enjoyed great glory and his son named Utkala was extremely devoted to lord Narayana and he performed a thousand Rajashuya-yajnas in Puskara-ksetra.

## \|\| 50.9 \|\|

*sarvāṇi ratnapātrāṇi brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā \|*  
*amūlyaratnarāśīnāṃ sahasraṃ tejasā vṛtam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. He gave away in charity to the Brahmanas invaluable gems, a lot of riches which were shining. The king had given all these at the end of graet sacrifice.

## \|\| 50.10-13 \|\|

*brāhmaṇebhyo dadau rājā yajñānte sa mahotsave \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā tacchobhanaṃ yajñaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ priye \|\| 10 \|\|*

*suyajñaṃ nāma nṛpatiṃ cakāra surasaṃsadi \|*  
*sa ca rājā suyajñaśca manuvaṃśasamudbhavaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*annadātā ratnadātā dātā vai sarvasampadām \|*  
*daśalakṣaṃ gavāṃ caiva ratnaśṛṅgaparicchadam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*nityaṃ dadau sa viprebhyo mudāyuktaḥ sadakṣiṇam \|*  
*gavāṃ dvādaśalakṣāṇāṃ dadau nityaṃ mudā'nvitaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. О dear, because of the performing of so many yajhas successfully and giving away enormous in charity, Brahma the creator of the universe, conferred the title of Suyajna on him, who was born in the race of Manu. He gave away in charity food, gems, riches and a lakh of cows with horns covered with gold, besides daksina, to the Brahmanas daily. О Parvati, he used to offer cooked meat to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 50.14-15 \|\|

*supakvāni ca māṃsāni brāhmaṇebhyaśca pārvati \|*  
*ṣaṭkoṭīrbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojayāmāsa nityaśaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*coṣyaiścarvyairlehyapeyairatitṛptaṃ dine dine \|*  
*vipralakṣaṃ sūpakāraṃ bhojayāmāsa tatparam \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. He used to feed six crores of Brahmanas and gave them stuffs for sucking, chewing, beverages daily, which satisfied them. A lakh of Brahmanas took food with him daily and the meals included ghee and cow milk.

## \|\| 50.16-22 \|\|

*pūrṇamannaṃ ca sūpāktaṃ sagavyaṃ māṃsavarjitam \|*  
*viprā bhojanakāle ca manuvaṃśasamudbhavam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*na tuṣṭuvuḥ suyajñaṃ ca tuṣṭuvustatpitṝṃśca te \|*  
*dine suyajñayajñānte ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣakoṭayaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*cakruḥ subhojanaṃ viprāścātitṛptāśca sundari \|*  
*gṛhītāni ca ratnāni svagṛhaṃ voḍhumakṣamāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*vṛṣalebhyo daduḥ kiñcitkiñcitpathi ca tatyajuḥ \|*  
*viprāṇāṃ bhojanānte ca viprānyebhyo dadau nṛpaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tathāpyurvaritaṃ tatra cānnarāśisahasrakam \|*  
*kṛtvā yajñaṃ mahābāhuḥ samuvāsa svasaṃsadi \|\| 20 \|\|*

*ratnendrasārasaṃklṛptacchatrakoṭisamanvite \|*  
*ratnasiṃhāsane ramye paṭṭavastraiḥ susaṃskṛte \|\| 21 \|\|*

*candanādisusaṃsṛṣṭe ramye candanapallavaiḥ \|*  
*śākhāyuktaiḥ pūrṇakumbhai rambhāvṛkṣaiśca śobhite \|\| 22 \|\|*

16-22. At the time of taking food of the Brahmanas praised Suyajna and his rays. On the completion of the yajna, Suyajna fed thirty six lakh crores of Brahmanas. О beautiful one, satisfying Brahmanas with the giving away of food and the gems which they were unable to carry back to their houses. Some of them gave a part of the charity they had received to the Shudras, while a part of its was left there. He fed other Brahmanas as well. Inspite of that, heaps of food still remained there. After completion of the yajna, the monarch having long arms went to his court and occupied the lion-throne which was studded with gems and had crores of umbrellas over it, was quite a charming one, decorated with fine silken garments and with sandal leaves, having a number of vases filled with water and trunks of banana trees and sandal-wood branches, scented with agnru, kastilrl, camphor and vermilion.

## \|\| 50.23 \|\|

*candanāgurukastūrīvanasindūrasaṃskṛte \|*  
*vasuvāsavacandrendrarudrāditya samanvite \|\| 23 \|\|*
