О king, I had heard all this from the mouth of Mrtyunjaya Shiva and the same has been separated by me. What else do you want to listen to from me?

## \|\| 54.105 \|\|

*suyajña uvāca \|*  
*kālāgnirudro viśvānāṃ saṃharttā ca tamoguṇaḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇo'nte vilīnaśca sattvaṃ mṛtyuñjaye śive \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. Suyajna said — Kalagni-mdra who happens to be the destroyer of the universe has the form of tamoguna. At the end of Brahma, he merges into Mrtyunjaya Shiva.

## \|\| 54.106 \|\|

*śivo līno nirguṇe ca śrīkṛṣṇe prākṛte laye \|*  
*kathaṃ tava gurornāma mṛtyuñjaya iti śrutam \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. Shiva on his part merges into lord Krishna at the time of dissolution, then how is your teacher Shiva called Mrtyunjaya.

## \|\| 54.107 \|\|

*kathaṃ prasūrmahāviṣṇormūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|*  
*asaṃkhyāni ca viśvāni santi vai yasya lomasu \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. Lord Maha-Vishnu whose hair-pits have innumerable globes, how could Mula-Prakriti be termed as his mother?

## \|\| 54.108 \|\|

*sutapā uvāca \|*  
*brahmaṇo'nte mṛtyukanyā praṇaṣṭā jalabimbavat \|*  
*saṃhartrī sarvalokānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ narādhipa \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. Sutapa said — О best of the kings, at the death of Brahma, Mrtyukanya who destroys everyone including Brahma is herself destroyed like a water bubble.

## \|\| 54.109 \|\|

*katidhā mṛtyukanyānāṃ brahmaṇāṃ koṭiśo laye \|*  
*kālena līnaḥ śambhuśca sattvarūpe ca nirguṇe \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. Thus after the vanishing of many Mrtyukanyas and crores of Brahmas, Shiva finding an opportunity merges into lord Krishna.

## \|\| 54.110 \|\|

*mṛtyukanyā jitā śaśvacchivena guruṇā mama \|*  
*na mṛtyunā jitaḥ śambhuḥ kalpe kalpe śrutau śrutam \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. My teacher Shiva alone has overcome Mrtyukanya and the case is not otherwise. This has happened in each and every kalpa and is testified in the Vedas.

## \|\| 54.111 \|\|

*śambhurnārāyaṇasyaiva prakṛteśca narādhipa \|*  
*nityānāṃ līnatā nitye tanmāyā na tu vāstavī \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. O best of the kings, Shiva, Narayana and Prakriti are all eternal; therefore, the merging of the eternal bodies into the eternal one is just an illusion and not the reality.

## \|\| 54.112 \|\|

*svayaṃ pumānnirguṇaśca kālena saguṇaḥ svayam \|*  
*svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śambhurmāyayā prakṛtiḥ svayam \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. Because the primeval Purusa is Nirgitna who at the appropriate time takes to a new form. Narayana himself is Shiva and his illusion is the Prakriti.

## \|\| 54.113-114 \|\|

*tadaṃśastatsamaḥ śaśvadyathā vahneḥ sphuliṅgavat \|*  
*ye ye ca brahmaṇā sṛṣṭā rudrādityādayastathā \|\| 113 \|\|*

*kalpe kalpe jitāste te naśvarā mṛtyukanyayā \|*  
*na śivo brahmaṇā sṛṣṭaḥ satyo nityaḥ sanātanaḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

113-114. It is like a flame of fire. The creation made by Brahma of Rudras, Adityas and others are all over-powered by Mrtyukanya and are therefore perishable, but Shiva is never created by Brahma. He is truthful eternal and everlasting.

## \|\| 54.115-120 \|\|

*katidhā brahmaṇāṃ pāto yannimeṣaṇa bhūmipa \|*  
*athādisarge śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛtyāṃ ca jagadguruḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

*cakāra vīryādhānaṃ ca puṇye vṛndāvane vane \|*  
*tadvāmāṃśasamudbhūtā rāse rāseśvarī parā \|\| 116 \|\|*

*garbhaṃ dadhāra sā rādhā yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ suṣāva sā ḍimbhaṃ goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|\| 117 \|\|*

*cukopa ḍimbhaṃ sā dṛṣṭvā hṛdayena vidūyatā \|*  
*taḍḍimbhaṃ prerayāmāsa tadadho viśva golake \|\| 118 \|\|*

*tyaktvā'patya mahādevī ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇastāṃ bodhayāmāsa mahāyogena yogavit \|\| 119 \|\|*

*babhūva tasmāḍimbhācca sarvādhāro mahāvirāṭ \|\| 120 \|\|*

115-120. O lord of the earth, by whose twinkling of an eye Brahma is destroyed, the same lord Krishna the teacher of the universe stays in Vrindavana at the beginning of the universe. At that point of time Radha emerges from his left side in the Rasamandala who carries the fragrance from the seed of lord Krishna up to the life of Brahma. Thereafter, in the Rasamandala of Goloka, she give birth to an egg. At the sight of the egg she is filled with grief, her heart becomes painful and she throws away the egg from Golojta over the universe. Thus disowning the egg she laments again and again. Then lord Krishna who is well-versed in the Yoga enlightens her variously. Out of that egg Maha-Vishnu is born who happens to be the best of all.

## \|\| 54.121 \|\|

*suyajña uvāca \|*  
*adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvanaṃ sārthakaṃ mama \|*  
*śāpo me vararūpaścāpyabhavadbhaktikāraṇam \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. Suyajna said — Му life has been successfal today. My life has been purposeful and the curse has been turned into a blessing as a result of which I have achieved the devotion of the lord.

## \|\| 54.122-123 \|\|

*sudurlabhā harerbhaktiḥ sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalā \|*  
*na tasyāśca samaṃ vipra vedoktaṃ bhaktipañcakam \|\| 122 \|\|*

*yathā bhaktirmama bhavecchrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani \|*  
*sudurlabhā ca sarveṣāṃ tatkuruṣva mahāmune \|\| 123 \|\|*

122-123. O Brahmana, the devotion of the lord provides welfare of all the welfares, is difficult to achieve and the five types of devotion mentioned in the Vedas cannot be equated with it. О great sage, you kindly tell me the way out by which my devotion towards lord Krishna can go on increasing.

## \|\| 54.124 \|\|

*nahyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ \|*  
*te punantyurukālena kṛṣṇabhaktāśca darśanāt \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. Because the holy places are not sacred because of water, nor do the gods dwell in the earth or the stone; they purify one in long term and the devotee of Krishna purifies whosoever looks at them.

## \|\| 54.125 \|\|

*sarveṣāmāśramāṇāṃ ca dvijāterjātiruttamā \|*  
*svadharmaniratāścaiva teṣu śreṣṭhaśca bhārate \|\| 125 \|\|*

125\. Of all the Asramas the Brahmanas are considered to be the best. Out of the Brahmanas, one is the best, who is devoted to his dharma.

## \|\| 54.126 \|\|

*kṛṣṇamantropāsakaśca kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*nityaṃ naivedyebhojī ca tataḥ śreṣṭho mahāñchuciḥ \|\| 126 \|\|*

126\. The one who recites the Krishna-mantra or is devoted to him or offers naivedya to him daily, is always considered to be pure and the best of all the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 54.127-128 \|\|

*tvāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ mahājñānārṇavaṃ param \|*  
*saṃprāpya śivaśiṣyaṃ ca kaṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ mune \|\| 127 \|\|*

*adhunā'haṃ galatkuṣṭhī tava śāpānmahāmune \|*  
*kathaṃ tapasyāmaśucirnādhikārī karomi ca \|\| 128 \|\|*

127-128. О sage, you are the pupil of Shiva, the best of the Brahmanas, a devotee of Vishnu and have an ocean of knowledge. After getting you, whom shall I approach for my rescue. О great sage, because of your curse I have been suffering from leprosy; therefore being impure I have no right to perfonn tapas. I, therefore, cannot perform iapas.

## \|\| 54.129 \|\|

*sutapā uvāca \|*  
*haribhaktipradātrī sā viṣṇumāyā sanātanī \|*  
*sā ca yānanugṛhṇāti tebhyo bhaktiṃ dadāti ca \|\| 129 \|\|*

129\. Sutapa said — The eternal illusion of lord Vishnu bestows devotion of the lord on whosoever she is graceful; she grants devotion to him.

## \|\| 54.130 \|\|

*yāṃśca māyā mohayati tebhyastāṃ na dadāti ca \|*  
*karoti vañcanāṃ teṣāṃ naśvareṇa dhanena ca \|\| 130 \|\|*

130\. Whosoever is influenced by this illusion, she grants him perishable things and deprives him of the devotion.

## \|\| 54.131 \|\|

*kṛṣṇapremamayīṃ śaktiṃ prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevatām \|*  
*bhaja rādhāṃ nirguṇāṃ tāṃ pradātrīṃ sarvasampadām \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. Therefore you recite the name of Radha who happens to be the beloved of lord Krishna and is his true energy. She happens to be supreme deity of his life and bestows all the riches on people.

## \|\| 54.132 \|\|

*śīghraṃ yāsyāsi golokaṃ tadanugrahasevayā \|*  
*sā sevitā śrīkṛṣṇena sarvārādhyena pūjitā \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. By serving her you will soon achieve Goloka because Krishna the lord of the universe has himself adored her.

## \|\| 54.133-134 \|\|

*dhyānasādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ bhaktāḥ saṃsevya nirguṇam \|*  
*sucireṇa ca golokaṃ prayānti bahujanmataḥ \|\| 133 \|\|*

*kṛpāmayīṃ ca saṃsevya bhaktā yāntyacireṇa vai \|*  
*sā prasūśca mahāviṣṇoḥ sarvasampatsvarūpiṇī \|\| 134 \|\|*

133-134. Having worshipped lord Krishna who is an attainable by meditation, fastidious, devoid of all the qualities, the devotees achieve Goloka after a long period of many births, but by adoring the compassionate mother of the universe, devotees achieve Goloka expeditiously. She is origin of all types of wealth.

## \|\| 54.135-136 \|\|

*sahasravarṣaparyyantaṃ viprapādodakaṃ piba \|*  
*kāmadevasvarūpaśca rogahīno bhaviṣyasi \|\| 135 \|\|*

*viprapādodakaklinnā yāvattiṣṭhati medinī \|*  
*tāvatpuṣkarapatreṣu pibanti pitaro jalam \|\| 136 \|\|*

135-136. Tcrefore you consume the water, washing the feet of the Brahmanas with great devotion for a year, which will make you beautiful like Kamadeva and you will be freed from all ailments because up to the time, the earth remains wet with the water of the feet of Brahmana, the manes consume food on the leaves of lotus.

## \|\| 54.137 \|\|

*pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni tāni tīrthāni sāgare \|*  
*sāgare yāni tīrthāni viprapādeṣu tāni ca \|\| 137 \|\|*

137\. The number of holy places on earth is equated with the number of holy places on the sea-shore. The same number of holy places are enshrined in the feet of the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 54.138 \|\|

*viprapādodakaṃ caiva pāpavyādhivināśanam \|*  
*sarvatīrthodakasamaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham \|\| 138 \|\|*

138\. Therefore, the water of the feet of a Brahmana removes all the ailments and grants salvation, devotion and provides welfare.

## \|\| 54.139 \|\|

*vipro mānavarūpī ca devadevo janārdanaḥ \|*  
*vipreṇa dattaṃ dravyaṃ ca bhuñjate sarvadevatāḥ \|\| 139 \|\|*

139\. Because Brahmana represents Janardana, the god of the gods and all the things given to the Brahmanas are consumed by the gods.

## \|\| 54.140 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā vipraśca gṛhītvā tasya pūjanam \|*  
*jagāma gṛhamityuktvā tvāyāsye vatsarāntare \|\| 140 \|\|*

140\. Thus speaking, he is retumes to his abode after adoring the Brahmana, saying, “I shall come back after the expiry of one year.”

## \|\| 54.141-143 \|\|

*bhaktyā ca bubhuje rājā viprapādodakaṃ śive \|*  
*viprāṃśca pūjayāmāsa bhojayāmāsa vatsaram \|\| 141 \|\|*

*saṃvatsare vyatīte tu nirmukto vyādhito nṛpaḥ \|*  
*ājagāma muniśreṣṭhaḥ sutapāḥ kaśyapāgraṇīḥ \|\| 142 \|\|*

*rādhāpūjāvidhānaṃ ca stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ manum \|*  
*dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ dadau tasmai nṛpāya saḥ \|\| 143 \|\|*

141-143. О Parvati, thereafter the king consuming the water of the feet of the Brahmana regularly, adoring them, fed them for a year. After the expiry of one year, the king was cured of all the ailments and the sage Sutapa of the race of Kashyapa also arrived there. He imparted knowledge of the method of the adoration of Radha, her stotra, mantra and dhyanam to him, as prescribed in the Samaveda.

## \|\| 54.144 \|\|

*rājannirgamyatāṃ śīghramityuktvā tapase muniḥ \|*  
*jagāma svālayāddurgaṃ nirjagāma tvarannṛpaḥ \|\| 144 \|\|*

144\. He said: “O' king now you proceed immediately for performing tapas.” Thus speaking the sage left the place and the king also went back to his abode.

## \|\| 54.145 \|\|

*rurudurbāndhavāḥ sarve trirātraṃ śokamūrcchitāḥ \|*  
*bhāryyāśca tatyajuḥ prāṇānputro rājā babhūva ha \|\| 145 \|\|*

145\. In his absence, all his relatives were filled with grief for three nights, the ladies nearly ended their life. After that he made his son the king.

## \|\| 54.146 \|\|

*suyajñaḥ puṣkaraṃ gatvā cakre vai duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ \|*  
*divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ rājā jajāpa paramaṃ manum \|\| 146 \|\|*

146\. The king Suyajna then went to Puskara-ksetra and performed tapas there for a hundred years.

## \|\| 54.147 \|\|

*tadā dadarśa gagane rathasthāṃ parameśvarīm \|*  
*sa taddarśanamātreṇa niṣpāpaśca babhūva ha \|\| 147 \|\|*

147\. Thereafter he had an audience with Radha, who was mounted on a chariot and descended from the sky; at the very sight of Radha all his sins disappeared.

## \|\| 54.148-149 \|\|

*tatyāja mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ divyāṃ mūrttiṃ dadhāra ha \|*  
*sā devī tena yānena ratnendrairnirmitena ca \|\| 148 \|\|*

*nṛpaṃ nītvā ca golokaṃ tatra caiṣā yayau tadā \|*  
*rājā dadarśa golokaṃ nadyā virajayā vṛtam \|\| 149 \|\|*

148-149. Discarding his human body he took to a divine form and mounted on the chariot studded with gems; he sat beside the goddess and went to Goloka. Reaching there the king saw Goloka surrounded by the river Viraja.

## \|\| 54.150-153 \|\|

*veṣṭitaṃ parvatenaiva śataśṛṅgeṇa cāruṇā \|*  
*śrīvṛndāvanasaṃyuktaṃ rāsamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam \|\| 150 \|\|*

*gogopagopīnikaraiḥ śobhitaṃ parisevataiḥ \|*  
*ratnendrasārakhacitairmandiraiḥ sumanoharaiḥ \|\| 151 \|\|*

*nānācitravicitraiśca rājitaṃ pariśobhitam \|*  
*saptatriṃśadbhirākrīḍaiḥ kalpavṛkṣasamanvitaiḥ \|\| 152 \|\|*

*pārijātadrumākīrṇairveṣṭitaṃ kāmadhenubhiḥ \|*  
*ākāśavatsuvistīrṇaṃ vartulaṃ candrabimbavat \|\| 153 \|\|*

150-153. It was surrounded by hundred peaked mount, ShriVrindavana and decorated with Rasamandala.It had many cows, cowherds and cowherdesses besides several beautiful temples studded with many variegated gems. It had thirty-three kalpa-vrksas besides the trees like Pdrijata, Kamadhenu cow. It was very large as the sky and circled as a disc of moon.

## \|\| 54.154 \|\|

*atyūrdhvamapi vaikuṇṭhātpañcāśatkoṭiyojanam \|*  
*śūnye sthitaṃ nirādhāraṃ dhuvameveśvarecchayā \|\| 154 \|\|*

154\. Above Vaikuntha and at a distance of fifty crores yojanas, Goloka was created at the desire of lord Krishna where it was staying still like Dhruva.

## \|\| 54.155-160 \|\|

*ātmākāśasamaṃ nityamasmākaṃ ca sudurlabham \|*  
*ahaṃ nārāyaṇo'nanto brahmā viṣṇurmahānvirāṭ \|\| 155 \|\|*

*dharmakṣudravirāṭsaṃgho gaṅgā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī \|*  
*tvaṃ viṣṇumāyā sāvitrī tulasī ca gaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 156 \|\|*

*sanatkumāraḥ skandaśca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī \|*  
*kapilo dakṣiṇā yajño brahmaputrāśca yoginaḥ \|\| 157 \|\|*

*pavano varuṇaścandraḥ sūryyo rudro hutāśanaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇamantropāsakaśca bhāratasthāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ \|\| 158 \|\|*

*ebhirdṛṣṭaśca goloko nānyairdṛṣṭaḥ kadācana \|*  
*nirāmaye ca tatraiva ratnasiṃhāsane sthitam \|\| 159 \|\|*

*ratnamālākirīṭaiśca bhūṣitaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*sunirmalaiḥ pītavastraiḥ vahniśuddhairvirājitam \|\| 160 \|\|*

155-160. It is difficult to achieve, like the soul and the sky, I could find only Narayana, Ananta, Brahma, Vishnu, Mahavirat, Dharma, Small Vishnu, Ganga, Lakshmi, Sarasvati, Vishnumaya, Savitri, Tulasi, Ganeshavara, Sanatkumara, Skanda, Nara-Narayana, Kapila, Daksina, Yajna the ascetic sons of Brahma, Vayu, Varuna, Chandra, Surya, Rudra, Agni and the Vaishnavas who always recited the mantra of Shri Krishna. Such people could be seen in the Goloka and none else. In the Goloka the lord Krishna is seated on the gem-studded lion-throne adorned with all the ornaments studded with gems, kirlta-mukuta spotless and clad in garments purified by the god of fire.

## \|\| 54.161-163 \|\|

*candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ kiśoraṃ goparūpiṇam \|*

161-163. The sandal-paste was plastered all over his body and he appeared in the form of a cowherd, having the complexion of new clouds and the eyes like white lotus and the lustre of the body resembled that of the full moon. He wore a serene smile on his face and had two arms having a flute in his hand. He takes to the human fonn for the welfare of his devotees; he is beyond Prakriti, who could be won over with devotion and his devotion is quite difficult to achieve.

*priyairdvādaśagopālaiḥ sevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|*

О Parvati, you are the eternal Prakriti and he was listening to the speech from your mouth, accompanied by music.

The arghya was being offered to him; he was in a delightful mood, independent, the cause of all the causes, the soul of all, the lord of all, the life of all, the base of all, most adorable, Brahman, eternal, the form of flame, the form of all the treasures, the bestower of all the riches and welfare and happens to be the welfare for all the welfares.

174-175. The king felt panicky at the sight of the lord. He got down from his chariot and bowed in reverence to him. Thereafter the lord pronounced a blessing on him and deputed him as a courtier bestowing his grace and devotion on him, which is very difficult to get even for the people like you.

## \|\| 54.176 \|\|

*rādhā'varuhya svarathātkṛṣṇavakṣasyuvāsa sā \|*

176\. Thereafter, the king got down from his chariot. Thereafter Radha got down from her chariot and merged into the chest of lord Krishna and the beautiful cowherdesses kept on flying white fly-whisks over the lord.

## \|\| 54.177 \|\|

*sambhāṣitā śrīkṛṣṇena sasmitena ca pūjitā \|*

177\. Lord Krishna also stood up with a smiling face and adored her and welcomed her speaking sweet words.

## \|\| 54.178-180 \|\|

*ādau rādhāṃ samuccāryya paścātkṛṣṇaṃ ca mādhavam \|*

*viparyyayaṃ ye vadanti ye nindanti jagatprasūm \|*  
*kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikāṃ premamayīṃ śaktiṃ ca rādhikām \|\| 179 \|\|*

*te pacyante kālasūtre yāvaccandradivākaram \|*  
*bhavanti strīputrahīnā rogiṇaḥ śatajanmasu \|\| 180 \|\|*

178-180. That is why Radha is spoken first and Krishna later. This has been ordained by those well-versed in the Vedas. Because those who first recite the name of Krishna and then Radha indeed insult her who happens to be the beloved and dearer to him than his life. They have to remain in the kalasiitra hell till the life of the sun and the moon and for hundred births, they are born ill without sons and wives.

## \|\| 54.181-183 \|\|

181-183. O Durgii, thus I have narrated to you the biography of Radhika. You are also the same Bhagavati, Vaishnavi, eternal goddess, NarayanI, Vishnumaya, MitlaPrakriti and Isvarl and still you are asking me under the influence of illusion though you know everything by yourself. You are the form of all females, the great goddess, the best of all and the one, who is adorable by all; thus I have told you the story of Radhika; now what else do you want to listen to from me?

## Chapter 55

## \|\| 55.1-2 \|\|

*śrīpārvatyuvāca \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇasya sthite mantre cānyeṣāmīśvarasya vaḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ jagrāha rādhāyā mantraṃ vai vaiṣṇavo nṛpaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kiṃ vidhānaṃ ca kiṃ dhyānaṃ kiṃ stotraṃ kavacaṃ ca kim \|*

1-2. Parvati said – Inspite of the king possessing you as well as Krishna’s mantra, how did he receive the mantra of Radha? What is the procedure for it? What is its dhyanam, stotra and kavachal These may be told to me. What type of mantra was suggested by him to the king? You kindly enlighten me on the procedure for the adoration.

## \|\| 55.3 \|\|

*śrīmaheśvara uvāca \|*

*śīghraṃ prāpnomi golokaṃ kasyārādhanato mune \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Maheshvara said – О Brahmana, whom shall I adore and by serving whom shall I achieve the Golokal

## \|\| 55.4-5 \|\|

*ityuktavantaṃ rājendramuvāca brāhmaṇottamaḥ \|*

4-5. When the king so asked the Brahmana, he told him like this: By serving the lord one achieves Goloka in many future births. Therefore, one should also adore Radha who happens to be the great goddess of Krishna’s life, because she is the best of all merciful and by whose grace you will achieve the great stage.

## \|\| 55.6-15 \|\|

*ityuktvā rādhikāmantraṃ dadau tasmai ṣaḍakṣaram \|*

*stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ taṃ ca śikṣayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*rājā tena krameṇaiva jajāpa paramaṃ manum \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgalam \|*

*śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ koṭicandrasamaprabhām \|*

*muktāpaṃktipratinidhidantapaṃktimanoharām \|\| 11 \|\|*

*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ bhaktānugrahakārikām \|*

*ratnakuṇḍalayugmena vicitreṇa virājitām \|\| 13 \|\|*

6-15. Thus speaking, the Brahmana enlightened him on the six-letter mantra of Radha which reads like this: art ттчт4 Besides that, he also enlightened him on the method of pranayama, purification of the body, application of mantra (mantranyasa), karanyasa, ahganyasa and the dhyanam which is difficult to acquire. The stotra and kavacha were also explained by the Brahmana to the king. Thereafter the king recited the mantra with dhyanam according to the provision of the Samaveda and provided all the welfare and the method by which lord Krishna had adored Radha in the earlier times which is like this. One should offer white campaka flowers to Radha who has the complexion of these flowers and bears the lustre of crores of moons; her face resembles the full moon of the winter season. Her eyes resemble the lotus flower of the winter season. She has a developed navel region, beautiful and developed breasts and lips resembling the ripe fruit of wood-apple; she is the best of all, having teeth like lines of jewels and wears a smile on her face. She is compassionate towards her devotees and is clad in the garments purified by fire. She wears garlands of gems and armlets studded with gems. She has all the ornaments including anklets and wristlets studded with gems besides a pair of kundalas in the ears. Her cheeks emit the lustre of Surya and she is adorned with invaluable garlands of gems. She wears a kirlta-mukuta which remains dazzling with the gems-studded in it. She wears the finger rings studded with gems besides other dmaments.

## \|\| 55.16-17 \|\|

*bibhratīṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyaśobhitām \|*

*gopībhiḥ supriyābhiśca sevitāṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ \|*

16-17. She wears a garland of jasmine flowers and wears a beautiful hair-do on the head. She happens to be the great goddess of beauty and walks like an intoxicated elephant. The loveable cowherdesses swing the white fly-whisks over her. Besides a spot of kasturl there is another small spot of sandal-paste on her forehead.

## \|\| 55.18-22 \|\|

*sindūrabindunā cārusīmantādhaḥsthalojjvalām \|*

18-22. She applies vermilion on the head at the parting of the hair which looks fine. She is adored daily by lord Krishna with great devotion. She possesses the fortune of lord Krishna and is his beloved. She is the best of the goddesses and is dearer to him than his life. She is beyond gunas and is the best of all besides being the mother of Maha-Vishnu. She is the bestower of all treasures, devotion of lord Krishna, peaceful in appearance, is Mula-Prakriti, is IsVari, VaishnavT, Vishnumaya, the beloved of lord Krishna and is seated on the beautiful gem-studded lion-throne in the Rasamandala and resides always with lord Krishna as the goddess of dance. I adore the goddess Radha.

After performing dhydnam she should be adored in sixteen ways, offering a seat, cloth, padya, arghya, fragrance, paste, essence, lamp, the best of flowers, water for bathing, gem-studded ornaments, various types of eatables, a fragrant betel, water, madhuparka and a bed studded with gems. All these items were presented by the king with devotion to Radha. О Durga, now I am going to tell you the commonly believed mantra of the goddess which you please listen to.

## \|\| 55.47-48 \|\|

*tvaṃ devī jagatāṃ mātā viṣṇumāyā sanātanī \|*

*kṛṣṇabhaktiprade rādhe namaste maṅgalaprade \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. О goddess, you are the mother of the universe, the eternal illusion of lord Vishnu, the great goddess of the life of lord Krishna, his beloved and image of welfare, beloved of lord Krishna, the incarnation of strength, the fortune of lord Krishna, the bestower of devotion of lord Krishna and bestower of welfare also. Therefore, O' Radhe, I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 55.49 \|\|

*adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvanaṃ sārthakaṃ mama \|*  
*pūjitā'si mayā sā ca yā śrīkṛṣṇena pūjitā \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Today our birth has been successful and well established because I have offered my prayer to you, who have been adored by lord Krishna himself.

## \|\| 55.50-54 \|\|

*kṛṣṇavakṣasi yā rādhā sarvasaubhāgyasaṃyutā \|*  
*rāse rāseśvarīrūpā vṛndā vṛndāvane vane \|\| 50 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇapriyā ca goloke tulasīkānane tu yā \|*  
*campāvatī kṛṣṇasaṃge krīḍā campakakānane \|\| 51 \|\|*

*candrāvalī candravane śataśṛṃge satīti ca \|*  
*virajā darpahantrī ca virajātaṭakānane \|\| 52 \|\|*

*padmāvatī padmavane kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇasarovare \|*  
*bhadrā kuñjakuṭīre ca kāmyā vai kamyake vane \|\| 53 \|\|*

*vaikuṇṭhe ca mahālakṣmīrvāṇī nārāyaṇorasi \|*  
*kṣīrode sindhukanyā ca martye lakṣmīrharipriyā \|\| 54 \|\|*

50-54. Radha who always resides in the heart of lord Krishna, the same is the goddess of Rama; she is known as Vrinda in Vrindavana, is known as Tulasi in Goloka as the beloved of lord Krishna. You are the image of play for Krishna in the campaka-Vana, Chandravall in the Chandra-vana. You are known as Sati on the mountain of a hundred peaks and Viraja on the bank of a river Viraja which destroys the pride of others. You are Padmavati in the forest of lotus flowers, Krishna on the bank of the stream Krishna, Bhadra in Kunja-kutlra; Kamya in Kamyaka-vana, Maha-Lakshmi in Vaikuntha, Van! of Narayana, Sindhukanya in the ocean of milk and Haripriya, Lakshmi with the human beings.

## \|\| 55.55-56 \|\|

*sarvasvarge svargalakṣmīrdevaduḥkhavināśinī \|*  
*sanātanī viṣṇumāyā durgā śaṅkaravakṣasi \|\| 55 \|\|*

*sāvitrī vedamātā ca kalayā brahmavakṣasi \|*  
*kalayā dharmapatnī tvaṃ naranārāyaṇaprabhoḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. You happen to be SvargLakshmi for the gods and remove all the misfortunes of the gods. You are lodged in the heart of lord Shiva, has the eternal Maya named Durga. You are lodged in the heart of Brahma as Savitri and mother of all the Vedas. By one of your rays you happen to be the spouse of Nara-Narayana.

## \|\| 55.57-58 \|\|

*kalayā tulasī tvaṃ ca gaṅgā bhuvanapāvanī \|*  
*lomakūpodbhavā gopyaḥ kalāṃśā rohiṇī ratiḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*iti śrī brahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvādāntargataharagaurīsaṃvāde śrīrādhikopākhyāne rādhāpūjāstotrādikathanaṃnāma pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. The goddess Tulasi emerges from you as also the Ganga who purifies the universe. The cowherdesses appear from your hair-pits. Rohini happens to be a ray of yours and Rati, Kala, Satarupa, Sachi, Diti, Aditi the mother of gods and Haripriya also emerged from your rays.

## \|\| 55.59 \|\|

*devyaśca munipatnyaśca tvatkalākalayā śubhe \|*  
*kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ dehi me kṛṣṇapūjite \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. O beautiful one, all the spouses of the sages emerge from your race; therefore, О goddess, bestowing the grace of lord Krishna and his devotion, you make me an attendant of the lord.

## \|\| 55.60-61 \|\|

*evaṃ kṛtvā parīhāraṃ stutvā ca kavacaṃ paṭhet \|*  
*purā kṛtaṃ stotrametadbhaktidāsyapradaṃ śubham \|\| 60 \|\|*

*evaṃ nityaṃ pūjayedyo viṣṇutulyaḥ sa bhārate \|*  
*jīvanmuktaśca pūtaśca golokaṃ yāti niścitam \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. Thus offering prayers with devotion her kavacha should be recited, this kavacha bestows her devotion and slavehood. This stotra was composed in earlier times. Thus the people who perform piijd with this kavacha take to the form of lord Vishnu and are freed from the cycle of birth and death, getting purified. They indeed dwell in the Goloka.

## \|\| 55.62 \|\|

*kārttikīpūrṇimāyāṃ ca rādhāṃ yaḥ pūjayecchive \|*  
*evaṃ krameṇa pratyabdaṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. О Parvati, on the full moon day of Kartika, one who adores Radhika yearly, surely achieves the merit of performing Rajasivya-yajna.

## \|\| 55.63 \|\|

*paramaiśvaryyayuktaḥ syādiha loke sa puṇyavān \|*  
*sarvapāpādvinirmukto yātyante viṣṇumandiram \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Enjoying all the riches in this world one is relieved of all his sins and is completely purified. Thereafter, he proceeds to the abode of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 55.64 \|\|

*ādāvevaṃ krameṇaiva rāse vṛndāvane vane \|*  
*stutā sā pūjitā rādhā śrīkṛṣṇena purā satī \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. In the earlier times for the first time Radhika was adored in Vrindavana at Rasamandala by lord Krishna who also prayed to her.

## \|\| 55.65 \|\|

*saṃpūjitā dvitīye ca dhātrā tvevaṃ krameṇa ca \|*  
*tvadvareṇa ca saṃprāpya vidhātā vedamātaram \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Thereafter, Brahma also adored her in the same way and achieved mother of the Vedas (Savitri) by your grace.

## \|\| 55.66 \|\|

*nārāyaṇo mahālakṣmīṃ prāpa saṃpūjya bhāratīm \|*  
*gaṃgāṃ ca tulasīṃ caiva parāṃ bhuvanapāvanīm \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Narayana too adored her and achieved Maha-Lakshmi, Sarasvati, Ganga the purifier of the universe.

## \|\| 55.67-70 \|\|

*viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodaśāyī ca prāpa sindhusutāṃ tathā \|*  
*mṛtāyāṃ dakṣakanyāyāṃ mayā kṛṣṇājñayā purā \|\| 67 \|\|*

*tvameva durgā samprāptā pūjitā puṣkare ca sā \|*  
*aditiṃ kaśyapaḥ prāpa candraḥ saṃprāpa rohiṇīm \|\| 68 \|\|*

*kāmo ratiṃ ca saṃprāpa dharmo mūrtiṃ pativratām \|*  
*devāśca munayaścaiva yāṃ saṃpūjya prativratām \|\| 69 \|\|*

*saṃprāpuryadvareṇaiva dharmakāmārthamokṣakam \|*  
*evaṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca kathitaṃ ca stavaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 70 \|\|*

67-70. Lord Vishnu, who sleeps on the serpent bed in the ocean of milk, had adored her for achieving Sindhu-kanya. After the death of Daksha-kanya, Sati, at the command of lord Krishna, I went to Puskara-ksetra and adoring Radhika, I got you as Durga. Similarly Kashyapa got Aditi; the moon got Rohini; Kama got Rati and Dharma got the chaste Marti. All other gods and the sages also achieved their spouses after adoring Radha and with her blessing they also achieved dharma, artha, кйта and moksa. Thus I have narrated to you the method of adoration; now I narrate to you the relevant stotra.

## \|\| 55.71-74 \|\|

*śrīmaheśvara uvāca \|*  
*ekadā māninī rādhā babhūvāgocarā prabhoḥ \|*  
*saṃsaktasya tulasyāṃ ca gopyāṃ ca tulasīvane \|\| 71 \|\|*

*sā saṃhṛtya svamūrttīśca kalāḥ sarvāśca līlayā \|*  
*sarve babhūvurdevāśca brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

*bhraṣṭaiśvaryyāśca niśśrīkā bhāryyāhīnā hyupadrutāḥ \|*  
*te ca sarve samālocya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ stotreṇa santuṣṭaḥ snātvā saṃpūjya tāṃ śuciḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭāva paramātmā sa sarveṣāṃ rādhikāṃ satīm \|\| 74 \|\|*

71-74. Maheshvara said – Once the proud Radha went to the Tulasi forest of lord Krishna, where she found Krishna engaged in a playful mood with Tulasi. She for a moment concealed herself together with the cowherdesses and the goddesses merging in her body. This surprised Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and all other gods and all of them started suffering in the absence of their spouses. Then, after deep consideration, all of them decided to take refuge with lord Krishna and praised him in various ways. Lord Krishna was pleased and getting purified after taking a bath, adored Radha offering prayers to her.

## \|\| 55.75-76 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*evameva priyo'haṃ te pramodaścaiva te mayi \|*  
*suvyaktamadya kāpaṭyavacanaṃ te varānane \|\| 75 \|\|*

*he kṛṣṇa tvaṃ mama prāṇā jīvātmeti ca santatam \|*  
*yadbrūhi nityaṃ premṇā tvaṃ sāmprataṃ tadgataṃ drutam \|\| 76 \|\|*

75-76. Lord Krishna said – О beautiful one, though I am your beloved and you love me also yet all your deceitful actions have been revealed to me. Infatuated with love you used to say that, "0 Krishna, you are my life and happen to be my soul always. Where have all these words gone?

## \|\| 55.77-78 \|\|

*asmākaṃ vacanaṃ satyaṃ yadbravīmi ca tacchrutam \|*  
*pañcaprāṇādhidevī tvaṃ rādhā prāṇādhiketi me \|\| 77 \|\|*

*śakto na rakṣituṃ tvāṃ ca yānti prāṇāstvayā vinā \|*  
*vinā'dhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca ko vā kutra ca jīvati \|\| 78 \|\|*

77-78. Whatever I am speaking is the established truth; like Dhruva, you are the lady of my five pranas and are dearer to me than even my life. I am not in a position to protect you, thus my life is departing out of my body in your absence. Because who can remain alive without the great goddess?

## \|\| 55.79 \|\|

*tasmātsarvamalīkaṃ te vacanaṃ jagadambike \|*  
*kṣuradhāraṃ ca hṛdayaṃ strījātīnāṃ ca sarvataḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. О mother of the universe, therefore you are not true because the mind of the ladies is always as sharp as a blade.

## \|\| 55.80 \|\|

*mahāviṣṇośca mātā tvaṃ mūlaprakṛtirīścarī \|*  
*saguṇā tvaṃ ca kalayā nirguṇā svayameva tu \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. You are Ishvari, the mother of Maha-Vishnu, besides being Mula-Prakriti. You have no form but you take to definite form out of your own rays.

## \|\| 55.81-82 \|\|

*jyotīrūpā nirākārā bhaktānugrahavigrahā \|*  
*bhaktānāṃ rucivaicitryānnānāmūrttīśca bibhratī \|\| 81 \|\|*

*mahālakṣmīśca vaikuṇṭhe bhāratī ca satāṃ prasūḥ \|*  
*puṇyakṣetre bhārate ca satī tvaṃ pārvatī tathā \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. You are the form of flame, are invisible and take to incarnation on earth for the benefit of your devotees. You take to many forms according to the convenience of the devotees. You are Maha-Lakshmi in Vaikuntha. You are Bharati in the sacred land of Bharata and the mother of all noble people. You are Sati and Parvati as well.

## \|\| 55.83 \|\|

*tulasī puṇyarūpā ca gaṃgā bhuvanapāvanī \|*  
*brahmaloke ca sāvitrī kalayā tvaṃ vasundharā \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. You are the chaste Tulasi, Ganga and purifier of the universe, Savitri in Brahmaloka and you are a part of your own ray.

## \|\| 55.84 \|\|

*goloke rādhikā tvaṃ ca sarvagopālakeśvarī \|*  
*tvayā vinā'haṃ nirjīvo hyaśaktaḥ sarva karmmasu \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. In the Goloka you are the great goddess of all the cowherds and cowherdesses. In your absence, I have become helpless and sometimes I feel totally helpless.

## \|\| 55.85-86 \|\|

*śivaḥ śaktastvayā śaktyā śavākārastvayā vinā \|*  
*vedakartā svayaṃ brahmā vedamātrā tvayā saha \|\| 85 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇastvayā lakṣmyā jagatpātā jagatpatiḥ \|*  
*phalaṃ dadāti yajñaśca tvayā dakṣiṇayā saha \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. Lord Shiva possesses the strength which emanates from you and he is like a dead body without you. Brahma is known as the creator of the Vedas because of your association with him in the fonn of Sarasvati. You are the preserver of the universe with Narayana. Lord Vishnu bestows the merit of yajna by your grace.

## \|\| 55.87-88 \|\|

*bibhartti sṛṣṭiṃ śeṣaśca tvāṃ kṛtvā mastake bhuvam \|*  
*bibhartti gaṅgārūpāṃ tvāṃ mūrdhni gaṃgādharaḥ śivaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

*śaktimacca jagatsarvaṃ śavarūpaṃ tvayā vinā \|*  
*vaktā sarvastvayā vāṇyā sūto mūkastvayā vinā \|\| 88\|\|*

87-88. Shesha holds you as earth over his headland Shiva holds you as Ganga over his head; you are the sole energy of the universe and without you Everything looks like dead. Because of your combination with the people they are speaking and without your grace one becomes dumb.

## \|\| 55.89 \|\|

*yathā mṛdā ghaṭaṃ karttuṃ kulālaḥ śaktimānsadā \|*  
*sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuṃ tathā'haṃ ca prakṛtyā ca tvayā saha \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. As a potter is always ready to create vases, similarly I also indulge in creation in association with you as Prakriti.

## \|\| 55.90 \|\|

*tvayā vinā jaḍaścāhaṃ sarvatra ca na śaktimān \|*  
*sarvaśaktisvarūpā tvaṃ tvamāgaccha mamāntikam \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. But without you I have lost my prowess and have become motionless. Because you are all powerful you should appear before me at once.

## \|\| 55.91 \|\|

*vahnau tvaṃ dāhikāśaktirnāgniśśaktastvayā vinā \|*  
*śobhāsvarūpā candre tvaṃ tvāṃ vinā na sa sundaraḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. You are the burning instinct of the fire, without you the fire is of no consequence. You are the grace of the moon, without you the moon has no beauty.

## \|\| 55.92-93 \|\|

*prabhārūpā hi sūryye tvaṃ tvāṃ vinā na sa bhānumān \|*  
*na kāmaḥ kāminībandhustvayā ratyā vinā priye \|\| 92 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā tāṃ saṃprāpa jagatprabhuḥ \|*  
*devā babhūvuḥ saśrīkāḥ sabhāryyāḥ śaktisaṃyutāḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

92-93. You are the form of the lustre of the sun and without you, the sun is deprived of the rays. О dear, without you, as Rati, Kamadeva cannot be associated with the beautiful damsels." After thus offering prayer to Radhika, lord Krishna got back his spouse.

## \|\| 55.94 \|\|

*sastrīkaṃ ca jagatsarvaṃ samabhūcchailakanyake \|*  
*gopīpūrṇaśca goloko hyabhavattatprasādataḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. О daughter of the mountain, with her pleasure the entire universe got their spouses restored and Goloka was filled with cowherdesses.

## \|\| 55.95-100 \|\|

*rājā jagāma golokamiti stutvā haripriyām \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇena kṛtaṃ stotraṃ rādhāyā yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ ca taddāsyaṃ saṃ prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*strīvicchede yaḥ śṛṇoti māsamekamidaṃ śuciḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

*acirāllabhate bhāryyāṃ suśīlāṃ sundarīṃ satīm \|*  
*bhāryāhīno bhāgyahīno varṣamekaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

*acirāllabhate bhāryyāṃ suśīlāṃ sundarīṃ satīm \|*  
*purā mayā ca tvaṃ prāptā stotreṇānena pārvati \|\| 98 \|\|*

*mṛtāyāṃ dakṣakanyāyāmājñayā paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*stotreṇānena saṃprāptā sāvitrī brahmaṇā purā \|\| 99 \|\|*

*purā durvāsasaḥ śāpānniśśrīke devatāgaṇe \|*  
*stotreṇānena devaistaiḥ saṃprāptā śrīḥ sudurlabhā \|\| 100 \|\|*

95-100. Then offering prayer to Radha, the beloved of Hari, the king achieved Goloka. Thus whosoever will recite the stotra of Radha will achieve the devotion of lord Krishna and his association. There is no doubt about it. At the expiry of one's wife, if one listens to the stotra for a month regularly, he soon gets a beautiful, chaste and noble wife. The unfortunate person having no wife if he listens to this stotra for a year, he also gets a beautiful, noble and chaste wife. О Parvati in the earlier times after the death of Daksha-kanya Sati, accepting the command of the lord, I also achieved you through this stotra. In earlier times Brahma also achieved Savitri through this stotra. In earlier times the gods also got back by reciting this stotra their glory which they had lost as a curse from Durvasa.

## \|\| 55.101 \|\|

*śṛṇoti varṣamekaṃ ca putrārthī labhate sutam \|*  
*mahāvyādhī rogamukto bhavetstotraprasādataḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. The one desirous of having a son can get one after listening to the stotra for a year. The reciting of this mantra relieves one of the terrific ailments.

## \|\| 55.102-103 \|\|

*kārttikīpūrṇimāyāṃ tu tāṃ saṃpūjya paṭhettu yaḥ \|*  
*acalāṃ śriyamāpnoti rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 102 \|\|*

*nārī śṛṇoti cetstotraṃ svāmisaubhāgyasaṃyutā \|*  
*bhaktyā śṛṇoti yaḥ stotraṃ bandhanānmucyate dhruvam \|\| 103 \|\|*

102-103. Radha should be adored on the full moon day of the month of Kartika. One achieves the merit of getting indestructible riches and the performing of Rajasuya-yajna. If a lady listens to this stotra, she is bestowed with all fortunes. The one who listens to it with devotion, is surely relieved of all bondage.

## \|\| 55.104 \|\|

*nityaṃ paṭhati yo bhaktyā rādhāṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*sa prayāti ca golokaṃ nirmukto bhavabandhanāt \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. He who adores Radha with devotion and recites this stotra always, is relieved of all bondages and proceeds on to Goloka.

## Chapter 56

## \|\| 56.1 \|\|

*śrīpārvatyuvāca \|*  
*pūjāvidhānaṃ stotraṃ ca śrutamatyadbhutaṃ mayā \|*  
*adhunā kavacaṃ brūhi śroṣyāmi tvatprasādataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Parvati said – I have listened to the astonishing method of worship and stotra but I woulc " e to listen to her kavacha by your grace. You.idly tell me the same.

## \|\| 56.2 \|\|

*śrīmaheśvara uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu vakṣyāmi he durge kavacaṃ paramādbhutam \|*  
*purā mahyaṃ nigaditaṃ goloke paramātmanaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Maheshvara said – О Durga, the same was revealed to me by lord Krishna in Goloka in earlier times. It is quite an astonishing kavacha which I am going to tell you. You please listen to me.

## \|\| 56.3 \|\|

*atiguhyaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ sarvamantraughavigraham \|*  
*yaddhṛtvā paṭhanādbrahmā saṃprāpto vedamātaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. It's quite secretive, the form of eternal tattva, the combination of all the mantras by practising which Brahma achieved Savitri, the mother of the Vedas.

## \|\| 56.4 \|\|

*yaddhṛtvā'haṃ tava svāmī sarvamātā sureśvarī \|*  
*nārāyaṇaśca yaddhṛtvā mahālakṣmīmavāpa saḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. By holding kavacha I happen to be your husband though you are the supreme goddess and the mother of the universe. By practising this Narayana obtained Maha-Lakshmi.

## \|\| 56.5 \|\|

*yaddhṛtvā paramātmā ca nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|*  
*babhūva śaktimānkṛṣṇaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ purā vibhuḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. By holding this lord Krishna who is beyond Nirguna-Prakriti and pervades everywhere, was able to create the universe.

## \|\| 56.6-7 \|\|

*viṣṇuḥ pātā ca yaddhṛtvā saṃprāptassindhukanyakām \|*  
*śeṣo bibharti brahmāṇḍaṃ mūrdhni sarṣapavadyataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*pratyekaṃ lomakūpeṣu brahmāṇḍāni mahānvirāṭ \|*  
*bibharti dhāraṇādyasya sarvādhāro babhūva saḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. By practising this, Vishnu maintains the universe and he also achieved Lakshmi, the daughter of Sindhu. By practising kavacha Shesha carries the globe on his head like a small seeds of Sinapis Alba. By practising which Mahavirat purifies the universe.

## \|\| 56.8 \|\|

*yaddhāraṇācca paṭhanāddharmmaḥ sākṣī ca sarvataḥ \|*  
*yaddhāraṇātkuberaśca dhanādhyakṣaśca bhārate \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. By practising and holding this, Dharma became a witness to all and Kubera became a president of the all wealth.

## \|\| 56.9 \|\|

*indraḥ surāṇāmīśaśca paṭhanāddhāraṇādvibhuḥ \|*  
*nṛpāṇāṃ manurīśaśca paṭhanāddhāraṇātprabhuḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Indra, the god of the gods, by holding and practicing it is a lord of universe and Manu, the lord of the kings gets the lordship.

## \|\| 56.10 \|\|

*śrīmāṃścandraśca yaddhṛtvā rājasūyaṃ cakāra saḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ sūryastrilokeśaḥ paṭhanāddhāraṇāddhariḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Holding this, splendid moon performed the Rajasuya sacrifice and by the reciting and holding the sun becomes the lord of three worlds.

## \|\| 56.11 \|\|

*yaddhṛtvā paṭhanādagnirjagatpūtaṃ karoti ca \|*  
*yaddhṛtvā vāti vāto'yaṃ punāti bhuvanatrayam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. By Holding and reading, the fire purifies the world and by this, the wind blows and purifies all three worlds.

## \|\| 56.12-14 \|\|

*yaddhṛtvā ca svatantro hi mṛtyuścarati jantuṣu \|*  
*triḥsaptakṛtvo niḥkṣatrāṃ cakāra ca vasundharām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*jāmadagnyaśca rāmaśca paṭhanāddhāraṇātprabhū \|*  
*papau samudraṃ yaddhṛtvā paṭhanātkumbhasambhavaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*sanatkumāro bhagavānyaddhṛtvā jñānināṃ guruḥ \|*  
*jīvanmuktau ca siddhau ca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. By practising this the goddess of death roams about freely in the universe; by practising this Parashurama the son of Jamadagni relieved the earth of the Kshatriyas twenty one times. By practising this Agastya, born of a vase, drank up the entire ocean. By practising kavacha Sanatkumara became the teacher of all the intellectuals and the sages, besides Narayana and attained perfection.

## \|\| 56.15-16 \|\|

*yaddhṛtvā paṭhanātsiddho vasiṣṭho brahmaputrakaḥ \|*  
*siddheśaḥ kapilo yasmādyasmāddakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*yasmādbhṛguśca māṃ dveṣṭi kūrmmaḥ śeṣaṃ bibhartti ca \|*  
*sarvādhāro yato vāyurvaruṇaḥ pavano yataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. By practising this Vasistha the son of Brahma achieved all success. By practising this Kapila became the lord of the siddhas. Because of the Daksha Prajapati and Bhrigu are jealous of me. Kashyapa carries Shesha and the wind god and Varuna became the base of all.

## \|\| 56.17-19 \|\|

*īśāno dikpatiścaiva yamaḥ śāstā yataḥ śive \|*  
*kālaḥ kālāgnirudraśca saṃharttā jagatāṃ yataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*yaddhṛtvā gautamaḥ siddhaḥ kaśyapaśca prajāpatiḥ \|*  
*vasudevasutāṃ prāpa caikāṃśena tu tatkalām \|\| 18 \|\|*

*purā svajāyāvicchede durvāsā munipuṅgavaḥ \|*  
*saṃprāpa rāmaḥ sītāṃ ca rāvaṇena hṛtāṃ purā \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. О Shiva, by the strength of this, Tsana and Dikpalas rule everywhere, Kalagni Rudra destroys the universe; by practising this Gautama achieved success and Kashyapa became Prajapati. Durvasa the best of the sages after the death of his wife married the daughter of Vasudeva, who was born of the ariisa Radha. In earlier times, Rama achieved Janakl who was kidnapped by Ravana.

## \|\| 56.20 \|\|

*purā nalaśca saṃprāpa damayantīṃ yataḥ satīm \|*  
*śaṅkhacūḍo mahāvīro daityānāmīśvaro yataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. By holding this, in earlier times. Nala achieve Damayanti and the valorous Sathkhacuda became the lord of the demons.

## \|\| 56.21 \|\|

*vṛṣo vahati māṃ durge yato hi garuḍo harim \|*  
*evaṃ saṃprāpa saṃsiddhiṃ siddhāśca munayaḥ purā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. О Durga by the grace of whom Nandi became our vehicle, Garuda became the vehicle of Vishnu and by the strength of kavacha the sages achieved all the success.

## \|\| 56.22-23 \|\|

*yaddhṛtvā ca mahālakṣmīḥ pradātrī sarvasampadām \|*  
*sarasvatī satāṃ śreṣṭhā yataḥ krīḍāvatī ratiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sāvitrī vedamātā ca yataḥ siddhimavāpnuyāt \|*  
*sindhukanyā martyalakṣmīryato viṣṇumavāpa sā \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. By holding this Maha-Lakshmi bestows all the riches, Sarasvati became adorable of all and became well-versed in love-sport and Savitri became the mother of the Vedas and Vishnu achieved Lakshmi the daughter of Sindhu on earth.

## \|\| 56.24 \|\|

*yaddhṛtvā tulasī pūtā gaṅgā bhuvanapāvanī \|*  
*yaddhṛtvā sarvasasyāḍhyā sarvādhārā vasundharā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. By holding this Tulasi was sanctified, Ganga became the purifier of the universe, Vasundhara became the goddess of the agricultural produce.

## \|\| 56.25-26 \|\|

*yaddhṛtvā manasādevī siddhā vai viśvapūjitā \|*  
*yaddhṛtvā devamātā ca viṣṇuṃ putramavāpa sā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*pativratā ca yaddhṛtvā lopāmudrā'pyarundhatī \|*  
*lebhe ca kapilaṃ putraṃ devahūtī yataḥ satī \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. By holding this the goddess Manasa was adored by the universe and Aditi the mother of the gods achieved a son like Vishnu. Lopamudra and Arundhatl achieved chastity and the chaste Devahuti achieved a son like Kapila.

## \|\| 56.27 \|\|

*priyavratottānapādau sutau prāpa ca tatprasūḥ \|*  
*tvanmātā cāpi saṃprāpa tvāṃ devīṃ girijāṃ yataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Satampa achieved Priyavrata and Uttanapada as son and by whose grace your mother Mena achieved you as the goddess of the earth.

## \|\| 56.28-29 \|\|

*evaṃ sarve siddhagaṇāḥ sarvaiśvaryyamavāpnuyuḥ \|*  
*śrījaganmaṅgalasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*ṛṣicchando'sya gāyatrī devī rāseśvarī svayam \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇabhakti saṃprāptau viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Thus all the siddhas achieved all the riches by that means. This is the kavacha which bestows happiness to a universe. Prajapati happens to be its Rsr, Gayatri is the metre; Radha, the goddess of Kamadeva is the goddess and by it one can achieve devotion to lord Krishna.

## \|\| 56.30 \|\|

*śiṣyāya kṛṣṇabhaktāya brāhmaṇāya prakāśayet \|*  
*śaṭhāya paraśiṣyāya dattvā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. It is to be revealed by a devotee of Krishna or a Brahmana because if some wicked person or a pupil reveals it, he meets with his end.

## \|\| 56.31-36 \|\|

*rājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ na deyaṃ kavacaṃ priye \|*  
*kaṇṭhe dhṛtamidaṃ bhaktyā kṛṣṇena paramātmanā \|\| 31 \|\|*

*mayā dṛṣṭaṃ ca goloke brahmaṇā viṣṇunā purā \|*  
*oṃ rādheti caturthyantaṃ vahnijāyāntameva ca \|\| 32 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇenopāsito mantraḥ kalpavṛkṣaḥ śiro'vatu \|*  
*oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ rādhikāṃ ṅentaṃ vahnijāyāntameva ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

*kapālaṃ netrayugmaṃ ca śrotra yugmaṃ sadā'vatu \|*  
*oṃ eṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ rādhikāyai vahnijāyāntameva ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

*mastakaṃ keśasaṃghāṃśca mantrarājaḥ sadā'vatu \|*  
*oṃ rāṃ rādhācaturthyantaṃ vahnijāyāntameva ca \|\| 35 \|\|*

*sarvasiddhipradaḥ pātu kapolaṃ nāsikāṃ mukham \|*  
*klīṃ śrīkṛṣṇapriyā ṅentaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ pātu namo'ntakam \|\| 36 \|\|*

31-36. O dear, one can give away 106 kingdom and even his life but this kavaca should not be given away to anyone because lord Krsna recited it with his own mouth which I have witnessed with Brahma and Krsna in the Goloka. \* ओं राधायै स्वाहा'। This is the mantra which is like kalpavrksa भात was recited by lord Krsna to protect me. "ओं & श्री राधिकायै स्वाहा, this mantra should protect my face, both the eyes and ears in all times to come. "ओं श्री & राधिकायै स्वाहा, ' should protect my forehead and पका. "ओं रौ राधायै स्वाहा", 18 the mantra which provides all success, should protect my cheeks, nose and face. क्रीं & कृष्णप्रियायै नमः, is the mantra which should protect my neck.

## \|\| 56.37 \|\|

*oṃ rāṃ rāseśvarīṃ ṅentaṃ skaṃdhaṃ pātu namo'ntakam \|*  
*oṃ rāṃ rāsavilāsinyai svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadā'vatu \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. ओं रो रसेश्रये नमः should protect my shoulders. ओं रां रासविलासिन्यै स्वाहा। should ए 01९01 my back.

## \|\| 56.38 \|\|

*vṛndāvanavilāsinyai svāhā vakṣaḥ sadā'vatu \|*  
*tulasīvanavāsinyai svāhā pātu nitambakam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. वृन्दावन विलासिन्यै स्वाहा। should protect my chest. तुलसीवनवासिन्यै स्वाहा। should protect my pelvic

## \|\| 56.39 \|\|

*kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā ṅentaṃ svāhāntaṃ praṇavādikam \|*  
*pādayugmaṃ ca sarvāṅgaṃ santataṃ pātu sarvataḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. ओं श्री कृष्ण प्राणाधिकायै स्वाहा। this mantra should protect my feet always, besides all the limbs. .

## \|\| 56.40 \|\|

*prācyāṃ rakṣatu sā rādhā vahnau kṛṣṇapriyā'vatu \|*  
*dakṣe rāseśvarī pātu gopīśā nairṛte'vatu \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Radha should protect he eastern direction, Krishnapriya should protect my north-eastern direction, the southern direction should be protected my Raseshvari. The south-east direction should be protected by gopisha.

## \|\| 56.41 \|\|

*paścime nirguṇā pātu vāyavye kṛṣṇapūjitā \|*  
*uttare santataṃ pātu mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The southern direction should be protected by Nirguna, the north-west direction should be protected by Krishnapujita and the north direction should be protected by Isvari, the MiilaPrakriti.

## \|\| 56.42-44 \|\|

*sarveśvarī sadaiśānyāṃ pātu māṃ sarvapūjitā \|*  
*jale sthale cāntarikṣe svapne jāgaraṇe tathā \|\| 42 \|\|*

*mahāviṣṇośca jananī sarvataḥ pātu santatam \|*  
*kavacaṃ kathitaṃ durge śrījaganmaṅgalaṃ param \|\| 43 \|\|*

*yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ param \|*  
*tava snehānmayā'' khyātaṃ pravaktavyaṃ na kasyacit \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. The north-east direction should be protected by Sarveshvari and the space, sleep and awakening should be protected by Sarvapfljita. The mother of Maha-Vishnu should protect me always from all sides. О Durga, I have explained to you the kavacha named Jaganmangala, the knowledge of which cannot be imparted to anyone because it happens to be the most secret of all the secrets and I have told you about it only because of my love for you.

## \|\| 56.45 \|\|

*gurumabhyarcya vidhivadvastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ \|*  
*kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau dhṛtvā viṣṇusamo bhavet \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. After giving away clothes, ornaments and adoring the preceptor with sandal-paste in a proper manner, one should wear this kavacha around the neck or the right arm. The one who wears the kavacha equates himself with Vishnu.

## \|\| 56.46-49 \|\|

*photsavaviśeṣe ca parvanniti sukīrtitā \|*  
*tasyādhidevī yā sā ca pārvatī parikīrtitā \|\| 46 \|\|*

*parvatasya sutā devī sā''virabhūtā ca parvate \|*  
*parvatādhiṣṭhātṛdevī pārvatī tena kīrtitā \|\| 47 \|\|*

*sarvakāle sanā prokto vistṛte ca tanīti ca \|*  
*sarvatra sarvakāle ca vidyamānā sanātanī \|\| 48 \|\|*

*śatalakṣajapenaiva siddhaṃ ca kavacaṃ bhavet \|*  
*yadi syātsiddhakavaco na dagdho vahninā bhavet \|\| 49 \|\|*

46-49. This ceremony is called parvan. Parvati is conceived to be its supreme goddess as she was born out of the mountain. And because of that, she is called Parvati, the great goddess; the word Sana is used for all the times and TanI stands for extension; therefore she is called SanatanI (eternal) because she remains present at all the times. One meets with success of this kavacha after reciting it for a hundred lakhs of times. In case one achieve success in the siddhi of this kavacha he can never be burnt alive.

## \|\| 56.50-52 \|\|

*etasmātkavacāddurge rājā duryyodhanaḥ purā \|*  
*viśārado jalastambhaṃ vahnistambhaṃ ca niścitam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*mayā sanatkumārāya purā dattaṃ ca puṣkare \|*  
*sūryyaparvaṇi merau ca sa sāndīpanaye dadau \|\| 51 \|\|*

*ballāya tena dattaṃ ca dadau duryyodhanāya saḥ \|*  
*kavacasya prasādena jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

50-52. О Durga, in the earlier times the king Duryodhana had over-powered water and fire by means of this kavacha. In the earlier times, I imparted the knowledge of this kavacha to Sanatkumara at Puskara-ksetra; it was given over to Sandlpani at the time of solar eclipse and Sandlpani imparted this knowledge to Balarama and Balarama in turn gave it out to Duryodhana. With the grace of this kavacha one is relieved of the bondage of birth and death.

## \|\| 56.53 \|\|

*nityaṃ paṭhati bhaktyedaṃ tanmantropāsakaśca yaḥ \|*  
*viṣṇutulyo bhavennityaṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. If a devotee of Radha recites with devotion the Radha mantra regularly, he becomes in turn like Vishnu earning the merit of performing the Rajasuya-yajna.

## \|\| 56.54-56 \|\|

*snānena sarvatīrthānāṃ sarvadānena yatphalam \|*  
*sarvavratopavāsena pṛthivyāśca pradakṣiṇaiḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣāyāṃ nityaṃ vai satyarakṣaṇe \|*  
*nityaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasevāyāṃ kṛṣṇanaivedyabhakṣaṇe \|\| 55 \|\|*

*pāṭhe caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ yatphalaṃ ca labhennaraḥ \|*  
*tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ paṭhanātkavacasya ca \|\| 56 \|\|*

54-56. Thus a person earns the merit of taking a bath in all the sacred places, performing all the charities, performing all the vratas and fasting, taking a round of the earth, performing all the yajnas, protecting truth always, adoring lord Krishna regularly after consuming his naivedya and the reciting of all the four Vedas. One gets all these merits by the recitation of this kavacha.

## \|\| 56.57-58 \|\|

*rājadvāre śmaśāne ca siṃhavyāghrānvite vane \|*  
*dāvāgnau saṃkaṭe caiva dasyucaurānvite bhaye \|\| 57 \|\|*

*kārāgāre vipadgraste ghore ca dṛḍhabandhane \|*  
*vyādhiyukto bhavenmukto dhāraṇātkavacasya ca \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. At the gateway of the king, in cremation ground, in the forest infested with lions and tigers, wild fire, misfortune, danger from thieves and decoits, prisons, hour of great misfortune, arrests and attracting serious ailment, one is freed from all these with the reciting of the mantra.

## \|\| 56.59 \|\|

*ityetatkathitaṃ durge tavaivedaṃ maheśvari \|*  
*tvameva sarvarūpā māṃ māyā pṛcchasi māyayā \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. О Durga, Maheshvari, whatever I have told you, it all belongs to you because you are the form of everything and you are just putting a question playfully.

## \|\| 56.60-61 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ityuktvā rādhikākhyānaṃ smāraṃsmāraṃ ca mādhavam \|*  
*pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetro babhūva saḥ \|\| 60\|\|*

*na kṛṣṇasadṛśo devo na gaṅgāsadṛśī sarit \|*  
*na puṣkarātparaṃ tīrthaṃ na varṇo brāhmaṇātparaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. Narayana said -Thus with the reciting of the story of Radhika and the name of lord Krishna again and again, lord Shiva became emotional and his eyes were wet with tears. Because there is no one else better then lord Krishna. There is no river more sacred then Ganga, there is no place holier than Puskara-ksetra and there is no one better then a Brahmana.

## \|\| 56.62-64 \|\|

*paramāṇoḥ paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ mahāviṣṇoḥ paro mahān \|*  
*nabhaḥ paraṃ ca vistīrṇaṃ yathā nāstyeva nārada \|\| 62 \|\|*

*yathā na vaiṣṇavājjñānī yogīndraḥ śaṅkarātparaḥ \|*  
*kāmakrodhalobhamohā jitāstenaiva nārada \|\| 63 \|\|*

*svapne jāgaraṇe śaśvatkṛṣṇadhyānarataḥ śivaḥ \|*  
*yathā kṛṣṇastathā śambhurna bhedo mādhaveśayoḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

62-64. О Narada, as there is nothing smaller than the atom, no one greater than Maha-Vishnu and on one as vast as the sky, similarly there is no one more knowledgeable than a Vaishnava and there is no greater yogi than Shiva. О Narada, Shiva has over powered passion, anger, grief and illusion. Lord Shiva always recites the name of lord Krishna, therefore Shiva is equated with Krishna. Thus there is absolutely no difference between Shiva and Madhava. О son, as Sambhu is the best of the Vaishnavas, Madhava is the best of the gods similarly this kavacha is the best of all the kavachas.

## \|\| 56.65-66 \|\|

*yathā śambhurvaiṣṇaveṣu yathā deveṣu mādhavaḥ \|*  
*tathedaṃ kavacaṃ vatsa kavaceṣu praśastakam \|\| 65 \|\|*

*śiśabdo maṅgalārthaśca vakāro dātṛvācakaḥ \|*  
*maṅgalānāṃ pradātā yaḥ sa śivaḥ parikīrttitaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. In the word, Shiva, fw stands for welfare and W stands for the one who grants the welfare. Therefore, Shiva is conceived to be the one who grants welfare.

## \|\| 56.67 \|\|

*narāṇāṃ santataṃ viśve śaṃ kalyāṇaṃ karoti yaḥ \|*  
*kalyāṇaṃ mokṣa ityuktaṃ sa evaṃ śaṅkaraḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. The one who bestows welfare on all human beings is called Sankara and welfare is also taken to be salvation.

## \|\| 56.68-69 \|\|

*brahmādīnāṃ surāṇāṃ ca munīnāṃ vedavādinām \|*  
*teṣāṃ ca mahatāṃ devo mahādevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*mahatī pūjitā viśve mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|*  
*tasyā devaḥ pūjitaśca mahādevaḥ sa ca smṛtaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. The one who is the best of all the gods including Brahma and is the best of all the sages well-versed in the Vedic knowledge, is called Mahadeva. In the entire universe MiilaPrakriti also known as Isvarl is adored by all the gods and by her lord who is called Mahadeva.

## \|\| 56.70-71 \|\|

*viśvasthānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mahatāmīśvaraḥ svayam \|*  
*maheśvaraṃ ca tenemaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*he brahmaputra dhanyo'si yadguruśca maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇa bhaktidātā yo bhavānpṛcchati māṃ ca kim \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. He happens to be the lord of all the creatures in the universe and intellectuals and is called Maheshvara. О son of Brahma, you are quite graceful because Maheshvara bestows the devotion of lord Krishna. Therefore why do you ask me all this?

## Chapter 57

## \|\| 57.1-3 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*sarvākhyānaṃ śrutaṃ brahmannatīva paramādbhutam \|*  
*adhunā śrotumicchāmi durgopākhyānamuttamam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*durgā nārāyaṇīśānā viṣṇumāyā śivā satī \|*  
*nityā satyā bhagavatī śarvāṇī sarvamaṅgalā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ambikā vaiṣṇavī gaurī pārvatī ca sanātanī \|*  
*nāmāni kauthumoktāni sarveṣāṃ śubhadāni ca \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Narada said – О Brahmana, I have listened to the astonishing story of Radha. Now you kindly relate to me the story of Durga which I intend to listen to from you. Durga, Narayani, Isani, Vis numaya, Shiva, Sati, Nitya, Satya, Bhagavati, Sarvani, Sarvamangala, Ambika, Vaishnavi, Gauri, Parvati, SanatanI are the names for her which have , been described in the Kauthumasakha and bestow welfare.

## \|\| 57.4 \|\|

*arthaṃ ṣoḍaśanāmnāṃ ca sarveṣāmīpsitaṃ varam \|*  
*brūhi vedavidāṃ śreṣṭha vedoktaṃ sarvasammatam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. О best of those well-versed in the Vedas, you kindly speak out the meaning of all the sixteen names mentioned above which bestow welfare on all and have been mentioned in the Vedas and opined by all.

## \|\| 57.5 \|\|

*kena vā pūjitā sā''dau dvitīye kena vā purā \|*  
*tṛtīye vā caturthe vā kena sarvatra pūjitā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Who adored this goddess first of all? Thereafter who was the second, third and four to adore?

## \|\| 57.6 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*arthaṃ ṣoḍaśanāmnāṃ ca viṣṇurvede cakāra saḥ \|*  
*jñātvā punaḥ pṛcchasi tvaṃ kathayāmi yathāgamam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Narayana said – Lord Vishnu has already given out the sixteen names in the Vedas and you are well aware of them. Inspite of that you are asking me the question and therefore I am speaking out whatever has been provided in the scriptures.

## \|\| 57.7-8 \|\|

*durgo daitye mahāvighne bhavabandhe ca karmmaṇi \|*  
*śoke duḥkhe ca narake yamadaṇḍe ca janmani \|\| 7 \|\|*

*mahābhaye'tiroge cāpyāśabdo hantṛvācakaḥ \|*  
*etānhantyeva yā devī sā durgā parikīrttitā \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. The word durga stands for a demon, who was a great obstruction representing human bondage, the deeds of the universe, grief, pain, hell, Yamadatida, birth, great danger and incurable disease and the word … stands for the killer of the same. Therefore the one who destroys all these miseries, has been given the name of Durga.

## \|\| 57.9 \|\|

*yaśasā tejasā rūpairnārāyaṇasamā guṇaiḥ \|*  
*śaktirnārāyaṇasyeyaṃ tena nārāyaṇī smṛtā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. In glory, lustre, beauty and virtues she is equated with Narayana and she happens to be her sole energy. She is therefore called Narayani.

## \|\| 57.10 \|\|

*īśānaḥ sarvasiddhyarthe cāśabdo dātṛvācakaḥ \|*  
*sarvasiddhipradātrī yā sā'pīśānā prakīrttitā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Ishana is a word used for all success and the word … stands for the giver. Therefore the one who bestows all success is called Isana.

## \|\| 57.11 \|\|

*sṛṣṭā māyā purā sṛṣṭau viṣṇunā paramātmanā \|*  
*mohitaṃ māyayā viśvaṃ viṣṇumāyā prakīrttitā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. In the earlier times lord Vishnu created the illusion (…) and the entire universe was infatuated with the illusion. She was therefore called Vishnumaya.

## \|\| 57.12-13 \|\|

*śive kalyāṇarūpā ca śivadā ca śivapriyā \|*  
*priye dātari cāśabdaḥ śivā tena prakīrtitā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sadbuddhyadhiṣṭhātṛdevī vidyamānā yuge yuge \|*  
*pativratā suśīlā ca sā satī parikīrtitā \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. She stands for the welfare of Shiva and is also beloved of Shiva, that is why she is called Shiva. In every aeon she pervades the universe as the great goddess of success. Being a chaste lady, possessing the best of nature, she is called Sati.

## \|\| 57.14-15 \|\|

*yathā nityo hi bhagavānnityā bhagavatī tathā \|*  
*svamāyayā tirobhūtā tatreśe prākṛte laye \|\| 14 \|\|*

*ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ mithyaiva kṛtrimam \|*  
*durgā satyasvarūpā sā prakṛtirbhagavānyathā \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. As lord Vishnu is eternal, similarly the goddess Bhagavati is also eternal; at the time of dissolution she merges into the body of her lord Krishna. Therefore, everything from a straw to Brahma is all artificial, but like the lord, the goddess Durga is also truthful.

## \|\| 57.16 \|\|

*siddhaiśvaryādikaṃ sarvaṃ yasyāmasti yuge yuge \|*  
*siddhādike bhago jñeyastena sā bhagavatī smṛtā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. As all the success of riches, the name present in all the aeons, the word Bhaga is added to the name of the same goddess forming the word Bhagavati.

## \|\| 57.17 \|\|

*sarvānmokṣaṃ prāpayati janmamṛtyujarādikam \|*  
*carācarāṃśca viśvasthāñcharvāṇī tena kīrtitā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The one who bestows salvation on all and the one who is the cause of birth, death and old age of all the creatures on earth is called Sarvanl.

## \|\| 57.18 \|\|

*maṅgalaṃ mokṣavacanaṃ cāśabdo dātṛvācakaḥ \|*  
*sarvānmokṣānyā dadāti saiva syātsarvamaṅgalā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The word Amba is used for mother for adoration and worship. Therefore the one who is worshipped by all is called Ambika, the devotees of Vishnu call her Vaishnavl since she happens to be the form of Vishnu, with whose energy the universe is created by Vishnu at the time of creation.

## \|\| 57.19 \|\|

*harṣe sampadi kalyāṇe maṃgalaṃ parikīrtitam \|*  
*tāndadāti ca sarvebhyastena sā sarvamaṃgalā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. She is of fair complexion, clad in yellow garments, unattached and spotless. Because she is the energy of the great soul she is called Gauri.

## \|\| 57.20-21 \|\|

*ambeti mātṛvacano vandane pūjane sadā \|*  
*pūjitā vanditā mātā jagatāṃ tena sā'mbikā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*viṣṇubhaktā viṣṇurūpā viṣṇoḥ śaktisvarūpiṇī \|*  
*sṛṣṭau ca viṣṇunā sṛṣṭā vaiṣṇavī tena kīrtitā \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Shiva happens to be the spouse of Shiva. Lord Krishna is also the teacher of all and she happens to be the illusion of Krishna. She is therefore called Gauri, because of the difference in date, difference in mountains, difference in kalpas and several other differences. She is thus called Parvati.

## \|\| 57.22 \|\|

*gauraḥ pīte ca nirlipte pare brahmaṇi nirmale \|*  
*tasyātmanaḥ śaktiriyaṃ gaurī tena prakīrtitā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The word Maiigala stands for welfare and the ЗП stands for the giver of the welfare. Therefore she grants welfare to all earning the name of Sarvamangala.

## \|\| 57.23-24 \|\|

*guruḥ śambhuśca sarveṣāṃ tasya śaktiḥ yā satī \|*  
*guruḥ kṛṣṇaśca tanmāyā gaurī tena prakīrttitā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tithibhede parvabhede kalpabhede'nyabhedake \|*  
*khyātau teṣu ca vikhyātā pārvatī tena kīrtitā \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. The word Maiigala is used for pleasures, riches and welfare which is bestowed by her on everyone. She is therefore known as Sarvamangala.

## \|\| 57.25 \|\|

*mahotsavaviśeṣe ca parvanniti sukīrtitā \|*  
*tasyādhidevī yā sā ca pārvatī parikīrttitā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. During the special occasion, the word parvan is used and since she happens to be the goddess of all the sacred occasions, she is called Parvati.

## \|\| 57.26 \|\|

*parvatasya sutā devī sā''virbhūtā ca parvate \|*  
*parvatādhiṣṭhātṛdevī pārvatī tena kīrttitā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. More so, because she happens to be the daughter of the mountain, appeared over a mountain and became the goddess of mountains and so she is called Parvati.

## \|\| 57.27-28 \|\|

*sarvakāle sanā prokto vistṛte ca tanīti ca \|*  
*sarvatrasarvakāle ca vidyamānā sanātanī \|\| 27 \|\|*

*arthaḥ ṣoḍaśanāmnāṃ ca kīrttitaśca mahāmune \|*  
*yathāgamaṃ tvaṃ vedoktopākhyānaṃ ca niśāmaya \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. The word sana is used for all times and in its expanded form, Tanl is added to it. Therefore since she is found present in all the times at all the places, she was given the name of Sanatanl. О sage I have explained the meaning of all the sixteen names. I am now narrating the relevant story about her and as told in the Vedas. You listen to me.

## \|\| 57.29 \|\|

*prathame pūjitā sā ca kṛṣṇena paramātmanā \|*  
*vṛndāvane ca sṛṣṭyādau goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. In the earlier times at the beginning of creation, lord Krishna adored her in the Goloka in Rasamandala of Vrindavana.

## \|\| 57.30-31 \|\|

*madhukaiṭabhabhītena brahmaṇā sā dvitīyataḥ \|*  
*tripurapreritenaiva tṛtīye tripurāriṇā \|\| 30 \|\|*

*bhraṣṭaśriyā mahendreṇa śāpāddurvāsasaḥ purā \|*  
*caturthe pūjitā devī bhaktyā bhagavatī satī \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. Secondly Brahma adored her getting terrified for Madhu-kaitabha. Thirdly lord Shiva adored her at the time of his war with Tripura. Fourthiy in the earlier times Mahendra adored her after he was cursed by Durvasa as a result of which he lost all his riches and glory. Having fallen from glory, he adored the goddess with great devotion.

## \|\| 57.32 \|\|

*tadā munīndraiḥ siddhendrairdevaiśca munipuṅgavaiḥ \|*  
*pūjitā sarvaviśveṣu samabhūtsarvataḥ sadā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Since then, she was popularly adored by all the sages, the siddhas, the gods and the Rsis everywhere.

## \|\| 57.33-34 \|\|

*tejassu sarvadevānāṃ sā''virbhūtā purā mune \|*  
*sarve devā dadustasyai śastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

*durgādayaśca daityāśca nihatā durgayā tayā \|*  
*dattaṃ svarājyaṃ devebhyo varaṃ ca yadabhīpsitam \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. О sage, in the earlier times, she appeared from the lustre of all the gods under the name of Durga. All the gods presented her with their weapons and ornaments. She killed the Durga and other demons and bestowed the kingship of word to the gods.

## \|\| 57.35 \|\|

*kalpāntare pūjitā sā surathena mahātmanā \|*  
*rājñā ca medhaśiṣyeṇa mṛnmayyāṃ ca sarittaṭe \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. With the change of the kalpa, king Suratha the disciple-of Medha, created an image of the goddess in clay and adored her.

## \|\| 57.36-38 \|\|

*meṣādibhiśca mahiṣaiḥ kṛṣṇasāraiśca maṇḍakaiḥ \|*  
*chāgairikṣusukūṣmāṇḍaiḥ pakṣibhirbalibhirmune \|\| 36 \|\|*

*vedoktāṃścaiva dattvaivamupacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*dhyātvā ca kavacaṃ dhṛtvā saṃpūjya ca vidhānataḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*rājā kṛtvā parīhāraṃ varaṃ prāpa yathepsitam \|*  
*muktiṃ saṃprāpa vaiśyaśca saṃpūjya ca sarittaṭe \|\| 38 \|\|*

36-38. The king adored her, offering sheep, buffaloes, deer, rams, goats, sugar-cane, melons and birds as sacrifices, besides sixteen types of other offerings as prescribed in the Vedas. Thereafter, the king held the kavacha and offered prayers to the goddess earning the desired boon as a result thereof. A businessman, named Samadhi seated on the river bank, also adored the goddess and achieved salvation.

## \|\| 57.39 \|\|

*tuṣṭāva rājā vaiśyaśca sāśrunetraḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ \|*  
*sasarja mṛnmayīṃ tāṃ vai gabhīre nirmale jale \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Both the king and Samadhi with their eyes wet with tears and with folded hands adored the goddess and consigned the image of the clay to the water.

## \|\| 57.40 \|\|

*mṛnmayīṃ tāmadṛṣṭvā ca jaladhautāṃ narādhipaḥ \|*  
*ruroda ca tadā vaiśyastataḥ sthānāntaraṃ yayau \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Thereafter, tlie king finding the image of the goddess made in clay getting dissolved in the water started crying and the businessman at once left that place and moved to somewhere else.

## \|\| 57.41-44 \|\|

*tyaktvā dehaṃ ca vaiśyastu puṣkare duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*kṛtvā jagāma golokaṃ durgādevīvareṇa saḥ \|*  
*rājā yayau svarājyaṃ ca pūjyo niṣkaṇṭakaṃ balī \|\| 42 \|\|*

*bhogaṃ ca bubhuje bhūpaḥ ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrakam \|*  
*bhāryāṃ svarājyaṃ saṃnyasya putre vai kālayogataḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*manurbabhūva sāvarṇistaptvā vai puṣkare tapaḥ \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa samāsena yathāgamam \|\| 44 \|\|*

41-44. After performing severe tapas in Puskara, he ended his life and with the grace of the goddess, he achieved Goloka. The brave king on the other hand ruled his country for sixty thousand years without interruption. Thereafter, he entrusted the kingdom and his wife to his son, went to Pus kara-ksetra and performed tapas. He was then turned into Savarni Manu. О son, О best of the sages, thus have I narrated to you the entire story of Durga as described in the scriptures; what else do you want to listen to from me?

## Chapter 58

## \|\| 58.1-2 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*kasya vaṃśodbhavo rājā suratho dharmiṇāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ saṃprāpa vai jñānaṃ medhaso jñānināṃ varāt \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kasya vaṃśodbhavo brahmanmedhaso munisattama \|*  
*babhūva kutra saṃvādo nṛpasya muninā saha \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Narada said – To which race, did Suratha, the best of the religious kings, belong? How could be obtain knowledge from the sage Medhas? О Brahmana, О best of the sages, in which race was the sage Medha bom? Where did the conversation between the sage and the king take place?

## \|\| 58.3 \|\|

*sakhyaṃ babhūva kutrāsya vā prabho nṛpavaiśyayoḥ \|*  
*vyāsena śrotumicchāmi vada vedavidāṃ vara \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. O lord, О best of those well-versed in the Vedas, how and where did the king Suratha and the business man, Samadhi, become friends? I would like to listen to the whole story in detail.

## \|\| 58.4 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*atriśca brahmaṇaḥ putrastasya putro niśākaraḥ \|*  
*sa ca kṛtvā rājasūyaṃ dvijarājo babhūva ha \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Narayana said – Atri was the son of Brahma and a son named Chandrama was born to him because he was known as the king of the Brahmanas. He performed a Rajashuya-yajna.

## \|\| 58.5 \|\|

*gurupatnyāṃ ca tārāyāṃ tasyābhūcca budhaḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*budhaputrastu caitraśca tatputraḥ surathaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. He produced a son named Budha from the wife of Brihaspati. Caitra was the son of Budha and Suratha was the son of Caitra.

## \|\| 58.6 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*gurupatnyāṃ ca tārāyāṃ samabhūttatsutaḥ katham \|*  
*aho vyatikramaṃ brūhi vedasya ca mahāmune \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Narada Said – O' great sage! how could he produce a son from the spouse of Brihaspati, becouse this is an outragious act of god. Therefore, please tell me.

## \|\| 58.7-10 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*sampanmatto mahākāmī vyacarajjāhnavītaṭe \|*  
*tārāṃ suraguroḥ patnīṃ dharmiṣṭhāṃ ca pativratām \|\| 7 \|\|*

*susnātāṃ sundarīṃ ramyāṃ pīnonnatapayodharām \|*  
*suśroṇīṃ sunitambāḍhyāṃ madhyakṣīṇāṃ manoharām \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sudatīṃ komalāṃgīṃ ca navayauvanasaṃyutām \|*  
*sūkṣmavastraparīdhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*kastūrībindunā sārddhamadhaścandanabindunā \|*  
*sindūrabindunā cāruphālamadhyasthalojjvalām \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. Narayana said – Once Chandrama getting intoxicated with his rich possessions was roaming about on the bank of the Ganga. At that very moment he found the chaste Tara coming there, who happened to be the wife of Brihaspati and was quite noble. She was quite beautiful and had developed breasts, well developed thighs, a beautiful pelvic region, a slender waist, a charming line of teeth, tender limbs, was youthful and was clad in fine garments. She was adorned with gem-studded omameifts on her head. There was a red spot beside the small spot of sandal-paste on the forehead. The vermilion was adorned on the head at the parting of the hair.

## \|\| 58.11-12 \|\|

*vāyunā'dhovastrahīnāṃ sakāmāṃ raktalocanām \|*  
*śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāṃ pakvabimbādharāṃ varām \|\| 11 \|\|*

*sasmitāṃ namnavaktrāṃ ca lajjayā candradarśanām \|*  
*gacchantīṃ svagṛhaṃ harṣānmattavāraṇagāminīm \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. The lower garment was suddenly removed by air. At that very moment Tara having red eyes, the face like the full moon of the winter season, the lips resembling ripe wood-apples, moved on wearing a smile on her face, lowering her head with shame. Looking at Chandrama she moved on towards her home like an intoxicated elephant.

## \|\| 58.13 \|\|

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā manmathākrāntaścandro lajjāṃ jahau mune \|*  
*pulakāṃkitasarvāṅgaḥ sakāmastāmuvāca saḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. О sage, on looking at her Chandrama was infatuated with passion and shedding his shame and with the hair of his body standing on end, he spoke to her in a passionate tone.

## \|\| 58.14 \|\|

*candra uvāca \|*  
*yoṣicchreṣṭhe kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha variṣṭhe rasikāsu ca \|*  
*suvidagdhe vidagdhānāṃ mano harasi santatam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Chandrama said – О best of the damsel, you are the best of the beautiful ladies. You stop for a moment, О beautiful one, you always steal away the minds of passionate people.

## \|\| 58.15 \|\|

*niṣevya prakṛtiṃ janmasahasre kāmasāgare \|*  
*tapaḥphalena tvāṃ prāpa bṛhacchroṇīṃ bṛhaspatiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. О ocean of the passion, Brihaspati adored Durga for a thousand years and as a result of the tapas he got a fortunate damsel like you.

## \|\| 58.16 \|\|

*aho tapasvinā sārddhamavidagdhena vedhasā \|*  
*yojitā tvaṃ rasavatī śaśvatkāmāturā varā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. But it is surprising that foolish Brahma gave away a passionate woman like you to an ascetic as a wife.

## \|\| 58.17 \|\|

*kiṃ vā sukhaṃ ca vijñātamavijñeṣu samāgame \|*  
*vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṅgamaḥ sukhasāgaraḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Therefore what type of pleasure would you be enjoying by keeping the company of that poor ascetic because a passionate lady can remain happy only with a passionate man and thus they are drowned in the ocean of pleasure.

## \|\| 58.18-19 \|\|

*kāmena kāminī tvaṃ ca dagdhā'si vyarthamīśvari \|*  
*karmaṇā vā''tmadoṣādvā ko jānāti manaḥ striyāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*dine dine vṛthā yāti durlabhaṃ navayauvanam \|*  
*navīnayauvanasthāyā vṛddhena svāminā tava \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. О goddess, you being the passionate one, are suffering from the pain of passion uselessly. Or this could be due to the turn of destiny. Because who can know the mind of a lady? You are quite youthful and therefore your youthfulness is getting wasted day by day.

## \|\| 58.20-22 \|\|

*śaśvattapasyāyuktaśca kṛṣṇamātmānamīpsitam \|*  
*svapne jāgaraṇe vā'pi dhyāyannāste bṛhaspatiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*sarvakāmarasajñā tvaṃ niṣkāmaṃ kāmamīpsitam \|*  
*dhyāyantī kāmukī śaśvadyūnāṃ śṛṃgāramātmani \|\| 21 \|\|*

*anyaśca tvanmanaḥkāmo bhinnaṃ tvadbharturīpsitam \|*  
*yayośca bhinnau viṣayau kā prītiḥ saṃgame tayoḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. Brihaspati always remains engrossed in tapas. Whether sleeping or awake he adores his lord Krishna; he is free from desires but on the other hand you are filled with passion. You are, therefore, quite passionate and remaining so, you always are attracted towards beautiful persons. Your mind is attracted towards passion but the aim of the life of your husband is entirely different. If the couple whose minds movements are differently placed, how can they enjoy the life?

## \|\| 58.23-25 \|\|

*vāsantīpuṣpatalpe ca gandhacandana carcite \|*  
*modasva māṃ gṛhītvā tvaṃ vasante mādhavīvane \|\| 23 \|\|*

*sugandhyutphullakusume nirjane candane vane \|*  
*bhavatī yuvatī bhāgyavatī tatraiva modatām \|\| 24 \|\|*

*candane campakavane śītacampakavāyunā \|*  
*ramye campakatalpe ca krīḍāṃ kuru mayā saha \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. Therefore, in the spring season, in the forest of Madhavi creepers and on a bed of flowers, sprinkled with sandal-paste, you can enjoy my company here in this secluded forest of sandalwood, having an abundance of fragrant flowers. You being a fortunate lady should enjoy my company on the flower-beds. After enjoying here we can move on to the garden of campaka flowers there.

## \|\| 58.26 \|\|

*ramyāyāṃ malayadroṇyāṃ mandacandanavāyunā \|*  
*rāme rama payā sārdhamatīva nirjane vane \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. О beautiful one, you enjoy my company in the caves of Mandracala mountain located at the lonely spots.

## \|\| 58.27 \|\|

*svaraṇikhātaṭavane narmadāpuline śubhe \|*  
*surāṇāṃ vācchitasthāne ratiṃ kuru mayā saha \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. О virtuous one, you enjoy my company in the forest of Svarnarekha on the bank of river Narmada which place is desired by the gods.

## \|\| 58.28-29 \|\|

*ityuktvā madano nmatto madanādhikasundaraḥ \|*  
*papāta caraṇe devyā mando mandākinītaṭe \|\| 28 \|\|*

*niruddhamārgā candreṇa śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukā \|*  
*abhītovāca kopena raktapaṃkajalocanā \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Thus the foolish Chandrama desired to carry her on the back of Mandakini which place was quite beautiful. Thus speaking he fell at the feet of the goddess Tara. With the obstruction thus created by Chandrama, the throat, lips and tongue of Tara dried up and her eyes became red like the red lotus flower. Thereafter she became fearless and spoke in anger.

## \|\| 58.30 \|\|

*tārovāca \|*  
*dhik tvāṃ candra tṛṇaṃ manye parastrīlampaṭaṃ śaṭham \|*  
*atrerabhāgyāttvaṃ putro vyarthaṃ te janma jīvanam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Tara said – О Chandrama, disgrace to you. I treat you like a straw because you are crooked and are attracted towards the wives of others. It was a disgrace on Atri having got you as a son because your life and birth are of no consequence.

## \|\| 58.31 \|\|

*are kṛtvā rājasūyamātmānaṃ manyase balī \|*  
*babhūva puṇyaṃ te vyarthaṃ viprastrīṣu ca yanmanaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. О wicked person, you think yourself to be all powerful after performing the Rajashuya-yajna. All your tapas has become infructuous by your getting attracted towards the wife of a Brahmana.

## \|\| 58.32 \|\|

*yasya cittaṃ parastrīṣu so'śuciḥ sarvakarmasu \|*  
*na karmaphalabhākpāpī nindyo viśveṣu sarvataḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Because he whose mind is attracted towards the wives of others, is considered to be an unchaste person. Not only this, such a great sinner is denounced the world over and is deprived of the reward of his good deeds.

## \|\| 58.33 \|\|

*satītvaṃ me nāśayasi yakṣmagrasto bhaviṣyasi \|*  
*atyucchrito nipatanaṃ prāpnotīti śrutau śrutam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. In case you defile my chastity then you will suffer from the disease of consumption. This has been ordained in the Vedas. The one who rises up is sure to fall.

## \|\| 58.34 \|\|

*duṣṭānāṃ darpahā kṛṣṇo darpaṃ te nihaniṣyati \|*  
*tyaja māṃ mātaraṃ vatsa satyaṃ te śaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Lord Krishna who shatters the pride of the wicked people will also destroy your pride. Therefore, О son, I am like your mother. You leave me alone. I am speaking out the truth and this will bestow welfare for you.

## \|\| 58.35-36 \|\|

*ityuktvā tārakā sādhvī ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*cakāra sākṣiṇaṃ dharmaṃ sūryyaṃ vāyuṃ hutāśanam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*brahmāṇaṃ paramātmānamākāśaṃ pavanaṃ dharām \|*  
*dinaṃ rātriṃ ca sandhyāṃ ca sarvaṃ suragaṇaṃ mune \|\| 36 \|\|*
