35-36. Thus speaking, the chaste Tara cried aloud again and again and invoked Dharma, Surya, Vayu, Agni, Brahma, the great soul, the sky, the wind god, the earth, day and night, sandhya and all the gods as witnesses.

## \|\| 58.37-38 \|\|

*tārakāvacanaṃ śrutvā na bhītaḥ sa cukopa ha \|*  
*kare dhṛtvā rathe tūrṇaṃ sthāpayāmāsa sundarīm \|\| 37 \|\|*

*rathaṃ ca cālayāmāsa manoyāyī manoharam \|*  
*manoharāṃ gṛhītvā tāṃ sa ca reme manoharam \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. О sage, on hearing these words of Tara, Chandrama was not all afraid, but on the other hand he became enraged. He cafght her with both hands and placed her in the chariot. Chandrama enjoyed her company.

## \|\| 58.39-41 \|\|

*vispandake suravane candane puṣpabhadrake \|*  
*puṣkare ca nadītīre puṣpite puṣpakānane \|\| 39 \|\|*

*sugandhi puṣpatalpe ca puṣpacandanavāyunā \|*  
*nirjane malayadroṇyāṃ snigdhacandanacarcite \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śaile śaile nade nadyāṃ śṛṃgāraṃ kurvatostayoḥ \|*  
*gataṃ varṣaśataṃ harṣānmuhūrttamiva nārada \|\| 41 \|\|*

39-41. They enjoyed each other's company on the bank of Puspabhadra river, in the sandal-wood forest named Vispandaka, on the bank of Pus kara-ksetra in the lands of blossoming flowers, on the bed of roses scented with flowers, the secluded places in the Malaya mountain, on the forest of sandal-wood trees, in the banks of rivers and streams. He continued the love sport for a hundred years which were spent like a muhurta.

## \|\| 58.42-43 \|\|

*babhūva śaraṇāpanno bhīto daityeṣu candramāḥ \|*  
*tejasvini tathā śukre teṣāṃ ca balināṃ gurau \|\| 42 \|\|*

*abhayaṃ ca dadau tasmai kṛpayā bhṛgunandanaḥ \|*  
*guruṃ jahāsa devānāṃ suvipakṣaṃ bṛhaspatim \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. Thereafter, Chandrama getting terrified by the gods went to Sukra, the teacher of the demons to take refuge with him. Sukra then provided him shelter taking pity on him. He then started making fun of Brihaspati who happened to be his enemy.

## \|\| 58.44-45 \|\|

*sabhāyāṃ jahasurhṛṣṭā balino ditinandanāḥ \|*  
*abhayaṃ ca dadustasmai bhītāya ca kalaṅkine \|\| 44 \|\|*

*satīsatītvadhvaṃsena pāpiṣṭhacandramaṇḍale \|*  
*babhūva śaśarūpaṃ ca kalaṃkaṃ nirmale malam \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. In the court of the demons, intoxicated with pride they provided shelter to terrified Chandrama who was filled with blemish and made fun of Brihaspati. Because defiling of the chastity of a chaste lady, Chandrama earned a black spot in disk.

## \|\| 58.46 \|\|

*uvāca taṃ mahābhītaṃ śukro vedavidāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*hitaṃ tathyaṃ vedayuktaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Thereafter, Sukra well-versed in the Vedas spoke to the terrified Chandrama, the truthful words full of welfare which were according to the Vedas and resulted in delight.

## \|\| 58.47 \|\|

*śukra uvāca \|*  
*tvamaho brahmaṇaḥ pautro'pyatrerbhagavataḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*durnītaṃ karma te putra nīcavannayaśaskaram \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Sukra said – You are the grandson of Brahma and the son of sage Atri; you have acted like the wicked people and it is not graceful.

## \|\| 58.48-50 \|\|

*rājasūyasya suphale nirmale kīrttimaṇḍale \|*  
*sudhārāśau surābindurūpamaṃkamupārjitam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*tyaja devagurau patnīṃ prasūmiva mahāsatīm \|*  
*dharmiṣṭhasya variṣṭhasya brāhmaṇānāṃ bṛhaspateḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*śambhoḥ surāṇāmīśasya guruputrasya vedhasaḥ \|*  
*pautrasyāṃgirase nityaṃ jvalato brahmatejasā \|\| 50 \|\|*

48-50. After performing the Rajasuya-yajna, you had earned a great glory but that collection of nectar has vanished like a drop of wine, earning you the blemish. I want that you should leave the wife of Brihaspati, the priest of the gods. She is like your mother and quite a chaste lady. Brihaspati is the best of the noble people and also the best of the Brahmanas. Shiva is the lord of the gods and Brahma happens to be the son of his Guru, Brihaspati who happens to be his grandson and the son of Angira who always shines with eternal lustre.

## \|\| 58.51 \|\|

*śatrorapi guṇā vācyā doṣā vācyā gurorapi \|*  
*iti sadvaṃśajātānāṃ svabhāvaṃ ca satāmapi \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. One should speak out the virtues of the enemies and the failings of his teacher. This is the nature of the people who are born in the noble race.

## \|\| 58.52-53 \|\|

*sa śatrurme suraguruḥ paro viśve niśākara \|*  
*tathā'pi sahajākhyānaṃ varṇitaṃ dharmasaṃsadi \|\| 52 \|\|*

*yatra lokāśca dharmiṣṭhāstatra dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*yato dharmastataḥ kṛṣṇo yataḥ kṛṣṇastato jayaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. О lord of the night, though Brihaspati, the priest of the gods, is my enemy in the universe, still he is of a noble character and one should not forget it. Wherever the noble people reside, the eternal Dhanna resides there. Wherever Dharma resides Krishna too dwells there and wherever there is Krishna victory is always found there.

## \|\| 58.54-57 \|\|

*gaurekaṃ pañca ca vyāghrī siṃhī sapta prasūyate hiṃsakāḥ pralayaṃ yānti dharmo rakṣati dhārmikam \|\| 54 \|\|*

*devāśca guravo viprāḥ śaktā yadyapi rakṣitum \|*  
*tathā'pi nahi rakṣanti dharmaghnaṃ pāpinaṃ janam \|\| 55 \|\|*

*kulaṭā viprapatnīnāṃ gamane suraviprayoḥ \|*  
*brahmahatyāṣoḍaśāṃśa pātakaṃ ca bhaveddhruvam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*tāsāmupasthitānāṃ ca gamane taccaturthakam \|\| 57 \|\|*

54-57. The cow litters one calf, the tigress litters five and a lioness litters seven, the terrific people are destroyed. Therefore, Dharma alone protects the religious people. Though the gods, the teacher and the Brahmanas are unable to protect themselves, yet the one who is deprived of the Dhanna is never protected by anyone. If one enjoys the company of the wives of Brahmanas and wicked women, he earns the sixteenth part of the sin of Brahmahatya but in case the women offer themselves for the purpose, one earns only one fourth of the sin of Brahmahatyd. To discard them is neither sinless nor sinful. This has been ordained by Brahma.

## \|\| 58.58-59 \|\|

*viprapatnīsatīnāṃ ca gamanaṃ vai balena cet \|*  
*brahmahatyāśataṃ pāpaṃ bhavedeva śrutau śrutam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*dharmmaṃ cara mahābhāga brāhmaṇīṃ tyaja sāmpratam \|*  
*kṛtvā'nutāpaṃ pāpācca nivṛttistu mahāphalā \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. But to enjoy the company of a Brahmana woman forcefully, one earns the sin of a hundred Brahmahatyas. This has been ordained in the Vedas. Therefore, О noble person, you move according to Dharma and leave this Brahmana woman. You should repent for the sin you have already committed, because it is better to relieve oneself of the sin.

## \|\| 58.60-61 \|\|

*upāyena ca te pāpaṃ dūrībhūtaṃ bhavennanu \|*  
*śaraṇāgata bhītasya mayi devasya dharmataḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*śastrahīnaṃ ca bhītaṃ ca dīnaṃ ca śaraṇārthinam \|*  
*yo na rakṣatyadharmiṣṭhaḥ kumbhīpāke vaseddhruvam \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. You can be relieved of your sin by other means also. Getting terrified you have come to take refuge with me inspite of you being a god. Therefore, it is my duty to protect you. Because he who does not protect a person without arms, a terrified person, a miserable person and the one who takes refuge, such an irreligious person falls into the kumbhipaka hell.

## \|\| 58.62 \|\|

*rājasūyaśatānāṃ ca rakṣitā labhate phalam \|*  
*paramaiśvaryyayuktaśca dharmeṇa sa bhavediha \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. But in case he protects him, he earns the merit of performing a hundred RajasHya-yajnas besides achieving immense riches and pleasures in the world.

## \|\| 58.63 \|\|

*ityuktvā vai daityaguruḥ svarge mandākinītaṭe \|*  
*snātvā taṃ snāpayāmāsa viṣṇupūjāṃ cakāra saḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Thus speaking the teacher Sukracarya took his bath in the river Mandakini and made Chandrama also to do so. Thereafter, he adored lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 58.64-65 \|\|

*viṣṇupādābjajātena tannaivedyaṃ śubhapradam \|*  
*gaṃgodakena puṇyena bhojayāmāsa candrakam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*kroḍe kṛtvā tu taṃ bhītaṃ sajjitaṃ pāpakarmaṇā \|*  
*kuśahastastamityūce smāraṃsmāraṃ hariṃ mune \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. Thereafter he offered the sacred Ganga-water of Vishnu’s feet, offering the naivedya to him. O' sage, thereafter, Sukra took the terrified Chandrama in his lap and placing the kusa-grass in his hand, he made him recite the name of the lord repeatedly.

## \|\| 58.66-67 \|\|

*śukra uvāca \|*  
*yadyasti me tapaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ pūjāphalaṃ hare \|*  
*satyaṃ vrataphalaṃ caiva satyaṃ satyavacaḥ phalam \|\| 66 \|\|*

*tīrthasnānaphalaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ dānaphalaṃ yadi \|*  
*upavāsaphalaṃ satyaṃ pāpānmukto bhavānbhavet \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. Sukra said – In case I have performed my tapas truly, in case the adoration of Hari is truthful, it is true to have the reward of performing vrala, one gets a truthful reward by speaking the truth, it is truthful to have a bath at the holy places, it is truthful to have the reward by the performing of charity and it is truthful to have the reward of fasting, then Chandrama should be freed from all his sins.

## \|\| 58.68 \|\|

*vipraṃ trisandhyāhīnaṃ yā viṣṇupūjāvihī nakam \|*  
*tannāpnotu mahāghoraṃ candrapāpaṃ sudāruṇam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. The sin accrued from the heinous sin committed by Chandrama should befall on a Brahmana who does not perform sandhya thrice a day, the one who is deprived of the adoration of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 58.69 \|\|

*svabhāryyāvañcanaṃ kṛtvā yaḥ prayāti parastriyam \|*  
*sa yātu narakaṃ ghoraṃ rudrapāpena pātakī \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. The one who enjoys the wives of others, cheating his own wives, such as a sinful person, relieves the sin of Chandrama and falls into terrific hell.

## \|\| 58.70-71 \|\|

*vācā vā tāḍayetkāntaṃ duśśīlā durmukhā ca yā \|*  
*sā yugaṃ candrapāpena yātu lālāmukhaṃ dhruvam \|\| 70 \|\|*

*anaivedyaṃ vṛthānnaṃ ca yaśca bhuṅkte harerdvijaḥ \|*  
*sa yātu kālasūtraṃ ca candrapāpāccaturyugam \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. A wicked woman who antagonises her husband by speaking harsh words, would fall in to terrific Lalamukha hell because of the sin of Chandrama. If a Brahmana eats without offering food first to lord Vishnu, he falls in to kalasutra hell because of the sin of Chandrama and shall remain there to the end of four yugas.

## \|\| 58.72-73 \|\|

*ambuvācyaṃ bhūkhananaṃ yaḥ karoti narā dhamaḥ \|*  
*candrapāpādyugaśataṃ kālasūtraṃ sa gacchatu \|\| 72 \|\|*

*svakāntaṃ vañcayitvā ca yā yāti parapūruṣam \|*  
*sā yātu vahnikuṇḍaṃ ca candrapāpāccaturyugam \|\| 73 \|\|*

72-73. A wiked person who digs the earth at a prohibited place, he falls into the kalastitra hell because of the sin of Chandrama. If a lady goes to some other person depriving of her own husband, she falls into Agnikunda hell because of the sin of Chandrama and remains there for four yugas.

## \|\| 58.74 \|\|

*kīrttiṃ karoti rajasā parakīrttiṃ vilupya ca \|*  
*sa yugaṃ candrapāpena kumbhīpākaṃ ca gacchatu \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. The one who gets infatuated with greed, deprives others of their legitimate glory and glorifies himself and he falls into the kumbhlpaka hell because of the sin in Chandrama.

## \|\| 58.75 \|\|

*pitaraṃ mātaraṃ bhāryyāṃ yo na puṣṇāti pātakī \|*  
*svaguruṃ candrapāpena yātu caṇḍālatāṃ dhruvam \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Such of the persons as does not maintain his parents, wife and teachers, becomes a Cdndala under the influence of the sin of Chandrama.

## \|\| 58.76-77 \|\|

*kulaṭānnamavīrānnamṛtusnātānnameva ca \|*  
*yo'śnāti candrapāpaṃ ca yātu taṃ pāpinaṃ dhruvam \|\| 76 \|\|*

*sa yātu tena pāpena kumbhīpākaṃ caturyugam \|*  
*tasmāduttīryya cāṇḍālīṃ yonimāpnoti pātakī \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. The one who consumes the food of a wicked woman, a woman having no son, a woman in period, such a sinner, because of the sin of Chandrama, has to remain in the kumbhlpaka hell for fouryngos and then is reborn as a Chandala.

## \|\| 58.78-79 \|\|

*divase yo grāmyadharmaṃ mahāpāpī karoti ca \|*  
*yo gacchetkāmataḥ kāmī gurviṇīṃ vā rajasvalām \|\| 78 \|\|*

*taṃ yātu candrapāpaṃ ca mahāghoraṃ ca pāpinam \|*  
*sa yātu tena pāpena kālasūtraṃ caturyugam \|\| 79 \|\|*

78-79. The sinners who cohabits during the day with passionate intentions and enjoys the company of a pregnant woman or a woman in period, such a sinner has to suffer for the sin of Chandrama and has to fall into kalasutra hell where he has to remain for four yugas.

## \|\| 58.80-81 \|\|

*mukhaṃ śroṇīṃ stanaṃ cāpi yaḥ paśyati parastriyāḥ \|*  
*kāmataḥ kāmadagdhaśca yātu taṃ candrakalmaṣam \|\| 80 \|\|*

*sa yātu lālābhakṣaṃ ca candrapāpāccaturyugam \|*  
*tasmāduttīryya bhavatu cāṇḍālo'ndho napuṃsakaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

80-81. Such a person who casts a passionate glance at the face of others' wives, her body or breasts, he earns the sin of Chandrama and because of that, he remains in Lalabhaksya hell for four yugas. Thereafter, he is born as a blind Chandala and impotent.

## \|\| 58.82-83 \|\|

*kuhūpūrṇendusaṃkrānticaturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca \|*  
*māṃsaṃ masūraṃ lakucaṃ yaśca bhukṅte raverdine \|\| 82 \|\|*

*kurute grāmyadharmaṃ ca yātu taṃ candrakilbiṣam \|*  
*caturyugaṃ kālasūtraṃ tena pāpena gacchatu \|\| 83 \|\|*

82-83. The one who consumes meat, lentil1 and lakuca2 or cohabits during the day of Amavasya, Pumima, CaturdasI, Astami and Sunday, he earns the sin of Chandrama and remains in the kalasutra hell for four yugas.

## \|\| 58.84 \|\|

*tasmāduttīryya cāṇḍālīṃ yonimāpnoti pātakī \|*  
*saptajanmasu sadrogī daridraḥ kubja eva ca \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Such a sinful person then becomes a Chanddla and remains infested with diseases, a pauper and a hunch-back for seven births.

## \|\| 58.85 \|\|

*ekādaśyāṃ ca yo bhuṅkte kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīdine \|*  
*śivarātrau mahāpāpī yātu taṃ candrapātakam \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. The one who takes food on Ekadashi, the birthday of lord Krishna and Shivaratri, he earns the sin of Chandrama.

## \|\| 58.86 \|\|

*sa yātu kumbhīpākaṃ ca yāvadindrāścaturdaśa \|*  
*tena pāpena cāpnotu cāṇḍālīṃ yonimeva ca \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. He remains in the kumbhlpaka hell for the period equivalent to the life of fourteen Indras and because of the same sin, he is reborn as a Chanddla.

## \|\| 58.87-89 \|\|

*tāmrasthaṃ dugdhamādhvīkamucchiṣṭe ghṛtameva ca \|*  
*nārikelodakaṃ kāṃsye dugdhaṃ salavaṇaṃ tathā \|\| 87 \|\|*

*pītaśeṣa jalaṃ caiva bhuktaśeṣaṃ tathaudanam \|*  
*asakṛccaudanaṃ bhuṅkte sūryye nāstaṃ gate dvijaḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

*taṃ yātu candrapāpaṃ ca durnivāraṃ ca dāruṇam \|*  
*sa yātu tena pāpena cāndhakūpaṃ caturyugam \|\| 89 \|\|*

87-89. The one who consumes milk in a copper vase or the wine of Elloopa tree3, ghee, coconut water in a bronze vase, milk with salt, the left-over of water and food or the one who consumes cooked rice again and again before the sunset, attracts the great sin of Chandrama and because of that sin he falls into the andhakiipa hell where he remains for four yugas.

## \|\| 58.90-91 \|\|

*svakanyāvikrayī vipro devalo vṛṣavāhakaḥ \|*  
*śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca teṣāṃ vai sūpakārakaḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

*aśvatthatarughātī ca viṣṇuvaiṣṇavanindakaḥ \|*  
*taṃ yātu candrapāpaṃ ca dāruṇaṃ pāpinaṃ bhṛśam \|\| 91 \|\|*

90-91. A Brahmana who sells away his daughter, the priest of a temple, one who mounts a bull, bums the body of Shudras and eats with them or cooks for them, the one who cuts away the plpala tree or denounces Vishnu and Vaishnavas, such a sinner attracts the terrific sin of Chandrama.

## \|\| 58.92 \|\|

*sa yātu tasmātpāpācca taptasūrmīṃ ca pātakī \|*  
*śaśvaddagdho bhavatu sa yāvadindrāścaturdaśa \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. Because of that sin he falls into Taptasurml hell and remains there up to the life of fourteen Indras, where he always remains burning.

## \|\| 58.93-94 \|\|

*tasmādutīryya cāṇḍālīṃ yonimāpnoti pātakī \|*  
*saptajanmasu cāṇḍālo vṛṣabhaḥ pañcajanmasu \|\| 93 \|\|*

*gardabho janmaśatakaṃ sūkarassaptajanmasu \|*  
*tīrthadhvāṃkṣassaptasu vai viṭkṛmiḥ pañcajanmasu \|*  
*jalaukā janmaśatakaṃ śucirbhavatu tatparam \|\| 94 \|\|*

93-94. While coming out of it, he is transformed into a Chandala. He is reborn a Cdndala seven times, a bull during seven births and an ass for a hundred births, a pig for seven births, a crow in holy places for seven births, an insect of refuse for five births, a leech for a hundred births and is purified thereafter.

## \|\| 58.95 \|\|

*vṛthā māṃsaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte svārthaṃ pākānnameva ca \|*  
*tadadattaṃ mahāpāpī prāpnuyāccandrapātakam \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. He who uselessly consumes meat or consumes food without having been given by anyone, earns the sin of Chandrama.

## \|\| 58.96 \|\|

*sa yātu candrapāpena cāsipatraṃ caturyugam \|*  
*tato bhavatu sarpaśca paśussyātsaptajanmasu \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. Because of this sin he has to remain in the Asipatra hell for four yugas. Thereafter, he becomes a snake for seven births and an animal thereafter.

## \|\| 58.97-100 \|\|

*vipro vārdhuṣiko yo hi yonijīvī cikitsakaḥ \|*  
*harernāmnāṃ ca vikretā yaśca vā svāṅgavikrayī \|\| 97 \|\|*

*svadharmakathakaścaiva yaśca svātmapraśaṃsakaḥ \|*  
*maṣījīvī dhāvakaśca kulaṭāpoṣya eva ca \|\| 98 \|\|*

*taṃ yātu candrapāpaṃ ca candro bhavatu vijvaraḥ \|*  
*sa yātu tena pāpena śūlaprotaṃ sudāruṇam \|\| 99 \|\|*

*tatra viddho bhavatu sa yāvadindrāścaturdaśa \|*  
*tato daridro rogī ca dīkṣāhīno naraḥ paśuḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

97-100. A Brahmana who receives interest or earns livelihood by illegitimate means or by becoming a physician or sells away his limbs or sells away his Dharma, praises himself, earns his livelihood by selling ink, serves as a messenger, is maintained by a wicked woman, he earns the sin of Chandrama who is freed from his sin. Because of that sin he falls into the Sulaprota hell and he remains there up to the life of fourteen Indras. Thereafter he is born as a pauper, a person with diseases and a human like an animal.

## \|\| 58.101-107 \|\|

*lākṣāmāṃsarasānāṃ ca tilānāṃ lavaṇasya ca \|*  
*aśvānāṃ caiva lauhānāṃ vikretā naraghātakaḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

*vipraḥ kulālaḥ cauraśca yātu taṃ candrapātakam \|*  
*sa yātu tena pāpena kṣuradhāraṃ suduḥsaham \|\| 102 \|\|*

*tatra cchinno bhavatu sa yāvadindrasahasrakam \|*  
*tasmāduttīryya sa bhavetsṛgālaḥ saptajanmasu \|\| 103 \|\|*

*saptajanmasu mārjāro mahiṣo janmapañcakam \|*  
*saptajanmasu bhallūkaḥ kukkurassaptajanmasu \|\| 104 \|\|*

*matsyatve janmaśatakaṃ karkaṭī janmapañcakam \|*  
*godhikā janmaśatakaṃ gardabhaḥ saptajanmasu \|\| 105 \|\|*

*saptajanmasu maṇḍūkastataḥ syānmānavo'dhamaḥ \|*  
*carmmakāraśca rajakastailakāraśca varddhakiḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

*nāvikaḥ śavajīvī ca vyādhaśca svarṇakārakaḥ \|*  
*kumbhakāro lohakārastataḥ kṣatrastato dvijaḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

101-107. The one who sells lac, meat, juice, sheshamum, salt, horses, iron is a killer of human beings or the one who works as a potter, or the one who steals, such a Brahmana earns the sin of Chandrama and falls into Ksuraghara hell, which is quite terrific and unbearable and he remains there up to the time of a thousand Indras, where he gets shattered. After coming out of that, he is born as a jackal for seven births. Thereafter he is born as a cat for seven births, a buffalo for five births, a bear for seven births, a dog for seven births, a fish for a hundred births, a cancer for five births, a lizard for a hundred births and an ass for seven births, a frog for seven births and thereafter he is born as a degraded human like a cobbler, a washerman, an oil man, a carpenter, a gardener, the one who earns his livelihood out of dead bodies, a hunter, a goldsmith, a potter, an iron-smith and thereafter he is born as a Kshatriya and then a Brahmana.

## \|\| 58.108 \|\|

*iti candraṃ śuciṃ kṛtvā samuvāca tu tārakām \|*  
*tyaktvā candraṃ mahāsādhvi gaccha kāntamiti dvijaḥ \|\| 108\|\|*

108\. Thus by purifying Chandrama, Sukra said to Tara, "O chaste lady, you better go back to your husband leaving Chandrama."

## \|\| 58.109 \|\|

*prāyaścittaṃ vinā pūtā tvamevaṃ śuddhamānasā \|*  
*akāmā yā baliṣṭhena na strī jāreṇa duṣyati \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. Because you are pure at heart you will be purified even without repentance. A lady who is not passionate remains pure even with the advances of an undesirable person.

## \|\| 58.110 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā śukraśca candraṃ vā tārakāṃ satīm \|*  
*sasmitāṃ sasmitaṃ caiva cakāra ca śubhāśiṣaḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. Thus speaking smilingly to the chaste Tara, and Chandra, Sukra blessed both of them.

## Chapter 59

## \|\| 59.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*bṛhaspatiḥ kiṃ cakāra tārakāharaṇāntare \|*  
*kathaṃ saṃprāpa tāṃ sādhvīṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said – What did Brihaspati do after the abduction of Tara? How did he get her back? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 59.2 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā vilambaṃ tārāyāḥ snāntyāścāpi guruḥ svayam \|*  
*prasthāpayāmāsa śiṣyamanveṣārthaṃ ca jāhnavīm \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Shri Narayana said – When Brihaspati realised that Tara who had gone for a bath to the river had not returned for long, he sent one of his disciples to the bank of the Gatiga to search for her.

## \|\| 59.3 \|\|

*śiṣyo gatvā ca tadvattaṃ jñātvā vai lokavaktrataḥ \|*  
*rudannuvāca svaguruṃ tārakāharaṇaṃ mune \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О sage, the disciple went there and he heard the news from the very mouths of the people there. He returned from the place and while crying narrated the story of the abduction of Tara to his teacher.

## \|\| 59.4-5 \|\|

*śrutvā suragururvārtāṃ śaśinā ca priyāṃ hṛtām \|*  
*muhūrttaṃ prāpa mūrcchāṃ ca tataḥ saṃprāpya cetanām \|\| 4 \|\|*

*rurodoccaiḥ saśiṣyaśca hadayena vidūyatā \|*  
*śokena lajjayā''viṣṭo vilalāpa muhurmuhuḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. The sage Brihaspati, on realising that his dear Tara had been abducted by Chandrama, fainted.

## \|\| 59.6 \|\|

*uvāca śiṣyānsambodhya nītiṃ ca śrutisammatām \|*  
*sāśrunetraḥ sāśrunetrāñchokārtaḥ śokakarśitān \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. After sometime, he regained consciousness and expressing his heart-felt grief with his pupil he started crying with grief and shame. He lamented with grief and shame unceasingly.

## \|\| 59.7 \|\|

*bṛhaspatiruvāca \|*  
*he vatsāḥ kena śapto'haṃ na jāne kāraṇaṃ param \|*  
*duḥkhaṃ dharmmaviruddho yaḥ sa prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Thereafter addressing the disciple he spoke out the words which were sanctified by the Vedas. With his words all the pupils were grief-stricken and tears started flowing from their eyes.

## \|\| 59.8 \|\|

*yasya nāsti satī bhāryyā gṛheṣu priyavādinī \|*  
*araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Brihaspati said – О sons, who has cursed me like this? I am not aware of any reason for the same because misfortune comes only to a person who acts against dharma. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 59.9 \|\|

*bhāvānuraktā vanitā hṛtā yasya ca śatruṇā \|*  
*araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. A house which there is no chaste lady speaking sweet words, one should leave that house and retire to the forest, because for him the forest and the house would be alike.

## \|\| 59.10-13 \|\|

*suśīlā sundarī bhāryyā gatā yasya gṛhādaho \|*  
*araṇyaṃ tena ganta vyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham \|\| 10 \|\|*

*daivenāpahṛtā yasya patisādhyā pativratā \|*  
*araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ yathā gṛham \|\| 11 \|\|*

*yasya mātā gṛhe nāsti gṛhiṇī vā suśāsitā \|*  
*araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham \|\| 12 \|\|*

*priyāhīnaṃ gṛhaṃ yasya pūrṇaṃ draviṇabandhubhiḥ \|*  
*araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. Не whose beloved wife is abducted by someone, should retire to the forest because for him the house and the forest would be the same.

## \|\| 59.14 \|\|

*bhāryāśūnyā vanasamāḥ sabhāryāśca gṛhā gṛhāḥ \|*  
*gṛhiṇī ca gṛhaṃ proktaṃ na gṛhaṃ gṛhamucyate \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Alas! The one from whose house a chaste lady departs, he should at once go to the forest because for him the forest and the home are similar. By the turn of destiny if the chaste wife of someone is abducted, he should go to the forest because for him there is no difference between the forest and the home. The one in whose house there is no mother or a disciplined wife, for him the forest and the house are alike and he should therefore leave for the forest. A house in which there are enough of people and riches but has no beloved wife, he should go to the forest because for him the forest and the house are alike.

## \|\| 59.15 \|\|

*aśuciḥ strīvihīnaśca daive pitrye ca karmaṇi \|*  
*yadahnā kurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. A house without a wife is like a forest and the house in which the house wife stays can be called a house in reality because the wife only represents the house and the house alone cannot be called a house.

## \|\| 59.16-17 \|\|

*dāhikāśaktihīnaśca yathā mando hutāśanaḥ \|*  
*prabhāhīno yathā sūryyaḥ śobhāhīno yathā śaśī \|\| 16 \|\|*

*śaktihīno yathā jīvo yathā cātmā tanuṃ vinā \|*  
*vinā''dhāraṃ yathā''dheyo yatheśaḥ prakṛtiṃ vinā \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Therefore a person without a wife is considered to be unchaste for performing the rites of manes and whatever actions are performed by him during the day are of no consequence.

## \|\| 59.18 \|\|

*na ca śakto yathā yajñaḥ phalado dakṣiṇāṃ vinā \|*  
*karmaṇāṃ ca phalaṃ dātuṃ sāmagrī mūlameva ca \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. As the fire without the flames, the sun without the lustre, the moon without the shine, the human without the strength, the body without the soul, the person without the base, similarly Isa without Prakriti is of no consequence.

## \|\| 59.19-20 \|\|

*vinā svarṇaṃ svarṇakāro yathā śaktaḥ svakarmaṇi \|*  
*yathā śaktaḥ kulālaśca mṛttikāṃ ca vinā dvijāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tathā gṛhī na śaktaśca satataṃ sarvakarmaṇi \|*  
*gṛhādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca svaśaktigṛhiṇīṃ vinā \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. О Brahmana, as the yajna is of no consequence without daksina so the main part of the yajna becomes infructuous without the material for performing yajna.

## \|\| 59.21 \|\|

*bhāryyāmūlāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā bhāryyāmūlā gṛhāstathā \|*  
*bhāryyāmūlaṃ sukhaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ gṛhe sadā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Or the goldsmith is unable to perform without gold or a potter is unable to create vases without clay, similarly a household is of no consequence without its supreme goddess (the house wife). Without the house wife, he is unable to perform his household duties.

## \|\| 59.22-23 \|\|

*bhāryyāmūlaḥ sadā harṣo bhāryyāmūlaṃ ca maṅgalam \|*  
*bhāryyāmūlaṃ ca saṃsāro bhāryyāmūlaṃ ca saurabham \|\| 22 \|\|*

*yathā rathaśca rathināṃ gṛhiṇāṃ ca tathā gṛham \|*  
*sārathistu yathā teṣāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ ca tathā priyā \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Because all the actions in a household can be complete only with the help of the house wife alone. All the houses become alive with the presence of the house wife. Therefore the house-holder achieves pleasures only through the house wife.

## \|\| 59.24 \|\|

*sarvaratnapradhānā ca strīratnaṃ duṣkulādapi \|*  
*gṛhītā sā gṛhasthenevetyāha kamalodbhavaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. One achieves pleasures only by means of the house wife and all the welfare eminates from her. Therefore the house wife represents the entire universe. Pleasure also is derived from the house wife. As a chariot is driven by the charioteer, similar is the case with the household. As the charioteer drives the chariot similarly the household is run by the house wife.

## \|\| 59.25 \|\|

*yathā jalaṃ vinā padmaṃ padmaṃ śobhāṃ vinā yathā \|*  
*tathaiva puṃsāṃ svagṛhaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ gṛhiṇīṃ vinā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Therefore the house wife happens to be the best of all the jewels. She should be taken away from the lower races by the house holder. This has been ordained by Brahma.

## \|\| 59.26-27 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā sa guruḥ praviveśa gṛhaṃ muhuḥ \|*  
*gṛhādbahirnissasāra bhūyo bhūyaḥ śucā'nvitaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*muhurmuhuśca mūrcchāṃ ca cetanāṃ samavāpa saḥ \|*  
*bhūyobhūyo rurodoccaiḥ smāraṃsmāraṃ priyāguṇān \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. As the lotus loses its lustre without the water, similarly the householder has no grace without the house wife.

## \|\| 59.28 \|\|

*athāntare mahājñānī jñānibhiśca prabodhitaḥ \|*  
*sacchiṣyairmunibhiścānyaiḥ purandaragṛhaṃ yayau \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Thus speaking the sage Brihaspati went inside the house and at once he came out from the same. In utter grief he behaved like this again and again. He repeatedly fainted and regained consciousness. Having been reminded of the qualities of his beloved, he started crying again and again.

## \|\| 59.29 \|\|

*sa guruḥ pūjitastena cātithyena marutvatā \|*  
*tamuvāca svavṛttāntaṃ hṛdi śalyamivāpriyam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Thereafter, the senior pupils of the sage Brihaspati and other sages consoled him. Thereafter he went to the abode of Indra.

## \|\| 59.30 \|\|

*bṛhaspativacaḥ śrutvā raktapaṅkajalocanaḥ \|*  
*tamuvāca mahendraśca kopaprasphuritādharaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Indra welcomed him and after adoring him enquired about his welfare. The teacher Brihaspati narrated his entire story to him which was pricking his heart like a nail.

## \|\| 59.31 \|\|

*mahendra uvāca \|*  
*dūtānāṃ vai sahasraṃ ca cārakarmaṇi gacchatu \|*  
*atīva nipuṇaṃ dakṣaṃ tattvaprāptinimittakam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. On hearing the words of Brihaspati, the eyes of Indra became red with anger. In anger his lips started fluttering and he spoke to the sage.

## \|\| 59.32 \|\|

*yatrāsti pātakī candro manmātrā tārayā saha \|*  
*gacchāmi tatra sannaddhaḥ sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ saha \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. О great sage, you free yourself from all the worries. Everything will be well done. This misfortune is indicative of some great welfare because without facing misfortune one cannot achieve grace.

## \|\| 59.33 \|\|

*tyaja cintāṃ mahābhāga sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati \|*  
*bhadrabījaṃ durgamidaṃ kasya sampadvipadvinā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. О sage, thus speaking, Indra at once deputed a thousand of his messengers who were quite competent in all respects.

## \|\| 59.34 \|\|

*ityuktvā ca śunāsīro dūtānāṃ ca sahasrakam \|*  
*tūrṇaṃ prasthāpa yāmāsa tatkarmanipuṇaṃ mune \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Those messengers went on searching in all the places in the universe and returned after a hundred years and met Indra. They said Chandrama is residing in the abode of Sukra quite happily together with Tara. Getting terrified of the gods he has taken refuge with Sukra. Thus the messengers informed Indra accordingly.

## \|\| 59.35-36 \|\|

*te dūtā vai varṣaśataṃ yayurnirjanameva ca \|*  
*sudurlaṃghyaṃ ca viśveṣu bhramitvā śakramāyayuḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*candraṃ ca śukrabhavane taṃ prapannaṃ ca vijvaram \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā satārakaṃ bhītaṃ kathayāmāsurīśvaram \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. On hearing the words of the messengers, Indra cast his head downwards and feeling disturbed at heart spoke to Brihaspati.

## \|\| 59.37 \|\|

*iti śrutvā śunāsīro natavaktro bṛhaspatim \|*  
*uvāca śokasantapto hadayena vidūyatā \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Mahendra said – I am deputing a thousand messengers to find out the whereabouts of Tara. These messengers are quite competent and can find out all the secrets.

## \|\| 59.38-39 \|\|

*mahendra uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu nātha pravakṣyāmi pariṇāmasukhāvaham \|*  
*bhayaṃ tyaja mahābhāga sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tvayā nahi jitaḥ śukro na mayā ditinandanaḥ \|*  
*etadālocya candraśca jagāma śaraṇaṃ kavim \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. I shall make them move on from place to place, wherever the wicked Chandrama might be resting with my mother Tara.

## \|\| 59.40-41 \|\|

*gaccha śīghraṃ brahmalokamasmābhiḥ sārddhameva ca \|*  
*brahmaṇā saha yāsyāmaḥ kailāse śaṅkaraṃ vayam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*ityuktvā tu mahendraśca santapto guruṇā saha \|*  
*jagāma brahmalokaṃ ca sukhadṛśyaṃ nirāmayam \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. Mahendra said – О lord, listen to me, whatever I am telling you and its results will be quite pleasant. О fortunate one, you shed away all your fear. Everything will be all right. Neither have you conquered Sukra nor I have conquered the demons; Chandrama has gone to Sukra taking only these things into consideration.

## \|\| 59.42 \|\|

*tatra dṛṣṭvā ca brahmāṇaṃ nanāma guruṇā saha \|*  
*provāca sarvavṛttāntaṃ devānāmīśvaraṃ param \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Therefore you move along with us to Brahmaloka and taking Brahma with us we shall move on to Shiva. Thus speaking Mahendra getting agitated in his mind, went to Brahmaloka which was quite pleasant to look at together with Brihaspati.

## \|\| 59.43 \|\|

*mahendravacanaṃ śrutvā hasitvā kamalodbhavaḥ \|*  
*hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītisāramuvāca vinayānvitaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Angira had three sons named Brihaspati, Utathya and Samvarta, who had control their senses and were well-versed in the Vedas.

## \|\| 59.44 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*yo dadāti parasmai ca duḥkhameva ca sarvataḥ \|*  
*tasmai dadāti duḥkhaṃ ca śāstā kṛṣṇaḥ sanātanaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Angira did not give anything to Samvarta his youngest son, who became a recluse and was always engaged in the adoration of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 59.45 \|\|

*ahaṃ sraṣṭā ca sṛṣṭeśca pātā viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*yathā rudraśca saṃharttā dadāti ca śivaṃ śivaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Meeting Brahma there, both Indra and Brihaspati bowed in reverence to him. Both narrated details of their sufferings to Brahma, the lord of the gods.

## \|\| 59.46 \|\|

*nirantaraṃ sarvasākṣī dharmo vai sarvakāraṇam \|*  
*sarve devā viṣayiṇaḥ kṛṣṇājñāparipālakāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. On hearing the words of Indra, Brahma spoke smilingly the words, which bestowed welfare and were quite appropriate to the occasion.

## \|\| 59.47 \|\|

*bṛhaspatirutathyaśca saṃvartaśca jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*trayaścāṃgirasaḥ putrā vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Brahma said – Lord Krishna who happens to be the ruler of the universe, punishes such a person himself who causes endless pain to others.

## \|\| 59.48 \|\|

*saṃvartāya kaniṣṭhāya na ca kiñciddadau guruḥ \|*  
*sa babhūva tapasvī ca kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyati ceśvaram \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. I am the creator of the universe. The eternal Vishnu preserves it and Rudra-Shiva destroys the universe. Shiva also bestowed welfare. Dharma conducts himself as a witness to the deeds of all the people and all other gods perform their respective duties according to the desire of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 59.49-50 \|\|

*madhyamasyotathyakasya satīṃ bhāryāṃ ca gurviṇīm \|*  
*jahāra kāmatastāṃ ca bhrātṛjāyāmakāmukīm \|\| 49 \|\|*

*yo haredbhrātṛjāyāṃ ca kāmī kāmādakāmukīm \|*  
*brahmahatyāsahasraṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. Utathya the middle son abducted with evil intentions the wife of his own brother who has pregnant and devoid of passions. The one who abducts the passionless wife of his own brother, earns the sin of a thousand Brahmahatyas; there is no doubt it.

## \|\| 59.51-53 \|\|

*sa yāti kumbhīpākaṃ ca yāvaccandradivākaram \|*  
*bhrātṛjāyāpahārī ca mātṛgāmī bhavennaraḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*tasmāduttīryya pāpī ca viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ \|*  
*varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi tatra sthitvā ca pātakī \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tato bhavenmahāpāpī varṣakoṭisahasrakam \|*  
*puṃścalīyonigarte ca kṛmiścaiva purandara \|\| 53 \|\|*

51-53. He has to remain in the kumbhipaka hell till the sun and the moon last; because the one who abducts the wife of his own brother is treated like the one who defiles the chastity of his own mother. Thereafter, he becomes an insect of the refuse and has to suffer for a thousand crores of years as a great sinner. О Indra, thereafter he is born as a germ of the Vagina of a wicked woman.

## \|\| 59.54 \|\|

*gṛdhraḥ koṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni kukkuraḥ \|*  
*bhrātṛjāyāpaharaṇācchatajanmāni sūkaraḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Thereafter for a thousand crores of years, he is born as a vulture; for a hundred births, he remains as a dog and because of the sin of the abduction of his brother’s wife he has to be born as a pig for a hundred births.

## \|\| 59.55-56 \|\|

*dadāti yo na dāyaṃ ca baliṣṭho durbalāya ca \|*  
*sa yāti kumbhīpākaṃ ca yāvaccandradivākaram \|\| 55\|\|*

*nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karmma kalpakoṭiśatairapi \|*  
*avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. If a powerful brother deprives his own younger brother of his legitimate dues he has to fall in the kumhhlpCLka hell and remain there till the sun and moon last, because a deed cannot vanish without facing its result thereof even after a hundred crores of years. Therefore one has to face the result of a good or bad deed performed by him.

## \|\| 59.57-59 \|\|

*jagadguroḥ śivasyāpi guruputro bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*jñātaṃ karotu vṛttāntamīśvaraṃ balināṃ varama \|\| 57 \|\|*

*sarve samūhā devānāṃ sannaddhāśca savāhanāḥ \|*  
*madhyasthā munayaścaiva santu vai narmadātaṭe \|\| 58 \|\|*

*paścādahaṃ ca yāsyāmi puṇyaṃ tannarmmadātaṭam \|*  
*gurustadguruputro'pi śīghraṃ yātu śivālayam \|\| 59 \|\|*

57-59. Brihaspati is the son of lord Shiva who happens to be the teacher of the universe therefore we should narrate the entire story to him; You get ready with their vehicles and go to the bank of Narmada and stay there. We shall follow them. Brihaspati should go to Kailasa.

## \|\| 59.60-61 \|\|

*mahendra uvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ vā vedakarttuśca siddhānāṃ yogināṃ guroḥ \|*  
*mṛtyuñjayasya śambhośca guruputro bṛhaspatiḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*aṅgirāstava putraśca tatputraśca bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*tvatto jñānī mahādevaḥ kathaṃ śiṣyo guroḥ pituḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. Mahendra said – How could Shiva who had overcome the death, be the teacher of Brihaspati who was well-versed in the Vedas and the best of the yogis? Because Angira happens to be your son and Brihaspati is born out of Angira. О lord, you are the best of intellectuals. Therefore, you tell me how the father of the teacher could become the pupil.

## \|\| 59.62 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*katheyamatiguptā ca purāṇeṣu purandara \|*  
*imāṃ purāpravṛttiṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Brahma said – О Indra, this story which is of a secret nature has been told in the Purana and therefore, I am revealing the same to you. You listen to me.

## \|\| 59.63 \|\|

*mṛtavatsā karmmadoṣādbhāryyā cāṅgirasaḥ purā \|*  
*vrataṃ cakāra sā caiva kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. In earlier times, the wife of Angira produced children who died in tender age. She therefore performed the vrata of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 59.64-66 \|\|

*vrataṃ puṃsavanaṃ nāma varṣamekaṃ cakāra sā \|*  
*sanatkumāro bhagavānkārayāmāsa tāṃ vratam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*tadā''gatya ca golokātparamātmā kṛpāmayaḥ \|*  
*svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ brahma bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*suvratāṃ ca salakṣmīkāṃ tāmuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*praṇatāṃ sāśrunetrāṃ ca vinītāṃ ca tayā stutaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

64-66. Sanatkumara made her perform the Punsavana vrata in a proper manner. Thereafter lord Krishna who is quite merciful, compassionate, moves according to will, eternal Brahmana, graceful to the devotees and takes to human form for their welfare, descended from the Goloka and spoke to the wife of Angira, who was adoring him with her eyes filled with tears.

## \|\| 59.67-68 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*gṛhāṇedaṃ vrataphalaṃ mama tejassamanvitam \|*  
*bhuṃkṣva madvarataḥ putri bhaviṣyati madaṃśataḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

*patirguruśca devānāṃ mahatāṃ jñānināṃ varaḥ \|*  
*putraste bhavitā sādhvi madvareṇa bṛhaspatiḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. Shri Krishna said – О daughter, you receive the fruit of this vrata which contains my tejas. You eat it up and with my blessing a son will be born to you with my rays. He will be the lord of the gods and their teacher besides being the best of the intellectuals. О chaste lady, with my blessing, Brihaspati would be born to you as a son.

## \|\| 59.69-70 \|\|

*madvareṇa bhavedyo hi sa ca madvaraputrakaḥ \|*  
*tvadgarbhe mama putro'yaṃ cirajīvī bhaviṣyati \|\| 69 \|\|*

*varajo vīryyajaścaiva kṣetrajaḥ pālakastathā \|*  
*vidyāmantrasutau caiva gṛhītaḥ saptamaḥ sutaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

69-70. Whosoever will be born with my boon will be known as my son. Therefore my son will be born out of your womb who will enjoy a long life. The son who was born of the boon of lord Krishna, was seventh known as Brihaspati and other two born from knowledge and sacred verses.

## \|\| 59.71-81 \|\|

*ityuktvā rādhikānāthaḥ svalokaṃ ca jagāma saḥ \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇavaraputro'yaṃ jñānīśvaraguruḥ svayam \|\| 71 \|\|*

*mṛtyuñjayaṃ mahājñānaṃ śivāya pradadau purā \|*  
*divyaṃ varṣatrilakṣaṃ ca tapaścakre himālaye \|\| 72 \|\|*

*svayogaṃ jñānamakhilaṃ tejassvāmasamaṃ param \|*  
*svaśaktiṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ ca svāṃśaṃ vai vāhanaṃ vṛṣam \|\| 73 \|\|*

*svaśūlaṃ ca svakavacaṃ svamantraṃ dvādaśākṣaram \|*  
*kṛpāmayaḥ stutastena śrīkṛṣṇaśca parātparaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

*śivaloke śivā sā ca viṣṇumāyā śivapriyā \|*  
*śaktirnārāyaṇasyeyaṃ sā''virbhūtā sanātanī \|\| 75 \|\|*

*tejastu sarvadevānāṃ sā''virbhūtā sanātanī \|*  
*jaghāna daityanikaraṃ devebhyaḥ pradadau padam \|\| 76 \|\|*

*kalpānte dakṣakanyā ca sā mūlaprakṛtiḥ satī \|*  
*pitṛyajñe tanuṃ tyaktvā yogādvai siddhayoginī \|\| 77 \|\|*

*babhūva śailakanyā sā sādhvī vai bhartṛnindayā kālena kṛṣṇatapasā śaṅkaraṃ prāpa sundarī \|\| 78 \|\|*

*śrīkṛṣṇo hi guruḥ śambhoḥ paramātmā parātparaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇasya varaputro'yaṃ svayameva bṛhaspatiḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*ato hetoḥ suragururguruputraḥ śivasya ca \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvamatiguhyaṃ purātanam \|\| 80 \|\|*

*iti pradhānasambandhaḥ śrutaśca kathito mayā \|*  
*pāraṃparikamanyaṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya \|\| 81 \|\|*

71-81. Thus speaking Krishna the lord of Radhika went back to Goloka. Therefore this great intellectual happens to be the son of lord Krishna who is the best of intellectuals and a teacher as well. Lord Krishna had given the great knowledge of over-powering the death initially to Shiva. He performed tapas on Himalaya for three lakh of years, as a result of which the lord was pleased and he bestowed his entire yogic knowledge, the lustre and Vishnumaya to him, besides the bull as his vehicle. He also handed over his own trident, kavacha and the twelve letter mantra. Thereafter Shiva adored the compassionate lord Krishna in the Kailasa and Vishnumaya started living as the beloved of Shiva as his spouse. She happens to be the eternal strength of Narayana. The eternal goddess emerged out of the tejas of all the gods and destroyed the demons, re-establishing all the gods in their respective places. She happened to be the MdlaPrakriti and after sometime, she emerged in the house of Daksha as his daughter. She sacrificed her body in the yajna of her father in protest against the denouncing of her husband. She was reborn as the daughter of Himalaya. The same chaste Sankarl adored lord Krishna and thereafter achieved Shiva as her husband. Therefore lord Krishna the great soul happens to be the teacher of lord Shiva. Brihaspati himself is the blessed son of lord Krishna and accordingly Brihaspati the teacher of the gods, happens to be the Guruputra of Shiva. Thus I have narrated to you the traditional story about the same, which you please listen to from me.

## \|\| 59.82-85 \|\|

*durvāsā garuḍaścaiva śaṅkarāṃśaḥ pratāpavān \|*  
*śiṣyau cāṃgirasastau dvau guruputro'thavā tataḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

*prāṇādhikāyāṃ satyāṃ ca mṛtāyāṃ dakṣaśāpataḥ \|*  
*svajñānaṃ svaṃ ca bhagavānvisasmāra svamohataḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*smaraṇaṃ kārayāmāsa kṛṣṇena prerito'ṅgirāḥ \|*  
*ato hetorguruścaivaṃ matsutassyācchivasya saḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

*śīghraṃ gacchatu kailāsaṃ svayameva bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*tvaṃ gaccha tatra sannaddhaḥ sadevo narmadātaṭam \|\| 85 \|\|*

82-85. Durvasa and Garuda happen to be the rays of Shiva and the disciples of Angira. Thus Brihaspati happens to be the Guruputra of Shiva and because of the curse of Daksha, as the death of Sati, Shiva forgot himself in illusion. With the inspiration of lord Krishna, Angira made him realise his worth and accordingly Angira happens to be the teacher of Shiva. Therefore Brihaspati himself should go to Kailasa and all the gods should go to the bank of Narmada collectively.

## \|\| 59.86 \|\|

*ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā virarāma ca nārada \|*  
*gururyayau ca kailāsaṃ mahendro narmadātaṭam \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. О Narada, Brahma the creator of the universe kept quiet after speaking thus. Thereafter Brihaspati went to Kailasa and Mahendra reached the bank of Narmada.

## Chapter 60

## \|\| 60.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*nārāyaṇa mahābhāga vedavedāṅgapāraga \|*  
*nipītaṃ ca mahākhyānaṃ tvanmukhenduvinisṛtam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said – О Narayana, О graceful one, you are well-versed in the Vedic and post-Vedic literature. I have enjoyed the taste of the nectar in the form of words spoken by you.

## \|\| 60.2 \|\|

*adhunā śrotumicchāmi kimuvāca bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*śivaṃ ca gatvā kailāsaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Now I want to listen to you as to what Brihaspti spoke to Shiva who bestows all the fortunes, after reaching Kailasa.

## \|\| 60.3 \|\|

*jagatkartā vidhātā ca kiṃ vā taṃ pratyuvāca saḥ \|*  
*etatsarvaṃ samālocya vada vedavidāṃ vara \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. What reply did Shiva the controller of the universe and its greater, give to the sage? О best of those well-versed in the Vedas, you kindly tell me all these things in detail.

## \|\| 60.4 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*śīghraṃ gatvā ca kailāsaṃ bhraṣṭaśrīḥ śaṃkaraṃ guruḥ \|*  
*praṇamya tasthau purato lajjāvanatakandharaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Narayana said – Brihaspati the priest of the gods arrived at the Kailasa mountain and bowed before Shiva and said before him with his head lowering down in shame.

## \|\| 60.5 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā gurusutaṃ śambhurudatiṣṭhatkuśāsanāt \|*  
*āliṅganaṃ dadau tasmai śīghraṃ māṃgalikāśiṣaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Thereafter Shiva finding the son of his teacher before him, got up from his seat of kusa-grass and embraces him blessing him at the same time.

## \|\| 60.6 \|\|

*svāsane vāsayitvā vai papraccha kuśalaṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ bhītaṃ taṃ lajjitaṃ śivaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Lord Shiva made him sit on the seat. The sage was filled with shame and fear but Shiva spoke to him the sweet words.

## \|\| 60.7-9 \|\|

*śrīśaṅkara uvāca \|*  
*kathamevaṃvidhastvaṃ ca duḥkhī malina vigrahaḥ \|*  
*sāśrunetro lajjitaśca bhrātastatkāraṇaṃ vada \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kiṃ vā tapasyā hīnā te sandhyā hīnā'thavā mune \|*  
*kiṃ vā śrīkṛṣṇasevā sā vihīnā daivadoṣataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*kiṃ vā gurau bhaktihīno'bhīṣṭadeve'thavā gurau \|*  
*kiṃ vā na rakṣituṃ śaktaḥ prapannaṃ śaraṇāgatam \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. Shiva said – О brother why are you feeling painful at heart with an unclean body and the tears filled in your eyes? Why are you feeling shameful? You tell me the reason. Are you unable to perform your tapas or have you been deprived of sandhya? Or, are you unable to serve lord Krishna by any move of destiny? Or have you been deprived of the devotion of your teacher or the gods? Or, are you unable to protect anyone who came to take refuse with you?

## \|\| 60.10 \|\|

*kiṃ vā'tithiste vimukhaḥ kiṃ vā poṣyā bubhukṣitāḥ \|*  
*kiṃ vā svatantrā strī vā te kiṃ vā putro'vacaskaraḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Or could it be like this, that some guest has returned from your house disappointed? Or, could it; be that your dependants have remain hungry? Has your wife become independent of you? Has your son become disobedient?

## \|\| 60.11 \|\|

*suśāsito na śiṣyo vā kiṃ bhṛtyāścottarapradāḥ \|*  
*kiṃ vā te vimukhā lakṣmīḥ kiṃ vā ruṣṭo gurustava \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Or, have your disciples become indisciplined? Or have your servants started giving curt replies? Has Lakshmi departed from your house? Has your teacher left you in anger?

## \|\| 60.12 \|\|

*gariṣṭhaśca variṣṭhaśca śaśvatsantuṣṭa mānasa \|*  
*gurustava vasiṣṭhaśca preṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ satāmaho \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О sage, you always remain satisfied and glorious and had. been the best of all. Your teacher Vasistha is the best of all the sages.

## \|\| 60.13-14 \|\|

*kiṃ vā ruṣṭo'bhīṣṭadevaḥ kiṃ vā ruṣṭāśca vāḍavāḥ \|*  
*kiṃ vā ruṣṭā vaiṣṇavāśca kiṃ vā te prabalo ripuḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*kiṃ vā te bandhuvicchedo vigraho balinā saha \|*  
*kiṃ vā padaṃ paragrastaṃ kiṃ vā bandhudhanaṃ ca vā \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Have the favourable gods become annoyed with you or have the Brahmanas been angry with you? Or have the Vaishnavas been angry with you or has your enemy become more powerful? Or have you been separated from some of your relatives? Or have you started a fight with a valorous person? Or has your brother and riches been usurped by someone else?

## \|\| 60.15-16 \|\|

*kena te vā kṛtā nindā khalairvā pāpibhirmune \|*  
*kena vā tvaṃ parityakto bāndhavena priyeṇa vā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*bandhustyaktastvayā kiṃ vā vairāgyeṇa krudhā'thavā \|*  
*kiṃ vā tīrthe nahi snātaṃ na dattaṃ puṇyavāsare \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Such of the people born in a low race and are of wicked nature, are used to denounce others. In the land of Bharata the noble people always praise others and remaining filled with welfare they feel delighted.

## \|\| 60.17 \|\|

*gurunindā bandhunindā khalavaktrācchrutā'thavā \|*  
*gurunindā hi sādhūnāṃ maraṇādatiricyate \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Because a son, glory, prowess, fortune, influence, the people, land, wealth, words, intelligence, nature, character and conduct always engaged the people in one form of the others.

## \|\| 60.18-19 \|\|

*asadvaṃśaprajātānāṃ khalānāṃ nindanaṃ tathā \|*  
*dauśśīlyamevamasatāṃ śaśvannārakiṇāmiha \|\| 18 \|\|*

*parapraśaṃsakāḥ santaḥ puṇyavanto hi bhārate \|*  
*śaśvanmaṅgalayuktāśca rājante manasā sadā \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. О sage or has wicked, degraded and a sinful person denounced you? Or has someone who is dear to you, deserted you? Or have you disowned anyone of your relatives in anger or have you not been able to take a bath in a sacred places? Or could you not perform charity at an auspicious occasion?

## \|\| 60.20-21 \|\|

*putre yaśasi toye ca samṛddhe ca parākrame \|*  
*aiśvarye vā pratāpe ca prajābhūmidhaneṣu ca \|\| 20 \|\|*

*vacaneṣu ca buddhau ca svabhāve ca caritrataḥ \|*  
*ācāre vyavahāre ca jāyate hṛdayaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Or have you heard the denouncing of your teacher or the relatives from someone else? Because the denouncing of the teacher is worse than death for a noble person.

## \|\| 60.22-23 \|\|

*yādṛgyeṣāṃ ca hadaye tādṛkteṣāṃ ca maṃgalam \|*  
*yādṛgyeṣāṃ pūrvapuṇyaṃ tādṛkteṣāṃ ca mānasam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*ityuktvā ca mahādevo virarāma svasaṃsadi \|*  
*tamuvāca mahāvaktā svayameva bṛhaspatiḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Therefore such a person who is pure at heart and enjoys all the welfare, his mind is designed according to his previous deeds. Thus speaking in his court, lord Shiva kept quiet. Thereafter the great orator Brihaspati started speaking himself.

## \|\| 60.24-25 \|\|

*bṛhaspatiruvāca \|*  
*akathyameva vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmi kimīśvara \|*  
*lokāḥ karmavaśānnityaṃ nānājanmasu yatkṛtam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*svakarmaṇāṃ phalaṃ bhuṅkte janturjanmani janmani \|*  
*nahi naṣṭaṃ ca tatkarma vinā bhogācca bhārate \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. Brihaspati said – О lord, though my tale cannot be narrated yet still I shall have to do it; one is controlled by his own actions. Whatever deeds are performed by him earlier, the result of the same has to be faced by him in every birth. Because in the land of Bharata no actions can be destroyed without facing the result of the same.

## \|\| 60.26-27 \|\|

*sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śoko narāṇāṃ bhārate prabho \|*  
*kecidvadanti hi bhavetsvakṛtena ca karmaṇā \|\| 26 \|\|*

*kecidvadanti daivena svabhāveneti kecana \|*  
*trividhā gatayo hyasya vedavedāṅgapāraga \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. О lord some of the people say that in the land of Bharata, pleasure, pain, fear and grief are influenced by one’s own deeds. Some of the people say that everything happens according to destiny and others say that things happen naturally. О well-versed in the Vedas and Vedic literature, thus three types of the move have been defined.

## \|\| 60.28 \|\|

*svayaṃ ca karmajanakaḥ karma vai daivakāraṇam \|*  
*svabhāvo jāyate nṝṇāṃ svātmanaḥ pūrvakarmaṇaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Whatever deeds are performed by a person become the cause of the destiny and the nature of the people also is influenced by the deeds of their pi'evious births.

## \|\| 60.29 \|\|

*svakarmaṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ jantūnāṃ pratijanmani \|*  
*sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ svātmanaśca prajāyate \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Therefore everyone has to face pleasure, pain, fear and grief according to the deeds performed by him in his earlier births.

## \|\| 60.30 \|\|

*svakarmaphalabhoktā ca jīvo hi saguṇaḥ sadā \|*  
*ātmabhojayitā sākṣī nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. A person always remains active to face the result of his deeds. The soul is the means for making one face the results of the deeds which is formless and beyond Prakriti.

## \|\| 60.31 \|\|

*sa evātmā sarvasevyaḥ sarveṣāṃ ca phalapradaḥ \|*  
*sa vai sṛjati daivaṃ ca svabhāvaṃ karma caiva hi \|\| 31\|\|*

31\. Thus speaking Brihaspati narrated the entire story to lord Shiva, hearing which even lord Shiva, who happens to be the lord of Gauri lowered his head in shame.

## \|\| 60.32 \|\|

*karmaṇā ca nṛṇāṃ lajjā praśaṃsā ca praphullatā \|*  
*lajjābījaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ tathā'pi kathayāmi te \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Shiva was then terribly enraged and in anger the rosary fell from his hand. His eyes became red in anger and he started trembling.

## \|\| 60.33 \|\|

*ityuktvā sarvavṛttāntamavocattaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*śrutvā babhūva namrāsyo gaurīśo lajjayā tadā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. О Narada, Shiva happens to be the lord of Rudra the friend of Vishnu the preserver, adored by Brahma the creator, lord of formless and Prakriti and lord Krishna. In anger the throat, tongue and lips of Shiva dried up and he started speaking in anger.

## \|\| 60.34 \|\|

*japamālā karādbhraṣṭā kopāviṣṭasya śūlinaḥ \|*  
*babhūva sadyaḥkampaśca raktapaṃkajalocane \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Shiva said – Let the noble people, the Vaishnavas and the sages be bestowed with welfare and the opponents of Vaishnavas and the wicked people face miseries at every step.

## \|\| 60.35-36 \|\|

*saṃhartturīśo rudrasya viṣṇoḥ pātuḥ sakhā śivaḥ \|*  
*sraṣṭuḥ stutyaśca mānyaśca svātmanaḥ paramātmanaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*nirguṇasya ca kṛṣṇasya prakṛtīśasya nārada \|*  
*kopātpravaktumārebhe śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. Therefore the soul has to be adored by all. The same provides the result of the deed. It is also called destiny, nature and creates actions.

## \|\| 60.37 \|\|

*śiva uvāca \|*  
*śivamastu ca sādhūnāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāmiha \|*  
*avaiṣṇavānāmasatāmaśivaṃ ca pade pade \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Therefore a person comes across shame, praise and pleasure according to his own deeds. My story is shameful but still I am narrating the same to you.

## \|\| 60.38 \|\|

*dadāti vaiṣṇavebhyaśca yo duḥkhaṃ susthito janaḥ \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇastasya saṃharttā vighnastasya pade pade \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The one who while enjoying a good position troubles the Vaishnavas and is killed by lord Krishna himself who creates misery for him at every step.

## \|\| 60.39 \|\|

*avaiṣṇavānāṃ hṛdayaṃ nahi śuddhaṃ sadāmalam \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇamantrasmaraṇaṃ manonairmalyakāraṇam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Those who are not Vaishnavas, their hearts are not pure and are filled with blemish, because the name of lord Krishna can be recited only with a spotless clean mind.

## \|\| 60.40 \|\|

*bhidyate hadayagranthiśchidyante sarvasaṃśayāḥ \|*  
*viṣṇumantropāsanayā kṣīyate karma tannṛṇām \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. By reciting the mantra of Vishnu all the knots of the mind are untied and all the doubts are cleared and the deeds also vanish.

## \|\| 60.41 \|\|

*aho śrīkṛṣṇadāsānāṃ kaḥ svabhāvaḥ sunirmalaḥ \|*  
*hṛtabhāryyaṃ mūrcchitaśca na śaśāpa ripuṃ guruḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The nature of the devotees of lord Krishna is always spotless. At the abduction of his wife, the teacher fainted in grief but he did not pronounce a curse on the disciple.

## \|\| 60.42 \|\|

*gururyasya variṣṭhaśca krodhahīnaśca dhārmikaḥ \|*  
*śataputraghnamapyenaṃ na śaśāpa ripuṃ muniḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. He whose teacher is the best, devoid of anger and is religious, but has not pronounced any curse on the enemies.

## \|\| 60.43-45 \|\|

*niśśvāsādvai suragurorbhrāturmama bṛhaspateḥ \|*  
*bhasmībhūto nimeṣeṇa śatacandro bhaveddhruvam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*tathā'pi taṃ no śaśāpa dharmmabhaṅgabhayena ca \|*  
*tapasyā hīyate śaptuḥ kopāviṣṭasya nityaśaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*aho hyatrerasatputraḥ parastrīlubdhakaḥ śaṭhaḥ \|*  
*tapasvino vaiṣṇavasya brahmaputrasya dhīmataḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

43-45. Though with the breathing of Brihaspati who happens to be my brother or with the twinkling of his eye hundreds of moons could be reduce to ashes, still, getting afraid of Dharma he did not pronounce a curse because the one who pronounces a curse in anger, his entire tapas is destroyed. It is really surprising that the wise sage Atri the son of Vaishnava Brahma could have such a crooked and degraded son.

## \|\| 60.46 \|\|

*dharmiṣṭhā brahmaṇaḥ putrā vaiṣṇavā brāhmaṇāstathā \|*  
*keciddevā dvijā daityāḥ pautrāśca trividhā matāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. His Sattvika sons are the Brahmanas, the gods are Rajasika sons and the Daityas are Tamsl sons who possess great prowess and always remain agitated. The Brahmanas getting devoted to the Dharma always adore Narayana. The gods adore Shiva and Daityas and the demons are deprived of adoration.

## \|\| 60.47-48 \|\|

*ye sāttvikā brāhmaṇāste devā rājasikāstathā \|*  
*daityāstāmasikā raudrā baliṣṭhāścoddhatāḥ sadā \|\| 47 \|\|*

*svadharmaniratā viprā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*śaivāḥ śāktāśca te devā daityāḥ pūjāvivarjitāḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. The Vaishnavas aspire for moksa. The Brahmanas aspire for serving lord Vishnu, the gods are desirous of riches and the demons are always having Tamsika nature. The Brahmanas who are free from desire, have their own Dharma and they adore lord Krishna who is formless and beyond Prakriti.

## \|\| 60.49-50 \|\|

*mumukṣavo viṣṇubhaktā brāhmaṇā dāsyalipsavaḥ \|*  
*aiśvaryyalipsavo devāścāsurāstāmasāstathā \|\| 49 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇānāṃ svadharmaśca kṛṣṇasyārccanamīpsitam \|*  
*niṣkāmānāṃ nirguṇasya parasya prakṛterapi \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. The Vaishnava Brahmanas achieve the highest stage independently and those who adore others, also achieve the highest place at the time of dissolution.

## \|\| 60.51 \|\|

*ye brāhmaṇā vaiṣṇavāśca svatantrāḥ paramaṃ padam \|*  
*yāntyanyopāsakāścānyaiḥ sārddhaṃ ca prākṛte laye \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The Brahmanas are the best of all the varnas provided they are noble and Vaishnava because a Chandala is better placed than a Brahmana who is deprived of the Vishnu-mantra.

## \|\| 60.52 \|\|

*varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ sādhavo vaiṣṇavā yadi \|*  
*viṣṇumantravihīnebhyo dvijebhyaḥ śvapaco varaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. All the sons of Brahma had been quite religious, Vaishnavas and Brahmanas. Some of them are gods, some are Brahmanas and the third type consists of the Daityas who happen to be his grandsons.

## \|\| 60.53-54 \|\|

*paripakvā vipakvā vā vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaśca te \|*  
*satataṃ pāti tāṃścaiva viṣṇucakraṃ sudarśanam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*yathā vahnau śuṣkatṛṇaṃ bhasmībhūtaṃ bhavetsadā \|*  
*tathā pāpaṃ vaiṣṇaveṣu kāṣṭhānīva hutāśane \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. The Vaishnavas and the noble Brahmanas whether they are mature or immature, the Cakra of lord Vishnu always protects them. As the dry grass is reduced to ashes in the fire similarly the sins of the Vaishnavas are burnt with their glory.

## \|\| 60.55-56 \|\|

*guruvaktrādviṣṇumantro yasya karṇe pravekṣyati \|*  
*taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mahāpūtaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*puṃsāṃ śataṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca śataṃ mātāmahasya ca \|*  
*svasodarāṃśca jananīmuddharantyeva vaiṣṇavāḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. The one in to whose ears the Vishnu-mantra is spoken by the teacher, is called a purified Vais nava. The Vaishnavas purify a hundred races of their grand parents and grand maternal parents besides the brothers and mothers.

## \|\| 60.57 \|\|

*gayāyāṃ piṇḍadānena piṇḍadāḥ piṇḍabhojinam \|*  
*samuddharanti puṃsāṃ ca vaiṣṇavāśca śataṃ śatam \|\| 57\|\|*

57\. The one who offers pindas Gaya, redeems only those who consume the pindas but the Vais navas redeems a hundred generations at a time.

## \|\| 60.58 \|\|

*mantragrahaṇamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*yamastasmānmahābhīto vainateyādivoragaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. One is rel ieved of all the bondages, only by accepting the mantra and even Yama gets terrified by him in the same way as a snake gets terrified by Garuda.

## \|\| 60.59 \|\|

*punantyeva hi tīrthāni gaṅgādīni ca bhārate \|*  
*kṛṣṇamantropāsakāśca sparśamātreṇa vākpate \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. O lord of speech, in the land of Bharata, the rivers like Ganga and others purify those who take a bath in their holy waters, but the one who recites the mantra of Krishna purifies whosoever touches him.

## \|\| 60.60 \|\|

*pāpāni pāpināṃ tīrthe yāvanti prabhavanti ca \|*  
*naśyanti tāni sarvāṇi vaiṣṇavasparśamātrataḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. All the sins which are created in the holy places vanish at the touch of the Vaishnava.

## \|\| 60.61 \|\|

*kṛṣṇamantropāsakānāṃ rajasā pādapadmayoḥ \|*  
*sadyo muktāḥ pātakebhyaḥ kṛtsnā pūtā vasundharā \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. The particle of dust from the feet of the devotee of lord Krishna who recites the Krishna-mantra, purifies the entire earth and removes all the sins.

## \|\| 60.62 \|\|

*vāyuśca pavano vahniḥ sūryyaḥ sarvaṃ punāti ca \|*  
*ete pūtā vaiṣṇavānāṃ sparśamātreṇa līlayā \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Though the wind, the air, fire and the sun also purify but everyone gets purified at the very touch of the Vaishnavas.

## \|\| 60.63 \|\|

*ahaṃ brahmā ca śeṣaśca dharmaḥ sākṣī ca karmmaṇām \|*  
*ete hṛṣṭāśca vāñchanti vaiṣṇavānāṃ samāgamam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. I myself Brahma, Shesha, Dharma, the witness of all the deeds, getting pleased are desirous of defending the Vaishnavas.

## \|\| 60.64 \|\|

*phalaṃ karmānurūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ bhārate bhavet \|*  
*na bhavettadvaiṣṇave ca siddhadhānye yathāṃ'kuram \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Though in the land of Bharata everyone gets the reward of his own deeds, yet the Vaishnavas are free from the reward of the deeds like the boiled paddy, which no more sprouts.

## \|\| 60.65 \|\|

*hanti teṣāṃ karma pūrvaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*kṛpayā svapadaṃ tebhyo dadātyeva kṛpānidhiḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Because the merciful lord first of all destroys the earlier deeds of his devotees and thereafter he bestows his grace on them.

## \|\| 60.66 \|\|

*tejasvināṃ ca pravaraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhṛgunandanam \|*  
*sa candro durbalo bhītaḥ śukraṃ ca śaraṇaṃ yayau \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. The weak Chandrama getting terrified has taken refuge with Vaishnava Sukra, who happens to be the son of Bhrigu.

## \|\| 60.67 \|\|

*sudarśano baliṣṭhaṃ ca śukraṃ jetuṃ na śaktimān \|*  
*tathā'pi coddhariṣyāmi tārāṃ mantreṇa madguroḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Though the Sudarsana-cakra of lord Krishna cannot over-power the powerful Sukra, still with the use of the mantra of lord Krishna given to me by my teacher I shall redeem Tara.

## \|\| 60.68 \|\|

*bhaja satyaṃ paraṃ brahma kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram \|*  
*suprasanne bhagavati patnīṃ prāpsyasi līlayā \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. You better recite the name of Krishna who is the form of truth, eternal Brahmana and the great lord. After achieving the pleasure of lord Krishna you will get back your wife.

## \|\| 60.69 \|\|

*mantraṃ tasya pradāsyāmi bhrātaḥ kalpataruṃ param \|*  
*koṭijanmāghanighnaṃ ca sarvamaṃgalakāraṇam \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. О brother, I am giving you the mantra of Krishna who is like the kalpataru or the wish-fulfilling tree. It destroys the sins of crores of births and is the cause for all welfare.

## \|\| 60.70-71 \|\|

*brahmādistaṃbaparyyantaṃ naśvaraṃ jalabimbavat \|*  
*śaraṇaṃ yāhi govindaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram \|\| 70 \|\|*

*tāvadbhavecchā bhogecchā strīsukhecchā nṛṇāmiha \|*  
*yāvadgurumukhāmbhojānna prāpnoti manuṃ hareḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. Everything from Brahma to a straw is perishable like the reflection in the water; therefore you take refuge under Govinda who is the great lord and the great soul. A man gets worldly desires for enjoyment or the pleasure of one woman till such time as the mantra of Krishna is not spoken by the teacher in his ears. Because after getting the mantra which is not easily accessible to everyone, a person is relieved of all desires.

## \|\| 60.72 \|\|

*saṃprāpya durlabhaṃ mantraṃ vitṛṣṇo hi bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*indratvamamaratvaṃ ca nahi vāñchanti vaiṣṇavāḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Therefore, the Vaishnavas always aspire to be the slaves of the lord in preference to the kingship of Indra, becoming eternal or achieving moksa.

## \|\| 60.73-78 \|\|

*nahi vāñchanti mokṣaṃ ca dāsyaṃ bhaktiṃ vinā hareḥ \|*  
*bhakti nirmathanaṃ bhakto mokṣaṃ no vāñchati prabhoḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

*jñānaṃ mṛtyuñjayatvaṃ ca sarvasiddhiṃ tadīpsitam \|*  
*vāksiddhiṃ caiva dhātṛtvaṃ bhaktānāṃ nahi vāñchitam \|\| 74 \|\|*

*bhaktiṃ vihāya kṛṣṇasya viṣayaṃ yo hi vāñchati \|*  
*kapilaśca kumāraśca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī \|\| 75 \|\|*

*ahaṃ brahmā ca viṣṇuśca dharmo'nantaśca kaśyapaḥ \|*  
*kapilaśca kumāraśca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī \|\| 76 \|\|*

*svāyambhuvo manuścaiva prahlādaśca parāśaraḥ \|*  
*bhṛguḥ śukraśca durvāsā vasiṣṭhaḥ kraturaṃgirāḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

*baliśca vālakhilyāśca varuṇaśca hutāśanaḥ \|*  
*vāyuḥ sūryaśca garuḍo dakṣo gaṇapatiḥ svayam \|\| 78 \|\|*

73-78. A true devotee does not aspire for moksa which deprives him of the adoration of the lord. He does not intend to over-power death, the desired success, success in speech and becoming Brahma. Because the one, who, discarding the devotion of the lord, becomes desirous of something else, he getting deprived of the influence of the Maya of Vishnu acts as if he intended to consume poison in preference to nectar. Brahma, Vishnu, Dharma, Ananta, Kashyapa, Kapila, Kumara, sage Narayana, Prahlada, Parashara, Bhrigu, Sukra, Durvasa, Vait ha, Kratu, Angira, Bali, Balakhilaya, Varuna, Agni, Vayu, Sirrya, Garuda, Daksha and Ganapati are all the best of the devotees of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 60.79-80 \|\|

*ete parā bhaktavarāḥ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*ye ca tasya kalāḥ śreṣṭhāste tadbhaktiparāyaṇāḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*ityuktvā śaṅkarastasmai dadau kalpataruṃ manum \|*  
*lakṣmīmāyākāmabījaṃ ṅentaṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ mune \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. Such of the people are like the rays of all of them and remain devoted to lord Krishna. О sage, thus speaking lord Shiva gave him the mantra ЭД tjf f\| =shi ^buiw ЯЧ: together with the best of the way of the adoration, the stotra and kavacha to Brihaspati who happened to be the son of the teacher of Shiva.

## \|\| 60.81-82 \|\|

*paraṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ mune \|*  
*tatpuraścaraṇaṃ dhyānaṃ śuddhe mandākinītaṭe \|\| 81 \|\|*

*guruḥ saṃprāpya taṃ mantraṃ śaṅkarācca jagadguroḥ \|*  
*viṣaṇṇo hi bhavābdhau ca babhūva tamuvāca ha \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. О sage, Shiva gave away the mantra to Brihaspati on the bank of Mandakini river besides the mantra and dhydnam. Brihaspati on the other hand feeling somewhat detached spoke to Shiva.

## \|\| 60.83 \|\|

*bṛhaspatiruvāca \|*  
*ājñāṃ kuru jagannātha yāmi taptuṃ harestapaḥ \|*  
*tārā tiṣṭhatu tatraiva na tayā me prayojanam \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Brihaspati said – О lord of the universe, you permit me to proceed for perfonning tapas. I am no more concerned about Tara and let her remain wherever she is.

## \|\| 60.84 \|\|

*paśyāmi viṣatulyaṃ ca sarvaṃ naśvaramīśvara \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi satyaṃ nityaṃ ca nirguṇam \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. О lord, I look at her like poison, since all things of the world are perishable. I, therefore, intend to take refuge under lord Krishna who is truthful, eternal and is Nirguna.

## \|\| 60.85 \|\|

*śrīmahādeva uvāca \|*  
*paragrastāṃ striyaṃ tyaktvā na praśaṃsyaṃ tapo mune \|*  
*sambhāvitasya duścarccā maraṇādatiricyate \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. Mahadeva said – О sage, it would not be appropriate to proceed to perform tapas leaving your own wife in the clutches of the enemy, because the ill-talk of a noble person is worse than death.

## \|\| 60.86 \|\|

*puro gaccha mahābhāga tametaṃ narmadātaṭam \|*  
*yatra brahmādayo devāstatrāhaṃ yāmi satvaram \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. О virtuous one, you move ahead to the place where Brahma and all other gods are lodged. I shall follow you shortly thereafter.

## \|\| 60.87 \|\|

*śivasya vacanaṃ śrutvā yayau suraguruḥ svayam \|*  
*āyayau ca mahābhāgaḥ śaṅkaro narmadātaṭam \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. On listening to the words of Shiva, Brihaspati the priest of the gods moved toward the bank of the river Narmada. Lord Shiva also arrived there soon.

## \|\| 60.88 \|\|

*sagaṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā prasannavadanekṣaṇam \|*  
*praṇemurdevatāḥ sarvā manavo munayastathā \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. Finding Shiva arriving there, together with his ganas wearing a smile on his face and happiness emanating from his eyes, all the gods, Manu and the sages bowed in reverence to him.

## \|\| 60.89 \|\|

*nanāma śambhuḥ śirasā viṣṇuṃ ca kamalodbhavam \|*  
*dadau viṣṇurmaheśāya premṇā''liṅganamāsanam \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. Shiva also bowed in reverence to Brahma and Vishnu. Thereafter Vishnu embraced Shiva with love and offered him a seat.

## \|\| 60.90-92 \|\|

*etasminnantare tatra cāgamacca bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*praṇanāma mahādevaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca kamalodbhavam \|\| 90 \|\|*

*sūryyaṃ dharmamanantaṃ ca naraṃ māṃ ca munīśvarān \|*  
*svaguruṃ pitaraṃ bhaktyā cāvasattatra saṃsadi \|\| 91 \|\|*

*sañcintya manasā yuktimūce tatra ca saṃsadi \|*  
*svayaṃ viṣṇuśca bhagavānbrahmāṇaṃ candraśekharam \|\| 92 \|\|*

90-92. In the meantime Brihaspati also reached there. He also bowed in reverence to Mahadeva, Vis nu, Brahma, Surya, Dharma, Ananta, Narayana, the sages and his father with devotion and took his seat. Thereafter Vishnu taking a clue from the minds of Brahma and Shiva, spoke.

## \|\| 60.93-94 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*yuvāṃ ca munayaścaiva samudrapulinaṃ drutam \|*  
*śukraṃ kañcicca madhyasthaṃ prasthāpayitumarhatha \|\| 93 \|\|*

*vigraheṇaiva viṣamaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*madāśiṣā suragurustārāṃ prāpsyati niścitam \|\| 94 \|\|*

93-94. Vishnu said – Both of you should go collectively to the sea-shore and meet Sukracarya there as mediators because the result of a war would be dangerous. There is no doubt about it. With my blessing Brihaspati is sure to get back Tara.

## \|\| 60.95 \|\|

*suraiḥ stutaśca santuṣṭaḥ śukrācāryyo bhaviṣyati \|*  
*suraiḥ śukro hi na jitaḥ kṛṣṇacakreṇa rakṣitaḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. Therefore all the gods should go to Sukracarya and please him with their prayers. Since Sukracarya is protected with the disc of Vishnu all the gods collectively cannot win Sukracarya.

## \|\| 60.96-97 \|\|

*yuvābhyāṃ prārthyamāno'haṃ yuvayoḥ stavanena ca \|*  
*śvetadvīpādāgato'smi parituṣṭaḥ stavena ca \|\| 96 \|\|*

*śukrāśramamasīparṇaṃ sarvā gacchantu devatāḥ \|*  
*ripurbaliṣṭhaḥ stotreṇa vaśībhūta iti śrutiḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

96-97. Getting pleased with your prayers I am moving to Shveta-dvipa. Therefore all the gods should go to the hermitage of Sukra. It is ordained in the scriptures that a powerful enemy should be won over with prayers.

## \|\| 60.98 \|\|

*ityuktvā jagatāṃ nāthastatraivāntara dhīyata \|*  
*stuto brahmādibhidevaiḥ praṇataiḥ paripūjitaḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. Thus speaking, Vishnu, the lord of the universe, having been adored by the gods disappeared from that place.

## \|\| 60.99-100 \|\|

*gate ca jagatāṃ nāthe śvetadvīpaṃ ca nārada \|*  
*cintitāśca surāḥ sarve viṣaṇṇamanasastathā \|\| 99 \|\|*

*munīndevāṃśca saṃbodhya brahmā vai tatra saṃsadi \|*  
*uvāca nītisāraṃ tatsammataṃ śaṅkarasya saḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

99-100. О Narada, at the departure of lord Vishnu to Shveta-dvipa, all the gods were upset in their minds and got worried. At that point of time, Brahma spoke to the sages highlighting the words of policy which were liked by lord Shiva.

## \|\| 60.101 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*mama śambhośca dharmasya viṣṇorvā sarvasākṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*asmākaṃ ca samaḥ sneho daitye deve ca putrakāḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. Brahma said: My sons, myself, Shiva, Dharma and Vishnu who stand witness for all, like the demons equally.

## \|\| 60.102 \|\|

*daityānāṃ ca guruṃ śukraṃ prapannaśca niśākaraḥ \|*  
*na jitaśca suraiḥ śukraḥ pūjito ditinandanaiḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. Chandrama on the other hand is residing in the abode of Sukra. Since he is adored by the demons, the gods cannot defeat Sukra.

## \|\| 60.103 \|\|

*tārāhetorahaṃ yāmi śukrasya bhavanaṃ surāḥ \|*  
*sarve samudrapulinaṃ yāntu viṣṇornideśataḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. Therefore О gods, all of you should move on to the sea-shore according to the command of Vishnu and I am moving alone to the house of Sukra for getting back Tara.

## \|\| 60.104 \|\|

*ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā cāgamacchukrasannidhim \|*  
*prayayurdevatā viprāḥ samudrapulinaṃ mune \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. О sage, thus speaking, Brahma, the creator of the universe, went to Sukra and all other gods went to the sea-shore.

## Chapter 61

## \|\| 61.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*tataḥ paraṃ kiṃ rahasyaṃ babhūvāsuradevayoḥ \|*  
*śrotumicchāmi bhagavanparaṃ kautūhalaṃ mama \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said – О lord, what happened between the gods and the demons thereafter? You please reveal the secret to me since I am getting very anxious.

## \|\| 61.2 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*brahmā jagāma nilayaṃ śukrasya ca mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*nānādaityagaṇākīrṇaṃ ratnamaṇḍapabhūṣitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Narayana said – Brahma went to the abode of Sukra which had many Mandapas bedecked with jewels.

## \|\| 61.3 \|\|

*pañcāśatkoṭibhiḥ śiṣyaiḥ parītaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ \|*  
*saptabhiḥ parikhābhiśca veṣṭitaṃ durgameva ca \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Fifty crores of disciples, well-versed in Brahmana, surrounded him and his fort was surrounded by seven moats.

## \|\| 61.4 \|\|

*rakṣitaṃ rakṣakagaṇairdaityaiśca śatakoṭibhiḥ \|*  
*padmarāgairviracitaiḥ prāvāraiḥ pariśobhitam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Hundred crores of demons protected the fort and the fort has the boundary walls bedecked with several of gems.

## \|\| 61.5 \|\|

*dadarśa jagatāṃ dhātā sabhāyāṃ bhṛgunandanam \|*  
*stutaṃ munigaṇairdaityai ratnasiṃhāsanasthitam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Reaching there Brahma, the creator of the universe, found Sukra, the son of Bhrigu who was seated on the gem-studded lion-throne being adored by the sages.

## \|\| 61.6 \|\|

*japantaṃ paramaṃ brahma kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram \|*  
*koṭisūryyaprabhaṃ śaśvajjvalantaṃ brahmatejasā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. He was reciting the name of Krishna, the eternal Brahmana, the great soul and the great lord. He had the lustre of crores of suns and the divine lustre illumining him.

## \|\| 61.7 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā pautraṃ prabhāyuktaṃ vidhātā hṛṣṭamānasaḥ \|*  
*ātmānaṃ kṛtinaṃ mene putraṃ pautraṃ ca nārada \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О Narada, Brahma was delighted at finding his grandson so illustrious. He developed a feeling that his sons and grandsons are all graceful.

## \|\| 61.8 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā pitāmahaṃ śukro dhātāraṃ jagatāṃ prabhum \|*  
*utthāya sahasā bhītaḥ praṇanāma kṛtāñjaliḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. As soon as Sukra found Brahma the creator of the universe he got up at once and feeling terrified stood before him with folded hands and bowed to him in reverence.

## \|\| 61.9-10 \|\|

*ādāya pūjayāmāsa copacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā sambhrameṇa yathāgamam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*vidyā mantrapradātāraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām \|*  
*svakarmaṇāṃ ca phaladaṃ sarveṣāṃ viśvato varam \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Не adored him with sixteen types of offerings and with his mind filled with devotion he started offering prayers to him on his arrival. Indeed he bestowed intelligence and mantra besides fortune since he had been the one who granted the reward of one’s own deeds. Indeed he was the best of all in the universe.

## \|\| 61.11 \|\|

*śukrasya stavanenaiva santuṣṭo jagatāṃ patiḥ \|*  
*avaruhya rathāttūrṇamavasattatra saṃsadi \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Brahma the lord of the universe felt extremely satisfied with the prayer of Sukra and he then addressed the court of Sukra.

## \|\| 61.12-14 \|\|

*śukreṇa śirasā dattaratnasiṃhāsane vare \|*  
*tejasā jvalite ramye nirmite viśvakarmaṇā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*śukraḥ praṇamya brahmāṇaṃ kumāraṃ śakunaṃ kratum \|*  
*vasiṣṭhaṃ ca marīciṃ ca sanandaṃ ca sanātanam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*kapilaṃ vai pañcaśikhaṃ voḍhumaṃgirasaṃ mune \|*  
*dharmaṃ māṃ ca naraṃ bhaktyā praṇanāma kṛtāñjaliḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. Sukra offered him the best seat of lion-throne bowing his head. This lion-throne was quite beautiful and illumining, which was built by Vishvakarma. О sage, Sukra after bowing in reverence to Brahma also bowed in reverence to Kumara, Sanaka, Kratu, Vasistha, Marichi, Sananda, Sanatana, Kapila, Pancsikha, Vodhu, Angira, Dhanna, myself (Narayana) and Nara with devotion folding his hands.

## \|\| 61.15-16 \|\|

*pratyekaṃ pūjayāmāsa sādaraṃ ca yathocitam \|*  
*siṃhāsaneṣu ratneṣu vāsayāmāsa dhārmikaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*prahṛṣṭavadanāḥ sarve praṇemurditinandanāḥ \|*  
*ṛṣisaṃghāśca dhātāraṃ tuṣṭuvuśca yathāgamam \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. The religious-minded Sukra adored all of them, offering them the gem-studded lion-thrones. Thereafter Sukra, the son of Diti, and the other sages with a delightful mind bowed in reverence to Brahma.

## \|\| 61.17 \|\|

*sarvānsaṃstūya sa kaviravocatsampuṭāñjaliḥ \|*  
*sāśrunetraḥ sapulakaḥ praṇato vinayānvitaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Thereafter, after welcoming all, Sukra with folded hands and eyes filled with tears, getting emotional, started speaking with great humility.

## \|\| 61.18 \|\|

*śukra uvāca \|*  
*adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam \|*  
*svayaṃ vidhātā bhagavānsākṣāddṛṣṭaḥ svamandire \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Sukra said – Today my life has met with success; my birth has been successful because all of you with Brahma have arrived here.

## \|\| 61.19 \|\|

*sākṣāddṛṣṭāśca tatputrā bhagavantaḥ sanātanāḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇo'tha māmevaṃ paramātmā parātparaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Besides his son Sanatana and others have also arrived here with their smiling faces. It appears as if lord Krishna himself has arrived here.

## \|\| 61.20-21 \|\|

*kṛtārthaṃ kartumīśā māṃ yuṣmākaṃ svāgataṃ śiśum \|*  
*svātmārāmeṣu kuśalapraśnamevaṃ viḍambanam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*pavitraṃ kartumīśā māṃ heturāgamane'tra vaḥ \|*  
*aparaṃ brūtha kiṃ vā'pi śāsta naḥ karavāmi kim \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. In order to grace a child like me, all of you have arrived here and I welcome you. It is just a fallacy to enquire about the welfare of the people who are self-engrossed in their own soul. You have arrived here in order to purify me. You kindly tell me what I can do for you?

## \|\| 61.22 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*udvignaściravicchedāttvāṃ pautraṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ \|*  
*vicchedaḥ putrapautrāṇāṃ maraṇādatiricyate \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Brahma said – I was feeling anxious because of my separation from you for long. I have come to meet my grandson like you, because the separation from a son and a grandson is extremely painful.

## \|\| 61.23 \|\|

*kuśalaṃ te muniśreṣṭha putrayoścāpi yoṣitaḥ \|*  
*kuśalaṃ te svadharmāṇāṃ kāmyānāṃ tapasāmapi \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. О best of the sages, are you quite well. Are your sons, wives, Dharma and tapas going on well?

## \|\| 61.24 \|\|

*dine dine'paricchannaṃ śrīkṛṣṇārcanamīpsitam \|*  
*sva guroḥ sevanaṃ nityamavicchinnaṃ bhavettava \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. I pray that you remain devoted to lord Krishna and your devotion towards your teacher may continue as ever.

## \|\| 61.25 \|\|

*gurviṣṭayoḥ pūjanaṃ ca sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam \|*  
*pāpādhirogaśokaghnaṃ puṇyaharṣapradaṃ śubham \|\| 25\|\|*

25\. Because to adore one’s teacher and the family gods is the cause of all the welfares and destroys sins, disease and grief, bestowing merit, pleasure and welfare.

## \|\| 61.26 \|\|

*abhīṣṭadevaḥ santuṣṭo gurau tuṣṭe nṛṇāmiha \|*  
*iṣṭadeve ca santuṣṭe santuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. With the pleasure of the teacher, the family gods of a person also remain happy and with the pleasure of the family god, all the gods remain happy.

## \|\| 61.27 \|\|

*gururvipraḥ suro ruṣṭo yeṣāṃ pātakināmiha \|*
