*teṣāṃ ca kuśalaṃ nāsti vighnastasya pade pade \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The sinners with whom the Brahmanas and the gods get angry, they cannot remain without blemish and have to face obstructions at every step.

## \|\| 61.28-29 \|\|

*tuṣṭaśca satataṃ vatsa śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|*  
*sarvāntarātmā bhagavāṃstava bhaktyā ca nirguṇaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*tava tuṣṭo gururahaṃ vidhātā jagatāmapi \|*  
*mayi tuṣṭe haristuṣṭo harau tuṣṭe tu devatāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. О son, you are devoted to lord Krishna, who is beyond-Prakriti and is the soul of all men, formless and remains happy with your adoration. I am the creator of the universe and also your teacher. I am quite happy with you and with my pleasure the lord also feels happy.

## \|\| 61.30-31 \|\|

*sāmprataṃ śṛṇu me dhīmannatrāgamanakāraṇam \|*  
*preṣitasya surāṇāṃ ca viśvasaṃhartureva ca \|\| 30 \|\|*

*śivasya guruputrasya sādhvīṃ tārāṃ bṛhaspateḥ \|*  
*apahṛtya niśānāthastavaiva śaraṇāgataḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. О intelligent one, the reason for my arrival at present is somewhat different, about which I am going to tell you, you listen to me. I have been deputed by the gods and lord Shiva. Brihaspati happens to be the Guruputra of Shiva whose chaste wife Tara has been abducted by Chandrama, who has taken refuge with you.

## \|\| 61.32-35 \|\|

*śambhurdharmaśca sūryyaśca śakro'nantaśca putraka \|*  
*ādityā vasavo rudrā dikpālāśca digīśvarāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*yuddhāyāyānti sannaddhāstisraḥ koṭyaśca devatāḥ \|*  
*nāgāḥ kimpuruṣāścaiva yakṣarākṣasaguhyakāḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍā brahmarākṣasāḥ \|*  
*kirātāścaiva gandharvāḥ samudrapuline'dhunā \|\| 34 \|\|*

*tārakāmayasaṃgrāme madhyastho 'haṃ sutaiḥ saha \|*  
*dehi tārāṃ raṇaṃ kiṃ vā tyaja candraṃ ca kāminam \|\| 35 \|\|*

32-35. O son, because of this lord Shiva, Dharma, Surya, Indra, Ananta, Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Dikpalas, lords of the quarters are arriving here for a battle. The army comprises of three crores of gods, Nagas, Kimpurusas, Yaksas, demons, Guhyakas, Goblins, Bhiitas and Pretas besides Kusmandas, Brahmraksasas, Brahmanas Kiratas, Gandharvas getting well-prepared and are currently lodged on the sea-shore. But in this war-like situation, I have been declared as a mediator, therefore either you return Tara or be prepared for a war or otherwise you disown Chandrama totally.

## \|\| 61.36 \|\|

*śukra uvāca \|*  
*āgacchantu surāḥ sarve sannaddhā raṇadurmadāḥ \|*  
*yotsye vinā maheśaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ ca guruṃ param \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Sukra said – Let the gods who are desirous of a war arrive here. Leaving Shiva, who happens to be the great teacher of all, I can fight with everyone.

## \|\| 61.37-38 \|\|

*daityā ūcuḥ \|*  
*ubhayeṣāṃ guruḥ śambhurmānyo vandyaśca sarvadā \|*  
*dharmaśca sākṣī sarveṣāṃ tvameva ca pitāmahaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*anyāṃśca tṛṇatulyāṃśca nahi manyāmahe vayam \|*  
*āgacchantu ca yotsyāmo vraja brūhi jagadguro \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. The demons said – Shiva is adorable by the gods and the demons alike. Dharma is the witness of all the deeds and you are the great grandfather. We consider all other gods like straw. Therefore, О teacher of the universe, you go and tell them that they can come and fight with us.

## \|\| 61.39 \|\|

*kṛpayā guruputrasya yadyāyāti maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*āgneyāstraṃ prayokṣyāmaḥ paścādyotsyāmahe prabho \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О lord, in case Shiva arrives here to display compassion on Brihaspati, who happens to be his Guruputra, he will first use Agneyastra and then start the fight.

## \|\| 61.40 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*kālāgnirudraḥ saṃharttā viśvasya balināṃ varaḥ \|*  
*he vatsāstena sārddhaṃ ca ko vā yuddhaṃ kariṣyati \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Brahma said – О son, he is Kalagni and the destroyer of the universe. As such he happens to be foremost of all the valorous people. Therefore, who can fight with him.

## \|\| 61.41 \|\|

*bhadrakālī jaganmātā khaḍgakharpara dhāriṇī \|*  
*tayā durddharṣayā sārddhaṃ ko vā yuddhaṃ kariṣyati \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The mother of the universe is associated with him, who holds a sword and skull-vase. Who would like to fight with the terrific one?

## \|\| 61.42-43 \|\|

*sā sahasrabhujā devī muṇḍamālāvibhūṣaṇā \|*  
*yojanāyatavaktrā ca daśayojanavistṛtā \|\| 42 \|\|*

*saptatālapramāṇāśca yasyā dantā bhayānakāḥ \|*  
*krośapramāṇajihvā ca māhālolā bhayaṅkarī \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. Who would fight with the goddess of a thousand arms who is adorned with the garland of skulls and has a yojana-long mouth which is ten yojanas wide? She has seven fangs like the tala trees which are horrible. She often moves around.

## \|\| 61.44-46 \|\|

*atīva raudrā sannaddhā bhīmāḥ śaṃkarakiṃkarāḥ \|*  
*atibhīmā bhairavāśca nandī ca raṇakarkaśaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*śivasya pārṣadāḥ sarvaṃ mahābalaparākramāḥ \|*  
*vīrabhadrādayaḥ śūrāḥ koṭisūryyasamaprabhāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*sahasramūrdhnaḥ śeṣasya phaṇāmaṇḍalabhūṣaṇam \|*  
*viśvaṃ sarṣapatulyaṃ ca ko vā yoddhā ca tatsamaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

44-46. The terrible looking attendants of Shiva also accompany her which include the horrible Bhairava, Nandi who roars in the battle field, besides Virabhadra and other ganas who are extremely valorous, possessing great prowess and have the lutsre of crores of suns. There is the thousand headed Shesha accompanying her, whose hoods are studded with gems and they hold them on the head like the sea-same seed. No warrior can equate them.

## \|\| 61.47-48 \|\|

*kālāgnirudraḥ saṃharttā yasya śambhośca kiṃkaraḥ \|*  
*śūlinastripuraghnasya jvalato brahmatejasā \|\| 47 \|\|*

*yasya pāśupatāstreṇa durnivāryeṇa putrakāḥ \|*  
*bhasmībhūtaṃ bhavedviśvaṃ daityānāṃ caiva kā kathā \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. О son, Shiva the killer of Tripura and from whom the Kalagni-rudra emanates, who destroys the world and the trident beaters serve him. Besides the horrible Pasupata weapon can reduce the entire universe to ashes. How can the demons stand before it?

## \|\| 61.49-51 \|\|

*yasya śūlena bhinnaśca śaṅkhacūḍaḥ pratāpavān \|*  
*sudāmā pārṣadavaraḥ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*trikoṭisūryyasadṛśastejasvī paramādbhutaḥ \|*  
*rādhākavacakaṇṭhaśca sarvadaityajaneśvaraḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*madhukaiṭabhayorhantā hiraṇyakaśipośca yaḥ \|*  
*sa ca viṣṇuḥ samāyāti śvetadvīpātsvayaṃ prabhuḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

49-51. The glorious Samkhacuda was destroyed with the trident of Shiva though he happened to be the associate of lord Krishna known by the name of Sudama and bore the lustre of three crores of sun, extremely astonishing and wore the kavacha of Radha round his neck and was the lord of all the demons. Lord Vishnu who happens to be the killer of Samkhacuda and Madhukaitabha was himself coming from Shveta-dvipa.

## \|\| 61.52 \|\|

*ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā virarāma ca saṃsadi \|*  
*prahasyovāca daiteyo dānavānāmadhīśvaraḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The one who had killed Hiranyakas'ipu and Madhukaitabha, the one in whom lord Krishna appears with all the rays, the one who happens to be the soul of everyone, his Sudarsana-cakra which is unbearable always protects us. О Vidhata, neither Shiva is more powerful than the same, nor the Pashupata weapon. Kali, Shesha and Rudra also cannot face it.

## \|\| 61.53 \|\|

*prahrāda uvāca \|*  
*namastubhyaṃ jagaddhātaḥ sarveṣāṃ prāktaneśvara \|*  
*sarvapūjyaḥ sarvanāthaḥ kiṃ vakṣyāmi tavāgrataḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. О lord of the universe, the one in whose hair-pit the entire universe is lodged, the one who is the base of all, the one who is toughest of all.

## \|\| 61.54-56 \|\|

*hiraṇyakaśiporhantā madhukaiṭabhayośca yaḥ \|*  
*sā kalā yasya kṛṣṇasya paripūrṇatamasya ca \|\| 54 \|\|*

*sarvāntarātmanastasya cakraṃ nāma sudarśanam \|*  
*asmākaṃ lokamasmāṃśca taddrāgdhakṣyati dussaham \|\| 55 \|\|*

*tato na balavāñchambhurna ca pāśupataṃ vidhe \|*  
*na ca kālī na śeṣaśca na ca rudrādayaḥ surāḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

54-56. Lord Virat happens to be the sixteenth ray of the same. Neither Ananta is stronger than the same nor is Kali superior to it.

## \|\| 61.57 \|\|

*yasya lomasu viśvāni nikhilāni jagatpate \|*  
*sarvādhārasya ca vibhoḥ sthūlātsthūlatarasya ca \|\| 57\|\|*

57\. Thus speaking in the court of Sukra, Brahma the creator of the universe kept quiet. Thereafter the king of Danvas spoke smilingly.

## \|\| 61.58 \|\|

*ṣoḍaśāṃśo bhagavataḥ sa caiva hi mahānvirāṭ \|*  
*ananto nahi tatsthūlo na kālī bṛhatī tataḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Prahlada said – О creator of the universe, you happen to be the oldest lord of the universe. You are adorable by all and are the lord of all. Therefore what could I speak before you?

## \|\| 61.59 \|\|

*āgacchantu surāḥ sarve yuddhaṃ kurvantu sāmpratam \|*  
*na bibhemi śarebhyaśca na ca pāśupatāddharāt \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Let all the gods come and fight with us because I am not afraid of the arrows of Shiva or his Pasupata weapon.

## \|\| 61.60 \|\|

*namastasmai bhagavate śivāya śivarūpiṇe \|*  
*namo'nantāya sādhubhyo vaiṣṇavebhyaḥ prajāpate \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. О Prajapati I bow in reverence to Shiva who is the form of welfare. I bow in reverence to serpent Ananta and the noble Vaishnavas.

## \|\| 61.61 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇasya prasādena nirbhayo'haṃ nirāmayaḥ \|*  
*na me svātmabalaṃ brahmaṃstadbalaṃ yatprabhorbalam \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. О lord, because of the grace of all, I am fearless and quite healthy; I don’t possess any strength of my own and whatever I possess belongs to the lord.

## \|\| 61.62-63 \|\|

*svapāpena mṛtastāto purā vai viṣṇunindayā \|*  
*nirbandhācchaṅkhacūḍaśca darpācca madhukaiṭabhau \|\| 62 \|\|*

*tripuraḥ kiṅkaro'smākaṃ vīratvena na gaṇyate \|*  
*tathā'pi preritastena sa rathastho maheśvaraḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. In the earlier times, my father was killed because of his own sin of denouncing Vishnu. Samkhacuda was killed because of his own stubbornness and the Madhukaitabha were destroyed because of their own arrogance. Tripura happened to be our servant and he could not be counted as a great warrior; still he was killed at the hand of Mahadeva, mounted on a chariot when he was incited by lord Shiva.

## \|\| 61.64 \|\|

*ityuktvā dānavaśreṣṭho virarāma ca saṃsadi \|*  
*uvāca jagatāṃ dhātā punareva ca nārada \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. О Narada, Prahlada the best of the demons kept quite after speaking all this. Thereafter Brahma the creator of the universe started speaking again.

## \|\| 61.65 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*vināśakāraṇaṃ yuddhamubhayordaityadevayoḥ \|*  
*suprītyā caraṇaṃ vatsa sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Brahma said – О son, a war between the demons and the gods will doom destruction on both the sides, therefore, you better act with love which is the root cause of all welfares.

## \|\| 61.66 \|\|

*tārāṃ bhikṣāṃ dehi mahyaṃ bhikṣukāya ca vedhase \|*  
*vimukhe bhikṣuke rājangṛhasthaḥ sarvapāpabhāk \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. О king mind it, that I have come as a beggar to you inspite of being Brahma and therefore, you give away Tara to me in charity because by disappointing a beggar, a householder attracts all sins.

## \|\| 61.67 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca \|*  
*svakīrtiṃ rakṣa rājendra siṃhastvaṃ suradaityayoḥ \|*  
*yasya bhikṣurjagaddhātā tasya kīrteśca kā kathā \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Sanatkumara said – О best of the kings, you are the lion among the races of the demons and the gods; therefore you protect your glory. The one at whose door Brahma comes as a beggar who could equate him in glory?

## \|\| 61.68 \|\|

*sanātana uvāca \|*  
*na jitastvaṃ surendraiśca brahmeśānapurogamaiḥ \|*  
*rakṣitaḥ kṛṣṇacakreṇa vaiṣṇavaḥ puṇyavāñchuciḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Sanatana said – Brahma, Shiva and other gods could not conquer you because of your being virtuous and noble and a Vaishnava also being protected by the Cakra of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 61.69 \|\|

*sanandana uvāca \|*  
*yasyeṣṭadevaḥ sarvātmā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ \|*  
*guruśca vaiṣṇavaḥ śukraḥ sa ca kena jito mahān \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Sanatana said – The one who adores lord Krishna who is beyond Prakriti and has a teacher like Vaishnava Sukra, who can over-power such a great king.

## \|\| 61.70 \|\|

*sanaka uvāca \|*  
*puṇyavānna jitaḥ kena jitaḥ pāpī svapātakaiḥ \|*  
*puṇyadīpo na nirvāti pāṣaṇḍenaiva vāyunā \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Sanaka said – No one can defeat a meritorious person. The sinner is over-powered because the lamp of virtues cannot be extinguished with the wind of illusion.

## \|\| 61.71 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*dehi tārāṃ mahābhāga candra prāṇādhikaṃ guroḥ \|*  
*svakīrtiṃ rakṣa suciraṃ prārthayāmaḥ punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The sage said – О virtues king, you hand over Tara and Chandrama to the teacher Brihaspati. I pray you again and again and preserve your glory for all times to come.

## \|\| 61.72-73 \|\|

*prahrāda uvāca \|*  
*sthite madīśvare sākṣānnahi bhṛtyo virājate \|*  
*karttāraṃ brūhi mannāthaṃ guruṃ śukraṃ satāṃ varam \|\| 72 \|\|*

*śiṣyāṇāmādhipatye ca sādhūnāṃ gururīśvaraḥ \|*  
*gurau samarpitaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvaiśvaryyaṃ munīśvaraṃ \|\| 73 \|\|*

72-73. Prahlada said – When the lord of all is present there, none of his attendants can occupy that position, nor could anyone else give the consent. You better tell all these words to Sukra who is the best of noble people. The teacher happens to be the lord of the noble disciples and he is always equated with the lord. In earlier times I entrusted all my riches and fortunes to my teacher.

## \|\| 61.74 \|\|

*vayaṃ bhṛtyāśca poṣyāśca svaguroḥ paricārakāḥ \|*  
*te ca śiṣyāḥ kuśalino gurvājñāṃ pālayanti ye \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. We are the servants of our teacher, who feeds us because the same disciples meet with welfare who obeys the command of the teacher.

## \|\| 61.75 \|\|

*prahrādasya vacaḥ śrutvā cakāra prārthanāṃ kavim \|*  
*dadau śukraśca tārāṃ tāṃ candraṃ ca malinaṃ mune \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. О sage, on hearing the words of Prahlada, he prayed to Sukra. Thereafter Sukra returned Tara and the sinful Chandrama to them.

## \|\| 61.76 \|\|

*dattvā tārāṃ vidhuṃ śukraḥ praṇanāma vidheḥ pade \|*  
*namaskṛtya munibhyaśca praṇataḥ svapuraṃ yayau \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Sukra handing over Tara and Chandrama touched the feet of Brahma and bowed in reverence to all the sages, finally retiring to his own place.

## \|\| 61.77 \|\|

*prahlādaḥ sagaṇo bhaktyā namaskṛtya vidheḥ pade \|*  
*pratyekaṃ vai munigaṇānpraṇataḥ svagṛhaṃ yayau \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Prahlada also bowed in reverence to Brahma together with all his courtiers and offered salutations to all the sages, who finally left for their abodes.

## \|\| 61.78 \|\|

*brahmā dadarśa tārāṃ ca praṇatāṃ svapade satīm \|*  
*lajjayā namravaktrāṃ ca rudatīṃ gurviṇīṃ mune \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. О sage, Brahma looked at Tara, who was lowering her head in shame and was pregnant at the same time. She touched the feet of Brahma. She was crying also.

## \|\| 61.79-80 \|\|

*candraṃ ca praṇataṃ dhātā kroḍe saṃsthāpya māyayā \|*  
*uvāca malināṃ tārāṃ kātarāṃ ca kṛpāmayaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*tāre tyaja bhayaṃ mattaḥ bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite \|*  
*saubhāgyayuktā svapatau bhaviṣyasi vareṇa me \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. Thereafter finding Chandrama offering salutations to him, the merciful Brahma lifted him up and made him sit in his lap and then spoke to Tara who had lost all her glory. Brahma said: "O Tara, don’t be afraid of me." With my boon you will regain the fortunes of your husband.

## \|\| 61.81 \|\|

*durbalā balinā grastā niṣkāmā na cyutā bhavet \|*  
*prāyaścittena śuddhā sā na strī jāreṇa duṣyati \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. Because a helpless and weak lady if over-powered by a strong man cannot be termed as unchaste and does not fall from her dharma. She is purified by her repentance and she cannot be treated as degraded because of the advances of a sinner.

## \|\| 61.82 \|\|

*sakāmā kāmato jāraṃ bhajate svasukhena ca \|*  
*prāyaścittānna śuddhā sā svāminā parivarjitā \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. On the other hand, the one who, becoming passionate, goes to another man for the sake of pleasure and enjoys his company, her mind cannot be purified even with repentance. Therefore she is considered as a discarded woman by her husband.

## \|\| 61.83-84 \|\|

*kumbhīpāke pacyate sā yāvaccandradivākaram \|*  
*annaṃ viṣṭhā jalaṃ mūtraṃ sparśanaṃ sarvapāpadam \|\| 83 \|\|*

*pāpī yasyāśca tasyāśca sādhubhiḥ parivarjitam \|*  
*kasya garbhaṃ vada śubhe gaccha vatse gurorgṛham \|\| 84 \|\|*

83-84. She will remain in the kumbhlpaka hell till the duration of the life of the sun and the moon. Her food is to be discarded like refuse and the water like urine and her mere touch showers all sins on a person. Therefore the noble people are prohibited from taking food and water from such a degraded woman. О daughter, you tell me who has made you pregnant. You better go back to Brihaspati.

## \|\| 61.85-87 \|\|

*tyaja lajjāṃ mahābhāge sarvaṃ ca prāktanādbhavet \|*  
*brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca satī tadā \|\| 85 \|\|*

*candrasya garbhaṃ he tāta bibharmyadya svakarmaṇā \|*  
*sarve me sākṣiṇaḥ santi durbalāyāḥ prajāpate \|\| 86 \|\|*

*yadā jagrāha candro māṃ dayāhīnaśca durmatiḥ \|*  
*ityuktvā tārakā devī suṣāva kanakaprabham \|\| 87 \|\|*

85-87. O virtuous lady, you shed away the shame because everything that has happened is due to the earlier deeds. On hearing the words of Brahma, the chaste lady spoke to him, "O father, I am pregnant by Chandrama and I am accordingly maintaining the same. О Prajapati, at the time when I was captured by this degraded Chandrama, all the people are witnesses to me. Saying this, Tara produced a child which was having the lustre of gold.

## \|\| 61.88-90 \|\|

*kumāraṃ sundaraṃ tatra jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā \|*  
*gṛhītvā tanayaṃ candro natvā brahmāṇamīśvaram \|\| 88 \|\|*

*jagāma sa svabhavanaṃ brahmā sindhutaṭaṃ yayau \|*  
*sādhvīṃ tārāṃ ca gurave devebhyo'pyabhayaṃ dadau \|\| 89 \|\|*

*āśiṣaṃ śambhudharmābhyāṃ dattvā lokaṃ yayau vidhiḥ \|*  
*devā yayuḥ svabhavanaṃ svagṛhaṃ ca bṛhaspatiḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

88-90. The child which was having the divine lustre was carried by Chandrama in his lap. He then bowed in reverence to Brahma and went back to his abode. Thereafter, Brahma entrusted Tara to Brihaspati and offering protection, the gods made them proceed to their respective abodes together with Shiva and Dharma. The gods too retired to their respective abodes together with Brihaspati.

## \|\| 61.91-94 \|\|

*bhāvānuraktavanitāṃ prāpya saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ \|*  
*tārakāgarbhasaṃbhūtaḥ sa eva ca budhaḥ svayam \|\| 91 \|\|*

*tejasvī sadgraho brahmaścandrasya tanayo mahān \|*  
*sa eva nandanavane citrāṃ saṃprāpya nirjane \|\| 92 \|\|*

*ghṛtācyā garbhasaṃbhūtāṃ kuberasya ca retasā \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā ca nirjane ramyāṃ kanyāṃ kamalalocanām \|\| 93 \|\|*

*atīva yauvanasthāṃ ca bālāṃ ṣoḍaśavārṣikīm \|*  
*gāndharveṇa vivāhena tāṃ jagrāha vidhoḥ sutaḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

91-94. The teacher Brihaspati was very much delighted in getting back Tara the lady of his life. Thus the child born from the womb of Tara was given the name Budha. О Brahmana, this son of Chandrama in due course of time became a powerful planet. The same Budha once spotted Chitra in the secluded forest who was born from the Apsara GhrtacI from the seed of Kubera. She had beautiful eyes like lotus flowers and was full of youth at the age of sixteen. Budha accepted her as his wife by means of the Gandharva marriage.

## \|\| 61.95 \|\|

*tasyāmathāyaṃ rahasi vīryyādhānaṃ cakāra saḥ \|*  
*babhūva rājā citrāyāṃ caitro vai maṇḍaleśvaraḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. He enjoyed her company in seclusion impregnating her. Because of this a king named Caitra was born out of Chitra.

## \|\| 61.96-101 \|\|

*saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ śāsti vai dhārmiko balī \|*  
*śataṃ nadyo ghṛtānāṃ ca dadhnāṃ nadyaḥ śatāni ca \|\| 96 \|\|*

*śatāni nadyo dugdhānāṃ madhunadyaśca ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*daśa nadyaśca tailānāṃ śarkarālakṣarāśayaḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

*miṣṭānnānāṃ svastikānāṃ lakṣarāśiśca nityaśaḥ \|*  
*pañcakoṭigavāṃ māṃsaṃ sāpūpaṃ svannameva ca \|\| 98 \|\|*

*eteṣāṃ ca nadīrāśīrbhuñjate brāhmaṇā mune \|*  
*gavāṃ lakṣaṃ ca ratnānāṃ maṇīnāṃ lakṣameva ca \|\| 99 \|\|*

*śatalakṣaṃ suvarṇānāṃ lakṣaṃ vai sūkṣmavāsasām \|*  
*ratnānāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ pātramatīva sumanoharam \|\| 100 \|\|*

*dadau dvijātaye rājā nityaṃ vai jīvitāvadhi \|*  
*tasya caitrasya putraśca rājā'dhiratha eva ca \|\| 101 \|\|*

96-101. The religious king mled over the land of seven islands. During his rule there were a hundred streams of ghee, a hundred steams of curd, a hundred streams of milk, sixteen streams of honey and ten streams of oil. In his kitchen sweets were made with sugar of a lakh of heaps, including sweet balls, five crores of meat preparations and other varieties of food, daily. О sage, the Brahmanas and others enjoy the treasures of these streams daily. Thus the king during his life time regularly gave away in charity a lakh of cows, a lakh of gems, a hundred lakhs of ornaments, a lakh of fine garments and gem-studded ornaments, to the Brahmanas. In due course of time, a son named Adhiratha was born to Caitra.

## \|\| 61.102-103 \|\|

*tasya putraśca surathaścakravarttī bṛhacchravāḥ \|*  
*mahājñānaṃ ca saṃprāpya medhaso munisattamāt \|\| 102 \|\|*

*bheje purā viṣṇumāyāṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate \|*  
*śaratkāle mahāpūjāṃ cakāra sa sarittaṭe \|\| 103 \|\|*

102-103. A son named Suratha was born to him who was a Cakravartl king, who received divine knowledge from Medhas, the best of the sages and adorned Vishnumaya in the sacred land of Bharata. The great intellectual performed a great puja in the winter Navaratras, on the bank of the river.

## \|\| 61.104-107 \|\|

*vaiśyena sārdhaṃ sa mahāñjñānināṃ munisattama \|*  
*rājā kaliṅgadeśasya virādhaśca viśāṃ varaḥ \|\| 104 \|\|*

*tasya putro mahāyogī drumiṇo jñānināṃ varaḥ \|*  
*drumiṇo vaiṣṇavaḥ prājñaḥ puṣkare duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ \|\| 105 \|\|*

*kṛtvā samādhiṃ saṃprāpa jñānināṃ vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ \|*  
*putrairdārairnirastaśca dhanalobhāddurātmabhiḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

*sa ca koṭisuvarṇaṃ ca nityaṃ dattvā jalaṃ papau \|*  
*muktiṃ saṃprāpa saṃsevya viṣṇumāyāṃ sanātanīm \|\| 107 \|\|*

104-107. О best of the sages Viradha, the king of the Kaliiiga country, happened to be the best of the kings. He had a son named Drumina who was a great yogi and intellectual. The great intellectual Vaishnava Drumina went to Puskara-ksetra and performed severe tapas there, as a result of which a son named Samadhi was born to him, who happened to be the best of the intellectuals and the Vaishnavas. His wicked son and the wife drove the king out of the house, who used to give away in charity a crore of gold coins daily before sipping the water. Thereafter, he was redeemed after adoring Vishnumaya.

## \|\| 61.108 \|\|

*rājā lebhe manutvaṃ ca rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ mune \|*  
*uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ dhātā trijagatāṃ patiḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. О sage, thus the king got back his kingdom and he ruled without interruption. In due course of time he became a Manu who was addressed as such by Brahma the creator of the universe.

## Chapter 62

## \|\| 62.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ rājā mahājñānaṃ saṃprāpa munisattamāt \|*  
*vaiśyo muktiṃ medhasaśca tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said – You kindly tell me how king Suratha achieved from the Medhas, the best of the sages, divine knowledge and ultimately achieved salvation.

## \|\| 62.2-3 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*dhruvasya pautro balavānnandirutkalanandanaḥ \|*  
*svāyambhuvamanorvaṃśyaḥ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*akṣauhiṇīnāṃ śatakaṃ gṛhītvā sainyameva ca \|*  
*kolāṃ ca veṣṭayāmāsa surathasya mahāmateḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Shri Narayana said – Nandi the grandson of Dhruva who happened to be the son of Utkala and belonged to the race of Svayambhuvamanu, was truthful and self disciplined. He together with his hundred Aksauhinl army surrounded the kingdom of Kola, ruled by Suratha.

## \|\| 62.4 \|\|

*yuddhaṃ babhūva niyataṃ pūrṇamabdaṃ ca nārada \|*  
*ciraṃjīvī vaiṣṇavaśca jigāya surathaṃ nṛpaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. О Narada, the war continued regularly for a year. Thereafter Nandi who enjoyed a long life and was a Vaishnavas, defeated Suratha.

## \|\| 62.5-6 \|\|

*ekākī suratho bhīto nandinā ca bahiṣkṛtaḥ \|*  
*niśāyāṃ hayamāruhya jagāma gahanaṃ vanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*dadarśa tatra vaiśyaṃ ca puṣpabhadrānadītaṭe \|*  
*tayorbabhūva saṃprītiḥ kṛtabāndhavayormune \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Suratha was alone and was driven out from the kingdom. He somehow escaped at the dead of night and mounted on a horse, went to a thick forest. In the forest he met a Vaisya on the bank of Puspabhadra river. О sage, soon they became intimate friends.

## \|\| 62.7-8 \|\|

*vaiśyena sārddhaṃ nṛpatiragacchanmedhasāśramam \|*  
*puṣkaraṃ duṣkaraṃ puṇyakṣetraṃ vai bhārate satām \|\| 7 \|\|*

*dadarśa tatra nṛpatirmuniṃ taṃ tīvratejasam \|*  
*śiṣyebhyaśca pravocantaṃ brahmatattvaṃ sudurlabham \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Thereafter, accompanied by Vaisya the king Suratha went to the hermitage of the sage Medhas which happened to be a sacred place and was known as the remover of the misfortune of noble people. The king found the sage having immense glory, teaching the divine tattvas to his disciples.

## \|\| 62.9-10 \|\|

*rājā nanāma vaiśyaśca śirasā munipuṅgavam \|*  
*munistau pūjayāmāsa dadau tābhyāṃ śubhāśiṣam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*praśnaṃ cakāra kuśalaṃ jātināma pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*dadau pratyuttaraṃ rājā krameṇa munipuṅgavam \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Both the king and the Vaishya bowed in reverence to the king. The sage in turn blessed them both welcoming them. Enquiring about their caste and named separately, the sage enquired of them about their welfare. The king then replied to the best of the sages.

## \|\| 62.11 \|\|

*suratha uvāca \|*  
*rājā'haṃ suratho brahmaṃścaitravaṃśasamudbhavaḥ \|*  
*bahirbhūtaḥ svarājyācca nandinā balinā'dhunā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Suratha said – О Brahmana, my name is Suratha and I am born in the Caitra race. Currently the powerful king Nandi has defeated me and separated me from my kingdom.

## \|\| 62.12 \|\|

*kimupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi kathaṃ rājyaṃ bhavenmama \|*  
*tanmāṃ brūhi mahābhāga tvāmeva śaraṇāgatam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. O virtuous one, what remedy should I apply, by which I could regain my lost kingdom? You kindly tell me. I have therefore come to take refuge with you.

## \|\| 62.13 \|\|

*ayaṃ vaiśyaḥ samādhiśca svagṛhācca bahiṣkṛtaḥ \|*  
*putraiḥ kalatrairdaivena dhanalobhena dhārmikaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. This is the Vaisya named Samadhi. By a turn of destiny, his son and the wife, over-powered by greed, have turned out this religious person from the house.

## \|\| 62.14-15 \|\|

*brāhmaṇāya dadau nityaṃ ratnakoṭiṃ dine dine \|*  
*niṣiddhyamānaḥ putraiśca kalatrairbāndhavairayam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kopānnirākṛtastaiśca punaranveṣitaḥ śucā \|*  
*ayaṃ gṛhaṃ ca na yayau virakto jñānavāñchuciḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. He used to give away a crore of gold coins in charity to the Brahmanas daily. The sons, wives and brothers objected to his performing charity. When he did not listen to them, they were enraged and ultimately they drove him out. When their anger subsided, they tried to find out his whereabouts. The noble hearted Vaisya developed detachment and he could not return his home.

## \|\| 62.16 \|\|

*putrāśca pitṛśokena gṛhaṃ tyaktvā yayurvanam \|*  
*dattvā dānāni viprebhyo viraktāḥ sarvakarmasu \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. On the other hand to the sons left their home with the separation of the father. In the forest getting relieved of all the karmas they distributed the entire riches to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 62.17 \|\|

*sudurlabhaṃ harerdāsyaṃ vaiśyasyāsya ca vāñchitam \|*  
*kathaṃ prāpnoti niṣkāmastanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Now only one desire is left with him to become the slave of the lord. He is the person with the only desire to know can how he achieve it; you kindly tell us.

## \|\| 62.18 \|\|

*śrīmedhā uvāca \|*  
*karoti māyayā cchannaṃ viṣṇumāyā duratyayā \|*  
*nirguṇasya ca kṛṣṇasya triguṇā viśvamājñayā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The sage Medhas said – The unconquerable Vishnumaya possessing three gums pervades the entire universe at the command of lord Krishna who is devoid of all the gunas.

## \|\| 62.19 \|\|

*kṛpāṃ karoti yeṣāṃ sā dharmiṇāṃ ca kṛpāmayī \|*  
*tebhyo dadāti kṛpayā kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ sudurlabhām \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. On whomsoever the merciful goddess showers her grace, he achieves the devotion of lord Krishna, which is difficult to get.

## \|\| 62.20 \|\|

*yeṣāṃ māyāvināṃ māyā na karoti kṛpāṃ nṛpa \|*  
*māyayā tānnibadhnāti mohajālena durgatān \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О king, the one on whom the goddess does not shower her grace, he is entangled with her illusion and has to face several types of miseries.

## \|\| 62.21 \|\|

*naśvare'nityasaṃsāre bhrāmayedbarbarā sadā \|*  
*kurvantī nityabuddhiṃ ca vihāya parameśvaram \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. In this perishable universe she roams about always and separating the people from the lord, she creates illusions.

## \|\| 62.22-26 \|\|

*devamanyaṃ niṣevante tanmantraṃ ca japaṃti ca \|*  
*mithyā kiñcinnimittaṃ ca kṛtvā manasi lobhataḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*saptajanmasu saṃsevya devatāśca hareḥ kalāḥ \|*  
*tadā prakṛtyā kṛpayā sevante prakṛtiṃ tadā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*saptajanmasu saṃsevya viṣṇumāyāṃ kṛpāmayīm \|*  
*śive bhaktiṃ labhante te jñānānande sanātane \|\| 24 \|\|*

*jñānādhiṣṭhātṛdevaṃ ca haressaṃsevya śaṅkaram \|*  
*acirādviṣṇubhaktiṃ ca prāpnuvanti maheśvarāt \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sevante saguṇaṃ sattvaṃ viṣṇuṃ viṣayiṇaṃ tadā \|*  
*sattvajñānācca paśyanti jñānaṃ vai nirmalaṃ narāḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

22-26. As a result of this, a person afflicted with grief, meditates upon false deities with false mantras. They ultimately become devotees of goddess Durga after adoring her for seven births. Thereafter, they serve for seven births the compassionate and eternal Vishnumaya, who is also called Durga and thereafter they achieve the devotion of lord Durga. Shiva who is eternal also bestows divine knowledge. Then‘after adoring lord Shiva, the great god of knowledge, they achieve the devotion of lord Vishnu. And after serving Vishnu they achieve the spotless divine knowledge.

## \|\| 62.27-28 \|\|

*niṣevya saguṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ sāttvikā vaiṣṇavā narāḥ \|*  
*labhante nirguṇe bhaktiṃ śrīkṛṣṇe prakṛteḥ pare \|\| 27 \|\|*

*gṛhṇanti santastadbhaktā mantraṃ tasya nirāmayam \|*  
*niṣevya nirguṇaṃ devaṃ te bhavanti ca nirguṇāḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Thus while serving Vishnu, the possessor of all the gunas, the Sdttvika-Vaishnavas achieve the devotion of lord Krishna who is beyond Prakriti. His devotees and the noble people recite his spotless mantra and by serving lord Krishna with the same, they are themselves deprived of all the gunas.

## \|\| 62.29-31 \|\|

*asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pātaṃ te ca paśyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ \|*

*kṛṣṇabhaktātkṛṣṇamantraṃ yo gṛhṇāti narottamaḥ \|*  
*puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca svapitṝṇāṃ samuddharet \|\| 30 \|\|*

*mātāmahānāṃ sāhasramuddharenmātaraṃ tathā \|*  
*dāsādikaṃ samuddhṛtya golokaṃ sa prayāti ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

29-31. Such of the Vaishnava people always adore lord Vishnu in Goloka and continue there in that position up to the life of innumerable Brahma. Such of the persons who are indeed the best, receive the mantra of lord Krishna, who redeems a thousand generations from his mother’s as well as father’s side besides the servants and ultimately proceeds to the Goloka.

## \|\| 62.32 \|\|

*bhavārṇave mahāghore karṇadhārasvarūpiṇī \|*

32\. The illusion of Maya becomes a sailor in the terrific ocean of the universe and makes the devotees to cross it mounted on the boat of the devotion of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 62.33 \|\|

*svakarmabandhanaṃ chettuṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca vaiṣṇavī \|*  
*tīkṣṇaśastrasvarūpā sā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The same Vaishnavl, the illusion of lord Krishna, cuts off all the bondages of the Vaishnavas with sharp weapons.

## \|\| 62.34 \|\|

*vivecikā cāvaraṇī śakteḥ śaktirdvidhā nṛpa \|*  
*pūrvaṃ dadāti bhaktāya cetarāya parātparā \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. О king, the shakti is divided into two parts viz. – Vivechika and Avaram. Initially she bestows on a devotee the Avarani-shakti.

## \|\| 62.35 \|\|

*satyasvarūpaḥ śrīkṛṣṇastasmātsarvaṃ ca naśvaram \|*  
*buddhirviveciketyevaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ sanātanī \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Lord Krishna happens to be the form of truth and all things which are separated from him are perishable. Similarly the Vivecika-sakti is also bestowed by the goddess to the Vaishnavas.

## \|\| 62.36 \|\|

*nityarūpā mameyaṃ śrīriti cāvaraṇī ca dhīḥ \|*  
*avaiṣṇavānāmasatāṃ karmmabhogabhujāmaho \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Such of the people who enjoy the rewards of their karmas are either opponents of Vaishnava or are wicked people and they are always engrossed in Avarani shakti which creates illusions for them. This is quite surprising.

## \|\| 62.37 \|\|

*ahaṃ pracetasaḥ putraḥ pautraśca brahmaṇo nṛpa \|*  
*bhajāmi kṛṣṇamātmānaṃ jñānaṃ saṃprāpya śaṅkarāt \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. О king, I am the son of Varuna and the grandson of Brahma; after achieving the divine knowledge from Shiva I always recite the name of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 62.38 \|\|

*gaccha rājannadītīraṃ bhaja durgāṃ sanātanīm \|*  
*buddhimāvaraṇīṃ tubhyaṃ devo dāsyati kāmine \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. О king, you also go to the bank of the river and adore Durga the eternal goddess. Since you have a desire in your mind, you will achieve the knowledge of Avarani.

## \|\| 62.39 \|\|

*niṣkāmāya ca vaiśyāya vaiṣṇavāya ca vaiṣṇavī \|*  
*buddhiṃ vivecikāṃ śuddhāṃ dāsyatyeva kṛpāmayī \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The merciful goddess Vaishnavi will bestow the Vivechika knowledge on Vaisya who intends to adore her without keeping any desire in his mind.

## \|\| 62.40 \|\|

*ityuktvā ca muniśreṣṭho dadau tābhyāṃ kṛpānidhiḥ \|*  
*pūjāvidhānaṃ durgāyāḥ stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ manum \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The merciful sage thus speaking explained to both of them the method of the adoration of goddess Durga, her stotra, kavacha and mantra.

## \|\| 62.41-42 \|\|

*vaiśyo muktiṃ ca saṃprāpa tāṃ niṣevya kṛpāmayīm \|*  
*rājā rājyaṃ manutvaṃ ca paramaiśvaryyamīpsitam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ durgopākhyānamuttamam \|*  
*sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Thereafter the Vaishya adored the merciful goddess Bhagavati and then achieved all his lost kingdom and glory and then achieved salvation. He ultimately became Manu. Thus I have narrated to you the story of goddess Durga who bestows welfare and grants salvation; what else do you want to listen to from me?

## Chapter 63

## \|\| 63.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*nārāyaṇa mahābhāga vada vedavidāṃ vara \|*  
*rājā kena prakāreṇa siṣeve prakṛtiṃ parām \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said – О Narayana, О virtuous one, О best of the possessor of knowledge of the Vedas, how did the king adore Durga?

## \|\| 63.2 \|\|

*samādhirnāma vaiśyo vā niṣkāmaṃ nirguṇaṃ vibhum \|*  
*bheje kena prakāreṇa prakṛterupadeśataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. How did the Vaisya named Samadhi adore Durga and at her advice the Nirguna-Brahmanal

## \|\| 63.3 \|\|

*kiṃ vā pūjāvidhānaṃ ca dhyānaṃ vā manureva ca \|*  
*kiṃ stotraṃ kavacaṃ kiṃ vā dadau rājñe mahāmuniḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. What are the details of the method of adoration, dhyanam, mantra, stotra and kavacha given by the sage to the king?

## \|\| 63.4 \|\|

*vaiśyāya prakṛtistasmai kiṃ vā jñānaṃ dadau param \|*  
*sākṣādbabhūva sahasā kena vā prakṛtistayoḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. And what type of divine knowledge was imparted by Durga to Vaisya and by which method she appeared before both of them?

## \|\| 63.5 \|\|

*jñānaṃ saṃprāpya vaiśyaśca kiṃ padaṃ prāpa durlabham \|*  
*gatirbabhūva rājñaśca kā vā tāṃ ca śṛṇomyaham \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. After achieving the divine knowledge what was the stage achieved by the Vaishya and the king separately? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 63.6-7 \|\|

*śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*rājā vaiśyaśca saṃprāpya mantraṃ vai medhaso muneḥ \|*  
*stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ devyā dhyānaṃ caiva puraskriyām \|*  
*jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ rājā vaiśyaśca puṣkare \|\| 6 \|\|*

*snātvā trikālaṃ varṣaṃ ca tataḥ śuddho babhūva saḥ \|*  
*sākṣādbabhūva tatraiva mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Shri Narayana said – The king and the Vaisya, after receiving the mantra, stotra, kavacha and dhyanam of the goddess from the Medhas Rsi, went to Puskara-ksetra and performed tapas there; they used to take a bath thrice a day and performed pUja and achieved success after a year.

## \|\| 63.8-12 \|\|

*rājñe dadau rājyavaraṃ manutvaṃ vāñchitaṃ sukham \|*  
*jñānaṃ nigūḍhaṃ vaiśyāya dadau cātisudurlabham \|\| 8 \|\|*

*yaddattaṃ śūline pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā \|*  
*nirāhāramatikliṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā vaiśyaṃ kṛpāmayī \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ruroda kṛtvā kroḍe tamaceṣṭaṃ śvāsavarjitam \|*  
*cetanāṃ kuru bho vatsetyuccāryya ca punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*cetanāṃ ca dadau tasmai svayaṃ caitanyarūpiṇī \|*  
*saṃprāpya cetanāṃ vaiśyo ruroda prakṛteḥ puraḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tamuvāca prasannā'sau kṛpayā'tikṛpāmayī \|\| 12 \|\|*

8-12. At that point of time Durga who happens to be the Mula-Prakriti appeared before them in person. The king got back his kingdom and also achieved the position of Manu besides all the worldly pleasures. The Vaisya, on the other hand, achieved the divine knowledge from the goddess which was earlier imparted to lord Krishna by Shiva. The merciful goddess lifted up Vaishya, who had become quite lean and thin, because of fasting and whose breathing had stopped making him senseless and said to him, "O son, you get up and regain consciousness." Thus speaking again and again, he started crying. Thereafter the goddess herself brought him back to life and the Vaisya regained consciousness. He then started crying before the goddess. The merciful goddess, becoming pleased with him, spoke to him affectionately.

## \|\| 63.13-14 \|\|

*śrīprakṛtiruvāca \|*  
*varaṃ vṛṇuṣva he vatsa yatte manasi varttate \|*  
*brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā tato vā'tisudurlabham \|\| 13 \|\|*

*indratvaṃ vā manutvaṃ vā sarvasiddhatvameva ca \|*  
*tucchaṃ tubhyaṃ na dāsyāmi naśvaraṃ bālavañcanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Prakriti said – О son, you ask for your desired boon. Whether you desire to achieve Brahmanahood or eternal life or anything else which is more difficult for you to get but you will not achieve the position of Indra, of Manu or any of the successful positions, which will be too small for you, which are quite perishable and are meant only for children alone.

## \|\| 63.15-16 \|\|

*vaiśya uvāca \|*  
*brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā mātarme nahi vāñchitam \|*  
*tato'tidurlabhaṃ kiṃ vā na jāne tadabhīpsitam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tvayyeva śaraṇāpanno dehi yadvāñchitaṃ tava \|*  
*anaśvaraṃ sarvasāraṃ varaṃ me dātumarhasi \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Vaishya said – О mother, I don’t aspire for Brahmanahood or etemalship and the position better than these is unknown to me. I have taken refuge with you, kindly grant me a boon which should result in my achieving the imperishable and the essence of all.

## \|\| 63.17 \|\|

*prakṛtiruvāca \|*  
*adeyaṃ nāsti me tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi mama vāñchitam \|*  
*yato yāsyasi golokaṃ padameva sudurlabham \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Prakriti said – There is nothing which cannot be granted to you. Therefore, 1 bestow upon you the position which is desired by me. By this you will obtain Goloka which is quite difficult to achieve.

## \|\| 63.18 \|\|

*sarvasāraṃ ca yajjñānaṃ surarṣīṇāṃ sudurlabham \|*  
*tadgṛhyatāṃ mahābhāga gaccha vatsa hareḥ padam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О son, I am bestowing upon you the essence of the divine knowledge which is quite difficult to achieve and by which you will reach the abode of the lord.

## \|\| 63.19-20 \|\|

*smaraṇaṃ vandanaṃ dhyānamarcanaṃ guṇakīrttanam \|*  
*śravaṇaṃ bhāvanaṃ sevā kṛṣṇe sarvanivedanam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*etadevaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ navadhā bhaktilakṣaṇam \|*  
*janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiyamatāḍanakhaṇḍanam \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. There are nine types of adoration prescribed for the Vaishnavas which include reciting the name of the lord, offering salutation, performing dhyanam, adoration, reciting of the glory, listening to his glory, deep thinking on him, serving him, to make all the prayers to him. This relieves one of the birth, death, old age, ailment and punishment from Yama.

## \|\| 63.21 \|\|

*āyurharati lokānāṃ ravireva hi santatam \|*  
*navadhā bhaktihīnānāmasatāṃ pāpināmapi \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The sun reduces the age of the person daily who are deprived of the nine types of adoration mentioned above and are wicked by nature.

## \|\| 63.22-28 \|\|

*bhaktāstadgatacittāśca vaiṣṇavāścirajīvinaḥ \|*  
*jīvanmuktāśca niṣpāpā janmādiparivarjitāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*śivaḥ śeṣaśca dharmaśca brahmā viṣṇurmahānvirāṭ \|*  
*sanatkumāraḥ kapilaḥ sanakaśca sanandanaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*voḍhuḥ pañcaśikho dakṣo nāradaśca sanātanaḥ \|*  
*bhṛgurmarīcirdurvāsāḥ kaśyapaḥ pulaho'ṅgirāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*medhāvī lomaśaḥ śukro vasiṣṭhaḥ kratureva ca \|*  
*bṛhaspatiḥ kardamaśca śaktiratriḥ parāśaraḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*mārkaṇḍeyo baliścaiva prahlādaśca gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*yamaḥ sūryyaśca varuṇo vāyuścandro hutāśanaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*akūpāra ulūkaśca nāḍījaṃghaśca vāyujaḥ \|*  
*naranārāyaṇau kūrmma indradyumno vibhīṣaṇaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*navadhā bhaktiyuktāśca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*ete mahānto dharmiṣṭhā bhaktānāṃ pravarāstathā \|\| 28 \|\|*

22-28. Such of the Vaishnavas devotees who are engrossed in the adoration of lord Vishnu, live longer and after getting free from the birth and death, are also relieved of all their sin. Shiva, Ses a, Dharma, Brahma, Vishnu, Mahavirat, Sanatkumara, Sanaka, Sananda, Vodhu, Sanatana, Bhrigu, Marlci, Lomasa, Sukra, Vasist ha, Brihaspati, Kardama, sakti, Atri, Parasara, Markandeya, Bali, Prahlada, Ganeshvara, Yama, Surya, Varuna, Vayu, Moon, Agni, Akupara, Ulflka, Nadljangha, Hanuman the son of the wind-god, Nara and Narayana, KQrma, Indradyumna and Vibhlsana were all the followers of Navadha-Bhakti by the grace of lord Krishna. They are all free from the birth and death and are devoted to the lord.

## \|\| 63.29 \|\|

*ye tadbhaktāste tadaṃśā jīvanmuktāśca santatam \|*  
*pāpāpahārāstīrthānāṃ pṛthivyāśca viśāṃ pate \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. О lord of all the riches, whosoever is devoted to the lord, they become his rays and because of that they are always free from the birth and can relieve all the sacred places of the earth of sins.

## \|\| 63.30 \|\|

*ūrdhvaṃ ca sapta svargāśca saptadvīpā vasundharā \|*  
*adhassapta ca pātālā etadbrahmāṇḍameva ca \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Of the seven lokas of the heaven, all the seven islands of the earth and the nether regions comprise of the globe.

## \|\| 63.31 \|\|

*evaṃvidhānāṃ viśvānāṃ saṃkhyā nāstyeva putraka \|*  
*evaṃ ca prativiśveṣu brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. О son, the number of globes is beyond counting and in each and every globe Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva besides other gods always remain.

## \|\| 63.32 \|\|

*devā devarṣayaścaiva manavo mānavādayaḥ \|*  
*sarvāśramāśca sarvatra santi baddhāśca māyayā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. All other gods, sages, Manu, humans and others are connected with the illusion of the lord.

## \|\| 63.33 \|\|

*mahāviṣṇorlomakūpe santi viśvāni yasya ca \|*

33\. All the globes are enshrined in the hair-pits of lord Maha-Vishnu. The same Mahavirat is the sixteenth ray of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 63.34-40 \|\|

*bhaja satyaṃ paraṃ brahma nityaṃ nirguṇamacyutam \|*  
*prakṛteḥ paramīśānaṃ kṛṣṇamātmānamīpsitam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*nirīhaṃ ca nirākāraṃ nirvikāraṃ nirañjanam \|*  
*niṣkāmaṃ nirvirodhaṃ ca nityānandaṃ sanātanam \|\| 35\|\|*

*svecchāmayaṃ sarvarūpaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham \|*  
*tejassvarūpaṃ paramaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām \|\| 36 \|\|*

*dhyānāsādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ śivādīnāṃ ca yoginām \|*  
*sarveśvaraṃ sarvapūjyaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvakāmadam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*sarvādhāraṃ ca sarvajñaṃ sarvānandakaraṃ param \|*  
*sarvadharmapradaṃ sarvaṃ sarvajñaṃ prāṇarūpiṇam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*sarvadharmasvarūpaṃ ca sarvakāraṇakāraṇam \|*  
*sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ pararūpaṃ ca bhaktidam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*dāsyadaṃ dharmadaṃ caiva sarvasiddhipradaṃ satām \|*  
*sarvaṃ tadatiriktaṃ ca naśvaraṃ kṛtrimaṃ sadā \|\| 40 \|\|*

34-40. Therefore one should always recite the name of lord Krishna who is the form of truth, eternal Brahmana, all-pervading, devoid of gunas, infallible, beyond Prakriti and Tsana. The lord who is invisible, formless, spotless without blemish, devoid of desires, without obstructions, blissful, eternal, moving according to his own will, the form of all, takes to human form for the sake of the devotees, glorious, bestower of all the riches, difficult to achieve even by Shiva and other yogis, difficult for adoration, lord of all, adored by all, the one who fulfils the wishes of all, the base of all, bestower of all the dharmas, the form of all, all knowledgeable, the fonn of Puranas, the form of all the dharmas, the cause of all the causes, who bestows pleasures and moksa and is the essence of all, bestows the best of devotion, bestower of slavehood of Krishna and dharma, the one who provides success to all the noble people and without him all other things have no base and are artificial.

## \|\| 63.41 \|\|

*parātparataraṃ śuddhaṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ śivam \|*  
*yathāsukhaṃ gaccha vatsa bhagavantamadhokṣajam \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. О son, you achieve lord Krishna blissfully which is beyond everything, is pure, complete and is the form of welfare.

## \|\| 63.42-44 \|\|

*kṛṣṇeti dvyakṣaraṃ mantraṃ gṛhītvā kṛṣṇadāsyadam \|*  
*puṣkaraṃ duṣkaraṃ gatvā daśalakṣamimaṃ japa \|\| 42 \|\|*

*daśalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirbhavettava \|*  
*ityuktvā sā bhagavatī tatraivāntaradhīyata \|\| 43 \|\|*

*vaiśyo natvā ca tāṃ bhaktyā cāgamatpuṣkaraṃ mune \|*  
*puṣkare duṣkaraṃ taptvā sa lebhe kṛṣṇamīśvaram \|*  
*bhagavatyāḥ prasādena kṛṣṇadāso babhūva saḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. The one who receiving the two letter mantra of Krishna which bestows slavehood of lord Krishna achieves success. You, therefore, go to the holy place of Puskara and recite this mantra ten lakhs of times. You will then achieve success. Thus speaking the goddess Bhagavati disappeared from the scene. О sage, thereafter the Vaisya, after offering salutation to the goddess, went to the Puskara-ksetra and performed tapas there vigorously. Thereafter he achieved lord Krishna and by the grace of the goddess he became the slave of lord Krishna.

## Chapter 64

## \|\| 64.1 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*rājā yena krameṇaiva bheje tāṃ prakṛtiṃ parām \|*  
*tacchrūyatāṃ mahābhāga vedoktaṃ kramameva ca \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narayana said – О virtuous one, I am going to narrate to you the way in which the king adored the goddess. The same routine rituals have been described in the Vedas.

## \|\| 64.2 \|\|

*snātvā''camya mahārājaḥ kṛtvā nyāsatrayaṃ tadā \|*

## \|\| 64.3 \|\|

*prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kṛtvā ca śaṅkhaśodhanam \|*  
*dhyātvā devīṃ ca mṛnmayyāṃ cakārāvāhanaṃ tadā \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Thereafter, he performed Pranayama and purifying his limbs, he performed dhyanam and by making the image of the goddess in clay invoked her.

## \|\| 64.4-5 \|\|

*punardhyātvā ca bhaktyā ca pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*+devyāśca dakṣiṇe bhāge saṃsthāpya kamalālayām \|\| 4 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya bhaktibhāvena bhaktyā paramadhārmikaḥ \|*  
*devaṣaṭkaṃ samāvāhya devyāśca purato ghaṭe \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Thereafter he adored her with devotion and consecrated Lakshmi towards her right side and adored her with great devotion. Thereafter the extremely religious king invoked six gods in the six pitchers filled with water.

## \|\| 64.6 \|\|

*bhaktyā ca pūjayāmāsa vidhipūrvaṃ ca nārada \|*  
*gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О Narada, the king then, with his mind filled with devotion, adored Ganesha, Surya, Agni, Vis nu, Shiva and Parvati.

*devaṣaṭkaṃ ca saṃpūjya namaskṛtya vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*

7\. After adoring the six gods, the intelligent king meditated upon Mahadevi reciting the same dkyanam.

## \|\| 64.8-12 \|\|

*dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ paraṃ kalpataruṃ mune \|*  
*dhyāyennityaṃ mahādevīṃ mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm \|\| 8 \|\|*

*brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ pūjyāṃ vandyāṃ sanātanīm \|*  
*nārāyaṇīṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ viṣṇubhaktidām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*sarvasvarūpāṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvādhārāṃ parātparām \|*  
*sarvavidyāsarvamantrasarvaśaktisvarūpiṇīm \|\| 10 \|\|*

*saguṇāṃ nirguṇāṃ sattvāṃ varāṃ svecchāmayīṃ satīm \|*  
*mahāviṣṇośca jananīṃ kṛṣṇasyārddhāṅgasambhavām \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇapriyāṃ kṛṣṇaśaktiṃ kṛṣṇabuddhyadhidevatām \|*  
*kṛṣṇastutāṃ kṛṣṇapūjyāṃ kṛṣṇavandyāṃ kṛpāmayīm \|\| 12 \|\|*

8-12. О sage, the said dhyanam has been described in the Samaveda and serves like the wish-fulfilling tree. It runs like this. I adore Mahadevi daily, who happens to be Mula-Prakriti, Isvarl, adorable by Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, eternal, NarayanI, Vishnumaya, Vaishnavl, the one who bestows the devotion of Vishnu, the form of all, the base of all, is beyond everything, combines all the knowledge, is the form of all the mantras and all the prowess, is formless and also with form, the form of truth, the best of all, moves according to her wishes, the chaste one, the mother of Maha-Vishnu, the one who emerged out of the body of lord Krishna, the beloved of Krishna, the prowess of lord Krishna, his intelligence, adored by lord Krishna who offered prayers to her and bowed before her. She is all merciful.

## \|\| 64.13-16 \|\|

*taptakāñcanavarṇābhāṃ koṭisūryyasamaprabhām \|*  
*īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ bhaktānugrahakārikām \|\| 13 \|\|*

*durgāṃ śatabhujāṃ devīṃ mahaddurgatināśinīm \|*  
*trilocanapriyāṃ sādhvīṃ triguṇāṃ ca trilocanām \|\| 14 \|\|*

*trilocanaprāṇarūpāṃ śuddhārddhacandraśekharām \|*  
*bibhratīṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyamaṇḍitam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*vartulaṃ vāmavaktraṃ ca śambhormānasamohinīm \|*  
*ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitām \|\| 16 \|\|*

13-16. She has the complexion of molten gold. She has the lustre of crores of suns, wears a serene smile on the face, is compassionate to the devotees, has hundred arms, relieves one of all the great miseries, beloved of three-eyed lord Shiva and the chaste one. She has three types of virtues, three eye and she is the beloved of lord Shiva. She is the better-half of lord Shiva who is also known as Chandrasekhara. She is adorned with the white jasmine flower on her beautifully arranged hair-do. She has a beautiful round face, is the attraction of lord Shiva and wears two ornamental kundalas besides having beautiful cheeks.

## \|\| 64.17-21 \|\|

*nāsādakṣiṇabhāgena bibhratīṃ gajamauktikam \|*  
*amūlyaratnaṃ bahulaṃ bibhratīṃ śravaṇopari \|\| 17 \|\|*

*muktāpaṃktivinindyaikadantapaṃktisuśobhitām \|*  
*pakvabimbādharoṣṭhīṃ ca suprasannāṃ sumaṃgalām \|\| 18 \|\|*

*citrapatrāvalīramyakapolayugalojjvalām \|*  
*ratnakeyūravalayaratnamañjīrarañjitām \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ratnakaṅkaṇabhūṣāḍhyāṃ ratnapāśaṃkaśobhitām \|*  
*ratnāṃgulīyanikaraiḥ karāṃgulicayojjvalām \|\| 20 \|\|*

*pādāṅgulinakhāsaktālaktarekhāsuśobhanām \|*  
*vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ gandhacandanacarcitām \|\| 21 \|\|*

17-21. She wears Gajamukta on the right side of the nose and is adorned with invaluable ornaments studded with gems. She has the line of teeth which shine like jewels. Her lips resemble the ripe wood-apples; she is delightful and provides welfare to all; her cheeks are decorated with beautiful paintings. She wears beautiful armlets and wristlets. She has anklets studded with gems, besides Cudamani and other ornaments. She also wears gem-studded rings on her fingers which shine in the hand and the nail-polish applied on the nails looks quite fine. She is clad in the garment which has the lustre of fire and sanctified with the sandal-paste.

## \|\| 64.22-23 \|\|

*bibhratīṃ stanayugmaṃ ca kastūrībinduśobhitam \|*  
*sarvarūpaguṇavatīṃ gajendramandagāminīm \|\| 22 \|\|*

*atīva kāntāṃ śāntāṃ ca nitāntāṃ yogasiddhiṣu \|*

22-23. She has a spot of kashlri placed on her breasts. She is all virtuous and moves slowly but gracefully like an elephant. She is quite attractive, peaceful and is always engaged in performing yogic practices. She is the strength of Brahma, the creator and is known as Parvati the base of all.

## \|\| 64.24-28 \|\|

*śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāmatīva sumanoharām \|*  
*kastūrībindubhiḥ sārddhamadhaścandanabindunā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sindūrabindunā śaśvadbhālamadhyasthalojjvalām \|*  
*śaranmadhyāhnakamalaprabhāmocanalocanām \|\| 25 \|\|*

*cārukajjalarekhābhyāṃ sarvataśca samujjvalām \|*  
*koṭikandarpalāvaṇyalīlāninditavigrahām \|\| 26 \|\|*

*ratnasiṃhāsanasthāṃ ca sadratnamukuṭojjvalām \|*  
*sṛṣṭau sraṣṭuḥ śilparūpāṃ dayāṃ pātuśca pālane \|\| 27 \|\|*

*saṃhārakāle saṃharttuḥ parāṃ saṃhārarūpiṇīm \|*  
*niśumbhaśumbhamathinīṃ mahiṣāsuramardinīm \|\| 28 \|\|*

24-28. She has the face like the full moon of winter season. She is quite pleasant. She has a spot of kastiirl on her forehead accompanied by a small spot of sandal-paste which looks quite prominent, she has beautiful eyes resembling the lotus flowers of the winter season. The collyrium decorates her eyes. She puts to shame the beauty of crores of gods of love and has a charming body. She is seated on the gem-studded lion-throne wearing a beautiful crown emitting lustre. She is the art of creation for Brahma, the compassionate one for Vishnu who preserves the universe and is the source of destruction for Shiva. She killed Nisumbha, Sumbha besides Mahis asura.

## \|\| 64.29 \|\|

*purā tripurayuddhe ca saṃstutā tripurāriṇā \|*  
*madhukaiṭabhayoryuddhe viṣṇuśaktisvarūpiṇīm \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. In the earlier times, during the battle with Tripura, she was associated with Shiva and at the time of the battle with Mtfdhukaitabha, she served as the strength of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 64.30-31 \|\|

*sarvadaityanihantrīṃ ca raktabījavināśinīm \|*

*varāhaśaktiṃ vārāhe hiraṇyākṣavadhe tathā \|*  
*parabrahmasvarūpāṃ ca sarvaśaktiṃ sadā bhaje \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. She is the one who destroys all the demons, the destroyer of Raktablja, Hiranyakas'ipu in the fonn of Narasimha, the killer of Hiranyaksa in the form of Varaha. I therefore adore the strength of great Varaha who represented the form of eternal Brahmana. I therefore adore Druga who is all powerful in the universe.

## \|\| 64.32 \|\|

*iti dhyātvā svaśirasi puṣpaṃ dattvā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*

32\. Thus meditating upon her, the intelligent person should place flowers on his head and with his mind filled with devotion he should again meditate upon the goddess invoking her.

33\. Where after holding the image of the goddess, one should recite the mantra and by reciting this mantra one should perform jlvanyasa.

## \|\| 64.34 \|\|

34\. О goddess, О mother, О eternal Prakriti, О goddess of the gods, you kindly accept our adoration after descending from the Shivaloka.

## \|\| 64.35-36 \|\|

35-36. You are adored by the world, О Maheshvari, you arrive here and take your seat. О mother, you stay on at this place during the performing of my pitjci. О infallible one, you should arrive here in person along with all of your saktis.

## \|\| 64.37 \|\|
