## \|\| 64.39-40 \|\|

*sa ihāgacchetyāvāhya parihāraṃ karoti ca \|*  
*mantreṇānena viprendra tacchṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*svāgataṃ bhagavatyamba śivalokācchivapriye \|*  
*prasādaṃ kuru māṃ bhadre bhadrakāli namo'stu te \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. О best of the Brahmanas, the goddess should be thus invoked and then the mantra which should be recited thereafter, is being told by me. You listen to me attentively. О Bhagavati, О mother, О beloved of Shiva, you arrive here from Shivaloka, I welcome you, О noble one, be merciful towards me. О Bhadrakali, I bow in reverence to you.

## \|\| 64.41-42 \|\|

*dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ mama \|*  
*āgatā'si yato durge māheśvari madālayam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*adya me saphalaṃ janma sārthakaṃ jīvanaṃ mama \|*  
*pūjayāmi yato durgāṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. О Durga, О Maheshvari, we have become graceful and indebted to you because my life has met with success because of your arrival in my house. My birth and life has met with success because I adore the goddess Durga in this merit-bestowing place of Bharata.

## \|\| 64.43 \|\|

*bhārate bhavatīṃ pūjyāṃ durgāṃ yaḥ pūjayed budhaḥ \|*  
*so'nte yāti ca golokaṃ paramaiśvaryyavāniha \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. In the sacred land of Bharata, such an intelligent one who adores the goddess Durga, achieving all the riches ultimately proceeds to Goloka.

## \|\| 64.44 \|\|

*kṛtvā ca vaiṣṇavīpūjāṃ viṣṇulokaṃ vrajetsudhīḥ \|*  
*māheśvarīṃ ca saṃpūjya śivalokaṃ ca gacchati \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. An intelligent person who adores Vaishnavi, achieves Vishnuloka and after Maheshvari, one achieves Shivaloka.

## \|\| 64.45 \|\|

*sāttvikī rājasī caiva tridhā pūjā ca tāmasī \|*  
*bhagavatyāśca vedoktā cottamā madhyamā 'dhamā \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. The adoration of Bhagavati according to the provisions of the Vedas with Sattvik, Rajas and Tamas intentions, bestows the highest, middle and the lower position respectively to the devotees.

## \|\| 64.46 \|\|

*sāttvikī vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca śāktādīnāṃ ca rājasī \|*  
*adīkṣitānāmasatāmanyeṣāṃ tāmasī smṛtā \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Out of them the Vaishnavas achieves the Sattvika position, the saktas achieve the Rajasl position and those devoid of dlksa achieve the lower position which is also called Tamasl.

## \|\| 64.47-49 \|\|

*jīvahatyā vihīnā yā varā pūjā tu vaiṣṇavī \|*  
*vaiṣṇavā yānti golokaṃ vaiṣṇavībalidānataḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*māheśvarī rājasī ca balidānasamanvitā \|*  
*śāktādayo rājasāśca kailāsaṃ yānti te tathā \|\| 48 \|\|*

*kirātāstridivaṃ yānti tāmasyā pūjayā tayā \|*  
*tvameva jagatāṃ mātaścaturvargaphalapradā \|\| 49 \|\|*

47-49. The adoration of Vaishnava is considered to be the best, because it does not invoke the killing of anyone. By offering the sacrifice Vaishnavas achieves the Goloka, by adoring Maheshvari with Rajasl intentions and by making the offering, they achieve the Rajasl-shakti and Kailasa. The Kiratas on the other hand, adoring the Tamasl goddess achieve heaven. You are the one who bestows, dharma, artha, kama and moksa and you are the illusion of the universe.

## \|\| 64.50 \|\|

*sarvaśaktisvarūpā ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharā tvaṃ ca parātparā \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. You are the sole energy of lord Krishna and are free from the birth, death, old age and ailments. You are the best of all, provide pleasure and salvation. You bestow welfare and the devotion of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 64.51 \|\|

*sukhadā mokṣadā bhadrā kṛṣṇabhaktipradā sadā \|*  
*nārāyaṇi mahāmāye durge durgatināśini \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. О Narayan!, О virtuous one, О Durga, О destroyer of the miseries, you be merciful. Thus with the reciting of the name of Durga all the difficulties of the people vanish.

## \|\| 64.52-54 \|\|

*durgeti smṛtimātreṇa yāti durgaṃ nṛṇāmiha \|*  
*iti kṛtvā parīhāraṃ devyā vāme ca sādhakaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tripadyā upariṣṭāttu śaṃkhaṃ saṃsthāpayettu saḥ \|*  
*tatra dattvā jalaṃ pūrṇaṃ dūrvāṃ puṣpaṃ ca candanam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*dhṛtvā dakṣiṇahastena mantramevaṃ paṭhennaraḥ \|*  
*puṇyastvaṃ śaṃkha puṇyānāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam \|*  
*prabhūtaḥ śaṃkhacūḍāttvaṃ purā kalpe pavitrakaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

52-54. Thereafter, thus adoring the goddess, the devotees would place the conch to the left of the goddess placing Diirva-grass, flowers and sandal-paste together with water. Then holding it in the right hand, he should recite the mantra saying, "O conch, you are full of merit and the bestower of welfare. О purifier, in the earlier kalpa you were created by Sarhkhacuda.

## \|\| 64.55 \|\|

*tato'rghyapātraṃ saṃsthāpya vidhinā'nena paṇḍitaḥ \|*  
*dattvā saṃpūjayeddevīmupacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Thereafter the priest should consecrate the vase in a similar manner and adore the goddess with sixteen types of offerings.

## \|\| 64.56 \|\|

*trikoṇamaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā sajalena kuśena ca \|*  
*kūrmaṃ śeṣaṃ dharitrīṃ ca pūjayettatra dhārmikaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Making a triangle of kusha-grass one should draw the figure of a tortoise, the serpent Shesha and the goddess earth, who should all be adored.

## \|\| 64.57-60 \|\|

*tripadīṃ sthāpayettatra tripadyāṃ śaṃkhameva ca \|*  
*śaṃkhe tribhāgatoyaṃ ca dattvā saṃpūjayettataḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati \|*  
*narmmade sindhukāveri candrabhāge ca kauśiki \|\| 58\|\|*

*svarṇarekhe kanakhale pāribhadre ca gaṇḍaki \|*  
*śvetagaṅge rudrarekhe pampe campe ca gomati \|\| 59 \|\|*

*padmāvati triparṇāśe vipāśe viraje prabhe \|*  
*śatahrade celagaṃge jale'sminsannidhiṃ kuru \|\| 60 \|\|*

57-60. Thereafter the conch should be placed over a three-legged pedestal. Three crores of the Samkha would be filled with water and the devotee should say. О Ganga, О Yamuna, О Godavari, О Sarasvati, О Narmada, О Sindhu, О Kaveri, О Chandrabhaga, О Kaushiki, О Svarnarekha, О Kanakhala, О Paribhadra, О Gandaki, О Shvetaganga, О Chandrarekha, О Champu, О Gomati, О Padmavati, О Triparnasi, О Vipasa, О Viraja, О Prabha, О Satahrida, О Celaganga, you come and reside in this water.

## \|\| 64.61-64 \|\|

*vahniṃ sūryyaṃ ca candraṃ ca viṣṇuṃ ca varuṇaṃ śivam \|*  
*pūjayettatra toye ca tulasyā candanena ca \|*  
*naivedyāni ca sarvāṇi prokṣayettajjalena ca \|\| 61 \|\|*

*pratyekaṃ vai tato dadyādupacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*āsanaṃ vasanaṃ pādyaṃ snānīyamanulepanam \|\| 62 \|\|*

*madhuparkaṃ gandhamarghyaṃ puṣpaṃ naivedyamīpsitam \|*  
*punarācamanīyaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇam \|\| 63 \|\|*

*iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde durgopākhyāne pūjāvidhibalipaśulakṣaṇaviśeṣo nāma catuṣṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

61-64. Thereafter, one should adore Agni, Surya, Chandrama, Vishnu, Varuna and Shiva by pouring Tulasi leaves in that water, offering naivedya at the same time. Thereafter, all gods should be given the sixteen types of offerings, including the seed, the cloth, water for sipping, the paste, madhuparka, fragrance, arghya, flower, naivedya, water for sipping, betel, gem-studded ornaments, essence, the lamp and the bed.

## \|\| 64.65 \|\|

*amūlyaratnasaṃklṛptaṃ nānācitra virājitam \|*  
*varaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ gṛhyatāṃ śaṅkarapriye \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. О beloved of Shiva, you accept this lion-throne which is studded with the best of gems and decorated with several paintings.

## \|\| 64.66 \|\|

*anantasūtraprabhavamīśvarecchāvinirmitam \|*  
*jvaladagniviśuddhaṃ ca vasanaṃ gṛhyatāṃ śive \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. О Parvati, you accept this cloth which is made of countless strings and by the grace of god, and which is sanctified by the fire.

## \|\| 64.67-68 \|\|

*amūlyaratnapātrasthaṃ nirmalaṃ jāhnavījalam \|*  
*pādaprakṣālanārthāya durge devi pragṛhyatām \|\| 67 \|\|*

*sugandhāmalakīsnigdhadravametatsudurlabham \|*  
*supakvaṃ viṣṇutailaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ parameśvari \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. О goddess Durga, you accept his vase of gems maintaining the spotless water for the washing of the feet. О Parameshvari, you accept the juice of fragrant mylobaran and the sanctified Vishnu-oil.

## \|\| 64.69 \|\|

*kastūrīkuṃkumāktaṃ ca sugandhi drutacandanam \|*  
*suvāsitaṃ jaganmātargṛhyatāmanulepanam \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. О mother of the universe, you accept this paste which is made of kasmrl, saffron and fragrant sandal-wood.

## \|\| 64.70 \|\|

*mādhvīkaṃ ratnapātrasthaṃ supavitraṃ sumaṅgalam \|*  
*madhuparkaṃ mahādevi gṛhyatāṃ prītipūrvakam \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. О Mahadevi, you accept this vase of gems filled with honey, which is sanctified and bestows welfare.

## \|\| 64.71 \|\|

*sugandhamūlacūrṇaṃ ca sugandhadravyasaṃyutam \|*  
*supavitraṃ maṅgalārhaṃ devi gandhaṃ gṛhāṇa me \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. О goddess, you accept this dhiipa which is made of the powder of the gum of the trees, the scented material and sanctified by fire.

## \|\| 64.72-73 \|\|

*pavitraṃ śaṃkhapātrasthaṃ dūrvāpuṣpākṣatānvitam \|*  
*svargamandākinītoyamarghyaṃ caṇḍi gṛhāṇa me \|\| 72 \|\|*

*sugandhi puṣpaśreṣṭhaṃ ca pārijātatarūdbhavam \|*  
*nānāpuṣpādimālyāni gṛhyantāṃ jagadambike \|\| 73 \|\|*

72-73. О goddess, you accept this fragrance which is the cause of all the fragrance and is scented with the best of the material.

## \|\| 64.74 \|\|

*divyaṃ siddhānnamāmānnaṃ piṣṭakaṃ pāyasādikam \|*  
*miṣṭānnaṃ laḍḍukaphalaṃ naivedyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ śive \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. О Chandi, you accept the arghya of the sacred water of the Ganga mixed with DUrva-grass, the flower and the rice kept in the conch. О mother of the universe, you kindly accept the garland made of the best of Parijata and other fragrant flowers.

## \|\| 64.75-76 \|\|

*suvāsitaṃ śītatoyaṃ karpūrādisusaṃskṛtam \|*  
*mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā gṛhyatāṃ śailakanyake \|\| 75 \|\|*

*guvākaparṇacūrṇaṃ ca karpūrādisuvāsitam \|*  
*sarvabhogakaraṃ ramyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ devi gṛhyatām \|\| 76 \|\|*

75-76. О Shiva, I offer you the divine food, unbaked cereals, the mixed stuff and pdyasam, besides the sweet balls for your eating which may kindly be accepted by you.

## \|\| 64.77 \|\|

*amūlyaratnasāraiśca khacitaṃ ceśvarecchayā \|*  
*sarvāṅgaśobhanakaraṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ devi gṛhyatām \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. О daughter of the mountain, I offer you the cool water sanctified with camphor, with devotion; you kindly accept it. О goddess, I offer you the charming betel containing the powder of betel-nut trees, camphor and other scented materials, you kindly accept it.

## \|\| 64.78 \|\|

*taruniryyāsacūrṇaṃ ca gandhavastusamanvitam \|*  
*hutāśamaśikhāśuddhaṃ dhūpaṃ devi ca gṛhyatām \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. О goddess, you kindly accept the ornaments which have been studded with the best of gems and are invaluable.

## \|\| 64.79-80 \|\|

*divyaratnaviśeṣaṃ ca sāndradhvāntanivārakam \|*  
*supavitraṃ pradīpaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ parameśvari \|\| 79 \|\|*

*ratnasāragaṇākīrṇaṃ divyaṃ paryyaṅkamuttamam \|*  
*sūkṣmavastraiśca saṃsyūtaṃ devi talpaṃ pragṛhyatām \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. О Parameshvari, I am offering you the lamp made of gems which removes darkness and is quite sacred. О goddess, you accept this excellent bed which is made of various types of gems and sewed by fine cloths.

## \|\| 64.81 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya tāṃ durgāṃ dadyātpuṣpāñjaliṃ mune \|*  
*tato'ṣṭanāyakā devīryatnataḥ paripūjayet \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. О sage, thus adoring the goddess Durga, one should offer the flowers to her. Thereafter, all the eight Nayikas should be adored carefully.

## \|\| 64.82-83 \|\|

*ugracaṇḍāṃ pracaṇḍāṃ ca caṇḍogrāṃ caṇḍanāyikām \|*  
*aticaṇḍāṃ ca caṇḍāṃ ca caṇḍāṃ caṇḍavatīṃ tathā \|\| 82 \|\|*

*padme cāṣṭadale caitāḥ prāgādikramatastathā \|*  
*pañcopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya bhairavānmadhyadeśataḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

82-83. These include Ugrachanda, Prachanda, Chandogra, Chandanayika, Atichanda, Camunda, Chanda and Chandavati. Thereafter, one should adore with an eight petalled lotus in the eastern and other directions, making five types of offerings including a Bhairavas.

## \|\| 64.84-88 \|\|

*ādau mahābhairavaṃ ca tathā saṃhārabhairavam \|*  
*asitāṃgabhairavaṃ ca rurubhairavameva ca \|\| 84 \|\|*

*kālabhairavamapyevaṃ krodhabhairavameva ca \|*  
*tāmracūḍaṃ candracūḍamante vai bhairavadvayam \|\| 85 \|\|*

*etānsaṃpūjya madhye vai nava śaktīṃśca pūjayet \|*  
*tatra padme cāṣṭadale madhye vai bhaktipūrvakam \|\| 86 \|\|*

*brahmāṇīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ caiva raudrīṃ māheśvarīṃ tathā \|*  
*nārasiṃhī ca vārāhīmindrāṇīṃ kārttikīṃ tathā \|\| 87 \|\|*

*sarvaśaktisvarūpāṃ ca pradhānāṃ sarvamaṅgalām \|*  
*nava śaktīśca saṃpūjya ghaṭe devāṃśca pūjayet \|\| 88 \|\|*

84-88. First of all Mahabhairava, Samharabhairava, the black-bhairava, Rurubhairava, Kalabhairava, Krodhabhairava, Tamracudabhairava and Chandarciidabhairava should be adored together with the nine s a let is to the centre point with the eight petalled lotus. They include Brahmani, Vaisnvavls, Raudri, Maheshvari, Narsimhl, Varahl, IndranI and Kartiki and all powerful Sarvamangala. All the nine saktis should be adored and thereafter the gods should be adored who are invoked in the vases.

## \|\| 64.89-90 \|\|

*śaṅkaraṃ kārttikeyaṃ ca sūryyaṃ somaṃ hutāśanam \|*  
*vāyuṃ ca varuṇaṃ caiva devyāśceṭīṃ baṭuṃ tathā \|\| 89 \|\|*

*catuṣṣaṣṭiṃ yoginīnāṃ saṃpūjya vidhipūrvakam \|*  
*yathāśakti baliṃ dattvā karoti stavanaṃ budhaḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

89-90. The gods include Shiva, Karttikeya, Surya, Chandrama, Agni, Vayu, Varuna, the attendant of the goddess, Batuka and the sixty four Yoginls. They should all be adored making offerings to them and prayers.

## \|\| 64.91 \|\|

*kavacaṃ ca gale baddhvā paṭhitvā bhaktipūrvakam \|*  
*tataḥ kṛtvā parīhāraṃ namaskuryyādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. The kavacha should be tied around the neck and one should recite the mantra regularly with devotion bowing before same.

## \|\| 64.92-96 \|\|

*balidānavidhānaṃ ca śrūyatāṃ munisattama \|*  
*māyārtiṃ mahiṣaṃ chāgaṃ dadyānmeṣādikaṃ śubham \|\| 92 \|\|*

*sahasravarṣaṃ suprītā durgā māyātidānataḥ \|*  
*mahiṣācchatavarṣaṃ ca daśavarṣaṃ ca chāgalāt \|\| 93 \|\|*

*varṣaṃ meṣeṇa kūṣmāṇḍaiḥ pakṣibhirhariṇaistathā \|*  
*daśavarṣaṃ kṛṣṇasāraiḥ sahasrābdaṃ ca gaṇḍakaiḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

*kṛtrimaiḥ piṣṭakalitaiḥ ṣaṇmāsaṃ paśubhistathā \|*  
*māsaṃ supakvādiphalairakṣatairiti nārada \|\| 95 \|\|*

*yuvakaṃ vyādhihīnaṃ ca saśṛṃgaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam \|*  
*viśuddhamavikārāṃgaṃ suvarṇaṃ puṣṭameva ca \|\| 96 \|\|*

92-96. Thereafter, I now recite the method of sacrifice; you please listen to it. Maydti, a buffalo, a goat and a sheep should be offered as sacrificed because by giving away Maydti, one enjoys the heaven for a thousand years; by offering a buffalo, one enjoys, the heaven for a hundred years; by offering a goat one achieves the heaven for ten years and by offering a sheep one enjoys the heaven for one year. By offering a bird and a deer one enjoys the heaven for one year. By offering a black-buck one enjoys heaven for ten years; by offering a rhinoceros for one thousand years. By offering artificial animals made of flour for six months, by offering beautiful ripe fruits, the goddess Durga is pleased for one month. О Narada, only such an animal should be selected for sacrifice which is quite healthy, without ailment, young, having horns, possessing good symbols, without blemish and with perfect limbs, having beautiful complexion and well built.

## \|\| 64.97-98 \|\|

*śiśunā balinā dāturhanti putraṃ ca caṇḍikā \|*  
*vṛddhena vai gurujanaṃ kṛśenāpīṣṭabāndhavān \|\| 97 \|\|*

*dhanaṃ caivādhikāṃgena hīnāṃgena prajāstathā \|*  
*kāminīṃ śṛṃgabhaṃgena kāṇena bhrātaraṃ tathā \|\| 98 \|\|*

97-98. With the offering of a young one Chandika destroys the son of the worshipper. Similarly the animal belonging to old person or a teacher or the weak relatives or the one having additional limbs, the one having short limbs, the one having only one eye when offered in sacrifice destroys the brothers of the worshipper.

## \|\| 64.99 \|\|

*ghuṭikena bhavenmṛtyurvighnaṃ syāccitramastakaiḥ \|*  
*hanti mitraṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhairbhraṣṭaśrīḥ pucchahīnataḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. If the ankle of the animal selected for sacrifice is broken the worshipper dies. In case the head of the animal is painted it creates obstruction, the one having the back of the complexion of the copper results in the destruction of the friend and the one having a severed tail results in the destruction of the glory.

## \|\| 64.100 \|\|

*māyātīnāṃ svarūpaṃ ca śrūyatāṃ munisattama \|*  
*vakṣyāmyatharvavedoktaṃ phalahānirvyatikrame \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. О best of the sages, now I am narrating to you the form of Maydti described in the Atharvaveda and you please listen to it. Any change in the same results in the obstruction of the merit accruing thereof.

## \|\| 64.101-102 \|\|

*pitṛmātṛvihīnaṃ ca yuvakaṃ vyādhivarjitam \|*  
*vivāhitaṃ dīkṣitaṃ ca paradāravihīnakam \|\| 101 \|\|*

*ajārajaṃ viśuddhaṃ ca sacchūdraparipoṣitam \|*  
*tadbandhubhyo dhanaṃ dattvā krītamūlyātirekataḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

101-102. The one who has no parents, is quite healthy, married, intellectual, without any attachment with an other woman, having no legitimate progeny, pure and brought up by noble people should be selected for sanctified offering. Enough of compensation should be paid to his relatives.

## \|\| 64.103-104 \|\|

*snāpayitvā ca taṃ karttā pūjayedvastracandanaiḥ \|*  
*mālyairdhūpaiśca sindūrairdadhigorocanādibhiḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

*taṃ ca varṣaṃ bhrāmayitvā bhṛtyadvāreṇa yatnataḥ \|*  
*varṣānte ca samutsṛjya durgāyai taṃ nivedayet \|\| 104 \|\|*

103-104. After bathing him, the worshipper should apply the sandal-paste and giving the costumes, garlands, essence, vermilion, curd gorocana etc. adoring him. He should then be taken on a pilgrimage for a year and thereafter he should be sacrificed before the goddess.

## \|\| 64.105-106 \|\|

*aṣṭamīnavamīsandhau dadyānmāyātimeva ca \|*  
*ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ balidānaṃ prasaṅgataḥ \|\| 105 \|\|*

*baliṃ stutvā ca dattvā ca dhṛtvā ca kavacaṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām \|\| 106 \|\|*

105-106. Mayatl should be sacrificed on the eight and ninth day of the moon, thus I have narrated to you in detail all about the sacrifices. After the sacrifice one should adore the kavacha prostrating before her and offering daksina to the Brahmanas at the same time.

## Chapter 65

## \|\| 65.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*śrutaṃ sarvaṃ mahābhāga sudhārasaparaṃ varam \|*  
*stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ pūjāphalaṃ kālaṃ vada prabho \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said – О virtuous one, О lord I have listened to the best of the stotra, kavacha and everything else, which is sweeter than nectar. Now I would like to know the result of performing pfijd and the time-frame in which one achieves the result.

## \|\| 65.2 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ārdrāyāṃ bodhayeddevīṃ mūlenaiva praveśayet \|*  
*uttareṇārccayitvā tāṃ śravaṇāyāṃ visarjayet \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Narayana said – One should perform the Jagarana (whole night awakening) during the Ardra constellation. In the Uttara constellation, one should perform worship and in the Sravana constellation, the performance should end.

## \|\| 65.3 \|\|

*ārdrāyuktanavamyāṃ tu kṛtvā devyāśca bodhanam \|*  
*pūjāyāḥ śatavārṣikyāḥ phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. In case one perfonned the adoration of the goddess in the ninth day of the moon in Ardra constellation, one achieves the reward for the worship of the goddess for a hundred years.

## \|\| 65.4-5 \|\|

*mūlāyāṃ tu praveśe ca naramedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kṛtvā visarjanaṃ devyāḥ śravaṇāyāṃ ca mānavaḥ \|*  
*lakṣmīṃ ca putrapautrāṃśca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. By worshipping the goddess in Mula constellation, one achieves the reward of Naramedha sacrifice; by performing рщй in the Uttara constellation one achieves the merit of: sacrifice; in the Sravana constellation by sending off the goddess, one achieves riches, sons and grandsons. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 65.6-7 \|\|

*bhuvaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ puṇyaṃ pūjāyāṃ labhate naraḥ \|*  
*nakṣatrayogābhāve tu pārvatyāścaiva nārada \|\| 6 \|\|*

*navamyāṃ bodhanaṃ kṛtvā pakṣaṃ saṃpūjya mānavaḥ \|*  
*aśvamedhaphalāvāptyai daśamyāṃ ca visarjayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. By worshipping her, one gets the merit of going down the entire globe. О Narada, in case the relevant constellation is not immediately available, one should adore goddess Parvati on the ninth day and continue the adoration for a fortnight, ending it in the tenth moon day. In such a case one achieves the merit of performing Asvamedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 65.8-9 \|\|

*saptamyāṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā baliṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*aṣṭamyāṃ pūjanaṃ śastaṃ balidānavivarjitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*aṣṭamyāṃ balidānena vipattirjāyate nṛṇām \|*  
*dadyādvicakṣaṇo bhaktyā navamyāṃ vidhivadbalim \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. The intellectuals should offer sacrifice on the seventh day of the moon, performing puja of the goddess because on the eighth day of the moon, the performing of the single puja has been prescribed and not the sacrifice. If one offers sacrifice on the eighth day of the moon, he invites misfortunes; therefore the intellectuals should offer sacrifice with devotion on the ninth day of the moon.

## \|\| 65.10 \|\|

*balidānena viprendra durgāprītirbhavennṛṇām \|*  
*hiṃsājanyaṃ na pāpaṃ ca labhate yajñakarmaṇi \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О best of the Brahmanas, the goddess Durga is pleased with the offering of the sacrifice and by offering yajna a person does not attract the sin of killing an animal.

## \|\| 65.11-12 \|\|

*utsargakarttā dātā ca cchettā poṣṭā ca rakṣakaḥ \|*  
*agre paścānnibaddhā ca saptaite'vadhakāriṇaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*yo yaṃ hanti sa taṃ hanti neti vedoktameva ca \|*  
*kurvanti vaiṣṇavīṃ pūjāṃ vaiṣṇavāstena hetunā \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. The one who gives away the animals for sacrifice, its donor, the killer, the one who feeds the animal, its protector, the one who maintains it, all these do not attract the sin of killing in sacrifice. The one who kills the animals is called the killer of the same. This has been prescribed in the Vedas which is not applicable in this case; therefore the Vaishnavas adore the goddess Vais navi alone.

## \|\| 65.13 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya surathaḥ pūrṇaṃ varṣaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*kavacaṃ ca gale baddhvā tuṣṭāva parameśvarīm \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Thus the king Suratha adored the goddess for lull one year holding the kavacha in his neck and started adoring the great goddess.

## \|\| 65.14 \|\|

*stotreṇa parituṣṭā sā tasya sākṣādbabhūva ha \|*  
*sa dadarśa puro devīṃ grīṣmasūryyasamaprabhām \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Thereafter getting pleased with the recitation of the stotra by the king, the goddess was pleased and she appeared before him in person. The king saw the goddess before him shining like the sun of the summer season emitting rays.

## \|\| 65.15-16 \|\|

*tejasvarūpāṃ paramāṃ saguṇāṃ nirguṇāṃ varām \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā tāṃ kamanīyāṃ ca tejomaṇḍalamadhyataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*svecchāmayīṃ kṛpārūpāṃ bhaktānugrahakāriṇīm \|*  
*punastuṣṭāva rājendro bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. In the disk of the tejas, she appeared in the form of the lustre, having all the virtues, nirguna, the best, charming, the one who moved at will, merciful and the one who showered her compassion over her devotees. The king adored her bowing in reverence.

## \|\| 65.17 \|\|

*stavena parituṣṭā sā sasmitā bhaktipūrvakam \|*  
*uvāca satyaṃ rājendraṃ kṛpayā jagadambikā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Getting immensely pleased with his prayer the goddess smiling gracefully looked at the king and lovingly spoke to him.

## \|\| 65.18 \|\|

*prakṛtiruvāca \|*  
*sākṣātsaṃprāpya māṃ rājanvṛṇoṣi vibhavaṃ varam \|*  
*dadāmi tubhyaṃ vibhavaṃ sāmprataṃ vāñchitaṃ tava \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Durga said – О king, if you ask for an audience with me if you are desirous of riches, the same will be granted by me at once.

## \|\| 65.19 \|\|

*nirjitya sarvāñchatrūṃśca labdhvā rājyamakaṇṭakam \|*  
*bhaviṣyasi mahārāja sāvarṇirmanuraṣṭamaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. О graceful one, you will overcome all your enemies and be victorious over them ruling the country without any interruption. Thereafter you will become the eighth Savarni Manu,

## \|\| 65.20 \|\|

*dāsyāmi tubhyaṃ jñānaṃ ca pariṇāme narādhipa \|*  
*bhaktiṃ dāsyaṃ ca parame śrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О best of the humans, I impart the divine knowledge to you as a result of which you will become the slave of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 65.21 \|\|

*vṛṇoti vibhavaṃ yo hi sākṣānmāṃ prāpya mandadhīḥ \|*  
*māyayā vañcitaḥ so'pi viṣamattyamṛtaṃ tyajet \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Because such a foolish fellow who having an audience with me, aspires for the riches, he acts under the influence of illusion and getting deprived of the nectar he seems like consuming poison.

## \|\| 65.22 \|\|

*brahmādistambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ naśvarameva ca \|*  
*nityaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brahma kṛṣṇaṃ nirguṇameva ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. All the things starting from Brahma to the straw are perishable. Lord Krishna alone is everlasting, truthful, eternal Brahmana and Nirguna.

## \|\| 65.23 \|\|

*brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāmahamādyā parātparā \|*  
*saguṇā nirguṇā cāpi varā svecchāmayī sadā \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Thus I happen to be the energy of Brahma, Vis nu, Shiva and other gods and am everlasting, beyond measure, both visible and invisible and the best, always moving at will.

## \|\| 65.24 \|\|

*nityā 'nityā sarvarūpā sarvakāraṇakāraṇam \|*  
*bījarūpā ca sarveṣāṃ mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. I happen to be Isvarl, Mula-Prakriti, everlasting, the form of all and the cause of all the causes and the seed of everyone.

## \|\| 65.25 \|\|

*puṇye vṛndāvane ramye goloke rāsamaṇḍale \|*  
*rādhā prāṇādhikā'haṃ ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The land with seven islands surrounded by seven oceans is called the earth, the Patala and other seven regions are located under the earth and those above the earth are the seven lokas named as the heaven and others. Similarly various types of globes were created by Brahma and in each such globe, the gods like Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva reside.

## \|\| 65.26-27 \|\|

*ahaṃ durgā viṣṇumāyā buddhyadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā \|*  
*ahaṃ lakṣmīśca vaikuṇṭhe svayaṃ devī sarasvatī \|\| 26 \|\|*

*sāvitrī vedamātā'haṃ brahmāṇī brahmalokataḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ gaṅgā ca tulasī sarvādhārā vasundharā \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. In the sacred forest of Vrindavana, in the Goloka, Rasamandala, I perform as Radhika, the beloved of lord Krishna.

## \|\| 65.28-30 \|\|

*nānāvidhā'haṃ kalayā māyayā sarvayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*sā'haṃ kṛṣṇena saṃsṛṣṭā nṛpa bhrūbhaṃgalīlayā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*bhrūbhaṃgalīlayā sṛṣṭo yena puṃsā mahānvirāṭ \|*  
*lomnāṃ kūpeṣu viśvāni yasya santi hi nityaśaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*asaṃkhyāni ca tānyeva kṛtrimāṇi ca māyayā \|*  
*anitye nityabuddhiṃ ca sarve kurvanti santatam \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. I am Durga, Vishnumaya, the best intelligence of the gods, Lakshmi of Vaikuntha, the great goddess, Sarasvati and Savitri the mother of Vedas, Brahman! of Brahmaloka, Ganga, Tulasi and the goddess earth.

## \|\| 65.31-32 \|\|

*saptasāgarasaṃyuktā saptadvīpā vasundharā \|*  
*tadadhaḥ sapta pātālāḥ svarlokāścaiva sapta ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

*evaṃ viśvaṃ bahuvidhaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam \|*  
*pratyekaṃ sarvavidhyaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. I appear on earth in various forms of the woman. О king, lord Krishna has created me from the moving of his eyebrows, because the one who created Mahavirat with the moving of his eye-brows, in the hair-pits of the same Krishna all the globes reside. They are all artificial and innumerable, the same eternal lord is adored by everyone always.

## \|\| 65.33-34 \|\|

*sarveṣāmīśvaraḥ kṛṣṇa iti jñānaṃ parātparam \|*  
*vedānāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ tapasāṃ tathā \|\| 33 \|\|*

*devānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ sāraḥ kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ \|*  
*tadbhaktihīno yo mūḍhaḥ sa ca jīvanmṛto dhuvam \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. But Krishna happens to be lord of all. He is the best and full of all knowledge. Lord Krishna is considered to be the essence of the Vedas, vratas, holy places, tapas, gods and virtues. Therefore the one who is deprived of this adoration, his life is of no consequence.

## \|\| 65.35 \|\|

*pavitrāṇi ca tīrthāni tadbhaktasparśavāyunā \|*  
*tanmantropāsakaścaiva jīvanmukta iti smṛtaḥ \|\| 35\|\|*

35\. With the touch of devotees of lord Krishna even the holy places get sanctified and the one who recites his mantra overcomes death.

## \|\| 65.36 \|\|

*mantragrahaṇamātreṇa naro nārāyaṇo bhavet \|*  
*vinā japena tapasā vinā tīrthena pūjayā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Because with the acceptance of his mantra alone one becomes Narayana himself without performing japam, tapas and visiting holy places.

## \|\| 65.37 \|\|

*mātāmahānāṃ śatakaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca sahasrakam \|*  
*puṃsāmevaṃ samuddhṛtya golokaṃ ca sa gacchati \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. He redeems a hundred generations of his maternal grand-father’s side and a thousand generations of his father. Thereafter he proceeds to Goloka.

## \|\| 65.38-39 \|\|

*idaṃ jñānaṃ sārabhūtaṃ kathitaṃ te narādhipa \|*  
*manvantarānte bhogānte bhaktiṃ dāsyāmi te harau \|\| 38 \|\|*

*nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karmma kalpakoṭiśatairapi \|*  
*avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karmma śubhāśubham \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. О best of the humans, this is the knowledge which is the essence of all and I have told you the same. After the expiry of a manvantara you will achieve the adoration of the lord, because after the expiry of crores of kalpas, the karmas do not vanish unless one faces the results of the good or bad deeds performed by him.

## \|\| 65.40 \|\|

*ahaṃ yamanugṛhṇāmi tasmai dāsyāmi nirmalām \|*  
*niścalāṃ sudṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ śrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. On whomsoever I shower my grace he achieves the spotless and infallible devotion of lord Krishna, the others get all the riches which disappear like a morning dream.

## \|\| 65.41-43 \|\|

*karomi vañcanāṃ yaṃ yaṃ tebhyo dāsyāmi sampadam \|*  
*prātaḥ svapnasvarūpāṃ ca mithyeti bhramarūpiṇīm \|\| 41 \|\|*

*iti te kathitaṃ jñānaṃ gaccha vatsa yathāsukham \|*  
*ityuktvā ca mahādevī tatraivāntaradhīyata \|\| 42 \|\|*

*rājā saṃprāpya rājyaṃ ca natvā tāṃ prayayau gṛham \|*  
*iti te kathitaṃ vatsa durgopākhyānamuttamam \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. O son, thus I have imparted the knowledge to you and now you can go anywhere you like. Thus speaking the goddess disappeared from the scene. The king also got back his kingdom and bowing in reverence to the goddess, reached his abode. О son, thus I have narrated to you the best of the story of goddess Durga.

## Chapter 66

## \|\| 66.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*śrutaṃ sarvaṃ nāvaśiṣṭaṃ kiñcideva hi niścitam \|*  
*prakṛteḥ kavacaṃ stotraṃ brūhi me munisattama \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said – О best of the sages, I have listened to everything and nothing remains. Now you kindly enlighten me on the kavacha and the stotra of the goddess.

## \|\| 66.2-6 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*purā stutā sā goloke kṛṣṇena paramātmanā \|*  
*saṃpūjya madhumāse ca saṃprīte rāsamaṇḍale \|\| 2 \|\|*

*madhukaiṭabhayoryuddhe dvitīye viṣṇunā purā \|*  
*tatraiva kāle sā durgā brahmaṇā prāṇasaṅkaṭe \|\| 3 \|\|*

*caturthe saṃstutā devī bhaktyā ca tripurāriṇā \|*  
*purā tripurayuddhe ca mahāghoratare mune \|\| 4 \|\|*

*pañcame saṃstutā devī vṛtrāsuravadhe tathā \|*  
*śakreṇa sarvadevaiśca ghore ca prāṇasaṅkaṭe \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tadā munīndrairmanubhirmānavaiḥ surathādibhiḥ \|*  
*saṃstutā pūjitā sā ca kalpe kalpe parātparā \|\| 6 \|\|*

2-6. Narayana said – In the earlier times, in the Goloka, Krishna had adored Prakriti and in the month of Caitra he adored the goddess in Rasamandala with great devotion. In the battle of Madhukaitabha, Vishnu adored the goddess Durga when the life of Brahma was in danger. Thereafter, О sage, in the earlier times, in the battle with the terrific demon Tripurasura, lord Shiva adored Durga. On the fifth time before the battle with Vrtrasura, Indra adored the goddess when he was facing a great danger, at that point of time all the sages, Manus, king Suratha and the humans adored the goddess. Thus in all the kalpas, the great goddess was adored by the gods.

## \|\| 66.7 \|\|

*stotraṃ ca śrūyatāṃ brahmansarvavighnavināśakam \|*  
*sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ bhavasantārakāraṇam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О Brahmana, now I am going to recite to you the stotra which results in the destruction of all the obstruction and provides pleasure and welfare and serve as a means to cross the ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 66.8 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*tvameva sarvajananī mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī \|*  
*tvamevādyā sṛṣṭividhau svecchayā triguṇātmikā \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Shri Krishna said – You are then mother of all, Mula-Prakriti and Ishvari, you are the eternal goddess in the universe and you take to any form at will.

## \|\| 66.9-11 \|\|

*kāryyārthe saguṇā tvaṃ ca vastuto nirguṇā svayam \|*  
*parabrahmasvarūpā tvaṃ satyā nityā sanātanī \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tejassvarūpā paramā bhaktānugravigrahā \|*  
*sarvasvarūpā sarveśā sarvādhārā parātparā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sarvabījasvarūpā ca sarvapūjyā nirāśrayā \|*  
*sarvajñā sarvatobhadrā sarvamaṃgalamaṃgalaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. Though you are invisible, still you appear in various forms at times. You are the fonn of eternal Brahmana, truthful, everlasting and eternal. You are the form of the lustre, the base of all. You are the one who takes to a definite fonn for the sake of your devotees,-you are the form of all and the great goddess of all. You are the base of all, all powerful, the seed of all, adorable by all, without any support, possessing all knowledge, provide prosperity to all and are welfare of all the welfares.

## \|\| 66.12 \|\|

*sarvabuddhisvarūpā ca sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī \|*  
*sarvajñānapradā devī sarvajñā sarvabhāvinī \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. You are Svaha in the charity of the gods, Svadha in the charity of the manes and daksina in the charities of all and are the strength of all.

## \|\| 66.13 \|\|

*tvaṃ svāhā devadāne ca pitṛdāne svadhā svayam \|*  
*dakṣiṇā sarvadāne ca sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. You represent sleep, mercy, greed, love, satisfaction of hunger, peace, Isa, glory and are always peaceful. You are faith, development, drowsiness, shyness, glory and the wealth of the noble people besides being the misery for the wicked people.

## \|\| 66.14-15 \|\|

*nidrā tvaṃ ca dayā tvaṃ ca tṛṣṇā tvaṃ cātmanaḥ priyā \|*  
*kṣutkṣāntiḥ śāntirīśā ca śāntiḥ sṛṣṭiśca śāśvatī \|\| 14 \|\|*

*śraddhā puṣṭiśca tandrā ca lajjā śobhā dayā tathā \|*  
*satāṃ sampatsvarūpā śrīrvipattirasatāmiha \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. You are love for the noble people and the quarrelsome for the sinner. You happen to be the goddess of action for all the creatures. You are the one who grants noble position to the gods, the merciful goddess of Brahma and the destroyer of all the demons for the benefit of the gods.

## \|\| 66.16-17 \|\|

*prītirūpā puṇyavatāṃ pāpināṃ kalahāṅkurā \|*  
*śaśvatkarmamayī śaktiḥ sarvadā sarvajīvinām \|\| 16 \|\|*

*devebhyaḥ svapado dātrī dhāturdhātrī kṛpāmayī \|*  
*hitāya sarvadevānāṃ sarvāsuravināśinī \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. You are the Yoganidra for the ascetics, the yogic practices, yoga of the ascetics, bestower of success and grant success to siddhas besides being Siddhayogini.

## \|\| 66.18 \|\|

*yoginidrā yogarūpā yogadātrī ca yoginām \|*  
*siddhisvarūpā siddhānāṃ siddhidā siddhayoginī \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. You are the fonn of all intelligence, all strength, bestower of all knowledge, the great goddess, all knowledgeable and adorable by all.

## \|\| 66.19-20 \|\|

*brahmāṇī māheśvarī ca viṣṇumāyā ca vaiṣṇavī \|*  
*bhadradā bhadrakālī ca sarvalokabhayaṃkarī \|\| 19 \|\|*

*grāme grāme grāmadevī gṛhadevī gṛhe gṛhe \|*  
*satāṃ kīrttiḥ pratiṣṭhā ca nindā tvamasatāṃ sadā \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. You are Brahman!, Maheshvari, Vishnumaya, Vaishnavl, bestower of prosperity, BhadrakalT and are terror for all the villages, the household goddess for the householders, glory for the noble peoples and denouncement for the wicked people.

## \|\| 66.21 \|\|

*mahāyuddhe mahāmārī duṣṭasaṃhārarūpiṇī \|*  
*rakṣāsvarūpā śiṣṭānāṃ māteva hitakāriṇī \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. You are the prevailing death during the time of the war, you destroy the wicked people, protect the noble people like a mother.

## \|\| 66.22-23 \|\|

*vandyā pūjyā stutā tvaṃ ca brahmādīnāṃ ca sarvadā \|*  
*brahmaṇyarūpā viprāṇāṃ tapasyā ca tapasvinām \|\| 22 \|\|*

*vidyā vidyāvatāṃ tvaṃ ca buddhirbuddhimatāṃ satām \|*  
*medhā smṛtisvarūpā ca pratibhā pratibhāvatām \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. You are adored by Brahma and all the gods who offer prayers to you. You are the Brahmanahood of the Brahmanas and the tapas of the sages. You are intelligence of the intelligent people, wisdom of the wise, glory of the noble people and the memory and the virtues of the influential people.

## \|\| 66.24-25 \|\|

*rājñāṃ pratāparūpā ca viśāṃ vāṇijyarūpiṇī \|*  
*sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭisvarūpā tvaṃ rakṣārūpā ca pālane \|\| 24 \|\|*

*tathā'nte tvaṃ mahāmārī viśve viśvaiśca pūjite \|*  
*kālarātrirmahārātrirmoharātriśca mohinī \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. You are the glory of the kings, business of the business people, creation for the lord of creation, protection during the time of maintenance and the death at the time of dissolution. You are adored by all the people in the universe, you are Kalaratri, Maharatri, Moharatri and Mohinl.

## \|\| 66.26-27 \|\|

*duratyayā me māyā tvaṃ yayā saṃmohitaṃ jagat \|*  
*yayā mugdho hi vidvāṃśca mokṣamārgaṃ na paśyati \|\| 26 \|\|*

*ityātmanā kṛtaṃ stotraṃ durgāyā durganāśanam \|*  
*pūjākāle paṭhedyo hi siddhirbhavati vāñchitā \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. You are great illusion which has the entire universe influenced by you; even the intellectual are unable to find the way to salvation. Whosoever recites the stotra which destroys miseries, he will achieve all success.

## \|\| 66.28-29 \|\|

*vandhyā ca kākavandhyā ca mṛtavatsā ca durbhagā \|*  
*śrutvā stotraṃ varṣamekaṃ suputraṃ labhate dhuvam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*kārāgāre mahāghore yo baddho dṛḍhabandhane \|*  
*śrutvā stotraṃ māsamekaṃ bandhanānmucyate dhuvam \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. The barren women or the women who produce dead children can surely get the son after reciting the stotra for a year. The one who is lodged in the prison with fetters, can be freed form all the fetters if he recites this for a month.

## \|\| 66.30-31 \|\|

*yakṣmagrasto galatkuṣṭhī mahāśūlī mahājvarī \|*  
*śrutvā stotraṃ varṣamekaṃ sadyo rogātpramucyate \|\| 30 \|\|*

*putrabhede prajābhede patnībhede ca durgataḥ \|*  
*śrutvā stotraṃ māsamekaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. The person suffering from consumption, leprosy, stomach-ache or high fever, could be relieved of the ailment after listening to the stotra for a year. With the developing of jealousy with the son, the people and the wife, one can be relieved of the troubles by reciting this mantra for a month. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 66.32 \|\|

*rājadvāre śmaśāne ca mahāraṇye raṇasthale \|*  
*hiṃsrajantusamīpe ca śrutvā stotraṃ pramucyate \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. With the reciting of this mantra a person becomes fearless in the royal court, cremation ground, thick forest, battle field and among the wild animals.

## \|\| 66.33 \|\|

*gṛhadāhe ca dāvāgnau dasyusainyasamanvite \|*  
*stotraśravaṇamātreṇa labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. One is relieved of the danger by the hearing of the stotra, when the house is in flames, the forest fire and when one is surrounded by thieves, dacoits and the army.

## \|\| 66.34 \|\|

*mahādaridro mūrkhaśca varṣaṃ stotraṃ paṭhettu yaḥ \|*  
*vidyāvāndhanavāṃścaiva sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The totally foolish person or a pauper will achieve all knowledge and riches if one recites the stotra for one year. There is no doubt.

## Chapter 67

## \|\| 67.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvajñānaviśārada \|*  
*brahmāṇḍamohanaṃ nāma prakṛteḥ kavacaṃ vada \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said – О lord, you are very well aware of all the Dharmas and are well-versed in the divine knowledge. You kindly enlighten me on the Brahmandamohanakavacha of the goddess.

## \|\| 67.2 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu vakṣyāmi he vatsa kavacaṃ ca sudurlabham \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇenaiva kathitaṃ kṛpayā brahmaṇe purā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Narayana said – О son, you listen to me; I am speaking out the kavacha which is difficult to get but the knowledge of the same was imparted by lord Krishna to Brahma.

## \|\| 67.3-4 \|\|

*brahmaṇā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dharmārthaṃ jāhnavītaṭe \|*  
*dharmeṇa dattaṃ mahyaṃ ca kṛpayā puṣkare prabhuḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tripurāriśca yaddhṛtvā jaghāna tripuraṃ purā \|*  
*mumoca dhātā yaddhṛtvā madhukaiṭabhayorbhayam \|*  
*jaghāna raktabījaṃ taṃ yatkṛtvā bhadrakālikā \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. In earlier times Brahma spoke to Dharma on the bank of the Ganga and Dharma in turn imparted knowledge of the same to me gracefully at the Puskara-ksetra. It was held by Shiva in earlier times at the time of the killing of Tripurasura and by holding such, Brahma was relieved of the danger of Madhukaitabha, by holding which Bhadrakall killed Raktablja.

## \|\| 67.5-6 \|\|

*yaddhṛtvā tu mahendraśca saṃprāpa kamalālayām \|*  
*yaddhṛtvā ca mahākālaścirajīvī ca dhārmikaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*yaddhṛtvā ca mahājñānī nandī sānandapūrvakam \|*  
*yaddhṛtvā ca mahāyoddhā rāmaḥ śatrubhayaṅkaraḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. By holding which Mahendra achieved the abode of Lakshmi. By achieving which Mahakala, crowned with Dharma, enjoyed long life and by holding which Nandi blissfully achieved the divine knowledge. By holding which Parashurama became a great warrior and by holding which Durvasa became a great intellectual.

## \|\| 67.7-9 \|\|

*yaddhṛtvā śivatulyaśca durvāsā jñānināṃ varaḥ \|*  
*oṃ durgeti caturthyantaṃ svāhānto me śiro'vatu \|\| 7 \|\|*

*mantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaro'yaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ kalpapādapaḥ \|*  
*vicāro nāsti vedeṣu grahaṇe ca manormune \|\| 8 \|\|*

*mantragrahaṇamātreṇa viṣṇutulyo bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*mama vaktraṃ sadā pātu coṃ durgāyai namo'ntataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. The mantra is зй W this mantra is like kalpavrksa and should protect my head. О sage there is nothing specifically mentioned about the holding of his mantra; by receiving this mantra one at once becomes equal to Vishnu. … this mantra should protect my mouth, зй this mantra should protect my throat.

## \|\| 67.10-14 \|\|

*oṃ durge rakṣayati ca kaṇṭhaṃ pātu sadā mama \|*  
*oṃ hrīṃ śrīmiti mantro'yaṃ skandhaṃ pātu nirantaram \|\| 10 \|\|*

*oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīmiti pṛṣṭhaṃ ca pātu me sarvataḥ sadā \|*  
*hrīṃ me vakṣaḥsthalaṃ pātu hastaṃ śrīmiti santatam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ pātu sarvāṅgaṃ svapne jāgaraṇe tathā \|*  
*prācaṃ māṃ prakṛtiḥ pātu pātu vahnau ca caṇḍikā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇe bhadrakālī ca nairṛtyāṃ ca maheśvarī \|*  
*vāruṇyāṃ pātu vārāhī vāyavyāṃ sarvamaṅgalā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*uttare vaiṣṇavī pātu tathaiśānyāṃ śivapriyā \|*  
*jale sthale cāntarikṣe pātu māṃ jagadambikā \|\| 14 \|\|*

10-14. … this mantra should protect my shoulders and the mantra … should protect my back, 'll should protect my chest, sft should always protect my hand, зй чей protects all my limbs while sleeping or awake. The goddess Prakriti should protect me from the east. Chandika should protect me from the southeast. Bhadrakali should protect me from the south, Maheshvari should protect me from the north-west. Varahi should protect me from the west, Sarvamangala should protect me from the south-west and Vaishnavl should protect me from the north, Shivapriya the beloved of Shiva should protect me from the north-east. Jagadambika should protect me from the water, earth and the sky.

## \|\| 67.15-16 \|\|

*iti te kathitaṃ vatsa kavacaṃ ca sudurlabham \|*  
*yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ pravaktavyaṃ na kasyacit \|\| 15 \|\|*

*gurumabhyarcya vidhivadvastrālaṃkāracandanaiḥ \|*  
*kavacaṃ dhārayedyastu so'pi viṣṇurna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. О son, thus I am spoken to you the kavacha which is difficult to get, this should not be given to anyone nor should its knowledge be imparted to everyone. After offering the costumes and ornaments to the teacher, one should hold this kavacha and the one who holds the same becomes Vishnu himself. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 67.17 \|\|

*bhramaṇe sarvatīrthānāṃ pṛthivyāśca pradakṣiṇe \|*  
*yatphalaṃ labhate lokastadetaddhāraṇānmune \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. О sage the merit one gets by making a pilgrimage to all the holy places on earth, the same merit is achieved by a person who holds it.

## \|\| 67.18 \|\|

*pañcalakṣajapenaiva siddhametadbhaveddhruvam \|*  
*loke ca siddhakavacaṃ nāstraṃ vidhyati saṃkaṭe \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. By reciting the mantra five lakhs of times, one meets with success. When someone meditates with this mantra, he cannot be injured by any weapon. He cannot be killed in water, flames of fire, administering of poison or fever.

## \|\| 67.19 \|\|

*na tasya mṛtyurbhavati jale vahnau viśeddhruvam \|*  
*jīvanmukto bhavetso'pi sarvasiddheśvaraḥ svayam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He meets with all the success and is freed from the birth and death. A person himself becomes the Siddhakavacha and is equated with lord Vishnu himself.

## \|\| 67.20-21 \|\|

*yadi syātsiddhakavaco viṣṇutulyo bhaveddhruvam \|*  
*kathitaṃ prakṛteḥ khaṇḍaṃ sudhākhaṇḍātparaṃ mune \|\| 20 \|\|*

*yā caiva mūlaprakṛtiryasyāḥ putro gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā kṛṣṇavrataṃ sā ca lebhe gaṇapatiṃ sutam \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. О sage thus I have narrated to you the entire Prakritikhanda which is better then Sudhakhanda. The one who is known as Mula-Prakriti and whose son was Ganesha, the same Prakriti accepted Ganapati as her son in fulfilment of the vrata of lord Krishna and lord Krishna also became Ganapati from his rays.

## \|\| 67.22 \|\|

*svāṃśena kṛṣṇo bhagavānbabhūva ca gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*śrutvā ca prakṛteḥ khaṇḍaṃ suśrāvyaṃ ca sudhopamam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Thus the Prakritikhanda is like nectar for all. After listening to the Prakritikhanda one should offer curd and other food to the Brahmanas giving away gold in charity.

## \|\| 67.23-24 \|\|

*bhojayitvā ca dadhyannaṃ tasmai dadyācca kāñcanam \|*  
*savatsāṃ surabhiṃ ramyāṃ dadyādvai bhaktipūrvakam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*vāso'laṃkāraratnaiśca toṣayedvācakaṃ mune \|*  
*puṣpālaṃkāravasanairupahāragaṇaistathā \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Thereafter, he should also give away a cow and a calf in charity. О sage, the reciter of the Prakritikhanda should be pleased with the offerings of the costumes, ornaments and gems besides the flowers etc. He should also worship the book with devotion.

## \|\| 67.25-26 \|\|

*pustakaṃ pūjayedevaṃ bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ kṛtvā yaḥ śṛṇoti tasya viṣṇuḥ prasīdati \|\| 25 \|\|*

*varddhate putrapautrādiryaśasvī tatprasādataḥ \|*  
*lakṣmīrvasati tadgehe hyante golokamāpnuyāt \|*  
*labhetkṛṣṇasya dāsyaṃ sa bhaktiṃ kṛṣṇe suniścalām \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Thus whosoever listens to it with attention and devotion, he pleases lord Vishnu. With his grace one achieves sons, grandsons and glory and his house always remains filled with riches. He ultimately reaches the Goloka and he achieves the slavehood of lord Krishna.
